teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as part of a person's full name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，在完整姓名中用于标示家族名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem sħiħ ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Caffari。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-formola, Anna huwa l-isem u Caffari huwa l-kunjom.
formal.en: In the example on the form, Anna is the given name and Caffari is the surname.
formal.zh: 在表格示例中，Anna 是名字，Caffari 是姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-kunjom tiegħek Caffari? Anna: Iva, Caffari. Jinkiteb b'żewġ f.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is your surname Caffari? Anna: Yes, Caffari. It is written with two f's.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你姓 Caffari 吗？Anna：是的，Caffari，拼写中有两个 f。

messages.speaker: Marta (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓 Caffari 吗？
messages.en: Is your surname Caffari?

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 是的，Caffari，拼写中有两个 f。
messages.en: Yes, Caffari. It is written with two f's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Caffari 放进表格的“姓氏”栏，特别圈出中间连续的两个 f，并记住姓氏首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as part of a person's full name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，在完整姓名中用于标示家族名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem sħiħ ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Calafato。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lista tal-mistednin, Maria huwa l-isem u Calafato huwa l-kunjom.
formal.en: In the example guest list, Maria is the given name and Calafato is the surname.
formal.zh: 在宾客名单示例中，Maria 是名字，Calafato 是姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek, Calafato? Maria: C, a, l, a, f, a, t, o.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How do you spell your surname, Calafato? Maria: C, a, l, a, f, a, t, o.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你的姓 Calafato 怎么拼？Maria：C、a、l、a、f、a、t、o。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓 Calafato 怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname, Calafato?

messages.speaker: Maria (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: C, a, l, a, f, a, t, o.
messages.mt_standard: C, a, l, a, f, a, t, o.
messages.zh: C、a、l、a、f、a、t、o。
messages.en: C, a, l, a, f, a, t, o.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Calafato 当作姓名卡上的姓来记：按字母观察三个 a 和末尾的 o，不必另猜词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as part of a person's full name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，在完整姓名中用于标示家族名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem sħiħ ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Camilleri。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tar-reġistru, Mark huwa l-isem u Camilleri huwa l-kunjom.
formal.en: In the example register, Mark is the given name and Camilleri is the surname.
formal.zh: 在登记表示例中，Mark 是名字，Camilleri 是姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Camilleri. David: Iva, is-Sur Camilleri qed jistenniek.
colloquial.en: Rita: I have an appointment with Mr Camilleri. David: Yes, Mr Camilleri is expecting you.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我和 Camilleri 先生有预约。David：好的，Camilleri 先生正在等您。

messages.speaker: Rita (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Camilleri 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Camilleri.

messages.speaker: David (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，Camilleri 先生正在等您。
messages.en: Yes, Mr Camilleri is expecting you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Camilleri 写在预约卡的姓氏栏，用“先生加姓氏”的搭配记忆，并特别留意连续的两个 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏，用于表示一个人的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Carabott bagħat it-talba tiegħu bil-miktub.
formal.en: Mr Carabott submitted his request in writing.
formal.zh: Carabott先生以书面形式提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kunjom għandek? Mark: Il-kunjom tiegħi huwa Carabott.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your surname? Mark: My surname is Carabott.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姓什么？Mark：我姓Carabott。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我姓Carabott。
messages.en: My surname is Carabott.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Carabott放进姓名卡的“姓氏”栏，再搭配is-Sur练习“Carabott先生”，用称呼场景记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person by surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem tal-familja li persuna tuża bħala kunjom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Cassar iffirmat id-dokument qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mrs Cassar signed the document before the meeting.
formal.zh: Cassar女士在会议前签署了文件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? Lara: Cassar, b'żewġ s.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you spell your surname? Lara: Cassar, with two s's.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你的姓怎么拼？Lara：Cassar，有两个s。

messages.speaker: Nina (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: Cassar，有两个s。
messages.en: Cassar, with two s's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Cassar写在访客登记表的姓氏栏，特别圈出中间的双写ss，再用“Cassar女士”复述一遍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname that serves as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为个人家族姓使用的姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jindika l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Cauchi se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-familja.
formal.en: Mr Cauchi will attend the meeting as the family's representative.
formal.zh: Cauchi先生将代表家人出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Inti s-Sur Cauchi? Paul: Iva, jien. Għandi appuntament fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you Mr Cauchi? Paul: Yes, that's me. I have an appointment at ten.
colloquial.zh: Sara：您是Cauchi先生吗？Paul：是的，我预约了十点。

messages.speaker: Sara (接待员)
messages.zh: 您是Cauchi先生吗？
messages.en: Are you Mr Cauchi?

messages.speaker: Paul (访客)
messages.zh: 是的，我预约了十点。
messages.en: Yes, that's me. I have an appointment at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象接待员拿着写有Cauchi的预约卡，开口确认“Cauchi先生”，把拼写和姓氏称呼一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family surname used as part of a person's name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人姓名中表示家族姓的姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem ta' persuna u jindika l-familja tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Chetcuti ppreżentat ir-rapport lill-kumitat.
formal.en: Mrs Chetcuti presented the report to the committee.
formal.zh: Chetcuti女士向委员会提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'kunjom inpoġġi fuq il-lista? Anna: Chetcuti, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: What surname should I put on the list? Anna: Chetcuti, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：名单上该填什么姓？Anna：请填Chetcuti。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动工作人员)
messages.zh: 名单上该填什么姓？
messages.en: What surname should I put on the list?

messages.speaker: Anna (参加者)
messages.zh: 请填Chetcuti。
messages.en: Chetcuti, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Chetcuti抄进活动名单的姓氏栏，按字母顺序核对拼写，再练习用is-Sinjura加姓氏称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to name a person as a member of a family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示个人所属家族、用作家族姓的姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jservi bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Il-familja Curmi rċeviet stedina uffiċjali għaċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The Curmi family received an official invitation to the ceremony.
formal.zh: Curmi一家收到了出席典礼的正式邀请。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal min hu dan il-pakkett? Ben: Għas-Sur Curmi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is this parcel for? Ben: It's for Mr Curmi.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个包裹是给谁的？Ben：给Curmi先生的。

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 这个包裹是给谁的？
messages.en: Who is this parcel for?

messages.speaker: Ben (快递员)
messages.zh: 给Curmi先生的。
messages.en: It's for Mr Curmi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹标签上写着“Curmi先生”，用收件人的姓氏来记Curmi，再联想il-familja Curmi表示一家人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as the family-name part of a person's name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于个人姓名中家族姓部分的姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża għall-parti tal-isem ta' persuna li tindika l-familja tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，家族姓。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Cutajar ikkonfermat li rċeviet l-ittra.
formal.en: Mrs Cutajar confirmed that she had received the letter.
formal.zh: Cutajar女士确认已收到信件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prenotazzjoni fuq liema kunjom hi? Rita: Fuq il-kunjom Cutajar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What surname is the reservation under? Rita: It's under the surname Cutajar.
colloquial.zh: Maja：预订登记的是哪个姓？Rita：登记的是Cutajar。

messages.speaker: Maja (餐厅接待员)
messages.zh: 预订登记的是哪个姓？
messages.en: What surname is the reservation under?

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 登记的是Cutajar。
messages.en: It's under the surname Cutajar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Cutajar想成餐厅预订簿上的姓氏，练习“登记在Cutajar名下”的完整场景，帮助记住用途和拼写。

gloss_zh: 可引起溃疡的；致溃疡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that can cause ulcers to form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某物能够引起溃疡形成，强调其致溃疡的可能性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jikkawża ulċerazzjoni, jiġifieri l-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可引起溃疡形成的；具有致溃疡作用的。

collocations.en: a material that can cause ulceration

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-materjal bħala dabbari, jiġifieri li jista' jikkawża l-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri.
formal.en: The text describes the material as capable of causing ulceration, meaning that it can cause ulcers to form.
formal.zh: 课文将这种材料描述为可致溃疡的，即它可能引起溃疡形成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser dabbari f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tista' tikkawża ulċeri.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does dabbari mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that something can cause ulcers.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这句话里的dabbari是什么意思？Mark：意思是某物可能引起溃疡。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的dabbari是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dabbari mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tista' tikkawża ulċeri.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tista' tikkawża ulċeri.
messages.zh: 意思是某物可能引起溃疡。
messages.en: It means that something can cause ulcers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dabbari写在“可能导致溃疡”的箭头旁，记住它描述致溃疡的性质；学习时特别保留“可能”这一层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the star known in English as Aldebaran.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恒星毕宿五的名称，英语称为Aldebaran。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-istilla magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Aldebaran.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毕宿五，恒星名称，英语为Aldebaran。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-isem Dabrani jirreferi għall-istilla magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Aldebaran.
formal.en: In the lesson, the name Dabrani refers to the star known in English as Aldebaran.
formal.zh: 在这节课中，Dabrani这个名称指英语称为Aldebaran的恒星，即毕宿五。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu Dabrani? Paul: Huwa l-isem ta' stilla, Aldebaran bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is Dabrani? Paul: It's the name of a star, Aldebaran in English.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Dabrani是什么？Paul：是一颗恒星的名称，英语叫Aldebaran，中文叫毕宿五。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: Dabrani是什么？
messages.en: What is Dabrani?

messages.speaker: Paul (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-isem ta' stilla, Aldebaran bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-isem ta' stilla, Aldebaran bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是一颗恒星的名称，英语叫Aldebaran，中文叫毕宿五。
messages.en: It's the name of a star, Aldebaran in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一颗星，在旁边并排写Dabrani、Aldebaran、毕宿五，把三种语言的名称连起来；首字母大写帮助提示专名。

gloss_zh: 反复编织；编辫子；编织者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To weave or plait repeatedly, interlacing strands to make a braid or a woven object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复把若干股材料交叉编在一起，编成辫子或编织物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinsiġ jew jagħmel nisġiet darba wara oħra billi jqassam u jdaħħal il-ħjut jew materjal ieħor f'xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to weave or plait (frequentative form of 'dafar')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复编织或编辫子，为 dafar 的反复动作形式。
编辫子或从事编织的人；编织者。

formal.mt: Matul il-wirja, l-artiġjan daffar il-qasab biex juri lill-istudenti kif isir qoffa.
formal.en: During the exhibition, the craftsman wove reeds to show the students how a basket is made.
formal.zh: 展览期间，工匠编织芦苇，向学生展示篮子的制作方法。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min daffar ix-xagħar ta' Sara? Pawlu: Ħuha; qagħad jaħdem fuqu bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who braided Sara's hair? Pawlu: Her brother; he worked on it patiently.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁给萨拉编的辫子？保罗：她哥哥；他很耐心地编好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给萨拉编的辫子？
messages.en: Who braided Sara's hair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 她哥哥；他很耐心地编好了。
messages.en: Her brother; he worked on it patiently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手反复交叉编头发，把 daffar 记成编织动作；作名词时则指做这件事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plait or braid made by interlacing strands of hair or another flexible material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把头发或其他柔软材料分股交叉编成的辫子或辫状物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nisġa magħmula minn trofof tax-xagħar jew minn materjal ieħor li jiddaħħlu f'xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辫子；由若干股材料交叉编成的辫状物。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, it-tifla tidher b'dafra twila marbuta b'żigarella ħamra.
formal.en: In the photograph, the girl is shown with a long braid tied with a red ribbon.
formal.zh: 照片中的女孩梳着一条长辫子，辫子上系着红丝带。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tagħmilli dafra qabel noħorġu? Marija: Iva, ġib il-moxt u żigarella.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you braid my hair before we go out? Marija: Yes, bring the comb and a ribbon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：出门前你能帮我编条辫子吗？玛丽娅：可以，把梳子和一条丝带拿来。

messages.speaker: Sara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 出门前你能帮我编条辫子吗？
messages.en: Can you braid my hair before we go out?

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.zh: 可以，把梳子和一条丝带拿来。
messages.en: Yes, bring the comb and a ribbon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dafra 和一条系着红丝带的辫子联系起来，重点记住它表示编好的成品。

gloss_zh: 心绪不宁；情绪上的困扰

teaching_sense.en_definition: Emotional upset or disturbance caused by something distressing or unsettling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由令人难受或不安的事情引起的情绪困扰或心绪不宁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqlib jew inkwiet fil-qalb minħabba xi ħaġa li tħawwad jew iddejjaq lil persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人心烦意乱的情绪困扰；内心受到搅扰。

formal.mt: Il-bidla f'daqqa fil-pjanijiet ikkawżat dagħdiegħ fost il-membri tal-familja.
formal.en: The sudden change in plans caused emotional upset among the family members.
formal.zh: 计划的突然改变让家人感到心绪不宁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-aħbar ġabitli ħafna dagħdiegħ. Nina: Trid toqgħod ftit miegħi u nitkellmu?
colloquial.en: Lara: This news has really upset me. Nina: Would you like to sit with me for a while and talk?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个消息让我心里很乱。妮娜：要不要和我坐一会儿，聊一聊？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个消息让我心里很乱。
messages.en: This news has really upset me.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toqgħod ftit miegħi u nitkellmu?
messages.mt_standard: Trid toqgħod ftit miegħi u nitkellmu?
messages.zh: 要不要和我坐一会儿，聊一聊？
messages.en: Would you like to sit with me for a while and talk?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计划突然改变后心里翻腾的感觉，把 dagħdiegħ 和心绪被搅乱的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily angered or irritated; inclined to be cranky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易生气或烦躁的；脾气乖戾、容易不高兴的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrabja jew jiddejjaq malajr u jkun ta' burdata ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发怒的；动辄生气的。
脾气乖戾的；烦躁而容易不高兴的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala raġel dagħdiegħi li jirrabja anki għal ħsejjes żgħar.
formal.en: In the novel, the neighbour is described as an irritable man who gets angry even at slight noises.
formal.zh: 小说把这位邻居描写成一个易怒的男人，连轻微的声响都会使他生气。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark hu daqshekk dagħdiegħi llum? Luqa: Ma raqadx sew u kollox qed idejqu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Mark so cranky today? Luqa: He didn't sleep well, and everything is bothering him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克今天怎么这么烦躁？卢卡：他没睡好，什么事都让他心烦。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark hu daqshekk dagħdiegħi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark hu daqshekk dagħdiegħi llum?
messages.zh: 马克今天怎么这么烦躁？
messages.en: Why is Mark so cranky today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma raqadx sew u kollox qed idejqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma raqadx sew u kollox qed idejqu.
messages.zh: 他没睡好，什么事都让他心烦。
messages.en: He didn't sleep well, and everything is bothering him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个没睡好、听到一点声音就生气的人，用这个人物记住 dagħdiegħi 的易怒含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Anger, especially when it is strong enough to become rage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愤怒的情绪，尤其指强烈到近乎暴怒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabja, speċjalment meta tkun qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愤怒；生气的情绪。
暴怒；极其强烈的愤怒。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur esprima dagħdigħ qawwi għall-mod kif ġew ittrattati l-ħaddiema.
formal.en: In his letter, the author expressed intense anger at the way the workers had been treated.
formal.zh: 作者在信中对工人受到的对待表达了强烈的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għadni mimli dagħdigħ wara dik il-laqgħa. Rita: Ejja nimxu ftit, imbagħad nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Toni: I'm still full of anger after that meeting. Rita: Let's walk for a bit, then talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：开完那个会，我现在还是满肚子火。丽塔：我们先走一会儿，然后平静地聊聊。

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mimli dagħdigħ wara dik il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mimli dagħdigħ wara dik il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 开完那个会，我现在还是满肚子火。
messages.en: I'm still full of anger after that meeting.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nimxu ftit, imbagħad nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nimxu ftit, imbagħad nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我们先走一会儿，然后平静地聊聊。
messages.en: Let's walk for a bit, then talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dagħdigħ 想成胸中积着的一团怒火，记住它表示愤怒情绪本身，可以很强烈。

gloss_zh: 一阵暴怒；一次怒气爆发

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular bout of rage or an outburst in which someone suddenly expresses anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的暴怒发作，或突然把怒气表现出来的爆发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mument jew episodju ta' rabja kbira, jew tifqigħa li fiha persuna turi r-rabja tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵暴怒；一次盛怒发作。
一次怒气爆发；突然发作的愤怒表现。

formal.mt: Wara d-dagħdigħa tiegħu waqt id-diskussjoni, il-parteċipant talab skuża lill-bqija tal-grupp.
formal.en: After his angry outburst during the discussion, the participant apologised to the rest of the group.
formal.zh: 这位参与者在讨论中发了一通火，随后向小组其他成员道歉。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Smajt id-dagħdigħa tiegħu meta tilef iċ-ċwievet? David: Iva, imma wara sabhom u kkalma.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you hear his angry outburst when he lost his keys? David: Yes, but then he found them and calmed down.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他丢了钥匙时发的那通火，你听到了吗？戴维：听到了，不过后来他找到了钥匙，也平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt id-dagħdigħa tiegħu meta tilef iċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt id-dagħdigħa tiegħu meta tilef iċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 他丢了钥匙时发的那通火，你听到了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear his angry outburst when he lost his keys?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma wara sabhom u kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma wara sabhom u kkalma.
messages.zh: 听到了，不过后来他找到了钥匙，也平静下来了。
messages.en: Yes, but then he found them and calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dagħdigħa 记成一次拍桌发火的完整片段；与 dagħdigħ 的愤怒情绪对照，突出这一次发作。

gloss_zh: 令人忧郁的；颜色深暗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to make someone sad or gloomy; also describing something dark in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人悲伤或心情阴郁的；也形容颜色深暗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jnikket jew idaħħal id-dwejjaq; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa ta' lewn skur.

sense_translations.en_definition: apt to sadden or make gloomy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易令人悲伤的；使人心情阴郁的。
颜色深暗的；色泽暗沉的。

formal.mt: Il-pittur għażel lewn dagħmiem għall-isfond biex isaħħaħ is-sens ta' dwejjaq fix-xena.
formal.en: The painter chose a dark shade for the background to heighten the sense of sadness in the scene.
formal.zh: 画家为背景选用了深暗的色调，以加强画面中的悲伤感。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kemm hu dagħmiem dan il-kliem fl-aħħar tal-istorja! Ben: Iva, ħallieni mdejjaq ukoll.
colloquial.en: Elena: How gloomy those words at the end of the story are! Ben: Yes, they left me feeling sad too.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：故事结尾这些话真让人忧郁！本：是啊，我读完也觉得难过。

messages.speaker: Elena (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu dagħmiem dan il-kliem fl-aħħar tal-istorja!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu dagħmiem dan il-kliem fl-aħħar tal-istorja!
messages.zh: 故事结尾这些话真让人忧郁！
messages.en: How gloomy those words at the end of the story are!

messages.speaker: Ben (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 是啊，我读完也觉得难过。
messages.en: Yes, they left me feeling sad too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅深暗色调的悲伤画面，把 dagħmiem 的颜色暗沉与令人忧郁两个义项一起记住。

gloss_zh: 咒骂；诅咒；亵渎神明的言语

teaching_sense.en_definition: A swear word or curse; also an utterance that insults God or something regarded as sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一句咒骂或诅咒的话；也指侮辱神明或神圣事物的亵渎言语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew espressjoni ta' saħta jew kliem ħażin; ukoll kliem li joffendi lil Alla jew lil dak li jitqies qaddis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂的话；诅咒语。
亵渎神明或神圣事物的言语；亵渎。

collocations.en: uttered a swear word or curse

formal.mt: Fix-xhieda tiegħu, ix-xhud qal li sema' dagħwa waqt l-argument, iżda ma rrepetiex il-kliem eżatt.
formal.en: In his testimony, the witness said that he had heard a curse during the argument, but he did not repeat the exact words.
formal.zh: 证人在证词中说，他在争吵时听到了一句咒骂，但没有复述原话。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qal meta waqa' l-martell fuq siequ? Karl: Qal dagħwa, imbagħad poġġa bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did he say when the hammer fell on his foot? Karl: He swore, then sat down.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：锤子掉到他脚上时，他说了什么？卡尔：他骂了一句，然后坐下了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal meta waqa' l-martell fuq siequ?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal meta waqa' l-martell fuq siequ?
messages.zh: 锤子掉到他脚上时，他说了什么？
messages.en: What did he say when the hammer fell on his foot?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.zh: 他骂了一句，然后坐下了。
messages.en: He swore, then sat down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漫画人物生气时冒出一串骂人符号，把 dagħwa 记成一句咒骂；涉及神圣对象时则记为亵渎。

gloss_zh: 引导；带领；另作名词指管家

teaching_sense.en_definition: To guide someone along a route or around a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导某人前进，或带领某人参观一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tmexxi lil xi ħadd fi triq jew turih post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引导；带领
管家；负责管理家宅事务的人

collocations.en: guided the guests around the house

formal.mt: Il-gwida dajjar lill-viżitaturi madwar il-palazz u spjega l-użu ta' kull kamra.
formal.en: The guide led the visitors around the palace and explained the use of each room.
formal.zh: 导游带领访客参观宫殿，并说明了每个房间的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min dajjar lill-mistednin madwar id-dar? Pawlu: Mark; uriehom il-kmamar u l-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who guided the guests around the house? Pawlu: Mark; he showed them the rooms and the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁带客人参观房子了？保罗：马克，他带他们看了房间和花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 谁带客人参观房子了？
messages.en: Who guided the guests around the house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 马克，他带他们看了房间和花园。
messages.en: Mark; he showed them the rooms and the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张词卡记忆：动词卡画带路的人，名词卡画管理家宅事务的管家，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 易于使受精或授粉的；具有传播力或感染力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to bring about fertilisation or pollination; also able to spread among people, as an idea or habit can.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使受精或授粉的倾向的；也形容思想、习惯等容易在人群中传播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jġib il-fertilizzazzjoni jew id-dakra; ukoll, li jista' jinxtered fost in-nies, bħal ħsieb jew drawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a propensity to fertilise or pollinate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使受精或授粉的倾向的

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to spread among people (used of ideas, habits etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够在人群中传播的；具有感染力的，用于思想、习惯等

formal.mt: L-entużjażmu dakkari tal-għalliem ħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jieħdu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The teacher's infectious enthusiasm encouraged the students to take part in the discussion.
formal.zh: 教师富有感染力的热情鼓励了学生参与讨论。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Pawlu għandu entużjażmu dakkari għal dan il-proġett. Lara: Veru! Wara li tkellimt miegħu, ridt nieħu sehem jien ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Pawlu has infectious enthusiasm for this project. Lara: True! After talking to him, I wanted to take part too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：保罗对这个项目的热情很有感染力。拉拉：真的！跟他聊过以后，我也想参加了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għandu entużjażmu dakkari għal dan il-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għandu entużjażmu dakkari għal dan il-proġett.
messages.zh: 保罗对这个项目的热情很有感染力。
messages.en: Pawlu has infectious enthusiasm for this project.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Wara li tkellimt miegħu, ridt nieħu sehem jien ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Wara li tkellimt miegħu, ridt nieħu sehem jien ukoll.
messages.zh: 真的！跟他聊过以后，我也想参加了。
messages.en: True! After talking to him, I wanted to take part too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅学习画面并列记忆：昆虫帮助授粉，热情在人群中传播；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pollinating flowers artificially through deliberate human intervention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人为操作使花朵授粉的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jsir it-trasferiment tal-polline għall-fjuri b'mod artifiċjali, bl-intervent tal-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人工授粉的行为

formal.mt: Id-dakra tal-fjuri saret bl-idejn, u d-data ta' kull intervent ġiet irreġistrata.
formal.en: The flowers were artificially pollinated by hand, and the date of each intervention was recorded.
formal.zh: 这些花朵接受了手工人工授粉，每次操作的日期都作了记录。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għamilt id-dakra tal-fjuri dalgħodu? Pawlu: Iva, u mmarkajt il-fjuri li ħdimt fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you artificially pollinate the flowers this morning? Pawlu: Yes, and I marked the flowers I worked on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天早上给花做人工授粉了吗？保罗：做了，我还标记了处理过的花。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺师)
messages.zh: 你今天早上给花做人工授粉了吗？
messages.en: Did you artificially pollinate the flowers this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mmarkajt il-fjuri li ħdimt fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mmarkajt il-fjuri li ħdimt fuqhom.
messages.zh: 做了，我还标记了处理过的花。
messages.en: Yes, and I marked the flowers I worked on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园艺师拿小刷子为花传递花粉，把 dakra 记成“人工授粉这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the night before today; last night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在今天之前的那个夜晚，即昨夜或昨晚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Matul il-lejl li għadda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昨夜；昨晚

formal.mt: Dal-lejl għamlet ħafna xita u diversi toroq ingħalqu.
formal.en: It rained heavily last night, and several roads were closed.
formal.zh: 昨夜下了大雨，几条道路被封闭了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Irqadt tajjeb dal-lejl? Ben: Le, kien hemm ħafna storbju fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you sleep well last night? Ben: No, there was a lot of noise in the street.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你昨晚睡得好吗？本：不好，街上很吵。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did you sleep well last night?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien hemm ħafna storbju fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien hemm ħafna storbju fit-triq.
messages.zh: 不好，街上很吵。
messages.en: No, there was a lot of noise in the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dal-lejl 放在今天左边的月亮图标下，配着过去发生的事，记作“昨夜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very frequently; on many occasions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很频繁地，表示某个动作或情况经常发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' spiss ħafna; f'ħafna okkażjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很频繁地；常常

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-grupp jiltaqgħu dali biex jiddiskutu l-progress tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The members of the group meet very frequently to discuss the progress of the work.
formal.zh: 小组成员经常会面，讨论工作进展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiltaqa' dali ma' Sara? Mark: Iva, naraha kważi kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you meet Sara very frequently? Mark: Yes, I see her almost every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你经常和萨拉见面吗？马克：是啊，我几乎每天都见到她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常和萨拉见面吗？
messages.en: Do you meet Sara very frequently?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我几乎每天都见到她。
messages.en: Yes, I see her almost every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dali 放进日历画面：许多日期都标着同一件事，帮助记住“很频繁地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flowering plant of the genus Dahlia, grown for its showy flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大丽花属的开花植物，常因花朵鲜艳醒目而被栽种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Dahlia, imkabbra għall-fjuri sbieħ u li jispikkaw tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大丽花，大丽花属植物

formal.mt: Dalja ħamra tħawlet ħdejn id-daħla tal-ġnien.
formal.en: A red dahlia was planted near the entrance to the garden.
formal.zh: 花园入口附近种下了一株红色大丽花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Din dalja. Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-fjura tagħha!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant called? Pawlu: This is a dahlia. Look how beautiful its flower is!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物叫什么？保罗：这是大丽花。看，它的花多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din dalja. Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-fjura tagħha!
messages.mt_standard: Din dalja. Ara kemm hi sabiħa l-fjura tagħha!
messages.zh: 这是大丽花。看，它的花多漂亮！
messages.en: This is a dahlia. Look how beautiful its flower is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dalja 写在大丽花的花盆标签上，再配一朵层层花瓣的花，建立词与图像的联系。

gloss_zh: 使变暗；工作到夜里；使变暗的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dark or darker; also, to continue working into the night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变暗或更暗；也可表示继续工作直到夜里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa mudlama jew aktar mudlama; ukoll, baqa' jaħdem sa billejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变暗；使光线减弱
工作到夜里；一直干到天黑以后

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that has a darkening effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 起遮暗作用的东西；使某物变暗的事物

formal.mt: Is-sħab oħxon dallam is-sema matul il-waranofsinhar.
formal.en: Thick clouds darkened the sky during the afternoon.
formal.zh: 午后，厚厚的云层使天空变暗了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt daqshekk tard? Toni: Kelli ħafna xogħol u dallamt naħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive so late? Toni: I had a lot of work and worked into the night.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么晚才到？托尼：我有很多工作，一直干到了夜里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么晚才到？
messages.en: Why did you arrive so late?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ħafna xogħol u dallamt naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ħafna xogħol u dallamt naħdem.
messages.zh: 我有很多工作，一直干到了夜里。
messages.en: I had a lot of work and worked into the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 dallam：拉帘使房间变暗，以及天黑后仍在工作；名词义另记为“遮暗的东西”。

gloss_zh: 使变暗的；有遮暗作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something dark or darker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变暗或使光线减弱的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa mudlama jew aktar mudlama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有使变暗的效果的；具有遮暗作用的

formal.mt: Id-drapp magħżul għandu effett dallami u jnaqqas id-dawl li jidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: The selected fabric has a darkening effect and reduces the light entering the room.
formal.zh: 选用的布料具有遮暗作用，能减少进入房间的光线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-purtiera tnaqqas id-dawl? Mark: Iva, id-drapp tagħha għandu effett dallami.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this curtain reduce the light? Mark: Yes, its fabric has a darkening effect.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这幅窗帘能减少光线吗？马克：能，它的布料有遮暗作用。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这幅窗帘能减少光线吗？
messages.en: Does this curtain reduce the light?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, id-drapp tagħha għandu effett dallami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, id-drapp tagħha għandu effett dallami.
messages.zh: 能，它的布料有遮暗作用。
messages.en: Yes, its fabric has a darkening effect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给遮光窗帘贴上 dallami 标签，记住它描述“能使环境变暗”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Darkness; a state in which there is little or no light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑暗，指光线很弱或没有光的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat fejn hemm ftit dawl jew ebda dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑暗；无光或光线微弱的状态

formal.mt: Wara li nqata' d-dawl, il-bini kollu spiċċa fid-dalma.
formal.en: After the power went out, the entire building was left in darkness.
formal.zh: 停电后，整栋建筑陷入了黑暗。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ma nara xejn f'din id-dalma! Ġanni: Stenna, se nixgħel it-torċ.
colloquial.en: Lina: I can't see anything in this darkness! Ġanni: Wait, I'll turn on the torch.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这么黑，我什么也看不见！詹尼：等等，我来打开手电筒。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这么黑，我什么也看不见！
messages.en: I can't see anything in this darkness!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 等等，我来打开手电筒。
messages.en: Wait, I'll turn on the torch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象关灯后眼前的一片黑，把这整个状态叫作 dalma；再用手电筒照亮它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A damson, a small plum often used for making jam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西洋李，一种小型李子，常用于制作果酱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' għanbaqar żgħir li spiss jintuża biex isir il-ġamm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西洋李；西洋李果实，一种小型李子

formal.mt: Għall-attività tat-togħma, kull parteċipant ingħata damaskina misjura.
formal.en: For the tasting activity, each participant was given a ripe damson.
formal.zh: 在品尝活动中，每位参加者都分到了一颗熟透的西洋李。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid idduq din id-damaskina? Luqa: Iva, imma qarsa? Marija: Ftit, iżda misjura.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like to taste this damson? Luqa: Yes, but is it sour? Marija: A little, but it's ripe.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：想尝尝这颗西洋李吗？卢卡：想，不过它酸吗？玛丽娅：有一点，但已经熟了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 想尝尝这颗西洋李吗？
messages.en: Would you like to taste this damson?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，不过它酸吗？
messages.en: Yes, but is it sour?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一点，但已经熟了。
messages.en: A little, but it's ripe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 damaskina 和英文 damson 并排写在小李子的图片旁，借对应词形和果实画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 发出震耳巨响；狠打；彻底击败

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a deafening noise; also, to beat someone violently or, colloquially, defeat an opponent thoroughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出震耳欲聋的声响；也指猛烈殴打某人，或在口语中指彻底击败对手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel ħoss qawwi ħafna; ukoll, sawwat lil xi ħadd bil-qawwa jew, fil-lingwaġġ mitkellem, għeleb avversarju għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出震耳欲聋的巨响
猛烈殴打某人；狠打某人

sense_translations.en_definition: to defeat sb. thoroughly (colloquial; e.g. in a sport)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彻底击败某人；大胜对手（口语，例如用于体育比赛）

collocations.en: the engine made a deafening noise
collocations.zh: 发动机发出了震耳的轰鸣

collocations.en: he thoroughly defeated his opponent in the game
collocations.zh: 他在比赛中彻底击败了对手

formal.mt: Il-mutur damdam meta beda jaħdem, u l-ħoss instema' fil-bini kollu.
formal.en: The engine made a deafening noise when it started, and the sound could be heard throughout the building.
formal.zh: 发动机启动时发出震耳的轰鸣，整栋建筑里都能听到。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif mar Mark fil-partita tat-tennis? Pawlu: Damdam lill-avversarju! Rebaħ sitt logħbiet għal xejn fiż-żewġ sets.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark do in the tennis match? Pawlu: He thrashed his opponent! He won six games to love in both sets.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克那场网球赛打得怎么样？保罗：他大胜对手！两盘都是六比零。

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷)
messages.zh: 马克那场网球赛打得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do in the tennis match?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Damdam lill-avversarju! Rebaħ sitt logħbiet għal xejn fiż-żewġ sets.
messages.mt_standard: Damdam lill-avversarju! Rebaħ sitt logħbiet għal xejn fiż-żewġ sets.
messages.zh: 他大胜对手！两盘都是六比零。
messages.en: He thrashed his opponent! He won six games to love in both sets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把 damdam 的重复节奏配上“轰轰”声，再分别联想猛烈殴打和球场大胜；这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rumbling or crashing sound made by thunder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雷发出的隆隆声或轰鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss qawwi jew imgerbeb tar-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雷声；雷鸣声。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, id-damdim tar-ragħad instema' minn diversi nħawi tal-gżira.
formal.en: During the night, the rumbling of thunder was heard in several parts of the island.
formal.zh: 夜间，岛上多处都听到了隆隆雷声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak id-damdim? Mark: Iva, jidher li ġejja maltempata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that thunder? Mark: Yes, it looks like a storm is coming.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到刚才的雷声了吗？马克：听到了，看样子暴风雨要来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到刚才的雷声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that thunder?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，看样子暴风雨要来了。
messages.en: Yes, it looks like a storm is coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 damdim 配上乌云与隆隆雷声的画面，记住它是声音名词，指雷鸣。

gloss_zh: 发出巨响的；声音回荡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a loud sound or a sound that echoes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容发出响亮声音或回荡声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħoss qawwi jew ħoss li jidwi.

sense_translations.en_definition: making a loud or echoing noise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出巨响的；发出回荡声的。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kellu leħen damdimi li nstema' ċar sa wara tas-sala.
formal.en: The speaker had a booming voice that could be heard clearly at the back of the hall.
formal.zh: 演讲者嗓音洪亮，连大厅后排也能听得清清楚楚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħoss damdimi għamel dak il-bieb! Pawlu: Iva, il-ħoss baqa' jidwi fit-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a loud, echoing noise that door made! Pawlu: Yes, the sound kept echoing in the stairwell.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那扇门发出的声音真响，还带着回声！保罗：是啊，声音一直在楼梯间回荡。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那扇门发出的声音真响，还带着回声！
messages.en: What a loud, echoing noise that door made!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 是啊，声音一直在楼梯间回荡。
messages.en: Yes, the sound kept echoing in the stairwell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大门砰然关上、楼梯间回声不断，用 damdimi 描述这种响亮回荡的声音。

gloss_zh: 流泪；眼睛红肿；渗出水分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shed tears; also to have red or swollen eyes, or to secrete moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流出眼泪；也可指眼睛发红或肿胀，以及分泌或渗出水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ id-dmugħ; ukoll li jkollu għajnejh ħomor jew minfuħin, jew li joħroġ l-umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流泪；流出眼泪。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have red or swollen eyes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛发红或肿胀。
分泌或渗出水分。

formal.mt: Meta rċieva l-ittra mingħand ibnu, il-missier damma' bil-ferħ.
formal.en: When he received the letter from his son, the father shed tears of joy.
formal.zh: 收到儿子的来信时，这位父亲流下了喜悦的泪水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex damma' n-nannu? Toni: Bil-ferħ, għax ra lin-neputi wara tant żmien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Grandpa shed tears? Toni: From happiness, because he saw his grandson after such a long time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷为什么流泪了？托尼：他是高兴，因为隔了那么久终于见到了孙子。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷为什么流泪了？
messages.en: Why did Grandpa shed tears?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-ferħ, għax ra lin-neputi wara tant żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-ferħ, għax ra lin-neputi wara tant żmien.
messages.zh: 他是高兴，因为隔了那么久终于见到了孙子。
messages.en: From happiness, because he saw his grandson after such a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面分开记忆：流下眼泪、眼睛红肿、表面渗水；具体义项要由语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To string things together repeatedly or in succession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西反复或接连串在一起，例如逐颗串起珠子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaqqad affarijiet f'ħolqa jew sensiela, waħda wara l-oħra, b'mod ripetut.

sense_translations.en_definition: to string together (a frequentative form of 'damm')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复或接连把东西串在一起；为 damm 的反复体形式。

collocations.en: strung pearls onto a thread one after another
collocations.zh: 把珍珠一颗颗穿到线上

formal.mt: L-artiġjan dammam iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta twila biex ħejja l-ġiżirana.
formal.en: The artisan strung the beads onto a long thread in succession to prepare the necklace.
formal.zh: 工匠把珠子逐颗穿到一根长线上，制作项链。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min dammam dawn iż-żibeġ kollha? Mark: Ħija; qatta' waranofsinhar sħiħ jagħmel il-ġiżirana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who strung all these beads together? Mark: My brother; he spent the whole afternoon making the necklace.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些珠子都是谁串起来的？马克：我哥哥，他花了整整一个下午做这条项链。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些珠子都是谁串起来的？
messages.en: Who strung all these beads together?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; qatta' waranofsinhar sħiħ jagħmel il-ġiżirana.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; qatta' waranofsinhar sħiħ jagħmel il-ġiżirana.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他花了整整一个下午做这条项链。
messages.en: My brother; he spent the whole afternoon making the necklace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指一次次把珠子穿上线，用连续重复的动作记住 dammam 的串联含义。

gloss_zh: 收集或串联物件的人；剥取棉絮的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who collects or strings things together; also a person who separates cotton from its pod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集物件或把物件串在一起的人；也指把棉絮从棉桃中分离出来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor jew tgħaqqad affarijiet flimkien; ukoll persuna li tifred il-qoton mill-fosdqa tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who collects or strings things together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集物件或把物件串联起来的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who separates cotton from its pod
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把棉絮从棉桃中分离出来的人。

collocations.en: a person who separates cotton from its pod
collocations.zh: 从棉桃中剥取棉絮的人

formal.mt: Id-dammiem tal-qoton jifred il-qoton mill-fosdqa tiegħu b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The cotton worker carefully separates the cotton from its pod.
formal.zh: 剥棉工小心地把棉絮从棉桃中分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jagħmel dammiem taż-żibeġ? Pawlu: Jgħaqqad iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta, bħal meta jagħmel ġiżirana.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a bead stringer do? Pawlu: He joins beads on a thread, as when making a necklace.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：串珠的人具体做什么？保罗：把珠子穿到线上，比如制作项链。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 串珠的人具体做什么？
messages.en: What does a bead stringer do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工艺教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħaqqad iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta, bħal meta jagħmel ġiżirana.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħaqqad iż-żibeġ fuq ħajta, bħal meta jagħmel ġiżirana.
messages.zh: 把珠子穿到线上，比如制作项链。
messages.en: He joins beads on a thread, as when making a necklace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dammiem 记成人物卡：一面是收集或串珠的人，另一面是从棉桃中剥取棉絮的人。

gloss_zh: 能串联物件的；能采棉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to string things together or to pick cotton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容具有把物件串在一起的能力，或具有采摘棉花能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jgħaqqad affarijiet f'sensiela jew jiġbor il-qoton.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to string together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有把物件串联起来的能力的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to pick cotton
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有采摘棉花能力的。

collocations.en: an artisan able to string things together
collocations.zh: 具有串联物件能力的工匠

collocations.en: a worker able to pick cotton

formal.mt: L-artiġjan dammiemi jgħaqqad iż-żibeġ f'sensiela skont id-disinn mogħti.
formal.en: The artisan skilled in stringing things together joins the beads in a sequence according to the supplied design.
formal.zh: 这位具有串珠能力的工匠按照给定设计，把珠子串成一串。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser li ħaddiem huwa dammiemi fil-ġbir tal-qoton? Toni: Ifisser li għandu l-ħila jiġbor il-qoton.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean to describe a worker as dammiemi in cotton picking? Toni: It means that he has the ability to pick cotton.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：说一个工人在采棉方面是 dammiemi，是什么意思？托尼：意思是他具备采摘棉花的能力。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li ħaddiem huwa dammiemi fil-ġbir tal-qoton?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li ħaddiem huwa dammiemi fil-ġbir tal-qoton?
messages.zh: 说一个工人在采棉方面是 dammiemi，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to describe a worker as dammiemi in cotton picking?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu l-ħila jiġbor il-qoton.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu l-ħila jiġbor il-qoton.
messages.zh: 意思是他具备采摘棉花的能力。
messages.en: It means that he has the ability to pick cotton.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物贴上两种能力标签：会串物件、会采棉花；dammiemi 是描述能力的形容词。

gloss_zh: 打扮得花哨讲究的；大摇大摆的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dressed with showy elegance, or behaving with a swagger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容衣着刻意讲究、带有炫耀意味，或举止大摇大摆、神气十足的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilbes b'eleganza biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni, jew li jimxi u jġib ruħu b'arja ta' kburija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打扮得花哨而讲究的；衣着带有炫耀意味的。
大摇大摆的；举止神气十足的。

collocations.zh: 打扮得花哨讲究的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel dandani jidħol fis-sala b'libsa eleganti u b'arja ta' kburija.
formal.en: In the story, the dandified man enters the hall in an elegant suit and with a proud air.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位打扮讲究的男子身穿优雅西装，神气十足地走进大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu dandani llum! Lara: Iva, libes dik il-ġakketta biex kulħadd iħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at Mark, how dandified he is today! Lara: Yes, he wore that jacket so everyone would look at him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看看马克，今天打扮得多花哨！拉拉：是啊，他穿那件外套就是想让大家都看他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu dandani llum!
messages.mt_standard: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu dandani llum!
messages.zh: 看看马克，今天打扮得多花哨！
messages.en: Look at Mark, how dandified he is today!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, libes dik il-ġakketta biex kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, libes dik il-ġakketta biex kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.zh: 是啊，他穿那件外套就是想让大家都看他。
messages.en: Yes, he wore that jacket so everyone would look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个穿着花哨、走路神气的人，用外表和步态两个画面分别记住 dandani 的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 大摇大摆的姿态；阵阵钟声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swaggering movement or manner; also the pealing of bells, especially church bells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大摇大摆、神气十足的动作或姿态；也指钟的鸣响，尤其是教堂钟声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi jew l-imġiba b'arja ta' kburija; ukoll id-daqq tal-qniepen, speċjalment dawk tal-knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大摇大摆的动作或姿态；神气十足的举止。

sense_translations.en_definition: the pealing of bells (especially church bells)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阵阵钟鸣；尤指教堂的钟声。

collocations.zh: 走路时大摇大摆的姿态

formal.mt: Id-dandin tal-qniepen tal-knisja nstema' mal-pjazza kollha qabel il-quddiesa.
formal.en: The pealing of the church bells could be heard throughout the square before Mass.
formal.zh: 弥撒开始前，教堂阵阵钟声传遍了整个广场。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Rajt id-dandin tiegħu meta daħal? Sara: Iva, mexa qisu kulħadd kellu jħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Did you see his swagger when he came in? Sara: Yes, he walked as though everyone was supposed to look at him.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你看见他进来时那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？萨拉：看见了，他走路那架势，好像所有人都该看他。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见他进来时那副大摇大摆的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see his swagger when he came in?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mexa qisu kulħadd kellu jħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mexa qisu kulħadd kellu jħares lejh.
messages.zh: 看见了，他走路那架势，好像所有人都该看他。
messages.en: Yes, he walked as though everyone was supposed to look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dandin 分设两张记忆卡：一张画大摇大摆的步态，一张画鸣响的教堂钟，靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suppose that something is true without being certain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在尚未确定的情况下，推想某件事是真的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel suppożizzjoni li xi ħaġa hija vera mingħajr ma tkun ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出推测；提出一种尚未确定的判断。
事物呈现出来的样子或表面情形。

collocations.zh: 推想一切已经准备好了

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur dann li l-bidla fit-temperatura kienet ir-raġuni għar-riżultat, iżda kien għad kellu bżonn aktar evidenza.
formal.en: The researcher supposed that the change in temperature was the reason for the result, but he still needed more evidence.
formal.zh: 研究人员推想，温度变化是产生这一结果的原因，但他仍然需要更多证据。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu telaq? Rita: Dann li l-laqgħa kienet spiċċat. Marta: Imma għad fadlilna ħafna x'niddiskutu!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu leave? Rita: He supposed the meeting was over. Marta: But we still have a lot to discuss!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么走了？丽塔：他以为会议已经结束了。玛尔塔：可我们还有很多事情要讨论！

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 他以为会议已经结束了。
messages.en: He supposed the meeting was over.

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 可我们还有很多事情要讨论！
messages.en: But we still have a lot to discuss!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“看样子，我推想……”的情境中记忆：动词侧重推想，名词侧重呈现的样子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form a supposition or regard someone or something as having a particular quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出推测，或认为某人、某物具有某种性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel suppożizzjoni jew tqis lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa bħala li għandhom kwalità partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出推测；形成尚未证实的看法。
认为；视为；经过判断而认定。

collocations.en: supposed that there was a mistake

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport, id-direttur danna l-proposta bħala xierqa għall-ħtiġijiet tal-iskola.
formal.en: After reading the report, the director deemed the proposal appropriate for the school's needs.
formal.zh: 主任阅读报告后，认为该提案符合学校的需要。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu reġa' ċċekkja l-kont? Rita: Danna li kien hemm żball. Marta: Sewwa għamel; aħjar jiċċekkja qabel iħallas.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu check the bill again? Rita: He supposed there was a mistake. Marta: That was sensible; it is better to check before paying.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么又检查了一遍账单？丽塔：他推测账单有错。玛尔塔：他做得对，付款前检查一下更好。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么又检查了一遍账单？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu check the bill again?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他推测账单有错。
messages.en: He supposed there was a mistake.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa għamel; aħjar jiċċekkja qabel iħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa għamel; aħjar jiċċekkja qabel iħallas.
messages.zh: 他做得对，付款前检查一下更好。
messages.en: That was sensible; it is better to check before paying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个句框帮助记忆：“推测有件事”和“认为某物合适”；两种用法都围绕形成判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing damage or having a bad effect on someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会对人或事物造成损害或不良影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħsara jew ikollu effett ħażin fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有害的；会造成损伤或不良影响的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-iskart jista' jkollu effett dannuż fuq l-ambjent.
formal.en: The report explains how waste can have a harmful effect on the environment.
formal.zh: 报告解释了废弃物如何可能对环境造成有害影响。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tiġbor dan il-plastik mill-bajja? Pawlu: Għax jista' jkun dannuż għall-annimali. Marta: Mela ngħinek niġbruh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you picking up this plastic from the beach? Pawlu: Because it can be harmful to animals. Marta: Then I will help you pick it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么在捡海滩上的这些塑料？保罗：因为它可能对动物有害。玛尔塔：那我来帮你一起捡。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiġbor dan il-plastik mill-bajja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiġbor dan il-plastik mill-bajja?
messages.zh: 你为什么在捡海滩上的这些塑料？
messages.en: Why are you picking up this plastic from the beach?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为它可能对动物有害。
messages.en: Because it can be harmful to animals.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我来帮你一起捡。
messages.en: Then I will help you pick it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象塑料伤害海洋动物的画面，把 dannuż 和“造成损害、有害”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excitement or disturbance that makes a situation lively, noisy, or unsettled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使场面活跃、嘈杂或不安定的兴奋或骚动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eċċitament jew taqlib li jagħmel sitwazzjoni mimlija ħajja, storbju jew nuqqas ta' kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴奋；激动的情绪或热烈的气氛。
骚动；扰乱平静或秩序的动静。

formal.mt: L-għalliema waqqfet il-lezzjoni għal ftit sakemm għadda d-daqdiq fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher paused the lesson briefly until the disturbance in the classroom had passed.
formal.zh: 老师暂停了片刻授课，等教室里的骚动平息下来。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dan id-daqdiq kollu? Pawlu: It-tfal għadhom kif semgħu li għada sejrin il-baħar. Marta: Issa nifhem għaliex huma daqshekk eċċitati!
colloquial.en: Marta: What is all this commotion? Pawlu: The children have just heard that they are going to the seaside tomorrow. Marta: Now I understand why they are so excited!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：怎么这么热闹？保罗：孩子们刚听说他们明天要去海边。玛尔塔：现在我明白他们为什么这么兴奋了！

messages.speaker: Marta (教师)
messages.zh: 怎么这么热闹？
messages.en: What is all this commotion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal għadhom kif semgħu li għada sejrin il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal għadhom kif semgħu li għada sejrin il-baħar.
messages.zh: 孩子们刚听说他们明天要去海边。
messages.en: The children have just heard that they are going to the seaside tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Marta (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex huma daqshekk eċċitati!
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex huma daqshekk eċċitati!
messages.zh: 现在我明白他们为什么这么兴奋了！
messages.en: Now I understand why they are so excited!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子听到出游消息后一阵欢腾：从开心的兴奋到打破安静的骚动，都可联系这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cuckoo, a bird known for its characteristic call.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杜鹃，也称布谷鸟，是以独特鸣叫声为人熟知的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf għall-għajta karatteristika tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杜鹃；布谷鸟，一种鸟。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti semgħu l-għajta tad-daqduq u mbagħad rawh fuq fergħa.
formal.en: During the bird observation activity, the students heard the cuckoo's call and then saw it on a branch.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们先听到了杜鹃的鸣叫，随后看见它停在树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Smajt dak l-għasfur? Pawlu: Iva, dak daqduq. Marta: Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex nerġgħu nisimgħuh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you hear that bird? Pawlu: Yes, that is a cuckoo. Marta: Let us stay quiet so we can hear it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你听见那只鸟了吗？保罗：听见了，那是杜鹃。玛尔塔：我们安静一点，再听听它叫。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that bird?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，那是杜鹃。
messages.en: Yes, that is a cuckoo.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex nerġgħu nisimgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu kwieti biex nerġgħu nisimgħuh.
messages.zh: 我们安静一点，再听听它叫。
messages.en: Let us stay quiet so we can hear it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张“树枝上的杜鹃”图卡，旁边写 daqduq；用鸟的画面区分表示兴奋或骚动的 daqdiq。

gloss_zh: 频繁演奏；乐师；乐器演奏者；弹打棉花等材料的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play a musical instrument frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常或反复演奏某种乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddoqq strument mużikali ta' spiss jew għal ħafna drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁演奏；经常弹奏或吹奏乐器。
乐师；从事音乐演奏的人。
乐器演奏者。
一名乐师；一名音乐演奏者。
弹打棉花等材料的人。

formal.mt: Matul is-sajf, Pawlu daqqaq il-pjanu fis-sala tal-komunità biex itejjeb il-ħila tiegħu.
formal.en: During the summer, Pawlu played the piano frequently in the community hall to improve his skill.
formal.zh: 夏季期间，保罗经常在社区礼堂弹钢琴，以提高演奏水平。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jdoqq il-vjolin fit-tieġ? Rita: Pawlu, daqqaq tal-vjolin li naf sew. Marta: Tajjeb, ħerqana nisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who will play the violin at the wedding? Rita: Pawlu, a violin player I know well. Marta: Good, I am looking forward to hearing him.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：婚礼上谁来拉小提琴？丽塔：保罗，一位我很熟悉的小提琴演奏者。玛尔塔：太好了，我很期待听他演奏。

messages.speaker: Marta (婚礼筹办者)
messages.zh: 婚礼上谁来拉小提琴？
messages.en: Who will play the violin at the wedding?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu, daqqaq tal-vjolin li naf sew.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu, daqqaq tal-vjolin li naf sew.
messages.zh: 保罗，一位我很熟悉的小提琴演奏者。
messages.en: Pawlu, a violin player I know well.

messages.speaker: Marta (婚礼筹办者)
messages.zh: 太好了，我很期待听他演奏。
messages.en: Good, I am looking forward to hearing him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两栏记忆：动作栏写“经常演奏”，人物栏写“乐师、演奏者、弹棉花者”，读句子时先辨词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing annoyance or repeatedly bothering someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人厌烦，或反复给人造成困扰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq jew jagħti fastidju lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦人的；令人感到厌烦的。
令人困扰的；给人添烦扰的。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss daqqaqi tal-magna fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The annoying sound of the machine disrupted the students' concentration while they were reading.
formal.zh: 机器发出的烦人声音干扰了学生阅读时的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dak il-ħoss daqqaqi? Pawlu: It-telefon tiegħi; jibqa' jagħti l-istess sinjal. Marta: Tista' titfih għal ftit?
colloquial.en: Marta: What is that annoying sound? Pawlu: My phone; it keeps making the same alert sound. Marta: Can you switch it off for a while?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那个烦人的声音是什么？保罗：我的手机，它一直重复同一个提示音。玛尔塔：你能把它关掉一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 那个烦人的声音是什么？
messages.en: What is that annoying sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-telefon tiegħi; jibqa' jagħti l-istess sinjal.
messages.mt_standard: It-telefon tiegħi; jibqa' jagħti l-istess sinjal.
messages.zh: 我的手机，它一直重复同一个提示音。
messages.en: My phone; it keeps making the same alert sound.

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 你能把它关掉一会儿吗？
messages.en: Can you switch it off for a while?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提示音一直响、让你无法专心的场景，把 daqqaqi 记成“烦人的、令人困扰的”。

gloss_zh: 按比例量定；平均分配；确定比例或尺寸的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To measure amounts or sizes in proportion, or distribute something in equal shares.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按比例量定数量或尺寸，或把某物平均分成若干份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkejjel kwantitajiet jew daqsijiet skont proporzjon, jew tqassam xi ħaġa f'ishma ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按比例量定；依照比例确定数量或尺寸。
平均分配；使各人或各份获得相等的数量。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who establishes the proportion or size of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定某物比例或尺寸的人。

collocations.en: measured the ingredients according to the proportion
distributed the food equally among the children
collocations.zh: 把食物平均分给孩子们

formal.mt: Il-kok daqqas l-ingredjenti skont il-proporzjon indikat fir-riċetta qabel beda jħallathom.
formal.en: The cook measured the ingredients according to the proportion indicated in the recipe before beginning to mix them.
formal.zh: 厨师先按食谱标明的比例量取配料，然后才开始混合。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kulħadd ħa l-istess ammont ta' ikel? Pawlu: Iva, il-kok daqqas l-ikel bejn it-tfal. Marta: Tajjeb, hekk ħadd ma jibqa' mingħajr sehmu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did everyone get the same amount of food? Pawlu: Yes, the cook distributed the food equally among the children. Marta: Good, that way no one goes without their share.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：大家拿到的食物一样多吗？保罗：是的，厨师把食物平均分给了孩子们。玛尔塔：很好，这样谁都不会少了自己那份。

messages.speaker: Marta (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd ħa l-istess ammont ta' ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd ħa l-istess ammont ta' ikel?
messages.zh: 大家拿到的食物一样多吗？
messages.en: Did everyone get the same amount of food?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kok daqqas l-ikel bejn it-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kok daqqas l-ikel bejn it-tfal.
messages.zh: 是的，厨师把食物平均分给了孩子们。
messages.en: Yes, the cook distributed the food equally among the children.

messages.speaker: Marta (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk ħadd ma jibqa' mingħajr sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk ħadd ma jibqa' mingħajr sehmu.
messages.zh: 很好，这样谁都不会少了自己那份。
messages.en: Good, that way no one goes without their share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先按比例量配料，再把成品平均分盘：两个动作帮助记住动词义；名词义则指确定比例或尺寸的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assigned the task of taking measurements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 职责是进行测量的；用于描述负责测量的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-inkarigu li jieħu l-qisien.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the task of taking measurements
sense_translations.zh_definition: 负有测量职责的；负责量取尺寸的。

collocations.en: a worker responsible for taking measurements
a technician assigned to take measurements
collocations.zh: 承担测量任务的技术员

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem daqqasi għandu jieħu l-qisien kollha qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker responsible for measurements must take all the measurements before the work begins.
formal.zh: 负责测量的工人必须在开工前量取所有尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jieħu l-qisien tal-kamra? Pawlu: Jien il-ħaddiem daqqasi; se neħodhom issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is going to measure the room? Pawlu: I'm the worker responsible for measurements; I'll take them now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来量房间的尺寸？保罗：我是负责测量的工人，现在就量。

messages.speaker: Mark (领班)
messages.zh: 谁来量房间的尺寸？
messages.en: Who is going to measure the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (测量工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-ħaddiem daqqasi; se neħodhom issa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-ħaddiem daqqasi; se neħodhom issa.
messages.zh: 我是负责测量的工人，现在就量。
messages.en: I'm the worker responsible for measurements; I'll take them now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着卷尺的工人，胸牌上写着“负责测量”，把 daqqasi 与这项职责一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Boastful talk about oneself or one's achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夸耀自己或自身成就的言语，即吹嘘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li bih wieħed jiftaħar bih innifsu jew b'dak li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹嘘；夸耀自己或自己的本领、成就。
殴打；反复击打的行为。

collocations.en: a lot of bragging and little work

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kumitat talab riżultati konkreti minflok daqqiq dwar kisbiet personali.
formal.en: In its report, the committee called for concrete results instead of bragging about personal achievements.
formal.zh: 委员会在报告中要求拿出具体成果，而不是吹嘘个人成就。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Reġa' qal li ħadd ma jaħdem tajjeb daqsu. Lara: Biżżejjed daqqiq! Ħa jurina x'għamel.
colloquial.en: Maja: He said again that nobody works as well as he does. Lara: Enough bragging! Let him show us what he's done.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他又说没人做事比他好。拉拉：别再吹了！让他给我们看看做出了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' qal li ħadd ma jaħdem tajjeb daqsu.
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' qal li ħadd ma jaħdem tajjeb daqsu.
messages.zh: 他又说没人做事比他好。
messages.en: He said again that nobody works as well as he does.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 别再吹了！让他给我们看看做出了什么。
messages.en: Enough bragging! Let him show us what he's done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 daqqiq 分成两张情景卡：一张是夸口吹嘘，一张是遭到殴打；根据谈话对象和上下文选义。

gloss_zh: 想笑的劲头；痒感；一种杜鹃

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mood or urge that makes someone want to laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人想发笑的情绪或劲头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burdata jew ħeġġa li ġġiegħel lil dak li jkun jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人想笑的情绪；一阵想发笑的劲头。
痒；使人想搔抓的感觉。

sense_translations.en_definition: a type of bird (a species of cuckoo)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鸟，属于杜鹃的一种。

collocations.en: I got the urge to laugh

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, l-attur waqaf għal mument għax qabditu d-daqquqa.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the actor paused for a moment because he got the urge to laugh.
formal.zh: 排练时，演员因为突然想笑而停顿了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tidħaq? Maja: Qabditni d-daqquqa meta ftakart f'dik iċ-ċajta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you laughing? Maja: I got the urge to laugh when I remembered that joke.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在笑？玛雅：我想起那个笑话，就忍不住想笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why are you laughing?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabditni d-daqquqa meta ftakart f'dik iċ-ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Qabditni d-daqquqa meta ftakart f'dik iċ-ċajta.
messages.zh: 我想起那个笑话，就忍不住想笑。
messages.en: I got the urge to laugh when I remembered that joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 daqquqa 画三幅独立小图：忍笑的脸、发痒的手臂、枝头的杜鹃；三义分别记，别混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rather large in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸相当大的；形容东西个头不小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu daqs pjuttost kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当大的；个头颇大的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew irċieva pakkett daqsieni li kien fih materjal għall-wirja.
formal.en: The museum received a rather large parcel containing material for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 博物馆收到一个相当大的包裹，里面装着展览所需的材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt il-kelb il-ġdid ta' Pawlu? Lara: Iva, kelb daqsieni! Imma hu kwiet ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you seen Pawlu's new dog? Lara: Yes, it's a rather large dog! But it's very calm.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你见过保罗新养的狗吗？拉拉：见过，个头可不小！不过它很安静。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 你见过保罗新养的狗吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Pawlu's new dog?

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kelb daqsieni! Imma hu kwiet ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kelb daqsieni! Imma hu kwiet ħafna.
messages.zh: 见过，个头可不小！不过它很安静。
messages.en: Yes, it's a rather large dog! But it's very calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个需要双手抱住的大包裹，用“个头不小”来记 daqsieni 的程度感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With equal size; used when comparing things that are the same size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示所比较的事物大小相等，即一样大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'daqs ugwali; jintuża meta l-affarijiet imqabbla jkollhom l-istess daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大小相等；表示所比较的事物一样大。

formal.mt: Għall-attività, aqta' żewġ biċċiet kartun daqsinsew.
formal.en: For the activity, cut two pieces of cardboard equal in size.
formal.zh: 进行这项活动时，请剪出两块大小相等的硬纸板。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ kaxxi huma daqsinsew? Mark: Iva, għandhom l-istess qisien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these two boxes the same size? Mark: Yes, they have the same measurements.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两个箱子一样大吗？马克：是的，它们的尺寸相同。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这两个箱子一样大吗？
messages.en: Are these two boxes the same size?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，它们的尺寸相同。
messages.en: Yes, they have the same measurements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个箱子的轮廓重叠，完全重合就说 daqsinsew；记住比较的是大小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces a comparison expressing an equal amount or degree: as much as or as ... as.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出数量或程度上的比较，表示和……一样多或像……那么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorbot żewġ partijiet ta' tqabbil biex juri l-istess ammont jew grad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和……一样多；像……那么……，用于比较数量或程度。

collocations.zh: 和我原先想的一样多；达到我原先想的程度

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jistgħu jieħdu daqskemm għandhom bżonn mill-materjal disponibbli.
formal.en: Participants may take as much of the available material as they need.
formal.zh: 参与者可以按自己的需要领取现有材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm nista' nieħu ross? Maja: Ħu daqskemm trid; hemm biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much rice can I take? Maja: Take as much as you want; there's enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以盛多少米饭？玛雅：想盛多少就盛多少，够大家吃的。

messages.speaker: Lara (客人)
messages.zh: 我可以盛多少米饭？
messages.en: How much rice can I take?

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu daqskemm trid; hemm biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu daqskemm trid; hemm biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 想盛多少就盛多少，够大家吃的。
messages.en: Take as much as you want; there's enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 daqskemm 想成连接两端的比较桥：一端是实际数量，另一端是需要或想要的数量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of the amount indicated by the speaker or the context; this much or that much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有说话者或语境所指出的数量的，即这么多的或那么多的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fl-ammont indikat mill-kelliem jew mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量为所指程度的；这么多的或那么多的。

formal.mt: Biex jitlesta daqstant xogħol fil-ħin, hemm bżonn ta' aktar ħaddiema.
formal.en: More workers are needed to complete this much work on time.
formal.zh: 要按时完成这么多工作，需要增加人手。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna bżonn daqstant ħobż? Lara: Iva, illum ġejjin għaxar mistednin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we need this much bread? Lara: Yes, ten guests are coming today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们需要这么多面包吗？拉拉：需要，今天有十位客人要来。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 我们需要这么多面包吗？
messages.en: Do we need this much bread?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 需要，今天有十位客人要来。
messages.en: Yes, ten guests are coming today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指着桌上的一堆面包说“这么多”，用这个指量动作记 daqstant。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wounded or experiencing pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受了伤的，或正感到疼痛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġerħa jew qiegħed iħoss l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受伤的；身上有伤的。
感到疼痛的；处于疼痛之中的。

formal.mt: Wara l-inċident, ir-raġel darban ittieħed l-isptar għall-kura.
formal.en: After the accident, the wounded man was taken to hospital for treatment.
formal.zh: 事故发生后，受伤的男子被送往医院接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-waqgħa? Mark: Għadu darban, imma qed jistrieħ id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu after the fall? Mark: He's still in pain, but he's resting at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗摔倒后怎么样了？马克：他还在疼，不过正在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗摔倒后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the fall?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu darban, imma qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu darban, imma qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.zh: 他还在疼，不过正在家里休息。
messages.en: He's still in pain, but he's resting at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“伤口”和“疼痛表情”两张图记 darban：前者提示受伤，后者提示正在疼痛。

gloss_zh: 易使污浊的；令人恶心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to make something dirty or murky, or to make someone feel sick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使物体变脏或使液体变浑浊的；也指容易使人恶心不适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jħammeġ jew idardar xi ħaġa, jew li jista' jqabbad id-dardir.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to soil or cause murkiness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使物体变脏或使液体变浑浊的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having a propensity to make one sick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易令人恶心或身体不适的。

collocations.en: material that can cause soiling or murkiness

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal dardari għandu jinżamm 'il bogħod mill-ilma tax-xorb biex ma jħammġux.
formal.en: This material, which can cause contamination or murkiness, should be kept away from drinking water so that it does not soil it.
formal.zh: 这种易造成污浊的材料应远离饮用水存放，以免弄脏水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ftaħt it-tieqa? Toni: Dan l-ikel dardari; ir-riħa tiegħu qed tqabbadni d-dardir. Maja: Mela nieħduh barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you open the window? Toni: This food is nauseating; its smell is making me feel sick. Maja: Then let's take it outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么开窗？Toni：这食物真让人恶心，气味让我想吐。Maja：那我们把它拿出去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么开窗？
messages.en: Why did you open the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ikel dardari; ir-riħa tiegħu qed tqabbadni d-dardir.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ikel dardari; ir-riħa tiegħu qed tqabbadni d-dardir.
messages.zh: 这食物真让人恶心，气味让我想吐。
messages.en: This food is nauseating; its smell is making me feel sick.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们把它拿出去吧。
messages.en: Then let's take it outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词配成两幅画：材料把清水弄浑，食物气味让人想吐；分别记住污浊与恶心两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the past; also, in the usual way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情发生在从前；也可表示按照平常的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-imgħoddi; jew bil-mod tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从前；过去。
照常；像平时一样。

formal.mt: Dari, in-nies ta' dan ir-raħal kienu jiltaqgħu fil-pjazza biex jaqsmu l-aħbarijiet.
formal.en: In the past, the people of this village used to meet in the square to share news.
formal.zh: 从前，这个村子的居民常在广场相聚，互通消息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nanna kienet tgħix hawn dari? Pawlu: Iva, kienet tgħix fid-dar ħdejn il-knisja. Nina: Nixtieq nara xi ritratt tagħha minn dak iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Grandma live here in the past? Pawlu: Yes, she lived in the house next to the church. Nina: I'd like to see a photograph of her from that time.
colloquial.zh: Nina：奶奶以前住在这里吗？Pawlu：对，她住在教堂旁边那栋房子里。Nina：我想看看她那时候的照片。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 奶奶以前住在这里吗？
messages.en: Did Grandma live here in the past?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet tgħix fid-dar ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet tgħix fid-dar ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.zh: 对，她住在教堂旁边那栋房子里。
messages.en: Yes, she lived in the house next to the church.

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nara xi ritratt tagħha minn dak iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nara xi ritratt tagħha minn dak iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 我想看看她那时候的照片。
messages.en: I'd like to see a photograph of her from that time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旧照片记住 dari 的从前义，再用每天重复的日常动作记照常义；阅读时依上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called darmstadtium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素𫟼的名称，英语称 darmstadtium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem darmstadtju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 𫟼，一种化学元素，英语名称为 darmstadtium。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-kimika, l-istudenti qabblu l-isem Malti darmstadtju mal-isem Ingliż darmstadtium.
formal.en: In the chemistry lesson, the students compared the Maltese name darmstadtju with the English name darmstadtium.
formal.zh: 化学课上，学生们对照学习了𫟼的马耳他语名称 darmstadtju 和英语名称 darmstadtium。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu d-darmstadtju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ darmstadtium. Sara: Sewwa, issa nista' nqabbel iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is darmstadtju? Mark: It is a chemical element. In English it is called darmstadtium. Sara: Right, now I can match the two names in my notes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：darmstadtju 是什么？Mark：是一种化学元素，英语叫 darmstadtium，中文叫𫟼。Sara：好，现在我能在笔记里把这两个名称对应起来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: darmstadtju 是什么？
messages.en: What is darmstadtju?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ darmstadtium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ darmstadtium.
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素，英语叫 darmstadtium，中文叫𫟼。
messages.en: It is a chemical element. In English it is called darmstadtium.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, issa nista' nqabbel iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, issa nista' nqabbel iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti.
messages.zh: 好，现在我能在笔记里把这两个名称对应起来了。
messages.en: Right, now I can match the two names in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把马耳他语 darmstadtju、英语 darmstadtium 和中文𫟼写在同一张元素词卡上，对照相似拼写记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get someone used to something or to establish a habit through repeated practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人逐渐适应某事，或通过反复练习使其养成习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel lil xi ħadd jidra xi ħaġa jew jieħu drawwa permezz tar-ripetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人习惯或适应某事。
通过反复引导使人养成某种习惯。

collocations.en: got the boy into the habit of reading every day
collocations.zh: 使男孩养成每天阅读的习惯

collocations.en: got the dog used to the noise

formal.mt: L-għalliem darra lill-istudenti jiċċekkjaw xogħolhom qabel jagħtuhlu.
formal.en: The teacher got the students into the habit of checking their work before handing it to him.
formal.zh: 老师使学生养成了交作业前检查的习惯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif darra lil ibnu jaqra kuljum? Toni: Beda jaqra miegħu għal għaxar minuti kull filgħaxija. Maja: Dik idea tajba; nipprovaha ma' binti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he get his son into the habit of reading every day? Toni: He started reading with him for ten minutes every evening. Maja: That's a good idea; I'll try it with my daughter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他是怎么让儿子养成每天阅读的习惯的？Toni：他开始每晚陪儿子读十分钟。Maja：这个办法好，我也和女儿试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif darra lil ibnu jaqra kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif darra lil ibnu jaqra kuljum?
messages.zh: 他是怎么让儿子养成每天阅读的习惯的？
messages.en: How did he get his son into the habit of reading every day?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda jaqra miegħu għal għaxar minuti kull filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Beda jaqra miegħu għal għaxar minuti kull filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 他开始每晚陪儿子读十分钟。
messages.en: He started reading with him for ten minutes every evening.

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik idea tajba; nipprovaha ma' binti.
messages.mt_standard: Dik idea tajba; nipprovaha ma' binti.
messages.zh: 这个办法好，我也和女儿试试。
messages.en: That's a good idea; I'll try it with my daughter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象家长每天陪孩子读十分钟：重点是让别人逐渐习惯，或帮助别人养成习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wound someone repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多次使某人受伤，反复造成创伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferut lil xi ħadd għal darba wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复使人受伤；多次造成创伤。
使他人受伤的人；致伤者。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont tax-xhud, l-aggressur darrab lill-vittma waqt l-attakk.
formal.en: According to the witness's account, the aggressor wounded the victim repeatedly during the attack.
formal.zh: 据证人叙述，施袭者在袭击中多次使受害者受伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fir-rumanz, il-ġellied darrab lill-avversarju tiegħu? Mark: Iva, ferih diversi drabi, iżda l-avversarju baqa' ħaj. Sara: Issa nifhem x'ġara fix-xena.
colloquial.en: Sara: In the novel, did the fighter wound his opponent repeatedly? Mark: Yes, he wounded him several times, but the opponent survived. Sara: Now I understand what happened in the scene.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小说里，那个战士多次打伤了他的对手吗？Mark：是的，他使对手受了好几次伤，但对手活了下来。Sara：现在我明白那个场景发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 小说里，那个战士多次打伤了他的对手吗？
messages.en: In the novel, did the fighter wound his opponent repeatedly?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ferih diversi drabi, iżda l-avversarju baqa' ħaj.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ferih diversi drabi, iżda l-avversarju baqa' ħaj.
messages.zh: 是的，他使对手受了好几次伤，但对手活了下来。
messages.en: Yes, he wounded him several times, but the opponent survived.

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 现在我明白那个场景发生了什么。
messages.en: Now I understand what happened in the scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张词性卡：动词卡画多次受伤，名词卡画造成伤害的人；动词义别漏掉反复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to strike or wound others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有动手打人或使他人受伤的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħti daqqiet jew jferi lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to strike or wound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有动手击打或致伤倾向的。

collocations.en: a person inclined to strike or wound others
collocations.zh: 有打人或伤人倾向的人

collocations.en: a character inclined to strike or wound others
collocations.zh: 有打人或伤人倾向的角色

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kittieb jippreżenta lill-protagonist bħala bniedem darrabi li jwieġeb għall-kritika bid-daqqiet.
formal.en: In the novel, the writer presents the protagonist as a person inclined to violence who responds to criticism by striking others.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者把主人公塑造成有打人倾向的人，受到批评便动手打人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru darrabi? Pawlu: Għax kull darba li jirrabja, jipprova jolqot lil xi ħadd. Nina: Iva, dejjem jirrikorri għad-daqqiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you say that character is inclined to strike others? Pawlu: Because every time he gets angry, he tries to hit someone. Nina: Yes, he always resorts to blows.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说那个角色有打人的倾向？Pawlu：因为他每次生气都想动手打人。Nina：是啊，他总是诉诸拳脚。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru darrabi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru darrabi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个角色有打人的倾向？
messages.en: Why do you say that character is inclined to strike others?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li jirrabja, jipprova jolqot lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li jirrabja, jipprova jolqot lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他每次生气都想动手打人。
messages.en: Because every time he gets angry, he tries to hit someone.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，他总是诉诸拳脚。
messages.en: Yes, he always resorts to blows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 darrabi 贴在小说中一生气就挥拳的角色旁：这是形容打人伤人的倾向，不只描述一次动作。

gloss_zh: 惹人烦躁的；使人心神不宁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to annoy or irritate someone, or to make them feel on edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人烦恼、恼怒，或使人紧张不安、心神不宁的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jdejjaq jew jirrita lil xi ħadd, jew iqiegħdu fuq ix-xwiek.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a propensity to annoy or irritate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易惹人厌烦或使人恼怒的。

sense_translations.en_definition: able to set sb. on edge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使人紧张不安、烦躁难耐的。

collocations.en: a tone that sets someone on edge

formal.mt: Il-ħoss darrasi tal-magna fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tal-istudenti waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The machine's irritating noise disrupted the students' concentration while they were reading.
formal.zh: 机器令人烦躁的噪声干扰了学生阅读时的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' titfi dak l-allarm? Il-ħoss tiegħu darrasi. Toni: Iva, qed idejjaqni wkoll. Maja: Grazzi, issa nista' nikkonċentra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you turn off that alarm? Its sound is irritating. Toni: Yes, it's bothering me too. Maja: Thanks, now I can concentrate.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能关掉那个闹钟吗？它的声音真让人烦躁。Toni：好，我也觉得烦。Maja：谢谢，现在我能集中注意力了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
