messages.mt_spoken: Tista' titfi dak l-allarm? Il-ħoss tiegħu darrasi.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' titfi dak l-allarm? Il-ħoss tiegħu darrasi.
messages.zh: 你能关掉那个闹钟吗？它的声音真让人烦躁。
messages.en: Can you turn off that alarm? Its sound is irritating.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我也觉得烦。
messages.en: Yes, it's bothering me too.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，现在我能集中注意力了。
messages.en: Thanks, now I can concentrate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闹钟不停响，让人皱眉又坐立不安；用这一场景同时记住惹烦与使人紧张两义。

gloss_zh: 使人上瘾的；使人形成习惯的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to cause addiction or to make someone become accustomed to something through repeated exposure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人上瘾的；也指通过反复接触使人逐渐习惯的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' joħloq vizzju jew iwassal biex wieħed jidra xi ħaġa permezz ta' kuntatt ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人上瘾、难以停止的。
使人因反复接触而逐渐习惯的。

collocations.zh: 容易使人上瘾的游戏活动

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi dan it-tip ta' logħob bħala darrej, għax iħajjar lill-plejer jibqa' jilgħab għal ħin twil.
formal.en: The article describes this type of gaming as addictive because it encourages the player to keep playing for a long time.
formal.zh: 文章把这类游戏活动描述为容易使人上瘾，因为它会诱使玩家长时间持续游玩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tilgħab? Mark: Iva, dan il-logħob darrej; dejjem ngħid li se nilgħab ftit ieħor. Sara: Ejja nieħdu pawża u noħorġu ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still playing? Mark: Yes, this game is addictive; I keep saying I'll play a little longer. Sara: Let's take a break and go outside for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你还在玩吗？Mark：是啊，这游戏很容易让人上瘾，我总想着再玩一会儿。Sara：我们休息一下，出去走走吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在玩吗？
messages.en: Are you still playing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-logħob darrej; dejjem ngħid li se nilgħab ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-logħob darrej; dejjem ngħid li se nilgħab ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，这游戏很容易让人上瘾，我总想着再玩一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, this game is addictive; I keep saying I'll play a little longer.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu pawża u noħorġu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu pawża u noħorġu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们休息一下，出去走走吧。
messages.en: Let's take a break and go outside for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用反复接触作记忆线索：一般情境是逐渐习惯，难以停下的游戏情境则帮助记住上瘾义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tooth at the back of the mouth, used for grinding food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于口腔后部、用来磨碎食物的牙齿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinna fuq wara tal-ħalq li tintuża biex titħan l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后牙；位于口腔后部的牙齿。

collocations.en: a filling in a back tooth

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina d-dars u spjega għaliex kien hemm bżonn ta' mili.
formal.en: The dentist examined the back tooth and explained why it needed a filling.
formal.zh: 牙医检查了这颗后牙，并解释了为什么需要补牙。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi dars juġagħni meta niekol. Pawlu: Ċempel lid-dentist u agħmel appuntament.
colloquial.en: Marta: One of my back teeth hurts when I eat. Pawlu: Call the dentist and make an appointment.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我吃东西时有颗后牙会疼。保罗：给牙医打电话，约个时间吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 我吃东西时有颗后牙会疼。
messages.en: One of my back teeth hurts when I eat.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 给牙医打电话，约个时间吧。
messages.en: Call the dentist and make an appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象吃饭时最后方负责磨碎食物的牙齿，把 dars 和后牙疼痛的就诊场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office in the papal administration concerned with certain official documents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教廷行政体系中处理某些正式文书的机构，即教廷文书署。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fl-amministrazzjoni tal-Papa li jieħu ħsieb ċerti dokumenti uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教廷文书署；这里指机构。

collocations.en: the documents of the datary office

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-funzjoni tad-datarija u d-dokumenti marbuta magħha.
formal.en: The report describes the function of the datary office and the documents associated with it.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了教廷文书署的职能及其相关文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi d-datarija f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawnhekk tfisser uffiċċju fl-amministrazzjoni tal-Papa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the datary in this text? Mark: Here it means an office in the papal administration.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 datarija 是什么？马克：这里指教廷行政体系中的一个机构。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 datarija 是什么？
messages.en: What is the datary in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指教廷行政体系中的一个机构。
messages.en: Here it means an office in the papal administration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 datarija 想成写在机构门牌上的名称，与表示官员的 datarju 配对区分；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official in the papal administration responsible for certain official documents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教廷行政体系中负责某些正式文书的官员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal fl-amministrazzjoni tal-Papa li jkun responsabbli għal ċerti dokumenti uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教廷文书官；这里指担任职务的人。

formal.mt: L-istudju jispjega l-kariga ta' datarju u r-responsabbiltajiet marbuta magħha.
formal.en: The study explains the post of datary and the responsibilities associated with it.
formal.zh: 这项研究解释了教廷文书官的职位及其相关职责。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Datarju huwa persuna jew uffiċċju? Toni: Persuna; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar uffiċjal tal-Papa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is a datary a person or an office? Toni: A person; here we are talking about a papal official.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：datarju 指人还是机构？托尼：指人；这里说的是一位教廷官员。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: datarju 指人还是机构？
messages.en: Is a datary a person or an office?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar uffiċjal tal-Papa.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar uffiċjal tal-Papa.
messages.zh: 指人；这里说的是一位教廷官员。
messages.en: A person; here we are talking about a papal official.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位在文件上签名的教廷官员，用 datarju 记人、datarija 记机构，避免看到相同英文释义就混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name, written David with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性名字，书写时首字母大写，形式为 David，通常译作戴维或大卫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel, miktub David b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戴维；大卫，男性名字。

formal.mt: David ippreżenta r-riżultati tal-proġett waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: David presented the project results during the meeting.
formal.zh: 戴维在会议上介绍了项目成果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se niltaqgħu ma' David illum? Ben: Iva, qal li jasal fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we meeting David today? Ben: Yes, he said he would arrive at three.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天要见戴维吗？本：是的，他说三点到。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天要见戴维吗？
messages.en: Are we meeting David today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他说三点到。
messages.en: Yes, he said he would arrive at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 David 写在一张姓名卡上，与中文戴维对应；同时记住人名开头的 D 要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving off light or appearing bright because it is illuminated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自身发出光线，或因受到照明而显得明亮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti d-dawl jew jidher imdawwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发光的；受到照明的；明亮的。

formal.mt: Sinjal dawli juri l-ħruġ sabiex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jsibuh faċilment.
formal.en: An illuminated sign indicates the exit so that visitors can find it easily.
formal.zh: 一个发光标志指示出口，让访客能够轻松找到出口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ħruġ? Mark: Ara dak is-sinjal dawli fuq il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the exit? Mark: Look at that illuminated sign above the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：出口在哪里？马克：看门上方那个发光标志。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 出口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the exit?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak is-sinjal dawli fuq il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak is-sinjal dawli fuq il-bieb.
messages.zh: 看门上方那个发光标志。
messages.en: Look at that illuminated sign above the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象黑暗中亮着的出口标志，把 sinjal dawli 整组记成发光标志，让形容词与具体画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The length of time something lasts; also the act of putting off something that should be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事持续的时间；也可指把应当做的事情一再推后的拖延行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li ddum xi ħaġa; ukoll il-posponiment ta' dak li għandu jsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续时间；某事从开始到结束所经历的时长。
拖延；迟迟不着手或不断推后应做之事。

formal.mt: Il-programm jispeċifika d-dawmien ta' kull sessjoni sabiex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jippjanaw il-ħin tagħhom.
formal.en: The programme specifies the duration of each session so that participants can plan their time.
formal.zh: 日程列明每个环节的持续时间，方便参与者安排时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadni ma bdejtx ix-xogħol; nibda għada. Luqa: Biżżejjed dawmien! Ibda b'biċċa żgħira llum.
colloquial.en: Anna: I still haven't started the work; I'll start tomorrow. Luqa: Enough procrastination! Start with a small part today.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我还没开始做，明天再开始吧。卢卡：别再拖了！今天先做一小部分。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma bdejtx ix-xogħol; nibda għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma bdejtx ix-xogħol; nibda għada.
messages.zh: 我还没开始做，明天再开始吧。
messages.en: I still haven't started the work; I'll start tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed dawmien! Ibda b'biċċa żgħira llum.
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed dawmien! Ibda b'biċċa żgħira llum.
messages.zh: 别再拖了！今天先做一小部分。
messages.en: Enough procrastination! Start with a small part today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dawmien 配两幅时间图：一幅量活动持续多久，一幅把任务不断推到明天；分别记住时长和拖延。

gloss_zh: 转动；旋转；磨坊的一个部件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Turning or spinning movement; in a mill context, a part of a windmill or flour mill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 转动或旋转的运动；在磨坊语境中，也指风车磨坊或面粉磨坊的一个部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li ddur; f'kuntest ta' mitħna, parti minn mitħna tar-riħ jew tat-tħin tad-dqiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转动；物体改变朝向或绕着轴转动的动作。
旋转；物体绕轴连续转动。

sense_translations.en_definition: part of a windmill or flour mill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 风车磨坊或面粉磨坊的一个部件。

collocations.en: the mill component called a dawr
collocations.zh: 磨坊中称作 dawr 的部件

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw id-dawr tar-rota u ddeskrivew kif inbidlet il-veloċità tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed the turning of the wheel and described how its speed changed.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了轮子的转动，并描述了其速度如何变化。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed tara d-dawr tar-rota? Samwel: Iva, issa qed iddur aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you see the wheel turning? Samwel: Yes, it's spinning faster now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看到轮子在转动吗？萨姆韦尔：看到了，现在转得更快了。

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 你看到轮子在转动吗？
messages.en: Can you see the wheel turning?

messages.speaker: Samwel (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed iddur aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed iddur aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 看到了，现在转得更快了。
messages.en: Yes, it's spinning faster now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用旋转的轮子记 dawr 的转动义，再单独制作磨坊部件义卡片；不要凭画面猜测它具体是哪种零件。

gloss_zh: 四处转悠；被耽搁；在外逗留

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of going around; depending on context, also being delayed or staying out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处走动或转悠的活动；依语境也可表示被耽搁，或在外逗留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed idur minn post għal ieħor; skont il-kuntest, ukoll li wieħed jittardja jew jibqa' barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处走动；转悠；到不同地方走一走。
被耽搁；因延误而未能及时前进、到达或完成事情的状态。
在外逗留；留在外面而没有回家。

formal.mt: Wara siegħa ta' dawrien mal-belt, il-grupp iltaqa' quddiem il-mużew.
formal.en: After an hour of going around town, the group met in front of the museum.
formal.zh: 在城里转了一个小时后，大家在博物馆前集合。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan id-dawrien kollu mal-ħwienet? Pietru: Qed infittex rigal għal oħti; imbagħad immorru d-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why all this going around the shops? Pietru: I'm looking for a present for my sister; then we'll go home.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：为什么要在这些商店之间转来转去？彼得：我在给妹妹找礼物，之后我们就回家。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么要在这些商店之间转来转去？
messages.en: Why all this going around the shops?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex rigal għal oħti; imbagħad immorru d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex rigal għal oħti; imbagħad immorru d-dar.
messages.zh: 我在给妹妹找礼物，之后我们就回家。
messages.en: I'm looking for a present for my sister; then we'll go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立场景卡记 dawrien：城里转悠、途中耽搁、很晚仍在外面；读句子时靠上下文选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light used to illuminate a place or help someone see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来照亮某处、帮助人看清东西的灯或光源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl li jintuża biex idawwal post jew jgħin lil xi ħadd jara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一盏灯；一个照明光源。

formal.mt: Tqiegħdet dawwala ħdejn il-mejda biex il-qarrej ikun jista' jara aħjar.
formal.en: A light was placed beside the table so that the reader could see better.
formal.zh: 桌旁放置了一盏灯，以便读者看得更清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn ftit mudlam. Tista' tixgħel id-dawwala? Pawlu: Iva, nixgħelha issa biex tkun tista' taqra.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's a little dark here. Can you turn on the light? Pawlu: Yes, I'll turn it on now so you can read.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里有点暗。你能把灯打开吗？保罗：可以，我现在就打开，方便你看书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ftit mudlam. Tista' tixgħel id-dawwala?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ftit mudlam. Tista' tixgħel id-dawwala?
messages.zh: 这里有点暗。你能把灯打开吗？
messages.en: It's a little dark here. Can you turn on the light?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixgħelha issa biex tkun tista' taqra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixgħelha issa biex tkun tista' taqra.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就打开，方便你看书。
messages.en: Yes, I'll turn it on now so you can read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dawwala 放进“床边开灯读书”的画面里记忆：需要看清，就打开这盏灯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone or something that gives light or serves as a light source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容能发出光、提供照明或充当光源的人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tagħti d-dawl jew isservi bħala sors ta' dawl.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that provides light
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容提供光亮或照明的人或物。
形容起光源作用、能提供光亮的。

formal.mt: L-apparat dawwali tqiegħed qrib id-daħla biex idawwal it-taraġ.
formal.en: The device that provides light was placed near the entrance to illuminate the stairs.
formal.zh: 照明设备被放在入口附近，用来照亮楼梯。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-oġġett jissejjaħ dawwali? Rita: Għax jagħti d-dawl; tista' tużah biex tara fid-dlam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this object described as dawwali? Rita: Because it gives light; you can use it to see in the dark.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么用 dawwali 来形容这个东西？丽塔：因为它能发光，你可以用它在黑暗中看东西。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么用 dawwali 来形容这个东西？
messages.en: Why is this object described as dawwali?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jagħti d-dawl; tista' tużah biex tara fid-dlam.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jagħti d-dawl; tista' tużah biex tara fid-dlam.
messages.zh: 因为它能发光，你可以用它在黑暗中看东西。
messages.en: Because it gives light; you can use it to see in the dark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dawwali 时问“它能提供光亮吗”：能发光或照明，就可联系这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 环岛；旋转物，尤指风车的旋转部件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Refers to a roundabout or a spinning object, especially a rotating part of a windmill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指环岛或旋转的物体，尤其是风车中转动的部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirreferi għal roundabout jew għal oġġett li jdur, speċjalment parti minn mitħna tar-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环岛；供车辆绕行的环形交叉路口。

sense_translations.en_definition: a spinning object (especially part of a windmill)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转的物体，尤其指风车的旋转部件。

collocations.en: a spinning part of the windmill
a spinning object that turns in the wind

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'dawwara' tirreferi għall-parti tal-mitħna li ddur mar-riħ.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'dawwara' refers to the part of the windmill that turns in the wind.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，dawwara 一词指风车上随风转动的部件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-parti li qed iddur mal-mitħna? Toni: Dik hi d-dawwara. Ara kif iddur meta jonfoħ ir-riħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that part spinning on the windmill? Toni: That's the dawwara. Look how it turns when the wind blows!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：风车上那个正在转的部件是什么？托尼：那是 dawwara。看，风一吹它就转起来了！

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-parti li qed iddur mal-mitħna?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-parti li qed iddur mal-mitħna?
messages.zh: 风车上那个正在转的部件是什么？
messages.en: What is that part spinning on the windmill?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi d-dawwara. Ara kif iddur meta jonfoħ ir-riħ!
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi d-dawwara. Ara kif iddur meta jonfoħ ir-riħ!
messages.zh: 那是 dawwara。看，风一吹它就转起来了！
messages.en: That's the dawwara. Look how it turns when the wind blows!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dawwara 配上“绕圈转动”的动态图：先看风车部件旋转，再联系环岛绕行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes something circular, or something that has been passed from one person to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容呈圆形的事物，也可形容已经在人与人之间传递过的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa b'forma ta' ċirku, jew xi ħaġa li għaddiet minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆形的；呈圆环状的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having been passed round from person to person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经在人与人之间依次传递过的。

collocations.en: a document that has been passed from person to person

formal.mt: Id-disinn dawwari tal-ġnien ipoġġi l-funtana fiċ-ċentru u l-bankijiet madwarha.
formal.en: The garden's circular design places the fountain in the centre and the benches around it.
formal.zh: 花园采用圆形设计，喷泉位于中央，长椅围绕喷泉布置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'forma għandu dan il-perkors? Ġorġ: Huwa dawwari; nimxu madwar il-ġnien u nerġgħu naslu hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shape is this route? Ġorġ: It's circular; we walk around the garden and end up back here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这条路线是什么形状的？乔治：是环形的，我们绕花园走一圈，就会回到这里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条路线是什么形状的？
messages.en: What shape is this route?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa dawwari; nimxu madwar il-ġnien u nerġgħu naslu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa dawwari; nimxu madwar il-ġnien u nerġgħu naslu hawn.
messages.zh: 是环形的，我们绕花园走一圈，就会回到这里。
messages.en: It's circular; we walk around the garden and end up back here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 dawwari：纸上画一个圆，再把一张纸依次传给身边的人，对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 咦？怎么回事？有什么特别的事吗？

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise or curiosity when something unexpected happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到意外情况时表达惊讶或好奇的感叹语，近似“咦？”“怎么回事？”或“今天有什么特别的事吗？”
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esklamazzjoni li tesprimi sorpriża jew kurżità meta jiġri xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to express surprise or curiosity about an unexpected event. Roughly translates to: “Really?”; “What's the occasion?”; “What’s going on here?”
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于对意外发生的事情表示惊讶或好奇，大致相当于“真的吗？”“有什么特别的事吗？”或“这是怎么回事？”

collocations.en: Oh, what's the occasion for this party?

formal.mt: F'djalogu miktub, 'Daxkien!' tista' tesprimi s-sorpriża ta' persuna li ssib festa mhux mistennija.
formal.en: In a written dialogue, 'Daxkien!' can express the surprise of someone who comes across an unexpected party.
formal.zh: 在书面对话中，Daxkien! 可以表达一个人意外遇上派对时的惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Daxkien! Għaliex ġibt kejk illum? Ben: Għax għaddejt mill-eżami, u ridt niċċelebra magħkom!
colloquial.en: Sara: Oh, what's the occasion? Why did you bring a cake today? Ben: Because I passed the exam, and I wanted to celebrate with you!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：咦，有什么喜事？你今天怎么带蛋糕来了？本：因为我考试通过了，想和你们一起庆祝！

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 咦，有什么喜事？你今天怎么带蛋糕来了？
messages.en: Oh, what's the occasion? Why did you bring a cake today?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għaddejt mill-eżami, u ridt niċċelebra magħkom!
messages.mt_standard: Għax għaddejt mill-eżami, u ridt niċċelebra magħkom!
messages.zh: 因为我考试通过了，想和你们一起庆祝！
messages.en: Because I passed the exam, and I wanted to celebrate with you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友突然端来蛋糕，你惊讶地问“咦，什么喜事？”；把这种好奇语气和 daxkien 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce and give off smoke.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生烟并向外散发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ id-duħħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒烟；散发烟雾

formal.mt: Waqt it-test, il-mutur daħan u t-tekniku waqqaf il-magna.
formal.en: During the test, the engine gave off smoke and the technician stopped the machine.
formal.zh: 测试期间，发动机冒烟，技术员随即停止了机器。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-forn daħan meta xgħeltu. Lara: Mela itfih u ħallih jiksaħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: The oven gave off smoke when I turned it on. Lara: Then turn it off and let it cool down.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我一开烤炉，它就冒烟了。拉拉：那就关掉，让它冷却。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我一开烤炉，它就冒烟了。
messages.en: The oven gave off smoke when I turned it on.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 那就关掉，让它冷却。
messages.en: Then turn it off and let it cool down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤炉上方升起一缕烟，用 daħan 记住“冒烟”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 一声笑；一次笑；笑的方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single instance of laughing, or a particular way of laughing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次发笑、一声笑，或某个人特有的笑法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda li persuna tidħaq, jew il-mod kif tidħaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a laughter (single instance of laughing; a way of laughing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声笑或一次发笑；一种笑的方式

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tad-diskors, l-istorja qasira tal-kelliem qanqlet daħka kbira fost dawk preżenti.
formal.en: At the end of the speech, the speaker's short story prompted a hearty laugh among those present.
formal.zh: 演讲结束时，演讲者讲的小故事引得在场的人一阵大笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dik id-daħka? Mark: Iva, kienet ta' Pawlu; nagħraf id-daħka tiegħu minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that laugh? Mark: Yes, it was Pawlu's; I recognise his laugh straight away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见刚才那声笑了吗？马克：听见了，是保罗；他的笑声我一下就能认出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才那声笑了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that laugh?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet ta' Pawlu; nagħraf id-daħka tiegħu minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet ta' Pawlu; nagħraf id-daħka tiegħu minnufih.
messages.zh: 听见了，是保罗；他的笑声我一下就能认出来。
messages.en: Yes, it was Pawlu's; I recognise his laugh straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听见朋友独特的一声笑，既记“一次笑”，也记“某人的笑法”。

gloss_zh: 爱笑的；微笑的；开朗友善的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laughing or smiling, or showing a cheerful and friendly manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着笑容的，或表现得开朗、友善的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidħaq jew jitbissem, jew li juri ferħ u ħbiberija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笑着的；微笑的；开朗的；友善的

formal.mt: L-impjegat laqa' lill-viżitaturi b'wiċċ daħkani u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tagħhom bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The employee welcomed the visitors with a smiling face and answered their questions patiently.
formal.zh: 工作人员面带笑容地迎接访客，并耐心回答他们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk dejjem daħkani hekk? Maja: Iva, iħobb jidħaq u jitkellem ma' kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your brother always this cheerful? Maja: Yes, he loves laughing and talking to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥一直都这么开朗爱笑吗？玛雅：是啊，他爱笑，也喜欢跟大家聊天。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥一直都这么开朗爱笑吗？
messages.en: Is your brother always this cheerful?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iħobb jidħaq u jitkellem ma' kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iħobb jidħaq u jitkellem ma' kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是啊，他爱笑，也喜欢跟大家聊天。
messages.en: Yes, he loves laughing and talking to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到一个总带笑容、主动打招呼的人，把 daħkani 与开朗友善的表情联系起来。

gloss_zh: 爱把东西放入或塞入的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to insert things or put them inside something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于把东西放进或塞进其他东西里面的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jdaħħal affarijiet ġo affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有把东西插入、放入或塞入的倾向的

collocations.en: a boy inclined to put things inside other things
collocations.zh: 爱把东西往里面塞的男孩

collocations.en: a worker inclined to insert things
collocations.zh: 有把东西插入或放入的倾向的工人

formal.mt: It-tifel daħħali kien idaħħal biċċiet tal-karti fil-kaxxi li kien isib fil-klassi.
formal.en: The boy, who was inclined to put things inside other things, would insert pieces of paper into boxes he found in the classroom.
formal.zh: 这个爱往东西里面塞物件的男孩，会把纸片塞进他在教室里找到的盒子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tifel daħħali; dejjem idaħħal xi ħaġa fil-kaxxi. Pawlu: Iva, illum daħħal il-lapsijiet kollha f'kaxxa waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: This boy is always putting things inside things; he keeps putting something into the boxes. Pawlu: Yes, today he put all the pencils into one box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个男孩就爱往里面放东西，总往盒子里塞点什么。保罗：是啊，今天他把所有铅笔都放进同一个盒子了。

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tifel daħħali; dejjem idaħħal xi ħaġa fil-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tifel daħħali; dejjem idaħħal xi ħaġa fil-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 这个男孩就爱往里面放东西，总往盒子里塞点什么。
messages.en: This boy is always putting things inside things; he keeps putting something into the boxes.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (助教)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum daħħal il-lapsijiet kollha f'kaxxa waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum daħħal il-lapsijiet kollha f'kaxxa waħda.
messages.zh: 是啊，今天他把所有铅笔都放进同一个盒子了。
messages.en: Yes, today he put all the pencils into one box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总爱把纸片塞进盒子的人，借这个习惯记住 daħħali 的形容词意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing or giving off smoke.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生或向外散发烟雾的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ id-duħħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒烟的；正在散发烟雾的

formal.mt: It-tekniku eżamina l-mutur daħħani qabel ma kompla x-xogħol.
formal.en: The technician examined the engine that was giving off smoke before continuing the work.
formal.zh: 技术员检查了那台冒烟的发动机，然后才继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-forn daħħani llum. Mark: Qed nara d-duħħan ukoll; se nitfih.
colloquial.en: Lara: This oven is giving off smoke today. Mark: I can see the smoke too; I'll turn it off.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个烤炉今天在冒烟。马克：我也看见烟了，我来把它关掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个烤炉今天在冒烟。
messages.en: This oven is giving off smoke today.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara d-duħħan ukoll; se nitfih.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara d-duħħan ukoll; se nitfih.
messages.zh: 我也看见烟了，我来把它关掉。
messages.en: I can see the smoke too; I'll turn it off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 daħħani 贴在冒烟的烤炉图片旁，记住它描述“冒烟的”状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal; the diminutive form of 'dbib'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小动物；是 dbib 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'dbib'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small animal (the diminutive form of 'dbib')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小动物，是 dbib 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small animal in the grass
a small animal under a stone

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, it-tfal raw dbejba tiċċaqlaq taħt il-weraq.
formal.en: While observing the garden, the children saw a small animal moving beneath the leaves.
formal.zh: 孩子们观察花园时，看见一只小动物在树叶下面移动。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara dik id-dbejba fil-ħaxix! Tista' taraha? Adam: Iva, qed timxi taħt il-weraq. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at that small animal in the grass! Can you see it? Adam: Yes, it's moving under the leaves. Let's leave it there.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看草丛里那只小动物！你看得到吗？亚当：看到了，它正往树叶下面走。我们就让它待在那里吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik id-dbejba fil-ħaxix! Tista' taraha?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik id-dbejba fil-ħaxix! Tista' taraha?
messages.zh: 看草丛里那只小动物！你看得到吗？
messages.en: Look at that small animal in the grass! Can you see it?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed timxi taħt il-weraq. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed timxi taħt il-weraq. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
messages.zh: 看到了，它正往树叶下面走。我们就让它待在那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's moving under the leaves. Let's leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dbib 和 dbejba 做成大小对照卡：后者配一只藏在叶下的小动物，记住它是指小形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small fly; the diminutive form of 'dubbiena'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小苍蝇；是 dubbiena 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dubbiena żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'dubbiena'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小苍蝇，是 dubbiena 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small fly on the window
a small fly flying around the lamp

formal.mt: L-istudenta osservat dbejbna fuq il-ħġieġ u kitbet deskrizzjoni qasira tal-movimenti tagħha.
formal.en: The student observed a small fly on the glass and wrote a short description of its movements.
formal.zh: 这名学生观察了玻璃上的一只小苍蝇，并简要描述了它的动作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm dbejbna fuq it-tieqa. Tista' tiftaħha? Luke: Iva, niftaħ it-tieqa biex tkun tista' toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: There's a small fly on the window. Can you open it? Luke: Yes, I'll open the window so it can get out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：窗户上有只小苍蝇。你能把窗户打开吗？卢克：可以，我把窗户打开，让它飞出去。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm dbejbna fuq it-tieqa. Tista' tiftaħha?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm dbejbna fuq it-tieqa. Tista' tiftaħha?
messages.zh: 窗户上有只小苍蝇。你能把窗户打开吗？
messages.en: There's a small fly on the window. Can you open it?

messages.speaker: Luke (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niftaħ it-tieqa biex tkun tista' toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niftaħ it-tieqa biex tkun tista' toħroġ.
messages.zh: 可以，我把窗户打开，让它飞出去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll open the window so it can get out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dbejbna 画一只停在窗玻璃上的小苍蝇，并与 dubbiena 配对记忆，突出“小”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wild animal that lives in nature rather than being kept as a domestic animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活在自然环境中的野生动物，与家养动物相区别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ li jgħix fin-natura u mhux bħala annimal domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野生动物；非家养的动物。

collocations.en: a wild animal in the forest
observe a wild animal from a distance

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-riżerva, il-grupp osserva dbib mill-bogħod mingħajr ma resaq lejh.
formal.en: During the visit to the reserve, the group observed a wild animal from a distance without approaching it.
formal.zh: 参观保护区时，小组从远处观察了一只野生动物，没有靠近它。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Rajt dbib ħdejn is-siġar! Immorru narawh? Sam: Nistgħu narawh minn hawn. Ejja ma nersqux wisq qrib.
colloquial.en: Ella: I saw a wild animal near the trees! Shall we go and look at it? Sam: We can see it from here. Let's not get too close.
colloquial.zh: 艾拉：我看到树旁有只野生动物！我们过去看看吗？萨姆：从这里就能看见，我们别靠得太近。

messages.speaker: Ella (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dbib ħdejn is-siġar! Immorru narawh?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dbib ħdejn is-siġar! Immorru narawh?
messages.zh: 我看到树旁有只野生动物！我们过去看看吗？
messages.en: I saw a wild animal near the trees! Shall we go and look at it?

messages.speaker: Sam (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu narawh minn hawn. Ejja ma nersqux wisq qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu narawh minn hawn. Ejja ma nersqux wisq qrib.
messages.zh: 从这里就能看见，我们别靠得太近。
messages.en: We can see it from here. Let's not get too close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dbib 放在“森林中远远观察野生动物”的画面里，再与表示小动物的 dbejba 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of slaughtering animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宰杀动物这一行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess tal-qtil tal-annimali għall-qatla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宰杀动物；动物屠宰。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri li jintużaw waqt id-dbiħ tal-annimali.
formal.en: The report describes the procedures used during the slaughtering of animals.
formal.zh: 报告描述了屠宰动物时采用的程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kapitlu dwar xiex jitkellem? Mark: Dwar id-dbiħ tal-annimali u l-proċeduri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this chapter about? Mark: The slaughtering of animals and its procedures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一章讲什么？马克：讲动物屠宰及其程序。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this chapter about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar id-dbiħ tal-annimali u l-proċeduri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar id-dbiħ tal-annimali u l-proċeduri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 讲动物屠宰及其程序。
messages.en: The slaughtering of animals and its procedures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和动物屠宰流程图一起记：dbiħ是名词，指宰杀这一行为或过程。

gloss_zh: 十分生气或烦乱；天气转阴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very upset or angry; also, of the weather, to become overcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得十分烦乱或愤怒；也指天气转阴、天空布满云。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħawwad jew jirrabja ħafna; dwar it-temp, isir imsaħħab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be very upset or angry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分烦乱、心烦意乱或愤怒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become overcast (used of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气转阴；天空变得阴云密布。

formal.mt: It-temp ddagħdagħ wara nofsinhar, u l-organizzaturi ddeċidew li jipposponu l-attività.
formal.en: The weather became overcast in the afternoon, and the organizers decided to postpone the activity.
formal.zh: 下午天气转阴，组织者决定推迟活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq hekk malajr Pawlu? Mark: Ddagħdagħ meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave so quickly? Mark: He became very upset when he heard that the meeting had been cancelled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么那么快就走了？马克：他听说会议取消后，心情变得很糟。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那么快就走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddagħdagħ meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.mt_standard: Ddagħdagħ meta sema' li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.zh: 他听说会议取消后，心情变得很糟。
messages.en: He became very upset when he heard that the meeting had been cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面联记：人脸上怒气聚集，天空中阴云聚集；分别对应情绪义和天气义。

gloss_zh: 受某人影响；举止像某人或某物；被人工授粉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be influenced by someone or take on another's manners or behaviour; also, of a plant, to be pollinated artificially.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某人的影响，或在举止、行为上变得像某人或某物；也指植物接受人工授粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi influwenzat minn xi ħadd jew jieħu mill-imġiba ta' ħaddieħor; dwar pjanta, jiġi mdakkar b'mod artifiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到某人的影响。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take after sb. or sth. in one's manners or behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在举止或行为上像某人或某物；沾染其行为习惯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be pollinated artificially (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物被人工授粉。

collocations.en: took after his brother in his behaviour
collocations.zh: 行为举止变得像他的兄弟

collocations.en: the flower was pollinated by hand
collocations.zh: 这朵花接受了人工授粉

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, il-fjur ddakkar bl-idejn, u d-data ġiet irreġistrata.
formal.en: In the experiment, the flower was pollinated by hand, and the date was recorded.
formal.zh: 实验中，这朵花接受了人工授粉，并记录了日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu qed jiċċajta l-ħin kollu bħal ħuh! Mark: Iva, ddakkar minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is joking all the time, just like his brother! Mark: Yes, he has picked it up from him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗现在跟他兄弟一样，老是开玩笑！马克：是啊，他受了他兄弟的影响。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qed jiċċajta l-ħin kollu bħal ħuh!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qed jiċċajta l-ħin kollu bħal ħuh!
messages.zh: 保罗现在跟他兄弟一样，老是开玩笑！
messages.en: Pawlu is joking all the time, just like his brother!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他受了他兄弟的影响。
messages.en: Yes, he has picked it up from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两栏记忆：人物栏写受影响、学举止，植物栏写人工授粉；这是学习分类，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dark or lose light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线变暗，或天色变黑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mudlam jew jonqos id-dawl fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；变得黑暗。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur ddallam meta ntefa d-dawl, u l-persunal uża t-torċi.
formal.en: The corridor became dark when the light went out, and the staff used torches.
formal.zh: 灯熄灭后，走廊变得黑暗，工作人员使用了手电筒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandna ħin għal mixja? Mark: Is-sema diġà ddallam; aħjar immorru għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have time for a walk? Mark: The sky has already grown dark; we'd better go tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还有时间出去散步吗？马克：天已经黑了，还是明天早上去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还有时间出去散步吗？
messages.en: Do we still have time for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sema diġà ddallam; aħjar immorru għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sema diġà ddallam; aħjar immorru għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 天已经黑了，还是明天早上去吧。
messages.en: The sky has already grown dark; we'd better go tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯光逐渐调低的画面，把ddallam记成从明亮变黑暗的变化过程。

gloss_zh: 给材料制作锦缎式花纹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work or decorate a material with a damask pattern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在材料上制作或装饰锦缎式花纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem jew iżejjen materjal b'disinn tad-damask.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给材料制作锦缎式花纹；以锦缎式纹样装饰。

collocations.en: worked a damask pattern into the fabric
collocations.zh: 在织物上制作了锦缎式花纹

collocations.en: decorated with a floral damask pattern
collocations.zh: 以花卉锦缎式纹样作了装饰

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ddamaska d-drapp b'disinn tal-fjuri għall-wirja.
formal.en: The artisan worked a floral damask pattern into the fabric for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 工匠为展览在织物上制作了花卉锦缎式纹样。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan id-disinn fuq id-drapp? Mark: Pawlu ddamaska d-drapp hu stess.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this pattern on the fabric? Mark: Pawlu worked the damask pattern into the fabric himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：织物上的这个花纹是谁做的？马克：是保罗亲自在织物上制作的锦缎式花纹。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dan id-disinn fuq id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dan id-disinn fuq id-drapp?
messages.zh: 织物上的这个花纹是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this pattern on the fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 是保罗亲自在织物上制作的锦缎式花纹。
messages.en: Pawlu worked the damask pattern into the fabric himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠给材料添上锦缎式花纹，重点记住这是制作或装饰花纹的动作。

gloss_zh: 神志不清；惨败；充满震耳噪声；被巨响震聋；疲惫不堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be out of one's senses, suffer a thorough defeat, be filled with deafening noise, be deafened by loud noise, or become extremely fatigued.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神志不清，遭到惨败，某处充满震耳噪声，被巨响震得听不清，或变得极度疲惫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-kontroll ta' moħħu, jitlef telfa kbira, jimtela bi storbju qawwi, jittarrax bl-istorbju, jew jegħja ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be out of one's senses (e.g. due to excessive drinking)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 神志不清或失去理智，例如因饮酒过量。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be thoroughly defeated (e.g. in a sport)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被彻底击败；惨败，例如在体育比赛中。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be filled with a deafening noise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某处充满震耳欲聋的噪声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be deafened by loud noises
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被巨大声响震得听不清或听觉受到影响。
变得极度疲劳；累得精疲力竭。

collocations.en: became out of his senses through drinking
the team was thoroughly defeated in the final
the corridor was filled with deafening noise
collocations.zh: 走廊充满了震耳欲聋的噪声

collocations.en: was deafened by the loud noises

formal.mt: Il-kuritur ddamdam bl-istorbju tal-magni waqt ix-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The corridor was filled with the deafening noise of the machines during the repair work.
formal.zh: 维修期间，走廊充满了机器发出的震耳噪声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid toħroġ magħna llejla? Mark: Illum ddamdamt bix-xogħol; se nibqa' d-dar nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go out with us tonight? Mark: Work has left me exhausted today; I'm staying home to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚要和我们一起出去吗？马克：今天工作累得我精疲力竭，我要待在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚要和我们一起出去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go out with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum ddamdamt bix-xogħol; se nibqa' d-dar nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Illum ddamdamt bix-xogħol; se nibqa' d-dar nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 今天工作累得我精疲力竭，我要待在家里休息。
messages.en: Work has left me exhausted today; I'm staying home to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用五张画面卡分别记：醉得糊涂、比赛惨败、场所嘈杂、耳朵受震、身体累垮；按主语和语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be collected or brought together in one place or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收集起来，或被聚集到同一地点、同一群体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar jew jitqiegħed flimkien f'post wieħed jew fi grupp wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收集起来。
被放在一起；被聚集起来。

collocations.en: The material was collected in one place.
collocations.zh: 材料被收集到同一个地方。

collocations.en: The group was brought together for the activity.
collocations.zh: 大家为参加活动被召集到一起。

formal.mt: Il-materjal meħtieġ għall-proġett ddammem qabel il-bidu tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The material needed for the project was collected before work began.
formal.zh: 项目所需的材料在工作开始前已被收集起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-materjal kollu ddammem f'post wieħed? Mark: Iva, kollox qiegħed fil-kamra ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has all the material been gathered in one place? Mark: Yes, everything is in the back room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：所有材料都收集到一个地方了吗？马克：是的，全都在后面的房间里。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目同事)
messages.zh: 所有材料都收集到一个地方了吗？
messages.en: Has all the material been gathered in one place?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox qiegħed fil-kamra ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox qiegħed fil-kamra ta' wara.
messages.zh: 是的，全都在后面的房间里。
messages.en: Yes, everything is in the back room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分散的材料最后集中到同一张桌上，用这个画面记住“被收集、被聚在一起”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause harm to something so that its condition, appearance, or usefulness becomes worse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的状态、外观或使用功能受到损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa u jnaqqas il-kwalità, id-dehra jew l-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏；使某物受到损害。

formal.mt: L-ilma li daħal mit-tieqa ddanneġġja l-għamara tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The water that came through the window damaged the office furniture.
formal.zh: 从窗户流进来的水损坏了办公室的家具。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-mejda? Mark: L-ilma ddanneġġja l-wiċċ tagħha. Maja: Mela rridu nsewwuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the table? Mark: Water damaged its surface. Maja: Then we need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌子怎么了？马克：水把桌面弄坏了。玛雅：那我们得把它修好。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 水把桌面弄坏了。
messages.en: Water damaged its surface.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那我们得把它修好。
messages.en: Then we need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“完好的桌面被水泡坏”的前后对比图，记住动作造成了损坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become emotionally worked up or excited about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而变得情绪激动或兴奋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqanqal emozzjonalment jew isir eċċitat minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to get worked up or excited
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得情绪激动；兴奋起来。

collocations.en: got worked up during the match

formal.mt: Meta tħabbar ir-riżultat, wieħed mill-parteċipanti ddaqdaq u beda jitkellem b'leħen għoli.
formal.en: When the result was announced, one of the participants got excited and began speaking loudly.
formal.zh: 结果公布时，一名参与者激动起来，开始大声说话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat waqt il-logħba? Pawlu: Ddaqdaq meta t-tim tiegħu skorja. Maja: Kien ferħan ħafna, mela!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark start shouting during the match? Pawlu: He got excited when his team scored. Maja: He must have been really happy, then!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么在比赛时喊起来了？保罗：他的球队进球时，他兴奋起来了。玛雅：那他一定特别高兴！

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat waqt il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark beda jgħajjat waqt il-logħba?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在比赛时喊起来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark start shouting during the match?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 他的球队进球时，他兴奋起来了。
messages.en: He got excited when his team scored.

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 那他一定特别高兴！
messages.en: He must have been really happy, then!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球迷看到进球后突然站起欢呼，把这个词和“情绪一下子激动起来”连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 变得骄傲或爱吹嘘；体重减轻

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become proud or boastful; in a separate sense, to lose weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得骄傲或爱吹嘘；另一个独立义项是体重减轻、变瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir kburi jew jibda jiftaħar; f'tifsira oħra, jonqos fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得骄傲自大；变得爱吹嘘。
体重减轻；变瘦。

collocations.en: became slimmer and lost a little weight
collocations.zh: 变瘦了，体重减轻了一些

formal.mt: Wara li rebaħ il-premju, Mark ddaqqaq u beda jiftaħar bil-kisbiet tiegħu.
formal.en: After winning the prize, Mark grew boastful and began bragging about his achievements.
formal.zh: 获奖后，马克变得自满，开始吹嘘自己的成就。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ddaqqaq dan l-aħħar? Mark: Iva, tilef ftit piż. Il-ġakketta issa tiġih wiesgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu lost weight recently? Mark: Yes, he has lost a little weight. His jacket is loose on him now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗最近是不是瘦了？马克：是的，他体重轻了一些。现在他的夹克穿着都宽松了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗最近是不是瘦了？
messages.en: Has Pawlu lost weight recently?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tilef ftit piż. Il-ġakketta issa tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tilef ftit piż. Il-ġakketta issa tiġih wiesgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，他体重轻了一些。现在他的夹克穿着都宽松了。
messages.en: Yes, he has lost a little weight. His jacket is loose on him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立卡片记忆：领奖后不停夸自己，表示变骄傲；夹克变宽松，表示变瘦。靠上下文区分两义。

gloss_zh: 被调整至恰当比例；被平均分配

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given suitable proportions or to be divided equally among recipients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被调整到合适的比例，或被平均分配给各个接受者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-proporzjonijiet xierqa jew jitqassam indaqs bejn dawk li jirċevuh.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be given the right proportions
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被调整至恰当的比例。
被平均分配；被均等分发。

collocations.en: The design was adjusted to the required proportions.
collocations.zh: 设计被调整到所需的比例。

collocations.en: The food was distributed equally among the guests.
collocations.zh: 食物被平均分给了客人。

formal.mt: Id-disinn ddaqqas sabiex il-partijiet kollha jkollhom il-proporzjonijiet xierqa.
formal.en: The design was adjusted so that all its parts had the appropriate proportions.
formal.zh: 设计经过调整，使各部分都具有恰当的比例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ikel ddaqqas bejn kulħadd? Mark: Iva, kull persuna ħadet l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the food shared equally among everyone? Mark: Yes, each person received the same amount.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：食物平均分给大家了吗？马克：是的，每个人拿到的量都一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚餐组织者)
messages.zh: 食物平均分给大家了吗？
messages.en: Was the food shared equally among everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚餐帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull persuna ħadet l-istess ammont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull persuna ħadet l-istess ammont.
messages.zh: 是的，每个人拿到的量都一样。
messages.en: Yes, each person received the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先把图形各部分调到合适比例，再把食物分成相等几份，分别记住“比例恰当”和“平均分配”。

gloss_zh: 做出惹人厌烦或招摇的举动；感到恶心

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in an irritating or showy way; in a separate sense, to feel nauseated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止惹人厌烦或故意招摇；另一个独立义项是感到恶心、想吐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod li jdejjaq lil ħaddieħor jew jiġbed l-attenzjoni; f'tifsira oħra, iħoss dardir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to behave in an annoying or showy manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做出惹人厌烦或招摇显摆的举动。
感到恶心；觉得想吐。

collocations.zh: 为了吸引注意而招摇表现

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, Mark ddardar biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni u fixkel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark behaved showily to attract attention and disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克为吸引注意而招摇表现，扰乱了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu niżel mill-karozza? Mark: Ddardar waqt il-vjaġġ u ried jieħu ftit arja. Maja: Mela nistennewh hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu get out of the car? Mark: He felt nauseated during the journey and wanted some fresh air. Maja: Then let's wait for him here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么下车了？马克：他路上觉得恶心，想透透气。玛雅：那我们在这里等他吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么下车了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get out of the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddardar waqt il-vjaġġ u ried jieħu ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Ddardar waqt il-vjaġġ u ried jieħu ftit arja.
messages.zh: 他路上觉得恶心，想透透气。
messages.en: He felt nauseated during the journey and wanted some fresh air.

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们在这里等他吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait for him here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两个场景：会上故意抢镜是行为义，车上难受想吐是身体感受义；不要把两义混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become accustomed to something through experience or repeated contact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过经历或反复接触而逐渐习惯某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imdorri b'xi ħaġa permezz tal-esperjenza jew tal-kuntatt ripetut magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习惯于某事物；适应某种情况。

collocations.en: became accustomed to the new school
became accustomed to the new schedule

formal.mt: Wara ftit ġimgħat, l-impjegat il-ġdid ddarra mal-ħinijiet tax-xogħol.
formal.en: After a few weeks, the new employee became accustomed to the working hours.
formal.zh: 几周后，新员工习惯了工作时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ibnek ddarra mal-iskola l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, issa għandu ħbieb u jmur ferħan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has your son settled into the new school? Mark: Yes, he has friends now and goes happily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你儿子适应新学校了吗？马克：是的，他现在交到了朋友，每天都高高兴兴地去。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你儿子适应新学校了吗？
messages.en: Has your son settled into the new school?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu ħbieb u jmur ferħan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu ħbieb u jmur ferħan.
messages.zh: 是的，他现在交到了朋友，每天都高高兴兴地去。
messages.en: Yes, he has friends now and goes happily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚到新学校时陌生，几周后熟门熟路，用“从陌生到习惯”的变化记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to sound, or to be struck by a blow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄响、被敲响，或受到一下敲击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindaqq biex joħroġ ħoss, jew jintlaqat b'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄响；被敲响。
受到敲击；被击打。

collocations.en: The metal was struck with a hammer.

formal.mt: Il-qanpien ddarrab fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja biex iħabbar il-ftuħ tagħha.
formal.en: The bells were sounded at the beginning of the ceremony to announce its opening.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，钟被敲响，以宣告仪式开幕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: Il-metall ddarrab bil-martell fil-ħanut ta' ħdejna. Maja: Issa fhimt minn fejn ġie.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise? Mark: Some metal was struck with a hammer in the shop next door. Maja: Now I understand where it came from.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？马克：隔壁店里有人用锤子敲了金属。玛雅：现在我知道声音从哪里来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-metall ddarrab bil-martell fil-ħanut ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-metall ddarrab bil-martell fil-ħanut ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 隔壁店里有人用锤子敲了金属。
messages.en: Some metal was struck with a hammer in the shop next door.

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 现在我知道声音从哪里来了。
messages.en: Now I understand where it came from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钟受到敲击后发出声音：关注响声时记“被敲响”，关注接触动作时记“受到敲击”。

gloss_zh: 感到烦躁；受到刺激而难受

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become irritated or feel unpleasantly on edge because of a disturbing sound, remark, or sensation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因刺耳的声音、令人不快的话语或其他刺激而变得烦躁、紧张或难受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħossok irritat jew skomdu minħabba ħoss, kliem jew sensazzjoni li ddejqek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得烦躁；感到恼怒。
受到刺激而感到紧张不适；被弄得浑身难受。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Pawlu ddarras bil-ħoss kontinwu li kien ġej mill-kuritur.
formal.en: During the meeting, Pawlu became irritated by the constant noise coming from the corridor.
formal.zh: 开会时，保罗被走廊里持续传来的噪声弄得烦躁起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Mark: Ddarras bil-ħoss tal-mużika u ħareġ ftit barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave? Mark: The loud music got on his nerves, so he stepped outside for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么走了？马克：音乐声弄得他心烦，他出去待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddarras bil-ħoss tal-mużika u ħareġ ftit barra.
messages.mt_standard: Ddarras bil-ħoss tal-mużika u ħareġ ftit barra.
messages.zh: 音乐声弄得他心烦，他出去待一会儿。
messages.en: The loud music got on his nerves, so he stepped outside for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刺耳噪声一响，人立刻皱眉、绷紧身体；用这个画面同时记住“烦躁”和“受刺激而难受”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To establish when something was made or happened, or to put a date on an item or document.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定物品制作或事件发生的年代，或在物品、文件上标明日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tistabbilixxi meta saret xi ħaġa jew meta ġrat, jew tikteb data fuq oġġett jew dokument.

sense_translations.en_definition: to date, to put a date on (to determine the age of something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……标注日期；确定某物的年代或已有多久的历史。

collocations.en: put a date on the letter

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina l-karta u l-kitba, ir-riċerkatur ddata l-manuskritt għas-seklu tmintax.
formal.en: After examining the paper and handwriting, the researcher dated the manuscript to the eighteenth century.
formal.zh: 研究人员检查纸张和笔迹后，将这份手稿的年代确定为十八世纪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-ittra għandha data? Mark: Iva, Pawlu ddata l-ittra qabel bagħatha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this letter have a date on it? Mark: Yes, Pawlu dated the letter before sending it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这封信上写日期了吗？马克：写了，保罗寄信前标了日期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这封信上写日期了吗？
messages.en: Does this letter have a date on it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu ddata l-ittra qabel bagħatha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu ddata l-ittra qabel bagħatha.
messages.zh: 写了，保罗寄信前标了日期。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu dated the letter before sending it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把文物旁的年代标签和信纸上的日期放在一起记：一个确定年代，一个写明日期，都围绕时间定位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To transfer a digital file from the internet or another remote system onto a device.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把数字文件从互联网或其他远程系统传输到自己的设备上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tittrasferixxi fajl diġitali mill-internet jew minn sistema oħra għal fuq it-tagħmir tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下载；把远程系统中的数字内容传输到本地设备。

formal.mt: L-istudent ddawnlowdja r-rapport mis-sit tal-università u qrah qabel il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The student downloaded the report from the university website and read it before the lesson.
formal.zh: 这名学生从大学网站下载了报告，并在上课前阅读了它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-fajl li għandna bżonn? Mark: Pawlu ddawnlowdja l-fajl fuq il-kompjuter tiegħu. Nistaqsuh għal kopja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the file we need? Mark: Pawlu downloaded it onto his computer. Let's ask him for a copy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要用的文件在哪儿？马克：保罗把文件下载到他的电脑上了。我们找他要一份吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-fajl li għandna bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-fajl li għandna bżonn?
messages.zh: 我们要用的文件在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the file we need?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ddawnlowdja l-fajl fuq il-kompjuter tiegħu. Nistaqsuh għal kopja.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ddawnlowdja l-fajl fuq il-kompjuter tiegħu. Nistaqsuh għal kopja.
messages.zh: 保罗把文件下载到他的电脑上了。我们找他要一份吧。
messages.en: Pawlu downloaded it onto his computer. Let's ask him for a copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件沿着向下的箭头进入电脑；把这个“下载到设备”的动作与整个词形一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 被照亮；受到启发；获得灵感

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lit up, gain understanding through enlightenment, or receive inspiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被光线照亮；也可指思想受到启发、理解有所增进，或获得灵感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir imdawwal bid-dawl; f'sens figurattiv, tikseb għarfien jew tirċievi ispirazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被照亮；有光线照射而变得明亮。
受到启发或启迪；对某事有了更清楚的认识。
受到鼓舞或启发；获得灵感。

collocations.en: was inspired by a new idea
collocations.zh: 因一个新想法而获得灵感

formal.mt: Il-kuritur ddawwal bid-dawl tax-xemx meta nfetħu l-bibien tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The corridor was illuminated by sunlight when the doors to the garden were opened.
formal.zh: 通往花园的门打开后，阳光照亮了走廊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu beda jikteb f'daqqa? Mark: Ddawwal b'idea ġdida waqt li konna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu suddenly start writing? Mark: He was inspired by a new idea while we were talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么突然写起东西来了？马克：我们聊天时，一个新想法给了他灵感。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么突然写起东西来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu suddenly start writing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddawwal b'idea ġdida waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ddawwal b'idea ġdida waqt li konna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 我们聊天时，一个新想法给了他灵感。
messages.en: He was inspired by a new idea while we were talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“亮起来”的画面串联三个义项：房间被照亮，理解变清楚，创作时脑中亮起灵感灯泡；这是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 被转动；被带着参观；被耽搁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be spun around, be taken around a place to see it, or be delayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被转动或旋转；被人带着参观某处；也可指受到耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddawwar fuqek innifsek, tittieħed minn xi ħadd biex tara post, jew iddum iżjed milli suppost minħabba dewmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被转动；被弄得旋转起来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be shown round a place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被带着参观某个地方。
被耽搁；受到延误。

collocations.en: was spun around on the chair
collocations.zh: 坐在椅子上被转了一圈

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur ddawwar mal-mużew minn gwida li spjegat l-istorja tal-oġġetti esposti.
formal.en: The visitor was shown around the museum by a guide who explained the history of the exhibits.
formal.zh: 一位导览员带这名访客参观了博物馆，并讲解了展品的历史。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ra l-binja l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, ddawwar mal-binja minn kollega dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu seen the new building? Mark: Yes, a colleague showed him around this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗看过新楼了吗？马克：看过了，今天上午一位同事带他参观了一圈。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗看过新楼了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu seen the new building?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ddawwar mal-binja minn kollega dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ddawwar mal-binja minn kollega dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 看过了，今天上午一位同事带他参观了一圈。
messages.en: Yes, a colleague showed him around this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别配三个场景记忆：转椅上被转动、跟着导览参观、事情受到耽搁；读句子时靠场景选择词义。

gloss_zh: 被插入；被强行塞入；获准进入

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put or inserted inside, to be forced in, or to be permitted to enter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放入或插入内部，被强行塞入，或获准进入某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed ġewwa, jidħol bil-forza, jew jingħata permess jidħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被插入；被放入。
被强行塞入或挤入。
获准进入；被允许入内。

formal.mt: Il-kejbil ddaħħal fit-toqba qabel ma twaħħal l-apparat mal-ħajt.
formal.en: The cable was inserted into the hole before the device was attached to the wall.
formal.zh: 设备固定到墙上之前，电缆先被穿入孔中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu seta' jidħol għall-kunċert? Mark: Iva, ddaħħal wara li wera l-biljett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Pawlu able to get into the concert? Mark: Yes, he was allowed in after showing his ticket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗进得了音乐会吗？马克：进去了，他出示票后获准入场。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗进得了音乐会吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu able to get into the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ddaħħal wara li wera l-biljett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ddaħħal wara li wera l-biljett.
messages.zh: 进去了，他出示票后获准入场。
messages.en: Yes, he was allowed in after showing his ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个入口，依次放上电缆、被硬塞的物件和持票的人，记住三种进入情形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become engulfed in smoke or covered with soot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被烟雾笼罩，或表面被烟灰覆盖、熏黑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-duħħan jew jitgħatta bin-nugrufun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烟雾笼罩或吞没。
被烟灰覆盖；被熏黑。

collocations.en: the corridor became filled with smoke
the wall became covered with soot

formal.mt: Il-kuritur ddaħħan waqt in-nar, u l-ħaddiema ħarġu mill-bini.
formal.en: The corridor became engulfed in smoke during the fire, and the workers left the building.
formal.zh: 火灾期间走廊被烟雾笼罩，工作人员撤出了大楼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħajt fuq il-fuklar sar iswed? Mark: Ddaħħan; irridu nnaddfuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the wall above the stove turned black? Mark: It has become covered with soot; we need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：炉子上方的墙怎么变黑了？马克：被烟灰熏黑了，得清理一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħajt fuq il-fuklar sar iswed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħajt fuq il-fuklar sar iswed?
messages.zh: 炉子上方的墙怎么变黑了？
messages.en: Why has the wall above the stove turned black?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 被烟灰熏黑了，得清理一下。
messages.en: It has become covered with soot; we need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把烟的两个结果连起来记：空气中烟雾弥漫，墙面上烟灰变黑，都是这个词的学习画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fool around or behave playfully instead of taking an activity seriously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胡闹、瞎玩，或在本应认真做事时嬉戏玩耍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqgħod tilgħab jew tagħmel ċajt minflok tieħu dak li qed tagħmel bis-serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡闹；瞎玩；不认真地嬉闹。

formal.mt: L-istudent ddebbeb waqt il-lezzjoni u ma semax l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliema.
formal.en: The student fooled around during the lesson and did not hear the teacher's instructions.
formal.zh: 这名学生上课时只顾胡闹，没有听到老师的指示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu lesta l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Le, ddebbeb mal-ħbieb u issa għadu fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu finished the exercise? Mark: No, he fooled around with his friends, and now he's still at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗做完练习了吗？马克：没有，他刚才和朋友们瞎玩，现在才做了个开头。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗做完练习了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu finished the exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ddebbeb mal-ħbieb u issa għadu fil-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ddebbeb mal-ħbieb u issa għadu fil-bidu.
messages.zh: 没有，他刚才和朋友们瞎玩，现在才做了个开头。
messages.en: No, he fooled around with his friends, and now he's still at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象练习本还空着，人却忙着和朋友嬉闹；把“该认真时只顾瞎玩”的完整场景与这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose strength or become debilitated, or to droop as a plant or part of something may do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去力气、变得虚弱或衰弱；也可指植物等失去挺立状态而低垂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlef is-saħħa jew issir dgħajjef ħafna; għal pjanta jew parti minnha, tinżel u ma tibqax wieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚弱；力气减弱。
变得衰弱；身体机能或体力明显减退。
低垂；下垂；失去挺立状态。

collocations.en: drooped because of a lack of water

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ddebbel wara l-marda u kellu bżonn aktar mistrieħ qabel ma reġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: The patient became debilitated after the illness and needed more rest before returning to work.
formal.zh: 这名患者病后身体衰弱，需要多休息一段时间才能重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-ward? Mark: Ddebbel għax ma kellux biżżejjed ilma. Se nsaqqih issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the roses? Mark: They drooped because they didn't have enough water. I'll water them now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些玫瑰怎么了？马克：水不够，花都垂下来了。我现在就浇水。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这些玫瑰怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the roses?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddebbel għax ma kellux biżżejjed ilma. Se nsaqqih issa.
messages.mt_standard: Ddebbel għax ma kellux biżżejjed ilma. Se nsaqqih issa.
messages.zh: 水不够，花都垂下来了。我现在就浇水。
messages.en: They drooped because they didn't have enough water. I'll water them now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把病后无力的人和缺水低垂的花并排想象：人失去力气，花失去挺立状态，帮助区分相关义项。

gloss_zh: 苍蝇滋生；耗费精力；胡闹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with flies; in other senses, to expend energy or to fool around.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某处滋生或聚满苍蝇；在其他义项中，指耗费精力，或胡闹、瞎玩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-dubbien; f'sensi oħra, jonfoq l-enerġija jew joqgħod jilgħab u jagħmel ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滋生苍蝇；被大量苍蝇侵扰。
耗费精力；付出体力或能量。
胡闹；瞎玩；嬉闹。

collocations.en: became infested with flies because of the rubbish
collocations.zh: 因垃圾而滋生了大量苍蝇

collocations.en: expended energy to finish the work
collocations.zh: 为完成工作耗费了精力

formal.mt: Il-post ddebben wara li l-iskart tħalla hemm għal diversi jiem mingħajr ma nġabar.
formal.en: The place became infested with flies after rubbish was left there for several days without being collected.
formal.zh: 垃圾在那里堆放了好几天无人清运，结果这个地方滋生了大量苍蝇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma bediex ix-xogħol? Mark: Ddebben mal-ħbieb dalgħodu u tilef il-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Pawlu started the work yet? Mark: He fooled around with his friends this morning and lost time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么还没开始干活？马克：他今天上午和朋友们瞎玩，把时间耽误了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma bediex ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu għadu ma bediex ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么还没开始干活？
messages.en: Why hasn't Pawlu started the work yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddebben mal-ħbieb dalgħodu u tilef il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ddebben mal-ħbieb dalgħodu u tilef il-ħin.
messages.zh: 他今天上午和朋友们瞎玩，把时间耽误了。
messages.en: He fooled around with his friends this morning and lost time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同一个词制作三张场景卡：垃圾旁苍蝇滋生、完成工作耗费精力、朋友之间嬉闹；分别记忆，不把三个义项硬合成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 被叫去干活；被召来工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be called upon to do some work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被叫来或被要求承担某项工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi msejjaħ biex jagħmel xi xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be called upon to work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被叫去工作；被召来干活。

collocations.en: was called upon to work in the warehouse
was called upon to help with the repairs

formal.mt: Minħabba n-nuqqas ta' ħaddiema, Mark ddebber għal xogħol fil-maħżen.
formal.en: Because of the staff shortage, Mark was called upon to work in the warehouse.
formal.zh: 由于人手不足，马克被叫去仓库工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu Mark? Pawlu: Ddebber biex jgħin fil-ħanut illum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Mark? Pawlu: He was called upon to help in the shop today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克在哪儿？保罗：他今天被叫去店里帮忙了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他今天被叫去店里帮忙了。
messages.en: He was called upon to help in the shop today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“人手不够，叫他来干活”的场景中记忆，重点记住被叫去承担工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something weaker or less strong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物的力量、体力或效力减弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa aktar dgħajfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 削弱；使力量减弱或使身体虚弱。

formal.mt: Il-mard ddebbulixxa lill-pazjent, li kellu bżonn żmien twil biex jirkupra.
formal.en: The illness weakened the patient, who needed a long time to recover.
formal.zh: 疾病使病人身体虚弱，他需要很长时间才能康复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadek daqshekk għajjien? Toni: Il-mard ddebbulixxa ġismi, u għadni qed nirkupra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you still so tired? Toni: The illness weakened my body, and I am still recovering.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么还是这么累？托尼：这场病把我的身体拖虚了，我还在恢复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还是这么累？
messages.en: Why are you still so tired?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mard ddebbulixxa ġismi, u għadni qed nirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mard ddebbulixxa ġismi, u għadni qed nirkupra.
messages.zh: 这场病把我的身体拖虚了，我还在恢复。
messages.en: The illness weakened my body, and I am still recovering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个力量条逐渐下降：既能表示病后身体变弱，也能表示结构或效力被削弱。

gloss_zh: 记入借方；从账户扣款；收取费用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter an amount as a debit against an account or charge someone a sum of money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把款项记入账户借方，或向某人收取一笔费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iniżżel ammont fuq in-naħa tad-debitu ta' kont jew jitlob ħlas mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将款项记入借方；从账户扣款或收取费用。

formal.mt: Il-bank ddebita għaxar ewro mill-kont tal-klijent bħala miżata ta' servizz.
formal.en: The bank debited ten euros from the customer's account as a service fee.
formal.zh: 银行从客户账户中扣除了十欧元作为服务费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għandi għaxar ewro inqas fil-kont? Sara: Il-bank ddebita miżata ta' servizz.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do I have ten euros less in my account? Sara: The bank charged a service fee.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的账户怎么少了十欧元？萨拉：银行收了一笔服务费。

messages.speaker: Mark (银行客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandi għaxar ewro inqas fil-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandi għaxar ewro inqas fil-kont?
messages.zh: 我的账户怎么少了十欧元？
messages.en: Why do I have ten euros less in my account?

messages.speaker: Sara (银行职员)
messages.zh: 银行收了一笔服务费。
messages.en: The bank charged a service fee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用银行账单记忆：看到一笔费用入账并从余额扣除，就联想到这个表示记借方或收费的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To appear or perform publicly for the first time in a particular role or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 首次以某种身份公开亮相、登台演出或参加活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher jew jieħu sehem għall-ewwel darba quddiem il-pubbliku f'qasam jew fi rwol partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首次公开亮相；首次登台或首次参加比赛等活动。

collocations.en: made his debut for the national team

formal.mt: L-attur żagħżugħ ddebutta fuq il-palk fit-teatru lokali s-sena li għaddiet.
formal.en: The young actor made his stage debut at the local theatre last year.
formal.zh: 这位年轻演员去年在当地剧院首次登台。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajtu jilgħab ilbieraħ? Luqa: Iva, ddebutta mat-tim nazzjonali u lagħab tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see him play yesterday? Luqa: Yes, he made his debut for the national team and played very well.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你昨天看他踢球了吗？卢卡：看了，他首次代表国家队出场，踢得很好。

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天看他踢球了吗？
messages.en: Did you see him play yesterday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ddebutta mat-tim nazzjonali u lagħab tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ddebutta mat-tim nazzjonali u lagħab tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 看了，他首次代表国家队出场，踢得很好。
messages.en: Yes, he made his debut for the national team and played very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给演员上台或球员出场的画面贴上“第一次”标签，抓住首次公开亮相这个共同点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lead someone into morally corrupt or excessively indulgent behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人陷入放纵、放荡或道德败坏的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwassal lil xi ħadd għal imġiba immorali jew għal ħajja ta' vizzji u eċċessi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人放荡或堕落；诱使人沉溺于放纵的生活。

collocations.zh: 使那个年轻人走向堕落
把朋友们带入放荡生活

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-ambjent ta' vizzji u eċċessi ddeбuxxa lill-protagonist u wasslu biex jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the environment of vice and excess debauched the protagonist and led him to neglect his responsibilities.
formal.zh: 小说中，充斥恶习与纵欲的环境使主人公堕落，并导致他疏忽自己的责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dak l-ambjent ddebuxxa lil Pawlu? Rita: Jiġifieri wasslu għal ħajja ta' vizzji u eċċessi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean when you say that environment debauched Pawlu? Rita: I mean it led him into a life of vice and excess.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说那个环境使保罗堕落，是什么意思？丽塔：就是说，那个环境让他过上了沉溺恶习、过度放纵的生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dak l-ambjent ddebuxxa lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dak l-ambjent ddebuxxa lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你说那个环境使保罗堕落，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say that environment debauched Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri wasslu għal ħajja ta' vizzji u eċċessi.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri wasslu għal ħajja ta' vizzji u eċċessi.
messages.zh: 就是说，那个环境让他过上了沉溺恶习、过度放纵的生活。
messages.en: I mean it led him into a life of vice and excess.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物受恶劣环境影响而越来越放纵，用“使人走向堕落”的情节记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give time or effort to a particular purpose, or to offer a work in someone's honour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把时间或精力投入某个目标，或把作品献给某人以表达敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti ħin jew sforz għal għan partikolari, jew toffri xogħol f'ġieħ xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奉献；把时间或精力投入某事；把作品献给某人。

collocations.en: dedicated the book to his mother

formal.mt: L-awtur iddedika dan il-ktieb lill-għalliema li għenuh matul l-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: The author dedicated this book to the teachers who helped him during his studies.
formal.zh: 作者把这本书献给了在求学期间帮助过他的老师们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min iddedikajt din il-kanzunetta? Pawlu: Iddedikajtha lil oħti, għax dejjem appoġġjatni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did you dedicate this song to? Pawlu: I dedicated it to my sister because she has always supported me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把这首歌献给了谁？Pawlu：我把它献给了姐姐，因为她一直支持我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把这首歌献给了谁？
messages.en: Who did you dedicate this song to?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (歌手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddedikajtha lil oħti, għax dejjem appoġġjatni.
messages.mt_standard: Iddedikajtha lil oħti, għax dejjem appoġġjatni.
messages.zh: 我把它献给了姐姐，因为她一直支持我。
messages.en: I dedicated it to my sister because she has always supported me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书的扉页写着“献给母亲”，再联想到把时间献给学习；用“把珍贵之物交给某人或目标”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach a conclusion by reasoning from facts or evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据事实或证据进行推理，得出结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tas għall-konklużjoni billi tirraġuna fuq fatti jew evidenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根据已知事实或证据推断；推导出结论。

collocations.en: deduced that there was an error

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur iddeduċa mir-riżultati li t-temperatura kellha effett fuq il-proċess.
formal.en: The researcher deduced from the results that temperature had an effect on the process.
formal.zh: 研究人员根据结果推断，温度对这一过程产生了影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif iddeduċejt li kont id-dar? Mark: Rajt id-dawl mixgħul u l-karozza tiegħek barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you deduce that I was at home? Mark: I saw the light on and your car outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么推断出我在家？Mark：我看到灯亮着，而且你的车停在外面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么推断出我在家？
messages.en: How did you deduce that I was at home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt id-dawl mixgħul u l-karozza tiegħek barra.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt id-dawl mixgħul u l-karozza tiegħek barra.
messages.zh: 我看到灯亮着，而且你的车停在外面。
messages.en: I saw the light on and your car outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“灯亮着、车在门外”画成两条线索，箭头指向“人在家”的结论；记住它强调有依据地推理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To protect someone or something against attack, or to argue in support of a person or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护某人或某物免受攻击，或通过论证为某人、某种立场辩护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipproteġi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn attakk, jew tressaq argumenti favur persuna jew pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保卫；保护；为某人或某种观点辩护。

formal.mt: L-avukat iddefenda lill-klijent tiegħu billi ppreżenta evidenza ġdida quddiem il-qorti.
formal.en: The lawyer defended his client by presenting new evidence before the court.
formal.zh: 律师通过向法庭提交新证据，为自己的当事人辩护。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex iddefendejt lil Toni fil-laqgħa? David: Għax il-kritika ma kinitx ġusta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you defend Toni at the meeting? David: Because the criticism was unfair.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么在会上替Toni说话？David：因为那些批评不公平。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么在会上替Toni说话？
messages.en: Why did you defend Toni at the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 因为那些批评不公平。
messages.en: Because the criticism was unfair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面盾牌挡住攻击，也想象一句有力的话挡住不公批评；身体上的保护和言语上的辩护都能一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or damaged by pressure or a heavy weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压力或重物挤压而被压坏、压扁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titgħaffeġ jew issirlek ħsara minħabba pressjoni jew toqol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压坏；被压扁；受到挤压而损坏。

collocations.zh: 在两块石头之间被压坏

formal.mt: Il-bott vojt iddeffen taħt it-toqol tal-ġebel li waqa' fuqu.
formal.en: The empty can was crushed under the weight of the stones that fell onto it.
formal.zh: 空罐子被落在上面的石头压扁了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lill-bott? Luqa: Iddeffen taħt il-kaxxa tqila.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to the can? Luqa: It was crushed under the heavy box.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个罐子怎么了？Luqa：它被沉重的箱子压扁了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这个罐子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the can?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 它被沉重的箱子压扁了。
messages.en: It was crushed under the heavy box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个空罐子被重箱压成扁片；把注意力放在“东西承受重压后的结果”，记住这里表达被压坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pushed into something, or to involve oneself in someone else's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被推入或塞进某物，也可指主动插手别人的事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddaħħal b'imbuttatura f'xi ħaġa, jew tindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力推入、塞入或插入某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to interfere in sb. else's business
sense_translations.zh_definition: 插手别人的事务；干涉他人的事情。

formal.mt: Il-feles iddeffes fix-xaqq biex iżomm il-biċċiet tal-injam mifrudin.
formal.en: The wedge was thrust into the crack to keep the pieces of wood apart.
formal.zh: 楔子被塞进裂缝，以使几块木头保持分开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark iddeffes fl-affarijiet tagħna? Lara: Ma nafx. Se ngħidlu jħallina nsolvu l-problema aħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark interfere in our affairs? Lara: I don't know. I'll tell him to let us solve the problem ourselves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么插手我们的事？Lara：我不知道。我会告诉他，让我们自己解决这个问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么插手我们的事？
messages.en: Why did Mark interfere in our affairs?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Se ngħidlu jħallina nsolvu l-problema aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Se ngħidlu jħallina nsolvu l-problema aħna.
messages.zh: 我不知道。我会告诉他，让我们自己解决这个问题。
messages.en: I don't know. I'll tell him to let us solve the problem ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记义：楔子被塞进缝隙，一个人插进别人的争论；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state precisely what a word or concept means, or to set clear limits for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准确说明词语或概念的含义，或明确划定某事物的范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tispjega b'mod preċiż it-tifsira ta' kelma jew kunċett, jew tistabbilixxi limiti ċari għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……下定义；明确说明含义；界定范围。

collocations.en: defined the limits of the project

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddefinixxa b'mod ċar il-kriterji għall-għażla tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The report clearly defined the criteria for selecting participants.
formal.zh: 报告明确界定了参与者的筛选标准。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif iddefinixxa l-għalliem il-kelma 'gżira'? Ben: Bħala biċċa art imdawra bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did the teacher define the word 'island'? Ben: As a piece of land surrounded by water.
colloquial.zh: Anna：老师怎样定义“岛”这个词？Ben：一块四周被水包围的陆地。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 老师怎样定义“岛”这个词？
messages.en: How did the teacher define the word 'island'?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 一块四周被水包围的陆地。
messages.en: As a piece of land surrounded by water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一个概念画出清楚的边框，再在框内写上准确解释；既能记“下定义”，也能记“界定范围”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have sexual intercourse with a woman who has not previously had sexual intercourse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与此前没有性交经历的女性发生性交，使其失去童贞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok x'taqsam sesswalment ma' mara li qatt ma kellha rapport sesswali qabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to deflower (to take the virginity of a woman or girl)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使女性失去童贞，即与此前没有性交经历的女性发生性交。

collocations.zh: 使一名成年女性失去童贞

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, il-verb 'ddeflora' jirreferi għall-ewwel rapport sesswali tal-mara adulta.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the verb 'ddeflora' refers to the adult woman's first sexual intercourse.
formal.zh: 在这篇小说分析中，动词“ddeflora”指这名成年女性的首次性交。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'ddeflora' f'din is-sentenza? Marija: Tfisser li raġel kellu x'jaqsam ma' mara għall-ewwel darba f'ħajjitha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ddeflora' mean in this sentence? Marija: It means that a man had sexual intercourse with a woman for the first time in her life.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的“ddeflora”是什么意思？Marija：意思是一名男子与一名女性发生了她人生中的首次性交。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学生)
