messages.zh: 这句话里的“ddeflora”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ddeflora' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Marija (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li raġel kellu x'jaqsam ma' mara għall-ewwel darba f'ħajjitha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li raġel kellu x'jaqsam ma' mara għall-ewwel darba f'ħajjitha.
messages.zh: 意思是一名男子与一名女性发生了她人生中的首次性交。
messages.en: It means that a man had sexual intercourse with a woman for the first time in her life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在阅读词汇卡上，标注“女性首次性交、失去童贞”；记忆重点是谁的首次经历，避免误解为双方首次相识。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change the shape of something so that it loses its normal or intended form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变某物的形状，使其失去正常或原定的形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibdel il-forma ta' xi ħaġa b'mod li titlef il-forma normali jew maħsuba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变形；使某物失去正常形状。

formal.mt: It-test wera li s-sħana eċċessiva ddeformat il-kontenitur tal-plastik.
formal.en: The test showed that excessive heat deformed the plastic container.
formal.zh: 测试表明，过高的温度使塑料容器变形了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-għatu m'għadux joqgħod sew? Sara: Is-sħana ddeformatu. Għandna bżonn wieħed ġdid.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why doesn't this lid fit properly anymore? Sara: The heat deformed it. We need a new one.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个盖子怎么盖不严了？Sara：高温把它弄变形了。我们需要一个新的。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-għatu m'għadux joqgħod sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-għatu m'għadux joqgħod sew?
messages.zh: 这个盖子怎么盖不严了？
messages.en: Why doesn't this lid fit properly anymore?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sħana ddeformatu. Għandna bżonn wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sħana ddeformatu. Għandna bżonn wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 高温把它弄变形了。我们需要一个新的。
messages.en: The heat deformed it. We need a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象圆形塑料盖受热后翘曲，怎么也盖不严；用“原来形状被改变”的画面记住使变形这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower someone's rank or status, reduce something's quality, or bring disgrace upon someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某人的级别或地位、降低某物的质量，或使某人蒙羞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-grad jew l-istatus ta' xi ħadd, ibaxxi l-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa, jew iġib għajb fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使降级；使降职；降低质量或地位。
使蒙羞；使丢脸；损害名誉。

formal.mt: Il-kmandant ddegrada lill-uffiċjal wara li dan kiser ir-regoli tas-servizz.
formal.en: The commander demoted the officer after he broke the service regulations.
formal.zh: 那名军官违反服役规定后，指挥官将他降了级。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-familja tant irrabjat ma' Karl? | Mark: Għax bl-aġir tiegħu ddegrada isem il-familja.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why was the family so angry with Karl? | Mark: Because his behaviour disgraced the family name.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：家里人为什么那么生卡尔的气？ | 马克：因为他的行为让家族名声蒙了羞。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-familja tant irrabjat ma' Karl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-familja tant irrabjat ma' Karl?
messages.zh: 家里人为什么那么生卡尔的气？
messages.en: Why was the family so angry with Karl?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bl-aġir tiegħu ddegrada isem il-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bl-aġir tiegħu ddegrada isem il-familja.
messages.zh: 因为他的行为让家族名声蒙了羞。
messages.en: Because his behaviour disgraced the family name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记义：肩章少一级是降职，家族名声受损是蒙羞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take on debt and become obliged to repay money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因借钱或承担付款义务而欠下债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fid-dejn u jkollu flus x'iħallas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负债；欠下债务。

collocations.en: went into debt to buy a house

formal.mt: Is-sid ddejjen mal-bank biex jixtri tagħmir ġdid għan-negozju.
formal.en: The owner incurred debt with the bank to buy new equipment for the business.
formal.zh: 业主为给企业购买新设备而向银行举债。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu qed joqgħod attent ħafna għall-ispejjeż? | Nina: Għax ddejjen biex jixtri dar u issa għandu l-ħlasijiet kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is Pawlu watching his spending so carefully? | Nina: Because he went into debt to buy a house and now has monthly payments.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么花钱这么谨慎？ | 妮娜：因为他为买房欠了债，现在每个月都要还款。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu qed joqgħod attent ħafna għall-ispejjeż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu qed joqgħod attent ħafna għall-ispejjeż?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么花钱这么谨慎？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu watching his spending so carefully?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ddejjen biex jixtri dar u issa għandu l-ħlasijiet kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ddejjen biex jixtri dar u issa għandu l-ħlasijiet kull xahar.
messages.zh: 因为他为买房欠了债，现在每个月都要还款。
messages.en: Because he went into debt to buy a house and now has monthly payments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想买房后每月还款的账本：这个词说的是背上债务、以后需要偿还。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lapse or to lose a right or entitlement, for example through failure to meet a deadline or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去效力，或因未满足期限、条件等而丧失某项权利或资格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-validità jew jitlef dritt, pereżempju minħabba li ma jkunx osserva terminu jew kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失效；丧失或失去某项权利、资格。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-applikant ddekada mid-dritt li jipparteċipa għax ma ssottomettiex id-dokumenti fil-ħin.
formal.en: In this example, the applicant forfeited the right to participate because he did not submit the documents on time.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，申请人因未按时提交文件而丧失了参与权。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, għaliex l-applikant ma jistax jipparteċipa? | Toni: Għax ma bagħatx id-dokumenti fil-ħin u ddekada mid-dritt li jipparteċipa.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this exercise, why can't the applicant participate? | Toni: Because he did not send the documents on time and forfeited the right to participate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里，申请人为什么不能参加？ | 托尼：因为他没有按时寄交文件，丧失了参与权。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, għaliex l-applikant ma jistax jipparteċipa?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, għaliex l-applikant ma jistax jipparteċipa?
messages.zh: 这道练习里，申请人为什么不能参加？
messages.en: In this exercise, why can't the applicant participate?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma bagħatx id-dokumenti fil-ħin u ddekada mid-dritt li jipparteċipa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma bagħatx id-dokumenti fil-ħin u ddekada mid-dritt li jipparteċipa.
messages.zh: 因为他没有按时寄交文件，丧失了参与权。
messages.en: Because he did not send the documents on time and forfeited the right to participate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象练习题里错过截止日期，原有资格随之失去；把“失效、失权”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce or eliminate carbon dioxide emissions from an activity, process, or sector.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少或消除某项活动、生产过程或行业的二氧化碳排放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas jew jelimina l-emissjonijiet tad-diossidu tal-karbonju minn attività, proċess jew settur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使脱碳；减少或消除二氧化碳排放。

formal.mt: F'dan l-istudju ta' każ, il-manifattur ddekarbonizza l-produzzjoni billi ssostitwixxa l-fjuwils fossili b'enerġija rinnovabbli.
formal.en: In this case study, the manufacturer decarbonized production by replacing fossil fuels with renewable energy.
formal.zh: 在这个案例研究中，制造商用可再生能源替代化石燃料，实现了生产脱碳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'biddel il-furnar fil-forn tiegħu? | Ben: Ddekarbonizza l-produzzjoni: issa juża forn elettriku li jaħdem bl-enerġija mix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the baker change at his bakery? | Ben: He decarbonized production: he now uses an electric oven powered by solar energy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：面包师给他的面包房做了什么改变？ | 本：他让生产脱碳了，现在用的是由太阳能供电的电烤炉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包师给他的面包房做了什么改变？
messages.en: What did the baker change at his bakery?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddekarbonizza l-produzzjoni: issa juża forn elettriku li jaħdem bl-enerġija mix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Ddekarbonizza l-produzzjoni: issa juża forn elettriku li jaħdem bl-enerġija mix-xemx.
messages.zh: 他让生产脱碳了，现在用的是由太阳能供电的电烤炉。
messages.en: He decarbonized production: he now uses an electric oven powered by solar energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“工厂换用清洁能源、碳排放下降”的画面绑定，记住脱碳这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pounded, or to be cooked for too long until excessively soft or mushy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被反复捣压，或因烹煮时间过长而变得过软、稀烂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi msawwat jew mgħaffeġ, jew jissajjar iżżejjed sakemm isir artab wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被捣打；被捣碎或捣烂。
被烹煮过头；煮得过软或过烂。

collocations.en: the pepper was pounded in the mortar
collocations.zh: 胡椒在研钵里被捣碎了

formal.mt: Il-bżar ddekkek fil-mehrież sakemm sar fin, imbagħad żdied mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The pepper was pounded in the mortar until fine, then added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 胡椒在研钵里被捣细，然后加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ir-ross sar daqshekk artab? | Toni: Ddekkek għax ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the rice become so soft? | Toni: It got overcooked because I left it on the heat too long.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：米饭怎么变得这么软烂？ | 托尼：我把它放在火上太久，煮过头了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 米饭怎么变得这么软烂？
messages.en: Why has the rice become so soft?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddekkek għax ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Ddekkek għax ħallejtu fuq in-nar wisq.
messages.zh: 我把它放在火上太久，煮过头了。
messages.en: It got overcooked because I left it on the heat too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 厨房里记两种结果：研钵中的胡椒被捣碎，锅里的米饭煮过头变得软烂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recite a text or deliver a speech aloud in an expressive, emphatic manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以富有表现力、强调语气的方式朗诵文字或发表演说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirreċta test jew jagħmel diskors b'leħen ċar u b'espressjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑扬顿挫地朗诵；慷慨激昂地演说。

collocations.zh: 富有感情地朗诵了一首诗
在观众面前朗诵或演说

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, l-istudent ddeklama poeżija b'leħen ċar u b'ħafna espressjoni.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the student declaimed a poem in a clear voice and with great expression.
formal.zh: 在仪式上，那名学生声音清晰、充满感情地朗诵了一首诗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif mar Mark fuq il-palk? | Lara: Ddeklama l-poeżija b'tant espressjoni li kulħadd ċapċap.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did Mark do on stage? | Lara: He declaimed the poem with so much expression that everyone applauded.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克在台上表现得怎么样？ | 拉拉：他把那首诗朗诵得特别有感染力，大家都鼓掌了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 马克在台上表现得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do on stage?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddeklama l-poeżija b'tant espressjoni li kulħadd ċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: Ddeklama l-poeżija b'tant espressjoni li kulħadd ċapċap.
messages.zh: 他把那首诗朗诵得特别有感染力，大家都鼓掌了。
messages.en: He declaimed the poem with so much expression that everyone applauded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在舞台中央，把诗句读得抑扬顿挫；用声音和表情一起记住朗诵之义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To politely refuse an invitation, offer, or request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以礼貌的方式拒绝邀请、提议或请求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrifjuta stedina, offerta jew talba b'mod edukat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婉拒；谢绝邀请、提议或请求。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ddeklina l-istedina għall-konferenza minħabba impenji oħra.
formal.en: The speaker declined the invitation to the conference because of other commitments.
formal.zh: 那位演讲者因另有安排而谢绝了会议邀请。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ġej għall-ikla? | Nina: Le, ddeklina l-istedina għax irid jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Mark coming to the meal? | Nina: No, he declined the invitation because he has to work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克来聚餐吗？ | 妮娜：不来，他因为得上班，谢绝了邀请。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克来聚餐吗？
messages.en: Is Mark coming to the meal?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ddeklina l-istedina għax irid jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ddeklina l-istedina għax irid jaħdem.
messages.zh: 不来，他因为得上班，谢绝了邀请。
messages.en: No, he declined the invitation because he has to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上“谢谢邀请，但我另有安排”这句礼貌回应，记住婉拒和谢绝。

gloss_zh: 使去殖民化；消除殖民统治或影响

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove colonial rule or colonial influence from a country or its institutions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一个国家或其机构摆脱殖民统治或殖民影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-ħakma jew l-influwenza kolonjali minn pajjiż jew mill-istituzzjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使去殖民化；使国家或机构摆脱殖民统治或影响。

collocations.zh: 消除教育体系中的殖民影响

formal.mt: Il-pjan għandu l-għan li jiddekolonizza l-istituzzjonijiet pubbliċi u jsaħħaħ it-tmexxija lokali.
formal.en: The plan aims to decolonize public institutions and strengthen local leadership.
formal.zh: 该计划旨在使公共机构去殖民化，并加强本地领导力量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'ddekolonizza' f'dan it-test? Mark: Jiġifieri li tneħħi l-ħakma jew l-influwenza kolonjali minn pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ddekolonizza' mean in this text? Mark: It means removing colonial rule or colonial influence from a country.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇课文里的 ddekolonizza 是什么意思？Mark：意思是消除一个国家所受的殖民统治或殖民影响。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇课文里的 ddekolonizza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ddekolonizza' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li tneħħi l-ħakma jew l-influwenza kolonjali minn pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li tneħħi l-ħakma jew l-influwenza kolonjali minn pajjiż.
messages.zh: 意思是消除一个国家所受的殖民统治或殖民影响。
messages.en: It means removing colonial rule or colonial influence from a country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddekolonizza 和“让本地人自己作主”的画面联系起来，记住核心意思是摆脱殖民统治或影响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break something into its components, or to break down through decay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分解或分离成组成部分；也指物质因腐败而逐渐分解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred xi ħaġa fil-partijiet li jiffurmawha, jew jitmermer u jinqasam f'sustanzi aktar sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分解；分离；把整体拆分成组成部分或不同物质。
腐解；腐败；指物质在腐败过程中逐渐分解。

formal.mt: Il-materjal organiku jiddekomponi maż-żmien u jsir parti mill-ħamrija.
formal.en: Organic material decomposes over time and becomes part of the soil.
formal.zh: 有机物随着时间逐渐腐解，成为土壤的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed inpoġġu l-weraq hawn? Mark: Biex jiddekomponi u jsir kompost għall-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we putting the leaves here? Mark: So they can decompose and become compost for the garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么把这些树叶放在这里？Mark：让它们腐解，变成花园用的堆肥。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么把这些树叶放在这里？
messages.en: Why are we putting the leaves here?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jiddekomponi u jsir kompost għall-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jiddekomponi u jsir kompost għall-ġnien.
messages.zh: 让它们腐解，变成花园用的堆肥。
messages.en: So they can decompose and become compost for the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ddekompona：实验中把物质分成不同成分，花园里落叶逐渐腐解；两者都从整体变成较小部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a place or object more attractive by adding flowers, ornaments, or other decorative details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加花卉、饰品等装饰物，使场所或物品更加美观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżejjen post jew oġġett bi fjuri, tiżjin jew dettalji oħra biex jidher isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；用饰品等布置场所或物品，使其更加美观。

formal.mt: L-iskola ddekorat is-sala bil-fjuri għall-festa ta' tmiem is-sena.
formal.en: The school decorated the hall with flowers for the end-of-year celebration.
formal.zh: 学校为学年结束庆典用鲜花装饰了大厅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nista' nagħmel biex il-kamra tidher isbaħ għall-festa? Luka: Ddekora l-mejda bil-fjuri u poġġi ftit blalen ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What can I do to make the room look nicer for the party? Luka: Decorate the table with flowers and put a few balloons by the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我能做些什么，让房间在聚会时更漂亮？卢卡：用鲜花装饰桌子，再在窗边放几个气球。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nista' nagħmel biex il-kamra tidher isbaħ għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: X'nista' nagħmel biex il-kamra tidher isbaħ għall-festa?
messages.zh: 我能做些什么，让房间在聚会时更漂亮？
messages.en: What can I do to make the room look nicer for the party?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddekora l-mejda bil-fjuri u poġġi ftit blalen ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Ddekora l-mejda bil-fjuri u poġġi ftit blalen ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 用鲜花装饰桌子，再在窗边放几个气球。
messages.en: Decorate the table with flowers and put a few balloons by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddekora 与“给桌子添鲜花、给房间挂气球”的画面绑定，记住核心意思是装饰得更美观。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give another person responsibility or authority to carry out a task on your behalf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某项任务交给他人负责，或授予他人代表自己执行任务的权限。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti lil persuna oħra r-responsabbiltà jew l-awtorità biex twettaq kompitu f'ismek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 委派；把任务或职责交给他人承担，或授权他人代为处理。

formal.mt: Id-direttriċi ddelegat il-ġestjoni tal-proġett lill-assistent tagħha.
formal.en: The director delegated management of the project to her assistant.
formal.zh: 女主管把项目管理工作交给了她的助理。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi ħafna xogħol illum. Kif nista' nlaħħaq? Rita: Ddelega xi kompiti lit-tim u ħu ħsieb dawk l-aktar importanti.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have a lot of work today. How can I get it all done? Rita: Delegate some tasks to the team and take care of the most important ones.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天有很多工作，怎样才能做得完？丽塔：把一些任务交给团队，你来处理最重要的那些。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna xogħol illum. Kif nista' nlaħħaq?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna xogħol illum. Kif nista' nlaħħaq?
messages.zh: 我今天有很多工作，怎样才能做得完？
messages.en: I have a lot of work today. How can I get it all done?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddelega xi kompiti lit-tim u ħu ħsieb dawk l-aktar importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Ddelega xi kompiti lit-tim u ħu ħsieb dawk l-aktar importanti.
messages.zh: 把一些任务交给团队，你来处理最重要的那些。
messages.en: Delegate some tasks to the team and take care of the most important ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddelega 想成主管把任务卡交到同事手中的动作：交出任务并让对方负责，就是委派。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To consider a matter carefully, especially in a formal discussion, or to reach a decision after considering it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细考虑或正式讨论某项事务；也可指经过考虑后作出决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkunsidra kwistjoni bir-reqqa, speċjalment f'diskussjoni formali, jew jieħu deċiżjoni wara li jikkunsidraha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审议；仔细考虑后作出决定。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddelibera dwar il-proposta qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The committee deliberated on the proposal before reaching a final decision.
formal.zh: 委员会审议了该提案，然后作出了最终决定。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se jiddelibera l-kumitat dwar il-proposta tagħna? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu. Wara l-laqgħa nkunu nafu d-deċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will the committee deliberate on our proposal? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning. After the meeting, we'll know the decision.
colloquial.zh: Marija：委员会什么时候审议我们的提案？Pawlu：明天上午。开完会后，我们就会知道决定了。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jiddelibera l-kumitat dwar il-proposta tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jiddelibera l-kumitat dwar il-proposta tagħna?
messages.zh: 委员会什么时候审议我们的提案？
messages.en: When will the committee deliberate on our proposal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu. Wara l-laqgħa nkunu nafu d-deċiżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu. Wara l-laqgħa nkunu nafu d-deċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 明天上午。开完会后，我们就会知道决定了。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning. After the meeting, we'll know the decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象委员会围桌讨论提案，再举手作出决定：把 ddelibera 和“认真审议、形成决定”这组画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show or describe clearly the shape, boundaries, or main features of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚地描绘某物的形状、界限或主要特点；勾勒或概述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri jew jiddeskrivi b'mod ċar il-forma, il-konfini jew il-karatteristiċi ewlenin ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勾勒或清楚描绘；界定范围、界限，或概述主要特点。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddelinea l-istadji ewlenin tal-proġett u r-responsabbiltajiet ta' kull tim.
formal.en: The report delineates the main stages of the project and the responsibilities of each team.
formal.zh: 报告清楚列明了项目的主要阶段及各团队的职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tiddelinea l-pjan qabel nibdew? Mark: Iva. L-ewwel niġbru l-informazzjoni, imbagħad naqsmu x-xogħol bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you outline the plan before we start? Mark: Yes. First we'll gather the information, then we'll divide the work among ourselves.
colloquial.zh: Sara：开始前，你能概述一下计划吗？Mark：可以。我们先收集资料，然后再分工。

messages.speaker: Sara (小组成员)
messages.zh: 开始前，你能概述一下计划吗？
messages.en: Can you outline the plan before we start?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. L-ewwel niġbru l-informazzjoni, imbagħad naqsmu x-xogħol bejnietna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. L-ewwel niġbru l-informazzjoni, imbagħad naqsmu x-xogħol bejnietna.
messages.zh: 可以。我们先收集资料，然后再分工。
messages.en: Yes. First we'll gather the information, then we'll divide the work among ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先在纸上画出清楚的轮廓，再用几句话说明计划要点：把 ddelinea 记成“画清界限、讲清框架”。

gloss_zh: 神志不清；说胡话；狂乱地说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be mentally confused and speak incoherently, for example because of a fever, or to speak in a wild, uncontrolled manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神志混乱并说出不连贯的话，例如因发烧而说胡话；也指狂乱、失控地说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun f'qagħda ta' taħwid mentali u jitkellem bla sens, pereżempju minħabba d-deni, jew jitkellem b'mod aġitat u bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于神志不清、意识混乱的状态。
狂乱地说话；语无伦次地说胡话。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-pazjent ddelirja matul il-lejl u ma għarafx lill-infermier.
formal.en: According to the report, the patient was delirious during the night and did not recognize the nurse.
formal.zh: 报告记载，该患者夜间神志不清，未能认出护士。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu ddelirja billejl? Anna: Iva, kellu d-deni u beda jgħid affarijiet bla sens. Marija: U kif inhu issa? Anna: Aħjar, u qed jitkellem sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was Pawlu delirious last night? Anna: Yes, he had a fever and started saying things that made no sense. Marija: And how is he now? Anna: Better, and he's speaking clearly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗昨晚说胡话了吗？安娜：是的，他发烧了，开始说些毫无意义的话。玛丽亚：那他现在怎么样？安娜：好些了，说话也清楚了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨晚说胡话了吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu delirious last night?

messages.speaker: Anna (保罗的姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu d-deni u beda jgħid affarijiet bla sens.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu d-deni u beda jgħid affarijiet bla sens.
messages.zh: 是的，他发烧了，开始说些毫无意义的话。
messages.en: Yes, he had a fever and started saying things that made no sense.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他现在怎么样？
messages.en: And how is he now?

messages.speaker: Anna (保罗的姐姐)
messages.zh: 好些了，说话也清楚了。
messages.en: Better, and he's speaking clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddelirja 和“发烧后脑子混乱、嘴里说胡话”的画面连在一起：既记意识状态，也记狂乱说话的表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smeared with a substance, or figuratively to have one's good name or reputation sullied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某种物质涂抹、弄脏；比喻名声或声誉受到玷污。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħammeġ b'sustanza li tinfirex fuqu; b'mod figurattiv, ikollu l-isem tajjeb jew ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu mħassra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被涂抹上某种物质；被抹脏。
受到玷污；尤指名声、声誉受到损害。

formal.mt: Isem il-kumpanija ddellek minħabba l-iskandlu, u l-klijenti tilfu l-fiduċja fiha.
formal.en: The company's name was sullied by the scandal, and its customers lost confidence in it.
formal.zh: 该公司的名声因丑闻受到玷污，客户也对其失去了信心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħajt ddellek biż-żejt? Mark: Il-flixkun waqa' u ż-żejt tar fuq il-ħajt. Lara: Ejja nnaddfuh qabel jinxef. Mark: Tajjeb, inġib ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the wall get smeared with oil? Mark: The bottle fell and oil splashed onto the wall. Lara: Let's clean it before it dries. Mark: Okay, I'll get a cloth.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：墙上怎么弄得都是油？马克：瓶子掉了，油溅到了墙上。拉拉：趁还没干，我们把墙擦干净吧。马克：好，我去拿块抹布。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 墙上怎么弄得都是油？
messages.en: Why did the wall get smeared with oil?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flixkun waqa' u ż-żejt tar fuq il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Il-flixkun waqa' u ż-żejt tar fuq il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 瓶子掉了，油溅到了墙上。
messages.en: The bottle fell and oil splashed onto the wall.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 趁还没干，我们把墙擦干净吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我去拿块抹布。
messages.en: Okay, I'll get a cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddellek 记成“表面被抹脏”的画面，再联想到“名声被玷污”：从看得见的污迹联想到看不见的声誉损害。

gloss_zh: 到阴凉处；使自己处于阴影中

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move into the shade to shelter oneself from direct sunlight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走到阴凉处，让自己避开阳光直晒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur fid-dell biex jistkenn mix-xemx.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put oneself in the shade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己处于阴凉处；到阴影下避晒。

collocations.en: took shelter in the shade of a tree
sheltered from the sun under an umbrella

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqfa, il-ħaddiem iddellel taħt siġra biex jistkenn mix-xemx qawwija.
formal.en: During the break, the worker took shelter in the shade of a tree to escape the strong sun.
formal.zh: 休息时，工人到树荫下躲避强烈的阳光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar Pawlu? Mark: Iddellel taħt is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Pawlu go? Mark: He went into the shade under the tree; it is too sunny here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 去哪儿了？Mark：他到那棵树下乘凉了；这里太阳太晒。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddellel taħt is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iddellel taħt is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
messages.zh: 他到那棵树下乘凉了；这里太阳太晒。
messages.en: He went into the shade under the tree; it is too sunny here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烈日下的人主动走进树荫，把这个动作与“到阴凉处避晒”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone a false impression or false hope, or to disappoint someone by failing to meet their expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生错误印象或虚假希望，或因未达到其期望而使其失望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd impressjoni jew tama falza, jew jiddiżappuntah billi ma jilħaqx l-aspettattivi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产生错觉或虚假希望；使失望。

collocations.en: deluded the public with false promises
collocations.zh: 用虚假承诺使公众抱有错觉

formal.mt: Il-kelliem iddeluda lill-pubbliku b'wegħdiet li ma setgħux jitwettqu.
formal.en: The speaker deluded the public with promises that could not be fulfilled.
formal.zh: 发言人用无法兑现的承诺使公众抱有虚假希望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-film kien tajjeb? Mark: Le, it-tmiem tiegħu ddeluda lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the film good? Mark: No, its ending disappointed everyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那部电影好看吗？Mark：不好，结局让大家都很失望。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部电影好看吗？
messages.en: Was the film good?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-tmiem tiegħu ddeluda lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-tmiem tiegħu ddeluda lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 不好，结局让大家都很失望。
messages.en: No, its ending disappointed everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“希望与现实不符”串联两个意思：先被误导而抱有希望，也可能因结果落空而失望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark or establish the boundaries of an area or the limits of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标出或确定某一区域的边界，或某事物的范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmarka jew jistabbilixxi l-konfini ta' żona jew il-limiti ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划定、标明边界；界定范围。

collocations.en: demarcated the boundaries of the land
marked out the area with rope

formal.mt: Il-perit iddemarka l-konfini tal-art fuq il-pjanta qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The architect marked the boundaries of the land on the plan before work began.
formal.zh: 工程开始前，建筑师在平面图上标明了土地边界。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nistgħu nħawlu s-siġar? Mark: Il-ġardinar iddemarka ż-żona bil-ħabel; nistgħu nħawlu hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can we plant the trees? Mark: The gardener marked out the area with rope; we can plant them there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们可以在哪里种树？Mark：园丁用绳子划出了区域；我们可以种在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 我们可以在哪里种树？
messages.en: Where can we plant the trees?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġardinar iddemarka ż-żona bil-ħabel; nistgħu nħawlu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġardinar iddemarka ż-żona bil-ħabel; nistgħu nħawlu hemm.
messages.zh: 园丁用绳子划出了区域；我们可以种在那里。
messages.en: The gardener marked out the area with rope; we can plant them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先在地图上画边界，再在地上拉绳子；两种动作都帮助记住“划定范围”。

gloss_zh: 使非军事化；撤除军事部署

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove military forces, weapons, or installations from an area so that it is no longer used for military purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撤走某地区的军队、武器或军事设施，使其不再用于军事目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi t-truppi, l-armi jew l-installazzjonijiet militari minn żona biex ma tibqax tintuża għal skopijiet militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使非军事化；撤除军队、武器或军事设施。

formal.mt: Il-gvern iddemilitarizza ż-żona tal-fruntiera skont il-ftehim ta' paċi.
formal.en: The government demilitarized the border area in accordance with the peace agreement.
formal.zh: 政府按照和平协议使边境地区非军事化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad hemm suldati f'dik iż-żona? Mark: Le, il-gvern iddemilitarizza ż-żona wara l-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are there still soldiers in that area? Mark: No, the government demilitarized the area after the agreement.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个地区还有士兵吗？Mark：没有，协议达成后，政府使那个地区非军事化了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个地区还有士兵吗？
messages.en: Are there still soldiers in that area?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-gvern iddemilitarizza ż-żona wara l-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-gvern iddemilitarizza ż-żona wara l-ftehim.
messages.zh: 没有，协议达成后，政府使那个地区非军事化了。
messages.en: No, the government demilitarized the area after the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成“撤走军队、搬走武器、移除军事设施”，由此联想到“使地区非军事化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For one's eyes to fill with tears because of emotion or irritation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指眼睛因情绪或刺激而泛起泪水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għall-għajnejn meta jimtlew bid-dmugħ minħabba emozzjoni jew irritazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to tear up (used of one's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛泛泪、含泪；用于描述眼睛。

collocations.en: his eyes began to fill with tears from emotion
collocations.zh: 他因情绪激动而眼中泛泪

collocations.en: his eyes began to water from the smoke
collocations.zh: 他的眼睛被烟熏得流泪

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, għajnejn Pawlu bdew jiddemmgħu meta sema' d-diskors ta' ommu.
formal.en: During the ceremony, Pawlu's eyes began to fill with tears when he heard his mother's speech.
formal.zh: 仪式上，Pawlu 听到母亲的致辞时，眼中开始泛起泪水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed togħrok għajnejk? Mark: Bdew jiddemmgħu meta qtajt il-basla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you rubbing your eyes? Mark: They began to water when I cut the onion.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么揉眼睛？Mark：我切洋葱时，眼睛开始流泪了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么揉眼睛？
messages.en: Why are you rubbing your eyes?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我切洋葱时，眼睛开始流泪了。
messages.en: They began to water when I cut the onion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住感动和切洋葱这两个画面：原因不同，共同点都是眼睛泛起泪水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For land to be fertilized by having manure applied to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指土地接受粪肥施用，得到肥力补充。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għall-art meta jiżdiedilha d-demel biex issir aktar għammiela.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be fertilised using manure (used of land)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被施以粪肥；用于土地。

collocations.en: the farmland was fertilized with cattle manure
the farmland was fertilized with manure before sowing
collocations.zh: 农田在播种前被施以粪肥

formal.mt: Ir-raba' ddemmel fil-ħarifa biex il-ħamrija tkun lesta għaż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The farmland was fertilized with manure in autumn so that the soil would be ready for sowing.
formal.zh: 农田在秋季被施以粪肥，以便土壤做好播种准备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-raba' diġà ddemmel? Mark: Iva, il-bidwi xerred id-demel il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this farmland already been fertilized with manure? Mark: Yes, the farmer spread the manure last week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这片农田已经施过粪肥了吗？Mark：是的，农民上周就把粪肥撒好了。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场学徒)
messages.zh: 这片农田已经施过粪肥了吗？
messages.en: Has this farmland already been fertilized with manure?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bidwi xerred id-demel il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bidwi xerred id-demel il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 是的，农民上周就把粪肥撒好了。
messages.en: Yes, the farmer spread the manure last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把土地想成接受肥料的一方：农民撒下粪肥，土地便处于“被施以粪肥”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bloody or covered or stained with blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得带血、沾满血或留下血迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imċappas jew miksi bid-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得带血或血淋淋；沾上血迹。

collocations.en: the face became bloody after a fall

formal.mt: Wara l-inċident, il-flokk tal-ħaddiem iddemmem minħabba ferita f'idu.
formal.en: After the accident, the worker's shirt became bloodstained because of a wound on his hand.
formal.zh: 事故发生后，工人手上的伤口使他的衬衫沾上了血。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-flokk tiegħi ddemmem meta waqajt. Sara: Għandi flokk nadif għalik.
colloquial.en: Mark: My shirt got bloodstained when I fell. Sara: I have a clean shirt for you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我摔倒时，衬衫沾上了血。Sara：我这里有件干净衬衫给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我摔倒时，衬衫沾上了血。
messages.en: My shirt got bloodstained when I fell.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我这里有件干净衬衫给你。
messages.en: I have a clean shirt for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件原本干净的衬衫逐渐染上血迹，重点记住“变得带血”这一状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For food to have salt, pepper, herbs, or other seasonings added to improve its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被加入盐、胡椒、香草等调味料，以改善味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għall-ikel meta jiżdiedlu melħ, bżar, ħwawar jew ingredjenti oħra biex jitjieb it-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被调味；用于食物。

collocations.en: the broth was seasoned with salt and pepper
collocations.zh: 清汤被加入盐和胡椒调味

collocations.en: the stew was seasoned with herbs and spices
collocations.zh: 炖菜被加入香草和香料调味

formal.mt: Il-brodu ddemmes bil-ħwawar qabel ma ġie servut lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The broth was seasoned with herbs and spices before it was served to the guests.
formal.zh: 清汤在端给客人之前，先加入香草和香料调了味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-brodu diġà ddemmes? Mark: Iva, żidt ftit melħ u bżar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the broth already been seasoned? Mark: Yes, I added a little salt and pepper.
colloquial.zh: Sara：清汤已经调过味了吗？Mark：是的，我加了一点盐和胡椒。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 清汤已经调过味了吗？
messages.en: Has the broth already been seasoned?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidt ftit melħ u bżar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidt ftit melħ u bżar.
messages.zh: 是的，我加了一点盐和胡椒。
messages.en: Yes, I added a little salt and pepper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一锅清汤被撒入盐、胡椒和香草，把食物作为接受调味的一方来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a system or organization more democratic by giving more people a voice in decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使制度或组织更加民主，让更多人能够参与决策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel sistema jew organizzazzjoni aktar demokratika billi tagħti lil aktar nies sehem fid-deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使民主化；扩大人们参与决策的机会。

collocations.en: democratize the running of the association

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddemokratizza t-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet billi ta vot lil kull membru.
formal.en: The committee democratized decision-making by giving every member a vote.
formal.zh: 委员会让每位成员都有投票权，从而使决策过程民主化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issa kull membru jista' jivvota? Mark: Iva, il-kumitat iddemokratizza s-sistema.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can every member vote now? Mark: Yes, the committee democratized the system.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在每位成员都能投票了吗？马克：对，委员会让这个制度民主化了。

messages.speaker: Maja (协会成员)
messages.zh: 现在每位成员都能投票了吗？
messages.en: Can every member vote now?

messages.speaker: Mark (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 对，委员会让这个制度民主化了。
messages.en: Yes, the committee democratized the system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“人人都有一票”的画面联系起来，记住它表示让制度更民主、让更多人参与决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deliberately tear down or destroy a building or other structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有意拆除或摧毁建筑物及其他构筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twaqqa' jew teqred apposta bini jew struttura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆毁；拆除建筑物或其他构筑物。

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur iddemolixxa l-bini antik wara li ngħata l-permess meħtieġ.
formal.en: The contractor demolished the old building after the required permit was granted.
formal.zh: 承包商在获得所需许可后拆除了那栋旧建筑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar il-garaxx l-antik? Pawlu: Is-sid iddemolixxa l-garaxx il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the old garage? Pawlu: The owner demolished the garage last week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个旧车库怎么不见了？保罗：业主上周把车库拆掉了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个旧车库怎么不见了？
messages.en: What happened to the old garage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid iddemolixxa l-garaxx il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid iddemolixxa l-garaxx il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 业主上周把车库拆掉了。
messages.en: The owner demolished the garage last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象挖掘机把旧墙拆成碎块，用“整座建筑被拆掉”的画面记住这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop pus or become infected, especially of a wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指伤口等出现化脓或受到感染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timtela bil-materja jew tiġi infettata, speċjalment meta tkun ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化脓；产生脓液。
受到感染；发生感染。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-ferita ddennat u li kien hemm il-materja.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the wound became infected and that pus was present.
formal.zh: 医疗报告指出，伤口发生了感染，并出现了脓液。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qallek it-tabib dwar il-qatgħa? Toni: Qalli li ddennat u spjegali kif nieħu ħsiebha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the doctor tell you about the cut? Toni: He told me it had become infected and explained how to care for it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：医生怎么说你的割伤？托尼：他说伤口感染了，还解释了该怎么护理。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说你的割伤？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you about the cut?

messages.speaker: Toni (伤者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li ddennat u spjegali kif nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li ddennat u spjegali kif nieħu ħsiebha.
messages.zh: 他说伤口感染了，还解释了该怎么护理。
messages.en: He told me it had become infected and explained how to care for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“伤口感染、随后出现脓液”的场景联想两个义项；记住感染与化脓分别对应不同描述，并非完全相同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be positioned end to end with another object, forming a line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一物体首尾相接地放置，形成一条连续的排列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed tarf ma' tarf ma' oġġett ieħor biex jifforma ringiela.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be placed end to end
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被首尾相接地放置；与其他物体端对端地排列。

collocations.en: a pipe placed end to end with another
collocations.zh: 与另一根管子端对端放置的管子

collocations.en: a railway carriage placed end to end with another
collocations.zh: 与另一节车厢首尾相接排列的车厢

formal.mt: Il-pajp iddenneb ma' pajp ieħor, bit-truf imissu ma' xulxin.
formal.en: The pipe was placed end to end with another pipe, with their ends touching.
formal.zh: 这根管子与另一根管子端对端放置，两端彼此接触。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pajp tqiegħed ħdejn l-ieħor? Ġanni: Le, iddenneb miegħu; tarf wieħed imiss mat-tarf tal-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was this pipe placed beside the other one? Ġanni: No, it was placed end to end with it; one end touches the end of the other.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这根管子是放在另一根旁边的吗？詹尼：不是，是端对端放的；它的一端碰着另一根的一端。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这根管子是放在另一根旁边的吗？
messages.en: Was this pipe placed beside the other one?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, iddenneb miegħu; tarf wieħed imiss mat-tarf tal-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, iddenneb miegħu; tarf wieħed imiss mat-tarf tal-ieħor.
messages.zh: 不是，是端对端放的；它的一端碰着另一根的一端。
messages.en: No, it was placed end to end with it; one end touches the end of the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两根吸管沿直线端对端接起来，记住关键是首尾相接的摆放状态。

gloss_zh: 失去光泽或颜色；变浑浊或污秽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose brightness or color, or to become murky or filthy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去原有的光泽或颜色，或变得浑浊、污秽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-leqq jew il-kulur, jew isir imċajpar jew maħmuġ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去光泽或颜色；变得暗淡或褪色。
变得浑浊或污秽。

collocations.en: fabric that lost its brightness or color
collocations.zh: 失去光泽或颜色的布料

collocations.en: water that became murky or filthy

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, l-ilma tal-għadira ddennes u ma baqax ċar.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the pond water became murky and was no longer clear.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，池塘里的水变得浑浊，不再清澈。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan id-drapp qabel kellu kulur aktar ħaj, hux? Rita: Iva, maż-żmien iddennes u tilef il-leqq.
colloquial.en: Marija: This fabric used to have a brighter color, didn't it? Rita: Yes, over time it grew dull and lost its sheen.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这块布以前颜色更鲜亮，对吧？丽塔：对，时间久了就暗淡了，也失去了光泽。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp qabel kellu kulur aktar ħaj, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp qabel kellu kulur aktar ħaj, hux?
messages.zh: 这块布以前颜色更鲜亮，对吧？
messages.en: This fabric used to have a brighter color, didn't it?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, maż-żmien iddennes u tilef il-leqq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, maż-żmien iddennes u tilef il-leqq.
messages.zh: 对，时间久了就暗淡了，也失去了光泽。
messages.en: Yes, over time it grew dull and lost its sheen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象一块失去鲜亮颜色的布和一池变浑的水，用“原本鲜明清亮，后来暗淡污浊”串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a name or designation to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个事物赋予名称或指定称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti isem jew denominazzjoni lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命名；给某事物指定名称或称谓。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddenomina l-ewwel żona bħala 'Żona A' biex jiffaċilita r-referenzi għaliha.
formal.en: The report designated the first area as 'Zone A' to make it easier to refer to.
formal.zh: 报告将第一个区域命名为“A区”，以便引用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dan il-grupp jissejjaħ 'Grupp B'? David: L-għalliem iddenomina kull grupp b'ittra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this group called 'Group B'? David: The teacher designated each group with a letter.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么这个小组叫“B组”？戴维：老师用字母给每个小组命名了。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这个小组叫“B组”？
messages.en: Why is this group called 'Group B'?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 老师用字母给每个小组命名了。
messages.en: The teacher designated each group with a letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给地图上的区域贴上“A区”名称标签，把这个词记成“赋予名称”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To indicate or stand for a particular meaning, thing, or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示或指示某种含义、事物或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika jew jirrappreżenta tifsira, ħaġa jew kundizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示；指示；代表某种含义或事物。

formal.mt: F'din il-mappa, kull ċirku blu jiddenota bir.
formal.en: On this map, each blue circle denotes a well.
formal.zh: 在这张地图上，每个蓝色圆圈都表示一口井。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'jiddenota dan it-trijanglu aħmar? Luqa: Jiddenota periklu, skont iċ-ċavetta tal-mappa.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does this red triangle denote? Luqa: It denotes danger, according to the map key.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这个红色三角形表示什么？卢卡：根据地图图例，它表示危险。

messages.speaker: Elena (徒步者)
messages.zh: 这个红色三角形表示什么？
messages.en: What does this red triangle denote?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 根据地图图例，它表示危险。
messages.en: It denotes danger, according to the map key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到地图图例就问“这个符号表示什么”，用“符号指向含义”的关系记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To publicly condemn someone or something as wrong, or to report wrongdoing to an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公开谴责某人或某事的不当之处，或向有关机构揭发不当行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikkundanna pubblikament lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bħala ħażina, jew tirrapporta għemil ħażin lil awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开谴责；揭发或告发不当行为。

formal.mt: Fi stqarrija pubblika, l-għaqda ddenunzjat l-abbuż tal-poter u talbet investigazzjoni indipendenti.
formal.en: In a public statement, the association denounced the abuse of power and called for an independent investigation.
formal.zh: 协会在公开声明中谴责了滥用权力的行为，并要求开展独立调查。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'qal il-kelliem dwar il-korruzzjoni? Simon: Iddenunzja l-korruzzjoni u talab li jittieħdu passi.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did the spokesperson say about corruption? Simon: He denounced corruption and called for action.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：发言人对腐败问题说了什么？西蒙：他谴责了腐败，并要求采取行动。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 发言人对腐败问题说了什么？
messages.en: What did the spokesperson say about corruption?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddenunzja l-korruzzjoni u talab li jittieħdu passi.
messages.mt_standard: Iddenunzja l-korruzzjoni u talab li jittieħdu passi.
messages.zh: 他谴责了腐败，并要求采取行动。
messages.en: He denounced corruption and called for action.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人站出来公开指出不当行为，并要求处理，用“公开谴责、向有关方面揭发”的场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rely on someone or something, or to be determined by a particular condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠某人或某物，或由某个条件决定结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu bżonn l-għajnuna ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew ikun jiddependi minn kundizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖；取决于。

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-proġett ddependa fuq il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri tat-tim.
formal.en: The success of the project depended on cooperation among the team members.
formal.zh: 项目的成功取决于团队成员之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma mortux il-baħar ilbieraħ? Mark: Kollox ddependa fuq it-temp, u għamlet ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you go to the beach yesterday? Mark: Everything depended on the weather, and it rained.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们昨天为什么没去海边？马克：一切都得看天气，结果下雨了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们昨天为什么没去海边？
messages.en: Why didn't you go to the beach yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox ddependa fuq it-temp, u għamlet ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Kollox ddependa fuq it-temp, u għamlet ix-xita.
messages.zh: 一切都得看天气，结果下雨了。
messages.en: Everything depended on the weather, and it rained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddependa 和“出门要看天气”连起来记：能不能出发，取决于天气；也可以用来表达依靠他人的帮助。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express strong regret or disapproval about something considered wrong or unfortunate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对被认为错误或令人痛心的事情表示强烈遗憾或谴责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi dispjaċir kbir jew diżapprovazzjoni qawwija dwar xi ħaġa ħażina jew ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对……深表遗憾；对……表示强烈不满或谴责。

collocations.zh: 对暴力行为表示强烈谴责

formal.mt: Fi stqarrija uffiċjali, il-kunsill ddeplora l-ħsara li saret fil-ġnien pubbliku.
formal.en: In an official statement, the council deplored the damage done to the public garden.
formal.zh: 委员会在一份正式声明中，对公共花园遭到破坏表示强烈谴责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qal il-kap dwar il-ġlieda? Pawlu: Ddeplora l-vjolenza u qal li rridu nirrispettaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the head say about the fight? Pawlu: He deplored the violence and said we must respect one another.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：负责人对那场打架说了什么？保罗：他强烈谴责了暴力行为，还说我们必须互相尊重。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 负责人对那场打架说了什么？
messages.en: What did the head say about the fight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddeplora l-vjolenza u qal li rridu nirrispettaw lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Ddeplora l-vjolenza u qal li rridu nirrispettaw lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 他强烈谴责了暴力行为，还说我们必须互相尊重。
messages.en: He deplored the violence and said we must respect one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象负责人看到花园被破坏后郑重发表声明，用 ddeplora 记住“深表遗憾、强烈谴责”这种较正式的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give evidence or testimony, especially as a witness in a formal proceeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供证据或证言，尤指作为证人在正式程序中作证。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xhieda jew provi, speċjalment bħala xhud fi proċedura formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供证据；作证。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud ddepona quddiem il-qorti u ddeskriva dak li ra dakinhar.
formal.en: The witness gave evidence before the court and described what he saw that day.
formal.zh: 证人在法庭上作证，描述了他当天看到的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk mar il-qorti llum? Toni: Iva, ddepona dwar l-inċident li ra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did your brother go to court today? Toni: Yes, he gave evidence about the incident he saw.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥今天去法院了吗？托尼：去了，他就自己目睹的那起事件作了证。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥今天去法院了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother go to court today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ddepona dwar l-inċident li ra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ddepona dwar l-inċident li ra.
messages.zh: 去了，他就自己目睹的那起事件作了证。
messages.en: Yes, he gave evidence about the incident he saw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddepona 放进“证人站在法庭上讲述亲眼所见”的画面，记住它表示提供证据或作证。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially force someone to leave a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由官方强制某人离开一个国家，即驱逐出境或遣返。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiż permezz ta' deċiżjoni uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人驱逐出境；遣返。

collocations.en: deported a person from the country
deported a person to their home country

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-gvern ddeporta lill-persuna wara li ntemmet il-proċedura.
formal.en: The report says that the government deported the person after the procedure ended.
formal.zh: 报告称，政府在程序结束后将该人驱逐出境。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'kien hemm fl-aħbarijiet? Mark: Qalu li l-gvern ddeporta raġel lejn pajjiżu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was on the news? Mark: They said the government deported a man to his home country.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：新闻里说了什么？马克：说政府把一名男子遣返回了他的本国。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 新闻里说了什么？
messages.en: What was on the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalu li l-gvern ddeporta raġel lejn pajjiżu.
messages.mt_standard: Qalu li l-gvern ddeporta raġel lejn pajjiżu.
messages.zh: 说政府把一名男子遣返回了他的本国。
messages.en: They said the government deported a man to his home country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ddeporta 时抓住“官方要求一个人离开国境”的场景，把人物、官方决定和离境三个要素连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put money into an account or place something somewhere for storage or safekeeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱存入账户，或把物品放在某处保存、保管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed flus f'kont jew xi ħaġa f'post biex tinżamm jew titħares.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存入款项；存放或寄存物品。

collocations.en: deposited a cheque at the bank

formal.mt: It-teżorier ddepożita l-flus miġbura fil-kont tal-għaqda.
formal.en: The treasurer deposited the money collected into the association's account.
formal.zh: 财务主管把募集到的钱存入了协会账户。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn huma l-flus tal-bejgħ? Pawlu: Toni ddepożita kollox fil-bank dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the money from the sale? Pawlu: Toni deposited it all at the bank this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卖东西收到的钱在哪里？保罗：托尼今天早上把钱全存进银行了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 卖东西收到的钱在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the money from the sale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼今天早上把钱全存进银行了。
messages.en: Toni deposited it all at the bank this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把现金交到银行柜台、账户余额随之增加，用这个“钱被存进去”的动作记住 ddepożita。

gloss_zh: 贬值；使价值下降；计提折旧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose value, cause something to lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价值下降、使某物价值下降，或随时间减少资产的账面价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-valur, inaqqas il-valur ta' xi ħaġa, jew inaqqas il-valur irreġistrat ta' assi maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬值；使价值下降；在会计中对资产计提折旧。

collocations.en: depreciated the equipment over five years
collocations.zh: 在五年内对设备计提折旧

formal.mt: Il-kontabilist ddeprezza t-tagħmir fuq perjodu ta' ħames snin.
formal.en: The accountant depreciated the equipment over a period of five years.
formal.zh: 会计在五年期间内对这批设备计提了折旧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karozza issa tiswa inqas? Mark: L-użu ta' kuljum ddeprezza l-karozza, u issa għandha ħafna kilometri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the car worth less now? Mark: Daily use reduced its value, and it now has high mileage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这辆车现在为什么不那么值钱了？马克：日常使用让它贬值了，而且现在里程数很高。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这辆车现在为什么不那么值钱了？
messages.en: Why is the car worth less now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-użu ta' kuljum ddeprezza l-karozza, u issa għandha ħafna kilometri.
messages.mt_standard: L-użu ta' kuljum ddeprezza l-karozza, u issa għandha ħafna kilometri.
messages.zh: 日常使用让它贬值了，而且现在里程数很高。
messages.en: Daily use reduced its value, and it now has high mileage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddeprezza 和二手车价格标签往下调的画面连起来：车用久了价值下降，账本中的设备也会逐年折旧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel sad, discouraged, or low in spirits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到悲伤、灰心或情绪低落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mdejjaq, skuraġġit jew baxx fil-burdata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使沮丧；使情绪低落。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-qerda tal-foresti ddeprima lil ħafna qarrejja.
formal.en: The report about the destruction of forests depressed many readers.
formal.zh: 这篇关于森林遭到破坏的报告使许多读者感到沮丧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-film? Toni: Kien tajjeb, imma t-tmiem ddeprima lili u lil ħija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the film? Toni: It was good, but the ending depressed me and my brother.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢这部电影吗？托尼：拍得不错，不过结局让我和哥哥都很沮丧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tajjeb, imma t-tmiem ddeprima lili u lil ħija.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tajjeb, imma t-tmiem ddeprima lili u lil ħija.
messages.zh: 拍得不错，不过结局让我和哥哥都很沮丧。
messages.en: It was good, but the ending depressed me and my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看完悲伤电影后肩膀垂下、心情低落，用“故事让人沮丧”的画面记住 ddeprima 的情绪作用。

gloss_zh: 委派；指派某人代表行事

teaching_sense.en_definition: To appoint someone to perform a task or act on behalf of another person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指派某人执行任务，或代表另一个人或团体行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħtar lil xi ħadd biex iwettaq xogħol jew jaġixxi f'isem persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 委派；指派某人执行任务或代表他人行事。

collocations.mt: ddeputa lil xi ħadd biex jattendi laqgħa
collocations.en: deputed someone to attend a meeting

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ddeputa lil Marija biex tippreżenta l-proposta f'ismu.
formal.en: The committee deputed Marija to present the proposal on its behalf.
formal.zh: 委员会委派玛丽亚代表委员会介绍这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jmur għal-laqgħa minflok id-direttur? Pawlu: Id-direttur ddeputa lil Mark biex imur f'ismu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to the meeting instead of the director? Pawlu: The director deputed Mark to go on his behalf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁会代替主任去开会？保罗：主任委派马克代表他去。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmur għal-laqgħa minflok id-direttur?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmur għal-laqgħa minflok id-direttur?
messages.zh: 谁会代替主任去开会？
messages.en: Who is going to the meeting instead of the director?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direttur ddeputa lil Mark biex imur f'ismu.
messages.mt_standard: Id-direttur ddeputa lil Mark biex imur f'ismu.
messages.zh: 主任委派马克代表他去。
messages.en: The director deputed Mark to go on his behalf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ddeputa 时想象主任把会议文件交给代表，说“你代表我去”：有人作出委派，另一个人接受任务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To manage an activity or control how work is carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 管理某项活动，或指挥、控制工作的进行方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imexxi attività jew jikkontrolla kif isir ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理；指挥；控制活动或工作的进行。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer dderieġa x-xogħol tat-tim u qassam ir-responsabbiltajiet bejn il-membri.
formal.en: The manager directed the team's work and distributed responsibilities among its members.
formal.zh: 经理指挥了团队的工作，并在成员之间分配了职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min dderieġa x-xogħol illum? Mark: Pawlu. Qal lil kull wieħed minna x'kellu jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who managed the work today? Mark: Pawlu. He told each of us what to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天是谁安排和管理工作的？马克：保罗。他告诉了我们每个人该做什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天是谁安排和管理工作的？
messages.en: Who managed the work today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Qal lil kull wieħed minna x'kellu jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Qal lil kull wieħed minna x'kellu jagħmel.
messages.zh: 保罗。他告诉了我们每个人该做什么。
messages.en: Pawlu. He told each of us what to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象经理站在团队中央分配任务，把这个词与“管理工作、指挥行动”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come from a source or obtain something through reasoning from existing information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来源于某个源头，或根据已有信息推导、得出某个结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi minn sors jew jasal għal riżultat permezz ta' raġunament fuq informazzjoni eżistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自；从某个来源取得，或根据已有信息推导出。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur dderiva formula ġdida mill-ekwazzjonijiet eżistenti u spjega kull pass tal-kalkolu.
formal.en: The researcher derived a new formula from the existing equations and explained every step of the calculation.
formal.zh: 研究人员根据现有方程推导出了一个新公式，并解释了计算的每一步。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif dderiva din il-formula l-għalliem? Toni: Beda b'dik li diġà nafu u biddel pass wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the teacher derive this formula? Toni: He started with the one we already know and changed one step.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：老师是怎样推导出这个公式的？托尼：他从我们已经知道的那个公式出发，改动了其中一步。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 老师是怎样推导出这个公式的？
messages.en: How did the teacher derive this formula?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda b'dik li diġà nafu u biddel pass wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Beda b'dik li diġà nafu u biddel pass wieħed.
messages.zh: 他从我们已经知道的那个公式出发，改动了其中一步。
messages.en: He started with the one we already know and changed one step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画“来源→结果”的箭头：事物可以源自某处，公式也可以从已知条件推导出来。

gloss_zh: 减损效力；例外偏离规定

teaching_sense.en_definition: To depart from a rule or limit its application by making an exception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过设置例外而偏离某项规定，或限制该规定的适用范围与效力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbiegħed minn regola jew jillimita l-applikazzjoni tagħha billi jagħmel eċċezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减损规定的效力；以例外方式偏离规定或限制其适用。

formal.mt: F'dan il-każ eċċezzjonali, il-kumitat dderoga mir-regola ġenerali u ta aktar żmien lill-applikant.
formal.en: In this exceptional case, the committee derogated from the general rule and gave the applicant more time.
formal.zh: 在这一特殊情况下，委员会例外偏离了一般规定，给予申请人更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ta aktar żmien il-kumitat? Mark: Dderoga mir-regola għax kien hemm problema bis-sistema.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the committee give more time? Mark: It made an exception to the rule because there was a problem with the system.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：委员会为什么延长了时间？马克：因为系统出了问题，所以委员会作出了例外处理。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.zh: 委员会为什么延长了时间？
messages.en: Why did the committee give more time?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dderoga mir-regola għax kien hemm problema bis-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Dderoga mir-regola għax kien hemm problema bis-sistema.
messages.zh: 因为系统出了问题，所以委员会作出了例外处理。
messages.en: It made an exception to the rule because there was a problem with the system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条规则旁边开了一个“例外通道”，帮助记住它表示偏离规定或减损规定的适用效力。

gloss_zh: 散开；被扬打脱粒（指小麦）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become scattered; also, of wheat, to undergo threshing to separate the grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散开或散落；也指小麦经过扬打等脱粒处理，使麦粒分离出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxtered; jingħad ukoll għall-qamħ meta jgħaddi mid-dris biex jinfired il-ħabb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散开；散落；被分散到不同位置。
被扬打脱粒，用于描述小麦经过脱粒处理。

formal.mt: Il-qamħ dderra fil-għalqa, u wara l-ħabb inġabar u tqiegħed fl-ixkejjer.
formal.en: The wheat was threshed in the field, and afterwards the grain was collected and put into sacks.
formal.zh: 小麦在田间经过了脱粒处理，随后麦粒被收集起来，装入袋中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-ħuxlief li ħallejna hawn? Toni: Dderra mar-riħ; issa rridu niġbruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the hay we left here go? Toni: It got scattered by the wind; now we need to gather it up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们放在这里的干草去哪儿了？托尼：被风吹散了；现在得把它收拢起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar il-ħuxlief li ħallejna hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar il-ħuxlief li ħallejna hawn?
messages.zh: 我们放在这里的干草去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the hay we left here go?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 被风吹散了；现在得把它收拢起来。
messages.en: It got scattered by the wind; now we need to gather it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅农场画面分别记忆：风把干草吹散，小麦被扬打脱粒；两个义项都要单独记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go mad or lose one's ability to think and behave rationally, also used in exaggeration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发疯或失去理智，无法理性思考和行动；也可用于夸张地描述人的反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġennen jew jitlef il-kontroll tal-ħsieb u tal-imġiba tiegħu; jintuża wkoll b'mod esaġerat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发疯；变得精神失常，也可用于夸张表达。
失去理智；无法保持清醒、理性的思考或行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist dderwex bir-rabja meta skopra t-tradiment ta' sieħbu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist went mad with anger when he discovered his companion's betrayal.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公发现同伴背叛了自己后，气得失去了理智。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta rebaħ it-tim tiegħu? Mark: Dderwex bil-ferħ! Beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu react when his team won? Mark: He went wild with joy! He started jumping and shouting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗支持的球队赢了，他是什么反应？马克：他高兴疯了！又跳又喊的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta rebaħ it-tim tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Pawlu meta rebaħ it-tim tiegħu?
messages.zh: 保罗支持的球队赢了，他是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu react when his team won?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dderwex bil-ferħ! Beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat.
messages.mt_standard: Dderwex bil-ferħ! Beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat.
messages.zh: 他高兴疯了！又跳又喊的。
messages.en: He went wild with joy! He started jumping and shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象情绪仪表冲过红线：愤怒时失去理智，开心时也能夸张地说“高兴疯了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To explain in words what someone or something is like or what happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用语言说明某人或某物是什么样子，或叙述事情发生的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid bil-kliem kif tkun persuna jew ħaġa, jew kif tkun ġrat xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 描述；描写人物、事物的特征或事件的经过。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud ddeskriva l-inċident fid-dettall u semma l-ħin u l-post fejn seħħ.
formal.en: The witness described the incident in detail and stated when and where it happened.
formal.zh: 证人详细描述了事件经过，并说明了事件发生的时间和地点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ddeskriva l-lukanda Mark? Toni: Qal li kienet żgħira, nadifa u qrib il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark describe the hotel? Toni: He said it was small, clean and close to the sea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克是怎么描述那家酒店的？托尼：他说酒店很小，很干净，而且离海边很近。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么描述那家酒店的？
messages.en: How did Mark describe the hotel?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li kienet żgħira, nadifa u qrib il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li kienet żgħira, nadifa u qrib il-baħar.
messages.zh: 他说酒店很小，很干净，而且离海边很近。
messages.en: He said it was small, clean and close to the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“描述”想成用语言画画：说出大小、颜色、位置，或把事情经过讲清楚，就能记住这个词。

gloss_zh: 使不稳定；动摇稳定状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person, system or situation less stable or secure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人、系统或局势失去原有的稳定性，变得不稳或不安定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel persuna, sistema jew sitwazzjoni inqas stabbli jew inqas sigura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使不稳定；破坏或动摇人、系统或局势的稳定状态。

formal.mt: Ix-xokk estern ddestabbilizza l-ekonomija u żied l-inċertezza fost l-investituri.
formal.en: The external shock destabilized the economy and increased uncertainty among investors.
formal.zh: 外部冲击动摇了经济的稳定，并加剧了投资者的不确定感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jaħdem ħażin il-kompjuter? Mark: L-aġġornament il-ġdid ddestabbilizza s-sistema; il-problemi bdew warajh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the computer not working properly? Mark: The new update destabilized the system; the problems started after it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电脑为什么运行不正常？马克：新的更新让系统变得不稳定；问题都是更新后出现的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 电脑为什么运行不正常？
messages.en: Why is the computer not working properly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aġġornament il-ġdid ddestabbilizza s-sistema; il-problemi bdew warajh.
messages.mt_standard: L-aġġornament il-ġdid ddestabbilizza s-sistema; il-problemi bdew warajh.
messages.zh: 新的更新让系统变得不稳定；问题都是更新后出现的。
messages.en: The new update destabilized the system; the problems started after it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本平稳的积木塔被推得摇晃：从稳定变得不稳定，就是这个词表达的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To designate someone or something for a purpose or destination, or appoint someone to a role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预定或指定某人、某物的用途与去向；也指任命某人担任职务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jassenja persuna jew ħaġa għal għan jew destinazzjoni, jew jaħtar persuna għal kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预定；指定某人或某物的用途、目标或去向。
任命；指定某人担任某项职务或承担某种职责。

collocations.zh: 指定这些资金用于维修

collocations.mt: ddestina lil Pawlu għall-kariga ta' direttur
collocations.en: appointed Pawlu to the post of director

formal.mt: Il-bord ddestina lil Pawlu għall-kariga ta' direttur u speċifika r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The board appointed Pawlu to the post of director and specified his responsibilities.
formal.zh: 董事会任命保罗担任主任，并明确了他的职责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex ddestina dawn il-flus il-kumitat? Toni: Għat-tiswijiet fis-sala, speċjalment għas-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the committee designate this money for? Toni: For repairs to the hall, especially the roof.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：委员会指定这笔钱用来做什么？托尼：用来维修礼堂，尤其是屋顶。

messages.speaker: Lara (社团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex ddestina dawn il-flus il-kumitat?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex ddestina dawn il-flus il-kumitat?
messages.zh: 委员会指定这笔钱用来做什么？
messages.en: What did the committee designate this money for?

messages.speaker: Toni (社团财务员)
messages.zh: 用来维修礼堂，尤其是屋顶。
messages.en: For repairs to the hall, especially the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给钱贴上“维修专用”，给人贴上“担任主任”：分别记住指定用途与任命职务两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To establish or decide something after considering the relevant information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据相关信息确定事实、结果或需要采取的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistabbilixxi jew jiddeċiedi xi ħaġa wara li jqis l-informazzjoni rilevanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定；判定；决定。

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina r-riżultati, it-tabib ddetermina l-kawża tal-uġigħ.
formal.en: After examining the results, the doctor determined the cause of the pain.
formal.zh: 查看检查结果后，医生确定了疼痛的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna ma nafux għaliex waqaf il-kompjuter? Mark: Issa nafu. It-tekniku ddetermina l-kawża dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still not know why the computer stopped working? Mark: We know now. The technician determined the cause this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们还不知道电脑为什么停止运行吗？Mark：现在知道了。技术员今天早上确定了原因。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma nafux għaliex waqaf il-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma nafux għaliex waqaf il-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 我们还不知道电脑为什么停止运行吗？
messages.en: Do we still not know why the computer stopped working?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nafu. It-tekniku ddetermina l-kawża dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nafu. It-tekniku ddetermina l-kawża dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 现在知道了。技术员今天早上确定了原因。
messages.en: We know now. The technician determined the cause this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和“查清后确定”连起来记：医生确定病因、技术员确定故障原因，都可帮助你回想这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事产生强烈的反感，程度比普通的“不喜欢”更深。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss dislike qawwi ħafna għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶；憎恶；非常讨厌。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb ddetesta l-inġustizzja u kkritikaha fil-kitbiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The writer detested injustice and criticized it in his writings.
formal.zh: 这位作家憎恶不公，并在自己的作品中加以批判。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu ħa gost bil-film? Lina: Le, ddetesta l-istorja, imma għoġbitu l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu enjoy the film? Lina: No, he detested the story, but he liked the music.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu喜欢那部电影吗？Lina：不喜欢，他很讨厌那个故事，不过他喜欢里面的音乐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu喜欢那部电影吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu enjoy the film?

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ddetesta l-istorja, imma għoġbitu l-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ddetesta l-istorja, imma għoġbitu l-mużika.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，他很讨厌那个故事，不过他喜欢里面的音乐。
messages.en: No, he detested the story, but he liked the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个强烈皱眉的表情，把它记成“非常讨厌”。这个词表达的反感比一般的不喜欢更强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove a king, queen, or other ruler from the throne.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥夺国王、女王或其他统治者的王位，使其失去君主地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi re, reġina jew ħakkiem ieħor minn fuq it-tron.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 废黜君主；使统治者失去王位。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kunsill ddetronizza r-re wara kriżi twila.
formal.en: In the novel, the council dethroned the king after a prolonged crisis.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，议会在一场旷日持久的危机后废黜了国王。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lir-re fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Mark: Il-kunsill ddetronizza r-re, u bintu ħadet postu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the king at the end of the story? Mark: The council dethroned the king, and his daughter took his place.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事结尾国王怎么样了？Mark：议会废黜了国王，他的女儿接替了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事结尾国王怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the king at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunsill ddetronizza r-re, u bintu ħadet postu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunsill ddetronizza r-re, u bintu ħadet postu.
messages.zh: 议会废黜了国王，他的女儿接替了他。
messages.en: The council dethroned the king, and his daughter took his place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象王冠被取下、王座空出来的画面，用“失去王位”记住这个词；重点是君主地位被剥夺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say words aloud so that another person can write them down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文字内容说出来，让另一个人按照所说的内容记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem b'leħen għoli biex persuna oħra tiktbu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dictate (words to be written down)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 口授；口述文字，供他人笔录。

collocations.zh: 口述了一句话让人写下

formal.mt: L-għalliem dd sempliċi, u l-istudenti kitbuha fid-d kpit: purċissjoni
formal.en: The teacher dictated a simple sentence, and the students wrote it in their notebooks.
formal.zh: 老师口述了一句简单的话，学生们把它写在自己的练习本上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġibt dan l-indirizz? Mark: Pawlu ddettahli fuq it-telefon, u jien ktibtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you get this address? Mark: Pawlu dictated it to me over the phone, and I wrote it down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个地址你是从哪里得到的？Mark：Pawlu在电话里口述给我，我把它记下来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个地址你是从哪里得到的？
messages.en: Where did you get this address?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ddettahli fuq it-telefon, u jien ktibtu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ddettahli fuq it-telefon, u jien ktibtu.
messages.zh: Pawlu在电话里口述给我，我把它记下来了。
messages.en: Pawlu dictated it to me over the phone, and I wrote it down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“一人说、另一人写”的配合画面：老师口授句子，学生逐字记录，就是这个词的核心场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To describe or explain something fully, including its individual facts or steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一件事的具体事实、组成部分或各个步骤详细地说明出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi jew jispjega xi ħaġa fid-dettall, inklużi l-fatti jew il-passi tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to detail, to relate in detail
sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细说明；详尽叙述。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-inġinier ddettalja l-passi meħtieġa biex isir ix-xogħol.
formal.en: In his report, the engineer detailed the steps needed to carry out the work.
formal.zh: 工程师在报告中详细说明了完成这项工作所需的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Issa fhimt kif se jsir il-proġett? Pawlu: Iva, Mark ddettalja kull pass waqt il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Do you now understand how the project will be carried out? Pawlu: Yes, Mark explained every step in detail during the meeting.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你现在明白这个项目要怎么做了吗？Pawlu：明白了，Mark在会上把每一步都详细说明了。

messages.speaker: Lina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt kif se jsir il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt kif se jsir il-proġett?
messages.zh: 你现在明白这个项目要怎么做了吗？
messages.en: Do you now understand how the project will be carried out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark ddettalja kull pass waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark ddettalja kull pass waqt il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 明白了，Mark在会上把每一步都详细说明了。
messages.en: Yes, Mark explained every step in detail during the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成“把细节逐项展开”：讲计划时连每一步、每笔费用都说明白，就能联想到这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave with exaggerated self-importance or to treat others in an overbearing, domineering way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得自命不凡、爱摆架子，或以专横、盛气凌人的方式对待别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'pompożità jew jittratta lil ħaddieħor b'arroganza u b'mod awtoritarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆架子；装出自命不凡、气派十足的样子。
专横跋扈；以盛气凌人的态度对待他人。

collocations.en: acted pompously in front of the guests

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-direttur ddetter mal-ħaddiema u rrifjuta li jisma' l-proposti tagħhom.
formal.en: During the meeting, the director behaved high-handedly toward the workers and refused to listen to their proposals.
formal.zh: 会上，主管对工人盛气凌人，拒绝听取他们的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġab ruħu Mark mal-mistednin? Sara: Ddetter quddiemhom; tkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark behave with the guests? Sara: He acted pompously in front of them; he spoke as though he alone knew everything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark在客人面前表现怎么样？Sara：他一直摆架子，说起话来好像只有他什么都懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark在客人面前表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark behave with the guests?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddetter quddiemhom; tkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Ddetter quddiemhom; tkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 他一直摆架子，说起话来好像只有他什么都懂。
messages.en: He acted pompously in front of them; he spoke as though he alone knew everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人昂着头摆架子：强调自我时记作“自命不凡”，压着别人时记作“盛气凌人”，对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce the value of something, especially the official value of a currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某物的价值，尤其指调低一种货币的官方价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-valur ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment il-valur uffiċjali ta' munita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使贬值；降低某物或某种货币的价值。

collocations.zh: 贬低了艺术家作品的价值

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-ktieb, il-gvern ddevaluta l-munita b'għaxra fil-mija.
formal.en: In the textbook example, the government devalued the currency by ten percent.
formal.zh: 在课本的例子中，政府使货币贬值了百分之十。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'għamel il-gvern fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni? Mark: Ddevaluta l-munita, jiġifieri naqqas il-valur uffiċjali tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What did the government do in the lesson's example? Mark: It devalued the currency, meaning it reduced its official value.
colloquial.zh: Lina：课上的例子里，政府做了什么？Mark：它使货币贬值，也就是调低了货币的官方价值。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 课上的例子里，政府做了什么？
messages.en: What did the government do in the lesson's example?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddevaluta l-munita, jiġifieri naqqas il-valur uffiċjali tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ddevaluta l-munita, jiġifieri naqqas il-valur uffiċjali tagħha.
messages.zh: 它使货币贬值，也就是调低了货币的官方价值。
messages.en: It devalued the currency, meaning it reduced its official value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在货币旁画一个向下箭头，记住“价值被调低”；也可把同一画面用于理解某人的作品受到贬低。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something less valuable or reduce the official value of a currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的价值降低，或调低一种货币的官方价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-valur ta' xi ħaġa jew ibaxxi l-valur uffiċjali ta' munita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使贬值；降低某物或某种货币的价值。

collocations.zh: 贬低了团队贡献的价值

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-maniġer ddevalwa l-kontribut tat-tim billi naqas milli jsemmi x-xogħol li għamel.
formal.en: In his report, the manager devalued the team's contribution by failing to mention the work it had done.
formal.zh: 经理在报告中没有提及团队完成的工作，从而贬低了团队贡献的价值。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tim kien diżappuntat bir-rapport? Pawlu: Il-maniġer ddevalwa l-kontribut tiegħu; lanqas semma x-xogħol li għamel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was the team disappointed with the report? Pawlu: The manager devalued its contribution; he did not even mention the work it had done.
colloquial.zh: Sara：团队为什么对那份报告感到失望？Pawlu：经理贬低了团队的贡献，甚至没有提到团队完成的工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 团队为什么对那份报告感到失望？
messages.en: Why was the team disappointed with the report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer ddevalwa l-kontribut tiegħu; lanqas semma x-xogħol li għamel.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer ddevalwa l-kontribut tiegħu; lanqas semma x-xogħol li għamel.
messages.zh: 经理贬低了团队的贡献，甚至没有提到团队完成的工作。
messages.en: The manager devalued its contribution; he did not even mention the work it had done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“价值往下走”的画面：货币可以被调低价值，团队贡献也可能被人低估或贬低，用两个场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause very great damage or destruction to a place or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某个地方或事物遭受极其严重的破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża ħsara kbira ħafna jew qerda f'post jew f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摧毁；使遭受毁灭性破坏

formal.mt: L-għargħar ddevasta r-raħal u kkawża ħsara kbira fid-djar.
formal.en: The flood devastated the village and caused extensive damage to the houses.
formal.zh: 洪水重创了村庄，造成房屋大面积受损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-ġnien wara l-maltemp? Mark: Iva, il-maltemp ddevasta kollox. Irridu nerġgħu nħawlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the garden after the storm? Mark: Yes, the storm devastated everything. We need to plant again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到暴风雨后的花园了吗？马克：看到了，暴风雨把一切都毁坏了。我们得重新种植。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看到暴风雨后的花园了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the garden after the storm?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-maltemp ddevasta kollox. Irridu nerġgħu nħawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-maltemp ddevasta kollox. Irridu nerġgħu nħawlu.
messages.zh: 看到了，暴风雨把一切都毁坏了。我们得重新种植。
messages.en: Yes, the storm devastated everything. We need to plant again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词联想成暴风雨过后的村庄：房屋、田地都严重受损，记住它强调大规模破坏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move away from an intended route, direction, or course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开原定的路线、方向或进程，转向别处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbiegħed mir-rotta, mid-direzzjoni jew mill-mixja maħsuba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏离原定路线、方向或进程

formal.mt: Ix-xufier ddevja mir-rotta ppjanata minħabba xogħlijiet fit-triq.
formal.en: The driver deviated from the planned route because of roadworks.
formal.zh: 由于道路施工，司机偏离了原定路线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ix-xufier ddevja mir-rotta? Pawlu: Għax it-triq ewlenija magħluqa. Se jgħaddi minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the driver deviate from the route? Pawlu: Because the main road is closed. He is going to take another road.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：司机为什么偏离了路线？保罗：因为主路封闭了。他要走另一条路。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.zh: 司机为什么偏离了路线？
messages.en: Why did the driver deviate from the route?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-triq ewlenija magħluqa. Se jgħaddi minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-triq ewlenija magħluqa. Se jgħaddi minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 因为主路封闭了。他要走另一条路。
messages.en: Because the main road is closed. He is going to take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上原本笔直的路线突然拐向旁边，把这个词与“偏离原路线”的画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 得到医治；痊愈；处理自己的伤口

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be healed, or to clean, treat, and dress one's own wounds.
