teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到医治而恢复健康，或清理、处理并包扎自己的伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifieq, jew inaddaf, jikkura u jorbot il-ġrieħi tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到医治；痊愈
清理、处理并包扎自己的伤口

collocations.en: was treated and healed after the accident
collocations.zh: 事故后得到医治并康复

collocations.en: treated and bandaged his own wounds
collocations.zh: 处理并包扎了自己的伤口

formal.mt: Wara perjodu ta' kura u mistrieħ, il-pazjent ddewwa u reġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: After a period of treatment and rest, the patient was healed and returned to work.
formal.zh: 经过一段时间的治疗和休养，病人康复并重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu Mark wara li waqa'? Lara: Diġà ddewwa u rabat il-ġrieħi tiegħu. Issa qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is Mark after his fall? Lara: He has already treated and bandaged his wounds. He is resting now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克摔倒后怎么样了？拉拉：他已经处理并包扎好自己的伤口了，现在正在休息。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Mark wara li waqa'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Mark wara li waqa'?
messages.zh: 马克摔倒后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Mark after his fall?

messages.speaker: Lara (马克的姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ddewwa u rabat il-ġrieħi tiegħu. Issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ddewwa u rabat il-ġrieħi tiegħu. Issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他已经处理并包扎好自己的伤口了，现在正在休息。
messages.en: He has already treated and bandaged his wounds. He is resting now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅连续画面记忆：先给自己的伤口清理包扎，再经过治疗恢复健康，对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被给予品尝；获让尝一尝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given some food or drink to taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到别人提供的少量食物或饮料，供自己尝一尝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata ftit ikel jew xorb biex iduqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予食物或饮料来品尝；获让尝一尝

collocations.en: was given a little cheese to taste
was given the new wine to taste
collocations.zh: 获让品尝了新酿的葡萄酒

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, il-mistieden ddewwaq ftit ġobon qabel għażel liema wieħed jixtri.
formal.en: During the visit, the guest was given a little cheese to taste before choosing which one to buy.
formal.zh: 参观期间，客人获让品尝了少量奶酪，然后才选择购买哪一种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark ddewwaq il-kejk il-ġdid? Anna: Iva, tajtu biċċa żgħira u għoġbitu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark given some of the new cake to taste? Anna: Yes, I gave him a small piece and he liked it very much.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人给马克尝新做的蛋糕了吗？安娜：有，我给了他一小块，他很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有人给马克尝新做的蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Was Mark given some of the new cake to taste?

messages.speaker: Anna (烘焙者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajtu biċċa żgħira u għoġbitu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajtu biċċa żgħira u għoġbitu ħafna.
messages.zh: 有，我给了他一小块，他很喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, I gave him a small piece and he liked it very much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店员递来一小块奶酪让你尝味道，重点记住“别人给你尝”的接受者视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become liquid by melting, or to dissolve in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因融化而变成液体，或溶解在液体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir likwidu meta jissaħħan, jew jinħall f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 融化；由固态变成液态
溶解；散入液体中形成溶液

collocations.en: the sugar dissolved in the water

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, iz-zokkor ddewweb fl-ilma sħun wara li t-taħlita tħawdet.
formal.en: In the experiment, the sugar dissolved in the hot water after the mixture was stirred.
formal.zh: 实验中，混合物经搅拌后，糖溶解在热水里。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-butir ddewweb? Maja: Iva, issa nistgħu nżidu d-dqiq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the butter melted? Maja: Yes, now we can add the flour.
colloquial.zh: 马克：黄油融化了吗？玛雅：融化了，现在可以加面粉了。

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 黄油融化了吗？
messages.en: Has the butter melted?

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 融化了，现在可以加面粉了。
messages.en: Yes, now we can add the flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅厨房画面：黄油受热变成液体是融化，糖进入水中看不见颗粒是溶解。

gloss_zh: 生虫；染上虱子或其他虫害

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with insects, lice, or worms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到昆虫、虱子或蠕虫侵染，出现生虫或虫害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-dud, bil-qamel jew b'insetti oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become infested with bugs, lice or worms
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生虫；受到昆虫、虱子或蠕虫侵染

collocations.en: the flour became infested with bugs
the wood became infested with wood-boring insects

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-injam ddewwed u kellu ħsara estensiva.
formal.en: During the inspection, the wood was found to have become infested with insects and to have extensive damage.
formal.zh: 检查发现，木材已经遭到虫蛀，并有大面积损坏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed tarmi dan id-dqiq? Pawlu: Għax ddewwed. Ara kemm hemm insetti żgħar fih.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you throwing this flour away? Pawlu: Because it has become infested. Look how many little bugs there are in it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么要扔掉这些面粉？保罗：因为生虫了。你看里面有多少小虫子。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要扔掉这些面粉？
messages.en: Why are you throwing this flour away?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ddewwed. Ara kemm hemm insetti żgħar fih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ddewwed. Ara kemm hemm insetti żgħar fih.
messages.zh: 因为生虫了。你看里面有多少小虫子。
messages.en: Because it has become infested. Look how many little bugs there are in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开久放的面粉袋，里面出现许多小虫，把这个词记作“东西已经生虫”的状态变化。

gloss_zh: 被缠绕；被卷绕（通常指线）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wound around something, especially when referring to thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被缠绕或卷绕在某物上，通常用于描述线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkebbeb madwar xi ħaġa, l-aktar meta jkun ħajt.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be wound (usually used of thread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缠绕；被卷绕（通常用于线）

collocations.en: the thread was wound onto the spool
the thread was wound around the cardboard

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħjata, il-ħajt ddewwer mar-rukkell b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: Before sewing, the thread was wound evenly onto the spool.
formal.zh: 缝纫前，线被均匀地绕在线轴上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-ħajt l-aħmar? Anna: Ddewwer madwar biċċa kartun. Qiegħed fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the red thread? Anna: It was wound around a piece of cardboard. It is in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：红线在哪里？安娜：绕在一块硬纸板上了，在抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学缝纫的朋友)
messages.zh: 红线在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the red thread?

messages.speaker: Anna (教缝纫的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddewwer madwar biċċa kartun. Qiegħed fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Ddewwer madwar biċċa kartun. Qiegħed fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 绕在一块硬纸板上了，在抽屉里。
messages.en: It was wound around a piece of cardboard. It is in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 盯住线轴上一圈又一圈的线，想象线正在被卷上去，记住这个词从线的角度描述被缠绕。

gloss_zh: 被狼吞虎咽地吃下；被粗磨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be eaten very quickly and greedily, or to be ground into coarse particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人快速而贪急地吃下，或被磨成较粗的颗粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittiekel malajr u b'regħba, jew jitħan f'biċċiet ħoxnin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被狼吞虎咽地吃下；被很快吃光
被粗磨；被磨成较粗的颗粒

collocations.zh: 食物被狼吞虎咽地吃下

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, il-qamħ ddexxex biex jibqa' f'biċċiet ħoxnin.
formal.en: For this recipe, the wheat was coarsely ground so that it remained in coarse pieces.
formal.zh: 为制作这道食物，小麦经过粗磨，以保留较粗的颗粒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Diġà spiċċa l-ikel kollu? Maja: Iva, ddexxex f'ħames minuti. Kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
colloquial.en: Mark: Has all the food gone already? Maja: Yes, it was gobbled down in five minutes. Everyone was hungry!
colloquial.zh: 马克：食物已经全吃完了吗？玛雅：是啊，五分钟就被狼吞虎咽地吃光了。大家都饿了！

messages.speaker: Mark (聚餐客人)
messages.zh: 食物已经全吃完了吗？
messages.en: Has all the food gone already?

messages.speaker: Maja (聚餐主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ddexxex f'ħames minuti. Kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ddexxex f'ħames minuti. Kulħadd kien bil-ġuħ!
messages.zh: 是啊，五分钟就被狼吞虎咽地吃光了。大家都饿了！
messages.en: Yes, it was gobbled down in five minutes. Everyone was hungry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两张独立记忆卡：空盘子提示“被飞快吃光”，粗颗粒谷物提示“被粗磨”，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distribute authority, activities, or services among several centres instead of keeping them in one central place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把权力、活动或服务从单一中心分散到多个地方或单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqassam is-setgħat, l-attivitajiet jew is-servizzi bejn diversi ċentri minflok iżommhom f'ċentru wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使分散；将权力、职能或服务从中心下放或分布到多个单位。

collocations.zh: 将服务分散到多个地点

formal.mt: Il-gvern ddeċentra s-servizzi billi fetaħ uffiċċji reġjonali biex iċ-ċittadini jinqdew eqreb ta' darhom.
formal.en: The government decentralized services by opening regional offices so that citizens could access them closer to home.
formal.zh: 政府通过设立地区办事处分散服务，让居民能在离家较近的地方办理事务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad irrid immur l-uffiċċju ewlieni? Lara: Le, id-dipartiment ddeċentra s-servizzi; tista' tmur fl-uffiċċju tar-raħal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do I still need to go to the main office? Lara: No, the department decentralized its services; you can go to the village office.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我还得去总部办事吗？拉拉：不用了，部门把服务分散到各地了，你可以去村里的办事处。

messages.speaker: Mark (办事居民)
messages.zh: 我还得去总部办事吗？
messages.en: Do I still need to go to the main office?

messages.speaker: Lara (办事处职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, id-dipartiment ddeċentra s-servizzi; tista' tmur fl-uffiċċju tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, id-dipartiment ddeċentra s-servizzi; tista' tmur fl-uffiċċju tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 不用了，部门把服务分散到各地了，你可以去村里的办事处。
messages.en: No, the department decentralized its services; you can go to the village office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个中心圆，再把权力或服务的箭头分送到周围几个圆，用这幅图记住分散与下放。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work out the meaning of a coded message or read writing that is difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解开编码信息的含义，或辨认难以读懂的文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifhem messaġġ miktub b'kodiċi jew jaqra kitba li tkun diffiċli biex tingħaraf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破译、解码；辨读难认的文字。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ddeċifra l-messaġġ billi qabbel is-simboli ma' dawk f'dokumenti oħra.
formal.en: The researcher deciphered the message by comparing its symbols with those in other documents.
formal.zh: 研究人员把信息中的符号与其他文献中的符号进行比较，从而破译了这条信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' taqra x'hemm fuq din in-nota? Ben: Jien le, imma Toni ddeċifra l-kitba u qal li l-laqgħa fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you read what is on this note? Ben: I cannot, but Toni deciphered the handwriting and said the meeting is at three.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能看懂这张便条写了什么吗？本：我看不懂，不过托尼辨认出了字迹，说会议是三点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqra x'hemm fuq din in-nota?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqra x'hemm fuq din in-nota?
messages.zh: 你能看懂这张便条写了什么吗？
messages.en: Can you read what is on this note?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien le, imma Toni ddeċifra l-kitba u qal li l-laqgħa fit-tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Jien le, imma Toni ddeċifra l-kitba u qal li l-laqgħa fit-tlieta.
messages.zh: 我看不懂，不过托尼辨认出了字迹，说会议是三点。
messages.en: I cannot, but Toni deciphered the handwriting and said the meeting is at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把密码纸和潦草便条并排想象：两者都需要费力读出意思，因此都能帮助记住破译和辨读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To destroy or kill a large proportion of a group, or greatly reduce its numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毁灭或杀死某个群体中的很大一部分，使其数量大幅减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeqred jew joqtol parti kbira minn grupp, jew inaqqas ħafna l-għadd tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量毁灭或杀伤；使某个群体的数量锐减。

formal.mt: Il-virus ddeċima l-popolazzjoni tal-għasafar fil-gżira, u ftit individwi biss baqgħu ħajjin.
formal.en: The virus decimated the island's bird population, and only a few individuals survived.
formal.zh: 病毒使岛上的鸟类数量锐减，只有少数个体存活下来。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ftit siġar hawn? Rita: In-nar tas-sajf li għadda ddeċima l-bosk.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why are there so few trees here? Rita: Last summer's fire decimated the woodland.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这里怎么只剩这么少的树？丽塔：去年夏天的大火毁掉了这片林地的大部分树木。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ftit siġar hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ftit siġar hawn?
messages.zh: 这里怎么只剩这么少的树？
messages.en: Why are there so few trees here?

messages.speaker: Rita (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nar tas-sajf li għadda ddeċima l-bosk.
messages.mt_standard: In-nar tas-sajf li għadda ddeċima l-bosk.
messages.zh: 去年夏天的大火毁掉了这片林地的大部分树木。
messages.en: Last summer's fire decimated the woodland.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本密集的一片树木遭灾后只剩零星几棵，把这个词与大量毁坏、数量锐减联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become worse in quality, condition, or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在质量、状况或行为方面变坏、恶化或退化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur għall-agħar fil-kwalità, fil-qagħda jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶化；退化；变得更糟。

formal.mt: Id-dibattitu ddeġenera f'sensiela ta' insulti, u għalhekk il-president waqqaf il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The debate degenerated into a series of insults, so the chair stopped the meeting.
formal.zh: 辩论恶化成接连不断的辱骂，因此主持人中止了会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar id-dibattitu? | Toni: Għall-ewwel kien kalm, imma mbagħad ddeġenera fi ġlieda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the debate go? | Toni: It was calm at first, but then it degenerated into a fight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：辩论进行得怎么样？ | 托尼：起初很平静，后来却恶化成了一场打斗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 辩论进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the debate go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel kien kalm, imma mbagħad ddeġenera fi ġlieda.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel kien kalm, imma mbagħad ddeġenera fi ġlieda.
messages.zh: 起初很平静，后来却恶化成了一场打斗。
messages.en: It was calm at first, but then it degenerated into a fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“讨论逐渐变成争吵”的画面里，记住核心是状况往坏处发展。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a place devastated, empty, or desolate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一个地方遭到严重破坏，变得荒凉或凄清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla post imħarbat, vojt jew f'qagħda ta' ħerba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使荒凉；使遭到破坏而呈现凄凉景象。

formal.mt: Il-maltemp ddeżola r-raħal u ħalla ħafna djar imġarrfa.
formal.en: The storm devastated the village and left many houses in ruins.
formal.zh: 暴风雨使村庄满目疮痍，许多房屋沦为废墟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt ir-raħal wara l-maltemp? Mark: Iva, il-maltemp ddeżola l-post kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the village after the storm? Mark: Yes, the storm devastated the whole place.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见暴风雨过后的村庄了吗？马克：看见了，暴风雨把整个地方都毁得一片凄凉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见暴风雨过后的村庄了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the village after the storm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，暴风雨把整个地方都毁得一片凄凉。
messages.en: Yes, the storm devastated the whole place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与暴风雨后荒凉的村庄画面联系起来：重点是地方遭破坏后的凄凉状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become weaker or lose physical strength or effectiveness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量、体力或效力减弱；变得虚弱无力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar aktar dgħajjef jew tilef mis-saħħa jew mill-effett tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变弱；力量、强度或效力受到削弱。
变得衰弱无力，尤指体力或身体机能衰退。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ddgħajjef wara marda twila u kellu bżonn iżjed mistrieħ.
formal.en: The patient grew weak after a long illness and needed more rest.
formal.zh: 患者久病之后身体衰弱，需要更多休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu n-nannu? Pawlu: Ddgħajjef bil-mard, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Grandpa? Pawlu: He has grown weak from illness, but today he ate a little more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷怎么样了？保罗：他病得有些虚弱，不过今天多吃了一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddgħajjef bil-mard, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ddgħajjef bil-mard, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 他病得有些虚弱，不过今天多吃了一点。
messages.en: He has grown weak from illness, but today he ate a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象生病后提不起原本能提动的袋子，用前后力量的变化记住“变弱、变虚弱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discuss a question by considering or exchanging different arguments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕一个问题提出、比较或交换不同论点，进行辩论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddiskuta kwistjoni billi qies jew skambja argumenti differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辩论；围绕某个问题讨论不同观点及其理由。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ddibatta l-proposta qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The council debated the proposal before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定之前就该提案进行了辩论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kumitat approva l-proposta? Mark: Għadu le. Illum ddibatta l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the committee approve the proposal? Mark: Not yet. Today it debated the costs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：委员会批准提案了吗？马克：还没有。今天讨论了费用问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 委员会批准提案了吗？
messages.en: Did the committee approve the proposal?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 还没有。今天讨论了费用问题。
messages.en: Not yet. Today it debated the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌两边轮流提出理由：有不同论点、有来有往，就是这个词的辩论场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse or use swear words repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连咒骂或反复说脏话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tenna kliem ta' saħta jew kliem oxxen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复咒骂或不断说脏话。

collocations.en: kept swearing for a long time

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel ddiegħa għal diversi minuti wara l-inċident.
formal.en: The witness said that the man swore repeatedly for several minutes after the incident.
formal.zh: 证人说，事件发生后，那名男子接连咒骂了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex telaq Toni? Lara: Irrabja, ddiegħa għal ftit, u mbagħad ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Toni leave? Lara: He got angry, swore repeatedly for a while, and then went out.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：托尼为什么走了？拉拉：他生气了，接连骂了一阵，然后就出去了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Toni leave?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrabja, ddiegħa għal ftit, u mbagħad ħareġ.
messages.mt_standard: Irrabja, ddiegħa għal ftit, u mbagħad ħareġ.
messages.zh: 他生气了，接连骂了一阵，然后就出去了。
messages.en: He got angry, swore repeatedly for a while, and then went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放一个人生气后接连骂个不停的场景，记住这里强调反复咒骂，并非只说一句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a thin layer of gold applied to the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被覆上一层薄金，例如经过镀金或贴金处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkesa b'saff irqiq ta' deheb fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被镀金或贴金；表面被覆上一层薄金。

collocations.zh: 经过镀金或贴金处理的画框
经过镀金或贴金处理的装饰物

formal.mt: Il-qafas ddieheb waqt ir-restawr biex jerġa' jikseb id-dehra oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: The frame was gilded during restoration to recover its original appearance.
formal.zh: 画框在修复过程中进行了贴金处理，以恢复原来的外观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-qafas kollu deheb? Toni: Le, tal-injam. Ddieheb biss fuq barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this frame solid gold? Toni: No, it is wooden. It was only gilded on the outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个画框是纯金的吗？托尼：不是，是木头的，只在外面贴了金。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个画框是纯金的吗？
messages.en: Is this frame solid gold?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tal-injam. Ddieheb biss fuq barra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tal-injam. Ddieheb biss fuq barra.
messages.zh: 不是，是木头的，只在外面贴了金。
messages.en: No, it is wooden. It was only gilded on the outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木画框穿上一层薄薄的金色外衣：物件表面被覆金，就能记住这个被动含义。

gloss_zh: 变得明智；受到启发而明白

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wiser or gain clearer understanding through learning or experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过学习或经历变得更明智，或受到启发而获得更清楚的认识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar aktar għaqli jew kiseb fehim aktar ċar bit-tagħlim jew bl-esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得明智；逐渐具有更好的判断力。
受到启发或启迪，从而明白原先不懂的事情。

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, iż-żagħżugħ ddiehen bl-esperjenza u beda jieħu deċiżjonijiet aktar meqjusa.
formal.en: Over time, the young man grew wiser through experience and began making more considered decisions.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，这名年轻人通过经历变得更加明智，开始作出更审慎的决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu għadu jonfoq kollox minnufih? Mark: Le, ddiehen wara dik l-esperjenza. Issa jfaddal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Pawlu still spend everything straight away? Mark: No, he grew wiser after that experience. Now he saves.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗还是一有钱就花光吗？马克：不会了，那次经历让他变明智了。现在他会存钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还是一有钱就花光吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu still spend everything straight away?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ddiehen wara dik l-esperjenza. Issa jfaddal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ddiehen wara dik l-esperjenza. Issa jfaddal.
messages.zh: 不会了，那次经历让他变明智了。现在他会存钱。
messages.en: No, he grew wiser after that experience. Now he saves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把学习过程画成脑中亮起一盏灯：经历让判断更明智，解释让原先不懂的事情变清楚。

gloss_zh: 受惊；吓一跳；感到一阵寒意

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened or startled, or to feel a sudden chill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到害怕、突然受惊，或感到一阵寒意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass il-biża', inħasad f'daqqa jew ħass bard jgħaddilu minn ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到惊吓；感到害怕。
被突然惊到；吓了一跳。
感到一阵寒意；身上忽然发冷。

collocations.zh: 突然受惊或感到一阵寒意

formal.mt: It-tifel ddiehex meta sema' ħoss qawwi wara l-bieb.
formal.en: The boy was startled when he heard a loud noise behind the door.
formal.zh: 男孩听到门后传来一声巨响，吓了一跳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qam Toni f'daqqa? Maja: Ddiehex meta waqa' l-ktieb minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Toni get up suddenly? Maja: He was startled when the book fell off the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼怎么突然站起来了？玛雅：书从架子上掉下来，把他吓了一跳。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼怎么突然站起来了？
messages.en: Why did Toni get up suddenly?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddiehex meta waqa' l-ktieb minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Ddiehex meta waqa' l-ktieb minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 书从架子上掉下来，把他吓了一跳。
messages.en: He was startled when the book fell off the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用身体突然一颤的画面串联三个义项：害怕、吓一跳，以及忽然感到一阵寒意。

gloss_zh: 频频发笑；嘲弄某人；出洋相

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh frequently, mock someone with b', or make a fool of oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频频发笑；与介词 b' 连用时表示嘲弄某人；也可表示使自己出洋相。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħak ta' spiss; ma' b' jista' jfisser li waqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt; jista' wkoll ifisser li għamel figura ta' iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频频发笑；多次或经常笑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mock someone (used with the preposition b')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄或取笑某人，与介词 b' 连用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a fool of oneself
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己显得愚蠢可笑；出洋相。

formal.mt: Matul l-ispettaklu komiku, it-tifel ddieħak ħafna u ħa gost.
formal.en: During the comedy show, the boy laughed frequently and enjoyed himself.
formal.zh: 在喜剧演出期间，男孩频频发笑，十分开心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Sara rrabjat ma' Toni? Lara: Għax ddieħak biha quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Sara get angry with Toni? Lara: Because he mocked her in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉为什么生托尼的气？拉拉：因为他当着大家的面取笑她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉为什么生托尼的气？
messages.en: Why did Sara get angry with Toni?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他当着大家的面取笑她。
messages.en: Because he mocked her in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个笑的镜头分别记忆：自己频频笑、用 b' 引出被取笑的人、自己出洋相而显得可笑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh a great deal, or to laugh at someone in a teasing or mocking way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笑得很多、尽情大笑；也可指拿某人开玩笑，或带嘲弄意味地取笑某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħak ħafna, jew jidħak b'xi ħadd biex jiċċajta miegħu jew jgħaddih biż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大笑；笑个不停。
取笑某人；拿某人开玩笑。
嘲弄；以言语或行为讥笑。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, Mark ddieħek ħafna biċ-ċajt tal-preżentatur.
formal.en: During the event, Mark laughed a lot at the presenter's jokes.
formal.zh: 活动期间，马克听到主持人的笑话，笑得很开心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Luqa: Għax Mark ddieħek bih quddiem kulħadd. Maja: Mela għandu jitolbu skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave? Luqa: Because Mark made fun of him in front of everyone. Maja: Then he should apologise to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么走了？卢卡：因为马克当着大家的面取笑他。玛雅：那他应该向保罗道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark ddieħek bih quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark ddieħek bih quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为马克当着大家的面取笑他。
messages.en: Because Mark made fun of him in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那他应该向保罗道歉。
messages.en: Then he should apologise to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个意思连成一条情景线：听笑话时大笑，拿朋友开玩笑时取笑，伤害对方感受时就是嘲弄；看语境判断笑的对象和态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be different from something else in one or more respects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一个或多个方面与另一事物不同，存在差别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun differenti minn xi ħaġa oħra f'aspett wieħed jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同；与另一事物有差别。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tat-tieni esperiment ddifferixxa minn dak tal-ewwel esperiment.
formal.en: The result of the second experiment differed from that of the first experiment.
formal.zh: 第二次实验的结果与第一次实验的结果不同。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-prezz kien l-istess fiż-żewġ ħwienet? Mark: Le, ddifferixxa b'ħames ewro. Sara: Mela tajjeb li qabbilna l-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the price the same in both shops? Mark: No, it differed by five euros. Sara: Then it's good that we compared prices.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：两家店的价格一样吗？马克：不一样，差了五欧元。萨拉：那幸好我们比较了价格。

messages.speaker: Sara (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 两家店的价格一样吗？
messages.en: Was the price the same in both shops?

messages.speaker: Mark (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 不一样，差了五欧元。
messages.en: No, it differed by five euros.

messages.speaker: Sara (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 那幸好我们比较了价格。
messages.en: Then it's good that we compared prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象并排比较两张价格标签：发现差别就想到 ddifferixxa；用 minn 引出比较对象，用 fil-prezz 指明差别在价格方面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread something, such as light or a scent, over a wider area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使光、气味等向更大的范围扩散或散布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred xi ħaġa, bħad-dawl jew ir-riħa, fuq żona aktar wiesgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使扩散；使散布到更广的范围。

collocations.en: diffused the scent throughout the room
collocations.zh: 使气味扩散到整个房间

formal.mt: Il-pannell ddiffonda d-dawl b'mod uniformi fil-kamra.
formal.en: The panel diffused the light evenly throughout the room.
formal.zh: 这块面板使光线均匀地散布在整个房间里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm hawn riħa sabiħa! Luqa: L-apparat il-ġdid ddiffonda r-riħa tal-lavanda fil-kamra kollha. Nina: Għalhekk tinxtamm anki ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: It smells lovely in here! Luqa: The new device diffused the lavender scent throughout the room. Nina: That's why you can smell it even by the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里真香！卢卡：新设备让薰衣草香味扩散到了整个房间。妮娜：难怪连门边都能闻到。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这里真香！
messages.en: It smells lovely in here!

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-apparat il-ġdid ddiffonda r-riħa tal-lavanda fil-kamra kollha.
messages.mt_standard: L-apparat il-ġdid ddiffonda r-riħa tal-lavanda fil-kamra kollha.
messages.zh: 新设备让薰衣草香味扩散到了整个房间。
messages.en: The new device diffused the lavender scent throughout the room.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 难怪连门边都能闻到。
messages.en: That's why you can smell it even by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象香味从房间中央慢慢散到门边，或一束光经过面板后铺开；用这个由集中到散开的画面记住 ddiffonda。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To thaw frozen food or remove accumulated frost from a freezer or similar appliance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使冷冻食物解冻，或清除冷冻柜等设备内积聚的霜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoll l-ikel iffriżat jew ineħħi s-silġ li jkun inġema' fil-friża jew f'apparat simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使解冻；给冷冻设备除霜。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ddifrostja l-friża qabel ma beda t-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The technician defrosted the freezer before starting the repairs.
formal.zh: 技术员开始维修之前，先给冷冻柜除霜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ddifrostja l-ħobż? Ben: Jien, għax ridt nagħmel ftit sandwiches. Maja: Tajjeb, ħa nieħu żewġ biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who defrosted the bread? Ben: I did, because I wanted to make a few sandwiches. Maja: Great, I'll take two slices.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把面包解冻了？本：我，因为我想做几个三明治。玛雅：好，那我拿两片。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 谁把面包解冻了？
messages.en: Who defrosted the bread?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, għax ridt nagħmel ftit sandwiches.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, għax ridt nagħmel ftit sandwiches.
messages.zh: 我，因为我想做几个三明治。
messages.en: I did, because I wanted to make a few sandwiches.

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 好，那我拿两片。
messages.en: Great, I'll take two slices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个厨房画面一起记：冻硬的面包变软是解冻，冷冻柜里的霜消失是除霜；两种动作都可联系 ddifrostja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially command or establish something by issuing a decree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过发布正式法令或命令，规定某事必须实行或成立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jordna jew jistabbilixxi xi ħaġa uffiċjalment permezz ta' digriet.

sense_translations.en_definition: to decree (to command by a decree)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 颁令；通过正式法令或命令作出规定。

collocations.en: decreed that the building be closed

formal.mt: L-imħallef ddigrieta li d-dokumenti jinżammu kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: The judge decreed that the documents be kept confidential.
formal.zh: 法官下令将这些文件保密。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu naqraw dawk id-dokumenti? Pawlu: Le, l-imħallef ddigrieta li jibqgħu kunfidenzjali. Anna: Mela nużaw biss l-informazzjoni pubblika.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we read those documents? Pawlu: No, the judge decreed that they remain confidential. Anna: Then we'll use only the public information.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们能读那些文件吗？保罗：不能，法官下令继续保密。安娜：那我们只用公开的信息。

messages.speaker: Anna (记者)
messages.zh: 我们能读那些文件吗？
messages.en: Can we read those documents?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (记者同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-imħallef ddigrieta li jibqgħu kunfidenzjali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-imħallef ddigrieta li jibqgħu kunfidenzjali.
messages.zh: 不能，法官下令继续保密。
messages.en: No, the judge decreed that they remain confidential.

messages.speaker: Anna (记者)
messages.zh: 那我们只用公开的信息。
messages.en: Then we'll use only the public information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法官在正式命令上盖章，命令从此生效；用这幅颁令画面记住 ddigrieta，并用 li 后接命令的具体内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat blood or another fluid by dialysis, separating substances through a membrane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过透析处理血液或其他液体，利用膜分离其中的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta d-demm jew likwidu ieħor bid-dijaliżi, billi jifred sustanzi permezz ta' membrana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行透析；用透析方法处理血液或其他液体。

collocations.zh: 对溶液进行了透析处理

formal.mt: Fil-laboratorju, ir-riċerkatur ddijalizza s-soluzzjoni permezz ta' membrana.
formal.en: In the laboratory, the researcher dialysed the solution using a membrane.
formal.zh: 在实验室里，研究人员利用膜对溶液进行了透析处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-riċerkatur diġà ddijalizza s-soluzzjoni? Ben: Iva, lesta għall-pass li jmiss. Maja: Tajjeb, ħa nħejji n-noti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the researcher already dialysed the solution? Ben: Yes, it's ready for the next step. Maja: Good, I'll prepare the notes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：研究人员已经给溶液做过透析了吗？本：是的，可以进行下一步了。玛雅：好，我来准备记录。

messages.speaker: Maja (实验室助理)
messages.zh: 研究人员已经给溶液做过透析了吗？
messages.en: Has the researcher already dialysed the solution?

messages.speaker: Ben (研究人员)
messages.zh: 是的，可以进行下一步了。
messages.en: Yes, it's ready for the next step.

messages.speaker: Maja (实验室助理)
messages.zh: 好，我来准备记录。
messages.en: Good, I'll prepare the notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把膜想成透析过程中的分隔界面，再把血液和实验溶液分别放进这个画面；记住 ddijalizza 表示进行透析处理这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To identify an illness or condition by examining symptoms and other evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据症状、检查结果等证据，识别并确定疾病或病症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidentifika marda jew kundizzjoni billi jeżamina s-sintomi u evidenza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诊断；根据症状和检查等证据确定病症。

formal.mt: It-tabib ddijanjostika l-marda wara li eżamina l-pazjent u r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
formal.en: The doctor diagnosed the illness after examining the patient and the test results.
formal.zh: 医生检查患者并查看检测结果后，诊断出了疾病。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qallek it-tabib? Mark: Ddijanjostika infezzjoni fil-widna. Sara: Spjegalek x'għandek tagħmel? Mark: Iva, spjegali kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the doctor tell you? Mark: He diagnosed an ear infection. Sara: Did he explain what you should do? Mark: Yes, he explained everything to me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：医生怎么说？马克：他诊断出我耳朵感染了。萨拉：他说明你该怎么做了吗？马克：说明了，他都给我解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you?

messages.speaker: Mark (就诊者)
messages.zh: 他诊断出我耳朵感染了。
messages.en: He diagnosed an ear infection.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说明你该怎么做了吗？
messages.en: Did he explain what you should do?

messages.speaker: Mark (就诊者)
messages.zh: 说明了，他都给我解释清楚了。
messages.en: Yes, he explained everything to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象医生把症状和检查结果拼成完整图像，最后说出病名；把这个确定病症的动作与 ddijanjostika 联系起来，后面可接具体疾病。

gloss_zh: 滗出；将酒等液体缓缓倒入另一容器

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pour a liquid gently into another container, especially to leave sediment behind or to let wine breathe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体缓缓倒入另一容器，尤其指留下沉淀，或把葡萄酒倒入醒酒器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iferragħ likwidu bil-mod f'reċipjent ieħor, speċjalment biex iħalli l-fond warajh jew biex l-inbid jieħu l-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滗出液体；将酒等缓缓倒入另一容器，留下沉淀或使酒接触空气。

formal.mt: Qabel is-servizz, il-wejter ddikanta l-inbid b'attenzjoni biex il-fond jibqa' fil-flixkun.
formal.en: Before serving, the waiter carefully decanted the wine so that the sediment would remain in the bottle.
formal.zh: 上酒前，服务员小心地将葡萄酒倒入醒酒器，让沉淀留在酒瓶里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ferragħt l-inbid f'dak ir-reċipjent? | Mark: Ddikantajtu biex il-fond jibqa' fil-flixkun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you pour the wine into that container? | Mark: I decanted it so that the sediment would stay in the bottle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把葡萄酒倒进那个容器？ | 马克：我把酒滗出来，让沉淀留在酒瓶里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把葡萄酒倒进那个容器？
messages.en: Why did you pour the wine into that container?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 我把酒滗出来，让沉淀留在酒瓶里。
messages.en: I decanted it so that the sediment would stay in the bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象慢慢倾斜酒瓶：清酒流入新容器，沉淀留在瓶底，用这个动作记住“滗出”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To announce or state something clearly, often publicly or officially.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚地宣布或陈述某事，常用于公开或正式表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid jew iħabbar xi ħaġa b'mod ċar, spiss fil-pubbliku jew b'mod uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布；声明；明确陈述或表示。

formal.mt: Fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu, id-direttur ddikjara li l-proġett kien se jitlesta sa Diċembru.
formal.en: In his statement, the director declared that the project would be completed by December.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中宣布，该项目将于十二月前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Pawlu dwar il-vjaġġ? | Nina: Ddikjara li ma kienx se jiġi magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu say about the trip? | Nina: He stated that he wasn't coming with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗对这次旅行怎么说？ | 妮娜：他明确表示不会和我们一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗对这次旅行怎么说？
messages.en: What did Pawlu say about the trip?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddikjara li ma kienx se jiġi magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ddikjara li ma kienx se jiġi magħna.
messages.zh: 他明确表示不会和我们一起去。
messages.en: He stated that he wasn't coming with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“站到大家面前把话说清楚”的画面相连，记住宣布、声明和明确表示。

gloss_zh: 以某事为爱好；有某种倾向

teaching_sense.en_definition: To engage in an activity for pleasure as a hobby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某项活动当作爱好，在闲暇时出于兴趣和乐趣参与。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel attività fil-ħin liberu għax jieħu pjaċir biha u jqisha bħala delizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有某项爱好；以某种活动自娱。
有某种倾向；容易出现某种行为或情况。

collocations.en: take up painting as a hobby

formal.mt: Matul is-snin tiegħu bħala għalliem, Pawlu ddiletta ruħu bil-pittura fil-ħin liberu.
formal.en: During his years as a teacher, Pawlu pursued painting as a hobby in his free time.
formal.zh: 在任教的那些年里，保罗在闲暇时以绘画为爱好。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Missierek kien jieħu r-ritratti bħala xogħol? | Luqa: Le, kien jiddiletta ruħu bil-fotografija fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did your father take photographs for a living? | Luqa: No, he pursued photography as a hobby at weekends.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你爸爸以前以摄影为职业吗？ | 卢卡：不是，他周末拍照只是出于爱好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek kien jieħu r-ritratti bħala xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek kien jieħu r-ritratti bħala xogħol?
messages.zh: 你爸爸以前以摄影为职业吗？
messages.en: Did your father take photographs for a living?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien jiddiletta ruħu bil-fotografija fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien jiddiletta ruħu bil-fotografija fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 不是，他周末拍照只是出于爱好。
messages.en: No, he pursued photography as a hobby at weekends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用周末画画、拍照的场景记“有爱好”，再单独记住“有倾向”这一义项，遇到句子按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a liquid or solution less concentrated by adding water or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入水或其他液体，使原有液体或溶液的浓度降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-konċentrazzjoni ta' likwidu jew soluzzjoni billi jżid ilma jew likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稀释；加入水或其他液体以降低浓度，也可指冲淡。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ddilwa s-soluzzjoni bl-ilma skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-esperiment.
formal.en: The technician diluted the solution with water according to the experiment's instructions.
formal.zh: 技术员按照实验说明，用水稀释了溶液。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-meraq ħelu wisq għalija. | Ben: Jien diġà ddilwejtu bi ftit ilma; tista' żżid ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: This juice is too sweet for me. | Ben: I've already diluted it with a little water; you can add a little more.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这果汁对我来说太甜了。 | 本：我已经加了一点水稀释，你可以再加一点。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这果汁对我来说太甜了。
messages.en: This juice is too sweet for me.

messages.speaker: Ben (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien diġà ddilwejtu bi ftit ilma; tista' żżid ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Jien diġà ddilwejtu bi ftit ilma; tista' żżid ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 我已经加了一点水稀释，你可以再加一点。
messages.en: I've already diluted it with a little water; you can add a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往浓果汁里加水，颜色变浅、味道变淡，把这整个变化记作“稀释”。

gloss_zh: 确定尺寸；按要求设定大小

teaching_sense.en_definition: To determine or specify the dimensions of an object or component for its intended use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据物体或部件的用途，确定或规定其长、宽、高等尺寸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistabbilixxi jew jispeċifika l-qisien ta' oġġett jew komponent skont l-użu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定或规定物体、构件等的尺寸；进行尺寸设计。

collocations.en: size the component according to the load
collocations.zh: 根据载荷确定部件尺寸

formal.mt: L-inġinier ddimensjona t-travu skont it-tagħbija li kellu jġorr.
formal.en: The engineer determined the beam's dimensions according to the load it had to carry.
formal.zh: 工程师根据梁所需承受的载荷确定了它的尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għamilt l-ixkaffa daqshekk ħoxna? | Toni: Ddimensjonajtha biex tiflaħ il-piż ta' dawn il-kotba kollha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you make the shelf so thick? | Toni: I sized it to support the weight of all these books.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么把搁板做得这么厚？ | 托尼：我按承受这些书的全部重量来确定了它的尺寸。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么把搁板做得这么厚？
messages.en: Why did you make the shelf so thick?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddimensjonajtha biex tiflaħ il-piż ta' dawn il-kotba kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Ddimensjonajtha biex tiflaħ il-piż ta' dawn il-kotba kollha.
messages.zh: 我按承受这些书的全部重量来确定了它的尺寸。
messages.en: I sized it to support the weight of all these books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把物体旁边的长宽高尺寸线想成记忆图：先看用途和承重，再把大小定下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally leave a job, office, or position by one's own decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本人作出决定，正式辞去工作、职位或职务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq minn impjieg jew kariga b'deċiżjoni tiegħu stess u jħabbar dan b'mod formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辞职；主动辞去工作、职位或职务。

formal.mt: Il-president tal-kumitat ddimetta mill-kariga għal raġunijiet personali.
formal.en: The committee president resigned from office for personal reasons.
formal.zh: 委员会主席因个人原因辞去了职务。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għaliex Mark m'għadux jaħdem hawn? | Sam: Ddimetta l-ġimgħa li għaddiet għax sab xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Julia: Why doesn't Mark work here anymore? | Sam: He resigned last week because he found a job closer to home.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：马克为什么不在这里工作了？ | 萨姆：他上周辞职了，因为找到了一份离家更近的工作。

messages.speaker: Julia (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不在这里工作了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark work here anymore?

messages.speaker: Sam (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddimetta l-ġimgħa li għaddiet għax sab xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ddimetta l-ġimgħa li għaddiet għax sab xogħol eqreb lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 他上周辞职了，因为找到了一份离家更近的工作。
messages.en: He resigned last week because he found a job closer to home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象本人递交辞职信、正式交还职位的场景，重点记住这是主动辞去职务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce the brightness of a light, screen, or other source of illumination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低灯光、屏幕或其他光源的亮度，使其变暗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-luminożità ta' dawl, skrin jew sors ieħor ta' dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调暗；降低亮度；使光线变弱。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-preżentazzjoni, it-tekniku ddimmja d-dawl tas-sala biex l-istampi jidhru aħjar.
formal.en: Before the presentation began, the technician dimmed the hall lights so that the images would be easier to see.
formal.zh: 演示开始前，技术员调暗了大厅的灯光，让图像更容易看清。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Id-dawl għadu qawwi wisq biex naraw il-film. | Adam: Diġà ddimmjajtu ftit; issa nnaqqsu aktar.
colloquial.en: Nina: The light is still too bright for us to watch the film. | Adam: I've already dimmed it a little; I'll turn it down more now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：灯还是太亮了，看电影不舒服。 | 亚当：我已经调暗了一点，现在再调暗些。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dawl għadu qawwi wisq biex naraw il-film.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dawl għadu qawwi wisq biex naraw il-film.
messages.zh: 灯还是太亮了，看电影不舒服。
messages.en: The light is still too bright for us to watch the film.

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ddimmjajtu ftit; issa nnaqqsu aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ddimmjajtu ftit; issa nnaqqsu aktar.
messages.zh: 我已经调暗了一点，现在再调暗些。
messages.en: I've already dimmed it a little; I'll turn it down more now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指把亮度滑块往下拖，灯还亮着但光线变弱，用这个动作记“调暗”。

gloss_zh: 以外交方式处理；使措辞或做法更圆融

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a statement or an approach a diplomatic character, using tact to avoid unnecessary conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使表达或处理方式带有外交式的圆融与审慎，以避免不必要的冲突。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil stqarrija jew lil mod ta' kif jittratta kwistjoni karattru diplomatiku, b'tatt biex jevita konflitt bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使具有外交性质；以外交式的审慎、圆融方式表达或处理。

collocations.zh: 以更委婉审慎的方式表达批评

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ddiplomatizza t-tweġiba tiegħu biex jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' qbil mingħajr ma jagħlaq il-bieb għad-djalogu.
formal.en: The spokesperson made his reply more diplomatic to express disagreement without closing the door to dialogue.
formal.zh: 发言人采用了更圆融的答复方式，在表达分歧的同时为对话保留余地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex biddilt il-kliem tal-messaġġ? | Karl: Ddiplomatizzajt it-tweġiba ftit biex ma tinstemax daqshekk ħarxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you change the wording of the message? | Karl: I made the reply a little more diplomatic so that it wouldn't sound so harsh.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么改了消息的措辞？ | 卡尔：我把答复写得圆融了一点，免得听起来那么生硬。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么改了消息的措辞？
messages.en: Why did you change the wording of the message?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddiplomatizzajt it-tweġiba ftit biex ma tinstemax daqshekk ħarxa.
messages.mt_standard: Ddiplomatizzajt it-tweġiba ftit biex ma tinstemax daqshekk ħarxa.
messages.zh: 我把答复写得圆融了一点，免得听起来那么生硬。
messages.en: I made the reply a little more diplomatic so that it wouldn't sound so harsh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把生硬的拒绝改成给对方留余地的表达，用“外交式地把话说圆融”帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 改变航向；劫持交通工具

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change the course of a vehicle or vessel, or to take control of it by force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使车辆、船舶或飞机改变原定路线；也可指以武力劫持并控制交通工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel ir-rotta ta' vettura, bastiment jew ajruplan, jew jieħu l-kontroll tiegħu bil-forza.

sense_translations.en_definition: to change course, to alter course
sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变行进路线或航向。
劫持或强行接管交通工具等。

collocations.en: redirected the ship to another port
collocations.zh: 使船舶改航至另一港口

formal.mt: Minħabba l-maltemp, il-kaptan iddirotta l-bastiment lejn port aktar sigur.
formal.en: Because of the storm, the captain redirected the ship to a safer port.
formal.zh: 由于暴风雨，船长将船舶改航至更安全的港口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li xi ħadd iddirotta ajruplan. Jiġifieri biddel ir-rotta biss? Mark: F'dan il-każ, ifisser li ħa l-kontroll tal-ajruplan bil-forza.
colloquial.en: Maja: The news said someone hijacked a plane. Does that just mean they changed its route? Mark: In this case, it means they took control of the plane by force.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新闻说有人劫持了一架飞机。这只是说改变了航线吗？Mark：在这里，是说有人以武力控制了飞机。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li xi ħadd iddirotta ajruplan. Jiġifieri biddel ir-rotta biss?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħbarijiet qalu li xi ħadd iddirotta ajruplan. Jiġifieri biddel ir-rotta biss?
messages.zh: 新闻说有人劫持了一架飞机。这只是说改变了航线吗？
messages.en: The news said someone hijacked a plane. Does that just mean they changed its route?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-każ, ifisser li ħa l-kontroll tal-ajruplan bil-forza.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-każ, ifisser li ħa l-kontroll tal-ajruplan bil-forza.
messages.zh: 在这里，是说有人以武力控制了飞机。
messages.en: In this case, it means they took control of the plane by force.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的航线被改画：普通情境是改道，出现武力控制交通工具的情境则是劫持。

gloss_zh: 使自己与某事划清界限；表明不认同

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state or show that one is not connected with, responsible for, or supportive of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表明自己与某事无关、不承担其责任或不支持其立场，常与反身表达搭配。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri jew jiddikjara li ma għandux rabta ma' xi ħaġa, ma jerfax ir-responsabbiltà tagħha jew ma jappoġġjahiex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己与某事脱离关系，或公开表明不认同、不支持某事。

collocations.zh: 表明自己不认同某项声明
表明自己不支持那种行为

formal.mt: L-għaqda ddisassoċjat ruħha mill-kummenti offensivi u ċċarat il-pożizzjoni tagħha fi stqarrija.
formal.en: The association dissociated itself from the offensive comments and clarified its position in a statement.
formal.zh: 该协会公开表明不认同那些冒犯性言论，并通过声明澄清了自身立场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark iddisassoċja ruħu minn dak il-messaġġ? Lara: Għax ma qabilx ma' dak li kien fih u ried jagħmilha ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark dissociate himself from that message? Lara: Because he disagreed with its contents and wanted to make that clear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么要表明自己不认同那条消息？Lara：因为他不同意里面的内容，想把立场说清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark iddisassoċja ruħu minn dak il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark iddisassoċja ruħu minn dak il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: Mark为什么要表明自己不认同那条消息？
messages.en: Why did Mark dissociate himself from that message?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma qabilx ma' dak li kien fih u ried jagħmilha ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma qabilx ma' dak li kien fih u ried jagħmilha ċara.
messages.zh: 因为他不同意里面的内容，想把立场说清楚。
messages.en: Because he disagreed with its contents and wanted to make that clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成公开划清界限的画面：把自己与某种言论分开，并连同 ruħu minn 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan the appearance or structure of something, or to draw a sketch showing an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构思事物的外观或结构，或通过草图把想法画出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jippjana d-dehra jew l-istruttura ta' xi ħaġa, jew jagħmel skeċċ biex juri idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计事物的外观或结构；画出草图、示意图。

collocations.zh: 在纸上画了一张桌子的草图

formal.mt: L-arkitett iddisinja librerija b'dawl naturali u spazju għall-qari.
formal.en: The architect designed a library with natural light and space for reading.
formal.zh: 建筑师设计了一座有自然采光和阅读空间的图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min iddisinja din il-mejda? Mark: Ħija. L-ewwel għamel skeċċ, imbagħad benieha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who designed this table? Mark: My brother. First he made a sketch, then he built it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张桌子是谁设计的？Mark：我哥哥。他先画了草图，然后把桌子做了出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是谁设计的？
messages.en: Who designed this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. L-ewwel għamel skeċċ, imbagħad benieha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. L-ewwel għamel skeċċ, imbagħad benieha.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他先画了草图，然后把桌子做了出来。
messages.en: My brother. First he made a sketch, then he built it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先在纸上画桌子，再决定形状和结构：一幅画面同时串起画草图与设计两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange ideas or consider a subject with someone, often to understand it or reach a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人就某个话题交换意见、共同考虑，以加深理解或作出决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiskambja ideat ma' oħrajn dwar suġġett biex jifhmuh aħjar jew jaslu għal deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨论某个话题，或与他人商议某件事。

collocations.en: discussed the problem with a colleague
collocations.zh: 与一位同事讨论了问题

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddiskuta l-proposta waqt il-laqgħa u talab aktar informazzjoni qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee discussed the proposal at the meeting and requested more information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在会议上讨论了该提案，并在作出决定前要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark iddiskuta l-pjan miegħek? Lara: Iva, tkellimna dwaru lbieraħ, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark discuss the plan with you? Lara: Yes, we talked about it yesterday, but we haven't decided yet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark和你讨论过这个计划了吗？Lara：讨论过，我们昨天聊了，不过还没作决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark和你讨论过这个计划了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark discuss the plan with you?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellimna dwaru lbieraħ, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellimna dwaru lbieraħ, imma għadna ma ddeċidejniex.
messages.zh: 讨论过，我们昨天聊了，不过还没作决定。
messages.en: Yes, we talked about it yesterday, but we haven't decided yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人围着同一份计划交换意见：记住讨论的话题，以及用 ma' 引出的讨论对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To regard or treat someone or something as unworthy of respect or attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人或某事不值得尊重或重视，并表现出鄙视、轻蔑或轻慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqis jew jittratta lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bħala li ma jistħoqqlux rispett jew attenzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to despise, to scorn, to disdain, to slight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鄙视、蔑视或不屑于某人某事；也可指以轻慢的态度对待。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali ddisprezza lil dawk li kellhom inqas flus minnu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character despised those who had less money than he did.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公鄙视那些没有他富有的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħassejt li Mark iddisprezza l-idea tiegħi. Maja: X'qal? Lara: Qal li lanqas kienet ta' min jiddiskutiha.
colloquial.en: Lara: I felt that Mark scorned my idea. Maja: What did he say? Lara: He said it wasn't even worth discussing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我觉得Mark对我的想法很不屑。Maja：他说了什么？Lara：他说那甚至不值得讨论。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt li Mark iddisprezza l-idea tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt li Mark iddisprezza l-idea tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我觉得Mark对我的想法很不屑。
messages.en: I felt that Mark scorned my idea.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他说了什么？
messages.en: What did he say?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li lanqas kienet ta' min jiddiskutiha.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li lanqas kienet ta' min jiddiskutiha.
messages.zh: 他说那甚至不值得讨论。
messages.en: He said it wasn't even worth discussing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把别人的建议推开，说连听都不值得：用这种轻蔑态度记住鄙视、轻慢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing or concentrating on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人的注意力从正在做或专心关注的事情上引开，使其分心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd 'il bogħod minn dak li jkun qed jagħmel jew jiffoka fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使分心，把注意力从原本关注的事情上引开。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tat-telefon iddistra lill-istudent waqt l-eżami, u kellu jerġa' jaqra l-mistoqsija.
formal.en: The sound of the phone distracted the student during the exam, and he had to read the question again.
formal.zh: 考试时，电话声使那名学生分了心，他不得不重新读一遍题目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft taqra? Mark: Il-ħoss barra ddistrani. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop reading? Mark: The noise outside distracted me. Can you close the window?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么不读了？Mark：外面的声音让我分心了。你能把窗户关上吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不读了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħoss barra ddistrani. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħoss barra ddistrani. Tista' tagħlaq it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 外面的声音让我分心了。你能把窗户关上吗？
messages.en: The noise outside distracted me. Can you close the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读书时被窗外声音拉走目光：注意力离开原任务，就是使分心、引开注意力。

gloss_zh: 准许出院；释放电荷、放电

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discharge, for example by formally releasing a patient from hospital or releasing stored electrical charge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使离院或使储存的电荷释放；具体含义由宾语和使用场景决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jippermetti lil pazjent joħroġ mill-isptar, jew jirrilaxxa ċarġ elettriku maħżun, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使离院、排出或释放；例如准许病人出院，或释放储存的电荷。

formal.mt: Wara l-aħħar eżami, it-tabib iddisċarġja lill-pazjent mill-isptar u tah struzzjonijiet għall-kura fid-dar.
formal.en: After the final examination, the doctor discharged the patient from hospital and gave him instructions for care at home.
formal.zh: 最后一次检查后，医生准许病人出院，并向他交代了居家护理事项。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tabib iddisċarġja lil missierek illum? Mark: Iva, ħareġ mill-isptar dalgħodu u issa qiegħed id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the doctor discharge your father today? Mark: Yes, he left hospital this morning and is home now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生今天准许你父亲出院了吗？Mark：是的，他今天早上出院了，现在在家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生今天准许你父亲出院了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor discharge your father today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħareġ mill-isptar dalgħodu u issa qiegħed id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħareġ mill-isptar dalgħodu u issa qiegħed id-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，他今天早上出院了，现在在家。
messages.en: Yes, he left hospital this morning and is home now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用宾语帮助选义：看到病人就想到准许出院，看到电池就想到释放电荷、放电。

gloss_zh: 逗乐；使开心；为……提供消遣

teaching_sense.en_definition: To amuse or entertain someone by providing something enjoyable or interesting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过有趣、令人愉快的活动或内容逗乐某人，使其开心或得到消遣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iferraħ jew idaħħak lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa pjaċevoli jew interessanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗乐，使开心；以有趣的内容使人得到消遣。

formal.mt: Il-preżentatur iddiverta lill-udjenza b'rakkonti umoristiċi waqt il-programm.
formal.en: The presenter entertained the audience with humorous stories during the programme.
formal.zh: 主持人在节目中用幽默故事逗乐了观众。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tfal ħadu gost fil-festa? Mark: Iva, il-buffu ddivertiehom bil-maġija u biċ-ċajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the children enjoy the party? Mark: Yes, the clown entertained them with magic and jokes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：孩子们在聚会上玩得开心吗？Mark：开心，小丑用魔术和笑话把他们逗乐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did the children enjoy the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-buffu ddivertiehom bil-maġija u biċ-ċajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-buffu ddivertiehom bil-maġija u biċ-ċajt.
messages.zh: 开心，小丑用魔术和笑话把他们逗乐了。
messages.en: Yes, the clown entertained them with magic and jokes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小丑讲笑话，孩子们笑起来：把这个词与逗乐别人、让人享受消遣的画面连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate something into parts or groups, or distribute it among people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把整体分成若干部分或组，或把物品分配给不同的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqsam xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew fi gruppi, jew iqassamha bejn diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划分；把某物分成部分或分配出去。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ddivida l-klassi fi tliet gruppi biex kull student ikollu ċans jitkellem.
formal.en: The teacher divided the class into three groups so that every student would have a chance to speak.
formal.zh: 老师把全班分成三个小组，让每位学生都有机会发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ddivida l-kejk? Mark: Jien, f'sitt biċċiet, waħda għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who divided up the cake? Mark: I did, into six pieces, one for each person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把蛋糕分好了？马克：我分的，分成了六块，每人一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把蛋糕分好了？
messages.en: Who divided up the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, f'sitt biċċiet, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, f'sitt biċċiet, waħda għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 我分的，分成了六块，每人一块。
messages.en: I did, into six pieces, one for each person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一个蛋糕切成六块：ddivida 表示把整体分开，再联想到分组和分配工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distinguish between people or things, especially by treating some people less fairly than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或事物作出区别，尤指因某种差异而不公平地对待某些人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel differenza bejn persuni jew affarijiet, speċjalment billi jittratta lil xi persuni b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 区别对待；尤指基于个人或群体差异而歧视。

collocations.en: discriminated on the basis of age

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ fejn min iħaddem ddivrenzja bejn il-kandidati abbażi tal-età.
formal.en: The report describes a case in which an employer discriminated between candidates on the basis of age.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起雇主基于年龄对候选人区别对待的案例。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għamilt ilment? Pawlu: Għax il-maniġer ddivrenzja bejnietna minħabba l-età.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you make a complaint? Pawlu: Because the manager discriminated between us because of our age.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么投诉？保罗：因为经理根据年龄对我们区别对待。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么投诉？
messages.en: Why did you make a complaint?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-maniġer ddivrenzja bejnietna minħabba l-età.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-maniġer ddivrenzja bejnietna minħabba l-età.
messages.zh: 因为经理根据年龄对我们区别对待。
messages.en: Because the manager discriminated between us because of our age.

cognitive_memory_aid: 设想两名能力相同的候选人因年龄受到不同待遇，用这个场景记住 ddivrenzja 的歧视义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release gas from the stomach through the mouth; to burp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把胃里的气体从口中排出，即嗳气或打饱嗝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ gass mill-istonku minn ħalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗳气；打饱嗝，把胃里的气体从口中排出。

formal.mt: Wara li xorob xarba bil-gass, it-tifel ddixxa u talab skuża.
formal.en: After drinking a fizzy drink, the boy belched and apologized.
formal.zh: 男孩喝了汽水后打了个嗝，并道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min ddixxa? Luqa: Jien, skużani! Xrobt il-luminata malajr wisq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who burped? Luqa: I did, sorry! I drank the lemonade too quickly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁打嗝了？卢卡：是我，不好意思！我柠檬汽水喝得太快了。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 谁打嗝了？
messages.en: Who burped?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, skużani! Xrobt il-luminata malajr wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, skużani! Xrobt il-luminata malajr wisq.
messages.zh: 是我，不好意思！我柠檬汽水喝得太快了。
messages.en: I did, sorry! I drank the lemonade too quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddixxa 配上喝完汽水后打出一个饱嗝的画面，记住这里是胃气上涌的嗳气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break down food in the body so that its nutrients can be absorbed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在体内分解食物，使其中的营养能够被吸收。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikisser l-ikel fil-ġisem sabiex in-nutrijenti tiegħu jkunu jistgħu jiġu assorbiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化；在体内分解食物以便吸收营养。

formal.mt: Wara li kiel, il-kelb ddiġerixxa l-ikel mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: After eating, the dog digested its food without difficulty.
formal.zh: 进食后，这只狗顺利地消化了食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kelb għadu jidher ma jiflaħx? Mark: Le, illum ddiġerixxa l-ikel sew u reġa' beda jilgħab. Sara: Tajjeb, jidher ħafna aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does the dog still look unwell? Mark: No, today he digested his food well and started playing again. Sara: Good, he looks much better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：狗看起来还是不舒服吗？马克：没有，今天它消化得很好，又开始玩了。萨拉：那就好，它看着好多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 狗看起来还是不舒服吗？
messages.en: Does the dog still look unwell?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum ddiġerixxa l-ikel sew u reġa' beda jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum ddiġerixxa l-ikel sew u reġa' beda jilgħab.
messages.zh: 没有，今天它消化得很好，又开始玩了。
messages.en: No, today he digested his food well and started playing again.

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 那就好，它看着好多了。
messages.en: Good, he looks much better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把食物进入身体后逐步被分解的过程想成一条消化流水线；看到 ddiġerixxa l-ikel，就联想到把吃下的食物消化掉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ask firmly or insistently for something or for an action to be taken.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以坚定或坚持的态度要求得到某物，或要求他人采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlob xi ħaġa b'qawwa jew b'insistenza, jew jinsisti li tittieħed azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈要求；坚持索要某物或要求采取某种行动。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ddmanda spjegazzjoni bil-miktub għad-dewmien fil-kunsinna.
formal.en: The customer demanded a written explanation for the delivery delay.
formal.zh: 客户强烈要求对交货延误作出书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-klijent meta wasal il-kont? Mark: Ddmanda spjegazzjoni għax il-prezz kien ogħla milli stenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the customer do when the bill arrived? Mark: He demanded an explanation because the price was higher than he expected.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：账单送来时，顾客做了什么？马克：他要求解释，因为价格比他预期的高。

messages.speaker: Maja (餐厅服务员)
messages.zh: 账单送来时，顾客做了什么？
messages.en: What did the customer do when the bill arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (餐厅服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ddmanda spjegazzjoni għax il-prezz kien ogħla milli stenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ddmanda spjegazzjoni għax il-prezz kien ogħla milli stenna.
messages.zh: 他要求解释，因为价格比他预期的高。
messages.en: He demanded an explanation because the price was higher than he expected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顾客拿着错误账单坚决要求解释，用坚定的语气记住 ddmanda，比随口询问更强烈。

gloss_zh: 驯化；使适应与人共同生活

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring animals under human care and control and adapt them to living with people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使动物接受人类的照料和管理，逐渐适应与人共同生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idarra annimali jgħixu mal-bniedem taħt il-kura u l-kontroll tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驯化，使动物适应人类照料、管理及共同生活的环境。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja fittizja, il-bidwi ddomestika l-annimali sabiex ikunu jistgħu jgħixu qrib in-nies.
formal.en: In the fictional story, the farmer domesticated the animals so that they could live near people.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，农夫驯化了这些动物，使它们能够在人们附近生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'ddomestika'? Sara: Jiġifieri darra annimal jgħix mal-bniedem u taħt il-kura tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'ddomestika' mean? Sara: It means getting an animal used to living with people and under their care.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：ddomestika 是什么意思？萨拉：意思是使动物习惯与人共同生活，并接受人的照料。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: ddomestika 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ddomestika' mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri darra annimal jgħix mal-bniedem u taħt il-kura tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri darra annimal jgħix mal-bniedem u taħt il-kura tiegħu.
messages.zh: 意思是使动物习惯与人共同生活，并接受人的照料。
messages.en: It means getting an animal used to living with people and under their care.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动物逐渐适应人类照料的连续画面记住 ddomestika，把重点放在驯化与共同生活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave arrogantly, as though one were better or more important than other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得自以为高人一等，或认为自己比别人更重要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu bi kburija żejda, bħallikieku hu aħjar jew aktar importanti minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得傲慢自大；以高人一等的态度待人。

formal.mt: Wara l-promozzjoni, il-maniġer ddottra mal-kollegi u ma baqax jisma' l-opinjonijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: After the promotion, the manager acted arrogantly towards his colleagues and stopped listening to their opinions.
formal.zh: 升职后，这位经理对同事态度傲慢，不再听取他们的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' Pawlu? Mark: Ħażin. Ddottra magħna u lanqas ħalliena nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting with Pawlu go? Mark: Badly. He acted arrogantly towards us and did not even let us speak.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：和保罗的会议开得怎么样？马克：很糟。他对我们摆架子，甚至不让我们说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 和保罗的会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting with Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażin. Ddottra magħna u lanqas ħalliena nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażin. Ddottra magħna u lanqas ħalliena nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 很糟。他对我们摆架子，甚至不让我们说话。
messages.en: Badly. He acted arrogantly towards us and did not even let us speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人昂着头、打断别人说话，用这种傲慢姿态记住 ddottra 所描述的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To adapt a story for dramatic performance, or make an event seem more dramatic or serious than it is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把故事改编为戏剧表演，或把事件渲染得比实际更戏剧化、更严重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jadatta storja għat-teatru, jew jippreżenta ġrajja b'mod aktar drammatiku jew serju milli hi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使戏剧化；改编为戏剧，或对事件进行夸张渲染。

formal.mt: Id-direttur ddrammatizza r-rumanz għal produzzjoni teatrali tal-iskola.
formal.en: The director dramatized the novel for a school theatre production.
formal.zh: 导演把这部小说改编成了供学校演出的戏剧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd ħaseb li kienet emerġenza? Luqa: Għax Mark ddrammatizza s-sitwazzjoni; fil-fatt, kien biss dewmien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did everyone think it was an emergency? Luqa: Because Mark dramatized the situation; actually, it was only a short delay.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么大家都以为出了紧急情况？卢卡：因为马克把情况说得太夸张了；其实只是稍微耽搁了一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd ħaseb li kienet emerġenza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd ħaseb li kienet emerġenza?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都以为出了紧急情况？
messages.en: Why did everyone think it was an emergency?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark ddrammatizza s-sitwazzjoni; fil-fatt, kien biss dewmien żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark ddrammatizza s-sitwazzjoni; fil-fatt, kien biss dewmien żgħir.
messages.zh: 因为马克把情况说得太夸张了；其实只是稍微耽搁了一下。
messages.en: Because Mark dramatized the situation; actually, it was only a short delay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ddrammatizza 想成给事情加上舞台灯光：故事可以搬上舞台，小事也可能被渲染成大戏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel uncertain about whether something is true, correct, or reliable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事是否真实、正确或可靠感到不确定，因而产生怀疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jkunx ċert jekk xi ħaġa hijiex vera, korretta jew ta' min joqgħod fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀疑；对某事的真实性、正确性或可靠性存疑。

collocations.en: doubted the accuracy of the result

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ddubita mill-eżattezza tar-riżultat u rrepeta l-esperiment.
formal.en: The researcher doubted the accuracy of the result and repeated the experiment.
formal.zh: 研究人员怀疑结果的准确性，因此重复了实验。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu emmen l-aħbar mill-ewwel? Maja: Le, ddubita minnha u fittex sors ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Pawlu believe the news straight away? Maja: No, he doubted it and looked for another source.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗立刻相信那则消息了吗？玛雅：没有，他对此存疑，又找了一个消息来源。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗立刻相信那则消息了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu believe the news straight away?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ddubita minnha u fittex sors ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ddubita minnha u fittex sors ieħor.
messages.zh: 没有，他对此存疑，又找了一个消息来源。
messages.en: No, he doubted it and looked for another source.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到消息先在心里画一个问号，再查另一个来源，用这个动作记住 ddubita 的怀疑义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fight another person in a duel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人进行一对一的决斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġġieled kontra persuna oħra f'dwell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与人决斗。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kavallier ddwella kontra r-rival tiegħu quddiem il-kastell.
formal.en: In the novel, the knight fought a duel against his rival in front of the castle.
formal.zh: 在小说中，骑士在城堡前与自己的对手进行了决斗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-kavallier fl-aħħar tal-film? Mark: Ddwella kontra r-rival tiegħu u rebaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the knight do at the end of the film? Mark: He fought a duel against his rival and won.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影结尾那个骑士做了什么？Mark：他与对手决斗，并且赢了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or play music together with one other performer as a duet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一位表演者一起唱二重唱或演奏二重奏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta jew idoqq ma' persuna oħra f'dwett.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing or play a duet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱二重唱，或演奏二重奏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A praying mantis, an insect with front legs held in a position resembling hands in prayer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 螳螂，一种前足常收拢在身前、姿态仿佛合掌的昆虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slaughter animals frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁或反复地宰杀动物，强调这一行为多次发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqtol l-annimali għall-qatla ta' spiss jew għal ħafna drabi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to slaughter frequently or repeatedly (used of animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁或反复宰杀，指宰杀动物。

formal.en: The narrative describes a man who frequently slaughtered sheep to sell the meat at the market.
formal.zh: 这篇叙述描写了一个经常宰羊、把羊肉拿到市场出售的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien jagħmel dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont? Mark: Debbaħ in-nagħaġ ta' spiss u biegħ il-laħam fis-suq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did that man do in the story? Mark: He frequently slaughtered sheep and sold the meat at the market.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的那个人做什么？Mark：他经常宰羊，并在市场上卖羊肉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To infest something with flies, or to sprinkle it with water or seasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某处或某物滋生、布满苍蝇；也可指洒水或撒盐等调料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla post jew oġġett bid-dubbien; jew iroxx xi ħaġa bl-ilma jew b'xi ħwawar bħall-melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某处或某物滋生、布满苍蝇。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sprinkle (e.g. with water, or with seasoning such as salt)

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that weakens or debilitates a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人虚弱、衰弱或失去精力的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li ddgħajjef lill-bniedem jew tnaqqaslu s-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人衰弱、耗损体力或精力的事物。

formal.mt: Fl-esej, l-awtur jiddeskrivi n-nuqqas ta' mistrieħ bħala debbiel tas-saħħa.
formal.en: In the essay, the author describes a lack of rest as something that saps one's strength.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，作者把缺乏休息描述为消耗体力的因素。

colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call this work something that saps your strength? Mark: Because it leaves me exhausted, and I don't even have time to rest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把这份工作叫作耗损精力之物？Mark：因为它让我精疲力尽，连休息的时间都没有。

messages.mt_spoken: Għax iħallini bla saħħa, u lanqas ikolli ħin nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iħallini bla saħħa, u lanqas ikolli ħin nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 因为它让我精疲力尽，连休息的时间都没有。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Attracting flies, as food or waste may do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会吸引苍蝇的，可用于描述食物或垃圾等。

colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么把食物盖起来？Mark：这些食物招苍蝇；你看这里有多少苍蝇！

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who discusses terms with others in order to reach an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过与他人商谈条件来争取达成协议的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiddiskuti l-kundizzjonijiet ma' oħrajn biex jintlaħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判者；负责协商条件、促成协议的人。

formal.zh: 谈判者提出了新的条件，以便双方达成协议。

colloquial.en: Lara: Who will discuss the price? Pawlu: Mark will handle that; he is a skilled negotiator.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁来谈价格？Pawlu：Mark 会处理；他是个熟练的谈判者。
