teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少力量或精力的状态或感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew sensazzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' saħħa jew enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚弱；无力；缺乏力量的状态。

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, il-pazjent baqa' jħoss debbolizza fil-muskoli.
formal.en: After the illness, the patient continued to feel weakness in his muscles.
formal.zh: 患病之后，这位患者仍感到肌肉无力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qgħadt bilqiegħda? Mark: Qed inħoss ftit debbolizza u rrid nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you sit down? Mark: I am feeling a little weak and want to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么坐下了？Mark：我觉得有点无力，想休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么坐下了？
messages.en: Why did you sit down?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss ftit debbolizza u rrid nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss ftit debbolizza u rrid nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我觉得有点无力，想休息一下。
messages.en: I am feeling a little weak and want to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象身体像电量不足的电池，用 debbolizza 给这种虚弱无力的感觉命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the proper or required manner, with the necessary steps completed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以适当或规定的方式，完成所需手续或步骤地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kif suppost jew skont dak li hu meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按规定地；依照应有程序妥善地。

formal.mt: Il-formolarju għandu jkun mimli u ffirmat debitament qabel jintbagħat lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The form must be duly completed and signed before it is sent to the office.
formal.zh: 表格必须按要求填写完整并签署，之后才能送交办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nibgħat il-formolarju issa? Pawlu: Iva, kollox mimli u ffirmat debitament.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I send the form now? Pawlu: Yes, everything is duly completed and signed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我现在可以寄出表格了吗？Pawlu：可以，所有内容都已按要求填好并签署。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.zh: 我现在可以寄出表格了吗？
messages.en: Can I send the form now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox mimli u ffirmat debitament.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox mimli u ffirmat debitament.
messages.zh: 可以，所有内容都已按要求填好并签署。
messages.en: Yes, everything is duly completed and signed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格逐项填好、签字齐全，再盖上按规定完成的章；debitament 修饰完成的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money that a person or organization owes to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或机构欠他人、需要偿还的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni għandha tagħti lura lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务；应偿还的欠款。

collocations.en: a debt owed to the bank

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħallset id-debitu kollu lill-fornitur sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The company paid its entire debt to the supplier by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 公司在月底前向供应商偿清了全部欠款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad għandek debitu mal-bank? Mark: Le, ħallast id-debitu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still owe money to the bank? Mark: No, I paid the entire debt last month.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你还欠银行的钱吗？Mark：不欠了，我上个月已经还清全部债务。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还欠银行的钱吗？
messages.en: Do you still owe money to the bank?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħallast id-debitu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħallast id-debitu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 不欠了，我上个月已经还清全部债务。
messages.en: No, I paid the entire debt last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在借条上圈出欠款金额，把它标成 debitu；记住这个词指债务这笔钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that owes money to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欠他人钱、负有偿还义务的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha tagħti flus lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务人；欠款人；负有偿还债务义务的一方。

collocations.en: a debtor who pays on time

formal.mt: Id-debitur talab lill-bank skeda ġdida għall-ħlas tad-debitu.
formal.en: The debtor asked the bank for a new debt repayment schedule.
formal.zh: 债务人向银行请求重新安排还款时间表。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu d-debitur f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Jien, għax jien li għandi nagħtik lura l-flus.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the debtor in this example? Pawlu: I am, because I am the one who has to pay you back.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这个例子里谁是债务人？Pawlu：是我，因为需要把钱还给你的人是我。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 这个例子里谁是债务人？
messages.en: Who is the debtor in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, għax jien li għandi nagħtik lura l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, għax jien li għandi nagħtik lura l-flus.
messages.zh: 是我，因为需要把钱还给你的人是我。
messages.en: I am, because I am the one who has to pay you back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 debitu 标在欠款金额上，把 debitur 标在欠款人身上；用钱与人的画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname of Italian origin, used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 源自意大利语的姓氏，用于标识个人或家族，中文可音译为“德博诺”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' oriġini Taljana li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个源自意大利语的姓氏：德博诺。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Debono ppreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mr Debono presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: 德博诺先生在会议期间提交了报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf fejn joqgħod is-Sur Debono? Pawlu: Iva, fid-dar ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know where Mr Debono lives? Pawlu: Yes, in the house next to the school.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你知道德博诺先生住在哪里吗？保罗：知道，就在学校旁边那栋房子里。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你知道德博诺先生住在哪里吗？
messages.en: Do you know where Mr Debono lives?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 知道，就在学校旁边那栋房子里。
messages.en: Yes, in the house next to the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Debono 放在人名牌上记忆：is-Sur Debono 就是“德博诺先生”；看到大写开头，先联想到姓氏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures, especially drinking and sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度沉溺于感官享乐的行为或生活状态，尤指酗酒、纵欲等放荡行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba jew ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla rażan, speċjalment xorb eċċessiv u attività sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放荡，纵欲；无节制地沉溺于酒色享乐。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħajja ta' deboxxaġni tal-protagonist twassal għat-telf tal-fiduċja tal-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's life of debauchery causes him to lose his family's trust.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公放荡的生活使他失去了家人的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser deboxxaġni f'din is-silta? Toni: Ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla rażan; hawn tirreferi għax-xorb u s-sess.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does deboxxaġni mean in this passage? Toni: A life of unrestrained pleasure; here it refers to drinking and sex.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这段文字里的 deboxxaġni 是什么意思？托尼：指无节制享乐的生活；这里说的是饮酒和纵欲。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 deboxxaġni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does deboxxaġni mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla rażan; hawn tirreferi għax-xorb u s-sess.
messages.mt_standard: Ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla rażan; hawn tirreferi għax-xorb u s-sess.
messages.zh: 指无节制享乐的生活；这里说的是饮酒和纵欲。
messages.en: A life of unrestrained pleasure; here it refers to drinking and sex.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“享乐失去节制”的场景记 deboxxaġni：它带有负面评价，不能把普通聚会或正常娱乐都叫作放荡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually indulges excessively in sensual pleasures, especially drinking and sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惯于无节制地沉溺于酒色等感官享乐的人；放荡者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li abitwalment tgħix ħajja ta' pjaċiri bla rażan, speċjalment xorb eċċessiv u attività sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放荡者；沉溺于酒色享乐的人。
放荡的，荒淫的；沉溺于无节制享乐的。

collocations.zh: 一个不知羞耻的放荡者

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala deboxxjat li jonfoq ġidu kollu fuq ix-xorb u pjaċiri oħra.
formal.en: The writer describes the character as a debauchee who spends all his wealth on drink and other pleasures.
formal.zh: 作者把这个人物描写成一个放荡者，将全部财富都挥霍在饮酒和其他享乐上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn deboxxjat qed jintuża bħala nom? Mark: Iva, ifisser persuna; f'raġel deboxxjat, il-kelma hi aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is deboxxjat being used as a noun here? Mark: Yes, it means a person; in raġel deboxxjat, the word is an adjective.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 deboxxjat 是名词吗？马克：是，指一个人；在 raġel deboxxjat 里，这个词就是形容词。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn deboxxjat qed jintuża bħala nom?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn deboxxjat qed jintuża bħala nom?
messages.zh: 这里的 deboxxjat 是名词吗？
messages.en: Is deboxxjat being used as a noun here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ifisser persuna; f'raġel deboxxjat, il-kelma hi aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ifisser persuna; f'raġel deboxxjat, il-kelma hi aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 是，指一个人；在 raġel deboxxjat 里，这个词就是形容词。
messages.en: Yes, it means a person; in raġel deboxxjat, the word is an adjective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“放荡者”和“放荡的人”两张卡片记 deboxxjat：名词指人，形容词描述人的生活作风，注意根据句子区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is just beginning an activity and has little experience in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刚开始学习或参与某项活动、经验还很少的人；初学者或新手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għadha kemm bdiet titgħallem jew tagħmel xi attività u għandha ftit esperjenza fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 初学者，新手；刚入门、尚缺乏经验的人。

formal.mt: Bħala debuttant fil-fotografija, l-istudent beda b'eżerċizzji sempliċi dwar id-dawl u l-kompożizzjoni.
formal.en: As a beginner in photography, the student started with simple exercises on lighting and composition.
formal.zh: 作为摄影初学者，这名学生从光线与构图的简单练习开始学习。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Għadni debuttant fil-kitarra. Nina: Mela nibdew b'żewġ kordi faċli.
colloquial.en: Luca: I'm still a beginner at playing the guitar. Nina: Then let's start with two easy chords.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我学吉他还是个新手。妮娜：那我们就从两个简单的和弦开始吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 我学吉他还是个新手。
messages.en: I'm still a beginner at playing the guitar.

messages.speaker: Nina (吉他教师)
messages.zh: 那我们就从两个简单的和弦开始吧。
messages.en: Then let's start with two easy chords.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象第一次上吉他课的人说“我是 debuttant”：把这个词与“刚入门、经验少”的学习阶段联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short note at the beginning of an artistic work saying to whom the work is dedicated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在艺术作品开头、说明作品献给谁的一段短文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba qasira fil-bidu ta' xogħol artistiku li tgħid lil min hu ddedikat ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: dedication (note prefixed to a work of art)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 献词，题献；置于艺术作品开头、说明作品献给谁的文字。

collocations.en: a dedication at the beginning of the book

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-ktieb hemm dedika lill-għalliema li ħeġġew lill-awtur jikteb.
formal.en: At the beginning of the book, there is a dedication to the teachers who encouraged the author to write.
formal.zh: 书的开头有一段献词，献给那些鼓励作者写作的老师。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qrajt id-dedika fil-bidu tal-ktieb? Ġużeppi: Iva, l-awtriċi kitbitha għal ommha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you read the dedication at the beginning of the book? Ġużeppi: Yes, the author wrote it for her mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你读了书开头的献词吗？朱塞佩：读了，是女作者写给她母亲的。

messages.speaker: Marija (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 你读了书开头的献词吗？
messages.en: Did you read the dedication at the beginning of the book?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 读了，是女作者写给她母亲的。
messages.en: Yes, the author wrote it for her mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻开一本书，第一页写着“献给母亲”；把这段开篇献词与 dedika 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dedicates a work or an object to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将作品或物品题献、奉献给某人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiddedika xogħol jew oġġett lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 题献者；作出题献或奉献的人。

formal.mt: Id-dedikant kiteb ismu taħt id-dedika u semma lill-persuna li lilha ddedika l-ktieb.
formal.en: The dedicant wrote his name beneath the dedication and named the person to whom he dedicated the book.
formal.zh: 题献者在献词下方写上自己的姓名，并注明这本书献给谁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu d-dedikant ta' dan il-ktieb? Mark: Hu ħija; kiteb id-dedika għal missierna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the dedicant of this book? Mark: My brother; he wrote the dedication for our father.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这本书的题献者是谁？马克：是我兄弟；他写了献词，把书献给我们的父亲。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-dedikant ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-dedikant ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书的题献者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the dedicant of this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija; kiteb id-dedika għal missierna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija; kiteb id-dedika għal missierna.
messages.zh: 是我兄弟；他写了献词，把书献给我们的父亲。
messages.en: My brother; he wrote the dedication for our father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面分成两项：纸上的献词是 dedika，写下题献、作出奉献的那个人是 dedikant。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using general rules or premises to reach a conclusion about a particular case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用一般规则或前提，对具体情况得出结论的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża regoli ġenerali jew premessi biex jasal għal konklużjoni dwar każ partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演绎的；运用一般规则或前提推导结论的。

formal.mt: Il-metodu deduttiv jibda minn regola ġenerali u japplikaha għal każ partikolari.
formal.en: The deductive method starts from a general rule and applies it to a particular case.
formal.zh: 演绎方法从一般规则出发，将其应用于具体情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ir-regola tgħid li kull student irid biljett. Allura jien ukoll irrid wieħed? David: Iva, dak hu raġunament deduttiv: qed tapplika r-regola għalik.
colloquial.en: Sara: The rule says every student needs a ticket. So I need one too? David: Yes, that is deductive reasoning: you are applying the rule to yourself.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：规定说每个学生都需要一张票。那么我也需要一张？戴维：对，这就是演绎推理：你把规则应用到了自己身上。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-regola tgħid li kull student irid biljett. Allura jien ukoll irrid wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-regola tgħid li kull student irid biljett. Allura jien ukoll irrid wieħed?
messages.zh: 规定说每个学生都需要一张票。那么我也需要一张？
messages.en: The rule says every student needs a ticket. So I need one too?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak hu raġunament deduttiv: qed tapplika r-regola għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak hu raġunament deduttiv: qed tapplika r-regola għalik.
messages.zh: 对，这就是演绎推理：你把规则应用到了自己身上。
messages.en: Yes, that is deductive reasoning: you are applying the rule to yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“所有学生要票，我是学生，所以我要票”这条推理链；deduttiv 用来描述这样的演绎方法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of reaching a conclusion from facts or premises, or the conclusion reached.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据事实或前提推导结论的过程，也指由此得出的推论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tasal għal konklużjoni minn fatti jew premessi, jew il-konklużjoni li tasal għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推导，推论；根据事实或前提得出结论的过程或结果。

formal.mt: Ir-regola tgħid li kull parteċipant għandu biljett; għalhekk id-deduzzjoni hi li Marija, bħala parteċipanta, għandha biljett.
formal.en: The rule states that every participant has a ticket; the deduction is therefore that Marija, as a participant, has a ticket.
formal.zh: 规则说明每位参与者都有票；因此可以推论，玛丽亚作为参与者也有票。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-bieb magħluq u d-dawl mitfi. Taħseb li telqu? Toni: Dik hija deduzzjoni raġonevoli, imma ejja nċemplulhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: The door is closed and the light is off. Do you think they have left? Toni: That is a reasonable deduction, but let's call them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：门关着，灯也灭了。你觉得他们已经走了吗？托尼：这个推论挺合理，不过我们打电话问问他们吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb magħluq u d-dawl mitfi. Taħseb li telqu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb magħluq u d-dawl mitfi. Taħseb li telqu?
messages.zh: 门关着，灯也灭了。你觉得他们已经走了吗？
messages.en: The door is closed and the light is off. Do you think they have left?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija deduzzjoni raġonevoli, imma ejja nċemplulhom.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija deduzzjoni raġonevoli, imma ejja nċemplulhom.
messages.zh: 这个推论挺合理，不过我们打电话问问他们吧。
messages.en: That is a reasonable deduction, but let's call them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见“门关、灯灭”，脑中得出“人可能走了”；把这个由线索得出的推论记作 deduzzjoni。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-għatu ma jagħlaqx sew? Nina: Hemm deformazzjoni fit-tarf; jidher li ħa daqqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why doesn't the lid close properly? Nina: There's some deformation along the edge; it looks like it took a knock.
colloquial.zh: 马克：盖子为什么盖不严？妮娜：边缘有变形，看起来是被撞了一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 盖子为什么盖不严？
messages.en: Why doesn't the lid close properly?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm deformazzjoni fit-tarf; jidher li ħa daqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm deformazzjoni fit-tarf; jidher li ħa daqqa.
messages.zh: 边缘有变形，看起来是被撞了一下。
messages.en: There's some deformation along the edge; it looks like it took a knock.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象金属盖被撞后盖不严，把“发生变形”这个画面与名词 deformazzjoni 连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape that differs from the usual or expected form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状偏离通常或预期形态的；变形的或畸形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma differenti minn dik normali jew mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变形的；形态异常的；畸形的。

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur deformi ma setax jingħalaq sew u tneħħa mill-użu.
formal.en: The deformed container could not be closed properly and was taken out of use.
formal.zh: 这个变形的容器无法正常闭合，因此被停用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nuża dan l-għatu? Pawlu: Aħjar tieħu ieħor; dan deformi u ma jagħlaqx sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I use this lid? Pawlu: You'd better take another one; this one is deformed and doesn't close properly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以用这个盖子吗？保罗：最好换一个；这个变形了，盖不严。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以用这个盖子吗？
messages.en: Can I use this lid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tieħu ieħor; dan deformi u ma jagħlaqx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tieħu ieħor; dan deformi u ma jagħlaqx sew.
messages.zh: 最好换一个；这个变形了，盖不严。
messages.en: You'd better take another one; this one is deformed and doesn't close properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给压歪的盖子贴上“变形的”标签，记住 deformi 用来描述东西的形状状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An abnormality in the shape or structure of a body part or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体部位或物体在形状、结构上出现的异常。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Anormalità fil-forma jew fl-istruttura ta' parti tal-ġisem jew ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畸形；形态或结构异常；变形。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi deformità fl-għadam tas-sieq.
formal.en: The medical report describes a deformity in the bones of the foot.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了足部骨骼的一处畸形。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser deformità f'dan ir-rapport? David: Tfisser li hemm forma jew struttura differenti minn dik normali; hawn qed jirreferu għall-għadam tas-sieq.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does deformity mean in this report? David: It means that a shape or structure differs from the usual one; here they are referring to the bones of the foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这份报告里的“deformità”是什么意思？戴维：意思是形状或结构与正常情况不同；这里指的是足部骨骼。

messages.speaker: Marta (患者)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的“deformità”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does deformity mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li hemm forma jew struttura differenti minn dik normali; hawn qed jirreferu għall-għadam tas-sieq.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li hemm forma jew struttura differenti minn dik normali; hawn qed jirreferu għall-għadam tas-sieq.
messages.zh: 意思是形状或结构与正常情况不同；这里指的是足部骨骼。
messages.en: It means that a shape or structure differs from the usual one; here they are referring to the bones of the foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告中圈出一处形态异常，把 deformità 与“这一处畸形或变形”的名词概念一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Too interested in other people's private affairs or too ready to interfere in them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分关注他人私事、爱打听或爱插手干涉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tistaqsi żżejjed dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor jew tindaħal fiha bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱打听别人私事的；好管闲事的。
爱插手别人事务的；爱干涉的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġara hija deskritta bħala defsa għax tistaqsi dwar kwistjonijiet privati u tagħti pariri mhux mitluba.
formal.en: In the story, the female neighbour is described as nosy and interfering because she asks about private matters and gives unsolicited advice.
formal.zh: 故事中的女邻居被描述为爱打听、爱干涉，因为她询问私事，还主动给出别人没有征求的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inkun qed nidher defsa jekk nistaqsi kemm taqla'? Lara: Iva, ftit; aħjar tħalliha tgħidlek hi jekk trid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would I seem nosy if I asked how much she earns? Lara: Yes, a little; it's better to let her tell you if she wants to.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：如果我问她赚多少钱，会不会显得爱打听？拉拉：会有一点；最好让她愿意时自己告诉你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inkun qed nidher defsa jekk nistaqsi kemm taqla'?
messages.mt_standard: Inkun qed nidher defsa jekk nistaqsi kemm taqla'?
messages.zh: 如果我问她赚多少钱，会不会显得爱打听？
messages.en: Would I seem nosy if I asked how much she earns?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit; aħjar tħalliha tgħidlek hi jekk trid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit; aħjar tħalliha tgħidlek hi jekk trid.
messages.zh: 会有一点；最好让她愿意时自己告诉你。
messages.en: Yes, a little; it's better to let her tell you if she wants to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邻居先追问私事、再插手安排，用同一个人物串起“爱打听”和“爱干涉”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 有辱人格的；贬损尊严的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to feel humiliated or deprived of dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到受辱、尊严受到贬损的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jumilja lil persuna jew inaqqsilha d-dinjità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有辱人格的；使人受辱的；贬损尊严的。

formal.mt: Il-kodiċi tal-imġiba jipprojbixxi trattament degradanti u jitlob rispett lejn kull persuna.
formal.en: The code of conduct prohibits degrading treatment and requires respect for every person.
formal.zh: 行为守则禁止有辱人格的待遇，并要求尊重每个人。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak il-kumment kien degradanti. Mark: Għandek raġun; seta' jikkritika x-xogħol mingħajr ma jumiljaha.
colloquial.en: Rita: That comment was degrading. Mark: You're right; he could have criticised the work without humiliating her.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那句话太侮辱人了。马克：你说得对；他完全可以批评工作，而不羞辱她。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话太侮辱人了。
messages.en: That comment was degrading.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; seta' jikkritika x-xogħol mingħajr ma jumiljaha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; seta' jikkritika x-xogħol mingħajr ma jumiljaha.
messages.zh: 你说得对；他完全可以批评工作，而不羞辱她。
messages.en: You're right; he could have criticised the work without humiliating her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人当众受到羞辱，把 degradanti 与“让人的尊严受损”这个感受连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made of gold, having the colour of gold, or both.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由黄金制成的、呈金色的，或同时具有这两种特点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul mid-deheb, li għandu l-kulur tad-deheb, jew it-tnejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: gold; golden (made of gold and/or of its colour)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 金的；金制的；金色的，可指黄金材质、金色外观，或两者兼有。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni, il-vażun għandu lewn dehbieni, iżda huwa magħmul miċ-ċeramika.
formal.en: In the description, the vase has a golden hue, but it is made of ceramic.
formal.zh: 描述中，这只花瓶呈金色，但材质是陶瓷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu sabiħ dan iċ-ċurkett dehbieni! Nina: Iva, imma hawn dehbieni qed jiddeskrivi l-kulur; iċ-ċurkett mhux tad-deheb.
colloquial.en: Lara: This golden ring is so beautiful! Nina: Yes, but here golden describes the colour; the ring isn't made of gold.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这枚金色戒指真漂亮！妮娜：是啊，不过这里“金色的”说的是颜色；戒指不是黄金做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ dan iċ-ċurkett dehbieni!
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ dan iċ-ċurkett dehbieni!
messages.zh: 这枚金色戒指真漂亮！
messages.en: This golden ring is so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma hawn dehbieni qed jiddeskrivi l-kulur; iċ-ċurkett mhux tad-deheb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma hawn dehbieni qed jiddeskrivi l-kulur; iċ-ċurkett mhux tad-deheb.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过这里“金色的”说的是颜色；戒指不是黄金做的。
messages.en: Yes, but here golden describes the colour; the ring isn't made of gold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象一枚金戒指和一只金色陶瓷瓶，记住 dehbieni 既能说材质，也能说颜色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of boat used on a river.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种在河流上航行的船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' dgħajsa li tintuża fuq xmara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种河船。

collocations.en: a river boat on the river

formal.mt: Id-dehbija ġarret il-passiġġieri minn tarf għall-ieħor tax-xmara.
formal.en: The river boat carried the passengers from one side of the river to the other.
formal.zh: 这艘河船把乘客从河的一岸运到另一岸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik id-dgħajsa fuq ix-xmara x'inhi? Pawlu: Dik dehbija. Trid tara kif tidher mill-qrib?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that boat on the river? Pawlu: That's a dehbija, a type of river boat. Would you like to see it up close?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：河上那艘是什么船？保罗：那是dehbija，一种河船。你想近距离看看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 河上那艘是什么船？
messages.en: What is that boat on the river?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik dehbija. Trid tara kif tidher mill-qrib?
messages.mt_standard: Dik dehbija. Trid tara kif tidher mill-qrib?
messages.zh: 那是dehbija，一种河船。你想近距离看看吗？
messages.en: That's a dehbija, a type of river boat. Would you like to see it up close?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dehbija放进河上载客的画面里，连同xmara（河流）一起记住它是一种河船。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push or thrust something into a place with force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物用力推入、插入或戳入某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal xi ħaġa f'post b'daqqa jew bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力插入；戳入。

collocations.en: thrust a rod into the mud
collocations.zh: 把一根杆用力插入泥中

collocations.en: thrust a pole into the ground
collocations.zh: 把一根柱杆用力插入地面

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem dehes arblu fl-art biex jimmarka l-post.
formal.en: The worker thrust a pole into the ground to mark the location.
formal.zh: 工人把一根柱杆用力插入地面，以标明位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm virga fit-tajn? Mark: Pawlu dehes il-virga hemm biex jara kemm hu fond it-tajn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a rod in the mud? Mark: Pawlu thrust the rod in there to see how deep the mud is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：泥里为什么有一根杆？马克：保罗把杆插在那里，想看看泥有多深。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 泥里为什么有一根杆？
messages.en: Why is there a rod in the mud?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dehes il-virga hemm biex jara kemm hu fond it-tajn.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dehes il-virga hemm biex jara kemm hu fond it-tajn.
messages.zh: 保罗把杆插在那里，想看看泥有多深。
messages.en: Pawlu thrust the rod in there to see how deep the mud is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记dehes时想象把杆猛地插进泥里，重点记住动作带有向内用力的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with a thin layer of gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆上一层薄金，使其具有金色外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiksi wiċċ ta' oġġett b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给物体表面镀金或贴金。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan dehheb il-qafas b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.
formal.en: The artisan gilded the frame with a thin layer of gold.
formal.zh: 工匠在框架表面贴上了一层薄金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-qafas kollu deheb? Mark: Le, l-artiġjan dehheb il-wiċċ biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this frame entirely made of gold? Mark: No, the artisan only gilded the surface.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个框架整个都是金的吗？马克：不是，工匠只在表面贴了金。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个框架整个都是金的吗？
messages.en: Is this frame entirely made of gold?

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.zh: 不是，工匠只在表面贴了金。
messages.en: No, the artisan only gilded the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dehheb记成给旧画框披上薄金衣，强调表面覆金这个动作，而非整件物品都是金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To choose or anoint, with a frequentative sense indicating repetition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示反复进行选定或施膏的动作，是带有反复意义的动词形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħżel jew tidlek biż-żejt, b'sens ta' ripetizzjoni tal-azzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to choose or anoint (a frequentative form of 'dehen')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选定或施膏；是dehen的反复体形式，表示动作反复发生。

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis dehhen lill-magħżulin wieħed wara l-ieħor.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the priest anointed the chosen people one after another.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，神父为获选的人逐一施膏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-qassis waqt iċ-ċerimonja? Pawlu: Dehhen lill-magħżulin wieħed wara l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the priest do during the ceremony? Pawlu: He anointed the chosen people one after another.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：神父在仪式上做了什么？保罗：他为获选的人逐一施膏。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 神父在仪式上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest do during the ceremony?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为获选的人逐一施膏。
messages.en: He anointed the chosen people one after another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用仪式中逐一施膏的连续画面记dehhen，同时记住词条还包含选定义和动作反复的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who covers objects or surfaces with a thin layer of gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门在物品或表面覆上薄金层的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artiġjan li jiksi oġġetti jew uċuħ b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事镀金或贴金工作的工匠。

collocations.zh: 一位技艺娴熟的贴金工匠

formal.mt: Id-dehhieb applika saff irqiq ta' deheb fuq il-qafas wara li ħejja l-wiċċ.
formal.en: The gilder applied a thin layer of gold to the frame after preparing the surface.
formal.zh: 贴金工匠处理好框架表面后，在上面覆了一层薄金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jiksi dan il-qafas bid-deheb? Mark: Ħudu għand dehhieb; dak hu xogħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can cover this frame with gold? Mark: Take it to a gilder; that's his job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能给这个框架贴金？马克：拿去找贴金工匠吧，这就是他的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jiksi dan il-qafas bid-deheb?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jiksi dan il-qafas bid-deheb?
messages.zh: 谁能给这个框架贴金？
messages.en: Who can cover this frame with gold?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudu għand dehhieb; dak hu xogħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudu għand dehhieb; dak hu xogħlu.
messages.zh: 拿去找贴金工匠吧，这就是他的工作。
messages.en: Take it to a gilder; that's his job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dehhieb和dehheb配成工匠与动作：前者是负责贴金的人，后者是进行贴金。

gloss_zh: 镀金的；与贴金工艺有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the craft or process of gilding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与镀金、贴金的工艺或过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sengħa jew mal-proċess tal-kisi bid-deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀金的；与贴金工艺有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi xogħol dehhiebi fuq frejms tal-injam.
formal.en: The course includes gilding work on wooden frames.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括木制框架的贴金工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nitgħallmu llum fil-ħanut? Pawlu: Xogħol dehhiebi; se niksu qafas b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are we going to learn in the workshop today? Pawlu: Gilding work; we're going to cover a frame with a thin layer of gold.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天我们在作坊里要学什么？保罗：贴金工艺；我们要给一个框架覆上一层薄金。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 今天我们在作坊里要学什么？
messages.en: What are we going to learn in the workshop today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Xogħol dehhiebi; se niksu qafas b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.
messages.mt_standard: Xogħol dehhiebi; se niksu qafas b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.
messages.zh: 贴金工艺；我们要给一个框架覆上一层薄金。
messages.en: Gilding work; we're going to cover a frame with a thin layer of gold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dehhiebi贴在xogħol（工作）旁边记忆：它描述工作与贴金有关，词性是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tries to gain someone's favour through flattery or pleasing behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过奉承或刻意讨好的行为来争取他人好感的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprova tikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd bit-tifħir żejjed jew billi togħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻意讨好、奉承或巴结他人以求获得好感的人。

collocations.en: someone who curries favour with the boss

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dehhies ifaħħar lill-kap biex jikseb vantaġġ personali.
formal.en: In the story, the flatterer praises the boss to gain a personal advantage.
formal.zh: 故事中，奉承者通过赞美上司来谋取个人好处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark dejjem jaqbel mal-kap? Lara: Għax hu dehhies; irid jogħġbu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark always agree with the boss? Lara: Because he curries favour; he wants to please him to get what he wants.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么总是附和上司？拉拉：因为他是个巴结者；他想讨好上司，好得到自己想要的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么总是附和上司？
messages.en: Why does Mark always agree with the boss?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu dehhies; irid jogħġbu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu dehhies; irid jogħġbu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
messages.zh: 因为他是个巴结者；他想讨好上司，好得到自己想要的东西。
messages.en: Because he curries favour; he wants to please him to get what he wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记dehhies时想象总在上司旁边奉承的人，把讨好他人以求好处这一动机一起记住。

gloss_zh: 暗示性的；委婉讨好以施加影响的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seeking to influence someone through subtle suggestions or an ingratiating manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过含蓄暗示或委婉讨好的方式试图影响他人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipprova jinfluwenza lil xi ħadd permezz ta' ħjiel jew b'mod li jfittex li jogħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含蓄暗示的；以委婉讨好的姿态试图影响他人的。

collocations.zh: 含有暗示或讨好意味的语气
含蓄暗示、意在影响对方的话语

formal.mt: Il-kelliem uża ton dehhiesi biex jissuġġerixxi li kien jistħoqqlu trattament speċjali.
formal.en: The speaker used an insinuating tone to suggest that he deserved special treatment.
formal.zh: 发言者用含蓄讨好的语气暗示，自己理应得到特殊待遇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed ifaħħarni qabel ma jitlob xi ħaġa? Maja: Dak ton dehhiesi; qed jipprova jġiegħlek taqbel miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is he praising me before asking for something? Maja: That's an insinuating tone; he's trying to get you to agree with him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么还没开口提要求，就先夸起我来了？玛雅：那语气带着讨好和暗示；他正想让你答应他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed ifaħħarni qabel ma jitlob xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed ifaħħarni qabel ma jitlob xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 他为什么还没开口提要求，就先夸起我来了？
messages.en: Why is he praising me before asking for something?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ton dehhiesi; qed jipprova jġiegħlek taqbel miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ton dehhiesi; qed jipprova jġiegħlek taqbel miegħu.
messages.zh: 那语气带着讨好和暗示；他正想让你答应他。
messages.en: That's an insinuating tone; he's trying to get you to agree with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把dehhiesi配上ton（语气）记：话里含着暗示，或先讨好再引导对方答应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of having one's mind occupied with a thought, task, or concern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心思被某个念头、任务或挂虑占据的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat fejn il-moħħ ikun mehd b'xi ħsieb, xogħol jew tħassib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心神被某事占据；正想着或专注于某事。

formal.mt: Id-dehi tiegħu fix-xogħol kien tant kbir li ma ntebaħx bil-ħin.
formal.en: His absorption in his work was so complete that he lost track of time.
formal.zh: 他工作时十分入神，以至于忘记了时间。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma weġibtnix meta kellimtek? Pawlu: Minħabba d-dehi fix-xogħol, lanqas smajt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you answer when I spoke to you? Pawlu: I was so absorbed in my work that I didn't even hear you.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我跟你说话时，你怎么没回答？保罗：我工作太入神了，根本没听见。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 我跟你说话时，你怎么没回答？
messages.en: Why didn't you answer when I spoke to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我工作太入神了，根本没听见。
messages.en: I was so absorbed in my work that I didn't even hear you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehi 想成脑中被一件事占满的画面：同事叫你，你却还沉浸在工作或思绪中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiring sound judgement and helping someone think wisely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够启发良好判断、帮助人明智思考的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jispira ġudizzju tajjeb u jgħin lil dak li jkun jaħseb bil-għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能启发明智判断的；能使人获得良好判断力的。

collocations.en: a thought that encourages wise judgement
collocations.zh: 促使人明智判断的想法

formal.mt: Il-parir dehieni tal-għalliem għen lill-istudent jagħżel triq xierqa għall-futur tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher's advice inspired sound judgement and helped the student choose a suitable path for his future.
formal.zh: 老师的建议启发了学生的明智判断，帮助他选择了适合自己未来的道路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel. Mark: Il-parir ta' Marija kien dehieni; għenni naħseb fuq dak li verament irrid.
colloquial.en: Lara: I still don't know which course to choose. Mark: Marija's advice helped me think wisely; it made me consider what I really want.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我还是不知道该选哪门课程。马克：玛丽娅的建议很能启发判断，帮我想清楚了自己真正想要什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx liema kors nagħżel.
messages.zh: 我还是不知道该选哪门课程。
messages.en: I still don't know which course to choose.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-parir ta' Marija kien dehieni; għenni naħseb fuq dak li verament irrid.
messages.mt_standard: Il-parir ta' Marija kien dehieni; għenni naħseb fuq dak li verament irrid.
messages.zh: 玛丽娅的建议很能启发判断，帮我想清楚了自己真正想要什么。
messages.en: Marija's advice helped me think wisely; it made me consider what I really want.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehieni 放在 parir（建议）后记忆：一句好建议让人想得更明白，也判断得更明智。

gloss_zh: 吓唬别人的人；使人受惊者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who frightens or startles someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人害怕或突然受惊的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbeżża' jew taħsad lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who frightens or startles another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬他人或使他人突然受惊的人。

collocations.en: a person who hides behind the door to give someone a fright

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dehiex jinħeba wara l-bieb u joħroġ għal għarrieda biex ibeżża' lil min jidħol.
formal.en: In the story, the person giving others a fright hides behind the door and suddenly jumps out to scare whoever enters.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个吓人的人躲在门后，突然跳出来吓唬进门的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark qabeż minn wara l-bieb u ħasadni! Lara: Dak dehiex! Ngħidlu biex ma jerġax jagħmilha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Mark jumped out from behind the door and startled me! Lara: He loves giving people a fright! I'll tell him not to do it again.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克从门后跳出来，吓了我一跳！拉拉：他就是个爱吓人的家伙！我会叫他别再这样做。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qabeż minn wara l-bieb u ħasadni!
messages.mt_standard: Mark qabeż minn wara l-bieb u ħasadni!
messages.zh: 马克从门后跳出来，吓了我一跳！
messages.en: Mark jumped out from behind the door and startled me!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dehiex! Ngħidlu biex ma jerġax jagħmilha.
messages.mt_standard: Dak dehiex! Ngħidlu biex ma jerġax jagħmilha.
messages.zh: 他就是个爱吓人的家伙！我会叫他别再这样做。
messages.en: He loves giving people a fright! I'll tell him not to do it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用门后突然跳出的人来记 dehiex：这个名词指造成惊吓的人，画面焦点放在吓人者身上。

gloss_zh: 容易受惊的；易被吓到的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to become frightened or startled easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有容易害怕或容易突然受惊的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibża' jew jinħasad malajr.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a propensity to be easily frightened
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易受到惊吓的；具有易受惊倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who is easily frightened

formal.mt: It-tifel dehiexi għandu bżonn ambjent kalm, għax ħsejjes qawwija jistgħu jbeżżgħuh.
formal.en: The easily frightened boy needs a calm environment, because loud noises can scare him.
formal.zh: 这个容易受惊的男孩需要安静的环境，因为巨大的声响会吓到他。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb jinħeba meta tagħlaq il-bieb? Pawlu: Hu dehiexi; agħlaq bil-mod biex ma tbeżżgħux.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the dog hide when you close the door? Pawlu: He's easily startled; close it gently so you don't frighten him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎么一关门，那只狗就躲起来？保罗：它很容易受惊，轻轻关门，别吓着它。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kelb jinħeba meta tagħlaq il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kelb jinħeba meta tagħlaq il-bieb?
messages.zh: 怎么一关门，那只狗就躲起来？
messages.en: Why does the dog hide when you close the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dehiexi; agħlaq bil-mod biex ma tbeżżgħux.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dehiexi; agħlaq bil-mod biex ma tbeżżgħux.
messages.zh: 它很容易受惊，轻轻关门，别吓着它。
messages.en: He's easily startled; close it gently so you don't frighten him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehiexi 配上一听响声就躲起来的小狗：它描述容易受惊的性情，可与指吓人者的 dehiex 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 灵感，尤指神启；使人明白的点拨

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiration or inner guidance, especially inspiration understood as coming from God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灵感或内在的指引，尤指被理解为来自上帝的启示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ispirazzjoni jew gwida ġewwinija, speċjalment dik li titqies li ġejja minn Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；尤指来自神的启示或感召。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of having sb. wise up about sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人认清或明白某事的点拨、开导。

collocations.en: guidance that makes someone aware of the risks

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi t-talb bħala mument ta' dehin divin li għenu jieħu deċiżjoni diffiċli.
formal.en: In his letter, the author describes prayer as a moment of divine inspiration that helped him make a difficult decision.
formal.zh: 作者在信中把祈祷描述为获得神启的时刻，这份启示帮助他作出了艰难的决定。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Issa fhimt għaliex kelli noqgħod attent. Lara: Id-dehin ta' Pawlu dwar ir-riskji għenek tara l-affarijiet aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Now I understand why I needed to be careful. Lara: Pawlu's guidance about the risks helped you see things more clearly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：现在我明白为什么得小心了。拉拉：保罗对风险的点拨，帮你把事情看得更清楚了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex kelli noqgħod attent.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex kelli noqgħod attent.
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么得小心了。
messages.en: Now I understand why I needed to be careful.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dehin ta' Pawlu dwar ir-riskji għenek tara l-affarijiet aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dehin ta' Pawlu dwar ir-riskji għenek tara l-affarijiet aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 保罗对风险的点拨，帮你把事情看得更清楚了。
messages.en: Pawlu's guidance about the risks helped you see things more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehin 记成心里亮起一盏灯：宗教语境里是神的启示，人际语境里是让人认清事情的点拨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden feeling of shock or fright caused by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意外的事情引起的突然震惊或惊吓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni qawwija u f'daqqa ta' xokk jew biża' minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 震惊；因突发事件而受到的心理冲击。
惊吓；突然产生的恐惧。

collocations.zh: 突如其来的震惊或惊吓

formal.mt: L-aħbar mhux mistennija kkawżat dehix kbir fost dawk li kienu preżenti.
formal.en: The unexpected news caused great shock among those present.
formal.zh: 这个意外的消息使在场的人大为震惊。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Tani dehix kbir! Mark: Kien biss il-bieb li ngħalaq bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was that noise? It gave me such a fright! Mark: It was just the door slamming in the wind.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那是什么声音？吓了我一大跳！马克：只是风把门吹得关上了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Tani dehix kbir!
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Tani dehix kbir!
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？吓了我一大跳！
messages.en: What was that noise? It gave me such a fright!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien biss il-bieb li ngħalaq bir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kien biss il-bieb li ngħalaq bir-riħ.
messages.zh: 只是风把门吹得关上了。
messages.en: It was just the door slamming in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听到门突然砰地关上，心里猛地一惊：用这个感受记 dehix，既可表示震惊，也可表示惊吓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of applying oil or ointment to a person or part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或身体某个部位涂抹油或油膏的一次行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' tqegħid ta' żejt jew ingwent fuq persuna jew fuq parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次涂油或傅油的行为。

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis għamel dehna biż-żejt fuq il-ġbin tal-parteċipant.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the priest anointed the participant's forehead with oil.
formal.zh: 仪式中，神父在参与者的额头上傅油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-qassis fuq il-ġbin tiegħu? Mark: Għamel dehna biż-żejt bħala parti miċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the priest do to his forehead? Mark: He anointed it with oil as part of the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：神父刚才在他额头上做了什么？马克：给他傅油，这是仪式的一部分。

messages.speaker: Lara (仪式参加者)
messages.zh: 神父刚才在他额头上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest do to his forehead?

messages.speaker: Mark (仪式参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel dehna biż-żejt bħala parti miċ-ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel dehna biż-żejt bħala parti miċ-ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 给他傅油，这是仪式的一部分。
messages.en: He anointed it with oil as part of the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指蘸油后在额头涂一下：dehna 记的是这一次涂油的动作，可连同 biż-żejt（用油）一起记。

gloss_zh: 十分清楚的；非常明确的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very clear and easy to understand or recognize.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分清楚，容易理解或辨认的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċar ħafna u faċli biex wieħed jifhmu jew jagħrfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分清楚的；非常明确的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti messaġġ dehri: kull applikazzjoni trid tasal qabel id-data indikata.
formal.en: The report gives a very clear message: every application must arrive before the stated date.
formal.zh: 报告传达的信息十分明确：所有申请都必须在指定日期之前送达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nibgħat l-applikazzjoni l-ġimgħa d-dieħla? Pawlu: Il-messaġġ hu dehri: trid tibgħatha sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I send the application next week? Pawlu: The message is very clear: you must send it by Friday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我能下周再交申请吗？保罗：通知说得很明确：你必须最迟星期五提交。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请者)
messages.zh: 我能下周再交申请吗？
messages.en: Can I send the application next week?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-messaġġ hu dehri: trid tibgħatha sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-messaġġ hu dehri: trid tibgħatha sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 通知说得很明确：你必须最迟星期五提交。
messages.en: The message is very clear: you must send it by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehri 配上一条日期写得清清楚楚的通知：读完就明白，没有含糊之处，强调十分清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful, diligent attention and thorough involvement in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项活动专心投入、认真照料或勤勉用心的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attenzjoni u ħidma bir-reqqa, b'impenn sħiħ f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: thorough occupation with something; care, diligence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事的充分投入；用心；勤勉。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tħejja b'dehwa kbira, b'attenzjoni għal kull dettall.
formal.en: The report was prepared with great diligence, with attention to every detail.
formal.zh: 这份报告经过认真细致的编写，每个细节都得到了关注。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm ħadt ħsieb dan ix-xogħol! Pawlu: Iva, ħdimt fuqu b'dehwa biex ma nħalli xejn barra.
colloquial.en: Marija: You put so much care into this work! Pawlu: Yes, I worked on it diligently so I wouldn't leave anything out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这项工作你做得真用心！保罗：是啊，我认真做了，免得漏掉什么。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 这项工作你做得真用心！
messages.en: You put so much care into this work!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdimt fuqu b'dehwa biex ma nħalli xejn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdimt fuqu b'dehwa biex ma nħalli xejn barra.
messages.zh: 是啊，我认真做了，免得漏掉什么。
messages.en: Yes, I worked on it diligently so I wouldn't leave anything out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehwa 与逐项核对作业的画面联系起来：专心投入，每个细节都用心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden feeling of fright caused by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意外发生的事情而突然产生的惊吓或恐惧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' li tħoss f'daqqa minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次惊吓；突如其来的恐惧。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi ta dehxa lill-istudenti, iżda ħadd ma weġġa'.
formal.en: The loud noise gave the students a fright, but nobody was injured.
formal.zh: 那声巨响把学生们吓了一跳，但没有人受伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħadt dehxa meta waqa' l-ktieb! Mark: Skużani, żelaqli minn idi.
colloquial.en: Lara: I got a fright when the book fell! Mark: Sorry, it slipped out of my hand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书掉下来的时候，我吓了一跳！马克：抱歉，它从我手里滑下去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 书掉下来的时候，我吓了一跳！
messages.en: I got a fright when the book fell!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，它从我手里滑下去了。
messages.en: Sorry, it slipped out of my hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书突然落地，人猛地一惊：dehxa 记的是这一次突发的惊吓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to become frightened easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人容易受到惊吓，稍有动静便可能害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jibża' jew jitwerwer malajr.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a propensity to be easily frightened
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有容易受惊的倾向；容易惊恐的。

collocations.en: a person who is easily frightened

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa dehxi u jitwerwer malajr meta jisma' ħoss qawwi għal għarrieda.
formal.en: Pawlu is easily frightened and quickly becomes alarmed when he hears a sudden loud noise.
formal.zh: 保罗容易受惊，突然听到巨响时很快就会感到害怕。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int dehxi? Mark: Iva, anki bieb li jingħalaq f'daqqa jbeżżagħni.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you easily frightened? Mark: Yes, even a door closing suddenly scares me.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你很容易受惊吗？马克：是啊，连门突然关上都会吓到我。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你很容易受惊吗？
messages.en: Are you easily frightened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, anki bieb li jingħalaq f'daqqa jbeżżagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, anki bieb li jingħalaq f'daqqa jbeżżagħni.
messages.zh: 是啊，连门突然关上都会吓到我。
messages.en: Yes, even a door closing suddenly scares me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物标签来记 dehxi：这个人总是容易受惊；它描述倾向，而非一次惊吓。

gloss_zh: 向某人提供赊账；借钱给某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let someone obtain something on credit, or to lend someone money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许某人先取得商品或服务、以后付款，或把钱借给某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd jixtri u jħallas aktar tard, jew jagħtih flus b'self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予某人赊账或延期付款的信用。
向某人提供贷款；借钱给某人。

collocations.en: he extended credit to the customer
he gave his friend a loan

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ dejjen lill-klijent u ħallieh iħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The seller extended credit to the customer and allowed him to pay at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 卖方允许这位顾客赊账，在月底付款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħallas Mark għat-tiswija? Pawlu: Ħabibu dejjen lil Mark, u Mark se jħallsu lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark pay for the repair? Pawlu: His friend gave Mark a loan, and Mark will pay him back next month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克是怎么付维修费的？保罗：朋友借了钱给马克，马克下个月会还给他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么付维修费的？
messages.en: How did Mark pay for the repair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħabibu dejjen lil Mark, u Mark se jħallsu lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Ħabibu dejjen lil Mark, u Mark se jħallsu lura x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 朋友借了钱给马克，马克下个月会还给他。
messages.en: His friend gave Mark a loan, and Mark will pay him back next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 dejjen：商家让顾客月底付款，朋友先借出一笔钱；都是提供信用的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lasting for ever, or continuing steadily without interruption.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 永久存在的，或持续不断、没有间断的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' għal dejjem, jew li jkompli bla waqfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 永恒的；永久持续的。
持续不断的；恒常的。

formal.mt: L-għan tal-ftehim huwa li jistabbilixxi sliem dejjiem bejn iż-żewġ komunitajiet.
formal.en: The aim of the agreement is to establish everlasting peace between the two communities.
formal.zh: 这项协议旨在两个社群之间建立永久的和平。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħoss dejjiem qed idejjaqni. Anna: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
colloquial.en: Mark: This constant noise is bothering me. Anna: I'll close the window to reduce the noise.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这持续不断的噪声让我很烦。安娜：我把窗户关上，让噪声小一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这持续不断的噪声让我很烦。
messages.en: This constant noise is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaq it-tieqa biex ikun hemm inqas storbju.
messages.zh: 我把窗户关上，让噪声小一点。
messages.en: I'll close the window to reduce the noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dejjiem 画一条不断延伸的线：理想中的和平永远延续，耳边的声音持续不停。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who extends credit to others, including a seller who lets customers pay later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人提供信用的人，也可指允许顾客以后付款的赊销商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti kreditu lil ħaddieħor, jew bejjiegħ li jħalli lill-klijenti jħallsu aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人提供信用的人。
允许买方延期付款的卖方；赊销商。

collocations.en: a seller who sells on credit
collocations.zh: 以赊账方式销售的商人

formal.mt: Id-dejjien spjega lill-klijent meta kellu jħallas għall-oġġetti li xtara bid-dejn.
formal.en: The credit seller explained to the customer when he had to pay for the goods he had bought on credit.
formal.zh: 赊销商向顾客说明了赊购商品的付款期限。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak il-bejjiegħ huwa dejjien? Pawlu: Iva, iħallik tieħu l-oġġetti llum u tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does that seller sell on credit? Pawlu: Yes, he lets you take the goods today and pay at the end of the month.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那个卖家提供赊销吗？保罗：是的，他让你今天拿走商品，月底再付款。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 那个卖家提供赊销吗？
messages.en: Does that seller sell on credit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iħallik tieħu l-oġġetti llum u tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iħallik tieħu l-oġġetti llum u tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
messages.zh: 是的，他让你今天拿走商品，月底再付款。
messages.en: Yes, he lets you take the goods today and pay at the end of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店主说“今天拿货，月底付款”：dejjien 指提供信用、允许赊账的那个人。

gloss_zh: 允许赊账的；向他人提供信用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willing to give others credit and allow them to pay later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿意向他人提供信用、允许对方以后再付款的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti kreditu lil ħaddieħor u jippermettilu jħallas aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人提供信用、允许赊账的。

collocations.en: a seller who allows payment later

formal.mt: In-negozjant dejjieni jippermetti lill-klijenti jħallsu fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The merchant who gives credit allows customers to pay at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 这位允许赊账的商人让顾客在月底付款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nħallas illum? Pawlu: Le, il-bejjiegħ dejjieni; tista' tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I have to pay today? Pawlu: No, the seller gives credit; you can pay at the end of the month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我今天就得付款吗？保罗：不用，这个卖家允许赊账；你可以月底再付。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我今天就得付款吗？
messages.en: Do I have to pay today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-bejjiegħ dejjieni; tista' tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-bejjiegħ dejjieni; tista' tħallas fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
messages.zh: 不用，这个卖家允许赊账；你可以月底再付。
messages.en: No, the seller gives credit; you can pay at the end of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商人把付款日期写到月底：dejjieni 描写愿意让别人赊账的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something narrower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过操作或改动，使某个东西的宽度减小的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar dejqa billi tnaqqsilha l-wisa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变窄的人。

collocations.en: a person who narrows the passage
a person who narrows the opening

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-ħaddiem li naqqas il-wisa' tal-passaġġ ġie deskritt bħala d-dejjieq tal-passaġġ.
formal.en: In the report, the worker who reduced the width of the passage was described as the person who narrowed it.
formal.zh: 报告把那位减小通道宽度的工人描述为使通道变窄的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser dejjieq? Pawlu: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar dejqa, bħal min inaqqas il-wisa' ta' fetħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dejjieq mean? Pawlu: A person who makes something narrower, such as someone who reduces the width of an opening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：dejjieq 是什么意思？保罗：指使某物变窄的人，比如减小开口宽度的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: dejjieq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dejjieq mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar dejqa, bħal min inaqqas il-wisa' ta' fetħa.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar dejqa, bħal min inaqqas il-wisa' ta' fetħa.
messages.zh: 指使某物变窄的人，比如减小开口宽度的人。
messages.en: A person who makes something narrower, such as someone who reduces the width of an opening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个人把通道两侧向内推，并把 dejjieq 标签贴在人身上，记住它指实施动作的人。

gloss_zh: 使变窄的；有收窄作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect of making something narrower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有减小某物宽度、使其变窄的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar dejqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变窄的；起收窄作用的。

collocations.en: a mechanism that makes something narrower

formal.mt: L-apparat għandu mekkaniżmu dejjieqi li jnaqqas il-wisa' tal-fetħa.
formal.en: The device has a narrowing mechanism that reduces the width of the opening.
formal.zh: 该装置具有一个能够减小开口宽度的收窄机构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan iċ-ċirku għandu effett dejjieqi fuq il-fetħa? Pawlu: Iva, meta ddaħħlu, il-fetħa ssir iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this ring have a narrowing effect on the opening? Pawlu: Yes, when you insert it, the opening becomes smaller.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个环会使开口变窄吗？保罗：会，把它放进去，开口就会变小。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iċ-ċirku għandu effett dejjieqi fuq il-fetħa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iċ-ċirku għandu effett dejjieqi fuq il-fetħa?
messages.zh: 这个环会使开口变窄吗？
messages.en: Does this ring have a narrowing effect on the opening?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, meta ddaħħlu, il-fetħa ssir iżgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, meta ddaħħlu, il-fetħa ssir iżgħar.
messages.zh: 会，把它放进去，开口就会变小。
messages.en: Yes, when you insert it, the opening becomes smaller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个箭头向中间挤，把 dejjieqi 写在箭头旁，记住它形容使宽度减小的作用。

gloss_zh: 妻子不忠的丈夫；被戴绿帽子的男人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A husband whose wife is sexually unfaithful to him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妻子与他人发生婚外性关系的丈夫；这一称呼可能带有侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li martu ma tkunx fidila lejh fir-relazzjoni taż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妻子有婚外性关系的丈夫；被戴绿帽子的男人。

collocations.zh: 被称为戴绿帽子的男人

collocations.en: to be regarded as a cuckold
collocations.zh: 被认为是妻子不忠的丈夫

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-raġel jissejjaħ dejjud wara li jsir magħruf li martu għandha relazzjoni sesswali ma' raġel ieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, the husband is called a cuckold after it becomes known that his wife is having a sexual relationship with another man.
formal.zh: 小说中，妻子与另一名男子有性关系的事曝光后，这位丈夫被称为戴绿帽子的男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu dejjud? Pawlu: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh; dik il-kelma tista' tkun insult.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do they call him a cuckold in the book? Pawlu: Because his wife is unfaithful to him; that word can be an insult.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里为什么叫他戴绿帽子的男人？保罗：因为他的妻子对他不忠；这个词可能是侮辱性的称呼。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 书里为什么叫他戴绿帽子的男人？
messages.en: Why do they call him a cuckold in the book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh; dik il-kelma tista' tkun insult.
messages.mt_standard: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh; dik il-kelma tista' tkun insult.
messages.zh: 因为他的妻子对他不忠；这个词可能是侮辱性的称呼。
messages.en: Because his wife is unfaithful to him; that word can be an insult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借中文戴绿帽子的情境记 dejjud：词语指向妻子不忠的丈夫，使用时注意其侮辱意味。

gloss_zh: 边缘；山脚或山丘下缘；衣服的膝前兜部

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extremity or lower edge, such as the foot of a hill; also the part of a garment forming a lap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的末端或下缘，例如山丘脚下的边缘地带；也指衣服在膝前形成的兜部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tarf ta' xi ħaġa, bħal tarf t'isfel ta' għolja; ukoll il-parti ta' libsa li tkun fuq il-ħoġor.

sense_translations.en_definition: extremity, skirt (eg. of a mountain or a hill)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 末端；边缘地带，尤指山或山丘的下缘、山脚。
衣服覆盖膝前或在膝前兜起的部分。

collocations.en: at the foot of the hill
in the lap of the dress
collocations.zh: 在裙子膝前兜起的部分里

formal.mt: Il-mara ġabret it-tuffieħ fid-dejl tal-libsa tagħha.
formal.en: The woman gathered the apples in the lap of her dress.
formal.zh: 那位女子把苹果收拢在裙子膝前兜起的部分里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nistrieħu? Pawlu: Fid-dejl tal-għolja, ħdejn dik is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we rest? Pawlu: At the foot of the hill, beside that tree.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里休息？保罗：在山丘脚下，那棵树旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里休息？
messages.en: Where shall we rest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 在山丘脚下，那棵树旁边。
messages.en: At the foot of the hill, beside that tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dejl 画两张学习卡：一张圈出山丘下缘，一张画裙子膝前兜着苹果，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of having little width.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽度较小、横向空间有限的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li għandha ftit wisa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄；宽度不足或横向空间有限的状态。

formal.mt: Id-dejqien tal-passaġġ ma jippermettix li żewġ persuni jgħaddu ħdejn xulxin.
formal.en: The narrowness of the passage prevents two people from passing side by side.
formal.zh: 由于通道狭窄，两个人无法并排通过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu بجانب xulxin? Pawlu: Minħabba d-dejqien tal-passaġġ; ejja ngħaddu wieħed wara l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we pass side by side? Pawlu: Because of the narrowness of the passage; let's go one after the other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么不能并排通过？保罗：因为通道太窄；我们一个接一个地过吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu ħdejn xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu ħdejn xulxin?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能并排通过？
messages.en: Why can't we pass side by side?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-dejqien tal-passaġġ; ejja ngħaddu wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-dejqien tal-passaġġ; ejja ngħaddu wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为通道太窄；我们一个接一个地过吧。
messages.en: Because of the narrowness of the passage; let's go one after the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条只能单人通过的小巷，把 dejqien 写在宽度标线上，记住它表示狭窄这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A castle or fortress; in another sense, a convent or monastery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于居住或防御的城堡、堡垒；另一个义项指修士或修女共同生活的修道院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kastell jew fortizza; f'sens ieħor, kunvent jew monasteru fejn jgħixu patrijiet jew sorijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城堡；堡垒。
修道院，包括男修道院或女修道院。

formal.mt: Il-ħitan ħoxnin tad-dejr kienu jipproteġu lill-abitanti waqt l-assedju.
formal.en: The thick walls of the fortress protected its inhabitants during the siege.
formal.zh: 围城期间，堡垒厚实的城墙保护着其中的居民。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jgħix f'dan id-dejr? Pawlu: Il-patrijiet; dan huwa monasteru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who lives in this dejr? Pawlu: The friars; this is a monastery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁住在这座 dejr 里？保罗：修士们；这里是一座修道院。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 谁住在这座 dejr 里？
messages.en: Who lives in this dejr?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.zh: 修士们；这里是一座修道院。
messages.en: The friars; this is a monastery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅独立画面记 dejr：城墙与守卫提示堡垒，修士与庭院提示修道院，再靠上下文选义。

gloss_zh: 颓废的；腐朽衰败的；奢靡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing moral or cultural decline, often with excessive luxury or pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出道德或文化上的衰败，常伴随过度奢华或沉迷享乐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri tnaqqis fil-valuri morali jew kulturali, spiss b'lussu żejjed jew b'tfittxija eċċessiva tal-pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颓废的；道德或文化上腐朽衰败的，也可指过度奢华、沉迷享乐的。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri soċjetà dekadenti li tagħti aktar importanza lil-lussu milli lir-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The novel portrays a decadent society that values luxury more than responsibility.
formal.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个重奢华而轻责任的颓废社会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru jgħix ħajja dekadenti? Pawlu: Għax jaħseb biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say the character lives a decadent life? Pawlu: Because he thinks only about parties and luxury, and neglects his responsibilities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说这个人物过着奢靡颓废的生活？保罗：因为他只想着聚会和奢华享受，忽视自己的责任。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru jgħix ħajja dekadenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li l-karattru jgħix ħajja dekadenti?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个人物过着奢靡颓废的生活？
messages.en: Why do you say the character lives a decadent life?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaħseb biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaħseb biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jittraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他只想着聚会和奢华享受，忽视自己的责任。
messages.en: Because he thinks only about parties and luxury, and neglects his responsibilities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dekadenti 配上一幅宴会奢华、责任清单却落满灰尘的画面，记住享乐过度与颓废的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decline in moral, cultural, or artistic standards, often associated with excessive luxury or self-indulgence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道德、文化或艺术水准的衰退，常伴随奢靡、放纵或颓废的生活风气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-livell morali, kulturali jew artistiku, spiss marbut ma' lussu żejjed jew ħajja ta' pjaċiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颓废；道德、文化或生活风气的衰败。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tiegħu, l-awtur jorbot id-dekadenza morali tal-karattri mal-ħajja ta' lussu tagħhom.
formal.en: In his analysis, the author connects the characters' moral decadence with their luxurious lifestyle.
formal.zh: 作者在分析中把人物的道德颓败与他们奢华的生活联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-kritiku juża l-kelma dekadenza? Mark: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-lussu u fil-pjaċir.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does the critic use the word decadence? Mark: Because the characters think only about luxury and pleasure.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：评论家为什么用“颓废”这个词？马克：因为这些人物只想着奢华和享乐。

messages.speaker: Rita (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 评论家为什么用“颓废”这个词？
messages.en: Why does the critic use the word decadence?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-lussu u fil-pjaċir.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-lussu u fil-pjaċir.
messages.zh: 因为这些人物只想着奢华和享乐。
messages.en: Because the characters think only about luxury and pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物沉迷宴会、价值观逐渐衰败的画面，把 dekadenza 与“颓废、衰败”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of reducing carbon dioxide emissions from activities such as energy production, transport, and industry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少能源生产、交通和工业等活动中二氧化碳排放的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitnaqqsu l-emissjonijiet tad-diossidu tal-karbonju minn attivitajiet bħall-produzzjoni tal-enerġija, it-trasport u l-industrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱碳；减少能源、交通或工业等领域二氧化碳排放的过程。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' dekarbonizzazzjoni tal-fabbrika jinkludi l-użu ta' enerġija rinnovabbli u tagħmir aktar effiċjenti.
formal.en: The factory's decarbonization plan includes the use of renewable energy and more efficient equipment.
formal.zh: 这家工厂的脱碳计划包括使用可再生能源和效率更高的设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi d-dekarbonizzazzjoni tat-trasport? Pawlu: Tfisser li nnaqqsu l-emissjonijiet tal-karbonju mit-trasport, pereżempju billi nużaw aktar il-karozzi tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is transport decarbonization? Paul: It means reducing carbon emissions from transport, for example by using buses more.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：交通运输脱碳是什么意思？保罗：就是减少交通运输产生的碳排放，例如更多地乘坐公共汽车。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 交通运输脱碳是什么意思？
messages.en: What is transport decarbonization?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li nnaqqsu l-emissjonijiet tal-karbonju mit-trasport, pereżempju billi nużaw aktar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li nnaqqsu l-emissjonijiet tal-karbonju mit-trasport, pereżempju billi nużaw aktar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.zh: 就是减少交通运输产生的碳排放，例如更多地乘坐公共汽车。
messages.en: It means reducing carbon emissions from transport, for example by using buses more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把工厂、车辆旁逐渐缩小的排放云团作为记忆图像：dekarbonizzazzjoni 表示减少碳排放的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive or self-indulgent drinking of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放纵自己饮酒，或过度沉迷于酒精饮品的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xorb ta' alkoħol b'mod eċċessiv jew bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纵酒；放纵自己饮酒或沉湎于饮酒。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb juri kif id-dekdik tal-protagonist jagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu mal-familja.
formal.en: The writer shows how the protagonist's excessive drinking damages his relationships with his family.
formal.zh: 作者展示了主人公的纵酒行为如何损害他与家人的关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tinkwieta dwar Toni? Nina: Minħabba d-dekdik tiegħu; kull festa jispiċċa jixrob wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you worried about Toni? Nina: Because of his excessive drinking; he ends up drinking too much at every party.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么担心托尼？妮娜：因为他纵酒；每次聚会他最后都会喝得太多。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么担心托尼？
messages.en: Why are you worried about Toni?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-dekdik tiegħu; kull festa jispiċċa jixrob wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-dekdik tiegħu; kull festa jispiċċa jixrob wisq.
messages.zh: 因为他纵酒；每次聚会他最后都会喝得太多。
messages.en: Because of his excessive drinking; he ends up drinking too much at every party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“聚会上一杯接一杯、喝得失去节制”的画面记 dekdik，重点记住纵酒而非普通喝酒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pound something with repeated blows, or to cook food for too long so that it becomes overly soft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反复敲击把东西捣碎；也指把食物烹煮过久，使其过于软烂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaffeġ xi ħaġa b'daqqiet ripetuti, jew issajjar l-ikel iżżejjed sakemm isir artab wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣；通过反复敲击把东西捣碎或压碎。
把食物煮过头；烹煮过久而使食物过于软烂。

formal.mt: Il-kok dekkek il-ħwawar fil-mehrież qabel żiedhom maz-zalza.
formal.en: The cook pounded the spices in the mortar before adding them to the sauce.
formal.zh: 厨师先在研钵里把香料捣碎，再把它们加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-ħaxix sar artab daqshekk? Ġanni: Għax il-kok dekkek il-ħaxix; ħallieh fuq in-nar għal ħin twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Maria: Why have the vegetables become so soft? John: Because the cook overcooked them; he left them on the heat for far too long.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：蔬菜怎么变得这么软了？约翰：因为厨师把蔬菜煮过头了；他把菜放在火上煮了太久。

messages.speaker: Marija (食客)
messages.zh: 蔬菜怎么变得这么软了？
messages.en: Why have the vegetables become so soft?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同桌朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kok dekkek il-ħaxix; ħallieh fuq in-nar għal ħin twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kok dekkek il-ħaxix; ħallieh fuq in-nar għal ħin twil wisq.
messages.zh: 因为厨师把蔬菜煮过头了；他把菜放在火上煮了太久。
messages.en: Because the cook overcooked them; he left them on the heat for far too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个厨房画面并排记忆：研钵里捣碎香料，锅里蔬菜煮得软烂；dekkek 的两个义项分别对应它们。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pounds or pulverises material into smaller pieces or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过捣击或研磨把材料弄成小块或粉末的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħaffeġ materjal b'daqqiet jew titħnu sakemm isir biċċiet żgħar jew trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣碎或研碎东西的人；将材料捣成碎块或粉末者。

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, id-dekkiek tal-ħwawar uża mehrież biex juri kif il-ħwawar isiru trab.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the person pounding the spices used a mortar to show how the spices are reduced to powder.
formal.zh: 演示时，捣香料的人用研钵展示了如何把香料捣成粉末。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu d-dekkiek tal-ħwawar illum? Tumas: Jien; se nuża l-mehrież il-kbir.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is pounding the spices today? Thomas: I am; I'll use the large mortar.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天谁负责捣香料？托马斯：我；我会用那个大研钵。

messages.speaker: Anna (烹饪课学员)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责捣香料？
messages.en: Who is pounding the spices today?

messages.speaker: Tumas (烹饪课学员)
messages.zh: 我；我会用那个大研钵。
messages.en: I am; I'll use the large mortar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头从研钵转向握着杵的人：dekkiek 指做捣碎工作的人，记忆重点放在“人”上。

gloss_zh: 能捣碎的；有粉碎能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to pound material into smaller pieces or pulverise it into powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有通过捣击使材料破碎，或将其粉碎成粉末的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jgħaffeġ materjal b'daqqiet jew jagħmlu trab.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to pound or pulverise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能捣碎或研碎东西的；具有粉碎能力的。

collocations.en: equipment capable of pounding or pulverising
collocations.zh: 具有捣碎或粉碎能力的设备

collocations.en: a mechanism capable of pounding or pulverising
collocations.zh: 具有捣碎或粉碎能力的机构

formal.mt: L-apparat dekkieki jintuża biex il-materjal jitnaqqas għal biċċiet żgħar qabel l-istadju li jmiss.
formal.en: The equipment capable of pulverising is used to reduce the material to small pieces before the next stage.
formal.zh: 这种具有粉碎能力的设备用于在下一道工序前把材料加工成小块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-apparat iħallat biss? Mark: Le, huwa dekkieki wkoll; jista' jagħmel il-ħwawar trab.
colloquial.en: Maya: Does this equipment only mix? Mark: No, it can also pulverise; it can turn spices into powder.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个设备只能搅拌吗？马克：不，它也有粉碎能力；能把香料打成粉末。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个设备只能搅拌吗？
messages.en: Does this equipment only mix?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa dekkieki wkoll; jista' jagħmel il-ħwawar trab.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa dekkieki wkoll; jista' jagħmel il-ħwawar trab.
messages.zh: 不，它也有粉碎能力；能把香料打成粉末。
messages.en: No, it can also pulverise; it can turn spices into powder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给粉碎设备贴上“能捣碎”的功能标签来记 dekkieki；它是描述能力的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for grass, referring to bluegrass or, in another sense, dactylis, also called cocksfoot grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种草类名称，可指蓝草，也可指鸭茅，即鸡脚草；具体所指需结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' ħaxix li jista' jirreferi għal bluegrass jew, f'sens ieħor, għal dactylis, magħruf ukoll bħala cocksfoot grass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝草，一种草类名称。
鸭茅，也称鸡脚草。

collocations.en: bluegrass or cocksfoot seed, depending on the intended sense
collocations.zh: 蓝草或鸭茅的种子，具体依语境而定

collocations.en: a sample of bluegrass or cocksfoot, depending on the intended sense
collocations.zh: 蓝草或鸭茅的样本，具体依语境而定

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, il-kelma dekkuk tirreferi għal dactylis, magħruf ukoll bl-isem Ingliż cocksfoot grass.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the word dekkuk refers to dactylis, also known by the English name cocksfoot grass.
formal.zh: 在这份目录中，dekkuk 一词指鸭茅，英语也称 cocksfoot grass。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fuq il-pakkett hemm miktub dekkuk; hawn ifisser bluegrass? Pawlu: Iva, fuq dan il-pakkett hemm ukoll l-isem bluegrass.
colloquial.en: Lina: The packet says dekkuk; does it mean bluegrass here? Paul: Yes, this packet also gives the name bluegrass.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：包装上写着 dekkuk；这里是指蓝草吗？保罗：是的，这个包装上也写着 bluegrass 这个名称。

messages.speaker: Lina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-pakkett hemm miktub dekkuk; hawn ifisser bluegrass?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-pakkett hemm miktub dekkuk; hawn ifisser bluegrass?
messages.zh: 包装上写着 dekkuk；这里是指蓝草吗？
messages.en: The packet says dekkuk; does it mean bluegrass here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fuq dan il-pakkett hemm ukoll l-isem bluegrass.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fuq dan il-pakkett hemm ukoll l-isem bluegrass.
messages.zh: 是的，这个包装上也写着 bluegrass 这个名称。
messages.en: Yes, this packet also gives the name bluegrass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dekkuk 做两张草类图片卡，一张标蓝草，一张标鸭茅；学习时分别配上语境，避免把两个义项混成同一种草。

gloss_zh: 朗诵式的；慷慨陈词式的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Delivered or expressed in an emphatic, rhetorical manner like a formal recitation or public speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像正式朗诵或公开演说那样，语气强烈、讲究修辞并带有明显表演色彩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ton qawwi u retoriku, bħar-reċitazzjoni formali jew diskors quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朗诵式的；演说腔的；语气强烈而带有修辞或表演色彩的。

collocations.zh: 朗诵式的语调；慷慨激昂的演说腔
朗诵式或慷慨陈词式的风格

formal.mt: L-attur adotta ton deklamatorju biex jagħti aktar forza lill-kliem tal-poeżija.
formal.en: The actor adopted a declamatory tone to give the words of the poem greater force.
formal.zh: 演员采用了慷慨激昂的朗诵语调，使诗句更有力量。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed taqra l-messaġġ b'ton deklamatorju? David: Qed nipprova nagħmlu qisu diskors fuq palk!
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you reading the message in a declamatory tone? David: I'm trying to make it sound like a speech on a stage!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么用朗诵腔读这条消息？戴维：我想把它读得像在舞台上演讲一样！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taqra l-messaġġ b'ton deklamatorju?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taqra l-messaġġ b'ton deklamatorju?
messages.zh: 你为什么用朗诵腔读这条消息？
messages.en: Why are you reading the message in a declamatory tone?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova nagħmlu qisu diskors fuq palk!
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova nagħmlu qisu diskors fuq palk!
messages.zh: 我想把它读得像在舞台上演讲一样！
messages.en: I'm trying to make it sound like a speech on a stage!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友站上舞台，把普通消息读成激昂演说；用这副“朗诵腔”记住 deklamatorju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who recites poetry or other texts aloud with expressive delivery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以富有表现力的语调朗诵诗歌或其他文本的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirreċta poeżiji jew testi oħra b'vuċi espressiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朗诵者；以鲜明语调和表现力诵读文本的人。

formal.mt: Id-deklamatur ippreżenta l-poeżija b'leħen ċar u b'ritmu meqjus.
formal.en: The reciter presented the poem with a clear voice and a measured rhythm.
formal.zh: 朗诵者以清晰的声音和恰到好处的节奏朗诵了这首诗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu d-deklamatur li se nisimgħu llejla? Mark: Hu Pawlu; jogħġobni kif jirreċta l-poeżiji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the reciter we are going to hear tonight? Mark: It's Pawlu; I like the way he recites poems.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们要听的朗诵者是谁？Mark：是Pawlu；我喜欢他朗诵诗歌的方式。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-deklamatur li se nisimgħu llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-deklamatur li se nisimgħu llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们要听的朗诵者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the reciter we are going to hear tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Pawlu; jogħġobni kif jirreċta l-poeżiji.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Pawlu; jogħġobni kif jirreċta l-poeżiji.
messages.zh: 是Pawlu；我喜欢他朗诵诗歌的方式。
messages.en: It's Pawlu; I like the way he recites poems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上拿着诗稿朗诵的人，用人物画面记住“朗诵者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The expressive recitation of poetry or another text before listeners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面向听众，以富有表现力的声音诵读诗歌或其他文本的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reċitazzjoni espressiva ta' poeżija jew ta' test ieħor quddiem is-semmiegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朗诵；以富有表现力或慷慨激昂的语调诵读文本。

formal.mt: Id-deklamazzjoni tal-poeżija kienet parti mill-programm tal-lejla letterarja.
formal.en: The recitation of the poem was part of the literary evening's programme.
formal.zh: 这首诗的朗诵是文学晚会节目的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra l-preparazzjoni għad-deklamazzjoni? Mark: Qed nipprattika l-pawżi biex il-poeżija tinftiehem aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the preparation for the recitation going? Mark: I'm practising the pauses so that the poem is easier to understand.
colloquial.zh: Maja：朗诵准备得怎么样了？Mark：我正在练习停顿，让这首诗更容易听懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 朗诵准备得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the preparation for the recitation going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprattika l-pawżi biex il-poeżija tinftiehem aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprattika l-pawżi biex il-poeżija tinftiehem aħjar.
messages.zh: 我正在练习停顿，让这首诗更容易听懂。
messages.en: I'm practising the pauses so that the poem is easier to understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在声音、节奏和停顿上，记住这个词表示“朗诵这项活动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to change form according to grammatical case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够根据语法格改变词形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jibdel il-forma tiegħu skont il-każ grammatikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可变格的；能够依语法格发生词形变化的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-grammatika, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw kull nom deklinabbli u jiktbu l-forom tiegħu.
formal.en: In the grammar exercise, students must identify each declinable noun and write its forms.
formal.zh: 在语法练习中，学生须找出每个可变格名词，并写出它的各个词形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li nom hu deklinabbli? Mark: Ifisser li jista' jibdel il-forma skont il-każ grammatikali.
