colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean for a noun to be declinable? Mark: It means that it can change form according to grammatical case.
colloquial.zh: Maja：说一个名词可变格是什么意思？Mark：意思是它能根据语法格改变词形。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li nom hu deklinabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li nom hu deklinabbli?
messages.zh: 说一个名词可变格是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean for a noun to be declinable?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jista' jibdel il-forma skont il-każ grammatikali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jista' jibdel il-forma skont il-każ grammatikali.
messages.zh: 意思是它能根据语法格改变词形。
messages.en: It means that it can change form according to grammatical case.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象名词走进不同的语法格，就换上一套词形衣服，帮助记住“可变格的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In astronomy, the angular distance of a celestial object north or south of the celestial equator.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天文学中，天体在天球赤道以北或以南的角距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-astronomija, id-distanza angolari ta' oġġett ċelesti lejn it-tramuntana jew in-nofsinhar tal-ekwatur ċelesti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤纬；天体相对于天球赤道向北或向南的角距离。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jindika d-deklinazzjoni ta' kull stilla fi gradi.
formal.en: The catalogue gives the declination of each star in degrees.
formal.zh: 该星表以度为单位列出每颗恒星的赤纬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-istilla għandha deklinazzjoni pożittiva. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser li tinsab fit-tramuntana tal-ekwatur ċelesti.
colloquial.en: Maja: This star has a positive declination. What does that mean? Mark: It means that it lies north of the celestial equator.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这颗恒星的赤纬是正值。这是什么意思？Mark：意思是它位于天球赤道以北。

messages.speaker: Maja (天文社学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-istilla għandha deklinazzjoni pożittiva. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-istilla għandha deklinazzjoni pożittiva. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 这颗恒星的赤纬是正值。这是什么意思？
messages.en: This star has a positive declination. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (天文社老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tinsab fit-tramuntana tal-ekwatur ċelesti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tinsab fit-tramuntana tal-ekwatur ċelesti.
messages.zh: 意思是它位于天球赤道以北。
messages.en: It means that it lies north of the celestial equator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象的星空上画一条天球赤道，再看星星偏北或偏南多少度，记住“赤纬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of ending colonial rule and establishing political independence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结束殖民统治并建立政治独立的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tintemm il-ħakma kolonjali u tinkiseb l-indipendenza politika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非殖民化；结束殖民统治、实现自主与独立的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-rabta bejn id-dekolonizzazzjoni u l-ħolqien ta' istituzzjonijiet politiċi indipendenti.
formal.en: The study examines the relationship between decolonization and the creation of independent political institutions.
formal.zh: 这项研究探讨非殖民化与建立独立政治机构之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni? Mark: Fuq id-dekolonizzazzjoni u kif il-popli kisbu l-indipendenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will your presentation be about? Mark: About decolonization and how peoples gained independence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的报告准备讲什么？Mark：讲非殖民化，以及各民族如何获得独立。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你的报告准备讲什么？
messages.en: What will your presentation be about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq id-dekolonizzazzjoni u kif il-popli kisbu l-indipendenza.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq id-dekolonizzazzjoni u kif il-popli kisbu l-indipendenza.
messages.zh: 讲非殖民化，以及各民族如何获得独立。
messages.en: About decolonization and how peoples gained independence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“结束殖民统治，自己决定政治事务”这一情景，记住非殖民化的核心含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a substance or material breaks down into simpler components.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种物质或材料分解为较简单组成部分的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih sustanza jew materjal jinqasam f'komponenti aktar sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分解；物质分解为较简单成分的过程，也可指有机物的腐解。

formal.mt: L-esperiment ikejjel ir-rata tad-dekompożizzjoni tal-materjal organiku f'temperaturi differenti.
formal.en: The experiment measures the rate of decomposition of organic material at different temperatures.
formal.zh: 该实验测量不同温度下有机物的分解速率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-weraq fil-kompost qed jinbidel? Mark: Minħabba d-dekompożizzjoni; il-materjal qed jinqasam f'partijiet aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the leaves in the compost changing? Mark: Because of decomposition; the material is breaking down into simpler parts.
colloquial.zh: Maja：堆肥里的叶子为什么在变化？Mark：因为发生了分解；这些物质正在分解成更简单的部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 堆肥里的叶子为什么在变化？
messages.en: Why are the leaves in the compost changing?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-dekompożizzjoni; il-materjal qed jinqasam f'partijiet aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-dekompożizzjoni; il-materjal qed jinqasam f'partijiet aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 因为发生了分解；这些物质正在分解成更简单的部分。
messages.en: Because of decomposition; the material is breaking down into simpler parts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象堆肥中的落叶逐渐分解，用“复杂物质变成简单成分”的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Polite and proper behaviour suited to a social or formal occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合社交或正式场合要求的礼貌、得体的行为举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba edukata u xierqa għall-okkażjoni, speċjalment f'ambjent formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼仪；端庄得体、符合场合规范的行为举止。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom josservaw ir-regoli tad-dekor waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: Participants should observe the rules of etiquette during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 参加者在仪式期间应遵守礼仪规范。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' ninterrompi lil min qed jitkellem? Mark: Aħjar tistenna sakemm jispiċċa; hekk jitlob id-dekor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I interrupt the person who is speaking? Mark: It's better to wait until they finish; that is what etiquette calls for.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以打断正在发言的人吗？Mark：最好等对方说完；礼仪要求这样做。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ninterrompi lil min qed jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ninterrompi lil min qed jitkellem?
messages.zh: 我可以打断正在发言的人吗？
messages.en: Can I interrupt the person who is speaking?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tistenna sakemm jispiċċa; hekk jitlob id-dekor.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tistenna sakemm jispiċċa; hekk jitlob id-dekor.
messages.zh: 最好等对方说完；礼仪要求这样做。
messages.en: It's better to wait until they finish; that is what etiquette calls for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象正式仪式中安静倾听、轮流发言的举止，把这个词与“礼仪得体”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used or intended to make something look more attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使事物外观更美观、具有装饰作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża jew ikun maħsub biex iżejjen xi ħaġa u jagħmilha isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰性的；以美化外观为用途的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell tal-injam iservi bħala element dekorattiv fid-daħla tal-bini.
formal.en: The wooden panel serves as a decorative element at the entrance to the building.
formal.zh: 这块木质饰板在建筑入口处起装饰作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għalxiex hu dan l-oġġett fuq l-ixkaffa? Mark: Hu oġġett dekorattiv; poġġejtu hemm biex iżejjen il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this object on the shelf for? Mark: It's a decorative object; I put it there to brighten up the room.
colloquial.zh: Maja：架子上这个东西是做什么用的？Mark：它是装饰物；我把它放在那里是为了美化房间。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalxiex hu dan l-oġġett fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Għalxiex hu dan l-oġġett fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 架子上这个东西是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this object on the shelf for?

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu oġġett dekorattiv; poġġejtu hemm biex iżejjen il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu oġġett dekorattiv; poġġejtu hemm biex iżejjen il-kamra.
messages.zh: 它是装饰物；我把它放在那里是为了美化房间。
messages.en: It's a decorative object; I put it there to brighten up the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象架子上的摆件让房间更漂亮，用“美化外观的用途”记住“装饰性的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to decorate rooms, buildings, or spaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以装饰房间、建筑或其他空间为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li żżejjen kmamar, bini jew spazji oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰师；负责空间装饰与布置的人。

formal.mt: Il-lukanda qabbdet dekoratur biex jagħżel il-kuluri u jżejjen is-sala ewlenija.
formal.en: The hotel hired a decorator to choose the colours and decorate the main hall.
formal.zh: 酒店聘请了一位装饰师，负责选择配色并装饰主大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna bżonn dekoratur għas-salott? Mark: Iva, jista' jgħinna nagħżlu l-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we need a decorator for the living room? Mark: Yes, he can help us choose the colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们的客厅需要请装饰师吗？马克：需要，他可以帮我们选择配色。

messages.speaker: Maja (妻子)
messages.zh: 我们的客厅需要请装饰师吗？
messages.en: Do we need a decorator for the living room?

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 需要，他可以帮我们选择配色。
messages.en: Yes, he can help us choose the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dekoratur 和“拿着色卡布置客厅的人”一起记，重点记住它指装饰师这个人。

gloss_zh: 端庄得体的；合乎礼仪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Proper, dignified, and suitable for the social occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止、言谈或外表端庄，符合场合与礼仪要求的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xieraq u dinjituż, skont dak li jitlob il-post jew l-okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 端庄得体的；合乎场合及礼仪要求的。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-parteċipanti huma mitluba jilbsu lbies dekoruż.
formal.en: During the ceremony, participants are asked to wear decorous attire.
formal.zh: 参加仪式时，请参与者穿着端庄得体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-libsa tajjeb għaċ-ċerimonja? Nina: Iva, l-ilbies tiegħek dekoruż u jaqbel mal-okkażjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this dress suitable for the ceremony? Nina: Yes, your outfit is decorous and suits the occasion.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条裙子适合参加仪式吗？妮娜：适合，你的着装端庄得体，很符合这个场合。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条裙子适合参加仪式吗？
messages.en: Is this dress suitable for the ceremony?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ilbies tiegħek dekoruż u jaqbel mal-okkażjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ilbies tiegħek dekoruż u jaqbel mal-okkażjoni.
messages.zh: 适合，你的着装端庄得体，很符合这个场合。
messages.en: Yes, your outfit is decorous and suits the occasion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dekoruż 放进“参加正式仪式，衣着言谈都得体”的画面里，记住它描述端庄合宜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intentionally, as the result of a conscious choice rather than by accident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出于有意识的选择而做某事，而非偶然发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod intenzjonat, b'għażla konxja u mhux b'kumbinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 故意地；有意地；出于明确意图地。

formal.mt: L-awtur ħalla deliberatament xi dettalji barra mis-sommarju biex iżommu qasir.
formal.en: The author deliberately left some details out of the summary to keep it short.
formal.zh: 作者有意从摘要中省去了一些细节，以保持简洁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħallejt it-telefon id-dar deliberatament? Pawlu: Iva, ridt nimxi ftit mingħajr ma jċempilli ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you leave your phone at home deliberately? Pawlu: Yes, I wanted to go for a short walk without anyone calling me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你是故意把手机留在家里的吗？保罗：是的，我想散会儿步，不被任何人的电话打扰。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是故意把手机留在家里的吗？
messages.en: Did you leave your phone at home deliberately?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridt nimxi ftit mingħajr ma jċempilli ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridt nimxi ftit mingħajr ma jċempilli ħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，我想散会儿步，不被任何人的电话打扰。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to go for a short walk without anyone calling me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“手机留在家，是我有意安排的”这个情景，用 deliberatament 标明动作出于故意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with considering matters carefully and reaching decisions or resolutions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及仔细讨论、审议事项，并作出决定或决议的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-eżami u d-diskussjoni ta' kwistjonijiet biex jittieħdu deċiżjonijiet jew riżoluzzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审议的；具有作出决定或形成决议作用的。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill huwa korp deliberattiv li jeżamina l-proposti qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The council is a deliberative body that examines proposals before making a decision.
formal.zh: 该理事会是一个审议机构，在作出决定之前会研究各项提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma ħadniex deċiżjoni? Mark: Il-proċess deliberattiv għadu għaddej; irridu nisimgħu l-opinjonijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why haven't we made a decision yet? Mark: The deliberative process is still under way; we need to hear everyone's views.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么还没有作出决定？马克：审议过程还在进行，我们需要听取所有人的意见。

messages.speaker: Maja (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么还没有作出决定？
messages.en: Why haven't we made a decision yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (委员会主席)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċess deliberattiv għadu għaddej; irridu nisimgħu l-opinjonijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċess deliberattiv għadu għaddej; irridu nisimgħu l-opinjonijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 审议过程还在进行，我们需要听取所有人的意见。
messages.en: The deliberative process is still under way; we need to hear everyone's views.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deliberattiv 与“围桌讨论提案，最后形成决定”的场景相连，记住它修饰审议机构或过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful consideration and discussion of a matter, or a formal resolution reached through such consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对事项进行仔细考虑和讨论的审议过程，也指经审议形成的正式决议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami u diskussjoni bir-reqqa ta' kwistjoni, jew riżoluzzjoni formali li tittieħed wara dan l-eżami.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审议；慎重讨论；经审议形成的决议。

formal.mt: Wara deliberazzjoni twila, il-kumitat approva l-proposta b'vot unanimu.
formal.en: After lengthy deliberation, the committee approved the proposal by a unanimous vote.
formal.zh: 经过长时间审议后，委员会一致投票通过了该提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà għażiltu l-post għall-laqgħa? Pawlu: Iva, wara ftit deliberazzjoni għażilna s-sala l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you already chosen the venue for the meeting? Pawlu: Yes, after some deliberation we chose the large hall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们已经选好开会的地方了吗？保罗：选好了，商量考虑了一番后，我们选了大会议厅。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们已经选好开会的地方了吗？
messages.en: Have you already chosen the venue for the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara ftit deliberazzjoni għażilna s-sala l-kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara ftit deliberazzjoni għażilna s-sala l-kbira.
messages.zh: 选好了，商量考虑了一番后，我们选了大会议厅。
messages.en: Yes, after some deliberation we chose the large hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先仔细审议，再写下决议”这两个连续画面记 deliberazzjoni，兼顾讨论过程与形成的决议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drawing or description that sets out the outline or main features of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用图画或文字勾勒事物的轮廓、主要特征或基本内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpinġija jew deskrizzjoni li turi l-kontorni jew il-karatteristiċi ewlenin ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勾勒；描绘轮廓；对主要特征的描述或概述。

formal.mt: L-ewwel taqsima tar-rapport tagħti delineament tal-proġett u tal-għanijiet ewlenin tiegħu.
formal.en: The first section of the report provides an outline of the project and its main objectives.
formal.zh: 报告的第一部分概述了该项目及其主要目标。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid id-dettalji kollha llum? Mark: Le, għalissa biżżejjed delineament ċar tal-idea.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want all the details today? Mark: No, for now a clear outline of the idea is enough.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天就需要全部细节吗？马克：不用，目前把这个想法清楚地概述一下就够了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天就需要全部细节吗？
messages.en: Do you want all the details today?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għalissa biżżejjed delineament ċar tal-idea.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għalissa biżżejjed delineament ċar tal-idea.
messages.zh: 不用，目前把这个想法清楚地概述一下就够了。
messages.en: No, for now a clear outline of the idea is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先画出轮廓、再补充细节，把 delineament 记成“让主要形状或要点先显出来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of confused awareness and thinking, or, figuratively, a state of extreme excitement or frenzy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意识和思维混乱的谵妄状态；也可比喻极度兴奋、近乎失控的狂热状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' konfużjoni fil-kuxjenza u fil-ħsieb, jew, b'mod figurattiv, stat ta' eċċitament kbir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谵妄；意识、注意和思维出现混乱的状态。
狂热；极度兴奋或激动、近乎失控的状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-tabib isib lill-pazjent fi stat ta' delirju, b'diskors imħawwad u diffikultà biex jagħraf il-post.
formal.en: In the novel, the doctor finds the patient in a state of delirium, with confused speech and difficulty recognising the place.
formal.zh: 小说中，医生发现病人处于谵妄状态，言语混乱，难以辨认自己所在的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara meta t-tim rebaħ? Pawlu: Kien hemm delirju ta' ferħ; kulħadd beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat!
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened when the team won? Pawlu: There was a frenzy of joy; everyone started jumping and shouting!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：球队获胜时发生了什么？保罗：大家欣喜若狂，所有人都跳了起来，大声欢呼！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 球队获胜时发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened when the team won?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm delirju ta' ferħ; kulħadd beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat!
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm delirju ta' ferħ; kulħadd beda jaqbeż u jgħajjat!
messages.zh: 大家欣喜若狂，所有人都跳了起来，大声欢呼！
messages.en: There was a frenzy of joy; everyone started jumping and shouting!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记 delirju：病房里的意识混乱是“谵妄”，球场上的极度激动是“狂热”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Great pleasure or enjoyment, or something that gives such pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的愉悦或享受，也指带来这种感受的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjaċir jew gost kbir, jew xi ħaġa li tagħti dan il-pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愉悦；喜悦；令人十分愉快或享受的人或事物。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien, bil-fjuri kkuluriti u l-mogħdijiet kwieti tiegħu, huwa delizzja għall-għajnejn.
formal.en: The garden, with its colourful flowers and quiet paths, is a delight for the eyes.
formal.zh: 这座花园有缤纷的花朵和幽静的小径，令人赏心悦目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbitek il-kejk? Nina: Iva, kien delizzja! Nista' nieħu biċċa oħra?
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the cake? Nina: Yes, it was a delight! Can I have another slice?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这蛋糕吗？妮娜：喜欢，吃起来真享受！我可以再来一块吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Did you like the cake?

messages.speaker: Nina (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien delizzja! Nista' nieħu biċċa oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien delizzja! Nista' nieħu biċċa oħra?
messages.zh: 喜欢，吃起来真享受！我可以再来一块吗？
messages.en: Yes, it was a delight! Can I have another slice?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 delizzja 和“看见美景、尝到美味时心里一亮”联系起来，记住愉悦感与带来愉悦的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide shade for someone or something, or to cast a shadow over a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人或物遮挡阳光，或在某处投下影子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti d-dell lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew jitfa' dell fuq post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为……遮阴；遮挡照向……的阳光。
投下影子；使某处出现阴影。

collocations.en: cast a shadow on the wall

formal.mt: Il-bini l-ġdid dellel parti mill-ġnien matul waranofsinhar.
formal.en: The new building shaded part of the garden during the afternoon.
formal.zh: 新建筑在下午为花园的一部分遮住了阳光。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min dellel il-mejda? Mark: Jien, poġġejt umbrella fuqha biex ma noqogħdux fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who shaded the table? Mark: I did. I put an umbrella over it so we wouldn't sit in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给桌子遮了阳光？马克：我呀。我在上面撑了把伞，这样我们就不用晒着太阳坐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给桌子遮了阳光？
messages.en: Who shaded the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, poġġejt umbrella fuqha biex ma noqogħdux fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, poġġejt umbrella fuqha biex ma noqogħdux fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 我呀。我在上面撑了把伞，这样我们就不用晒着太阳坐了。
messages.en: I did. I put an umbrella over it so we wouldn't sit in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成撑起一把伞：伞为人遮阴，也在地上投下影子，两个义项都强调动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having shade and protected from strong or excessive sunlight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有阴影遮蔽、不受强烈或过多阳光照射的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fid-dell u mħares minn xemx qawwija jew żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴凉的；有树阴或其他阴影遮蔽的。
受到遮蔽而不受过多阳光照射的。

formal.mt: Għall-mistrieħ ta' nofsinhar, intgħażel post delli qrib is-siġar.
formal.en: A shady place near the trees was chosen for the midday rest.
formal.zh: 午间休息地点选在了靠近树木的一处阴凉地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se noqogħdu? Pawlu: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post delli u frisk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we sit? Pawlu: Here under the tree; this spot is shady and cool.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们坐哪里？保罗：就坐这棵树下面吧，这里阴凉又凉快。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post delli u frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post delli u frisk.
messages.zh: 就坐这棵树下面吧，这里阴凉又凉快。
messages.en: Here under the tree; this spot is shady and cool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树下一张阴凉的长椅，用这个词描述地点的状态：有遮阴，不被烈日直晒。

gloss_zh: 涂抹者；把东西抹开的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who smears or spreads a substance onto a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹或抹开在表面上的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidlek xi sustanza fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹某物的人；将某种物质抹在表面上的人。

formal.mt: Fid-dimostrazzjoni, id-delliek taż-żejt wera kif jinfirex saff irqiq fuq il-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: In the demonstration, the person applying the oil showed how to spread a thin layer over the wooden surface.
formal.zh: 在演示中，涂油的人展示了如何在木头表面均匀抹上一层薄油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun id-delliek tal-krema llum? Mark: Jien! Agħtini l-krema u ndillek dahrek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to be the cream applier today? Mark: Me! Give me the cream and I'll put it on your back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁来当涂乳霜的人？马克：我来！把乳霜给我，我帮你涂背。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun id-delliek tal-krema llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun id-delliek tal-krema llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁来当涂乳霜的人？
messages.en: Who's going to be the cream applier today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Agħtini l-krema u ndillek dahrek.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Agħtini l-krema u ndillek dahrek.
messages.zh: 我来！把乳霜给我，我帮你涂背。
messages.en: Me! Give me the cream and I'll put it on your back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住手拿乳霜、正在给人涂背的那个人：这个名词指涂抹者，注意把人和涂料分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sticky to the touch, or moist rather than dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触摸起来发黏的，或带有水分而湿润的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħel mal-mess, jew li jkun niedi aktar milli niexef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏的；接触时容易黏住的。
湿润的；含有少量水分、尚未干燥的。

formal.mt: Wara li nxtered il-ġulepp, il-wiċċ tal-mejda baqa' dellieki u kellu jitnaddaf.
formal.en: After the syrup was spilled, the tabletop remained sticky and needed cleaning.
formal.zh: 糖浆洒出后，桌面一直黏黏的，需要清理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-wiċċ tal-mejda għadu dellieki? Pawlu: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu; se nnaddfu issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the tabletop still sticky? Pawlu: Some honey spilled on it; I'll clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌面怎么还黏黏的？保罗：上面洒了点蜂蜜，我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌面怎么还黏黏的？
messages.en: Why is the tabletop still sticky?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu; se nnaddfu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' ftit għasel fuqu; se nnaddfu issa.
messages.zh: 上面洒了点蜂蜜，我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: Some honey spilled on it; I'll clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用指尖触感记两个义项：摸到蜂蜜是黏，摸到未干的布是湿润；具体含义看搭配。

gloss_zh: 遮阴物；为物遮阴的人；小心照顾他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that provides shade; also a person who places something in the shade or treats others with care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供遮阴的物体；也指把东西放到阴凉处的人，或小心周到地对待他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħti d-dell; ukoll persuna li tqiegħed xi ħaġa fid-dell jew li tittratta lil ħaddieħor b'attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供遮阴的东西；遮阴物。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who puts sth. in the shade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放到阴凉处或为其遮阴的人。
小心周到地对待、照顾他人的人。

collocations.en: a person who puts plants in the shade
a person who treats children with care

formal.mt: Is-siġra kbira sservi ta' delliel naturali għall-bank tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The large tree serves as a natural source of shade for the garden bench.
formal.zh: 这棵大树为花园长椅提供天然遮阴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun id-delliel tal-pjanti llum? Mark: Jien; se npoġġi l-qsari fid-dell qabel tisħon ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to put the plants in the shade today? Mark: I will; I'll move the pots into the shade before the sun gets hot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁来把植物放到阴凉处？马克：我来，我会在太阳变晒之前把花盆搬到阴凉处。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun id-delliel tal-pjanti llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun id-delliel tal-pjanti llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁来把植物放到阴凉处？
messages.en: Who's going to put the plants in the shade today?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; se npoġġi l-qsari fid-dell qabel tisħon ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; se npoġġi l-qsari fid-dell qabel tisħon ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 我来，我会在太阳变晒之前把花盆搬到阴凉处。
messages.en: I will; I'll move the pots into the shade before the sun gets hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张卡片记忆：遮阴的大树、搬花盆到阴凉处的人、细心照顾别人的人；这是义项归纳，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object, such as a sun umbrella, used to block sunlight and provide shade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来遮挡阳光、提供阴凉的用具，如遮阳伞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett, bħal umbrella tax-xemx, li jintuża biex jilqa' x-xemx u jagħti d-dell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮阳用具；用于挡住阳光的遮阳伞等。

formal.mt: Fuq it-terrazzin tqiegħdet delliela biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu joqogħdu fid-dell.
formal.en: A sunshade was placed on the terrace so that visitors could sit in the shade.
formal.zh: 露台上设置了遮阳伞，让访客能够坐在阴凉处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tiftaħ id-delliela, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Iva, u nressaq is-siġġijiet taħtha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Could you open the sunshade, please? Pawlu: Yes, and I'll move the chairs underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：请把遮阳伞撑开，好吗？保罗：好，我再把椅子搬到伞下面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 请把遮阳伞撑开，好吗？
messages.en: Could you open the sunshade, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我再把椅子搬到伞下面。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll move the chairs underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象露台上一把撑开的遮阳伞，下面摆着两把椅子；把这个词牢牢记成遮阳用具。

gloss_zh: 提供遮阴的；细心待人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing shade, or showing care in the way one treats other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提供遮阴的；也指对待他人小心周到的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti d-dell, jew li jittratta lil ħaddieħor b'attenzjoni u ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供遮阴的；能够挡住阳光的。
对待他人小心周到的；细心照顾别人的。

collocations.en: a person who treats others with care

formal.mt: Is-saqaf dellieli jipproteġi ż-żona tal-mistrieħ mix-xemx diretta.
formal.en: The shade-providing roof protects the rest area from direct sunlight.
formal.zh: 这个能够遮阴的屋顶使休息区免受阳光直射。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Pawlu mat-tfal? Lara: Hu dellieli ħafna magħhom; jismagħhom u jgħinhom bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is Pawlu like with children? Lara: He treats them with great care; he listens to them and helps them patiently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗对孩子怎么样？拉拉：他对孩子特别细心，会听他们说话，也会耐心帮助他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 保罗对孩子怎么样？
messages.en: What is Pawlu like with children?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dellieli ħafna magħhom; jismagħhom u jgħinhom bil-paċenzja.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dellieli ħafna magħhom; jismagħhom u jgħinhom bil-paċenzja.
messages.zh: 他对孩子特别细心，会听他们说话，也会耐心帮助他们。
messages.en: He treats them with great care; he listens to them and helps them patiently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个形容画面记忆：屋顶能够遮阴，人待别人细心；本词描述性质，结合所修饰的对象选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A funnel for guiding liquid into a narrow opening; in another sense, a wooden pail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体导入狭小开口的漏斗；另一义项指木制提桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tiggwida likwidu għal ġo fetħa dejqa; f'tifsira oħra, barmil tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漏斗；用于把液体等导入较小开口的器具。
木制提桶；用于盛装或提运液体等的木桶。

formal.mt: Biex iż-żejt jidħol fil-flixkun mingħajr ma jinxtered, għandu jintuża delu.
formal.en: A funnel should be used to transfer the oil into the bottle without spilling it.
formal.zh: 应使用漏斗把油倒入瓶中，以免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek delu? Il-fetħa tal-flixkun żgħira wisq. Maja: Iva, hawn wieħed; żommu waqt li nferra' l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a funnel? The bottle opening is too small. Maja: Yes, here's one; hold it while I pour the water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有漏斗吗？瓶口太小了。玛雅：有，这里有一个；我倒水的时候你扶住它。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek delu? Il-fetħa tal-flixkun żgħira wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek delu? Il-fetħa tal-flixkun żgħira wisq.
messages.zh: 你有漏斗吗？瓶口太小了。
messages.en: Do you have a funnel? The bottle opening is too small.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed; żommu waqt li nferra' l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed; żommu waqt li nferra' l-ilma.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个；我倒水的时候你扶住它。
messages.en: Yes, here's one; hold it while I pour the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成两件器具：细嘴导流的是漏斗，木板围成可盛水的是木桶；借瓶口和木材语境辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on a false belief held despite clear evidence against it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基于错误信念的，即使有明确的相反证据仍坚持相信的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibbażat fuq twemmin falz li jibqa' jinżamm minkejja evidenza ċara kontrih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妄想的；基于与事实不符、且面对相反证据仍坚持的信念的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru għandu twemmin delużjonali li kulħadd jista' jaqra ħsibijietu.
formal.en: In the novel, the character has a delusional belief that everyone can read his thoughts.
formal.zh: 小说中的人物抱有一种妄想性信念，认为所有人都能读懂他的思想。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kritiku jsejjaħ it-twemmin tal-karattru delużjonali? Mark: Għax jibqa' jemmen li kulħadd qed isegwih, minkejja l-evidenza li turi l-kuntrarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the critic call the character's belief delusional? Mark: Because he keeps believing that everyone is following him, despite evidence showing otherwise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：评论家为什么说这个人物的信念是妄想性的？马克：因为尽管证据表明并非如此，他仍相信所有人都在跟踪他。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kritiku jsejjaħ it-twemmin tal-karattru delużjonali?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kritiku jsejjaħ it-twemmin tal-karattru delużjonali?
messages.zh: 评论家为什么说这个人物的信念是妄想性的？
messages.en: Why does the critic call the character's belief delusional?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jibqa' jemmen li kulħadd qed isegwih, minkejja l-evidenza li turi l-kuntrarju.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jibqa' jemmen li kulħadd qed isegwih, minkejja l-evidenza li turi l-kuntrarju.
messages.zh: 因为尽管证据表明并非如此，他仍相信所有人都在跟踪他。
messages.en: Because he keeps believing that everyone is following him, despite evidence showing otherwise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说人物面对反证仍紧抱错误信念，用这个画面记住“妄想的”，并与普通的猜错区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A false belief held despite evidence against it; also, disappointment when hopes are not fulfilled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对相反证据仍坚持的错误信念；也指希望落空时的失望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin falz li jibqa' jinżamm minkejja evidenza kontrih; ukoll diżappunt meta t-tamiet ma jitwettqux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妄想，即与事实不符而仍坚信的观念；失望，即期望未能实现时的感受。

formal.mt: Il-kanċellazzjoni tal-kunċert kienet delużjoni kbira għal dawk li kienu xtraw il-biljetti.
formal.en: The cancellation of the concert was a great disappointment to those who had bought tickets.
formal.zh: 音乐会取消，让已经购票的人大失所望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien il-film li kont qed tistenna? Paul: Kien delużjoni kbira; l-istorja ma kienet interessanti xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the film you were looking forward to? Paul: It was a great disappointment; the story wasn't interesting at all.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你一直期待的那部电影怎么样？保罗：太令人失望了，故事一点也不有趣。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-film li kont qed tistenna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-film li kont qed tistenna?
messages.zh: 你一直期待的那部电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film you were looking forward to?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien delużjoni kbira; l-istorja ma kienet interessanti xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Kien delużjoni kbira; l-istorja ma kienet interessanti xejn.
messages.zh: 太令人失望了，故事一点也不有趣。
messages.en: It was a great disappointment; the story wasn't interesting at all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画面记忆：错误信念牢牢不放是“妄想”，期待的电影不好看是“失望”；依语境选择。

gloss_zh: 蛊惑民众的政客；煽动家

teaching_sense.en_definition: A political leader or speaker who gains support by exploiting people's emotions and prejudices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过利用民众的情绪和偏见来获取支持的政治领袖或演说者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxej politiku jew kelliem li jikseb appoġġ billi jisfrutta l-emozzjonijiet u l-preġudizzji tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛊惑民众的政客或演说者；靠煽动情绪、迎合偏见争取支持的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-demagogu jikseb il-fiduċja tal-folla billi jisfrutta l-biżgħat tagħha.
formal.en: In the novel, the demagogue gains the crowd's trust by exploiting its fears.
formal.zh: 小说中，这名煽动家利用人群的恐惧来赢取他们的信任。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-ktieb isejjaħlu demagogu? Joseph: Għax jisfrutta l-preġudizzji tan-nies biex jikseb l-appoġġ tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does the book call him a demagogue? Joseph: Because he exploits people's prejudices to gain their support.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这本书为什么称他为煽动家？约瑟夫：因为他利用人们的偏见来获取他们的支持。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书为什么称他为煽动家？
messages.en: Why does the book call him a demagogue?

messages.speaker: Joseph (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jisfrutta l-preġudizzji tan-nies biex jikseb l-appoġġ tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jisfrutta l-preġudizzji tan-nies biex jikseb l-appoġġ tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为他利用人们的偏见来获取他们的支持。
messages.en: Because he exploits people's prejudices to gain their support.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人、做法、性质”三格记忆：本词放在“人”那一格，指站在台上利用情绪拉拢群众的煽动家。

gloss_zh: 蛊惑民众的政治手法；煽动民心

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of gaining political support by exploiting people's emotions and prejudices rather than presenting reasoned arguments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用民众的情绪和偏见争取政治支持，而不是提出理性论据的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li jinkiseb appoġġ politiku billi jiġu sfruttati l-emozzjonijiet u l-preġudizzji tan-nies minflok ma jingħataw argumenti raġunati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛊惑民众的政治手法；利用公众情绪、偏见或恐惧谋取支持的做法。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jikkritika d-demagoġija fil-kampanja elettorali u jitlob dibattitu bbażat fuq il-fatti.
formal.en: The article criticizes demagoguery in the election campaign and calls for a debate based on facts.
formal.zh: 文章批评竞选活动中蛊惑民众的手法，并呼吁开展以事实为依据的辩论。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma għoġbokx id-diskors? David: Għax kien mimli demagoġija: ħafna biża' u rabja, imma ftit fatti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't you like the speech? David: Because it was full of demagoguery: lots of fear and anger, but few facts.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不喜欢那场演讲？戴维：因为里面满是蛊惑人心的话，恐惧和愤怒很多，事实却很少。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢那场演讲？
messages.en: Why didn't you like the speech?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien mimli demagoġija: ħafna biża' u rabja, imma ftit fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien mimli demagoġija: ħafna biża' u rabja, imma ftit fatti.
messages.zh: 因为里面满是蛊惑人心的话，恐惧和愤怒很多，事实却很少。
messages.en: Because it was full of demagoguery: lots of fear and anger, but few facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演讲台上的人不断挑动恐惧与愤怒，却拿不出事实；这个“靠情绪拉支持”的做法就是本词。

gloss_zh: 蛊惑民众的；煽动民心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seeking political support by exploiting public emotions and prejudices rather than using reasoned arguments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用公众情绪和偏见，而非理性论据来争取政治支持的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jfittex appoġġ politiku billi jisfrutta l-emozzjonijiet u l-preġudizzji tal-pubbliku minflok juża argumenti raġunati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛊惑民众的；通过煽动公众情绪或迎合偏见来谋取支持的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi d-diskors bħala demagoġiku għax jisfrutta l-biża' tal-pubbliku mingħajr ma jippreżenta evidenza.
formal.en: The author describes the speech as demagogic because it exploits public fear without presenting evidence.
formal.zh: 作者将这场演讲描述为蛊惑民众的演讲，因为它利用公众的恐惧，却不提供证据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-diskors jidher demagoġiku. Simon: Naqbel; qed jipprova jqanqal ir-rabja minflok jispjega l-proposta.
colloquial.en: Lara: This speech seems demagogic. Simon: I agree; he's trying to stir up anger instead of explaining the proposal.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这场演讲听起来是在蛊惑民众。西蒙：我同意，他在试图煽动愤怒，而不是解释提案。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这场演讲听起来是在蛊惑民众。
messages.en: This speech seems demagogic.

messages.speaker: Simon (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel; qed jipprova jqanqal ir-rabja minflok jispjega l-proposta.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel; qed jipprova jqanqal ir-rabja minflok jispjega l-proposta.
messages.zh: 我同意，他在试图煽动愤怒，而不是解释提案。
messages.en: I agree; he's trying to stir up anger instead of explaining the proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词当作贴在“演讲”上的形容词标签：只顾煽动情绪、缺少论据的演讲，可以用它来描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of establishing or marking a boundary between areas, responsibilities, or categories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定或标示区域、职责或类别之间界限的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istabbiliment jew l-immarkar ta' konfini bejn żoni, responsabbiltajiet jew kategoriji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划界；界限或范围的划定，可指地理边界，也可指职责等抽象界限。

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri linja ta' demarkazzjoni bejn iż-żona residenzjali u ż-żona industrijali.
formal.en: The plan shows a demarcation line between the residential area and the industrial area.
formal.zh: 规划图标明了住宅区与工业区之间的分界线。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-linja ħamra fuq il-mappa xi tfisser? Karl: Hija linja ta' demarkazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ żoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does this red line on the map mean? Karl: It's a demarcation line between the two areas.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：地图上这条红线是什么意思？卡尔：这是两个区域之间的分界线。

messages.speaker: Marta (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-linja ħamra fuq il-mappa xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-linja ħamra fuq il-mappa xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 地图上这条红线是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this red line on the map mean?

messages.speaker: Karl (规划人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija linja ta' demarkazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ żoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hija linja ta' demarkazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ żoni.
messages.zh: 这是两个区域之间的分界线。
messages.en: It's a demarcation line between the two areas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿红笔在地图上划出两区边界，再把这条线移到职责表上，就能同时记住具体划界和抽象分工。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drop of clear, salty liquid that comes from an eye, for example when someone cries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从眼睛流出的一滴透明、带咸味的液体，例如哭泣时的泪珠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatra ta' likwidu ċar u mielaħ li toħroġ minn għajn, pereżempju meta persuna tibki.

sense_translations.en_definition: tear (drop of clear salty liquid from the eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼泪；从眼睛流出的一滴透明、带咸味的液体。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, niżlet demgħa ta' ferħ fuq ħaddejn l-omm.
formal.en: During the ceremony, a tear of joy rolled down the mother's cheek.
formal.zh: 仪式进行时，一滴喜悦的泪水顺着母亲的脸颊流下。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandek demgħa fuq ħaddek. Qed tibki? Marija: Iva, imma bil-ferħ! Għadni kif smajt l-aħbar it-tajba.
colloquial.en: Lina: You've got a tear on your cheek. Are you crying? Marija: Yes, but with joy! I've just heard the good news.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你脸颊上有一滴眼泪。你在哭吗？玛丽娅：是啊，不过是高兴的！我刚听到那个好消息。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek demgħa fuq ħaddek. Qed tibki?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek demgħa fuq ħaddek. Qed tibki?
messages.zh: 你脸颊上有一滴眼泪。你在哭吗？
messages.en: You've got a tear on your cheek. Are you crying?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bil-ferħ! Għadni kif smajt l-aħbar it-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bil-ferħ! Għadni kif smajt l-aħbar it-tajba.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过是高兴的！我刚听到那个好消息。
messages.en: Yes, but with joy! I've just heard the good news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一颗沿脸颊滑落的泪珠来记：它指一滴眼泪，既可以因悲伤流下，也可以因喜悦流下。

gloss_zh: 非军事化；解除军事部署

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of removing military forces, weapons, or installations from an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某一区域撤除军队、武器或军事设施，使其非军事化的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tneħħija ta' forzi militari, armi jew installazzjonijiet militari minn żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非军事化；从某一区域撤除军队、武器或军事设施的过程。

formal.mt: L-abbozz tal-ftehim jipprevedi d-demilitarizzazzjoni taż-żona permezz tal-irtirar tat-truppi u t-tneħħija tal-armi.
formal.en: The draft agreement provides for the demilitarization of the area through the withdrawal of troops and the removal of weapons.
formal.zh: 协议草案规定，通过撤军和撤除武器实现该区域的非军事化。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi tfisser id-demilitarizzazzjoni taż-żona f'dan it-test? Daniel: Tfisser li jitneħħew it-truppi, l-armi u l-installazzjonijiet militari minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does demilitarization of the area mean in this text? Daniel: It means that troops, weapons, and military installations are removed from there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这篇文章里说的区域非军事化是什么意思？丹尼尔：就是从那里撤除军队、武器和军事设施。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser id-demilitarizzazzjoni taż-żona f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser id-demilitarizzazzjoni taż-żona f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里说的区域非军事化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does demilitarization of the area mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li jitneħħew it-truppi, l-armi u l-installazzjonijiet militari minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li jitneħħew it-truppi, l-armi u l-installazzjonijiet militari minn hemm.
messages.zh: 就是从那里撤除军队、武器和军事设施。
messages.en: It means that troops, weapons, and military installations are removed from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的士兵、武器和军事设施图标逐一被移走；把这个撤除军事部署的过程与“非军事化”对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shed tears; also, of a vine, to exude sap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流出眼泪；也指葡萄藤渗出汁液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ id-dmugħ mill-għajnejn; jingħad ukoll għal dielja li toħroġ il-meraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流泪；流出眼泪。
（指葡萄藤）渗出汁液。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-missier demma' bil-ferħ meta sema' isem bintu.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the father shed tears of joy when he heard his daughter's name.
formal.zh: 典礼上，父亲听到女儿的名字时，流下了喜悦的眼泪。

colloquial.mt: Marija: In-nannu demma' meta ra r-ritratt? Pawlu: Iva, ftakar f'kemm kienu ferħanin dakinhar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Grandpa shed tears when he saw the photo? Pawlu: Yes, he remembered how happy they were that day.
colloquial.zh: Marija：爷爷看到照片时流泪了吗？Pawlu：是啊，他想起了他们那天有多开心。

messages.speaker: Marija (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷看到照片时流泪了吗？
messages.en: Did Grandpa shed tears when he saw the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftakar f'kemm kienu ferħanin dakinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftakar f'kemm kienu ferħanin dakinhar.
messages.zh: 是啊，他想起了他们那天有多开心。
messages.en: Yes, he remembered how happy they were that day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demma' 配上两幅画来记：人眼流泪、葡萄藤渗汁；共同画面是液体向外流出，但要分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 给食物调味，尤指给酱汁调味

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add ingredients that improve the flavour of food, especially a sauce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入调味料，使食物尤其是酱汁的味道更好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid ħwawar jew ingredjenti oħra biex jagħti togħma tajba lill-ikel, speċjalment liz-zlazi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to season (used of food, especially sauces)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给食物调味，尤其指给酱汁添加调味料。

formal.mt: Il-kok demmes iz-zalza bil-melħ, bil-bżar u bi ftit ħabaq qabel servieha.
formal.en: The chef seasoned the sauce with salt, pepper and a little basil before serving it.
formal.zh: 厨师在上桌前，用盐、胡椒和少量罗勒给酱汁调了味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min demmes iz-zalza? Mark: Jien, żidt ftit bżar u ħabaq frisk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who seasoned the sauce? Mark: I did; I added a little pepper and fresh basil.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁给酱汁调的味？Mark：我，加了点胡椒和新鲜罗勒。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁给酱汁调的味？
messages.en: Who seasoned the sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, żidt ftit bżar u ħabaq frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, żidt ftit bżar u ħabaq frisk.
messages.zh: 我，加了点胡椒和新鲜罗勒。
messages.en: I did; I added a little pepper and fresh basil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 demmes 时想象厨师尝一口酱汁，再撒入香料；把它和“动手调味”这一动作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seasons food by adding ingredients to improve its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加入调味料来改善食物味道的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżid ħwawar jew ingredjenti oħra mal-ikel biex tagħtih togħma tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给食物调味的人。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju tat-tisjir, id-demmies għandu jduq l-ikel qabel iżid aktar melħ.
formal.en: In this cooking exercise, the person seasoning the food should taste it before adding more salt.
formal.zh: 在这项烹饪练习中，负责调味的人应先尝食物，再决定是否加盐。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jkun id-demmies illum? Toni: Jien! Int ħawwad iz-zalza u jien nieħu ħsieb it-togħma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who's going to season the food today? Toni: I am! You stir the sauce, and I'll take care of the flavour.
colloquial.zh: Nina：今天谁来负责调味？Toni：我来！你搅拌酱汁，我负责调味。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天谁来负责调味？
messages.en: Who's going to season the food today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Int ħawwad iz-zalza u jien nieħu ħsieb it-togħma.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Int ħawwad iz-zalza u jien nieħu ħsieb it-togħma.
messages.zh: 我来！你搅拌酱汁，我负责调味。
messages.en: I am! You stir the sauce, and I'll take care of the flavour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 demmies 画一张人物卡：一手拿勺、一手拿香料。看到这个词先想到“调味的人”，记牢它是名词。

gloss_zh: 能使食物味道好的；有助于调出好味道的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to give food a pleasant flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使食物产生好味道的倾向或特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħti togħma tajba lill-ikel.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to give food a good taste
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使食物味道变好的特性或倾向。

collocations.en: an ingredient that gives food a good flavour
collocations.zh: 能使食物增添好味道的食材

collocations.en: spices that give food a good flavour
collocations.zh: 能给食物增添好味道的香料

formal.mt: Il-ħabaq huwa ingredjent demmiesi li jagħti togħma tajba liz-zalza tat-tadam.
formal.en: Basil is a flavour-enhancing ingredient that gives tomato sauce a pleasant taste.
formal.zh: 罗勒是一种能增添好味道的食材，可以使番茄酱汁更可口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħabaq demmiesi ħafna! Luka: Veru, ftit minnu jagħti togħma tajba liz-zalza kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: This basil really adds a lovely flavour! Luka: True, a little of it makes the whole sauce taste good.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这罗勒真能提味！Luka：确实，加一点就能让整份酱汁都变好吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这罗勒真能提味！
messages.en: This basil really adds a lovely flavour!

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ftit minnu jagħti togħma tajba liz-zalza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ftit minnu jagħti togħma tajba liz-zalza kollha.
messages.zh: 确实，加一点就能让整份酱汁都变好吃。
messages.en: True, a little of it makes the whole sauce taste good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demmiesi 写在香料罐旁，配上“能让菜更好吃”的标签；用这一性质画面记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a democratic way, allowing people to participate in making a choice or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以民主方式进行，让相关人员参与选择或决策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod demokratiku, billi n-nies ikollhom sehem fl-għażla jew fid-deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民主地；以民主方式。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tal-istudenti ntgħażel demokratikament permezz ta' vot sigriet.
formal.en: The student representative was chosen democratically through a secret ballot.
formal.zh: 学生代表通过无记名投票，以民主方式选出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nagħżlu fejn immorru? Ben: Nagħżlu demokratikament: kulħadd jagħti l-opinjoni tiegħu u mbagħad nivvutaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to choose where to go? Ben: We'll choose democratically: everyone gives their opinion, and then we vote.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们怎么决定去哪儿？Ben：用民主的方式选：大家先发表意见，然后投票。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们怎么决定去哪儿？
messages.en: How are we going to choose where to go?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħżlu demokratikament: kulħadd jagħti l-opinjoni tiegħu u mbagħad nivvutaw.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħżlu demokratikament: kulħadd jagħti l-opinjoni tiegħu u mbagħad nivvutaw.
messages.zh: 用民主的方式选：大家先发表意见，然后投票。
messages.en: We'll choose democratically: everyone gives their opinion, and then we vote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大家发言，再来投票”的场景记 demokratikament；它回答的是“怎样作决定”，所以按副词记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a system or institution more democratic by increasing people's participation in decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过扩大人们参与决策的机会，使制度或机构更加民主的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih sistema jew istituzzjoni ssir aktar demokratika u n-nies ikollhom aktar sehem fid-deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民主化；使制度或机构变得更加民主的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-demokratizzazzjoni tal-istituzzjoni permezz ta' parteċipazzjoni usa' tal-membri fid-deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: The report describes the democratization of the institution through broader member participation in decisions.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该机构如何通过扩大成员的决策参与来推进民主化。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'tfisser demokratizzazzjoni fil-każ tal-klabb tagħna? Samwel: Li aktar membri jkollhom vuċi fid-deċiżjonijiet, mhux biss il-kumitat.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does democratization mean for our club? Samwel: That more members have a say in decisions, beyond just the committee.
colloquial.zh: Elena：民主化对我们俱乐部来说是什么意思？Samwel：就是让更多成员在决策中有发言权，而不只是委员会。

messages.speaker: Elena (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 民主化对我们俱乐部来说是什么意思？
messages.en: What does democratization mean for our club?

messages.speaker: Samwel (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Li aktar membri jkollhom vuċi fid-deċiżjonijiet, mhux biss il-kumitat.
messages.mt_standard: Li aktar membri jkollhom vuċi fid-deċiżjonijiet, mhux biss il-kumitat.
messages.zh: 就是让更多成员在决策中有发言权，而不只是委员会。
messages.en: That more members have a say in decisions, beyond just the committee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌边的座位逐渐增加，更多人能够参与决定；用这个变化过程记 demokratizzazzjoni 的“民主化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of tearing down a building or another structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆除或拆毁建筑物及其他构筑物的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twaqqigħ ta' bini jew ta' struttura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆除；拆毁建筑物或其他构筑物。

formal.mt: Id-demolizzjoni tal-bini l-antik se tibda wara li titlesta l-ispezzjoni tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: Demolition of the old building will begin after the safety inspection is completed.
formal.zh: 旧楼的拆除将在安全检查完成后开始。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għalqu t-triq? Ġorġ: Minħabba d-demolizzjoni tal-garaxx; illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did they close the road? Ġorġ: Because of the garage demolition; today we need to take another road.
colloquial.zh: Rita：为什么封路了？Ġorġ：因为要拆车库，今天我们得绕另一条路。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 为什么封路了？
messages.en: Why did they close the road?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-demolizzjoni tal-garaxx; illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-demolizzjoni tal-garaxx; illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 因为要拆车库，今天我们得绕另一条路。
messages.en: Because of the garage demolition; today we need to take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 demolizzjoni 配上旧楼被逐步拆除的画面，再联想工地上的拆除工程告示，记住它表示拆除这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loss of confidence, hope or enthusiasm, or the process that causes such a loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信心、希望或热情的丧失，也指使人产生这种低落状态的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-telf tal-fiduċja, tat-tama jew tal-ħeġġa, jew il-proċess li jwassal għal dan it-telf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 士气受挫、信心或热情的丧失；使人灰心丧气的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li n-nuqqas ta' appoġġ wassal għal demoralizzazzjoni fost il-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report indicates that a lack of support led to demoralization among the workers.
formal.zh: 报告指出，缺乏支持导致员工士气低落。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hemm sens ta' demoralizzazzjoni fit-tim wara t-telfa. David: Iva, ejja nitkellmu dwar dak li mar tajjeb u nibdew mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Anna: There's a feeling of demoralization in the team after the defeat. David: Yes, let's talk about what went well and start again.
colloquial.zh: Anna：输掉比赛后，队里有些灰心丧气。David：是啊，我们聊聊表现好的地方，再重新开始吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm sens ta' demoralizzazzjoni fit-tim wara t-telfa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm sens ta' demoralizzazzjoni fit-tim wara t-telfa.
messages.zh: 输掉比赛后，队里有些灰心丧气。
messages.en: There's a feeling of demoralization in the team after the defeat.

messages.speaker: David (队长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nitkellmu dwar dak li mar tajjeb u nibdew mill-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nitkellmu dwar dak li mar tajjeb u nibdew mill-ġdid.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们聊聊表现好的地方，再重新开始吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's talk about what went well and start again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demoralizzazzjoni 想象成团队的士气电量下降：原本充满干劲，受挫后失去信心；用“士气掉电”记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A den used by a wild animal, or an underground prison; the intended meaning depends on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指野兽栖身的洞穴，也可指地下牢狱；具体含义须根据上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jgħix jew jistkenn annimal selvaġġ, jew ħabs taħt l-art; it-tifsira tiddependi mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野兽居住或藏身的洞穴。
设在地下、用于关押囚犯的牢狱。

collocations.en: a prisoner in the underground prison

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-priġunier qatta' l-lejl fid-demus taħt il-kastell.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner spent the night in the underground prison beneath the castle.
formal.zh: 在故事中，囚犯在城堡下方的地下牢狱里度过了一夜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser demus f'din is-sentenza dwar annimal selvaġġ? Pawlu: Hawnhekk ifisser il-post fejn jgħix jew jistkenn l-annimal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does demus mean in this sentence about a wild animal? Pawlu: Here it means the place where the animal lives or shelters.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句讲野兽的话里，demus 是什么意思？保罗：这里指动物居住或藏身的洞穴。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser demus f'din is-sentenza dwar annimal selvaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser demus f'din is-sentenza dwar annimal selvaġġ?
messages.zh: 这句讲野兽的话里，demus 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does demus mean in this sentence about a wild animal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser il-post fejn jgħix jew jistkenn l-annimal.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser il-post fejn jgħix jew jistkenn l-annimal.
messages.zh: 这里指动物居住或藏身的洞穴。
messages.en: Here it means the place where the animal lives or shelters.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demus 配成两张画面卡：野兽钻进洞穴，囚犯关在地下牢房；阅读时用句中的动物或囚犯来选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called African amaranth, identified by the scientific name Amaranthus muricatus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称作非洲苋的植物，学名为 Amaranthus muricatus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus muricatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非洲苋，学名 Amaranthus muricatus。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, denb id-dib Afrikan jidher bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus muricatus.
formal.en: In the plant list, African amaranth appears under the scientific name Amaranthus muricatus.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，非洲苋列于学名 Amaranthus muricatus 之下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Mark: Denb id-dib Afrikan. Fuq it-tikketta hemm Amaranthus muricatus.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant in the photograph called? Mark: African amaranth. The label says Amaranthus muricatus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这株植物叫什么？马克：非洲苋。标签上写着 Amaranthus muricatus。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Denb id-dib Afrikan. Fuq it-tikketta hemm Amaranthus muricatus.
messages.mt_standard: Denb id-dib Afrikan. Fuq it-tikketta hemm Amaranthus muricatus.
messages.zh: 非洲苋。标签上写着 Amaranthus muricatus。
messages.en: African amaranth. The label says Amaranthus muricatus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三栏词卡：denb id-dib Afrikan、非洲苋、Amaranthus muricatus；把 Afrikan 当作名称中的识别提示，不据此推断植物产地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant Amaranthus hybridus, called green amaranth in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Amaranthus hybridus、英语称为 green amaranth 的苋属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta tal-ġeneru Amaranthus, bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus hybridus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿苋，此处特指 Amaranthus hybridus。

collocations.en: a specimen of green amaranth (Amaranthus hybridus)

collocations.mt: l-isem xjentifiku ta' denb id-dib bagħal
collocations.en: the scientific name of green amaranth (Amaranthus hybridus)

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-kampjun tagħti żewġ ismijiet: denb id-dib bagħal u Amaranthus hybridus.
formal.en: The specimen label gives two names: denb id-dib bagħal and Amaranthus hybridus.
formal.zh: 标本标签给出两个名称：denb id-dib bagħal 和 Amaranthus hybridus。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema isem xjentifiku nikteb ħdejn denb id-dib bagħal? Pawlu: Ikteb Amaranthus hybridus, biex ikun ċar liema speċi qed insemmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which scientific name should I write next to denb id-dib bagħal? Pawlu: Write Amaranthus hybridus, so it is clear which species we mean.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：denb id-dib bagħal 旁边该写哪个学名？保罗：写 Amaranthus hybridus，这样就能明确我们说的是哪个物种。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema isem xjentifiku nikteb ħdejn denb id-dib bagħal?
messages.mt_standard: Liema isem xjentifiku nikteb ħdejn denb id-dib bagħal?
messages.zh: denb id-dib bagħal 旁边该写哪个学名？
messages.en: Which scientific name should I write next to denb id-dib bagħal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb Amaranthus hybridus, biex ikun ċar liema speċi qed insemmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb Amaranthus hybridus, biex ikun ċar liema speċi qed insemmu.
messages.zh: 写 Amaranthus hybridus，这样就能明确我们说的是哪个物种。
messages.en: Write Amaranthus hybridus, so it is clear which species we mean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħal 与 hybridus 固定配对背诵：本条虽译作绿苋，仍要用学名区分另一条同样叫 green amaranth 的词。

gloss_zh: 尾穗苋（Amaranthus caudatus）；大果苋（Amaranthus deflexus）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant name used for either love-lies-bleeding (Amaranthus caudatus) or large-fruit amaranth (Amaranthus deflexus); the scientific name distinguishes the two senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个可指尾穗苋（Amaranthus caudatus），也可指大果苋（Amaranthus deflexus）的植物名称；须借助学名区分这两个义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jista' jirreferi għal Amaranthus caudatus jew għal Amaranthus deflexus; l-isem xjentifiku jiddistingwi ż-żewġ tifsiriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尾穗苋，学名 Amaranthus caudatus。
大果苋，学名 Amaranthus deflexus。

collocations.mt: denb id-dib lixx bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus caudatus
collocations.en: denb id-dib lixx identified as Amaranthus caudatus, or love-lies-bleeding
collocations.zh: 以学名 Amaranthus caudatus 标明的 denb id-dib lixx，即尾穗苋

collocations.mt: denb id-dib lixx bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus deflexus
collocations.en: denb id-dib lixx identified as Amaranthus deflexus, or large-fruit amaranth
collocations.zh: 以学名 Amaranthus deflexus 标明的 denb id-dib lixx，即大果苋

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, denb id-dib lixx jirreferi għal Amaranthus caudatus; l-isem xjentifiku jagħmel it-tifsira ċara.
formal.en: In this list, denb id-dib lixx refers to Amaranthus caudatus; the scientific name makes the meaning clear.
formal.zh: 在这份名录中，denb id-dib lixx 指 Amaranthus caudatus；学名明确了此处的词义。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fuq din il-karta hemm denb id-dib lixx. Ifisser Amaranthus caudatus? Nina: Hawnhekk le. Taħtu hemm miktub Amaranthus deflexus.
colloquial.en: Mark: This card says denb id-dib lixx. Does it mean Amaranthus caudatus? Nina: Not here. Underneath it says Amaranthus deflexus.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张卡写着 denb id-dib lixx。指的是 Amaranthus caudatus 吗？妮娜：这里不是。下面写着 Amaranthus deflexus。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din il-karta hemm denb id-dib lixx. Ifisser Amaranthus caudatus?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din il-karta hemm denb id-dib lixx. Ifisser Amaranthus caudatus?
messages.zh: 这张卡写着 denb id-dib lixx。指的是 Amaranthus caudatus 吗？
messages.en: This card says denb id-dib lixx. Does it mean Amaranthus caudatus?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk le. Taħtu hemm miktub Amaranthus deflexus.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk le. Taħtu hemm miktub Amaranthus deflexus.
messages.zh: 这里不是。下面写着 Amaranthus deflexus。
messages.en: Not here. Underneath it says Amaranthus deflexus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lixx 词卡画成两个分支：caudatus 连尾穗苋，deflexus 连大果苋；看到这个共同名称，先查学名再选中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called edible amaranth, identified by the scientific name Amaranthus tricolor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称作食用苋或三色苋的植物，学名为 Amaranthus tricolor。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta li tittiekel, magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus tricolor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食用苋，即三色苋，学名 Amaranthus tricolor。

collocations.mt: żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri
pjanta ta' denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu taż-żerriegħa, denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus tricolor.
formal.en: In the seed catalogue, edible amaranth is listed under the scientific name Amaranthus tricolor.
formal.zh: 在种子目录中，食用苋列于学名 Amaranthus tricolor 之下。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri? Lara: Iva, ara dan il-pakkett. Fuqu hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus tricolor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have seeds of edible amaranth? Lara: Yes, look at this packet. It also has the name Amaranthus tricolor on it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有食用苋的种子吗？拉拉：有，看看这包。上面也写着 Amaranthus tricolor。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib ta' tliet kuluri?
messages.zh: 你们有食用苋的种子吗？
messages.en: Do you have seeds of edible amaranth?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara dan il-pakkett. Fuqu hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus tricolor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara dan il-pakkett. Fuqu hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus tricolor.
messages.zh: 有，看看这包。上面也写着 Amaranthus tricolor。
messages.en: Yes, look at this packet. It also has the name Amaranthus tricolor on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三种颜色写下 tliet kuluri，帮助记住名称中的“三种颜色”；再把整条名称与食用苋、Amaranthus tricolor 一起复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called purple amaranth, identified by the scientific name Amaranthus blitum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称作紫苋的植物，学名为 Amaranthus blitum。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus blitum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紫苋，学名 Amaranthus blitum。

formal.mt: Għall-wirja tal-klassi, kull kampjun ta' denb id-dib tal-qsari għandu tikketta bl-isem Amaranthus blitum.
formal.en: For the class exhibition, each purple amaranth specimen has a label bearing the name Amaranthus blitum.
formal.zh: 在班级展览中，每份紫苋标本都附有写着 Amaranthus blitum 的标签。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-tikketta ta' denb id-dib tal-qsari fejn inpoġġiha? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-kampjun li għandu l-isem Amaranthus blitum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put this purple amaranth label? Pawlu: Next to the specimen named Amaranthus blitum.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张紫苋标签该放在哪里？保罗：放在标有 Amaranthus blitum 的标本旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tikketta ta' denb id-dib tal-qsari fejn inpoġġiha?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tikketta ta' denb id-dib tal-qsari fejn inpoġġiha?
messages.zh: 这张紫苋标签该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this purple amaranth label?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-kampjun li għandu l-isem Amaranthus blitum.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-kampjun li għandu l-isem Amaranthus blitum.
messages.zh: 放在标有 Amaranthus blitum 的标本旁边。
messages.en: Next to the specimen named Amaranthus blitum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tal-qsari、紫苋和 blitum 写在同一张紫色词卡上；颜色只是学习提示，认词时仍以完整名称与学名的配对为准。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called mat amaranth, identified by the scientific name Amaranthus blitoides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英语称为 mat amaranth 的铺地苋，学名为 Amaranthus blitoides。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus blitoides.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺地苋，学名 Amaranthus blitoides。

collocations.mt: ritratt ta' denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani
l-identifikazzjoni ta' denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-lezzjoni, ir-ritratt ta' denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani jidher ħdejn l-isem Amaranthus blitoides.
formal.en: In the lesson report, the photograph of mat amaranth appears beside the name Amaranthus blitoides.
formal.zh: 在课堂报告中，铺地苋的照片旁标有名称 Amaranthus blitoides。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif niftakar l-isem twil denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani? Maja: Aqsam il-frażi f'żewġ partijiet u għaqqadha ma' Amaranthus blitoides fuq il-karta.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I remember the long name denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani? Maja: Split the phrase into two parts and pair it with Amaranthus blitoides on the card.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani 这个长名称怎么记？玛雅：把短语分成两部分，再在卡片上把它和 Amaranthus blitoides 配在一起。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niftakar l-isem twil denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar l-isem twil denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani?
messages.zh: denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani 这个长名称怎么记？
messages.en: How can I remember the long name denb id-dib tal-ward ħamrani?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqsam il-frażi f'żewġ partijiet u għaqqadha ma' Amaranthus blitoides fuq il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Aqsam il-frażi f'żewġ partijiet u għaqqadha ma' Amaranthus blitoides fuq il-karta.
messages.zh: 把短语分成两部分，再在卡片上把它和 Amaranthus blitoides 配在一起。
messages.en: Split the phrase into two parts and pair it with Amaranthus blitoides on the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按 denb id-dib / tal-ward ħamrani 两段朗读，再配对铺地苋与 blitoides；特别比较 blitoides 和上一条 blitum 的不同拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Amaranthus tricolor, also called edible amaranth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指三色苋这一植物，学名为 Amaranthus tricolor，也称食用苋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Amaranthus tricolor, magħrufa wkoll bħala amarant li jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食用苋；三色苋，学名为 Amaranthus tricolor。

collocations.mt: żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola kbir
weraq ta' denb id-dib vjola kbir

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-pjanti, denb id-dib vjola kbir huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus tricolor.
formal.en: In the plant catalogue, edible amaranth is listed under the scientific name Amaranthus tricolor.
formal.zh: 在植物目录中，三色苋以学名 Amaranthus tricolor 列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dan il-pakkett? Toni: Żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola kbir. Maja: Mela se niktbu Amaranthus tricolor fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in this packet? Toni: Edible amaranth seeds. Maja: Then we'll write Amaranthus tricolor on the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个小袋里是什么？托尼：三色苋的种子。玛雅：那我们就在标签上写 Amaranthus tricolor。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这个小袋里是什么？
messages.en: What's in this packet?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola kbir.
messages.zh: 三色苋的种子。
messages.en: Edible amaranth seeds.

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se niktbu Amaranthus tricolor fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se niktbu Amaranthus tricolor fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 那我们就在标签上写 Amaranthus tricolor。
messages.en: Then we'll write Amaranthus tricolor on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整词组与“三色苋—Amaranthus tricolor”做成同一张词卡；特别圈出结尾 kbir，帮助区分另一条以 żgħir 结尾的植物名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Amaranthus cruentus, commonly called red amaranth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指称作红苋的植物，学名为 Amaranthus cruentus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Amaranthus cruentus, magħrufa wkoll bħala amarant aħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红苋，学名为 Amaranthus cruentus。

collocations.mt: żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola żgħir
ritratt ta' denb id-dib vjola żgħir

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem Amaranthus cruentus għall-pjanta magħrufa bħala denb id-dib vjola żgħir.
formal.en: The guide gives the name Amaranthus cruentus for the plant known as red amaranth.
formal.zh: 指南将这种称为红苋的植物标注为 Amaranthus cruentus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din hi żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola żgħir? Mark: Iva, ara l-isem Amaranthus cruentus fuq il-pakkett. Sara: Tajjeb, se nżomm il-pakkett ħdejn il-qsari.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these red amaranth seeds? Mark: Yes, look at the name Amaranthus cruentus on the packet. Sara: Good, I'll keep the packet beside the pots.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些是红苋的种子吗？马克：是的，你看袋子上的名字 Amaranthus cruentus。萨拉：好，我把袋子放在花盆旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Din hi żerriegħa ta' denb id-dib vjola żgħir?
messages.zh: 这些是红苋的种子吗？
messages.en: Are these red amaranth seeds?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-isem Amaranthus cruentus fuq il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-isem Amaranthus cruentus fuq il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 是的，你看袋子上的名字 Amaranthus cruentus。
messages.en: Yes, look at the name Amaranthus cruentus on the packet.

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nżomm il-pakkett ħdejn il-qsari.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nżomm il-pakkett ħdejn il-qsari.
messages.zh: 好，我把袋子放在花盆旁边。
messages.en: Good, I'll keep the packet beside the pots.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“żgħir 结尾这一条对应红苋 cruentus”来配对记忆；把它与 kbir 结尾的词条并排复习，避免只记住共同的前半段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Amaranthus retroflexus, also called red-root amaranth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指反枝苋这一植物，学名为 Amaranthus retroflexus，英语也称 red-root amaranth。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Amaranthus retroflexus, waħda mill-ispeċi tal-amarant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反枝苋，学名为 Amaranthus retroflexus，英语名称意为红根苋。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' denb id-dib xewwikija u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus retroflexus.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of red-root amaranth and gives the scientific name Amaranthus retroflexus.
formal.zh: 报告附有反枝苋的照片，并列出学名 Amaranthus retroflexus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Denb id-dib xewwikija; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus retroflexus. Lara: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this plant in the photograph called? Pawlu: Red-root amaranth; the book also gives the name Amaranthus retroflexus. Lara: I'll write both names in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种植物叫什么？保罗：反枝苋；书上还写着 Amaranthus retroflexus 这个名字。拉拉：我要把两个名字都记在笔记里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Denb id-dib xewwikija; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus retroflexus.
messages.mt_standard: Denb id-dib xewwikija; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Amaranthus retroflexus.
messages.zh: 反枝苋；书上还写着 Amaranthus retroflexus 这个名字。
messages.en: Red-root amaranth; the book also gives the name Amaranthus retroflexus.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我要把两个名字都记在笔记里。
messages.en: I'll write both names in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把结尾 xewwikija 当作这张词卡的识别标记，与“反枝苋—retroflexus”整体配对；不要仅凭名称猜测植物的外形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant Amaranthus viridis, called green amaranth in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Amaranthus viridis、英语称为 green amaranth 的苋属植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal pjanta tal-ġeneru Amaranthus, bl-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus viridis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿苋，此处特指 Amaranthus viridis。

collocations.en: a photograph of green amaranth (Amaranthus viridis)

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar denb id-dib ħadra tinkludi ritratt u l-isem xjentifiku Amaranthus viridis.
formal.en: The page about green amaranth includes a photograph and the scientific name Amaranthus viridis.
formal.zh: 介绍绿苋的页面附有照片及学名 Amaranthus viridis。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi żewġ karti bl-isem Ingliż green amaranth. Liema waħda hi denb id-dib ħadra? Lara: Dik li fuqha hemm Amaranthus viridis.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have two cards with the English name green amaranth. Which one is denb id-dib ħadra? Lara: The one that says Amaranthus viridis.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我有两张卡片，英语名称都写着 green amaranth。哪张是 denb id-dib ħadra？拉拉：写着 Amaranthus viridis 的那张。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi żewġ karti bl-isem Ingliż green amaranth. Liema waħda hi denb id-dib ħadra?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi żewġ karti bl-isem Ingliż green amaranth. Liema waħda hi denb id-dib ħadra?
messages.zh: 我有两张卡片，英语名称都写着 green amaranth。哪张是 denb id-dib ħadra？
messages.en: I have two cards with the English name green amaranth. Which one is denb id-dib ħadra?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik li fuqha hemm Amaranthus viridis.
messages.mt_standard: Dik li fuqha hemm Amaranthus viridis.
messages.zh: 写着 Amaranthus viridis 的那张。
messages.en: The one that says Amaranthus viridis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做成对照卡：ħadra 对应 viridis，bagħal 对应 hybridus；两条英语都可叫绿苋，复习时遮住学名再分别回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Meadow foxtail, the grass species Alopecurus pratensis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指草地看麦娘这一禾草，学名为 Alopecurus pratensis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa tal-ispeċi Alopecurus pratensis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草地看麦娘，学名为 Alopecurus pratensis。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ta' denb il-ġurdien huwa mmarkat bl-isem xjentifiku Alopecurus pratensis.
formal.en: The meadow foxtail specimen is labelled with the scientific name Alopecurus pratensis.
formal.zh: 这份草地看麦娘标本标有学名 Alopecurus pratensis。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser denb il-ġurdien fuq din it-tikketta? David: Hawnhekk huwa isem ta' ħaxixa, Alopecurus pratensis. Nina: Issa nifhem; se nfittex ir-ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does denb il-ġurdien mean on this label? David: Here it's the name of a grass, meadow foxtail, Alopecurus pratensis. Nina: Now I understand; I'll look for a photograph of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个标签上的 denb il-ġurdien 是什么意思？戴维：这里是一种禾草的名称，指草地看麦娘，学名 Alopecurus pratensis。妮娜：现在明白了，我去找找它的照片。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser denb il-ġurdien fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser denb il-ġurdien fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.zh: 这个标签上的 denb il-ġurdien 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does denb il-ġurdien mean on this label?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk huwa isem ta' ħaxixa, Alopecurus pratensis.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk huwa isem ta' ħaxixa, Alopecurus pratensis.
messages.zh: 这里是一种禾草的名称，指草地看麦娘，学名 Alopecurus pratensis。
messages.en: Here it's the name of a grass, meadow foxtail, Alopecurus pratensis.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem; se nfittex ir-ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem; se nfittex ir-ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 现在明白了，我去找找它的照片。
messages.en: Now I understand; I'll look for a photograph of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把较短的 denb il-ġurdien 配给 pratensis；复习时与多出 it-twil 的另一词条对照，记住这里整体是植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slender meadow foxtail, the grass species Alopecurus myosuroides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指大穗看麦娘这一禾草，学名为 Alopecurus myosuroides，英语称 slender meadow foxtail。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa tal-ispeċi Alopecurus myosuroides.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大穗看麦娘，学名为 Alopecurus myosuroides，英语名称为 slender meadow foxtail。

formal.mt: Il-lista tiddistingwi bejn denb il-ġurdien it-twil, Alopecurus myosuroides, u denb il-ġurdien, Alopecurus pratensis.
formal.en: The list distinguishes slender meadow foxtail, Alopecurus myosuroides, from meadow foxtail, Alopecurus pratensis.
formal.zh: 这份清单区分了大穗看麦娘 Alopecurus myosuroides 与草地看麦娘 Alopecurus pratensis。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Għandi nikteb denb il-ġurdien biss? Samwel: Le, fuq din it-tikketta ikteb denb il-ġurdien it-twil. Ella: Tajjeb, u nżid Alopecurus myosuroides taħtu.
colloquial.en: Ella: Should I just write denb il-ġurdien? Samwel: No, on this label write denb il-ġurdien it-twil, slender meadow foxtail. Ella: All right, and I'll add Alopecurus myosuroides underneath.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：我只写 denb il-ġurdien 就行吗？萨姆韦尔：不，这张标签上要写 denb il-ġurdien it-twil，指大穗看麦娘。埃拉：好的，我再在下面加上 Alopecurus myosuroides。

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.zh: 我只写 denb il-ġurdien 就行吗？
messages.en: Should I just write denb il-ġurdien?

messages.speaker: Samwel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fuq din it-tikketta ikteb denb il-ġurdien it-twil.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fuq din it-tikketta ikteb denb il-ġurdien it-twil.
messages.zh: 不，这张标签上要写 denb il-ġurdien it-twil，指大穗看麦娘。
messages.en: No, on this label write denb il-ġurdien it-twil, slender meadow foxtail.

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, u nżid Alopecurus myosuroides taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, u nżid Alopecurus myosuroides taħtu.
messages.zh: 好的，我再在下面加上 Alopecurus myosuroides。
messages.en: All right, and I'll add Alopecurus myosuroides underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上给 it-twil 画下划线，提醒自己这个较长名称对应 myosuroides；不能省略尾部，否则会与另一植物词条混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hangs something up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把某件东西挂起来的人，强调动作的执行者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddendel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂某物的人；把东西挂起来的人。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma dendiel tirreferi għall-persuna li ddendel l-istampi fis-sala.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word dendiel refers to the person who hangs the pictures in the hall.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，dendiel 指在大厅里挂画的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser dendiel? Toni: Persuna li ddendel xi ħaġa, bħal xi ħadd li jdendel il-purtieri. Maja: Mela l-kelma tirreferi għall-persuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dendiel mean? Toni: A person who hangs something up, such as someone hanging curtains. Maja: So the word refers to the person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：dendiel 是什么意思？托尼：指把东西挂起来的人，比如挂窗帘的人。玛雅：所以这个词指的是人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: dendiel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dendiel mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li ddendel xi ħaġa, bħal xi ħadd li jdendel il-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li ddendel xi ħaġa, bħal xi ħadd li jdendel il-purtieri.
messages.zh: 指把东西挂起来的人，比如挂窗帘的人。
messages.en: A person who hangs something up, such as someone hanging curtains.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 所以这个词指的是人。
messages.en: So the word refers to the person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人站在梯子上挂画，把人物旁边标成 dendiel；再与表示“悬挂这件事”的 dendil 对照，先分清人和动作。

gloss_zh: 悬挂；把某物挂起来的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hanging something up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把某件东西挂起来这一行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed idendel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂某物的行为；把东西挂起来这一动作。

formal.mt: Id-dendil tal-istampi għandu jitlesta qabel il-ftuħ tal-wirja.
formal.en: The hanging of the pictures must be completed before the exhibition opens.
formal.zh: 挂画工作必须在展览开幕前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer id-dendil tal-purtieri? Mark: Kważi lest; baqa' purtiera waħda. Sara: Tajjeb, se nġiblek is-sellum.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is hanging the curtains going? Mark: Almost done; there's one curtain left. Sara: All right, I'll bring you the ladder.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：窗帘挂得怎么样了？马克：快好了，还剩一幅窗帘。萨拉：好，我把梯子给你拿来。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 窗帘挂得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is hanging the curtains going?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 快好了，还剩一幅窗帘。
messages.en: Almost done; there's one curtain left.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我把梯子给你拿来。
messages.en: All right, I'll bring you the ladder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“挂窗帘”整项工作画成待办事项，并写上 dendil；人物写 dendiel，工作写 dendil，用同一场景区分两个名词。

gloss_zh: 衣着破旧邋遢的；外表寒酸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shabby in appearance, especially in the way a person is dressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人外表寒酸、衣着破旧或邋遢，尤其着重其穿着。
