teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher bi ħwejjeġ imqattgħin jew traskurati, jew b'dehra ġenerali traskurata.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is shabby in appearance (especially dress)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容外表寒酸或邋遢的人，尤指衣着破旧、不整洁。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ir-raġel huwa deskritt bħala denduli minħabba l-kowt imqatta' u l-ħwejjeġ traskurati tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man is described as shabby because of his torn coat and unkempt clothes.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名男子因大衣破损、衣着邋遢而被描述为外表寒酸。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Nidher denduli b'din il-ġakketta mqattgħa? Nina: Iva, aħjar tilbes il-ġakketta l-oħra. Luca: Sewwa, nibdilha qabel noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Luca: Do I look shabby in this torn jacket? Nina: Yes, you'd better wear the other jacket. Luca: All right, I'll change it before we go out.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我穿这件破夹克是不是显得很邋遢？妮娜：是的，你最好穿另一件夹克。卢卡：好，出门前我把它换掉。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我穿这件破夹克是不是显得很邋遢？
messages.en: Do I look shabby in this torn jacket?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，你最好穿另一件夹克。
messages.en: Yes, you'd better wear the other jacket.

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，出门前我把它换掉。
messages.en: All right, I'll change it before we go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友照镜子检查破夹克，用 Nidher denduli? 记住“我看起来邋遢吗”；这个词描述人的外表，尤其是穿着。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of speaking or writing about someone or something in a way that damages their reputation or makes them seem less worthy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或文字贬低某人或某事，损害其名誉或价值的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitkellem jew jikteb b'mod li jnaqqas ir-reputazzjoni jew il-valur ta' persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诋毁；贬低；损害名誉的言论或行为。

formal.mt: L-awtur talab dibattitu mibni fuq il-fatti u mingħajr denigrazzjoni personali.
formal.en: The author called for a debate based on facts and free of personal denigration.
formal.zh: 作者呼吁开展基于事实、不含人身诋毁的辩论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt dak il-kumment dwar Lara? Mark: Iva, imma dik hi denigrazzjoni, mhux kritika utli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you read that comment about Lara? Mark: Yes, but that is denigration, not useful criticism.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读了那条关于拉拉的评论吗？马克：读了，但那是诋毁，不是有用的批评。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你读了那条关于拉拉的评论吗？
messages.en: Did you read that comment about Lara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma dik hi denigrazzjoni, mhux kritika utli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma dik hi denigrazzjoni, mhux kritika utli.
messages.zh: 读了，但那是诋毁，不是有用的批评。
messages.en: Yes, but that is denigration, not useful criticism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“说坏话、压低别人名声”的场景绑定，记住它表示诋毁这种行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a wound to produce pus, or to cause an infection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指伤口化脓，也可表示使某处受到感染。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta ferita tibda toħroġ il-materja; jew meta xi ħaġa tikkawża infezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 化脓，尤其指伤口产生脓液。
使感染；使受到病原体侵染。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ferita bdiet tiddenna ftit jiem wara l-inċident.
formal.en: In the account, the wound began to suppurate a few days after the accident.
formal.zh: 记述中，伤口在事故发生几天后开始化脓。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser li ferita bdiet tiddenna? Pawlu: Tfisser li bdiet toħroġ il-materja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean when a wound begins to suppurate? Pawlu: It means that it has started producing pus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说伤口开始 tiddenna 是什么意思？保罗：意思是伤口开始出脓了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser li ferita bdiet tiddenna?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser li ferita bdiet tiddenna?
messages.zh: 说伤口开始 tiddenna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean when a wound begins to suppurate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是伤口开始出脓了。
messages.en: It means that it has started producing pus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用伤口示意图记住两个方向：伤口自己化脓，以及某物使伤口感染；留意谁是主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To string things together, join them, or make different elements balance out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把若干事物串接或连接起来，也可指使不同因素相互平衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet waħda wara l-oħra u jgħaqqadhom, jew iġib bilanċ bejn elementi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把多个部分依次串接起来。
连接；把分开的部分接合起来。
使平衡；使不同因素相互抵消或取得均衡。

formal.mt: L-istudent denneb il-kliem biex jifforma sentenza waħda.
formal.en: The student strung the words together to form a single sentence.
formal.zh: 学生把词语串接起来，组成了一个句子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nuża dawn il-kelmiet kollha? Pawlu: Denneb kelma wara oħra biex tagħmel sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I use all these words? Pawlu: String one word after another to make a sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些词要怎么一起用？保罗：把词一个接一个串起来，组成一句话。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这些词要怎么一起用？
messages.en: How do I use all these words?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Denneb kelma wara oħra biex tagħmel sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Denneb kelma wara oħra biex tagħmel sentenza.
messages.zh: 把词一个接一个串起来，组成一句话。
messages.en: String one word after another to make a sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三幅学习小图：珠子串成串、两块接起来、天平两端配平，分别记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or murky, or cause it to lose colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、变得浑浊，或失去原有颜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa maħmuġa, jagħmel likwidu mdardar, jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa titlef il-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使沾上污物。
使某物浑浊；使不再清澈。
使某物褪色或失去原有色泽。

formal.mt: It-tajn dennes l-ilma fil-kontenitur u għamilha diffiċli biex naraw il-qiegħ.
formal.en: The mud made the water in the container murky and made it difficult to see the bottom.
formal.zh: 泥土使容器里的水变得浑浊，让人难以看清底部。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min dennes l-art? Mark: Jien, dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn. Se nnaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who dirtied the floor? Mark: I did. I came in with muddy shoes. I'll clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把地板弄脏了？马克：是我，我穿着沾满泥的鞋进来了。我现在就打扫。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把地板弄脏了？
messages.en: Who dirtied the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn. Se nnaddafha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, dħalt biż-żraben mimlijin tajn. Se nnaddafha issa.
messages.zh: 是我，我穿着沾满泥的鞋进来了。我现在就打扫。
messages.en: I did. I came in with muddy shoes. I'll clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把衣服变脏、水变浑、颜色变淡并排画出来，按宾语区分这个动词的三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing harm or having an unfavourable effect on someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会造成损害，或对某人、某事产生不利影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħsara jew ikollu effett ħażin fuq persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有害的；造成损害或带来不利影响的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi dan it-tibdil bħala denni għall-proġett.
formal.en: The report describes this change as detrimental to the project.
formal.zh: 报告将这一改动描述为对项目不利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tibdil se jgħinna? Mark: Ma naħsibx. Jista' jkun denni għall-proġett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will this change help us? Mark: I don't think so. It could be detrimental to the project.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个改动会对我们有帮助吗？马克：我觉得不会，可能会对项目不利。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这个改动会对我们有帮助吗？
messages.en: Will this change help us?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx. Jista' jkun denni għall-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx. Jista' jkun denni għall-proġett.
messages.zh: 我觉得不会，可能会对项目不利。
messages.en: I don't think so. It could be detrimental to the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一个向下的效果箭头，把 denni 与“造成损害、带来不利”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes things or places dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品或地方弄脏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħammeġ affarijiet jew postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏东西或环境的人。

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, il-kelma 'dennies' tirreferi għall-persuna li ħammġet l-art.
formal.en: In this sentence, the word 'dennies' refers to the person who dirtied the floor.
formal.zh: 在这个句子中，dennies 指把地板弄脏的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'dennies'? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li jħammeġ, bħal persuna li tħalli marki tat-tajn mal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'dennies' mean? Pawlu: Someone who makes things dirty, such as a person who leaves muddy marks on the floor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：dennies 是什么意思？保罗：指弄脏东西的人，比如在地板上留下泥印的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: dennies 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dennies' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jħammeġ, bħal persuna li tħalli marki tat-tajn mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jħammeġ, bħal persuna li tħalli marki tat-tajn mal-art.
messages.zh: 指弄脏东西的人，比如在地板上留下泥印的人。
messages.en: Someone who makes things dirty, such as a person who leaves muddy marks on the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象泥脚印旁站着一个人，把 dennies 记成“弄脏东西的人”，重点记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 容易把东西弄脏的；爱弄脏东西的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make things dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易把东西弄脏的倾向或习惯的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jħammeġ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易把东西弄脏的；有弄脏东西的倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to make things dirty
collocations.zh: 一个容易把东西弄脏的男孩

collocations.en: a dog that tends to make things dirty
collocations.zh: 一只经常把东西弄脏的狗

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala denniesi għax spiss iħammeġ il-mejda waqt li jpinġi.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is described as tending to make things dirty because he often dirties the table while painting.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个男孩被描述为容易把东西弄脏，因为他画画时经常弄脏桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art! Mark: Iva, huwa denniesi, speċjalment wara mixja fix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your dog always leaves mud on the floor! Mark: Yes, he tends to make things dirty, especially after a walk in the rain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗总在地板上留下泥巴！马克：是啊，它很容易把东西弄脏，尤其是雨天散步以后。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art!
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem iħalli t-tajn mal-art!
messages.zh: 你的狗总在地板上留下泥巴！
messages.en: Your dog always leaves mud on the floor!

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa denniesi, speċjalment wara mixja fix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa denniesi, speċjalment wara mixja fix-xita.
messages.zh: 是啊，它很容易把东西弄脏，尤其是雨天散步以后。
messages.en: Yes, he tends to make things dirty, especially after a walk in the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“怎样的人或动物”这一栏，想象经常留下泥印的小狗，记住它描述弄脏东西的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Formed from a noun, especially when describing a verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由名词构成或派生的，尤其用于描述动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun iffurmat minn nom, speċjalment meta jingħad għal verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由名词构成或派生的，尤指动词。

collocations.zh: 由名词构成词语的用法

formal.mt: L-analiżi tiddeskrivi l-verb bħala denominattiv għax huwa ffurmat minn nom.
formal.en: The analysis describes the verb as denominative because it is formed from a noun.
formal.zh: 分析将该动词描述为由名词派生，因为它是从一个名词构成的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'verb denominattiv'? Pawlu: Ifisser verb iffurmat minn nom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'denominative verb' mean? Pawlu: It means a verb formed from a noun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“名词派生动词”是什么意思？保罗：就是由名词构成的动词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “名词派生动词”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'denominative verb' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 就是由名词构成的动词。
messages.en: It means a verb formed from a noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在卡片上写“名词→动词”，把 denominattiv 贴在箭头旁，记住它说明词的构成来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number below the line in a fraction, showing how many equal parts make up a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分数中写在分数线下方的数，表示一个整体被分成多少个相等的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru taħt il-linja fi frazzjoni, li juri f'kemm-il parti ndaqs jinqasam is-sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分母；分数线下方表示整体等分份数的数。

formal.mt: Fil-frazzjoni 3/8, id-denominatur huwa 8 u jindika li s-sħiħ jinqasam fi tmien partijiet indaqs.
formal.en: In the fraction 3/8, the denominator is 8 and indicates that the whole is divided into eight equal parts.
formal.zh: 在分数3/8中，分母是8，表示整体被分成八个相等的部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema hu d-denominatur fi 3/8? Pawlu: It-tmienja, in-numru ta' taħt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which number is the denominator in 3/8? Pawlu: Eight, the number underneath.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：3/8里哪个数是分母？保罗：八，就是下面那个数。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 3/8里哪个数是分母？
messages.en: Which number is the denominator in 3/8?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 八，就是下面那个数。
messages.en: Eight, the number underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把分数想成切好的蛋糕：下方的 denominatur 记录总共切成几等份，先看下面再数份数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular value in a series of monetary units, or a religious group sharing a name and beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货币单位系列中的某一种面额；也指具有共同名称和信仰的宗教派别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valur partikolari f'sensiela ta' unitajiet monetarji, jew grupp reliġjuż b'isem u twemmin komuni.

sense_translations.en_definition: denomination (unit in a series of units)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面额；同一单位系列中的某一级单位，尤指纸币或硬币的票面价值。

sense_translations.en_definition: denomination (class or society with the same name, a sect)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗派；具有共同名称的类别或团体，尤指宗教派别。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jelenka l-karti tal-flus skont id-denominazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: The report lists the banknotes according to their denomination.
formal.zh: 报告按照面额列出各类纸币。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Hawnhekk, denominazzjoni tfisser il-valur tal-karta tal-flus? David: Iva, bħal ħames ewro jew għaxar ewro.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does denomination mean the value of the banknote here? David: Yes, like five euros or ten euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里的 denominazzjoni 是指纸币的面额吗？戴维：对，比如五欧元或十欧元。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, denominazzjoni tfisser il-valur tal-karta tal-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, denominazzjoni tfisser il-valur tal-karta tal-flus?
messages.zh: 这里的 denominazzjoni 是指纸币的面额吗？
messages.en: Does denomination mean the value of the banknote here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħal ħames ewro jew għaxar ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħal ħames ewro jew għaxar ewro.
messages.zh: 对，比如五欧元或十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, like five euros or ten euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张分类标签记忆 denominazzjoni：钞票按面额分类，宗教团体按宗派分类；看到语境再选中文义。

gloss_zh: 指称的；表示字面意义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the direct or literal meaning of a word or expression rather than its associated feelings or ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与词语直接指称或字面意义有关的，区别于词语引起的情感和联想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda t-tifsir dirett jew litterali ta' kelma jew espressjoni, aktar milli s-sentimenti jew l-ideat assoċjati magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指称的；涉及词语直接所指或字面意义的。

formal.mt: Fit-tifsir denotattiv tagħha, il-kelma 'dar' tindika bini fejn jgħixu n-nies.
formal.en: In its denotative meaning, the word 'dar' refers to a building where people live.
formal.zh: 从指称意义来看，dar 一词指人们居住的建筑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu t-tifsir denotattiv ta' 'dar'? Mark: Bini fejn jgħixu n-nies; is-sens ta' kenn huwa assoċjazzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the denotative meaning of 'dar'? Mark: A building where people live; the feeling of shelter is another association.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：dar 的指称意义是什么？马克：人们居住的建筑；庇护的感觉属于另一层联想。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: dar 的指称意义是什么？
messages.en: What is the denotative meaning of 'dar'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bini fejn jgħixu n-nies; is-sens ta' kenn huwa assoċjazzjoni oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Bini fejn jgħixu n-nies; is-sens ta' kenn huwa assoċjazzjoni oħra.
messages.zh: 人们居住的建筑；庇护的感觉属于另一层联想。
messages.en: A building where people live; the feeling of shelter is another association.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给词语画一根直接指向实物的箭头，提醒自己 denotattiv 描述的是直接所指；它是形容词，常修饰“意义”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direct or literal meaning of a word or expression, as distinct from the feelings or associations it suggests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语直接表达或指向的意义，区别于该词语引起的情感和联想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsir dirett jew litterali ta' kelma jew espressjoni, distint mis-sentimenti jew l-assoċjazzjonijiet li tqajjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指称；词语的直接所指或字面意义，与附带的情感和联想相区别。

formal.mt: L-analiżi tiddistingwi bejn id-denotazzjoni tal-kelma u l-assoċjazzjonijiet kulturali tagħha.
formal.en: The analysis distinguishes between the word's denotation and its cultural associations.
formal.zh: 这项分析区分了该词的指称意义与文化联想。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Id-denotazzjoni ta' 'warda' tinkludi l-imħabba? Toni: Le, tindika tip ta' fjura; l-imħabba hija assoċjazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does the denotation of 'warda' include love? Toni: No, it refers to a type of flower; love is an association.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：warda 的指称意义包含爱情吗？托尼：不，它指一种花；爱情是联想意义。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: warda 的指称意义包含爱情吗？
messages.en: Does the denotation of 'warda' include love?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tindika tip ta' fjura; l-imħabba hija assoċjazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tindika tip ta' fjura; l-imħabba hija assoċjazzjoni.
messages.zh: 不，它指一种花；爱情是联想意义。
messages.en: No, it refers to a type of flower; love is an association.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到玫瑰先答“一种花”，再想到“爱情”：前面的直接所指帮助记住 denotazzjoni；本词是名词。

gloss_zh: 密集的；浓厚的；污垢；杂质

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many parts packed closely together, or having a thick consistency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组成部分紧密聚集、密度较大的；也可形容质地浓厚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna elementi qrib ħafna ta' xulxin, jew li għandu konsistenza ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密集的；稠密的；组成部分紧密聚集的。
浓厚的；浓稠的；质地厚实的。
污垢；脏物。
杂质；混入某种物质中的不纯成分。

formal.mt: Ċpar dens naqqas il-viżibbiltà fit-triq matul il-lejl.
formal.en: Thick fog reduced visibility on the road during the night.
formal.zh: 夜间的浓雾降低了道路能见度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed issuq daqshekk bil-mod? Ġużeppi: Iċ-ċpar dens wisq; bilkemm nara t-triq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you driving so slowly? Ġużeppi: The fog is too thick; I can barely see the road.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么开得这么慢？朱塞佩：雾太浓了，我几乎看不清路。

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 你为什么开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you driving so slowly?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċpar dens wisq; bilkemm nara t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċpar dens wisq; bilkemm nara t-triq.
messages.zh: 雾太浓了，我几乎看不清路。
messages.en: The fog is too thick; I can barely see the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张词性卡记忆 dens：形容词卡画浓雾和稠液，名词卡画污垢和杂质；不要把名词义直接套进形容词句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A complaint or notice reporting an alleged offence or wrongdoing to an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向主管机构提出的投诉、举报或通报，用来反映涉嫌违法或不当的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilment jew avviż lil awtorità dwar reat jew imġiba ħażina allegata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投诉；举报；向有关机构报告情况的通知或通报。

collocations.zh: 向警方提交的举报或报案

formal.mt: Ir-resident ressaq denunzja bil-miktub lill-awtorità dwar ir-rimi illegali ta' skart.
formal.en: The resident submitted a written complaint to the authority about illegal waste dumping.
formal.zh: 该居民就非法倾倒垃圾一事向主管机构提交了书面举报。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek ma rrapportajtx is-serq? Karl: Iva, dalgħodu għamilt denunzja lill-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Rita: Haven't you reported the theft yet? Karl: Yes, I made a report to the police this morning.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你还没报告失窃的事吗？卡尔：报了，我今天早上已经向警方报案了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还没报告失窃的事吗？
messages.en: Haven't you reported the theft yet?

messages.speaker: Karl (失主)
messages.zh: 报了，我今天早上已经向警方报案了。
messages.en: Yes, I made a report to the police this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把事情写在纸上交给有关机构：交出去的投诉或举报就是 denunzja，可连同“提交投诉”的搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who reports or publicly condemns someone's alleged wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举报、揭发或公开谴责他人涉嫌不当行为的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrapporta jew tikkundanna pubblikament imġiba ħażina allegata ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举报人；揭发者；公开谴责他人不当行为的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiġbor id-dikjarazzjoni tad-denunzjatur u d-dokumenti li ppreżenta.
formal.en: The report brings together the denouncer's statement and the documents he submitted.
formal.zh: 报告汇集了举报人的陈述及其提交的文件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu d-denunzjatur f'dan il-każ? Ben: Il-persuna li rrappurtat il-fatti lill-awtorità.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the denouncer in this case? Ben: The person who reported the facts to the authority.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个案件中的举报人是谁？本：就是向主管机构报告事实的那个人。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这个案件中的举报人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the denouncer in this case?

messages.speaker: Ben (教师)
messages.zh: 就是向主管机构报告事实的那个人。
messages.en: The person who reported the facts to the authority.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物和文件配对记忆：denunzja 是提交的举报，denunzjatur 是提出举报的人；看到本词就想起递交材料的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that relies on or is determined by someone or something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以依赖他人或其他事物的方式；受其他因素制约地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jiddependi minn persuna jew ħaġa oħra, jew li jkun determinat minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖地；依附地；以受他人或其他事物制约的方式。

collocations.zh: 以依赖其他因素的方式运作

collocations.en: to operate in dependence on another system

formal.mt: Il-modulu jopera dependentement mis-sistema ċentrali, li tipprovdilu d-data meħtieġa.
formal.en: The module operates in dependence on the central system, which provides it with the necessary data.
formal.zh: 该模块依赖中央系统运行，中央系统向它提供所需数据。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fin-noti hemm 'jaħdem dependentement'. Xi jfisser? Sam: Li jiddependi minn xi ħaġa oħra biex jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Lina: The notes say 'works dependently'. What does that mean? Sam: That it relies on something else to work.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：笔记里写着“以依赖的方式运作”。这是什么意思？萨姆：就是说它要依靠其他东西才能运作。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 笔记里写着“以依赖的方式运作”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The notes say 'works dependently'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jiddependi minn xi ħaġa oħra biex jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Li jiddependi minn xi ħaġa oħra biex jaħdem.
messages.zh: 就是说它要依靠其他东西才能运作。
messages.en: That it relies on something else to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台必须连接主机才能运行的设备：dependentement 描述它“依赖地运行”的方式；记住这是修饰动作的副词。

gloss_zh: 依赖的；需要他人供养的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Needing someone or something for support, resources, or the ability to function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要依靠某人或某物获得支持、资源或维持运作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħtieġ l-għajnuna jew ir-riżorsi ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa biex jgħix jew jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖的；依靠他人或其他事物支持的。

formal.mt: Is-servizz huwa dependenti fuq il-kontribuzzjonijiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: The service is dependent on contributions from the community.
formal.zh: 这项服务依赖社区的捐助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tixtrix karozza? Toni: Għadni dependenti fuq il-ġenituri tiegħi għall-flus.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you buy a car? Toni: I'm still dependent on my parents for money.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不买辆车？托尼：我在经济上还依赖父母。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不买辆车？
messages.en: Why don't you buy a car?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni dependenti fuq il-ġenituri tiegħi għall-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni dependenti fuq il-ġenituri tiegħi għall-flus.
messages.zh: 我在经济上还依赖父母。
messages.en: I'm still dependent on my parents for money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dependenti 想成需要有人扶着才能站稳的人，并连同 dependenti fuq 一起记成“依赖于”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of relying on someone or something for support, resources, or functioning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在支持、资源或运作方面依靠某人或某物的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min jiddependi fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa għall-għajnuna, għar-riżorsi jew biex jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖；依存；需要依靠他人或其他事物的状态。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jnaqqas id-dependenza tal-irħula fuq provvista waħda tal-ilma.
formal.en: The project aims to reduce the villages' dependence on a single water supply.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在减少这些村庄对单一供水来源的依赖。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex trid titgħallem issajjar? Pawlu: Irrid innaqqas id-dependenza tiegħi fuq ikel lest.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you want to learn to cook? Pawlu: I want to reduce my dependence on ready-made food.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么想学做饭？保罗：我想减少对现成食物的依赖。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想学做饭？
messages.en: Why do you want to learn to cook?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid innaqqas id-dependenza tiegħi fuq ikel lest.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid innaqqas id-dependenza tiegħi fuq ikel lest.
messages.zh: 我想减少对现成食物的依赖。
messages.en: I want to reduce my dependence on ready-made food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一根必须接着电源的电线来记 dependenza：重点是“依赖这种状态”，所以它是名词。

gloss_zh: 令人痛惜的；应受谴责的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So bad that it causes strong disapproval or sadness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 糟糕到令人强烈不满、谴责或痛惜的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħażin ħafna, b'mod li jqanqal diżapprovazzjoni qawwija jew niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人痛惜的；糟糕透顶的；应受谴责的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet fil-bini bħala deplorabbli.
formal.en: The report describes the conditions in the building as deplorable.
formal.zh: 报告将楼内的状况描述为糟糕透顶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt kemm ħallew żibel fil-park? Mark: Iva, din hi mġiba deplorabbli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see how much rubbish they left in the park? Mark: Yes, this is deplorable behaviour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到他们在公园里留下了多少垃圾吗？马克：看到了，这种行为真该受谴责。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到他们在公园里留下了多少垃圾吗？
messages.en: Did you see how much rubbish they left in the park?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，这种行为真该受谴责。
messages.en: Yes, this is deplorable behaviour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deplorabbli 配上满地垃圾和皱眉表情，记住它表达强烈的痛惜或谴责，比普通的“不好”更重。

gloss_zh: 令人痛惜的；应受谴责的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very bad and deserving strong disapproval or regret.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常糟糕，令人强烈不满或深感痛惜的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħażin ħafna u li jistħoqqlu diżapprovazzjoni qawwija jew iqanqal dispjaċir kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人痛惜的；极其糟糕的；应受谴责的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkundanna l-aġir deplorevoli ta' dawk li għamlu ħsara lill-ġnien pubbliku.
formal.en: The committee condemned the deplorable conduct of those who damaged the public garden.
formal.zh: 委员会谴责了破坏公共花园者的恶劣行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt il-bitħa wara l-festa? Luqa: Fi stat deplorevoli, bi fliexken u karti kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was the yard like after the party? Luqa: In a deplorable state, with bottles and paper everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：聚会结束后，院子怎么样？卢卡：糟糕透了，到处都是瓶子和纸。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 聚会结束后，院子怎么样？
messages.en: What was the yard like after the party?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi stat deplorevoli, bi fliexken u karti kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Fi stat deplorevoli, bi fliexken u karti kullimkien.
messages.zh: 糟糕透了，到处都是瓶子和纸。
messages.en: In a deplorable state, with bottles and paper everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 deplorevoli 写在“糟糕得让人摇头”的场景卡上，与 stat 连读，记成“令人痛惜的状态”。

gloss_zh: 宣誓作证者；异相的（语法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives evidence or makes a statement under oath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在宣誓后提供证词或作出陈述的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti xhieda jew tagħmel dikjarazzjoni bil-ġurament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣誓作证者；作出宣誓陈述的人。
异相的，指动词形式为被动而意义为主动的。

formal.mt: Id-deponent iddikjara bil-ġurament li kien preżenti waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The deponent stated under oath that he had been present at the meeting.
formal.zh: 宣誓作证者声明，他当时在会议现场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'deponent' f'dan id-dokument? David: Hawnhekk ifisser persuna li tagħmel dikjarazzjoni bil-ġurament.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'deponent' mean in this document? David: Here it means a person who makes a statement under oath.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份文件里的 deponent 是什么意思？戴维：在这里，它指作出宣誓陈述的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份文件里的 deponent 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'deponent' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser persuna li tagħmel dikjarazzjoni bil-ġurament.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser persuna li tagħmel dikjarazzjoni bil-ġurament.
messages.zh: 在这里，它指作出宣誓陈述的人。
messages.en: Here it means a person who makes a statement under oath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 deponent 做两张卡：人物卡画举手宣誓者，语法卡写“被动形式、主动意义”，分开记住名词和形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of officially forcing a person to leave a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由官方强制某人离开一个国家的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna titneħħa minn pajjiż bil-forza fuq ordni tal-awtoritajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驱逐出境；由官方强制将某人遣送出国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett tad-deportazzjoni fuq il-familja.
formal.en: The report describes the effect of deportation on the family.
formal.zh: 报告描述了驱逐出境对这个家庭的影响。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'deportazzjoni' fl-aħbarijiet? Ben: Tfisser li l-awtoritajiet iġiegħlu lil persuna titlaq mill-pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'deportazzjoni' mean in the news? Ben: It means that the authorities force a person to leave the country.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：新闻里的 deportazzjoni 是什么意思？本：意思是当局强制某人离开这个国家。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 新闻里的 deportazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'deportazzjoni' mean in the news?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-awtoritajiet iġiegħlu lil persuna titlaq mill-pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-awtoritajiet iġiegħlu lil persuna titlaq mill-pajjiż.
messages.zh: 意思是当局强制某人离开这个国家。
messages.en: It means that the authorities force a person to leave the country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张写着“官方命令离境”的通知单记 deportazzjoni，把“强制离开国家”作为完整画面来记。

gloss_zh: 受托保管的；承担托管职责的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Entrusted with keeping money, assets, or documents on behalf of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受他人委托，承担金钱、资产或文件保管职责的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fdat biex iżomm flus, assi jew dokumenti f'isem ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受托保管的；承担款项、资产或文件托管职责的。

formal.mt: Il-bank depożitarju jżomm l-assi f'isem il-klijenti.
formal.en: The depositary bank holds the assets on behalf of its clients.
formal.zh: 托管银行代表客户保管资产。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser 'depożitarju' ħdejn il-kelma 'bank'? Karl: Ifisser li l-bank għandu r-rwol li jżomm assi f'isem ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'depożitarju' mean next to the word 'bank'? Karl: It means that the bank has the role of holding assets on behalf of others.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：bank 旁边的 depożitarju 是什么意思？卡尔：意思是这家银行承担替他人保管资产的职责。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: bank 旁边的 depożitarju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'depożitarju' mean next to the word 'bank'?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-bank għandu r-rwol li jżomm assi f'isem ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-bank għandu r-rwol li jżomm assi f'isem ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 意思是这家银行承担替他人保管资产的职责。
messages.en: It means that the bank has the role of holding assets on behalf of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depożitarju 贴在银行保险柜上，记住它在 bank depożitarju 中描述“承担托管职责的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that places money in a bank account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将钱存入银行账户的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tqiegħed flus f'kont bankarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存款人；把款项存入银行账户的个人或机构。

formal.mt: Id-depożitur talab rendikont tal-kont tiegħu.
formal.en: The depositor requested a statement of his account.
formal.zh: 这位存款人要求提供其账户的对账单。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser 'depożitur' fuq din il-formola? Ġużepp: Hija l-persuna li tqiegħed il-flus fil-kont.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'depożitur' mean on this form? Ġużepp: It is the person who puts the money into the account.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这张表上的 depożitur 是什么意思？朱塞佩：就是把钱存入账户的人。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张表上的 depożitur 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'depożitur' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-persuna li tqiegħed il-flus fil-kont.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-persuna li tqiegħed il-flus fil-kont.
messages.zh: 就是把钱存入账户的人。
messages.en: It is the person who puts the money into the account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depożitur 配上一位往账户里存钱的人，记住它指“存款人”；再与描述托管职责的 depożitarju 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling very sad and low in spirits, with little interest or enjoyment in usual activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪十分低落，对平常的活动缺少兴趣或乐趣的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dwejjaq kbar u ftit interess jew gost fl-attivitajiet tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情绪低落的；抑郁的。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, Mark qal li kien qed iħossu depress u li kien tilef l-interess fl-attivitajiet tas-soltu.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark said that he was feeling depressed and had lost interest in his usual activities.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克说自己情绪低落，对平常的活动失去了兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-aħħar qed inħossni depress. Lara: Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar kif qed tħossok?
colloquial.en: Mark: I've been feeling depressed lately. Lara: Would you like us to talk a little about how you're feeling?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我最近一直觉得情绪低落。拉拉：你想和我聊聊你的感受吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我最近一直觉得情绪低落。
messages.en: I've been feeling depressed lately.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar kif qed tħossok?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar kif qed tħossok?
messages.zh: 你想和我聊聊你的感受吗？
messages.en: Would you like us to talk a little about how you're feeling?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 depress 记成一个人的低落状态，配合“我感到……”来练习；再与表示事物令人低落的 depressanti 对照。

gloss_zh: 令人沮丧的；使人情绪低落的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing sadness, discouragement, or a lowering of someone's spirits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到悲伤、灰心或情绪低落的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib dwejjaq jew jaqta' qalb min jarah, jisimgħu jew jgħaddi minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人沮丧的；使人情绪低落的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti stampa depressanti tal-kundizzjonijiet tad-djar f'din iż-żona.
formal.en: The report presents a depressing picture of housing conditions in this area.
formal.zh: 这份报告呈现了该地区令人沮丧的住房状况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-film huwa depressanti wisq għalija llejla. Pawlu: Mela nagħżlu kummiedja?
colloquial.en: Nina: This film is too depressing for me tonight. Pawlu: Shall we choose a comedy, then?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今晚这部电影对我来说太压抑了。保罗：那我们选一部喜剧吧？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film huwa depressanti wisq għalija llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film huwa depressanti wisq għalija llejla.
messages.zh: 今晚这部电影对我来说太压抑了。
messages.en: This film is too depressing for me tonight.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们选一部喜剧吧？
messages.en: Shall we choose a comedy, then?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一部电影让观众越看越低落：电影是 depressanti，观众感到 depress；用“引起感受”和“处于状态”区分。

gloss_zh: 抑郁；经济萧条；洼地；低气压区

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mental state involving serious, long-lasting low mood and reduced enjoyment; also a major economic downturn, a low area of land, or an area of low atmospheric pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指持续较久、明显降低生活乐趣的抑郁状态；也可指严重的经济萧条、地势较低的洼地或低气压区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' dwejjaq serji u fit-tul li jnaqqas il-gost fil-ħajja; ukoll tnaqqis ekonomiku kbir, żona baxxa tal-art jew żona ta' pressjoni atmosferika baxxa.

sense_translations.en_definition: dejection, depression, despondency (state of mind producing serious long-term lowering of enjoyment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沮丧、抑郁或消沉的精神状态，表现为生活乐趣长期而明显地减少。
经济萧条；经济活动大幅收缩的一段时期。
洼地；地势低于周围地区的低地。

sense_translations.en_definition: depression, low (area of lowered air pressure)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 低气压区；大气压力低于周围地区的区域。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif id-depressjoni ekonomika affettwat l-impjiegi u d-dħul tal-familji.
formal.en: The study examines how the economic depression affected employment and household income.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察经济萧条如何影响就业和家庭收入。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tbassir isemmi depressjoni atmosferika. X'jiġifieri? Toni: Żona ta' pressjoni baxxa fl-atmosfera.
colloquial.en: Sara: The forecast mentions an atmospheric depression. What does that mean? Toni: An area of low pressure in the atmosphere.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：天气预报提到了大气低压区。这是什么意思？托尼：就是大气中气压较低的区域。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 天气预报提到了大气低压区。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The forecast mentions an atmospheric depression. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 就是大气中气压较低的区域。
messages.en: An area of low pressure in the atmosphere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张“低”的图卡记义：心情低落、经济低迷、地势低洼、气压偏低。这是学习联想，具体词义仍由上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decrease in the value of an asset over time, including the allocation of an asset's cost over its useful life in accounting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资产价值随时间下降；在会计中也指将资产成本分摊到其使用年限内的折旧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-valur ta' assi maż-żmien; fil-kontabilità, ukoll it-tqassim tal-ispiża ta' assi fuq il-ħajja utli tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬值；资产价值的下降，或会计上对资产成本进行分摊的折旧。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju juri d-deprezzament annwali tat-tagħmir u l-valur tiegħu fi tmiem is-sena.
formal.en: The financial report shows the equipment's annual depreciation and its value at the end of the year.
formal.zh: 财务报告列出了设备的年度折旧及其年末价值。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex din il-karozza użata tiswa ħafna inqas minn waħda ġdida? Rita: Minħabba d-deprezzament; il-valur tagħha naqas maż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does this used car cost much less than a new one? Rita: Because of depreciation; its value has fallen over time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆二手车为什么比新车便宜这么多？丽塔：因为贬值；它的价值随时间下降了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-karozza użata tiswa ħafna inqas minn waħda ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-karozza użata tiswa ħafna inqas minn waħda ġdida?
messages.zh: 这辆二手车为什么比新车便宜这么多？
messages.en: Why does this used car cost much less than a new one?

messages.speaker: Rita (汽车销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-deprezzament; il-valur tagħha naqas maż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-deprezzament; il-valur tagħha naqas maż-żmien.
messages.zh: 因为贬值；它的价值随时间下降了。
messages.en: Because of depreciation; its value has fallen over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一辆车从新车变旧车，价签逐年变小，把 deprezzament 与“价值下降、账上折旧”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 代表团；受委派的代表团体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people appointed to represent others, especially at a meeting or when presenting a request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受委派代表他人出席会议、表达意见或提出请求的一组人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies magħżula biex jirrappreżentaw lil oħrajn, speċjalment f'laqgħa jew biex iressqu talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表团；受委派代表某个群体办事、会谈或提出意见的一组人。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill laqa' deputazzjoni ta' residenti li ressqet talba għal servizz aħjar tat-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The council received a delegation of residents that presented a request for better public transport services.
formal.zh: 议会接见了一个居民代表团，该代表团提出了改善公共交通服务的请求。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jmur ikellem lill-kunsill? Ġorġ: Se tmur deputazzjoni ta' tliet ġirien biex tirrappreżenta t-triq kollha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is going to speak to the council? Ġorġ: A delegation of three neighbours will go to represent the whole street.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁去和议会谈？乔治：会有三位邻居组成代表团，代表整条街的居民前去。

messages.speaker: Anna (居民)
messages.zh: 谁去和议会谈？
messages.en: Who is going to speak to the council?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur deputazzjoni ta' tliet ġirien biex tirrappreżenta t-triq kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur deputazzjoni ta' tliet ġirien biex tirrappreżenta t-triq kollha.
messages.zh: 会有三位邻居组成代表团，代表整条街的居民前去。
messages.en: A delegation of three neighbours will go to represent the whole street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全体居民选出三个人带着共同诉求去开会：deputazzjoni 就是这支受委派、替大家发言的代表团。

gloss_zh: 派生的；衍生的；模仿性强而缺少独创性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on or developed from something else, especially an existing work, idea, or style; sometimes implying a lack of originality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从其他事物发展或衍生而来的，尤指以已有作品、观念或风格为基础的；有时含缺乏独创性的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn xi ħaġa oħra jew hu bbażat fuq xogħol, idea jew stil eżistenti; xi drabi jindika nuqqas ta' oriġinalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 派生的；衍生的；形容作品或风格时也可指过于依赖已有作品、缺少独创性的。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku ddeskriva l-istil tar-rumanz bħala derivattiv għax kien jixbah ħafna lil dak ta' awturi oħra.
formal.en: The critic described the novel's style as derivative because it closely resembled that of other authors.
formal.zh: 评论家认为这部小说的风格缺少独创性，因为它与其他作家的风格十分相似。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-film? Ben: Kien divertenti, imma l-istil tiegħu kien derivattiv; fakkarni wisq f'films oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the film? Ben: It was entertaining, but its style was derivative; it reminded me too much of other films.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢这部电影吗？本：挺好看的，但风格缺少新意，让我想起太多其他电影。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien divertenti, imma l-istil tiegħu kien derivattiv; fakkarni wisq f'films oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Kien divertenti, imma l-istil tiegħu kien derivattiv; fakkarni wisq f'films oħra.
messages.zh: 挺好看的，但风格缺少新意，让我想起太多其他电影。
messages.en: It was entertaining, but its style was derivative; it reminded me too much of other films.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derivattiv 配在“作品、风格”旁边记：看得到已有作品的影子，可能是衍生，也可能是在批评缺少新意。

gloss_zh: 派生构词的；与词汇派生有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the formation of a new word from an existing word, rather than merely changing its grammatical form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与从已有词形成新词的构词过程有关的，区别于仅改变词的语法形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħolqien ta' kelma ġdida minn kelma eżistenti, aktar milli biss mat-tibdil tal-forma grammatikali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 派生构词的；与由已有词形成新词的过程有关的。

formal.mt: L-analiżi derivazzjonali tispjega kif kelma ġdida tinbena minn kelma eżistenti.
formal.en: Derivational analysis explains how a new word is formed from an existing word.
formal.zh: 派生构词分析解释新词如何由已有词形成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser proċess derivazzjonali? David: Proċess li joħloq kelma ġdida minn kelma oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a derivational process mean? David: A process that creates a new word from another word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：派生构词过程是什么意思？戴维：就是从另一个词形成新词的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 派生构词过程是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a derivational process mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Proċess li joħloq kelma ġdida minn kelma oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Proċess li joħloq kelma ġdida minn kelma oħra.
messages.zh: 就是从另一个词形成新词的过程。
messages.en: A process that creates a new word from another word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 derivazzjonali，就在脑中画“已有词→新词”的学习箭头；它是形容词，常用来修饰构词过程或分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of obtaining or forming something from something else, such as forming a word from another word or establishing a formula through logical steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从其他事物形成或得出某事物的过程，例如从已有词形成新词，或通过逻辑步骤推导公式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinkiseb jew tinbena minn xi ħaġa oħra, bħal meta kelma tinbena minn kelma oħra jew formula tinkiseb permezz ta' passi loġiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 派生；推导；指从已有事物形成或得出另一事物的过程，可用于构词或公式推导等语境。

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta d-derivazzjoni tal-formula pass pass u jispjega kull operazzjoni.
formal.en: The author presents the derivation of the formula step by step and explains each operation.
formal.zh: 作者逐步展示公式的推导，并解释每一步运算。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nifhem il-formula, imma ma nifhimx id-derivazzjoni tagħha. Sam: Ejja naraw flimkien kif naslu għaliha, pass pass.
colloquial.en: Nina: I understand the formula, but I don't understand its derivation. Sam: Let's look together at how we arrive at it, step by step.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我理解这个公式，但不明白它的推导。萨姆：我们一起看看怎样一步步得出它。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem il-formula, imma ma nifhimx id-derivazzjoni tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem il-formula, imma ma nifhimx id-derivazzjoni tagħha.
messages.zh: 我理解这个公式，但不明白它的推导。
messages.en: I understand the formula, but I don't understand its derivation.

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw flimkien kif naslu għaliha, pass pass.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw flimkien kif naslu għaliha, pass pass.
messages.zh: 我们一起看看怎样一步步得出它。
messages.en: Let's look together at how we arrive at it, step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derivazzjoni 想成一条有步骤的路线：从已有词走到新词，或从已知条件走到公式；重点记住“形成、得出的过程”。

gloss_zh: 可获准例外处理的；可予豁免的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a rule or requirement from which an exception may be permitted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某项规则或要求允许在特定情况下作例外处理或给予豁免。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jkun soġġett għal eċċezzjoni jew eżenzjoni f'ċerti ċirkostanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可允许例外的；可予豁免的。

collocations.en: a requirement from which an exception may be permitted
an obligation that may be waived

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega jekk dan ir-rekwiżit huwiex derogabbli u f'liema ċirkostanzi tista' tingħata eżenzjoni.
formal.en: The document explains whether an exception to this requirement is permissible and in what circumstances an exemption may be granted.
formal.zh: 该文件说明这项要求是否可作例外处理，以及在何种情况下可以给予豁免。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan l-obbligu huwa derogabbli? Pawlu: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regoli biex naraw jekk jippermettux eċċezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can this obligation be waived? Pawlu: Let's check the rules to see whether they allow an exception.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这项义务可以豁免吗？保罗：我们查一下规则，看看是否允许例外。

messages.speaker: Marta (申请人)
messages.zh: 这项义务可以豁免吗？
messages.en: Can this obligation be waived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regoli biex naraw jekk jippermettux eċċezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw ir-regoli biex naraw jekk jippermettux eċċezzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们查一下规则，看看是否允许例外。
messages.en: Let's check the rules to see whether they allow an exception.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象要求旁有一个“允许例外”的勾选框：derogabbli 描述的是这项要求可以获准豁免的性质。

gloss_zh: 贬损的；带有贬低意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing a low opinion of someone or something in a belittling or disrespectful way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语或表达带有贬低、轻视他人或事物的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi disprezz jew inaqqas mill-valur jew mid-dinjità ta' persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬损的；表达轻视或贬低意味的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li jiġi evitat kull kumment derogattiv dwar il-kollegi.
formal.en: The report recommends avoiding any derogative comment about colleagues.
formal.zh: 报告建议避免发表任何贬损同事的评论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-kumment kien derogattiv. Mark: Għandek raġun; stajt nesprimi ruħi b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: That comment was derogative. Mark: You're right; I could have expressed myself more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那句话带有贬低人的意味。马克：你说得对，我本可以表达得更尊重一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话带有贬低人的意味。
messages.en: That comment was derogative.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; stajt nesprimi ruħi b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; stajt nesprimi ruħi b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我本可以表达得更尊重一些。
messages.en: You're right; I could have expressed myself more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derogattiv 配上一句让人感到被看低的评论，记住它描述言语中的贬损意味。

gloss_zh: 对规则的例外处理；豁免

teaching_sense.en_definition: An officially permitted departure from a rule or requirement in a particular case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定情况下，经正式许可而不完全适用某项规则或要求的例外处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eċċezzjoni permessa uffiċjalment għall-applikazzjoni ta' regola jew rekwiżit f'każ partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对规则或要求的减免、豁免或例外适用。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva derogazzjoni temporanja mir-rekwiżit, bil-kundizzjonijiet imniżżla fid-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee approved a temporary derogation from the requirement, subject to the conditions listed in the decision.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了对该项要求的临时豁免，并规定须遵守决定中列明的条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu nitolbu derogazzjoni għal dan il-każ? David: Iva, imma rridu nispjegaw għaliex hemm bżonn eċċezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we request a derogation for this case? David: Yes, but we need to explain why an exception is needed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们可以为这个情况申请例外处理吗？戴维：可以，但我们得说明为什么需要例外。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitolbu derogazzjoni għal dan il-każ?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitolbu derogazzjoni għal dan il-każ?
messages.zh: 我们可以为这个情况申请例外处理吗？
messages.en: Can we request a derogation for this case?

messages.speaker: David (项目主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu nispjegaw għaliex hemm bżonn eċċezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu nispjegaw għaliex hemm bżonn eċċezzjoni.
messages.zh: 可以，但我们得说明为什么需要例外。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to explain why an exception is needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derogazzjoni 想成申请表上获准的一项“例外”：它是例外处理这件事的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who threshes harvested grain to separate the grains from the ears or stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给收割后的谷物打谷，使谷粒从穗或秆上分离出来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidres iċ-ċereali maħsuda biex tifred il-ħbub mis-sbul jew miz-zkuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打谷者；从事谷物脱粒工作的人。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri derrej waqt ix-xogħol, jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul wara l-ħsad.
formal.en: The photograph shows a thresher at work, separating the grains from the ears after the harvest.
formal.zh: 照片展示了一名打谷者在收割后工作，将谷粒从穗上分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-għalqa? Toni: Dak hu d-derrej; qed jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that man in the field? Toni: That's the thresher; he's separating the grains from the ears.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：田里的那个男人是谁？托尼：他是打谷者，正在把谷粒从穗上分离出来。

messages.speaker: Marija (参观者)
messages.zh: 田里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the field?

messages.speaker: Toni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu d-derrej; qed jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu d-derrej; qed jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul.
messages.zh: 他是打谷者，正在把谷粒从穗上分离出来。
messages.en: That's the thresher; he's separating the grains from the ears.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 derrej 配一张人物卡：收割以后，这个人负责把谷粒从谷穗上打下来，记住“打谷者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To thresh grain repeatedly in order to separate the grains from the ears or stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复给谷物打谷，使谷粒从穗或秆上脱离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidres iċ-ċereali għal darba wara oħra biex tifred il-ħbub mis-sbul jew miz-zkuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复打谷；多次进行谷物脱粒。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem derres il-qamħ għal darba wara oħra sakemm il-ħbub infirdu mis-sbul.
formal.en: The worker threshed the wheat again and again until the grains separated from the ears.
formal.zh: 工人反复给小麦打谷，直到谷粒从穗上分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għad hemm qamħ fuq is-sbul? Ġużeppi: Ma nafx; Toni derres il-qamħ għal darba wara oħra dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there still grain on the ears? Ġużeppi: I don't know; Toni threshed the wheat again and again this morning.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么穗上还有谷粒？朱塞佩：我不知道，托尼今天早上已经反复给小麦打谷了。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għad hemm qamħ fuq is-sbul?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għad hemm qamħ fuq is-sbul?
messages.zh: 为什么穗上还有谷粒？
messages.en: Why is there still grain on the ears?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; Toni derres il-qamħ għal darba wara oħra dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; Toni derres il-qamħ għal darba wara oħra dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 我不知道，托尼今天早上已经反复给小麦打谷了。
messages.en: I don't know; Toni threshed the wheat again and again this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derres 想成一段循环播放的打谷动作：一下接一下，重点记住“反复进行脱粒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who threshes harvested cereals to separate the grain from the ears or stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事收获后谷物脱粒工作，将谷粒与穗或秆分开的劳动者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jidres iċ-ċereali maħsuda biex jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul jew miz-zkuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打谷者；从事谷物脱粒工作的人。

formal.mt: Id-derries wera lill-istudenti kif il-ħbub jinfirdu mis-sbul waqt id-dris.
formal.en: The thresher showed the students how the grains separate from the ears during threshing.
formal.zh: 打谷者向学生展示了打谷时谷粒如何从穗上分离。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jurina kif isir id-dris? Pietru: Id-derries se jurina; ilu jagħmel dan ix-xogħol ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will show us how threshing is done? Pietru: The thresher will show us; he has been doing this work for many years.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来给我们演示怎么打谷？彼得：打谷者会给我们演示，他干这项工作已经很多年了。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jurina kif isir id-dris?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jurina kif isir id-dris?
messages.zh: 谁来给我们演示怎么打谷？
messages.en: Who will show us how threshing is done?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-derries se jurina; ilu jagħmel dan ix-xogħol ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Id-derries se jurina; ilu jagħmel dan ix-xogħol ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 打谷者会给我们演示，他干这项工作已经很多年了。
messages.en: The thresher will show us; he has been doing this work for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derries 放在农场人物名单中，旁边写“负责打谷的人”；用人物形象记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 具有打谷能力的；能脱粒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to thresh grain by separating the grains from the ears or stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有给谷物打谷、将谷粒从穗或秆上分离出来的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jew il-kapaċità li jidres iċ-ċereali u jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul jew miz-zkuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有打谷能力的；能够进行谷物脱粒的。

collocations.zh: 具有脱粒能力的机械装置

formal.mt: Il-mudell jinkludi mekkaniżmu derriesi li jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul.
formal.en: The model includes a mechanism capable of threshing that separates the grains from the ears.
formal.zh: 该模型包含一个具有脱粒能力的机械装置，可将谷粒从穗上分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-apparat derriesi kif jaħdem? Ġorġ: Jifred il-ħbub mis-sbul; ejja nurik.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does this equipment that can thresh work? Ġorġ: It separates the grains from the ears; let me show you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这台能脱粒的设备怎么工作？乔治：它把谷粒从穗上分离出来，我演示给你看。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.zh: 这台能脱粒的设备怎么工作？
messages.en: How does this equipment that can thresh work?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (农机指导员)
messages.zh: 它把谷粒从穗上分离出来，我演示给你看。
messages.en: It separates the grains from the ears; let me show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象设备说明卡上写着“能打谷”：derriesi 是描述脱粒能力的形容词，记住它在说明“能做什么”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a situation, system, or institution less stable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种局势、系统或机构变得不稳定的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħmel sitwazzjoni, sistema jew istituzzjoni inqas stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失稳；使局势、系统或机构的稳定性受到破坏的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kif bidliet f'daqqa jistgħu jwasslu għad-destabbilizzazzjoni tas-sistema.
formal.en: The report analyses how sudden changes can lead to the destabilisation of the system.
formal.zh: 报告分析了突然的变化如何可能导致系统失稳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri destabbilizzazzjoni f'dan it-test? Daniel: Tfisser li s-sitwazzjoni qed issir inqas stabbli, bħal meta l-pjanijiet jinbidlu l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does destabilisation mean in this text? Daniel: It means the situation is becoming less stable, like when plans keep changing all the time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的“失稳”是什么意思？丹尼尔：意思是局面变得不那么稳定，就像计划一直变来变去那样。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“失稳”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does destabilisation mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li s-sitwazzjoni qed issir inqas stabbli, bħal meta l-pjanijiet jinbidlu l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li s-sitwazzjoni qed issir inqas stabbli, bħal meta l-pjanijiet jinbidlu l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 意思是局面变得不那么稳定，就像计划一直变来变去那样。
messages.en: It means the situation is becoming less stable, like when plans keep changing all the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张原本稳固的桌子开始摇晃，把 destabbilizzazzjoni 记成“从稳定变得不稳定”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person to whom a letter, message, or other communication is addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信件、消息或其他通信所指定的接收者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna li lilha tkun indirizzata ittra, messaġġ jew komunikazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收件人；通信所指定的接收者。

formal.mt: Qabel tibgħat l-ittra, iċċekkja li isem id-destinatarju u l-indirizz tiegħu huma korretti.
formal.en: Before sending the letter, check that the addressee's name and address are correct.
formal.zh: 寄信前，请核对收件人的姓名和地址是否正确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu d-destinatarju ta' din l-ittra? Mark: Ħija Pawlu. Se nibgħathielu llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this letter addressed to? Mark: My brother Pawlu. I'll send it to him today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这封信的收件人是谁？马克：我兄弟保罗。我今天会寄给他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-destinatarju ta' din l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-destinatarju ta' din l-ittra?
messages.zh: 这封信的收件人是谁？
messages.en: Who is this letter addressed to?

messages.speaker: Mark (寄信人)
messages.zh: 我兄弟保罗。我今天会寄给他。
messages.en: My brother Pawlu. I'll send it to him today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信封上写着收件人的姓名，把 destinatarju 与“这封信寄给谁”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in which a condition, quality, or state becomes worse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 状况、质量或状态变得比原来更差的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li fiha kundizzjoni, kwalità jew stat isiru agħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶化；状况或质量的下降。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi deterjorament fil-kundizzjoni tal-bini minħabba nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a deterioration in the condition of the building due to a lack of maintenance.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这栋建筑因缺乏维护而出现的状况恶化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Innutajt deterjorament fil-kwalità ta' dawn iż-żraben? Ben: Iva, dan il-par tqatta' wara ġimgħa biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you noticed a deterioration in the quality of these shoes? Ben: Yes, this pair tore after just one week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有没有发现这些鞋的质量变差了？本：有，这双只穿了一星期就破了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt deterjorament fil-kwalità ta' dawn iż-żraben?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt deterjorament fil-kwalità ta' dawn iż-żraben?
messages.zh: 你有没有发现这些鞋的质量变差了？
messages.en: Have you noticed a deterioration in the quality of these shoes?

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-par tqatta' wara ġimgħa biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-par tqatta' wara ġimgħa biss.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一双鞋从完好到破损，把 deterjorament 记成“状况一步步变差”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grammatical word or element that specifies the reference or scope of a noun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于限定名词所指对象或范围的语法词语或成分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew element grammatikali li jispeċifika r-referenza jew il-firxa ta' nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限定词；用于限定名词所指对象或范围的语法成分。

formal.mt: F'din il-frażi, id-determinanti jgħin lill-qarrej jidentifika liema ktieb qed jissemma.
formal.en: In this phrase, the determiner helps the reader identify which book is being referred to.
formal.zh: 在这个短语中，限定词帮助读者确定所指的是哪一本书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jagħmel id-determinanti f'din il-frażi? Pawlu: Jgħinna nifhmu liema ktieb qed insemmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the determiner do in this phrase? Pawlu: It helps us understand which book we are referring to.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个短语里的限定词有什么作用？保罗：它帮助我们弄清说的是哪一本书。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个短语里的限定词有什么作用？
messages.en: What does the determiner do in this phrase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħinna nifhmu liema ktieb qed insemmu.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħinna nifhmu liema ktieb qed insemmu.
messages.zh: 它帮助我们弄清说的是哪一本书。
messages.en: It helps us understand which book we are referring to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 determinanti 想成名词旁的指示牌，帮助回答“具体是哪一个或哪一些”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decisive in establishing an outcome, or definite and clearly specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对结果起决定作用的；或明确、确定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett deċiżiv fuq riżultat, jew li huwa ċar u definit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定性的；对结果起关键决定作用的。
明确的；确定的。

formal.mt: Il-prezz kien fattur determinattiv fl-għażla tal-fornitur.
formal.en: Price was a decisive factor in the choice of supplier.
formal.zh: 价格是选择供应商时的决定性因素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan il-kors? Mark: Il-ħin kien determinattiv għalija; il-lezzjonijiet isiru wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this course? Mark: The timing was decisive for me; the lessons take place after work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选这门课？马克：上课时间对我起了决定性作用；课程安排在下班后。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这门课？
messages.en: Why did you choose this course?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħin kien determinattiv għalija; il-lezzjonijiet isiru wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħin kien determinattiv għalija; il-lezzjonijiet isiru wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 上课时间对我起了决定性作用；课程安排在下班后。
messages.en: The timing was decisive for me; the lessons take place after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 determinattiv 的两个提示：“决定结果”与“明确确定”，再结合语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds that events, including human actions, are determined by prior causes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为事件，包括人的行为，都由先前原因所决定的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqis li l-ġrajjiet, inklużi l-azzjonijiet tal-bniedem, huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定论者；主张事件由先前原因决定的人。

formal.mt: Fid-dibattitu, id-determinista sostna li l-għażliet tal-bniedem huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti.
formal.en: In the debate, the determinist argued that human choices are determined by prior causes.
formal.zh: 在辩论中，这位决定论者主张人的选择由先前原因所决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid li int determinista, xi trid tfisser? Ben: Li nemmen li kull għażla tagħna hija determinata minn kawżi preċedenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say you are a determinist, what do you mean? Ben: That I believe every choice we make is determined by prior causes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你说自己是决定论者，是什么意思？本：意思是我相信，我们的每个选择都由先前原因所决定。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li int determinista, xi trid tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li int determinista, xi trid tfisser?
messages.zh: 你说自己是决定论者，是什么意思？
messages.en: When you say you are a determinist, what do you mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nemmen li kull għażla tagħna hija determinata minn kawżi preċedenti.
messages.mt_standard: Li nemmen li kull għażla tagħna hija determinata minn kawżi preċedenti.
messages.zh: 意思是我相信，我们的每个选择都由先前原因所决定。
messages.en: That I believe every choice we make is determined by prior causes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 determinista 放进人物卡片，记作“相信先前原因决定事件的人”，突出它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view that events, including human actions, are determined by prior causes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为事件，包括人的行为，都由先前原因所决定的观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li l-ġrajjiet, inklużi l-azzjonijiet tal-bniedem, huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定论；认为事件由先前原因决定的观点或理论。

formal.mt: L-esej jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn id-determiniżmu u r-rieda ħielsa.
formal.en: The essay examines the relationship between determinism and free will.
formal.zh: 这篇文章探讨决定论与自由意志之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu d-determiniżmu? Pawlu: Hija l-fehma li l-ġrajjiet huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti, anki l-għażliet tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is determinism? Pawlu: It is the view that events are determined by prior causes, including our choices.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是决定论？保罗：就是认为事件由先前原因所决定的观点，我们的选择也包括在内。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是决定论？
messages.en: What is determinism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-fehma li l-ġrajjiet huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti, anki l-għażliet tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-fehma li l-ġrajjiet huma determinati minn kawżi preċedenti, anki l-għażliet tagħna.
messages.zh: 就是认为事件由先前原因所决定的观点，我们的选择也包括在内。
messages.en: It is the view that events are determined by prior causes, including our choices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 determiniżmu 放进理论卡片，与指人的 determinista 对照：一个是观点，一个是持观点的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of intense dislike or hatred toward someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物极其强烈的厌恶或憎恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ħafna ta' stmerrija jew mibegħda lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 憎恶；极其强烈的厌恶。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur esprima d-detestazzjoni tiegħu lejn il-moħqrija tal-annimali.
formal.en: In his letter, the author expressed his detestation of cruelty to animals.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了对虐待动物行为的深恶痛绝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex użajt il-kelma detestazzjoni? Mark: Għax ma ridtx ngħid biss li ma togħġobnix il-vjolenza; inħoss stmerrija kbira lejha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you use the word detestation? Mark: Because I did not just mean that I dislike violence; I feel a strong revulsion toward it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用了“憎恶”这个词？马克：因为我想说的并不只是我不喜欢暴力；我对暴力有非常强烈的厌恶。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么用了“憎恶”这个词？
messages.en: Why did you use the word detestation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma ridtx ngħid biss li ma togħġobnix il-vjolenza; inħoss stmerrija kbira lejha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma ridtx ngħid biss li ma togħġobnix il-vjolenza; inħoss stmerrija kbira lejha.
messages.zh: 因为我想说的并不只是我不喜欢暴力；我对暴力有非常强烈的厌恶。
messages.en: Because I did not just mean that I dislike violence; I feel a strong revulsion toward it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用情绪强度来记：从“不喜欢”升到“深恶痛绝”，到达 detestazzjoni 的强烈程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With thorough attention to the individual facts, parts, or steps of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充分说明或处理具体事实、组成部分或步骤地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jagħti attenzjoni sħiħa lill-fatti, lill-partijiet jew lill-passi individwali ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细地；逐项说明细节地。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega dettaljatament il-passi meħtieġa biex titlesta l-proċedura.
formal.en: The report explains in detail the steps needed to complete the procedure.
formal.zh: 报告详细解释了完成该程序所需的各个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tispjegali dettaljatament kif nasal hemm? Ben: Żgur. Ħu l-ewwel triq fuq ix-xellug, imbagħad imxi dritt sal-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you explain to me in detail how to get there? Ben: Of course. Take the first street on the left, then walk straight to the square.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能详细告诉我怎么去那里吗？本：当然。走左边第一条街，然后一直走到广场。

messages.speaker: Lara (问路者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tispjegali dettaljatament kif nasal hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tispjegali dettaljatament kif nasal hemm?
messages.zh: 你能详细告诉我怎么去那里吗？
messages.en: Can you explain to me in detail how to get there?

messages.speaker: Ben (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Ħu l-ewwel triq fuq ix-xellug, imbagħad imxi dritt sal-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Ħu l-ewwel triq fuq ix-xellug, imbagħad imxi dritt sal-pjazza.
messages.zh: 当然。走左边第一条街，然后一直走到广场。
messages.en: Of course. Take the first street on the left, then walk straight to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讲解时把每个步骤逐一放大，dettaljatament 就是“把细节讲清楚地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of writing down words that another person reads aloud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把别人朗读或口述的词句写下来的活动，常用于语言学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li fiha persuna tikteb il-kliem li persuna oħra taqra jew tgħid b'leħen għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听写；口授，即一人口述、另一人记录的活动。

formal.mt: L-għalliema tuża eżerċizzju ta' dettatura biex tevalwa l-ortografija tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The teacher uses a dictation exercise to assess the students' spelling.
formal.zh: 老师用听写练习评估学生的拼写能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna dettatura għada? Mark: Iva, ejja nipprattikaw għaxar kelmiet flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have a dictation tomorrow? Mark: Yes, let's practise ten words together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天有听写吗？Mark：有，我们一起练十个词吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们明天有听写吗？
messages.en: Do we have a dictation tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nipprattikaw għaxar kelmiet flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nipprattikaw għaxar kelmiet flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，我们一起练十个词吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's practise ten words together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dettatura 配上课堂画面：老师念一句，学生写一句，记住它表示听写或口授。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in value, especially a reduction in the value of a currency relative to other currencies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价值的降低，尤其指一种货币相对于其他货币的价值下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-valur ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment fil-valur ta' munita meta mqabbla ma' muniti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬值；价值降低，尤指货币相对于其他货币的价值降低。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif id-devalutazzjoni tal-munita żiedet l-ispiża tal-importazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The report examines how the devaluation of the currency increased the cost of imports.
formal.zh: 报告分析了货币贬值如何提高进口成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-prodott importat sar jiswa aktar? Mark: Minħabba d-devalutazzjoni tal-munita tagħna, irridu nħallsu aktar biex nixtruh minn barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has this imported product become more expensive? Mark: Because of the devaluation of our currency, we have to pay more to buy it from abroad.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个进口产品怎么变贵了？Mark：因为我们的货币贬值了，从国外买它就得多付钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-prodott importat sar jiswa aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-prodott importat sar jiswa aktar?
messages.zh: 这个进口产品怎么变贵了？
messages.en: Why has this imported product become more expensive?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-devalutazzjoni tal-munita tagħna, irridu nħallsu aktar biex nixtruh minn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-devalutazzjoni tal-munita tagħna, irridu nħallsu aktar biex nixtruh minn barra.
messages.zh: 因为我们的货币贬值了，从国外买它就得多付钱。
messages.en: Because of the devaluation of our currency, we have to pay more to buy it from abroad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 devalutazzjoni 时想象同样一张钞票能换到的外币变少，用这个画面联想货币贬值。

gloss_zh: 毁坏者；造成严重破坏的人或事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that causes extensive destruction or serious damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成大范围毁坏或严重损害的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li teqred jew tikkawża ħsara kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏者；破坏者；造成严重毁坏的人或事物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lill-ħarrub bħala devastatur tal-għelejjel.
formal.en: The report describes the locust as a destroyer of crops.
formal.zh: 报告将蝗虫描述为庄稼的毁坏者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm kiel weraq dan l-insett! Mark: Huwa devastatur veru tal-pjanti; irridu nipproteġu l-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many leaves this insect has eaten! Mark: It is a real destroyer of plants; we need to protect the garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，这只虫吃掉了多少叶子！Mark：它真是植物的毁坏者，我们得保护花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm kiel weraq dan l-insett!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm kiel weraq dan l-insett!
messages.zh: 看，这只虫吃掉了多少叶子！
messages.en: Look how many leaves this insect has eaten!

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa devastatur veru tal-pjanti; irridu nipproteġu l-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa devastatur veru tal-pjanti; irridu nipproteġu l-ġnien.
messages.zh: 它真是植物的毁坏者，我们得保护花园。
messages.en: It is a real destroyer of plants; we need to protect the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 devastatur 放在破坏现场，问自己是谁或什么造成毁坏，答案就是这个词所指的毁坏者。

gloss_zh: 严重毁坏；满目疮痍的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extensive destruction or severe damage affecting a place or its surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地方或其周围遭到大范围毁坏、严重破坏的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerda mifruxa jew ħsara kbira f'post jew fl-inħawi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重毁坏；大范围破坏；遭到毁坏后的惨状。

formal.mt: L-għargħar ikkawża devastazzjoni kbira fir-raħal u ħalla ħafna familji mingħajr dar.
formal.en: The flood caused extensive devastation in the village and left many families homeless.
formal.zh: 洪水给村庄造成严重破坏，使许多家庭无家可归。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratti wara l-maltemp? Mark: Iva, hemm devastazzjoni kbira; ħafna djar tilfu s-soqfa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the photos taken after the storm? Mark: Yes, there is extensive devastation; many houses have lost their roofs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看过暴风雨后的照片吗？Mark：看过，破坏很严重，许多房子的屋顶都没了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过暴风雨后的照片吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the photos taken after the storm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm devastazzjoni kbira; ħafna djar tilfu s-soqfa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm devastazzjoni kbira; ħafna djar tilfu s-soqfa.
messages.zh: 看过，破坏很严重，许多房子的屋顶都没了。
messages.en: Yes, there is extensive devastation; many houses have lost their roofs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 devastazzjoni 配上灾后满目疮痍的照片，记住它指严重毁坏的情况；可与指毁坏者的 devastatur 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or occurrence of a solid becoming liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 固体变成液体的过程或一次融化、熔化现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-okkorrenza li fiha materjal solidu jsir likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次融化或熔化；固体变成液体的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw id-dewba tas-silġ u rreġistraw il-bidla minn solidu għal likwidu.
formal.en: The students observed the melting of ice and recorded the change from solid to liquid.
formal.zh: 学生观察了冰的融化，并记录了固体变成液体的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm l-ilma taħt il-kubi tas-silġ? Mark: Minħabba d-dewba tas-silġ; hawn sħun wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there water under the ice cubes? Mark: Because of the melting of the ice; it is too warm here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：冰块下面怎么有水？Mark：因为冰融化了，这里太热了。

messages.speaker: Maja (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm l-ilma taħt il-kubi tas-silġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm l-ilma taħt il-kubi tas-silġ?
messages.zh: 冰块下面怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water under the ice cubes?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-dewba tas-silġ; hawn sħun wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-dewba tas-silġ; hawn sħun wisq.
messages.zh: 因为冰融化了，这里太热了。
messages.en: Because of the melting of the ice; it is too warm here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 dewba 就想象桌上的冰块慢慢变成一滩水，用固体变液体的画面记住融化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The length of time something lasts, or a delay that makes something happen later than expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事持续的时间；也指使事情比预期更晚发生的延误或耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li ddum xi ħaġa, jew dewmien li jwassal biex xi ħaġa sseħħ aktar tard milli mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续时间；某件事从开始到结束所经历的时长。
延误；耽搁；使事情比原定或预期时间更晚发生的情况。

collocations.en: a duration or delay of one hour
collocations.zh: 一小时的持续时间或延误，具体依语境而定

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob id-data tal-attività u d-dewma tagħha f'minuti.
formal.en: The form asks for the date of the activity and its duration in minutes.
formal.zh: 表格要求填写活动日期及其以分钟计算的持续时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma tlaqniex? Mark: Hemm dewma ta' għaxar minuti minħabba t-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why haven't we left yet? Mark: There is a ten-minute delay because of the traffic.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们怎么还没出发？Mark：因为交通问题，要延误十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没出发？
messages.en: Why haven't we left yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm dewma ta' għaxar minuti minħabba t-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm dewma ta' għaxar minuti minħabba t-traffiku.
messages.zh: 因为交通问题，要延误十分钟。
messages.en: There is a ten-minute delay because of the traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两只钟记 dewma：一只量事情持续多久，另一只显示比计划晚多久，分别对应时长与延误。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of trying a small amount of food or drink to experience or assess its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝少量食物或饮料，以体验或判断其味道的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tipprova ftit ikel jew xorb biex tagħraf jew tevalwa t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝；试味，即通过尝少量食物或饮料来感受其味道的行为。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi sessjoni ta' dewq biex il-parteċipanti jqabblu t-togħmiet ta' prodotti differenti.
formal.en: The course includes a tasting session so that participants can compare the flavours of different products.
formal.zh: 课程设有品尝环节，让参加者比较不同产品的味道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għal sessjoni ta' dewq tal-ġobon? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nipprova xi tipi ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come to a cheese-tasting session? Mark: Yes, I'd like to try some new varieties.

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为生病或受伤的人提供治疗、帮助其康复的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfejjaq jew tgħin fil-fejqan ta' persuna marida jew imweġġgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治疗者；帮助他人恢复健康的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dewwej iżur lill-morda u joffrilhom l-għajnuna tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the healer visits the sick and offers them his help.
formal.zh: 在故事中，治疗者探望病人，并向他们提供帮助。

colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the story? Toni: He is a healer; he helps the sick.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的那个男人是谁？托尼：他是治疗者，帮助生病的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wind thread or a similar material around something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线或类似材料绕在某个物体上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar ħajt jew materjal simili madwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；卷绕，通常用于线。

formal.zh: 开始缝纫之前，他把线绕在线轴上。

colloquial.en: Lara: What should I do with this thread? Pawlu: Wind the thread around the spool, slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根线该怎么处理？保罗：慢慢把线绕在线轴上。

gloss_zh: 能使物质熔化或溶解的东西

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够使其他物质熔化或溶解的东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that has the ability to melt or dissolve things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使其他东西熔化或溶解能力的事物。

collocations.zh: 起熔化剂或溶解剂的作用

formal.zh: 在实验中，这种液体被用作溶解该固体物质的溶解剂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term describing something infested with bugs.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that turns with the wind to show the direction from which it is blowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随风转动、用来显示风从哪个方向吹来的装置。

formal.en: In the story, the gobbler finished his meal before the others began eating.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个狼吞虎咽的人在其他人开始吃饭之前就吃完了自己的饭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħija spiċċa l-platt kollu diġà! Ben: X'dexxiex! Jien għadni kemm bdejt.
colloquial.en: Lara: My brother has already finished the whole plate! Ben: What a gobbler! I've only just started.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我哥哥已经把整盘都吃完了！本：他可真能狼吞虎咽！我才刚开始吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥已经把整盘都吃完了！
messages.en: My brother has already finished the whole plate!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他可真能狼吞虎咽！我才刚开始吃。
messages.en: What a gobbler! I've only just started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给餐桌上吃得最快的人画一个人物标签“dexxiex”；这个词指吃东西的人，记忆焦点放在人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to eat food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有急切猛吃、狼吞虎咽倾向的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiekol malajr ħafna u bir-regħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to gobble down food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有狼吞虎咽地吃下食物的倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to gobble his food
collocations.zh: 吃饭爱狼吞虎咽的男孩

collocations.en: a dog that tends to gobble its food

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lit-tifel bħala dexxiexi, għax dejjem jiekol bl-għaġla.
formal.en: The author describes the boy as prone to gobbling because he always eats in a hurry.
formal.zh: 作者把这个男孩描写成爱狼吞虎咽的人，因为他吃饭总是很急。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr? Luqa: Iva, hu dexxiexi ħafna; il-platt jitbattal f'ħakka t'għajn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does your dog always eat that fast? Luqa: Yes, he really tends to gobble; the bowl is empty in no time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的狗吃东西总是这么快吗？卢卡：是啊，它特别爱猛吃，碗一下子就空了。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 你的狗吃东西总是这么快吗？
messages.en: Does your dog always eat that fast?
