messages.speaker: Luqa (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu dexxiexi ħafna; il-platt jitbattal f'ħakka t'għajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu dexxiexi ħafna; il-platt jitbattal f'ħakka t'għajn.
messages.zh: 是啊，它特别爱猛吃，碗一下子就空了。
messages.en: Yes, he really tends to gobble; the bowl is empty in no time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一个总是猛吃的男孩写评语“爱狼吞虎咽的”；用这句评语记住 dexxiexi 的形容词功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急切、快速地吃东西这一行为，即狼吞虎咽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol malajr ħafna u bir-regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对食物的猛吃、吞食；狼吞虎咽这一行为。

collocations.zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西这一行为

formal.mt: Ix-xena turi d-dexxix tal-ikel minn raġel li kien ilu ħafna ħin bil-ġuħ.
formal.en: The scene shows a man gobbling food after being hungry for a long time.
formal.zh: 这个场景展现了一名饿了很久的男子狼吞虎咽吃东西的情形。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan id-dexxix kollu għaliex? Ġanni: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna, imma issa niekol aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why all this gobbling? Ġanni: I was really hungry, but I'll eat more slowly now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：怎么吃得这么狼吞虎咽？詹尼：我刚才太饿了，不过现在会吃慢一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 怎么吃得这么狼吞虎咽？
messages.en: Why all this gobbling?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna, imma issa niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna, imma issa niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我刚才太饿了，不过现在会吃慢一点。
messages.en: I was really hungry, but I'll eat more slowly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一段食物迅速被吃光的视频命名为“dexxix”；这个名词给整个“猛吃过程”起名字。

gloss_zh: 分权；权力下放；去中心化

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transfer or distribution of authority and responsibilities from a central body to local bodies or separate units.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把权力与职责从中央机构转移或分配给地方机构或不同单位的过程；分权或权力下放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trasferiment jew it-tqassim tas-setgħat u r-responsabbiltajiet minn korp ċentrali lil korpi lokali jew unitajiet separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分权，权力下放；将原本集中的权力、职能或组织安排分散至地方或不同单位。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi deċentrament amministrattiv biex il-kunsilli lokali jkunu jistgħu jieħdu aktar deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: The report proposes administrative decentralization so that local councils can make more decisions.
formal.zh: 报告提出实行行政分权，让地方议会能够作出更多决定。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed jitkellmu fuq id-deċentrament? Ġużeppi: Biex aktar deċiżjonijiet jittieħdu hawn, minflok kollox jiġi deċiż mill-uffiċċju ċentrali.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are they talking about decentralization? Ġużeppi: So that more decisions are made here, instead of everything being decided by the central office.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他们为什么在讨论权力下放？朱塞佩：为了让更多决定能在本地作出，而不是所有事情都由总部决定。

messages.speaker: Marija (居民)
messages.zh: 他们为什么在讨论权力下放？
messages.en: Why are they talking about decentralization?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (地方议会职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex aktar deċiżjonijiet jittieħdu hawn, minflok kollox jiġi deċiż mill-uffiċċju ċentrali.
messages.mt_standard: Biex aktar deċiżjonijiet jittieħdu hawn, minflok kollox jiġi deċiż mill-uffiċċju ċentrali.
messages.zh: 为了让更多决定能在本地作出，而不是所有事情都由总部决定。
messages.en: So that more decisions are made here, instead of everything being decided by the central office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个中央圆圈，把代表决定权的小箭头分给多个地方圆圈；用这幅“权力分散图”记 deċentrament。

gloss_zh: 可辨读的；可解读的；可破译的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be read or understood despite unclear writing or an unfamiliar code.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虽因字迹模糊或使用不熟悉的代码而难以阅读，但仍能够辨认、理解或破译的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinqara jew jinftiehem minkejja kitba mhux ċara jew kodiċi mhux familjari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可辨读的，可解读的；能够被辨认或破译的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif tad-dokument, it-test sar deċifrabbli u seta' jiġi traskritt.
formal.en: After the document was cleaned, the text became decipherable and could be transcribed.
formal.zh: 文献清理后，文字变得可以辨读，也就能够转录了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-messaġġ deċifrabbli? Ben: Iva, jekk tkabbar ir-ritratt, tista' taqrah.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this message decipherable? Ben: Yes, if you enlarge the photo, you can read it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这条信息能辨认出来吗？本：能，把照片放大就可以读了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条信息能辨认出来吗？
messages.en: Is this message decipherable?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk tkabbar ir-ritratt, tista' taqrah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk tkabbar ir-ritratt, tista' taqrah.
messages.zh: 能，把照片放大就可以读了。
messages.en: Yes, if you enlarge the photo, you can read it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把模糊照片放大后终于读出文字，此时就可说 deċifrabbli；记忆重点是“能够被读懂”这一性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of working out the meaning of unclear writing or a coded text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过辨认、分析等方式弄清模糊文字或编码文本含义的过程；辨读或破译。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed jasal biex jaqra jew jifhem kitba mhux ċara jew test f'kodiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辨读，解读，破译；弄清难辨文字或编码信息含义的过程。

formal.mt: Id-deċiframent tal-manuskritt ħa diversi xhur minħabba l-linka faded u l-kitba diffiċli.
formal.en: The decipherment of the manuscript took several months because of the faded ink and difficult handwriting.
formal.zh: 由于墨迹褪色、字迹难辨，这份手稿的辨读工作花了数月时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif sejjer id-deċiframent tal-ittra? Samwel: Bil-mod, imma issa nista' naqra l-ewwel żewġ sentenzi.
colloquial.en: Rita: How is the decipherment of the letter going? Samwel: Slowly, but I can now read the first two sentences.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那封信的辨读进展如何？萨姆韦尔：进展很慢，不过我现在能读出前两句话了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 那封信的辨读进展如何？
messages.en: How is the decipherment of the letter going?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mod, imma issa nista' naqra l-ewwel żewġ sentenzi.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mod, imma issa nista' naqra l-ewwel żewġ sentenzi.
messages.zh: 进展很慢，不过我现在能读出前两句话了。
messages.en: Slowly, but I can now read the first two sentences.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象逐字辨认旧信、不断写下结果的全过程，用 deċiframent 给这项“辨读工作”命名，重点记住它表示过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works out the meaning of unclear writing or coded messages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事难辨文字辨读或编码信息破译的人；辨读者或破译者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li jirnexxilha taqra jew tifhem kitba diffiċli jew messaġġi f'kodiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破译者，辨读者；解读难辨文字或编码信息的人。

formal.mt: Id-deċifratur qabbel is-simboli ripetuti biex jidentifika l-istruttura tal-messaġġ.
formal.en: The decipherer compared the repeated symbols to identify the structure of the message.
formal.zh: 破译者比较了重复出现的符号，以识别信息的结构。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min se jkun id-deċifratur fil-logħba tagħna? David: Jien! Agħtini l-messaġġ sigriet u nipprova nifhmu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who will be the decipherer in our game? David: Me! Give me the secret message and I'll try to work it out.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们的游戏里谁来当破译者？戴维：我来！把秘密信息给我，我试着解开它。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun id-deċifratur fil-logħba tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun id-deċifratur fil-logħba tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们的游戏里谁来当破译者？
messages.en: Who will be the decipherer in our game?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Agħtini l-messaġġ sigriet u nipprova nifhmu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Agħtini l-messaġġ sigriet u nipprova nifhmu.
messages.zh: 我来！把秘密信息给我，我试着解开它。
messages.en: Me! Give me the secret message and I'll try to work it out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个词放进同一场景：deċifratur 是破译的人，deċiframent 是破译过程，deċifrabbli 表示信息可以被破译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large cardinal number called a decillion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个称为 decillion 的极大基数，用于表达极大的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru kardinali kbir ħafna, li jintuża biex jesprimi kwantità enormi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极大数名：decillion。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-matematika, l-istudenti jqabblu deċiljun wieħed ma' żewġ deċiljuni.
formal.en: In the mathematics exercise, the students compare one decillion with two decillion.
formal.zh: 在数学练习中，学生比较一个 decillion 与两个 decillion 的大小。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu kbir deċiljun? Pawlu: Kbir ħafna! Ejja niktbuh biex narawh aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How big is a decillion? Pawlu: Very big! Let's write it out so we can see it more clearly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：一个 decillion 有多大？保罗：非常大！我们把它写出来，看得更清楚些。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 一个 decillion 有多大？
messages.en: How big is a decillion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kbir ħafna! Ejja niktbuh biex narawh aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Kbir ħafna! Ejja niktbuh biex narawh aħjar.
messages.zh: 非常大！我们把它写出来，看得更清楚些。
messages.en: Very big! Let's write it out so we can see it more clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deċiljun 想成数学练习里一个需要专门命名的极大数量；先记住它对应 decillion，再练习“一个”和“两个”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process of becoming worse in condition, structure, quality, or function.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 状态、结构、质量或功能逐渐变差的过程；在生物或医学语境中可指退化、变性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li fih il-kundizzjoni, l-istruttura, il-kwalità jew il-funzjoni ta' xi ħaġa tmur għall-agħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退化；变性；状态、质量或功能的衰退。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi deġenerazzjoni gradwali tat-tessut u tnaqqis fil-funzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The study describes gradual tissue degeneration and a decline in its function.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了组织的逐渐退化及其功能下降。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser deġenerazzjoni f'din is-silta? Toni: Hawn tfisser li t-tessut bil-mod il-mod jitlef il-kwalità jew il-funzjoni normali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does degeneration mean in this passage? Toni: Here it means that the tissue gradually loses its normal quality or function.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这段话里的“deġenerazzjoni”是什么意思？托尼：这里指组织逐渐失去正常的质量或功能。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这段话里的“deġenerazzjoni”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does degeneration mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li t-tessut bil-mod il-mod jitlef il-kwalità jew il-funzjoni normali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li t-tessut bil-mod il-mod jitlef il-kwalità jew il-funzjoni normali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这里指组织逐渐失去正常的质量或功能。
messages.en: Here it means that the tissue gradually loses its normal quality or function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条功能逐渐下降的曲线，把 deġenerazzjoni 记成随过程发生的退化或衰退。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To involve oneself in someone else's affairs or decisions in an unwanted way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不受欢迎的方式介入他人的事务或决定；干涉、插手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindaħal fl-affarijiet jew fid-deċiżjonijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jkun mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干涉；插手他人的事情。

collocations.en: he interfered in other people's affairs
he interfered in a personal decision
collocations.zh: 他干涉了一项个人决定

formal.mt: Hu deħes fid-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat mingħajr ma kellu rwol fiha.
formal.en: He interfered in the committee's decision without having any role in it.
formal.zh: 他在并不参与相关工作的情况下，干涉了委员会的决定。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu deħes fl-affarijiet tiegħek? Lara: Iva, u għedtlu biex iħallini niddeċiedi waħdi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu interfere in your affairs? Lara: Yes, and I told him to let me decide for myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗插手你的事情了吗？拉拉：是的，我叫他让我自己决定。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗插手你的事情了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu interfere in your affairs?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għedtlu biex iħallini niddeċiedi waħdi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għedtlu biex iħallini niddeċiedi waħdi.
messages.zh: 是的，我叫他让我自己决定。
messages.en: Yes, and I told him to let me decide for myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deħes 放进“别人正做决定，却有人插手”的场景，记住干涉他人事务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making fun of other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿别人开玩笑、加以嘲笑或戏弄的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi lil ħaddieħor biż-żmien jew twaqqgħu għaċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取笑别人；嘲弄他人的行为。

collocations.mt: deħik fuq l-iżbalji ta' xi ħadd

formal.mt: Id-deħik fuq l-iżbalji tal-istudenti jista' jnaqqas il-fiduċja tagħhom fihom infushom.
formal.en: Making fun of students' mistakes can reduce their self-confidence.
formal.zh: 取笑学生的错误可能会削弱他们的自信心。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dak id-deħik fuq Marija? Mark: Għandek raġun, ma kellix ngħaddiha biż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why all that mockery of Marija? Mark: You're right, I shouldn't have made fun of her.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么那样取笑玛丽娅？马克：你说得对，我不该拿她开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么那样取笑玛丽娅？
messages.en: Why all that mockery of Marija?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, ma kellix ngħaddiha biż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, ma kellix ngħaddiha biż-żmien.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我不该拿她开玩笑。
messages.en: You're right, I shouldn't have made fun of her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 deħik 时想象笑声指向某个人：重点是拿别人取笑这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of placing a dead person or animal in the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将死者遗体或死亡动物埋入地下的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih ġisem mejjet jitqiegħed taħt l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埋葬；将遗体安置于地下的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Id-dfin sar fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal fil-preżenza tal-familja.
formal.en: The burial took place in the village cemetery in the presence of the family.
formal.zh: 安葬在村里的墓地进行，家属在场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Id-dfin se jsir għada? Pietru: Iva, fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal, fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will the burial take place tomorrow? Pietru: Yes, in the village cemetery at ten in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：明天安葬吗？彼得：是的，上午十点，在村里的墓地。

messages.speaker: Anna (亲属)
messages.zh: 明天安葬吗？
messages.en: Will the burial take place tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pietru (亲属)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal, fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal, fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，上午十点，在村里的墓地。
messages.en: Yes, in the village cemetery at ten in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“遗体入土，家属送别”的场景记住 dfin，学习重点放在“埋葬、安葬”这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The interlacing of strands or strips to make woven objects, or of sections of hair to make plaits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线、条状材料等交错编在一起的编织活动，也指把几束头发交叉编成辫子的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qsim u t-tqegħid ta' ħjut, strixxi jew trofof tax-xagħar fuq xulxin biex jinħolqu oġġetti minsuġa jew nisġiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织：使线、条状材料等相互交错，制成物品。
编辫；把几束头发或几股材料交叉编合。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi lezzjoni dwar id-dfir tal-qfief bl-użu ta' strixxi flessibbli.
formal.en: The course includes a lesson on weaving baskets using flexible strips.
formal.zh: 这门课程包含一节用柔韧条状材料编织篮筐的课。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Tista' tgħallimni d-dfir tax-xagħar? Marija: Iva, ejja nibdew billi naqsmu x-xagħar fi tliet trofof.
colloquial.en: Ella: Can you teach me hair plaiting? Marija: Yes, let's start by dividing the hair into three sections.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你能教我编辫子吗？玛丽娅：可以，我们先把头发分成三束。

messages.speaker: Ella (妹妹)
messages.zh: 你能教我编辫子吗？
messages.en: Can you teach me hair plaiting?

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nibdew billi naqsmu x-xagħar fi tliet trofof.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nibdew billi naqsmu x-xagħar fi tliet trofof.
messages.zh: 可以，我们先把头发分成三束。
messages.en: Yes, let's start by dividing the hair into three sections.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象编篮子和编辫子：材料都要交叉排列，用这两个画面分别记住 dfir 的两项词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of losing strength or becoming less strong over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量、体力或强度逐渐下降、变得更弱的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jitlef is-saħħa u jsir aktar dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变弱的过程；力量或强度的衰减。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi dgħajfien gradwali tal-muskoli matul diversi xhur.
formal.en: The report describes a gradual weakening of the muscles over several months.
formal.zh: 报告描述了数月期间肌肉力量逐渐减弱的过程。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jgħid ir-rapport dwar in-nannu? David: Isemmi dgħajfien gradwali, imma għad irridu nitkellmu mat-tabib.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does the report say about Grandad? David: It mentions gradual weakening, but we still need to speak to the doctor.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：报告怎么说爷爷的情况？戴维：里面提到逐渐衰弱，不过我们还要和医生谈谈。

messages.speaker: Rita (孙女)
messages.zh: 报告怎么说爷爷的情况？
messages.en: What does the report say about Grandad?

messages.speaker: David (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Isemmi dgħajfien gradwali, imma għad irridu nitkellmu mat-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Isemmi dgħajfien gradwali, imma għad irridu nitkellmu mat-tabib.
messages.zh: 里面提到逐渐衰弱，不过我们还要和医生谈谈。
messages.en: It mentions gradual weakening, but we still need to speak to the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象力量刻度随时间一格格下降，用动态画面记住 dgħajfien 强调“逐渐变弱的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An anointing ceremony, or the formal selection of someone for a role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某人施行的傅油仪式，也可指正式选定某人担任某个角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rit ta' dilka biż-żejt, jew għażla formali ta' persuna għal rwol.

sense_translations.en_definition: anointment or formal choice of sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人举行的傅油礼，或对某人的正式选定。

collocations.en: the formal selection of the leader

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċerimonja jispjega li d-dhin biż-żejt isir wara t-talba.
formal.en: The ceremony programme explains that the anointing with oil takes place after the prayer.
formal.zh: 仪式流程说明，傅油礼将在祈祷后举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser id-dhin f'dan il-programm? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser ir-rit li fih tintuża dilka biż-żejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dhin mean in this programme? Mark: Here it means the ritual in which someone is anointed with oil.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份流程中的 dhin 是什么意思？马克：这里指给人傅油的仪式。

messages.speaker: Maja (仪式参加者)
messages.zh: 这份流程中的 dhin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dhin mean in this programme?

messages.speaker: Mark (仪式讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser ir-rit li fih tintuża dilka biż-żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser ir-rit li fih tintuża dilka biż-żejt.
messages.zh: 这里指给人傅油的仪式。
messages.en: Here it means the ritual in which someone is anointed with oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dhin 放进正式仪式的画面：一边是给人傅油，一边是正式选定人选；用这两个场景并列记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing gold, or capable of yielding gold when processed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有黄金，或能够从中提取黄金的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih id-deheb jew li minnu jista' jinkiseb id-deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含有黄金的，或能够产出黄金的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi saff dhubi u jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-analiżi tal-kampjuni.
formal.en: The report describes a gold-bearing layer and presents the results of the sample analysis.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一层含金地层，并列出了样本分析结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser blat dhubi? Pawlu: Blat li fih id-deheb jew li minnu jista' jinkiseb id-deheb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does gold-bearing rock mean? Pawlu: Rock that contains gold or from which gold can be obtained.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：含金岩石是什么意思？保罗：就是里面含有黄金，或可以从中提取黄金的岩石。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 含金岩石是什么意思？
messages.en: What does gold-bearing rock mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Blat li fih id-deheb jew li minnu jista' jinkiseb id-deheb.
messages.mt_standard: Blat li fih id-deheb jew li minnu jista' jinkiseb id-deheb.
messages.zh: 就是里面含有黄金，或可以从中提取黄金的岩石。
messages.en: Rock that contains gold or from which gold can be obtained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块标着 dhubi 的岩石，内部藏着可以提取的黄金；把它与“含金岩石”整组记住。

gloss_zh: 幽灵般的显现；显现；表现

teaching_sense.en_definition: An apparition, or a manifestation through which something becomes visible or evident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幽灵般出现的形象，或某种事物变得可见、明显的显现与表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dehra bħal ta' spirtu, jew il-mod kif xi ħaġa tidher jew issir evidenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幽灵般突然出现的形象；幻影。
某种事物的显现、呈现或可察觉的表现。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rakkont, id-dhur misterjuż huwa interpretat bħala simbolu tal-biża' tal-protagonist.
formal.en: In the analysis of the story, the mysterious apparition is interpreted as a symbol of the protagonist's fear.
formal.zh: 在对故事的分析中，那个神秘幻影被解读为主人公恐惧的象征。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak id-dhur ħdejn it-tieqa fir-rakkont? Mark: Jidher bħal spirtu, imma l-awtur ma jgħidx min hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that apparition beside the window in the story? Mark: It looks like a spirit, but the author does not say who it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里窗边出现的那个幻影是什么？马克：看起来像个幽灵，但作者没说它是谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak id-dhur ħdejn it-tieqa fir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak id-dhur ħdejn it-tieqa fir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 故事里窗边出现的那个幻影是什么？
messages.en: What is that apparition beside the window in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher bħal spirtu, imma l-awtur ma jgħidx min hu.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher bħal spirtu, imma l-awtur ma jgħidx min hu.
messages.zh: 看起来像个幽灵，但作者没说它是谁。
messages.en: It looks like a spirit, but the author does not say who it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“显现”串联 dhur 的两个义项：故事里显现的是幻影，情感中显现的是喜悦等表现；分别记住两个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A figure or image that appears like a ghost or spirit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像幽灵或灵体一样出现的形象；幻影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dehra ta' figura li tidher bħal spirtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个幽灵般显现的形象；幻影。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, dhura misterjuża tidher fil-kuritur u tisparixxi qabel ma l-karattri jkunu jistgħu jersqu lejha.
formal.en: In the story, a mysterious apparition appears in the corridor and disappears before the characters can approach it.
formal.zh: 故事中，一个神秘幻影出现在走廊里，还没等人物们走近便消失了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik id-dhura fil-film beżżgħatek? Nina: Iva, speċjalment meta dehret wara l-bieb!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did that apparition in the film scare you? Nina: Yes, especially when it appeared behind the door!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影里的那个幻影吓到你了吗？妮娜：吓到了，尤其是它出现在门后时！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的那个幻影吓到你了吗？
messages.en: Did that apparition in the film scare you?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta dehret wara l-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta dehret wara l-bieb!
messages.zh: 吓到了，尤其是它出现在门后时！
messages.en: Yes, especially when it appeared behind the door!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dhura 配上一幅电影画面：门后忽然出现一个幻影；反复连读 dhura misterjuża，记住“神秘幻影”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wild animal of the dog family, typically living and hunting in packs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犬科野生动物，通常群居并成群捕猎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ tal-familja tal-klieb li ġeneralment jgħix u jikkaċċja fi gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼，一种通常群居的犬科野生动物。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, dib bil-ġuħ joħroġ mill-foresta u jersaq lejn ir-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, a hungry wolf comes out of the forest and approaches the village.
formal.zh: 故事中，一匹饥饿的狼走出森林，向村庄靠近。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dak dib fl-istampa? Pawlu: Iva, u ħdejh hemm il-frieħ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is that a wolf in the picture? Pawlu: Yes, and its cubs are beside it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：图片里那是一匹狼吗？保罗：是的，它旁边还有它的幼崽。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 图片里那是一匹狼吗？
messages.en: Is that a wolf in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħdejh hemm il-frieħ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħdejh hemm il-frieħ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，它旁边还有它的幼崽。
messages.en: Yes, and its cubs are beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dib 配上森林中狼的图片，再联想它的嗥叫声；用“看见狼、听见狼叫”两个感官画面巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open to discussion or disagreement because it is not clearly settled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚无明确定论，可以讨论、质疑或持不同意见的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi diskuss jew ikkontestat għax mhuwiex deċiż b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可争论的；有待商榷的。

formal.mt: Il-konklużjoni tar-rapport għadha dibattibbli minħabba n-nuqqas ta' evidenza.
formal.en: The report's conclusion remains debatable because of the lack of evidence.
formal.zh: 由于缺乏证据，报告的结论仍有待商榷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li din hija l-aħjar soluzzjoni? Mark: Dan għadu dibattibbli; ejja naraw l-għażliet l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think this is the best solution? Mark: That's still debatable; let's look at the other options.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这是最好的解决办法吗？马克：这还有待商榷；我们看看其他选择吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li din hija l-aħjar soluzzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li din hija l-aħjar soluzzjoni?
messages.zh: 你觉得这是最好的解决办法吗？
messages.en: Do you think this is the best solution?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan għadu dibattibbli; ejja naraw l-għażliet l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan għadu dibattibbli; ejja naraw l-għażliet l-oħra.
messages.zh: 这还有待商榷；我们看看其他选择吧。
messages.en: That's still debatable; let's look at the other options.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在一份尚未通过的结论旁，记成“还能讨论，尚未定论”，不要理解成已经被证明错误。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A discussion in which different views on a subject are presented and examined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某一议题提出并讨论不同观点的辩论或讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskussjoni li fiha jiġu ppreżentati u eżaminati fehmiet differenti dwar suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辩论；围绕某个议题展开的讨论。

formal.mt: Id-dibattiment dwar il-proposta ta lill-parteċipanti l-opportunità li jesprimu fehmiet differenti.
formal.en: The debate on the proposal gave participants the opportunity to express different views.
formal.zh: 围绕该提案的辩论让参与者有机会表达不同观点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tmur għad-dibattiment illejla? Pawlu: Iva, irrid nisma' ż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going to the debate tonight? Pawlu: Yes, I want to hear both sides.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今晚会去听辩论吗？保罗：会，我想听听双方的观点。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你今晚会去听辩论吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the debate tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 会，我想听听双方的观点。
messages.en: Yes, I want to hear both sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位发言者轮流陈述观点，把整个辩论活动标为 dibattiment；它表示活动本身。

gloss_zh: 无色而不透明的；暗灰褐色的；骝色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Colourless and opaque, or having a muted tawny or dark brownish-grey colour; also bay or reddish-brown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容无色而不透明的外观，也可形容暗淡的黄褐色、深灰褐色，或骝色、红棕色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla kulur u mhux trasparenti, jew ta' lewn kannella griż u mitfi; ukoll ta' lewn kannella ħamrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无色的；不透明的。

sense_translations.en_definition: mousy; tawny; muted, dark, brownish grey color
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼠灰色的；黄褐色的；色调暗淡、偏深的灰褐色的。
骝色的；红棕色的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher żiemel dibsi ħdejn il-bieb tar-razzett.
formal.en: The photograph shows a bay horse beside the farm gate.
formal.zh: 照片中，一匹骝色马站在农场大门旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema kowt se tilbes? Toni: Il-kowt dibsi; il-lewn tiegħu jaqbel mal-qalziet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which coat are you going to wear? Toni: The brownish-grey coat; its colour matches the trousers.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算穿哪件外套？托尼：那件灰褐色外套；它的颜色和裤子很配。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算穿哪件外套？
messages.en: Which coat are you going to wear?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowt dibsi; il-lewn tiegħu jaqbel mal-qalziet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowt dibsi; il-lewn tiegħu jaqbel mal-qalziet.
messages.zh: 那件灰褐色外套；它的颜色和裤子很配。
messages.en: The brownish-grey coat; its colour matches the trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情境卡分别记忆：不透明的无色玻璃、暗灰褐外套、红棕色马；依所修饰的物体判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become warm or tepid, without necessarily becoming hot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度发生变化，变暖或变得温温的，并不一定达到烫热的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir sħun ftit jew fietel, mingħajr ma bilfors isir jaħraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暖；变得温温的。

formal.mt: Wara ftit minuti fix-xemx, l-ilma fil-flixkun dief.
formal.en: After a few minutes in the sun, the water in the bottle became tepid.
formal.zh: 在阳光下放了几分钟后，瓶里的水变得温温的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ilma għadu kiesaħ? Pawlu: Le, dief ftit fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the water still cold? Pawlu: No, it warmed up a little in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水还是冷的吗？保罗：不是，晒了一会儿，已经有点温了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 水还是冷的吗？
messages.en: Is the water still cold?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，晒了一会儿，已经有点温了。
messages.en: No, it warmed up a little in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一瓶冷水晒过太阳后变温，把 dief 记作温度的变化动作，重点是“变暖了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something darker in colour or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物的颜色或外观变得更暗、更深。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-kulur jew id-dehra ta' xi ħaġa aktar skura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变暗；使颜色加深。

formal.mt: Id-duħħan diegħem il-ħajt ta' fuq il-fuklar.
formal.en: The smoke darkened the wall above the stove.
formal.zh: 烟使炉灶上方的墙面颜色变深了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-ħajt sar daqshekk skur? Toni: Id-duħħan diegħem il-ħajt; irridu nnaddfuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why has the wall become so dark? Toni: The smoke darkened it; we need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：墙怎么变得这么暗了？托尼：烟把墙熏暗了；我们得把它清理一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 墙怎么变得这么暗了？
messages.en: Why has the wall become so dark?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 烟把墙熏暗了；我们得把它清理一下。
messages.en: The smoke darkened it; we need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排放一面干净墙和一面被烟熏暗的墙，用 diegħem 标记颜色从浅到深的变化。

gloss_zh: 启发；启迪；赋予明辨能力

teaching_sense.en_definition: To inspire or enlighten someone, or give someone the ability to judge well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人启发，使其理解得更清楚，或赋予其良好的判断能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd ispirazzjoni, fehim aktar ċar jew il-ħila li jiġġudika tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发某人；给予某人灵感。
启迪某人；使某人明白或理解。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sb. the ability to judge well
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赋予某人良好的判断能力；使某人能够明辨。

collocations.zh: 赋予那位领导者明辨能力

formal.mt: Il-kliem tal-għalliem diehen lill-istudent u għenu jifhem il-problema.
formal.en: The teacher's words enlightened the student and helped him understand the problem.
formal.zh: 老师的话启迪了那名学生，帮助他理解了问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-parir tal-għalliem għen lil Mark? Sara: Iva, diehen lil Mark u issa jaf kif ikompli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the teacher's advice help Mark? Sara: Yes, it enlightened Mark, and now he knows how to continue.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师的建议帮到马克了吗？萨拉：帮到了，马克受到了启发，现在知道该怎么继续了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 老师的建议帮到马克了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher's advice help Mark?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diehen lil Mark u issa jaf kif ikompli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diehen lil Mark u issa jaf kif ikompli.
messages.zh: 帮到了，马克受到了启发，现在知道该怎么继续了。
messages.en: Yes, it enlightened Mark, and now he knows how to continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项连成学习画面：得到灵感、理解问题、作出好判断；共同记成给人的心智带来启发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a long time or to delay doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事花费很长时间，或迟迟没有采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ħafna ħin jew jitأخر biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花很长时间；耗时很久。
拖延；迟迟不行动。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol diem aktar milli kien ippjanat minħabba nuqqas ta' materjal.
formal.en: The work took longer than planned because of a shortage of materials.
formal.zh: 由于材料短缺，这项工作耗费的时间比计划更长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark wieġbek? Pawlu: Iva, imma diem ħafna biex wieġeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark reply to you? Pawlu: Yes, but he took a long time to reply.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克回复你了吗？保罗：回了，不过他过了很久才回复。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克回复你了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark reply to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma diem ħafna biex wieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma diem ħafna biex wieġeb.
messages.zh: 回了，不过他过了很久才回复。
messages.en: Yes, but he took a long time to reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等待回复时钟表一直走：事情耗时很久是一个义项，迟迟才行动是另一个义项，都抓住时间拉长的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to develop pus, especially when describing a wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易产生脓液的，尤用于描述伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jrabbi l-materja, speċjalment meta jingħad għal feriment.

sense_translations.en_definition: liable to suppurate (especially used of a wound etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易化脓的，尤用于伤口等。

collocations.en: a finger liable to develop pus

formal.mt: It-tabib iddeskriva l-feriment bħala dieni fir-rapport tiegħu.
formal.en: The doctor described the wound as liable to suppurate in his report.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中将该伤口描述为容易化脓。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser 'dieni' f'dan ir-rapport? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-feriment jista' jrabbi l-materja.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'dieni' mean in this report? Pawlu: It means that the wound may develop pus.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这份报告里的 dieni 是什么意思？保罗：意思是伤口可能会化脓。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 dieni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dieni' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-feriment jista' jrabbi l-materja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-feriment jista' jrabbi l-materja.
messages.zh: 意思是伤口可能会化脓。
messages.en: It means that the wound may develop pus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dieni 配着伤口图来记：重点是“容易化脓”，不必理解成已经流脓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name for ten used in games, such as when naming a playing card.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅在游戏中使用的“十”，例如用来称呼十点牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għan-numru għaxra li jintuża biss fil-logħob, pereżempju għal karta tal-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十；仅用于游戏中的称呼。

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba, id-dieċi għandu valur ta' għaxar punti.
formal.en: In this game, the ten is worth ten points.
formal.zh: 在这个游戏中，十点牌计十分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'karta ġibt? Mark: Ġibt dieċi; issa jmissek int.
colloquial.en: Maja: What card did you draw? Mark: I drew a ten; now it's your turn.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你抽到了什么牌？马克：我抽到了一张十点牌；现在轮到你了。

messages.speaker: Maja (牌友)
messages.zh: 你抽到了什么牌？
messages.en: What card did you draw?

messages.speaker: Mark (牌友)
messages.zh: 我抽到了一张十点牌；现在轮到你了。
messages.en: I drew a ten; now it's your turn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dieċi 写在游戏里的十点牌上，连同“游戏专用”一起记忆；日常数数的“十”用 għaxra。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become slightly warm or lukewarm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得稍暖或温温的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir sħun xi ftit jew fietel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暖；变得温温的。
温和的天气，尤指冬季的暖和天气。

formal.mt: L-ilma difa wara li tħalla fix-xemx għal xi ħin.
formal.en: The water became warm after being left in the sun for a while.
formal.zh: 水在阳光下放了一会儿后变暖了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ilma għadu kiesaħ? Mark: Le, difa ftit fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the water still cold? Mark: No, it has warmed up a little in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水还是冷的吗？马克：不是，晒了太阳，稍微变暖了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 水还是冷的吗？
messages.en: Is the water still cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，晒了太阳，稍微变暖了。
messages.en: No, it has warmed up a little in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冬日阳光把冷水晒温：作动词记“变暖”，作名词记“温和天气”，两种词性分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a different way or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以另一种方式或与其他情况不同的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod differenti jew b'mod ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同地；以不同的方式。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ riċerkaturi interpretaw l-istess riżultati differentement.
formal.en: The two researchers interpreted the same results differently.
formal.zh: 两位研究者对同一组结果作出了不同的解读。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għamiltu hekk? Ben: Jien fhimt l-istruzzjonijiet differentement.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you do it that way? Ben: I understood the instructions differently.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么那样做？本：我对说明的理解不一样。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么那样做？
messages.en: Why did you do it that way?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 我对说明的理解不一样。
messages.en: I understood the instructions differently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人读同一份说明，却用了两种做法；differentement 回答的是“怎样做”：以不同方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to differences or, in mathematics, to derivatives and rates of change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与差别有关的；在数学中指与微分、导数或变化率有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mad-differenzi jew, fil-matematika, mad-derivati u mar-rati ta' bidla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 差别的；差异性的；微分的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża ekwazzjoni differentjali biex jiddeskrivi kif tinbidel il-kwantità maż-żmien.
formal.en: The report uses a differential equation to describe how the quantity changes over time.
formal.zh: 报告使用微分方程来描述该数量如何随时间变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din ekwazzjoni differentjali? Karl: Iva, fiha derivata tal-funzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a differential equation? Karl: Yes, it contains a derivative of the function.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是微分方程吗？卡尔：是的，里面有这个函数的导数。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是微分方程吗？
messages.en: Is this a differential equation?

messages.speaker: Karl (老师)
messages.zh: 是的，里面有这个函数的导数。
messages.en: Yes, it contains a derivative of the function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用固定搭配 ekwazzjoni differentjali 记“微分方程”，看到导数符号就联想到数学中的“微分的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hard to do, understand, or complete; requiring considerable effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以进行、理解或完成的；需要付出较多努力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu iebes biex isir, jinftiehem jew jitlesta, u jeħtieġ ħafna sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难的；难做的；费力的。

formal.mt: Il-kompitu kien diffikultuż għax kien jeħtieġ analiżi ta' ħafna dokumenti.
formal.en: The task was difficult because it required the analysis of many documents.
formal.zh: 这项任务很困难，因为需要分析大量文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan l-eżerċizzju diffikultuż ħafna. David: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: This exercise is very difficult. David: Let's break it into small steps and do it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这道练习非常难。戴维：我们把它分成小步骤，一起做吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习非常难。
messages.en: This exercise is very difficult.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqsmuh f'passi żgħar u nagħmluh flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们把它分成小步骤，一起做吧。
messages.en: Let's break it into small steps and do it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diffikultuż 写在一道难题旁边，记成“这件事很困难”；它是形容词，可搭配 xogħol 或 kompitu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With difficulty or considerable effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时遇到困难或需要费力地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'diffikultà jew bi sforz kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难地；费力地。

formal.mt: Il-bieb infetaħ diffiċilment minħabba s-sadid fuq iċ-ċappetti.
formal.en: The door opened with difficulty because of rust on the hinges.
formal.zh: 由于铰链生锈，门很费力才打开。

colloquial.mt: Ġanni: Dan il-kexxun jinfetaħ diffiċilment. Sara: Iġbdu bil-mod; forsi hemm xi ħaġa mwaħħla.
colloquial.en: Ġanni: This drawer is difficult to open. Sara: Pull it slowly; perhaps something is stuck.
colloquial.zh: 詹尼：这个抽屉很费力才能拉开。萨拉：慢慢拉，可能有东西卡住了。

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 这个抽屉很费力才能拉开。
messages.en: This drawer is difficult to open.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iġbdu bil-mod; forsi hemm xi ħaġa mwaħħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iġbdu bil-mod; forsi hemm xi ħaġa mwaħħla.
messages.zh: 慢慢拉，可能有东西卡住了。
messages.en: Pull it slowly; perhaps something is stuck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象费劲拉开生锈的门：diffiċilment 描述动作进行得“很费力”，记忆时把它接在动作后面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a substance, information, or an idea spreads through an area or among people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物质在某个空间中扩散，或信息、观念在人群中传播的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih sustanza tinfirex f'żona, jew informazzjoni u ideat jinfirxu fost in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩散；传播；散布。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina d-diffużjoni tal-informazzjoni fost il-membri tal-komunità.
formal.en: The study examines the spread of information among members of the community.
formal.zh: 该研究考察信息在社区成员之间的传播。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser 'diffużjoni' f'din il-lezzjoni? Samwel: Tfisser kif sustanza tinfirex, bħal gass fl-arja.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does 'diffużjoni' mean in this lesson? Samwel: It means how a substance spreads, like a gas in the air.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这节课里的 diffużjoni 是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：指物质如何扩散，比如气体在空气中扩散。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这节课里的 diffużjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'diffużjoni' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Samwel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser kif sustanza tinfirex, bħal gass fl-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser kif sustanza tinfirex, bħal gass fl-arja.
messages.zh: 指物质如何扩散，比如气体在空气中扩散。
messages.en: It means how a substance spreads, like a gas in the air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个点，再画向四周散开的箭头：物质散开叫“扩散”，消息传开叫“传播”，都可联系 diffużjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evergreen shrub with narrow leaves and clusters of flowers, known scientifically as Nerium oleander.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夹竹桃，学名 Nerium oleander，是一种叶片狭长、花朵成簇的常绿灌木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell dejjem aħdar b'weraq dojoq u fjuri fi gruppi, magħruf xjentifikament bħala Nerium oleander.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹竹桃（Nerium oleander）。

formal.mt: Id-difla fil-ġnien għandha weraq dojoq u fjuri roża.
formal.en: The oleander in the garden has narrow leaves and pink flowers.
formal.zh: 花园里的夹竹桃长着狭长的叶片，开着粉红色的花。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jisimha dik il-pjanta bil-fjuri roża? Toni: Dik difla; għandna waħda wkoll fil-ġnien tagħna.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's that plant with the pink flowers called? Toni: That's an oleander; we have one in our garden too.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那棵开粉红色花的植物叫什么？托尼：那是夹竹桃，我们家花园里也有一棵。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 那棵开粉红色花的植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's that plant with the pink flowers called?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik difla; għandna waħda wkoll fil-ġnien tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dik difla; għandna waħda wkoll fil-ġnien tagħna.
messages.zh: 那是夹竹桃，我们家花园里也有一棵。
messages.en: That's an oleander; we have one in our garden too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 difla 写在夹竹桃图片下，用“狭长叶片、成簇花朵”的画面记住植物名，再配读 fjuri tad-difla。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of placing a dead person's body in a grave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将逝者遗体安置于墓中的行为，即埋葬或安葬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġisem ta' persuna mejta jitqiegħed f'qabar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次埋葬或安葬。

formal.mt: Id-difna se ssir fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal fil-preżenza tal-familja.
formal.en: The burial will take place in the village cemetery in the presence of the family.
formal.zh: 安葬将在村里的公墓举行，家人将到场。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se ssir id-difna? Pawlu: Għada filgħodu, u l-familja talbet li tkun privata.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will the burial take place? Pawlu: Tomorrow morning, and the family has asked for it to be private.
colloquial.zh: Marija：什么时候安葬？Pawlu：明天早上，家人希望以私人方式进行。

messages.speaker: Marija (亲友)
messages.zh: 什么时候安葬？
messages.en: When will the burial take place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (逝者家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu, u l-familja talbet li tkun privata.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu, u l-familja talbet li tkun privata.
messages.zh: 明天早上，家人希望以私人方式进行。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning, and the family has asked for it to be private.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 difna 配上遗体安放入墓的画面，记住它指安葬这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or appliance function that removes frost or allows something frozen to thaw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清除冰霜或使冻结物解冻的过程，也可指电器的除霜或解冻功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-funzjoni ta' apparat li tneħħi l-ġlata jew tħalli xi ħaġa ffriżata tinħall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除霜或解冻的过程或功能。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega kif taħdem il-funzjoni tad-difrost ta' dan il-friġġ.
formal.en: The manual explains how this refrigerator's defrost function works.
formal.zh: 说明书解释了这台冰箱的除霜功能如何运作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-majkrowejv għandu funzjoni tad-difrost? Mark: Iva, il-buttuna qiegħda ħdejn it-tajmer.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this microwave have a defrost function? Mark: Yes, the button is next to the timer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这台微波炉有解冻功能吗？Mark：有，按钮就在定时器旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这台微波炉有解冻功能吗？
messages.en: Does this microwave have a defrost function?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 有，按钮就在定时器旁边。
messages.en: Yes, the button is next to the timer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 difrost 就想象电器上的除霜或解冻按钮，用按钮画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical treatment that removes waste substances and excess fluid from the blood when the kidneys cannot do so adequately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在肾脏无法充分发挥作用时，帮助清除血液中废物和多余液体的医疗治疗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament mediku li jneħħi sustanzi ta' skart u fluwidu żejjed mid-demm meta l-kliewi ma jkunux jistgħu jagħmlu dan biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透析；帮助清除血液中废物和多余液体的治疗。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent għandu appuntament għal sessjoni ta' dijalisi nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The patient has an appointment for a dialysis session on Monday.
formal.zh: 该患者预约了星期一的一次透析治疗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-unità tad-dijalisi? Rita: Fl-ewwel sular, ħdejn il-lift.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the dialysis unit? Rita: On the first floor, next to the lift.
colloquial.zh: Anna：透析科室在哪里？Rita：在地面层上一层，电梯旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (患者家属)
messages.zh: 透析科室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the dialysis unit?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 在地面层上一层，电梯旁边。
messages.en: On the first floor, next to the lift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijalisi 与“透析治疗”整组记忆，想象它帮助清除血液中的废物和多余液体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to dialysis or involving the use of dialysis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与透析有关的，或涉及使用透析方法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dijalisi jew li jinvolvi l-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透析的；与透析过程或透析治疗有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trattament dijalittiku li rċieva l-pazjent.
formal.en: The report describes the dialytic treatment received by the patient.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该患者接受的透析治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser dijalittiku f'din is-sentenza? Daniel: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dijalisi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dijalittiku mean in this sentence? Daniel: It means relating to dialysis.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 dijalittiku 是什么意思？Daniel：意思是与透析有关的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 dijalittiku 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dijalittiku mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是与透析有关的。
messages.en: It means relating to dialysis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijalittiku 放进“透析治疗、透析过程”两个搭配里，记住它是描述透析相关事物的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used in dialysis to separate waste substances and excess fluid from the blood through a membrane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 透析中使用的装置，通过膜帮助分离血液中的废物和多余液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat użat fid-dijalisi biex jifred sustanzi ta' skart u fluwidu żejjed mid-demm permezz ta' membrana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透析器；透析时用于通过膜分离血液中废物和多余液体的装置。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi kif id-demm jgħaddi mid-dijalizzatur waqt it-trattament.
formal.en: The diagram shows how blood passes through the dialyzer during treatment.
formal.zh: 示意图展示治疗过程中血液如何流经透析器。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan hu d-dijalizzatur? Joseph: Iva, huwa l-filtru li jintuża f'dan it-tip ta' dijalisi.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is this the dialyzer? Joseph: Yes, it is the filter used in this type of dialysis.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这就是透析器吗？Joseph：对，它是这种透析所使用的过滤装置。

messages.speaker: Elena (实习生)
messages.zh: 这就是透析器吗？
messages.en: Is this the dialyzer?

messages.speaker: Joseph (带教护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa l-filtru li jintuża f'dan it-tip ta' dijalisi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa l-filtru li jintuża f'dan it-tip ta' dijalisi.
messages.zh: 对，它是这种透析所使用的过滤装置。
messages.en: Yes, it is the filter used in this type of dialysis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面区分：dijalisi 是透析治疗，dijalizzatur 是治疗所用的透析器，把后者记成具体装置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to identify a disease or condition, or relating to the process of diagnosis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于识别疾病或病况的，或与诊断过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex tiġi identifikata marda jew kundizzjoni, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-proċess tad-dijanjosi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诊断的；用于确定疾病或病况的。

formal.mt: It-test dijanjostiku jgħin lit-tabib jidentifika l-kawża tas-sintomi.
formal.en: The diagnostic test helps the doctor identify the cause of the symptoms.
formal.zh: 这项诊断性检测帮助医生确定症状的原因。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan jissejjaħ test dijanjostiku? Nadia: Għax jgħinna nsiru nafu x'qed jikkawża s-sintomi tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this called a diagnostic test? Nadia: Because it helps us find out what is causing your symptoms.
colloquial.zh: Mark：为什么这叫诊断性检测？Nadia：因为它能帮助我们查明是什么导致了你的症状。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 为什么这叫诊断性检测？
messages.en: Why is this called a diagnostic test?

messages.speaker: Nadia (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħinna nsiru nafu x'qed jikkawża s-sintomi tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħinna nsiru nafu x'qed jikkawża s-sintomi tiegħek.
messages.zh: 因为它能帮助我们查明是什么导致了你的症状。
messages.en: Because it helps us find out what is causing your symptoms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijanjostiku 与“查明病因的检测”画面相连，记住它描述用于诊断的检查或工具。

gloss_zh: 中风；绝罚，逐出教会共融

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attack of apoplexy; in a separate religious sense, exclusion from the communion of the Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指中风发作；在另一个宗教义项中，指被排除于教会共融之外，即绝罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attakk ta' puplesija; f'sens reliġjuż separat, esklużjoni mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中风，卒中发作。
绝罚，逐出教会共融的宗教处分。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test reliġjuż, il-kelma 'dik' tirreferi għall-esklużjoni mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.
formal.en: In this religious text, the word 'dik' refers to exclusion from the communion of the Church.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，dik 一词指被排除于教会共融之外。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'dik' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser puplesija; f'test reliġjuż tista' tfisser skomunika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'dik' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means apoplexy; in a religious text it can mean excommunication.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 dik 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指中风；在宗教文本中，它也可以指绝罚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 dik 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'dik' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser puplesija; f'test reliġjuż tista' tfisser skomunika.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser puplesija; f'test reliġjuż tista' tfisser skomunika.
messages.zh: 这里指中风；在宗教文本中，它也可以指绝罚。
messages.en: Here it means apoplexy; in a religious text it can mean excommunication.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dik 做成两张语境卡：病情卡写中风，教会卡写绝罚；阅读时先看语境再选义。

gloss_zh: 雌雄同体生物；雌雄同体的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organism that has both male and female reproductive organs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官的生物个体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organiżmu li għandu organi riproduttivi kemm maskili kif ukoll femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雌雄同体生物，同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官的个体。
雌雄同体的，具有雄性和雌性生殖器官的。

collocations.zh: 两性花，同时具有雄蕊和雌蕊的花

formal.mt: It-terminu 'dika', meta jintuża bħala nom fil-bijoloġija, jindika organiżmu b'organi riproduttivi maskili u femminili.
formal.en: The term 'dika', when used as a noun in biology, denotes an organism with male and female reproductive organs.
formal.zh: 在生物学中，dika 用作名词时，指具有雄性和雌性生殖器官的生物个体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'fjura dika'? David: Fjura li għandha kemm organi maskili kif ukoll organi femminili.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'fjura dika' mean? David: A flower that has both male and female organs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：fjura dika 是什么意思？David：就是同时具有雄性和雌性器官的花。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: fjura dika 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'fjura dika' mean?

messages.speaker: David (生物教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fjura li għandha kemm organi maskili kif ukoll organi femminili.
messages.mt_standard: Fjura li għandha kemm organi maskili kif ukoll organi femminili.
messages.zh: 就是同时具有雄性和雌性器官的花。
messages.en: A flower that has both male and female organs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个生物个体，旁边并列标出雄性与雌性器官；名词记个体，形容词记其特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container, usually made of glass, into which wine or spirits are poured for holding and serving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常由玻璃制成、用于盛放和斟倒葡萄酒或烈酒的容器，也可用作醒酒器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent, ġeneralment tal-ħġieġ, li fih jitferra' nbid jew xorb alkoħoliku ieħor biex jinżamm u jiġi servut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 醒酒器，盛酒壶，供盛放和斟倒酒液的容器。

collocations.en: pour the wine into the decanter

formal.mt: Qabel is-servizz, il-wejter ferra' l-inbid f'dikanter tal-ħġieġ u poġġieh fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before serving, the waiter poured the wine into a glass decanter and placed it on the table.
formal.zh: 上酒前，侍者把葡萄酒倒入玻璃醒酒器，并将其放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu d-dikanter? Rita: Fuq l-ixkaffa, ħdejn it-tazzi tal-inbid.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the decanter? Rita: On the shelf, next to the wine glasses.
colloquial.zh: Mark：醒酒器在哪里？Rita：在架子上，葡萄酒杯旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 醒酒器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the decanter?

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 在架子上，葡萄酒杯旁边。
messages.en: On the shelf, next to the wine glasses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dikanter 和英语 decanter 配对记忆，再想象从酒瓶倒入玻璃醒酒器的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing a statement or presenting information, especially as a grammatical form or style.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于作出陈述或表达信息的，尤指语法形式或表达风格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi stqarrija jew jippreżenta informazzjoni, speċjalment bħala forma grammatikali jew stil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陈述的，陈述式的，用于作出陈述或表达信息的。

formal.mt: It-test juża stil dikjarattiv biex jippreżenta l-fatti b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The text uses a declarative style to present the facts clearly.
formal.zh: 这篇文本采用陈述式风格，清楚地呈现事实。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Il-ħanut jagħlaq fis-sitta' hija sentenza dikjarattiva? Pawlu: Iva, għax tagħti informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is 'The shop closes at six' a declarative sentence? Pawlu: Yes, because it gives information.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“商店六点关门”是陈述句吗？Pawlu：是的，因为它提供信息。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: “商店六点关门”是陈述句吗？
messages.en: Is 'The shop closes at six' a declarative sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，因为它提供信息。
messages.en: Yes, because it gives information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“商店六点关门”作记忆句：直接说出一条信息，就能联想到陈述式 dikjarattiv。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked for too long, so that the food has lost its desirable texture or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因烹煮时间过长而失去理想口感或品质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun issajret għal żmien twil wisq u tilfet in-nisġa jew il-kwalità mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煮过头的，烹煮时间过长的。

formal.mt: Il-patata kienet dikka u tilfet il-forma tagħha meta tħawdet.
formal.en: The potatoes were overcooked and lost their shape when stirred.
formal.zh: 土豆煮过头了，一搅拌就散了形。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ġiet il-patata? Mark: Dikka, sfortunatament. Ħallejtha fuq in-nar wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the potatoes turn out? Mark: Overcooked, unfortunately. I left them on the heat too long.
colloquial.zh: Lara：土豆煮得怎么样？Mark：可惜煮过头了。我把它们放在火上太久了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 土豆煮得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the potatoes turn out?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dikka, sfortunatament. Ħallejtha fuq in-nar wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Dikka, sfortunatament. Ħallejtha fuq in-nar wisq.
messages.zh: 可惜煮过头了。我把它们放在火上太久了。
messages.en: Overcooked, unfortunately. I left them on the heat too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计时器已经响了，土豆却还在锅里煮；看到软烂的土豆，就复习 dikka。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A utensil with a small bowl and a handle, used for eating, serving, or stirring food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有凹形勺头和柄、用于进食、舀取或搅拌食物的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'parti żgħira konkava u manku, li tintuża biex wieħed jiekol, iservi jew iħawwad l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勺子，匙，用于舀取、进食或搅拌的餐具。

formal.mt: Ħawwad is-soppa bil-mod b'dikxiena tal-injam sakemm l-ingredjenti jitħalltu sew.
formal.en: Stir the soup gently with a wooden spoon until the ingredients are well combined.
formal.zh: 用木勺轻轻搅拌汤，直到食材充分混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tgħaddili d-dikxiena, jekk jogħġbok? Omm: Hawn hi, ħdejn il-platt tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: Could you pass me the spoon, please? Mum: Here it is, next to your plate.
colloquial.zh: Sara：请把勺子递给我，好吗？妈妈：在这里，就在你的盘子旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 请把勺子递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the spoon, please?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在这里，就在你的盘子旁边。
messages.en: Here it is, next to your plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出一把有凹面和长柄的勺子，边做舀汤动作边读 dikxiena，把声音连到用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Participation in an activity as an amateur; also, a lack of professional skill or standards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以业余身份参与某项活动的性质或做法；也可指缺乏专业技能或规范的作风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika ta' attività bħala dilettant; ukoll, nuqqas ta' ħila jew standards professjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 业余性质，业余参与；也可指不够专业的做法或作风。

collocations.zh: 体育运动中的业余性质

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika sinjali ta' dilettantiżmu fl-organizzazzjoni tal-avveniment, fosthom skeda mhux ċara u nuqqas ta' koordinazzjoni.
formal.en: The report identified signs of amateurism in the organization of the event, including an unclear schedule and a lack of coordination.
formal.zh: 报告指出，活动组织存在不够专业的迹象，包括日程不清晰和协调不足。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex semmejt id-dilettantiżmu fl-organizzazzjoni? Toni: Għax ħadd ma kien jaf x'kellu jagħmel, u l-programm inbidel tliet darbiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you mention amateurism in the organization? Toni: Because nobody knew what they had to do, and the programme changed three times.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说组织工作有业余作风？Toni：因为没人知道自己该做什么，而且节目安排改了三次。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 你为什么说组织工作有业余作风？
messages.en: Why did you mention amateurism in the organization?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħadd ma kien jaf x'kellu jagħmel, u l-programm inbidel tliet darbiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħadd ma kien jaf x'kellu jagħmel, u l-programm inbidel tliet darbiet.
messages.zh: 因为没人知道自己该做什么，而且节目安排改了三次。
messages.en: Because nobody knew what they had to do, and the programme changed three times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆：周末为兴趣参加活动是业余参与，安排混乱受批评则是业余作风。

gloss_zh: 涂抹，抹上的一层；软膏，涂剂

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or application of smearing a substance over a surface; also, an ointment for application to the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质抹在表面上的动作或一次涂抹；也指供涂于皮肤的软膏或涂剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew applikazzjoni ta' tixrid ta' sustanza fuq wiċċ; ukoll, ingwent li jitqiegħed fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次涂抹，抹上一层物质的动作或结果。
软膏，供涂抹于皮肤的膏状制剂。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-ħaddiem għadda dilka ta' żejt fuq il-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: After cleaning, the worker applied a smearing of oil to the surface of the wood.
formal.zh: 清洁之后，工人在木材表面抹了一层油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi d-dilka għall-ġilda? Mark: Fil-kexxun ta' fuq, fil-vażett iż-żgħir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the skin ointment? Mark: In the top drawer, in the small jar.
colloquial.zh: Lara：皮肤用软膏在哪里？Mark：在最上面的抽屉里，装在那个小罐子中。

messages.speaker: Lara (妻子)
messages.zh: 皮肤用软膏在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the skin ointment?

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 在最上面的抽屉里，装在那个小罐子中。
messages.en: In the top drawer, in the small jar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dilka 连成两幅图：手把油抹开，旁边放一罐软膏；分别记住涂抹和软膏两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made less concentrated by adding water or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入水或其他液体后浓度降低的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar inqas ikkonċentrat biż-żieda ta' ilma jew likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稀释的；因加入液体而浓度降低的。

formal.mt: Għal dan l-esperiment, għandu jintuża alkoħol dilwit.
formal.en: Diluted alcohol should be used for this experiment.
formal.zh: 本实验应使用稀释的酒精。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-meraq dilwit? Pawlu: Iva, żidt ftit ilma għax kien qawwi wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this juice diluted? Pawlu: Yes, I added a little water because it was too strong.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这果汁兑过水吗？保罗：是的，原来味道太浓，我加了一点水。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这果汁兑过水吗？
messages.en: Is this juice diluted?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żidt ftit ilma għax kien qawwi wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żidt ftit ilma għax kien qawwi wisq.
messages.zh: 是的，原来味道太浓，我加了一点水。
messages.en: Yes, I added a little water because it was too strong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯浓果汁加入清水，颜色变浅、味道变淡，用这个画面记住 dilwit 表示“稀释的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to dimensions, such as spatial measurements or the physical quantities used in an analysis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与维度有关的，例如空间中的尺寸，或分析中使用的物理量纲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dimensjonijiet, bħall-qisien fl-ispazju jew id-dimensjonijiet tal-kwantitajiet fiżiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 维度的；与尺寸、空间维数或物理量纲有关的。

formal.mt: L-analiżi dimensjonali tintuża biex jiġi vverifikat jekk iż-żewġ naħat ta' ekwazzjoni għandhomx l-istess dimensjonijiet fiżiċi.
formal.en: Dimensional analysis is used to check whether the two sides of an equation have the same physical dimensions.
formal.zh: 量纲分析用于检查方程两边是否具有相同的物理量纲。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tagħmel analiżi dimensjonali? Mark: Biex nara jekk l-unitajiet fil-formula jaqblux.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you doing dimensional analysis? Mark: To see whether the units in the formula are consistent.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么在做量纲分析？马克：为了看看公式里的单位是否一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么在做量纲分析？
messages.en: Why are you doing dimensional analysis?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nara jekk l-unitajiet fil-formula jaqblux.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nara jekk l-unitajiet fil-formula jaqblux.
messages.zh: 为了看看公式里的单位是否一致。
messages.en: To see whether the units in the formula are consistent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dimensjonali 和标着长、宽、高的盒子一起记；遇到物理公式时，再联想到检查单位的“量纲分析”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has resigned or is leaving a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经提出辞职或即将离开所任职位的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun irriżenjat jew li tkun se tħalli l-kariga tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 即将离任的人；辞职者。

collocations.en: the successor to the outgoing person

formal.mt: Id-dimissjonarju ppreżenta rapport dwar ix-xogħol li kien għadu ma tlestiex qabel ma ħalla l-kariga.
formal.en: The outgoing person submitted a report on the unfinished work before leaving the position.
formal.zh: 离任者在离开职位前提交了一份关于未完成工作的报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jgħaddi d-dokumenti lill-kap il-ġdid? David: Id-dimissjonarju se jgħaddihomlu għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will hand the documents over to the new head? David: The outgoing person will hand them over to him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁会把文件交给新主管？戴维：离任者明天会交给他。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħaddi d-dokumenti lill-kap il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħaddi d-dokumenti lill-kap il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 谁会把文件交给新主管？
messages.en: Who will hand the documents over to the new head?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 离任者明天会交给他。
messages.en: The outgoing person will hand them over to him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用交接文件的画面记住 dimissjonarju：重点是“离任的那个人”；再和表示辞职行为的 dimissjoni 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or formal notice of voluntarily leaving a job or official position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自愿离开工作或职务的行为，也指正式提出辞职的通知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-avviż formali li bih persuna tagħżel li tħalli l-impjieg jew il-kariga tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辞职；辞去职务的正式表示或通知。

formal.mt: Id-direttur ippreżenta l-ittra ta' dimissjoni tiegħu lill-bord.
formal.en: The director submitted his resignation letter to the board.
formal.zh: 董事向董事会提交了辞职信。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Diġà bgħatt l-ittra ta' dimissjoni? Ġanni: Iva, bgħattha dalgħodu u għedt lill-maniġer ukoll.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you already sent the resignation letter? Ġanni: Yes, I sent it this morning and told the manager too.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你已经发出辞职信了吗？詹尼：是的，今天早上发的，也告诉经理了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经发出辞职信了吗？
messages.en: Have you already sent the resignation letter?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bgħattha dalgħodu u għedt lill-maniġer ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bgħattha dalgħodu u għedt lill-maniġer ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上发的，也告诉经理了。
messages.en: Yes, I sent it this morning and told the manager too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dimissjoni 写在想象中的辞职信标题上，连同 ittra ta' dimissjoni 一起记，看到这个词就想到“正式提出辞职”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be shown to be true or to exist through evidence, reasoning, or a practical demonstration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够通过证据、推理或实际演示证明其真实性或存在的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintwera li hu veru jew li jeżisti permezz ta' provi, raġunament jew turija prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可证明的；能够通过证据或演示加以证实的。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati juru titjib dimostrabbli fil-preċiżjoni tal-kejl.
formal.en: The results show a demonstrable improvement in measurement accuracy.
formal.zh: 结果显示，测量准确度出现了可验证的改善。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif taf li l-metodu l-ġdid hu aħjar? Karl: It-titjib hu dimostrabbli; nistgħu nqabblu r-riżultati taż-żewġ metodi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you know the new method is better? Karl: The improvement is demonstrable; we can compare the results of the two methods.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么知道新方法更好？卡尔：改善是可以验证的；我们可以比较两种方法的结果。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif taf li l-metodu l-ġdid hu aħjar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif taf li l-metodu l-ġdid hu aħjar?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道新方法更好？
messages.en: How do you know the new method is better?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-titjib hu dimostrabbli; nistgħu nqabblu r-riżultati taż-żewġ metodi.
messages.mt_standard: It-titjib hu dimostrabbli; nistgħu nqabblu r-riżultati taż-żewġ metodi.
messages.zh: 改善是可以验证的；我们可以比较两种方法的结果。
messages.en: The improvement is demonstrable; we can compare the results of the two methods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把前后两组结果并排摆出来，让别人亲眼核对；能拿证据展示出来的，就是 dimostrabbli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in a public demonstration to express support, opposition, or a demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加公开示威，以表达支持、反对意见或诉求的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'dimostrazzjoni pubblika biex tesprimi appoġġ, oppożizzjoni jew talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 示威者；参加公开示威表达立场或诉求的人。
助理教授。

formal.mt: Dimostrant paċifiku qara stqarrija li talbet titjib fit-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: A peaceful demonstrator read a statement calling for improvements to public transport.
formal.zh: 一名和平示威者宣读了一份要求改善公共交通的声明。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu dak id-dimostrant bil-kartellun aħdar? Toni: Hu ġar tiegħi; qed jitlob aktar spazji ħodor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is that demonstrator with the green placard? Toni: He's my neighbour; he's calling for more green spaces.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那个举着绿色标语牌的示威者是谁？托尼：他是我的邻居，正在呼吁增加绿地。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak id-dimostrant bil-kartellun aħdar?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak id-dimostrant bil-kartellun aħdar?
messages.zh: 那个举着绿色标语牌的示威者是谁？
messages.en: Who is that demonstrator with the green placard?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ġar tiegħi; qed jitlob aktar spazji ħodor.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ġar tiegħi; qed jitlob aktar spazji ħodor.
messages.zh: 他是我的邻居，正在呼吁增加绿地。
messages.en: He's my neighbour; he's calling for more green spaces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dimostrant 准备两张语境卡：街头举牌的人对应“示威者”，大学职位名称对应“助理教授”，阅读时靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used in grammar to describe a word that points out a particular person or thing, such as 'this' or 'that'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中指用来指明特定人或事物的，例如“这个”或“那个”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, jiddeskrivi kelma li tindika persuna jew ħaġa partikolari, bħal 'dan' jew 'dak'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指示的，尤指语法中用于指明人或事物的；也可指明显表露感情的。

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Dan hu tiegħi', il-kelma 'dan' hija pronom dimostrattiv.
formal.en: In the sentence 'This is mine', the word 'this' is a demonstrative pronoun.
formal.zh: 在“这是我的”这句话中，“这”是指示代词。

colloquial.mt: Elena: 'Dan' f''Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi' hu pronom dimostrattiv? Simon: Iva, għax jindika ktieb partikolari.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is 'dan' in 'Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi' a demonstrative pronoun? Simon: Yes, because it points to a particular book.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：“Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi”（这是我的书）里的 dan 是指示代词吗？西蒙：是的，因为它指向某一本特定的书。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Dan' f''Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi' hu pronom dimostrattiv?
messages.mt_standard: 'Dan' f''Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi' hu pronom dimostrattiv?
messages.zh: “Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi”（这是我的书）里的 dan 是指示代词吗？
messages.en: Is 'dan' in 'Dan hu l-ktieb tiegħi' a demonstrative pronoun?

messages.speaker: Simon (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，因为它指向某一本特定的书。
messages.en: Yes, because it points to a particular book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸手指着近处说“这个”，再指远处说“那个”，用指物动作记住 dimostrattiv 的语法义；描述人时再考虑“表露感情”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who shows others how something works or how to carry out a practical task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人展示某物如何运作或某项实际操作如何完成的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li turi lil ħaddieħor kif taħdem xi ħaġa jew kif isir xogħol prattiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演示者；向他人示范操作方法或展示事物运作过程的人。

formal.mt: Id-dimostratur spjega kull pass tal-esperiment qabel ma l-istudenti bdew jaħdmu.
formal.en: The demonstrator explained every step of the experiment before the students began working.
formal.zh: 示范人员在学生开始操作前解释了实验的每一个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min jista' jurini kif taħdem din il-magna? Luqa: Id-dimostratur qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih u jurik.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who can show me how this machine works? Luqa: The demonstrator is beside the table; ask him and he'll show you.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁能给我演示这台机器怎么用？卢卡：演示人员就在桌子旁边，你问他，他会演示给你看。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jurini kif taħdem din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jurini kif taħdem din il-magna?
messages.zh: 谁能给我演示这台机器怎么用？
messages.en: Who can show me how this machine works?

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dimostratur qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih u jurik.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dimostratur qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih u jurik.
messages.zh: 演示人员就在桌子旁边，你问他，他会演示给你看。
messages.en: The demonstrator is beside the table; ask him and he'll show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展台旁有人一边操作机器一边讲解，把这个“做给你看的人”记作 dimostratur，并连同产品演示的场景一起复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A practical display showing how something works, or a public gathering expressing a shared opinion or demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过实际操作展示事物如何运作的演示；也指公开表达共同立场或诉求的示威活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirja prattika ta' kif taħdem xi ħaġa, jew laqgħa pubblika ta' nies biex jesprimu fehma jew talba komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演示，示范；也可指公开表达立场或诉求的示威活动。

formal.mt: Qabel l-eżerċizzju, l-għalliema tat dimostrazzjoni prattika ta' kif jintuża l-apparat.
formal.en: Before the exercise, the teacher gave a practical demonstration of how to use the equipment.
formal.zh: 练习开始前，老师实际演示了设备的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini dimostrazzjoni ta' kif taħdem din il-magna? Mark: Żgur, ara kif nagħmel jien u mbagħad ipprova int.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me a demonstration of how this machine works? Mark: Sure, watch how I do it and then try it yourself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能给我演示一下这台机器怎么操作吗？Mark：当然，先看我怎么做，然后你自己试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini dimostrazzjoni ta' kif taħdem din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini dimostrazzjoni ta' kif taħdem din il-magna?
messages.zh: 你能给我演示一下这台机器怎么操作吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a demonstration of how this machine works?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ara kif nagħmel jien u mbagħad ipprova int.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ara kif nagħmel jien u mbagħad ipprova int.
messages.zh: 当然，先看我怎么做，然后你自己试试。
messages.en: Sure, watch how I do it and then try it yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上两个画面来记：老师操作机器是“演示”，人群公开表达诉求是“示威”；根据场景判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with the village of Dingli.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于丁利、来自丁利或与丁利有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu ta' Ħad-Dingli, ġej minn hemm jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan ir-raħal.

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Dingli
sense_translations.zh_definition: 丁利的；来自丁利或与丁利有关的。
丁利本地人或居民。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jippreżenta x-xogħol ta' artist Dingli u jispjega r-rabta tiegħu mar-raħal.
formal.en: The catalogue presents the work of an artist from Dingli and explains his connection with the village.
formal.zh: 这本目录介绍了一位丁利艺术家的作品，并说明了他与该村的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu artist Dingli? Pawlu: Iva, hu minn Ħad-Dingli u għadu jgħix hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this an artist from Dingli? Pawlu: Yes, he is from Dingli and still lives there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是一位来自丁利的艺术家吗？Pawlu：对，他来自丁利，现在仍住在那里。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这是一位来自丁利的艺术家吗？
messages.en: Is this an artist from Dingli?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu minn Ħad-Dingli u għadu jgħix hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu minn Ħad-Dingli u għadu jgħix hemm.
messages.zh: 对，他来自丁利，现在仍住在那里。
messages.en: Yes, he is from Dingli and still lives there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 Dingli 与地名“丁利”绑定，再记两张卡片：形容词回答“哪里的”，名词回答“哪里的人”，不要混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 小于一 ħabba 的小硬币；硬币

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small coin worth less than a ħabba; also a coin in a general sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种价值低于一 ħabba 的小硬币；也可泛指硬币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munita żgħira b'valur inqas minn ħabba; ukoll, munita b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small coin less than a ħabba
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种价值低于一 ħabba 的小硬币。
硬币；铸币。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tiddeskrivi d-dinier bħala munita żgħira b'valur inqas minn ħabba.
formal.en: The label describes the dinier as a small coin worth less than a ħabba.
formal.zh: 标签将 dinier 解释为一种价值低于一 ħabba 的小硬币。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dinier? Toni: Hu munita żgħira b'valur inqas minn ħabba; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll munita b'mod ġenerali.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is a dinier? Toni: It is a small coin worth less than a ħabba; the word can also mean a coin in general.
colloquial.zh: Nina：dinier 是什么？Toni：它是一种价值低于一 ħabba 的小硬币；这个词也可以泛指硬币。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: dinier 是什么？
messages.en: What is a dinier?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu munita żgħira b'valur inqas minn ħabba; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll munita b'mod ġenerali.
messages.mt_standard: Hu munita żgħira b'valur inqas minn ħabba; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll munita b'mod ġenerali.
messages.zh: 它是一种价值低于一 ħabba 的小硬币；这个词也可以泛指硬币。
messages.en: It is a small coin worth less than a ħabba; the word can also mean a coin in general.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一枚小硬币，在旁边写“价值小于一 ħabba”；再用一个大圈标注“也可泛指硬币”，同时记住专指和泛指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the whole world or extending across many countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与整个世界有关的，或范围涉及许多国家的；全球性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dinja kollha jew li jestendi għal ħafna pajjiżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世界的；遍及世界的；全球性的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-effett tal-kummerċ dinji fuq l-ekonomija lokali.
formal.en: The report analyses the effect of world trade on the local economy.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了世界贸易对本地经济的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-prodott jinbiegħ hawn biss? Mark: Le, jinbiegħ fis-suq dinji, f'ħafna pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this product sold only here? Mark: No, it is sold on the global market, in many countries.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个产品只在这里销售吗？Mark：不是，它面向全球市场，在许多国家都有销售。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个产品只在这里销售吗？
messages.en: Is this product sold only here?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jinbiegħ fis-suq dinji, f'ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jinbiegħ fis-suq dinji, f'ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 不是，它面向全球市场，在许多国家都有销售。
messages.en: No, it is sold on the global market, in many countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 dinji，就想象地球上许多国家被连起来；把“世界贸易”和“全球市场”成组朗读，记住它表示全球范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds a high-ranking or important official position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任高级或重要正式职务的人；显要人物或要员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha kariga uffiċjali għolja jew importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显要人物；担任高级职务的要员。

formal.mt: Dinjitarju barrani attenda ċ-ċerimonja u sellem lir-rappreżentanti lokali.
formal.en: A foreign dignitary attended the ceremony and greeted the local representatives.
formal.zh: 一位外国要员出席了典礼，并向本地代表致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk? Pawlu: Hu dinjitarju barrani mistieden għaċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man beside the stage? Pawlu: He is a foreign dignitary invited to the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: Maja：舞台旁边那个男人是谁？Pawlu：他是一位受邀参加典礼的外国要员。

messages.speaker: Maja (来宾)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-palk?
messages.zh: 舞台旁边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man beside the stage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.zh: 他是一位受邀参加典礼的外国要员。
messages.en: He is a foreign dignitary invited to the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象正式典礼上被郑重介绍的高级来宾，把 dinjitarju 记成“有重要职务的人”；它是人物名词，重点在身份。

gloss_zh: 庄重的；有尊严的；得体的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing dignity, self-respect, and behaviour appropriate to the situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出尊严、自尊与庄重气度的；言行符合场合、得体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri dinjità u rispett lejh innifsu, b'imġiba xierqa għas-sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有尊严的，庄重的；举止得体的。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem wieġeb għall-kritika b'ton dinjituż u b'rispett lejn kulħadd.
formal.en: The speaker responded to the criticism in a dignified tone and with respect for everyone.
formal.zh: 发言人以庄重的语气回应批评，并对所有人保持尊重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien id-diskors tiegħu? Toni: Kien dinjituż; tkellem bil-kalma u ma offenda lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was his speech like? Toni: It was dignified; he spoke calmly and did not offend anyone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他的讲话怎么样？Toni：很庄重得体；他说话平静，也没有冒犯任何人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他的讲话怎么样？
messages.en: What was his speech like?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien dinjituż; tkellem bil-kalma u ma offenda lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Kien dinjituż; tkellem bil-kalma u ma offenda lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 很庄重得体；他说话平静，也没有冒犯任何人。
messages.en: It was dignified; he spoke calmly and did not offend anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“遇到批评仍平静、有礼、有尊严”的画面记 dinjituż；再配读 diskors dinjituż，记住它描述庄重得体的表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The management of relations between countries, or tactful handling of people and sensitive situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处理国家之间关系的外交活动；也指在人际交往或敏感情境中表现出的圆融与分寸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma biex jitmexxew ir-relazzjonijiet bejn il-pajjiżi, jew il-ħila li wieħed jittratta man-nies u sitwazzjonijiet delikati b'reqqa u b'tattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外交；处理国家之间关系与交涉的活动。
处事圆融；说话做事顾及他人感受、掌握分寸的能力。

formal.mt: Id-diplomazija għenet liż-żewġ pajjiżi jilħqu ftehim permezz tad-djalogu.
formal.en: Diplomacy helped the two countries reach an agreement through dialogue.
formal.zh: 外交活动帮助两国通过对话达成了协议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ngħidilha li l-idea ma taħdimx? Mark: Għidilha b'diplomazija: spjega l-problema u ssuġġerixxi soluzzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I tell her that the idea will not work? Mark: Tell her tactfully: explain the problem and suggest another solution.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我该怎么告诉她这个想法行不通？Mark：说得委婉得体些：解释问题，再提出另一种解决办法。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħidilha li l-idea ma taħdimx?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħidilha li l-idea ma taħdimx?
messages.zh: 我该怎么告诉她这个想法行不通？
messages.en: How do I tell her that the idea will not work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidilha b'diplomazija: spjega l-problema u ssuġġerixxi soluzzjoni oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għidilha b'diplomazija: spjega l-problema u ssuġġerixxi soluzzjoni oħra.
messages.zh: 说得委婉得体些：解释问题，再提出另一种解决办法。
