messages.en: Tell her tactfully: explain the problem and suggest another solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diplomazija 放在两张谈话桌上记：国家之间谈判是“外交”，同事之间顾及感受、讲究分寸是“处事圆融”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Narrowness or lack of space; also severe financial hardship or a feeling of sadness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空间狭窄或不足的状态；也指严重的经济窘迫，或悲伤、愁苦的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' wisa' jew ta' spazju; ukoll, qagħda ta' faqar jew diffikultà kbira bil-flus, jew sens ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄；宽度或空间不足的状态。
严重的经济窘迫；手头极其拮据的处境。
悲伤；愁苦或难过的情绪。

formal.mt: Minħabba d-diq tat-triq, il-vetturi l-kbar ma jistgħux jgħaddu minn hemm.
formal.en: Because of the narrowness of the road, large vehicles cannot pass through.
formal.zh: 由于道路狭窄，大型车辆无法从那里通过。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sejjer minn meta tlift ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Qiegħed f'diq finanzjarju, imma l-familja qed tgħinni.
colloquial.en: Nina: How have you been doing since you lost your job? Pawlu: I am in severe financial difficulty, but my family is helping me.
colloquial.zh: Nina：失业之后你过得怎么样？Pawlu：我现在经济上很困难，不过家人在帮助我。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer minn meta tlift ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer minn meta tlift ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 失业之后你过得怎么样？
messages.en: How have you been doing since you lost your job?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed f'diq finanzjarju, imma l-familja qed tgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed f'diq finanzjarju, imma l-familja qed tgħinni.
messages.zh: 我现在经济上很困难，不过家人在帮助我。
messages.en: I am in severe financial difficulty, but my family is helping me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“路窄、钱紧、心愁”三个画面串记 diq 的三个名词义；这只是帮助区分语境的学习联想，不代表词义的历史演变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hate someone or something, or to find something repulsive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 憎恨某人或某事，或觉得某种事物令人厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss mibegħda lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew isib xi ħaġa tistmellu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 憎恨；对某人或某事怀有强烈的厌恶。
觉得某物令人厌恶或恶心。

collocations.zh: 觉得那股气味令人恶心

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali dira l-vjolenza wara dak li ra fil-gwerra.
formal.en: The main character hated violence after what he saw in the war.
formal.zh: 主人公在目睹战争中的情景后憎恨暴力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu ħareġ mill-kċina? Mark: Dira r-riħa tal-ħut u mar barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu leave the kitchen? Mark: He found the smell of the fish repulsive and went outside.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么离开厨房了？马克：他觉得鱼的气味令人恶心，就到外面去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么离开厨房了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dira r-riħa tal-ħut u mar barra.
messages.mt_standard: Dira r-riħa tal-ħut u mar barra.
messages.zh: 他觉得鱼的气味令人恶心，就到外面去了。
messages.en: He found the smell of the fish repulsive and went outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dira 配上皱眉和退后的动作：面对行为是憎恨，闻到气味则是觉得厌恶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lizard: a reptile typically having a long body, a tail, and four legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜥蜴，一类通常身体较长、有尾巴和四条腿的爬行动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal rettili li ġeneralment għandu ġisem tawwali, denb u erba' saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜥蜴。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw dirbi żgħir fuq ħajt tal-ġebel.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a small lizard on a stone wall.
formal.zh: 学生们在花园里进行观察时，看见石墙上有一只小蜥蜴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak id-dirbi fuq il-ħajt! Ben: Rajtu! Għadu kemm daħal bejn il-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that lizard on the wall! Ben: I saw it! It has just gone between the stones.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看墙上的那只蜥蜴！本：我看到了！它刚钻进石头缝里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看墙上的那只蜥蜴！
messages.en: Look at that lizard on the wall!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Għadu kemm daħal bejn il-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Għadu kemm daħal bejn il-ġebel.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它刚钻进石头缝里。
messages.en: I saw it! It has just gone between the stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dirbi 时想象石墙上一只长尾小蜥蜴，把单词与具体动物画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get out of bed early in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清晨较早起床，开始一天的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqum mis-sodda kmieni filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；清晨较早起床。

formal.mt: L-istudent direk biex jistudja qabel ma jibdew il-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The student got up early to study before lessons began.
formal.zh: 那名学生早起学习，以便在上课前用功。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex David diġà lest biex joħroġ? Luqa: Illum direk għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is David already ready to go out? Luqa: Today he got up early for work.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：戴维怎么已经准备好出门了？卢卡：他今天为了上班早起了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David diġà lest biex joħroġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David diġà lest biex joħroġ?
messages.zh: 戴维怎么已经准备好出门了？
messages.en: Why is David already ready to go out?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 他今天为了上班早起了。
messages.en: Today he got up early for work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 direk 写在清晨闹钟旁，联想天刚亮就起床准备出门的动作。

gloss_zh: 逐渐习惯的过程；憎恨；厌恶

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming accustomed to something; also a feeling of hatred or repulsion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐适应或习惯某事的过程；也可表示憎恨或厌恶的情感，须结合语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li wieħed jidra xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll mibegħda jew stmerrija, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of getting used to sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐习惯或适应某事的过程。
憎恨；强烈的仇视或厌恨情感。
厌恶；因某物令人反感或恶心而产生的排斥感。

collocations.en: the process of getting used to the new environment

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-diri lejn l-għadu jinfluwenza d-deċiżjonijiet tal-karattru prinċipali.
formal.en: In the novel, hatred towards the enemy influences the main character's decisions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，对敌人的憎恨影响着主人公的决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni nħossni mitlufa fl-iskola l-ġdida. Sara: Id-diri għall-ambjent il-ġdid jieħu ż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Nina: I still feel lost at the new school. Sara: Getting used to the new environment takes time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我在新学校还是觉得无所适从。萨拉：适应新环境需要时间。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同学)
messages.zh: 我在新学校还是觉得无所适从。
messages.en: I still feel lost at the new school.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 适应新环境需要时间。
messages.en: Getting used to the new environment takes time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 diri 做三张语境卡：新环境对应适应过程，敌人对应憎恨，反感表情对应厌恶；分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who directs or manages an organization, department, or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责指导或管理机构、部门或团队的人，如主管或经理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi jew tamministra organizzazzjoni, dipartiment jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主管；经理；负责领导或管理的人。

formal.mt: Id-diriġent tal-kumpanija ppreżenta l-pjan ta' ħidma lill-impjegati.
formal.en: The company manager presented the work plan to the employees.
formal.zh: 公司经理向员工介绍了工作计划。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nitkellem mad-diriġent? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fl-uffiċċju tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I speak to the manager? Rita: Yes, he is in his office.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我能和经理谈谈吗？丽塔：可以，他在自己的办公室里。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我能和经理谈谈吗？
messages.en: Can I speak to the manager?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 可以，他在自己的办公室里。
messages.en: Yes, he is in his office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diriġent 放在办公室门牌上，想象门内那位负责分配工作和管理团队的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the role of directing or managing a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承担指导、领导或管理团队及机构职能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu r-rwol li jmexxi jew jamministra grupp jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起领导、指导或管理作用的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat diriġenti approva l-programm ta' attivitajiet għas-sena li ġejja.
formal.en: The managing committee approved the programme of activities for the coming year.
formal.zh: 管理委员会批准了来年的活动计划。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jiddeċiedi dwar il-baġit tal-klabb? Pawlu: Il-kumitat diriġenti se jiddiskutih għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will decide on the club's budget? Pawlu: The managing committee will discuss it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来决定俱乐部的预算？保罗：管理委员会明天会讨论。

messages.speaker: Anna (俱乐部会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiddeċiedi dwar il-baġit tal-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiddeċiedi dwar il-baġit tal-klabb?
messages.zh: 谁来决定俱乐部的预算？
messages.en: Who will decide on the club's budget?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (俱乐部秘书)
messages.zh: 管理委员会明天会讨论。
messages.en: The managing committee will discuss it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diriġenti 贴在委员会名称旁，提醒自己这里是形容词，说明该委员会承担管理职能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be steered so that its direction of travel can be controlled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够操纵行进方向的；可控制航向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitmexxa f'direzzjoni magħżula billi jiġi kkontrollat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可操纵方向的；能够控制航向的。
飞艇；能够控制航向的浮空飞行器。

formal.mt: Il-mudell juri bużżieqa diriġibbli li tista' tbiddel id-direzzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The model shows a steerable balloon that can change its direction.
formal.zh: 这个模型展示了一个能够改变航向的可操纵气球。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak fis-sema? Ben: Dak diriġibbli; ara kemm qed jimxi bil-mod!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that in the sky? Ben: That is an airship; look how slowly it is moving!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：天上那个是什么？本：那是飞艇；看，它飞得多慢！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 天上那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the sky?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak diriġibbli; ara kemm qed jimxi bil-mod!
messages.mt_standard: Dak diriġibbli; ara kemm qed jimxi bil-mod!
messages.zh: 那是飞艇；看，它飞得多慢！
messages.en: That is an airship; look how slowly it is moving!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一艘可以转向的飞艇：修饰气球时记作可操纵的，单独指飞行器时记作飞艇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of unlawfully taking control of a vehicle, especially an aircraft, by force or threats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以武力或威胁非法夺取交通工具控制权的行为，尤指劫持飞机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu illegalment il-kontroll ta' vettura, speċjalment ajruplan, bil-forza jew bit-theddid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 劫持交通工具的行为；尤指劫机。

collocations.zh: 劫持企图；劫持未遂事件

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi attentat ta' dirottament ta' ajruplan u r-rispons tal-awtoritajiet.
formal.en: The report describes an attempted aircraft hijacking and the authorities' response.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起劫机企图及有关当局的应对。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex hu l-film tal-lejla? Mark: Dwar dirottament ta' ajruplan u kif il-passiġġieri jsalvaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is tonight's film about? Mark: It is about an aircraft hijacking and how the passengers survive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚的电影讲什么？马克：讲一次劫机事件，以及乘客们如何生还。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚的电影讲什么？
messages.en: What is tonight's film about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar dirottament ta' ajruplan u kif il-passiġġieri jsalvaw.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar dirottament ta' ajruplan u kif il-passiġġieri jsalvaw.
messages.zh: 讲一次劫机事件，以及乘客们如何生还。
messages.en: It is about an aircraft hijacking and how the passengers survive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dirottament 与新闻标题中的劫机事件配对，重点记住有人非法夺取交通工具控制权。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Discomfort in the stomach caused by difficulty digesting food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物消化不顺畅引起的胃部不适，即消化不良。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skumdità fl-istonku minħabba diffikultà fid-diġestjoni tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化不良。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li jbati bid-dirra wara ikliet kbar.
formal.en: The patient said that he suffers from indigestion after large meals.
formal.zh: 患者说，他在吃过大餐后会消化不良。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma tridx tiekol aktar? Pawlu: Għandi d-dirra; għalissa ma rridx aktar ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't you want to eat any more? Pawlu: I've got indigestion; I don't want any more food for now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么不想再吃了？保罗：我消化不良，暂时不想再吃东西了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再吃了？
messages.en: Why don't you want to eat any more?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi d-dirra; għalissa ma rridx aktar ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi d-dirra; għalissa ma rridx aktar ikel.
messages.zh: 我消化不良，暂时不想再吃东西了。
messages.en: I've got indigestion; I don't want any more food for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dirra 和“吃完大餐，胃里不舒服”的画面绑定，整句记忆 Għandi d-dirra，表示“我消化不良”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion or operation of separating grain from the harvested stalks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将收割后的谷物籽粒从茎秆或穗上分离下来的一次作业，即一次打谷或脱粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma li fiha l-qamħ jinfired mis-sbul wara l-ħsad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次打谷或脱粒作业。

formal.mt: Wara d-dirsa, il-bdiewa ġabru l-qamħ u ħażnuh f'post niexef.
formal.en: After the threshing, the farmers gathered the wheat and stored it in a dry place.
formal.zh: 打谷之后，农民们收集了小麦，并将其储存在干燥的地方。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lestejtu d-dirsa? Ġużeppi: Iva, issa se niġbru l-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished the threshing? Ġużeppi: Yes, now we're going to gather the wheat.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你们打完谷了吗？朱塞佩：打完了，现在准备把小麦收起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你们打完谷了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the threshing?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 打完了，现在准备把小麦收起来。
messages.en: Yes, now we're going to gather the wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住农事顺序“收割、dirsa、储藏”：中间把谷粒从穗上分离的那次作业，就是 dirsa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 900, equal to nine groups of one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数九百，表示九个一百，即900。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 900, jiġifieri disa' darbiet mija.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-għadd totali tal-parteċipanti kien disa' mija.
formal.en: According to the report, the total number of participants was nine hundred.
formal.zh: 根据报告，参与者总数为九百人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm kien hemm nies fil-festa? Mark: Disa' mija, skont l-organizzaturi.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many people were at the celebration? Mark: Nine hundred, according to the organisers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：庆祝活动上有多少人？马克：据组织者说，有九百人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 庆祝活动上有多少人？
messages.en: How many people were at the celebration?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 据组织者说，有九百人。
messages.en: Nine hundred, according to the organisers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用算式九乘一百来记 disa' mija：先想到九组，再把每组换成一百，总数就是九百。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of the number nine, used before certain following nouns, as in disat ijiem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词“九”在某些后接名词前使用的长定语形式，如 disat ijiem（九天）。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma twila tan-numru disgħa, użata quddiem ċerti nomi, bħal fil-frażi disat ijiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: disgħa（九）的长定语形式，用于某些名词之前。

formal.mt: Il-kors se jdum disat ijiem u se jinkludi lezzjonijiet prattiċi.
formal.en: The course will last nine days and will include practical lessons.
formal.zh: 课程将持续九天，并包含实践课。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm se ddum hemm? David: Disat ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: How long will you stay there? David: Nine days; I'll be back on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你会在那里待多久？戴维：九天，我星期一回来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Disat ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Disat ijiem; nerġa' lura nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 九天，我星期一回来。
messages.en: Nine days; I'll be back on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 disat ijiem“九天”整块背下来：disat 是“九”带着后面名词一起出现时的一种形式，不能随意替换所有“九”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 9,000, equal to nine groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数九千，表示九个一千，即9000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 9,000, jiġifieri disgħa darbiet elf.

formal.mt: Il-baġit għall-proġett huwa ta' disat elef ewro.
formal.en: The budget for the project is nine thousand euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的预算为九千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Toni: Disat elef ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi s-servizz.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much does this car cost? Toni: Nine thousand euros, and the price includes servicing.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这辆车多少钱？托尼：九千欧元，价格包含保养。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Toni (汽车销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Disat elef ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi s-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Disat elef ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi s-servizz.
messages.zh: 九千欧元，价格包含保养。
messages.en: Nine thousand euros, and the price includes servicing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象九捆各一千张的纸，合起来就是 disat elef；把“九千欧元”disat elef ewro 作为完整短语练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 99, equal to ninety plus nine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数九十九，表示九十加九，即99。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 99, jiġifieri disgħin u disgħa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十九；99。

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-biljett huwa disgħa u disgħin ewro għal kull persuna.
formal.en: The ticket price is ninety-nine euros per person.
formal.zh: 票价为每人九十九欧元。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandha żmien in-nanna tiegħek? Mark: Għandha disgħa u disgħin sena; is-sena d-dieħla tagħlaq mija.
colloquial.en: Sara: How old is your grandmother? Mark: She's ninety-nine; next year she'll turn one hundred.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你奶奶多大了？马克：她九十九岁，明年就满一百岁了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你奶奶多大了？
messages.en: How old is your grandmother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha disgħa u disgħin sena; is-sena d-dieħla tagħlaq mija.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha disgħa u disgħin sena; is-sena d-dieħla tagħlaq mija.
messages.zh: 她九十九岁，明年就满一百岁了。
messages.en: She's ninety-nine; next year she'll turn one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按马耳他语顺序记“九和九十”：disgħa 是九，u 是和，disgħin 是九十，合起来就是九十九。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 49, equal to forty plus nine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数四十九，表示四十加九，即49。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 49, jiġifieri erbgħin u disgħa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十九；49。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih disgħa u erbgħin paġna, inklużi t-tabelli.
formal.en: The report contains forty-nine pages, including the tables.
formal.zh: 这份报告包含表格在内共有四十九页。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm jiswa dan il-flokk? Marija: Disgħa u erbgħin ewro. Trid tippruvah?
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does this top cost? Marija: Forty-nine euros. Would you like to try it on?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这件上衣多少钱？玛丽娅：四十九欧元。你想试穿吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件上衣多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this top cost?

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Disgħa u erbgħin ewro. Trid tippruvah?
messages.mt_standard: Disgħa u erbgħin ewro. Trid tippruvah?
messages.zh: 四十九欧元。你想试穿吗？
messages.en: Forty-nine euros. Would you like to try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四十九倒着拆成“九和四十”：先说 disgħa，再用 u 连接 erbgħin；个位在前，十位在后。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number twenty-nine, one more than twenty-eight and one less than thirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数二十九，比二十八多一，比三十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u għoxrin u qabel tletin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十九。

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet għall-eżerċizzju jinsabu f'paġna disgħa u għoxrin tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The instructions for the exercise are on page twenty-nine of the book.
formal.zh: 练习说明见本书第二十九页。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema paġna għandna naqraw? Pawlu: Paġna disgħa u għoxrin. Sara: Sewwa, sibtha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which page should we read? Pawlu: Page twenty-nine. Sara: Right, I've found it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们该读哪一页？保罗：第二十九页。萨拉：好，找到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们该读哪一页？
messages.en: Which page should we read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 第二十九页。
messages.en: Page twenty-nine.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 好，找到了。
messages.en: Right, I've found it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它按“九＋和＋二十”的顺序记：disgħa 是九，u 是和，għoxrin 是二十，合起来是二十九；想象翻到标着29的书页。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number seventy-nine, one more than seventy-eight and one less than eighty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数七十九，比七十八多一，比八十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u sebgħin u qabel tmenin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十九。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-bejgħ, fadal disgħa u sebgħin biljett għall-kunċert.
formal.en: According to the sales report, seventy-nine tickets remain for the concert.
formal.zh: 根据销售报告，该音乐会尚余七十九张票。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm fadal biljetti? Toni: Fadal disgħa u sebgħin. Lara: Mela nistgħu nixtru tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many tickets are left? Toni: Seventy-nine are left. Lara: Then we can buy two.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：还剩多少张票？托尼：还剩七十九张。拉拉：那我们可以买两张。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 还剩多少张票？
messages.en: How many tickets are left?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 还剩七十九张。
messages.en: Seventy-nine are left.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们可以买两张。
messages.en: Then we can buy two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象售票屏显示79张余票：disgħa 表示九，sebgħin 表示七十，中间用 u 连接；按“九和七十”组合理解为七十九。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number sixty-nine, one more than sixty-eight and one less than seventy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数六十九，比六十八多一，比七十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u sittin u qabel sebgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十九。

collocations.zh: 六十九年；用于年龄时为六十九岁

formal.mt: Il-kandidat kiseb disgħa u sittin punt minn mija fl-eżami bil-miktub.
formal.en: The candidate obtained sixty-nine points out of one hundred in the written examination.
formal.zh: 该考生在满分一百分的笔试中取得六十九分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm ġibt fil-prova? Ben: Ġibt disgħa u sittin minn mija. Nina: Trid nistudjaw flimkien għall-prova li jmiss?
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you score on the test? Ben: I got sixty-nine out of one hundred. Nina: Do you want us to study together for the next test?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你这次测验得了多少分？本：满分一百，我得了六十九分。妮娜：下次测验前要一起复习吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你这次测验得了多少分？
messages.en: What did you score on the test?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt disgħa u sittin minn mija.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt disgħa u sittin minn mija.
messages.zh: 满分一百，我得了六十九分。
messages.en: I got sixty-nine out of one hundred.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nistudjaw flimkien għall-prova li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nistudjaw flimkien għall-prova li jmiss?
messages.zh: 下次测验前要一起复习吗？
messages.en: Do you want us to study together for the next test?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把试卷上的69分当作画面：先念九 disgħa，再用 u 连上六十 sittin；“九和六十”就是六十九，注意与七十 sebgħin 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number thirty-nine, one more than thirty-eight and one less than forty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数三十九，比三十八多一，比四十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u tletin u qabel erbgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十九。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'kamra disgħa u tletin fit-tieni sular tal-bini.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in room thirty-nine on the second floor of the building.
formal.zh: 会议将在该楼二层的三十九号房间举行。

colloquial.mt: Marija: F'liema kamra se niltaqgħu? Ġużeppi: F'kamra disgħa u tletin, ħdejn it-taraġ. Marija: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which room are we meeting in? Ġużeppi: Room thirty-nine, next to the stairs. Marija: All right, see you there.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们在哪个房间见面？朱塞佩：三十九号房间，就在楼梯旁边。玛丽亚：好，到时那里见。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 我们在哪个房间见面？
messages.en: Which room are we meeting in?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'kamra disgħa u tletin, ħdejn it-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: F'kamra disgħa u tletin, ħdejn it-taraġ.
messages.zh: 三十九号房间，就在楼梯旁边。
messages.en: Room thirty-nine, next to the stairs.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 好，到时那里见。
messages.en: All right, see you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌39：把 disgħa 记成九，把 tletin 记成三十，用 u 串成“九和三十”；听到末尾 tletin，就把十位定位为三。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number eighty-nine, one more than eighty-eight and one less than ninety.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数八十九，比八十八多一，比九十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u tmenin u qabel disgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十九。

collocations.zh: 八十九年；用于年龄时为八十九岁

formal.mt: Disgħa u tmenin fil-mija tal-parteċipanti wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet kollha tal-istħarriġ.
formal.en: Eighty-nine percent of the participants answered all the survey questions.
formal.zh: 百分之八十九的参与者回答了调查中的全部问题。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kemm għandu żmien nannuk? David: Għandu disgħa u tmenin sena, u għadu jħobb jimxi. Elena: Xi ġmiel! Jimxi magħkom ukoll?
colloquial.en: Elena: How old is your grandfather? David: He's eighty-nine, and he still enjoys walking. Elena: How lovely! Does he walk with you too?
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你爷爷多大年纪了？戴维：他八十九岁了，仍然喜欢散步。埃莱娜：真好！他也和你们一起散步吗？

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷多大年纪了？
messages.en: How old is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu disgħa u tmenin sena, u għadu jħobb jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu disgħa u tmenin sena, u għadu jħobb jimxi.
messages.zh: 他八十九岁了，仍然喜欢散步。
messages.en: He's eighty-nine, and he still enjoys walking.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 真好！他也和你们一起散步吗？
messages.en: How lovely! Does he walk with you too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用89岁生日蜡烛作记忆画面：disgħa 是九，tmenin 是八十，u 把两者连接；念作“九和八十”，理解为八十九。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number fifty-nine, one more than fifty-eight and one less than sixty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数五十九，比五十八多一，比六十少一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmienja u ħamsin u qabel sittin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十九。

formal.mt: Il-prezz totali tal-ordni huwa disgħa u ħamsin ewro, inkluża l-kunsinna.
formal.en: The total price of the order is fifty-nine euros, including delivery.
formal.zh: 该订单总价为五十九欧元，包含配送费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-borża? Rita: Disgħa u ħamsin ewro. Mark: Tajjeb, nieħuha.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this bag cost? Rita: Fifty-nine euros. Mark: All right, I'll take it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个包多少钱？丽塔：五十九欧元。马克：好，我买了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this bag cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 五十九欧元。
messages.en: Fifty-nine euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买了。
messages.en: All right, I'll take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见59欧元的价签，就按“九＋和＋五十”念 disgħa u ħamsin；先说个位九，再说十位五十，帮助记住马耳他语的排列顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who plans how something will look or work, such as clothing, a product, or a website.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计师，规划服装、产品或网站等事物的外观或使用方式的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfassal kif se tidher jew taħdem xi ħaġa, bħal ħwejjeġ, prodott jew sit elettroniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计师；从事外观、版式或产品等设计工作的人。

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur grafiku ħejja tliet proposti għal-logo l-ġdid tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The graphic designer prepared three proposals for the company's new logo.
formal.zh: 平面设计师为公司的新标志准备了三套方案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taf lil xi disinjatur grafiku? Luqa: Iva, ħija huwa disinjatur. Anna: Tista' tistaqsih jekk jistax jgħinni b'poster?
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you know a graphic designer? Luqa: Yes, my brother is a designer. Anna: Can you ask him whether he can help me with a poster?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你认识平面设计师吗？卢卡：认识，我哥哥就是设计师。安娜：你能问问他可不可以帮我设计一张海报吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你认识平面设计师吗？
messages.en: Do you know a graphic designer?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 认识，我哥哥就是设计师。
messages.en: Yes, my brother is a designer.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tistaqsih jekk jistax jgħinni b'poster?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tistaqsih jekk jistax jgħinni b'poster?
messages.zh: 你能问问他可不可以帮我设计一张海报吗？
messages.en: Can you ask him whether he can help me with a poster?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 disinjatur 与“拿着草图讨论方案的人”绑定记忆，再配对 disinjatur grafiku 平面设计师、disinjatur tal-moda 时装设计师，借职业场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of having lost hope, or of being so distressed that one urgently seeks a way out of a difficult situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绝望或极度焦急的状态，指失去希望，或因困境而迫切想找到出路的心情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' telf ta' tama jew ta' dwejjaq kbar meta persuna ma tarax kif tista' toħroġ minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绝望；因身处困境、看不到出路而产生的极度焦急或走投无路之感。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur juri d-disprament tal-protagonist permezz tal-ittri li jikteb lil ħabibu.
formal.en: In the novel, the author portrays the protagonist's despair through the letters he writes to his friend.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者通过主人公写给朋友的信展现他的绝望。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Wara tant tweġibiet negattivi, qed inħoss sens ta' disprament. Simon: Nifhmek. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar x'tista' tagħmel issa? Marta: Iva, jgħinni jekk tismagħni.
colloquial.en: Marta: After so many rejections, I'm feeling a sense of despair. Simon: I understand. Would you like us to talk a little about what you can do now? Marta: Yes, it would help if you listened to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：遭到这么多次拒绝后，我感到很绝望。西蒙：我理解。要不要聊聊你现在可以做些什么？玛尔塔：好，你愿意听我说说就会有帮助。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara tant tweġibiet negattivi, qed inħoss sens ta' disprament.
messages.mt_standard: Wara tant tweġibiet negattivi, qed inħoss sens ta' disprament.
messages.zh: 遭到这么多次拒绝后，我感到很绝望。
messages.en: After so many rejections, I'm feeling a sense of despair.

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar x'tista' tagħmel issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Trid nitkellmu ftit dwar x'tista' tagħmel issa?
messages.zh: 我理解。要不要聊聊你现在可以做些什么？
messages.en: I understand. Would you like us to talk a little about what you can do now?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，你愿意听我说说就会有帮助。
messages.en: Yes, it would help if you listened to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 disprament 放进“连续受挫、看不到出路”的画面，记住它比普通难过更强烈；搭配 sens ta' disprament 记绝望感，搭配 għajta ta' disprament 记绝望的呼喊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing contempt for someone or something, or speaking about them in a belittling way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示看不起某人或某事，或用言语贬低其价值、能力或地位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri disprezz lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li jnaqqas mill-valur tagħhom bil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻蔑的；带有贬低、鄙视意味的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-awtur għandu jevita ton dispreġjativ meta jiddiskuti l-fehmiet ta' ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In his report, the author should avoid a disparaging tone when discussing other people's views.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中讨论他人的观点时，应避免使用轻蔑的语气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment deherli dispreġjativ. Mark: Għandek raġun; seta' esprima l-opinjoni tiegħu b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment sounded disparaging to me. Mark: You're right; he could have expressed his opinion more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我觉得那条评论有点贬低人。马克：你说得对；他本可以更尊重地表达自己的意见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得那条评论有点贬低人。
messages.en: That comment sounded disparaging to me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; seta' esprima l-opinjoni tiegħu b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; seta' esprima l-opinjoni tiegħu b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 你说得对；他本可以更尊重地表达自己的意见。
messages.en: You're right; he could have expressed his opinion more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人用轻蔑的语气评价别人，把 dispreġjativ 与“语气里带着看不起”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called dysprosium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种化学元素，中文名称为“镝”，英文名称为 dysprosium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem disprożju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镝，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw id-disprożju bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should identify dysprosium as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应指出镝是一种化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser disprożju? Pawlu: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ dysprosium.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does disprożju mean? Pawlu: It's the name of a chemical element; in English it's called dysprosium.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：disprożju 是什么意思？保罗：它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 dysprosium，中文叫镝。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: disprożju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does disprożju mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ dysprosium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ dysprosium.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称，英语叫 dysprosium，中文叫镝。
messages.en: It's the name of a chemical element; in English it's called dysprosium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：disprożju—dysprosium—镝，反复按这组三语对应关系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Disagreement with an opinion, decision, or position, especially when that disagreement is expressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种意见、决定或立场持不同看法，尤指明确表达出来的异议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil ma' opinjoni, deċiżjoni jew pożizzjoni, speċjalment meta dan jiġi espress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异议；对某项观点、立场或决定表示不赞同。

collocations.zh: 委员会内部的不同意见

formal.mt: Żewġ membri esprimew id-dissens tagħhom dwar il-proposta waqt il-laqgħa tal-kumitat.
formal.en: Two members expressed their dissent regarding the proposal during the committee meeting.
formal.zh: 两名成员在委员会会议上对该提案表达了异议。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kulħadd qabel mal-proposta? Maja: Le, kien hemm dissens; jien u Lara ma qbilniex.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did everyone agree with the proposal? Maja: No, there was dissent; Lara and I disagreed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：大家都同意这个提案吗？玛雅：没有，有不同意见；我和拉拉都不赞同。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 大家都同意这个提案吗？
messages.en: Did everyone agree with the proposal?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien hemm dissens; jien u Lara ma qbilniex.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien hemm dissens; jien u Lara ma qbilniex.
messages.zh: 没有，有不同意见；我和拉拉都不赞同。
messages.en: No, there was dissent; Lara and I disagreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议上有人举手说“我有不同意见”，把这一幕与名词 dissens 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 心不在焉的；注意力不集中的；分心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not paying full attention because one's thoughts or attention are elsewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因心思在别处或注意力被转移而没有专心的；心不在焉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx qed jagħti attenzjoni sħiħa għax ikun qed jaħseb f'xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心不在焉的；不专心的；注意力被其他事情分散的。

formal.mt: L-istudent kien distratt waqt l-ispjegazzjoni u ma semax l-istruzzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: The student was distracted during the explanation and did not hear all the instructions.
formal.zh: 这名学生在讲解时走了神，没有听到全部指示。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu, smajt x'għedt? Pawlu: Skużani, illum jien distratt. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
colloquial.en: Lara: Pawlu, did you hear what I said? Pawlu: Sorry, I'm distracted today. Can you tell me again?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗，你听到我刚才说的话了吗？保罗：抱歉，我今天有点心不在焉。你能再说一遍吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗，你听到我刚才说的话了吗？
messages.en: Pawlu, did you hear what I said?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, illum jien distratt. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, illum jien distratt. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.zh: 抱歉，我今天有点心不在焉。你能再说一遍吗？
messages.en: Sorry, I'm distracted today. Can you tell me again?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“人在教室，心在别处”的画面：distratt 用来形容这个心不在焉的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of absent-mindedness or inattention, or something that draws attention away from a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心不在焉或注意力不集中的状态，也可指使人无法专注于当前任务的干扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' attenzjoni, jew xi ħaġa li tiġbed l-attenzjoni 'l bogħod minn dak li jkun qed isir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心不在焉；注意力不集中；分心或使人分心的干扰。

formal.mt: Mument ta' distrazzjoni wassal biex l-istudent jikteb in-numru żbaljat fit-tweġiba.
formal.en: A moment of inattention caused the student to write the wrong number in the answer.
formal.zh: 片刻的走神使这名学生在答案中写错了数字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt il-mowbajl fil-kexxun? Mark: Għax huwa sors ta' distrazzjoni meta nkun qed nistudja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put your phone in the drawer? Mark: Because it's a source of distraction when I'm studying.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把手机放进抽屉里？马克：因为我学习时，它会让我分心。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把手机放进抽屉里？
messages.en: Why did you put your phone in the drawer?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa sors ta' distrazzjoni meta nkun qed nistudja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa sors ta' distrazzjoni meta nkun qed nistudja.
messages.zh: 因为我学习时，它会让我分心。
messages.en: Because it's a source of distraction when I'm studying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性对照记忆：distratt 描写“人分心了”，distrazzjoni 命名“分心这种状态或干扰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a district, neighbourhood, or local area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个地区、辖区或街区有关的，用来修饰当地的机构、服务或事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' distrett jew ma' żona lokali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街区的；邻里地区的；辖区的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat distrettwali se jiddiskuti l-ħtiġijiet tar-residenti fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The district committee will discuss residents' needs at its next meeting.
formal.zh: 地区委员会将在下次会议上讨论居民的需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nitlob informazzjoni dwar is-servizzi taż-żona? Mark: Mur fl-uffiċċju distrettwali; hemm jistgħu jgħinuk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I ask for information about local services? Mark: Go to the district office; they can help you there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以去哪里咨询本地区的服务？马克：去地区办事处吧；那里的人可以帮助你。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nitlob informazzjoni dwar is-servizzi taż-żona?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nitlob informazzjoni dwar is-servizzi taż-żona?
messages.zh: 我可以去哪里咨询本地区的服务？
messages.en: Where can I ask for information about local services?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur fl-uffiċċju distrettwali; hemm jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.mt_standard: Mur fl-uffiċċju distrettwali; hemm jistgħu jgħinuk.
messages.zh: 去地区办事处吧；那里的人可以帮助你。
messages.en: Go to the district office; they can help you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 distrettwali 放在“办事处、委员会”后一起记：它说明机构属于哪个地区，承担形容词作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A discharge: a release or letting out, including a patient's release from hospital.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出或释放；也可指患者获准离开医院，即出院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ jew rilaxx, inkluż meta pazjent jitħalla joħroġ mill-isptar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排出；释放；在医院语境中指出院。

formal.mt: L-ittra tad-disċarġ tinkludi sommarju tal-kura li rċieva l-pazjent fl-isptar.
formal.en: The discharge letter includes a summary of the care the patient received in hospital.
formal.zh: 出院信包含患者住院期间所接受治疗护理的摘要。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Meta se nirċievi l-ittra tad-disċarġ? Rita: Qabel titlaq; se nġibhielek dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: When will I receive the discharge letter? Rita: Before you leave; I'll bring it to you shortly.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我什么时候能拿到出院信？丽塔：你离开之前，我很快就给你拿来。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.zh: 我什么时候能拿到出院信？
messages.en: When will I receive the discharge letter?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.zh: 你离开之前，我很快就给你拿来。
messages.en: Before you leave; I'll bring it to you shortly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 discharge 作词形提示，再记医院场景“拿到出院信、离开医院”；遇到其他语境时，再判断是排出还是释放。

gloss_zh: 维护自身声誉的；以自己的工作为荣的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who safeguards their reputation or takes pride in their work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人注重维护自己的声誉，或以自己的工作为荣、用心对待工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħares ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu jew ikun kburi bix-xogħol tiegħu u jieħu ħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容注重维护自己声誉的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. with pride in their work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容以自己的工作为荣、重视工作质量的人。

collocations.en: a person who safeguards their reputation
collocations.zh: 注重维护自身声誉的人

collocations.en: a worker who takes pride in their work
collocations.zh: 以自己的工作为荣的劳动者

formal.mt: Bħala ħaddiem dittur, Pawlu jiċċekkja kull biċċa xogħol bir-reqqa qabel ma jgħaddiha lill-klijent.
formal.en: As a worker who takes pride in his work, Pawlu checks every job carefully before handing it over to the client.
formal.zh: 保罗以自己的工作为荣，因此每项工作在交给客户之前，他都会仔细检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu talab li jikkoreġu dak li qalu dwaru? Lara: Għax hu dittur u jħares ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu ask them to correct what they said about him? Lara: Because he cares about his good name and safeguards his reputation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么要求他们更正对他的说法？拉拉：因为他很重视自己的名声，会维护自己的声誉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu talab li jikkoreġu dak li qalu dwaru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu talab li jikkoreġu dak li qalu dwaru?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么要求他们更正对他的说法？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu ask them to correct what they said about him?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu dittur u jħares ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu dittur u jħares ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他很重视自己的名声，会维护自己的声誉。
messages.en: Because he cares about his good name and safeguards his reputation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“珍惜名声、珍惜手艺”两幅画面记 dittur，分别对应维护声誉和以工作为荣两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving enjoyment or amusement; entertaining or fun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能使人感到愉快、觉得有意思或发笑的；有趣好玩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti gost, idaħħak jew jagħmel il-ħin pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有趣的；逗人开心的；具有娱乐性、好玩的。

formal.mt: L-għalliema għażlet attività divertenti biex tgħin lill-istudenti jipprattikaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
formal.en: The teacher chose a fun activity to help the students practise the new vocabulary.
formal.zh: 老师选择了一项有趣的活动，帮助学生练习新词汇。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għoġbok il-film tal-bieraħ? Maja: Iva, kien divertenti ħafna; dħakt ħafna waqt li kont qed narah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you like yesterday's film? Maja: Yes, it was very entertaining; I laughed a lot while watching it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你喜欢昨天那部电影吗？玛雅：喜欢，特别有趣；我看的时候笑了好多次。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨天那部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like yesterday's film?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien divertenti ħafna; dħakt ħafna waqt li kont qed narah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien divertenti ħafna; dħakt ħafna waqt li kont qed narah.
messages.zh: 喜欢，特别有趣；我看的时候笑了好多次。
messages.en: Yes, it was very entertaining; I laughed a lot while watching it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看电影笑出声、玩游戏很开心的场景，把 divertenti 与“有趣、好玩、令人愉快”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bout of repeated belching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃中气体经口排出而形成的一阵连续嗳气，区别于膈肌痉挛造成的呃逆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' tifwigħ li taqbad lil persuna għal ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵连续嗳气；一阵从胃里排气的打嗝。

collocations.en: he had a fit of belching
a bout of belching after a meal

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, ir-raġel kellu dixxatura li damet ftit minuti.
formal.en: After the meal, the man had a bout of belching that lasted a few minutes.
formal.zh: 饭后，那名男子连续嗳气了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex waqaft tiekol? Pawlu: Qabditni dixxatura. Se nistenna ftit.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you stop eating? Pawlu: I've started belching repeatedly. I'll wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你怎么不吃了？Pawlu：我突然连续打嗝，先等一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不吃了？
messages.en: Why did you stop eating?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我突然连续打嗝，先等一会儿。
messages.en: I've started belching repeatedly. I'll wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dixxatura 联想到饭后接连几声嗳气的场景，记住它指“一阵发作”，不是单独一次打嗝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be broken down by the digestive system so that the body can use it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被消化系统分解并供身体利用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi diġerit mis-sistema diġestiva u jintuża mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可消化的；能够被身体消化的。

formal.mt: It-test iqabbel kemm dan l-ikel ikun diġeribbli qabel u wara t-tisjir.
formal.en: The test compares how digestible this food is before and after cooking.
formal.zh: 该测试比较这种食物在烹调前后的可消化程度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġifieri diġeribbli? David: Li jista' jiġi diġerit; jekk ngħidu faċilment diġeribbli, infissru li l-ġisem jista' jiddiġerih bla wisq diffikultà.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does diġeribbli mean? David: Able to be digested; if we say easily digestible, we mean that the body can digest it without much difficulty.
colloquial.zh: Nina：diġeribbli 是什么意思？David：就是能够被消化；如果说容易消化，就是指身体消化它时不会太费劲。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: diġeribbli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does diġeribbli mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jista' jiġi diġerit; jekk ngħidu faċilment diġeribbli, infissru li l-ġisem jista' jiddiġerih bla wisq diffikultà.
messages.mt_standard: Li jista' jiġi diġerit; jekk ngħidu faċilment diġeribbli, infissru li l-ġisem jista' jiddiġerih bla wisq diffikultà.
messages.zh: 就是能够被消化；如果说容易消化，就是指身体消化它时不会太费劲。
messages.en: Able to be digested; if we say easily digestible, we mean that the body can digest it without much difficulty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 diġeribbli 配上食物被身体分解吸收的画面，重点记住“能够被消化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to digestion or to the organs and processes that break down food in the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与消化有关的，或与身体分解食物所涉及的器官和过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-diġestjoni jew mal-organi u l-proċessi li bihom il-ġisem jiddiġerixxi l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化的；与消化过程或消化器官有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi r-rwol tal-istonku fil-proċess diġestiv.
formal.en: The chapter describes the stomach's role in the digestive process.
formal.zh: 本章描述胃在消化过程中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-proċess jissejjaħ diġestiv? Luke: Għax għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif il-ġisem jiddiġerixxi l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this process called digestive? Luke: Because it relates to how the body digests food.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这个过程被称为消化过程？Luke：因为它与身体如何消化食物有关。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这个过程被称为消化过程？
messages.en: Why is this process called digestive?

messages.speaker: Luke (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif il-ġisem jiddiġerixxi l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu x'jaqsam ma' kif il-ġisem jiddiġerixxi l-ikel.
messages.zh: 因为它与身体如何消化食物有关。
messages.en: Because it relates to how the body digests food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“消化过程”搭配记 diġestiv，表示与消化有关；再与“可消化的”作区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not paying enough attention to what is happening or being said.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有充分注意正在发生的事情或别人所说的话的；不专心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma joqgħodx attent biżżejjed għal dak li jkun qed jiġri jew jingħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不专心的；注意力不集中的；疏于留意的。

collocations.zh: 注意力不集中的驾驶员

formal.mt: Student diżattent jista' ma jifhimx l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem.
formal.en: An inattentive student may fail to understand the teacher's instructions.
formal.zh: 不专心的学生可能听不明白老师的指示。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt x'qal l-għalliem? Mark: Le, illum kont diżattent. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear what the teacher said? Mark: No, I wasn't paying attention today. Can you tell me again?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听到老师说什么了吗？Mark：没有，我今天没专心。你能再告诉我一遍吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你听到老师说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear what the teacher said?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum kont diżattent. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum kont diżattent. Tista' terġa' tgħidli?
messages.zh: 没有，我今天没专心。你能再告诉我一遍吗？
messages.en: No, I wasn't paying attention today. Can you tell me again?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师讲完指示，学生却还望着窗外：用 diżattent 给这个“没有专心听”的状态贴标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The office or service of a deacon, or ministry carried out in a religious community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 执事的职分或服务工作，也可指宗教团体中的事工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma jew il-kariga ta' djaknu, jew ministeru fi ħdan komunità reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执事职分；宗教团体中的服事工作或事工。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħidma tad-djakonija fil-parroċċa u s-servizz tagħha lill-komunità.
formal.en: The report describes the work of the ministry in the parish and its service to the community.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了堂区的事工及其为团体提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'qed taqra? Ġużeppi: Artiklu dwar id-djakonija u s-servizz lill-komunità.
colloquial.en: Anna: What are you reading? Ġużeppi: An article about ministry and service to the community.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你在读什么？Ġużeppi：一篇介绍教会事工和团体服务的文章。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Artiklu dwar id-djakonija u s-servizz lill-komunità.
messages.mt_standard: Artiklu dwar id-djakonija u s-servizz lill-komunità.
messages.zh: 一篇介绍教会事工和团体服务的文章。
messages.en: An article about ministry and service to the community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djakonija 放进“教会中承担服务工作”的画面，联系“执事职分、事工”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The diaconate: the religious order or rank of deacons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教会中的执事圣秩或执事职级。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ordni jew il-grad tad-djakni fil-Knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执事圣秩；教会中的执事职级。

collocations.zh: 为领受执事圣秩而接受的培育

formal.mt: Il-kandidat temm il-formazzjoni tiegħu qabel l-ordinazzjoni għad-djakunat.
formal.en: The candidate completed his formation before ordination to the diaconate.
formal.zh: 这名候选人在领受执事圣秩前完成了培育。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed jistudja dawn is-suġġetti? David: Qed iħejji ruħu għad-djakunat.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is he studying these subjects? David: He is preparing for the diaconate.
colloquial.zh: Rita：他为什么在学习这些科目？David：他正在为领受执事圣秩做准备。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在学习这些科目？
messages.en: Why is he studying these subjects?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 他正在为领受执事圣秩做准备。
messages.en: He is preparing for the diaconate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djakunat 与“受培育、领圣秩、成为执事”的顺序连起来，重点记住它指执事这一职级。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made of or relating to diamond, or resembling a diamond in appearance or qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由金刚石制成或与金刚石有关的；也指外观或性质像钻石的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul mid-djamant jew marbut miegħu, jew li jixbah lid-djamant fid-dehra jew fil-kwalitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金刚石的；钻石的；由金刚石制成或与之有关的。
像钻石的；具有类似钻石的外观或性质的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun wera leqq djamantin meta ġie eżaminat taħt id-dawl.
formal.en: The sample displayed a diamond-like sparkle when examined under the light.
formal.zh: 在灯光下检查时，样本呈现出钻石般的闪光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kif ileqq dan il-kristall! Toni: Għandu leqq djamantin, imma dan ma jfissirx li hu djamant.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how this crystal sparkles! Toni: It has a diamond-like sparkle, but that doesn't mean it is a diamond.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看这块晶体多闪亮！Toni：它有钻石般的闪光，但这不代表它就是钻石。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这块晶体多闪亮！
messages.en: Look how this crystal sparkles!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu leqq djamantin, imma dan ma jfissirx li hu djamant.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu leqq djamantin, imma dan ma jfissirx li hu djamant.
messages.zh: 它有钻石般的闪光，但这不代表它就是钻石。
messages.en: It has a diamond-like sparkle, but that doesn't mean it is a diamond.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 djamantin：金刚石粉强调材质，晶体的钻石般闪光强调相似；遇到它先看所修饰的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Undergoing melting, or capable of melting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正处于熔化过程中的；或具有能够熔化这一性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed idub, jew li jkollu l-ħila li jdub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在熔化的；处于由固态变为液态的过程中的。
能够熔化的；具有可熔化性质的。

collocations.en: metal undergoing melting in the furnace
material capable of melting when heated

formal.mt: Il-kampjun huwa materjal djubi: jista' jdub meta jissaħħan biżżejjed.
formal.en: The sample is a fusible material: it can melt when heated sufficiently.
formal.zh: 该样本是一种可熔材料：加热到足够程度时能够熔化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser li dan il-materjal hu djubi? Karl: Li jista' jdub meta jissaħħan biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does it mean that this material is fusible? Karl: That it can melt when heated sufficiently.
colloquial.zh: Nina：说这种材料可熔是什么意思？Karl：就是说它加热到足够程度时能熔化。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li dan il-materjal hu djubi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li dan il-materjal hu djubi?
messages.zh: 说这种材料可熔是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that this material is fusible?

messages.speaker: Karl (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jista' jdub meta jissaħħan biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Li jista' jdub meta jissaħħan biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 就是说它加热到足够程度时能熔化。
messages.en: That it can melt when heated sufficiently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 djubi 画两格图：一格是固体正在变液体，一格是固体旁标“加热可熔”；分别记住过程义与能力义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition or degree of being narrow, with little width or space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽度小、空间有限的状态，或这种狭窄的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa li tkun dejqa, bi ftit wisa' jew spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄；宽度不足的状态或程度。

formal.mt: Id-djuq tat-triq jagħmilha diffiċli biex żewġ vetturi jgħaddu minn ħdejn xulxin.
formal.en: The narrowness of the road makes it difficult for two vehicles to pass each other.
formal.zh: 道路狭窄，使两辆车难以交会通过。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma nistgħux inġorru s-sufan minn hawn? Luqa: Minħabba d-djuq tal-kuritur. Ejja nkejluh l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can't we carry the sofa through here? Luqa: Because of the narrowness of the corridor. Let's measure it first.
colloquial.zh: Marta：为什么不能把沙发从这里搬过去？Luqa：因为走廊太窄。我们先量一下吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux inġorru s-sufan minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux inġorru s-sufan minn hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么不能把沙发从这里搬过去？
messages.en: Why can't we carry the sofa through here?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba d-djuq tal-kuritur. Ejja nkejluh l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba d-djuq tal-kuritur. Ejja nkejluh l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 因为走廊太窄。我们先量一下吧。
messages.en: Because of the narrowness of the corridor. Let's measure it first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沙发卡在窄走廊里，把造成困难的“狭窄这一状态”叫作 djuq，提醒自己这里是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A propensity to bring about fertilisation or pollination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促成受精或进行传粉的倾向；强调这种倾向本身，而非一次已经完成的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza li jiffertilizza jew idakkar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使受精或进行传粉的倾向。

collocations.en: a strong propensity to fertilise or pollinate
collocations.zh: 较强的使受精或传粉倾向

collocations.en: the plant's propensity to fertilise or pollinate
collocations.zh: 植物使受精或传粉的倾向

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel id-dkura ta' żewġ varjetajiet tal-istess pjanta taħt kundizzjonijiet simili.
formal.en: The study compares the propensity to fertilise or pollinate of two varieties of the same plant under similar conditions.
formal.zh: 该研究比较同一种植物的两个品种在相似条件下使受精或传粉的倾向。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser dkura f'dan it-test? Simon: It-tendenza li jiffertilizza jew idakkar; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar pjanta.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does dkura mean in this text? Simon: A propensity to fertilise or pollinate; here they are talking about a plant.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这篇文章里的 dkura 是什么意思？Simon：使受精或传粉的倾向；这里说的是一种植物。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 dkura 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dkura mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Simon (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tendenza li jiffertilizza jew idakkar; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar pjanta.
messages.mt_standard: It-tendenza li jiffertilizza jew idakkar; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar pjanta.
messages.zh: 使受精或传粉的倾向；这里说的是一种植物。
messages.en: A propensity to fertilise or pollinate; here they are talking about a plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dkura 配一张植物传粉示意图，再在旁边写“倾向”：这样记住的是使受精或传粉的倾向，而非一次传粉事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat dark, with relatively little light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线有些不足、略显昏暗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun xi ftit mudlam, b'dawl mhux qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略暗的；有些昏暗的。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur kien dlajjem, u għalhekk tqiegħed dawl ieħor ħdejn it-taraġ.
formal.en: The corridor was somewhat dark, so another light was placed near the stairs.
formal.zh: 走廊略显昏暗，因此在楼梯旁增设了一盏灯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kantun jidher dlajjem. Mark: Iva, ejja nixegħlu l-lampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This corner looks a little dark. Mark: Yes, let's turn on the lamp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个角落看起来有点暗。马克：是啊，我们把灯打开吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个角落看起来有点暗。
messages.en: This corner looks a little dark.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把灯打开吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's turn on the lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走廊还看得清，却需要补一盏灯：把 dlajjem 记成“略暗”，注意程度只是“有点”。

gloss_zh: 身体虚弱的人；瘦弱的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is physically frail or weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体虚弱、显得缺乏体力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna dgħajfa fil-ġisem, li ma tantx għandha saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体虚弱的人；体质孱弱的人。

collocations.en: a frail person who needs help

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, id-dliela timxi bil-mod u tistrieħ ta' spiss.
formal.en: In the story, the frail person walks slowly and rests frequently.
formal.zh: 故事中，这位身体虚弱的人走得很慢，而且经常休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel jidher għajjien ħafna. Mark: Huwa dliela; ejja nġibulu siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: That man looks very tired. Mark: He's a frail person; let's get him a chair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那位男士看起来很累。马克：他身体很虚弱，我们给他搬把椅子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位男士看起来很累。
messages.en: That man looks very tired.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他身体很虚弱，我们给他搬把椅子吧。
messages.en: He's a frail person; let's get him a chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“给虚弱的人搬椅子”的画面记 dliela；它是指人的名词，学习时连同“一个虚弱者”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slender in build, or physically frail and lacking strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容身材纤细，也可形容身体瘦弱、缺乏力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem irqiq, jew li jkun dgħajjef u bla ħafna saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纤细的；身材修长而清瘦的。
身体虚弱的；瘦弱而缺乏力量的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi żagħżugħ dlieli, b'ġisem irqiq u movimenti ħfief.
formal.en: The author describes a slender young man with a slim body and light movements.
formal.zh: 作者描写了一位身材纤细、动作轻盈的年轻男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak ir-raġel dlieli qed jistrieħ? Mark: Jidher bla saħħa; ejja noffrulu siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is that frail man resting? Mark: He looks weak; let's offer him a chair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个瘦弱的男人为什么在休息？马克：他看起来没什么力气，我们请他坐下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak ir-raġel dlieli qed jistrieħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak ir-raġel dlieli qed jistrieħ?
messages.zh: 那个瘦弱的男人为什么在休息？
messages.en: Why is that frail man resting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher bla saħħa; ejja noffrulu siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher bla saħħa; ejja noffrulu siġġu.
messages.zh: 他看起来没什么力气，我们请他坐下吧。
messages.en: He looks weak; let's offer him a chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dlieli 配两幅图：一幅是纤细的身形，一幅是虚弱地休息；“纤细”与“虚弱”要按语境分别理解。

gloss_zh: 柔软的；软嫩的；湿润的泥土（农业用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soft or tender, rather than hard or tough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地柔软或软嫩的，可用来描述触感或食物的口感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun artab jew tari, mhux iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔软的；质地不硬的。
软嫩的；容易咬动或切开的。

sense_translations.en_definition: damp earth (used in an agricultural context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿润的泥土；农业语境中指带有水分的土壤。

collocations.en: the damp earth in the field

formal.mt: Fir-rapport agrikolu, il-kelma dlil tintuża bħala nom biex tfisser ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: In the agricultural report, the word dlil is used as a noun meaning damp earth.
formal.zh: 在这份农业报告中，dlil 用作名词，表示湿润的泥土。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġie l-laħam? Mark: Ġie dlil ħafna; tista' taqtgħu faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meat turn out? Mark: It turned out very tender; you can cut it easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：肉做得怎么样？马克：很软嫩，很容易切开。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 肉做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meat turn out?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie dlil ħafna; tista' taqtgħu faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie dlil ħafna; tista' taqtgħu faċilment.
messages.zh: 很软嫩，很容易切开。
messages.en: It turned out very tender; you can cut it easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dlil 分成两张词卡：形容词卡画软布和嫩肉，名词卡画湿润田土；用词性帮助分清三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dark or obscure because there is little light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线不足、显得黑暗或幽暗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mudlam jew ftit imdawwal, u ma jidhirx ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑暗的；幽暗而看不清楚的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ kien dlumi, u l-viżitaturi kellhom bżonn torċa biex jaraw it-triq.
formal.en: The passage was dark, and the visitors needed a torch to see the way.
formal.zh: 通道里光线昏暗，参观者需要用手电筒照路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kuritur dlumi wisq. Mark: Stenna ftit, għandi torċa fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: This corridor is too dark. Mark: Wait a moment, I have a torch in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条走廊太暗了。马克：等一下，我包里有手电筒。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 这条走廊太暗了。
messages.en: This corridor is too dark.

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 等一下，我包里有手电筒。
messages.en: Wait a moment, I have a torch in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进入幽暗通道后打开手电筒，把 dlumi 与“黑暗、看不清”的场景绑定，连同 passaġġ dlumi 一起朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small tear; the diminutive form of demgħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小滴眼泪，是 demgħa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Demgħa żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' demgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small tear (the diminutive form of 'demgħa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小滴眼泪；demgħa（眼泪）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little tear on the cheek

formal.mt: Meta semgħet l-aħbar it-tajba, niżlet dmejgħa ta' ferħ minn għajn l-omm.
formal.en: When the mother heard the good news, a little tear of joy fell from her eye.
formal.zh: 母亲听到好消息时，眼中落下了一小滴喜悦的泪水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek dmejgħa fuq ħaddejk. Mark: Iva, il-film messli qalbi.
colloquial.en: Maja: You have a little tear on your cheek. Mark: Yes, the film touched my heart.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你脸颊上有一小滴眼泪。马克：是啊，这部电影让我很感动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你脸颊上有一小滴眼泪。
messages.en: You have a little tear on your cheek.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，这部电影让我很感动。
messages.en: Yes, the film touched my heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demgħa 和 dmejgħa 并排写，后者旁边画一颗小泪珠；借“小一滴”的画面记住所给的指小关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces something happening whilst another situation continues, or a condition meaning as long as.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接分句，表示另一情况持续期间，或表示“只要”某个条件成立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ partijiet ta' sentenza biex tfisser waqt li jew sakemm tibqa' tgħodd kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当……期间；只要……，用于引出持续的情况或条件。

collocations.en: as long as there is time

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jistgħu jużaw il-kamra dment li jħalluha nadifa wara l-laqgħa.
formal.en: Participants may use the room as long as they leave it clean after the meeting.
formal.zh: 参与者可以使用这个房间，只要他们在会议结束后将其清理干净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nissellef il-ktieb tiegħek? Mark: Iva, dment li ġġibuli lura għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I borrow your book? Mark: Yes, as long as you bring it back to me tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能借你的书吗？马克：可以，只要你明天还给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能借你的书吗？
messages.en: Can I borrow your book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dment li ġġibuli lura għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dment li ġġibuli lura għada.
messages.zh: 可以，只要你明天还给我。
messages.en: Yes, as long as you bring it back to me tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“可以借书，只要明天归还”记 dment li 的条件用法；另把“某情况持续期间”作为时间义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving or marked by bloodshed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及流血或以流血暴力为特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih jinxtered id-demm minħabba l-vjolenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 血腥的；涉及流血或杀戮的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi kunflitt dmewwi u l-effetti tiegħu fuq il-popolazzjoni.
formal.en: The study describes a bloody conflict and its effects on the population.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了一场血腥冲突及其对民众的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-film dmewwi? Mark: Iva, fih ħafna vjolenza; nippreferi kummiedja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this film bloody? Mark: Yes, it has a lot of violence; I'd prefer a comedy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部电影血腥吗？马克：是啊，里面有很多暴力情节，我更想看喜剧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影血腥吗？
messages.en: Is this film bloody?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih ħafna vjolenza; nippreferi kummiedja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih ħafna vjolenza; nippreferi kummiedja.
messages.zh: 是啊，里面有很多暴力情节，我更想看喜剧。
messages.en: Yes, it has a lot of violence; I'd prefer a comedy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dmewwi 放进“这部电影血腥吗”的选片对话中记忆，再配上 kunflitt dmewwi，抓住“流血暴力”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drops of liquid that come from the eyes, especially when someone cries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从眼睛流出的泪水，尤其指哭泣时流出的眼泪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtar ta' likwidu li joħroġ mill-għajnejn, speċjalment meta persuna tibki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼泪；泪水

formal.mt: Wara li qrat l-ittra, kellha għajnejha mimlijin dmugħ.
formal.en: After reading the letter, her eyes were full of tears.
formal.zh: 读完信后，她的眼里噙满了泪水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek id-dmugħ f'għajnejk? Nina: Il-film messli qalbi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have tears in your eyes? Nina: The film touched my heart.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么眼里有泪水？妮娜：这部电影让我很感动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么眼里有泪水？
messages.en: Why do you have tears in your eyes?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影让我很感动。
messages.en: The film touched my heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dmugħ 和眼角的一滴泪联系起来，再用“擦去眼泪”这个动作记住 timsaħ id-dmugħ。

gloss_zh: 爱哭的；渗出水分的；潮湿的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to weeping; also used of something that gives off moisture or is damp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易哭泣；也可形容物体渗出水分或处于潮湿状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibki malajr; ukoll, li joħroġ l-umdità jew ikun niedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易哭泣的；爱哭的
渗出水分的；分泌水分的
潮湿的；微湿的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħajt bħala dmugħi minħabba l-umdità li tidher fuqu.
formal.en: The report describes the wall as damp because of the moisture visible on it.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这面墙表面可见水分，因此处于潮湿状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tibki? Mark: Illum inħossni dmugħi; anki storja żgħira tqanqalli d-dmugħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you crying? Mark: I feel weepy today; even a little story brings tears to my eyes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么哭了？马克：我今天特别容易哭，连一个小故事都会让我掉眼泪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么哭了？
messages.en: Why are you crying?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum inħossni dmugħi; anki storja żgħira tqanqalli d-dmugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Illum inħossni dmugħi; anki storja żgħira tqanqalli d-dmugħ.
messages.zh: 我今天特别容易哭，连一个小故事都会让我掉眼泪。
messages.en: I feel weepy today; even a little story brings tears to my eyes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记住 dmugħi：一个容易落泪的人，一面带着湿气的墙；分别对应爱哭与潮湿的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the capital city of Tanzania.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坦桑尼亚首都的城市名称，中文译作“多多马”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-belt kapitali tat-Tanżanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多多马，坦桑尼亚的首都

formal.mt: Dodoma hija l-belt kapitali tat-Tanżanija.
formal.en: Dodoma is the capital city of Tanzania.
formal.zh: 多多马是坦桑尼亚的首都。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi l-belt kapitali tat-Tanżanija? Mark: Dodoma. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the capital city of Tanzania? Mark: Dodoma. Let's look for it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：坦桑尼亚的首都是哪里？马克：多多马。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 坦桑尼亚的首都是哪里？
messages.en: What is the capital city of Tanzania?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 多多马。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: Dodoma. Let's look for it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的地图上给 Dodoma 贴上“坦桑尼亚首都”的标签，并把它与中文地名“多多马”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of being domesticated and kept by humans as a domestic animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被人类驯化，并作为家养动物饲养的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitrabba u jgħix mal-bniedem bħala annimal domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可驯化的；能够成为家养动物的

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina jekk dan l-annimal huwiex domestikabbli.
formal.en: The study examines whether this animal is domesticable.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察这种动物是否可以被驯化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dan l-annimal hu domestikabbli? Mark: Ma nafx; ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li jifhem fl-annimali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think this animal is domesticable? Mark: I don't know; let's ask someone who knows about animals.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这种动物可以驯化吗？马克：我不知道，我们问问懂动物的人吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan l-annimal hu domestikabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan l-annimal hu domestikabbli?
messages.zh: 你觉得这种动物可以驯化吗？
messages.en: Do you think this animal is domesticable?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li jifhem fl-annimali.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li jifhem fl-annimali.
messages.zh: 我不知道，我们问问懂动物的人吧。
messages.en: I don't know; let's ask someone who knows about animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 domestikabbli 放进“这种动物能否成为家养动物”的问题中记忆；重点记住“可以驯化”，而非“已经驯化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Within a country, or in a way connected with the home or household.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事发生在本国境内，或与家庭生活、家务范围有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi ħdan il-pajjiż, jew b'mod li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dar u l-ħajja tal-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在国内；在家庭范围内；就家庭生活而言

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika kemm minn dan il-prodott jinbiegħ domestikament.
formal.en: The report indicates how much of this product is sold domestically.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这种产品在国内的销售量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-prodott isir domestikament? Mark: Iva, isir hawn fil-pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this product made domestically? Mark: Yes, it is made here in the country.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这种产品是在国内制造的吗？马克：是的，就在本国制造。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种产品是在国内制造的吗？
messages.en: Is this product made domestically?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，就在本国制造。
messages.en: Yes, it is made here in the country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 domestikament 在回答“事情在哪个范围内进行”：谈生产销售时想到国内，谈家庭事务时想到家庭范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that something seems to be the case, judging by its appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据表面迹象表示某种情况似乎如此，并不直接断言它确定属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika li xi ħaġa tidher li hi hekk, skont dak li wieħed jara jew jinnota.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似乎；从表面看来；看起来

collocations.en: it looks as though it is going to rain

formal.mt: Mit-tweġiba tiegħu, donn ma fehemx il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: Judging by his answer, he seems not to have understood the question.
formal.zh: 从他的回答来看，他似乎没有理解这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Donn se tagħmel ix-xita. Mark: Mela nieħu l-umbrella miegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: It looks as though it is going to rain. Mark: Then I'll take my umbrella with me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看起来要下雨了。马克：那我把伞带上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看起来要下雨了。
messages.en: It looks as though it is going to rain.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我把伞带上。
messages.en: Then I'll take my umbrella with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见乌云后说“好像要下雨”，把 donn 记作依据迹象作判断时使用的“似乎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to, situated on, or directed toward the back of a body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与身体背部有关的，位于背侧的，或朝向背侧的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dahar, jinsab fuq id-dahar jew iħares lejn in-naħa tad-dahar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背部的；背侧的；朝向背侧的

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi n-naħa dorsali tal-ġisem.
formal.en: The diagram shows the dorsal side of the body.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了身体的背侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tissejjaħ din il-pinna fuq dahar il-ħuta? Mark: Dik hi l-pinna dorsali.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this fin on the fish's back called? Mark: That is the dorsal fin.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：鱼背上的这个鳍叫什么？马克：那是背鳍。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tissejjaħ din il-pinna fuq dahar il-ħuta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tissejjaħ din il-pinna fuq dahar il-ħuta?
messages.zh: 鱼背上的这个鳍叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fin on the fish's back called?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 那是背鳍。
messages.en: That is the dorsal fin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条鱼背上竖起的背鳍，把 pinna dorsali 整体记作“背鳍”，再将 dorsali 对应到“背侧的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of music; also a small strike or blow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一小段乐曲，也可指轻微的一击或一次小小的敲击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa mużika żgħira; ukoll, daqqa żgħira jew ħafifa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small piece of music (the diminutive of 'daqqa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小段乐曲（daqqa 的指小形式）
轻微的一击；一次小小的敲击

collocations.en: to play a little piece of music

formal.mt: L-istudent daqq dqajqa fuq il-pjanu qabel beda l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The student played a little piece on the piano before beginning the exercise.
formal.zh: 学生在开始练习前，先用钢琴弹奏了一小段乐曲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dqajqa mal-bieb. Kont int? Mark: Iva, tajtu dqajqa ħafifa biex ma nqajjimx lit-tarbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard a little tap on the door. Was that you? Mark: Yes, I gave it a light tap so I wouldn't wake the baby.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我听见有人轻轻敲了一下门，是你吗？马克：是的，我轻轻敲了一下，免得吵醒宝宝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我听见有人轻轻敲了一下门，是你吗？
messages.en: I heard a little tap on the door. Was that you?

messages.speaker: Mark (来访的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajtu dqajqa ħafifa biex ma nqajjimx lit-tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajtu dqajqa ħafifa biex ma nqajjimx lit-tarbija.
messages.zh: 是的，我轻轻敲了一下，免得吵醒宝宝。
messages.en: Yes, I gave it a light tap so I wouldn't wake the baby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“小”记住 dqajqa：钢琴上的一小段乐曲，门上的一次小敲击；通过场景判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ground or crushed into fine powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经研磨或粉碎而成为细粉末的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mitħun jew imfarrak fi trab fin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨成粉末的；粉碎成细粉的

formal.mt: Wara t-tħin, il-materjal dqiqi nġabar f'kontenitur separat għall-analiżi.
formal.en: After grinding, the pulverised material was collected in a separate container for analysis.
formal.zh: 研磨后，粉碎成细粉的材料被收集到单独的容器中，以供分析。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġibs dqiqi biżżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, sar trab fin u ma fihx biċċiet kbar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this gypsum pulverised finely enough? Pawlu: Yes, it has become fine powder and has no large pieces.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这石膏磨得够细了吗？保罗：够了，已经成了细粉，没有大块了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这石膏磨得够细了吗？
messages.en: Is this gypsum pulverised finely enough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sar trab fin u ma fihx biċċiet kbar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sar trab fin u ma fihx biċċiet kbar.
messages.zh: 够了，已经成了细粉，没有大块了。
messages.en: Yes, it has become fine powder and has no large pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大块石膏磨成细粉的画面与 dqiqi 绑定，记住它描述粉碎后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mythical dragon; in a military context, a dragoon soldier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神话或故事中的龙；在军事语境中也指龙骑兵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa fantastika li tidher fil-ħrejjef; f'kuntest militari, suldat ta' tip ta' kavallerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 龙，神话或传说中的幻想生物
龙骑兵，一类骑兵士兵

collocations.zh: 一名身穿军服的龙骑兵

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni tal-ħrafa turi dragun kbir quddiem il-bieb ta' kastell.
formal.en: The illustration of the tale shows a large dragon in front of a castle gate.
formal.zh: 这则传说的插图画着一条巨龙，位于城堡大门前。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hawn suldat taħt il-kelma dragun? Mark: Għax dragun jista' jfisser ukoll tip ta' suldat, mhux biss ħlejqa tal-ħrejjef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a soldier under the word dragun? Mark: Because dragun can also mean a type of soldier, as well as a mythical creature.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么 dragun 这个词下面画着一个士兵？马克：因为 dragun 也可以指一种士兵，也就是龙骑兵，还可以指传说中的龙。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hawn suldat taħt il-kelma dragun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hawn suldat taħt il-kelma dragun?
messages.zh: 为什么 dragun 这个词下面画着一个士兵？
messages.en: Why is there a soldier under the word dragun?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dragun jista' jfisser ukoll tip ta' suldat, mhux biss ħlejqa tal-ħrejjef.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dragun jista' jfisser ukoll tip ta' suldat, mhux biss ħlejqa tal-ħrejjef.
messages.zh: 因为 dragun 也可以指一种士兵，也就是龙骑兵，还可以指传说中的龙。
messages.en: Because dragun can also mean a type of soldier, as well as a mythical creature.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dragun 配两张记忆卡：故事里是龙，军队语境里是龙骑兵；靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dragonet, a fish belonging to the family Callionymidae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼠衔鱼，属于鼠衔鱼科的鱼类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta li tappartjeni għall-familja Callionymidae.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼠衔鱼，鼠衔鱼科鱼类

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-ħuta fir-ritratt bħala dragunett tal-familja Callionymidae.
formal.en: The guide identifies the fish in the photograph as a dragonet of the family Callionymidae.
formal.zh: 这本指南将照片中的鱼辨认为鼠衔鱼科的一条鼠衔鱼。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jisimha din il-ħuta fir-ritratt? Toni: Dragunett; ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida tal-ħut.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this fish in the photograph called? Toni: A dragonet; let's look it up in the fish guide.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：照片里的这条鱼叫什么？托尼：鼠衔鱼，我们在鱼类指南里查查吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这条鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fish in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 鼠衔鱼，我们在鱼类指南里查查吧。
messages.en: A dragonet; let's look it up in the fish guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dragunett 写在鱼类照片旁，并配上鼠衔鱼科标签，看到这个词就先想到鱼。

gloss_zh: 轻轻的一击；小小的一下敲击

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small strike or light blow, expressed as a diminutive of darba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次小小的敲击或轻击，是 darba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa żgħira jew ħafifa; forma diminuttiva ta' darba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small strike (the diminutive form of 'darba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的一击；轻击，是 darba 的指小形式

collocations.en: a small knock on the door

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ta drajba ħafifa bil-martell fuq il-biċċa tal-injam.
formal.en: The worker gave the piece of wood a light tap with the hammer.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子在那块木头上轻轻敲了一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħti drajba fuq il-bieb? Sara: Iva, bil-mod, għax it-tarbija rieqda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I give the door a little knock? Sara: Yes, gently, because the baby is asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我轻轻敲一下门好吗？萨拉：好，轻一点，宝宝睡着了。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我轻轻敲一下门好吗？
messages.en: Shall I give the door a little knock?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，轻一点，宝宝睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, gently, because the baby is asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象怕吵醒宝宝，只在门上轻敲一下；用这个动作记住 drajba 的轻小一击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small molar tooth, expressed as a diminutive of darsa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一颗小小的臼齿，是 darsa 的指小形式，强调牙齿小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darsa żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' darsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的臼齿，是 darsa 的指小形式

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina d-drajsa bir-reqqa u spjega lill-pazjent dak li ra.
formal.en: The dentist examined the small molar carefully and explained to the patient what he saw.
formal.zh: 牙医仔细检查了那颗小臼齿，并向患者解释了所见情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din id-drajsa tidher żgħira ħafna fil-mudell. Mark: Iva, qabbilha mad-darsa l-kbira ta' ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Lara: This little molar looks very small in the model. Mark: Yes, compare it with the large molar beside it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：模型里的这颗小臼齿看起来真小。马克：是啊，把它和旁边那颗大臼齿比较一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-drajsa tidher żgħira ħafna fil-mudell.
messages.mt_standard: Din id-drajsa tidher żgħira ħafna fil-mudell.
messages.zh: 模型里的这颗小臼齿看起来真小。
messages.en: This little molar looks very small in the model.

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qabbilha mad-darsa l-kbira ta' ħdejha.
