messages.mt_standard: Iva, qabbilha mad-darsa l-kbira ta' ħdejha.
messages.zh: 是啊，把它和旁边那颗大臼齿比较一下。
messages.en: Yes, compare it with the large molar beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 darsa 和 drajsa 配成大小两颗臼齿的图，记住后者强调小，并非另一种牙齿分类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The art of presenting stories and characters through acted performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过演员表演来呈现故事和人物的艺术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arti li tippreżenta stejjer u karattri permezz tar-reċtar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧艺术，通过表演呈现人物与故事的艺术

formal.mt: Il-kors tad-drama jgħin lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw il-vuċi, il-moviment u l-interpretazzjoni tal-karattri.
formal.en: The drama course helps students develop their voice, movement and interpretation of characters.
formal.zh: 这门戏剧课程帮助学生提升发声、形体动作及角色诠释能力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tiġi għall-kors tad-drama miegħi? Toni: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem nirreċta fuq il-palk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will you come to the drama course with me? Toni: Yes, I'd like to learn to act on stage.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你要和我一起上戏剧课吗？托尼：要，我想学习在舞台上表演。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要和我一起上戏剧课吗？
messages.en: Will you come to the drama course with me?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem nirreċta fuq il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem nirreċta fuq il-palk.
messages.zh: 要，我想学习在舞台上表演。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to learn to act on stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 drama 和舞台、演员、角色三幅画面连起来，记住这里指戏剧这门艺术。

gloss_zh: 戏剧性地；显著地；夸张地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a striking or theatrical manner, or to a very noticeable extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以引人注目或富于戏剧性的方式；也可表示变化程度显著。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jolqot ħafna jew jidher teatrali, jew sa grad li juri bidla kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧性地；显著地、大幅度地；以夸张的表演方式

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, in-numru ta' parteċipanti żdied drammatikament matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: According to the report, the number of participants increased dramatically over the past year.
formal.zh: 根据报告，参与人数在过去一年中大幅增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tirreaġixxi daqshekk drammatikament? Pawlu: Qed nipprova xena għad-drama ta' għada!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you reacting so dramatically? Pawlu: I'm rehearsing a scene for tomorrow's drama performance!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么反应得这么夸张？保罗：我在排练明天戏剧演出里的一场戏！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么反应得这么夸张？
messages.en: Why are you reacting so dramatically?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nipprova xena għad-drama ta' għada!
messages.mt_standard: Qed nipprova xena għad-drama ta' għada!
messages.zh: 我在排练明天戏剧演出里的一场戏！
messages.en: I'm rehearsing a scene for tomorrow's drama performance!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 drammatikament：演员夸张地反应，图表数字大幅上升；都很引人注目。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who writes plays for theatrical performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作供戏剧表演使用的剧本的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb xogħlijiet drammatiċi biex jittellgħu fuq il-palk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剧作家；创作戏剧剧本的人

formal.mt: Id-drammaturgu ppreżenta x-xogħol il-ġdid tiegħu waqt laqgħa mal-atturi u d-direttur.
formal.en: The playwright presented his new work during a meeting with the actors and the director.
formal.zh: 剧作家在与演员和导演的会议上介绍了自己的新作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kiteb id-djalogu ta' dan id-dramm? Mark: Id-drammaturgu; wara l-ispettaklu se jitkellem magħna dwar il-kitba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who wrote the dialogue for this play? Mark: The playwright; after the performance, he will talk to us about his writing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这出戏的对白是谁写的？马克：剧作家写的；演出结束后，他会和我们聊聊自己的创作。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kiteb id-djalogu ta' dan id-dramm?
messages.mt_standard: Min kiteb id-djalogu ta' dan id-dramm?
messages.zh: 这出戏的对白是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote the dialogue for this play?

messages.speaker: Mark (剧院工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-drammaturgu; wara l-ispettaklu se jitkellem magħna dwar il-kitba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Id-drammaturgu; wara l-ispettaklu se jitkellem magħna dwar il-kitba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 剧作家写的；演出结束后，他会和我们聊聊自己的创作。
messages.en: The playwright; after the performance, he will talk to us about his writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台旁有人伏案写人物对白，把 drammaturgu 贴在他身上，记住他是剧作家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hitting someone or something, or of causing wounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击打人或物的行为，也可指使人受伤的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tolqot lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew li tikkawża ġrieħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击打；打击的行为。
致伤；使人受伤的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-drib ripetut fuq id-driegħ tal-vittma.
formal.en: The report describes the repeated hitting of the victim's arm.
formal.zh: 报告描述了反复击打受害者手臂的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak l-istorbju? Mark: Kien id-drib ta' ballun mal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise? Mark: It was a ball repeatedly hitting the wall.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才是什么声音？Mark：是球反复撞墙的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是球反复撞墙的声音。
messages.en: It was a ball repeatedly hitting the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把球撞墙的击打画面与打人致伤的画面并排记，分别对应两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harvested crops or other material waiting to be threshed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经收割、尚待脱粒的庄稼或谷物材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uċuħ tar-raba' maħsuda li għad iridu jindirsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有待脱粒的东西，尤指已收割的谷物或庄稼。

collocations.en: a heap of crops awaiting threshing

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ġabar id-dries f'post niexef sakemm jasal iż-żmien tad-dris.
formal.en: The farmer gathered the crops awaiting threshing in a dry place until it was time to thresh them.
formal.zh: 农民把待脱粒的庄稼集中放在干燥处，等待脱粒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dak il-munzell? Pawlu: Dak dries tal-qamħ; għad irridu nidirsuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in that heap? Pawlu: That's wheat awaiting threshing; we still need to thresh it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那一堆是什么？Pawlu：是待脱粒的小麦，我们还得给它脱粒。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那一堆是什么？
messages.en: What's in that heap?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dries tal-qamħ; għad irridu nidirsuh.
messages.mt_standard: Dak dries tal-qamħ; għad irridu nidirsuh.
messages.zh: 是待脱粒的小麦，我们还得给它脱粒。
messages.en: That's wheat awaiting threshing; we still need to thresh it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谷堆上挂着“等待脱粒”的牌子：dries 指等待加工的庄稼，记住它表示材料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or habit of getting out of bed early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清早起床的行为或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew id-drawwa li tqum mis-sodda kmieni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；很早起床的行为。

collocations.en: the habit of getting up early
the benefits of getting up early

formal.mt: Id-drik jagħti lill-istudent aktar ħin biex jipprepara qabel l-ewwel lezzjoni.
formal.en: Getting up early gives the student more time to prepare before the first lesson.
formal.zh: 早起让学生在第一节课前有更多准备时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif irnexxielek tlesti kollox qabel it-tmienja? Maja: Id-drik għenni; qomt fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you manage to finish everything before eight? Maja: Getting up early helped me; I got up at six.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你怎么能在八点前把所有事做完？Maja：早起帮了忙，我六点就起床了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek tlesti kollox qabel it-tmienja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek tlesti kollox qabel it-tmienja?
messages.zh: 你怎么能在八点前把所有事做完？
messages.en: How did you manage to finish everything before eight?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 早起帮了忙，我六点就起床了。
messages.en: Getting up early helped me; I got up at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 drik 写在清晨六点的闹钟旁，联想“早早离开被窝”，记住它是表示早起的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of separating grain or seeds from harvested stalks and ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把谷粒或种子从已收割的茎秆、谷穗上分离出来的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jifred il-ħbub miż-żkuk u mis-sbul wara l-ħsad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱粒；使谷粒从谷穗或茎秆上分离的作业。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, isir id-dris biex il-ħbub jinfirdu miż-zkuk.
formal.en: After harvesting, threshing is carried out to separate the grain from the stalks.
formal.zh: 收割后进行脱粒，把谷粒从茎秆上分离出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex tintuża din il-magna? Pawlu: Għad-dris; tifred il-ħbub miż-zkuk.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this machine used for? Pawlu: For threshing; it separates the grain from the stalks.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这台机器是做什么用的？Pawlu：用来脱粒，把谷粒从茎秆上分离出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这台机器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this machine used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 用来脱粒，把谷粒从茎秆上分离出来。
messages.en: For threshing; it separates the grain from the stalks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dries 的待脱粒谷堆与 dris 的脱粒作业配成两张图：一张记材料，一张记加工过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The legal right that protects a creator's work and governs its use or copying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护创作者作品，并规范作品使用或复制的法律权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt legali li jipproteġi x-xogħol ta' awtur u jirregola l-użu jew l-ikkupjar tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著作权；创作者对其作品享有的版权。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tal-pubblikazzjoni tinkludi taqsima dwar id-dritt tal-awtur u l-użu ta' stampi.
formal.en: The publishing guide includes a section on copyright and the use of images.
formal.zh: 出版指南包含一个关于著作权与图片使用的章节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nuża din l-istampa fil-ktejjeb tagħna? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dritt tal-awtur u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-użu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I use this image in our booklet? Mark: Let's check the copyright and the terms of use.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以在我们的小册子里用这张图片吗？Mark：我们先查一下版权和使用条件吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża din l-istampa fil-ktejjeb tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża din l-istampa fil-ktejjeb tagħna?
messages.zh: 我可以在我们的小册子里用这张图片吗？
messages.en: Can I use this image in our booklet?

messages.speaker: Mark (编辑)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dritt tal-awtur u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-użu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-dritt tal-awtur u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-użu.
messages.zh: 我们先查一下版权和使用条件吧。
messages.en: Let's check the copyright and the terms of use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：dritt 是权利，tal-awtur 是作者的；连起来联想“作者对作品的权利”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 19,000, equal to nineteen groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数目19,000，即十九个一千，中文为一万九千。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 19,000, jiġifieri dsatax immultiplikat b'elf.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li dsatax-il elf persuna żaru l-wirja matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The report shows that nineteen thousand people visited the exhibition during the month.
formal.zh: 报告显示，当月有一万九千人参观了展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm tiswa l-karozza? Mark: Dsatax-il elf ewro. Maja: Dik aktar mill-baġit tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does the car cost? Mark: Nineteen thousand euros. Maja: That's more than my budget.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这辆车多少钱？Mark：一万九千欧元。Maja：这超出我的预算了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does the car cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (销售员)
messages.zh: 一万九千欧元。
messages.en: Nineteen thousand euros.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这超出我的预算了。
messages.en: That's more than my budget.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先按十九个一千计算：19乘1000等于19000，再换成中文计数单位“一万九千”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called dubnium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素𨧀的名称，英文为 dubnium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem dubnju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 𨧀，一种化学元素，英文名为 dubnium。

formal.mt: L-istudent ħejja preżentazzjoni qasira dwar l-element kimiku dubnju.
formal.en: The student prepared a short presentation about the chemical element dubnium.
formal.zh: 这名学生准备了一份关于化学元素𨧀的简短报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu d-dubnju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku. L-isem tiegħu bl-Ingliż huwa dubnium.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is dubnju? Mark: It's a chemical element. Its English name is dubnium.
colloquial.zh: Maja：dubnju 是什么？Mark：是一种化学元素，中文叫𨧀，英文名是 dubnium。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: dubnju 是什么？
messages.en: What is dubnju?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. L-isem tiegħu bl-Ingliż huwa dubnium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. L-isem tiegħu bl-Ingliż huwa dubnium.
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素，中文叫𨧀，英文名是 dubnium。
messages.en: It's a chemical element. Its English name is dubnium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡：dubnju、dubnium、𨧀；用两种外语名称相近的字形帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An affectionate name used when addressing someone dear to the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称呼亲近、喜爱的人时使用的爱称，可按语境译为“宝贝”或“亲爱的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' għożża użata biex tindirizza lil xi ħadd għażiż għalik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达亲昵或疼爱的称呼，相当于“宝贝”“亲爱的”等爱称。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, l-omm tuża l-kelma 'duda' bħala kelma ta' għożża meta tkellem lil bintha.
formal.en: In the dialogue, the mother uses the word 'duda' as a term of endearment when speaking to her daughter.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，母亲与女儿说话时，用 duda 这个爱称表达疼爱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Duda, trid ftit ilma? Maja: Iva, ma. Grazzi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Sweetheart, would you like some water? Maja: Yes, Mum. Thanks.
colloquial.zh: Rita：宝贝，要喝点水吗？Maja：要，妈妈。谢谢。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝贝，要喝点水吗？
messages.en: Sweetheart, would you like some water?

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 要，妈妈。谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, Mum. Thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 duda 放进母亲温柔说“宝贝，喝水吗”的场景，用亲昵语气记住它是爱称。

gloss_zh: 桶板；组成容器侧壁的狭长木板

teaching_sense.en_definition: Narrow wooden strips fitted together to form the sides of a vessel, such as a barrel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拼合起来构成桶等容器侧壁的狭长木板；此处表示多块桶板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxi dojoq tal-injam li jitwaħħlu flimkien biex jiffurmaw il-ġnub ta' reċipjent, bħal barmil.

sense_translations.en_definition: staves (narrow strips, a part of a vessel)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 桶板；构成桶等容器一部分的狭长板条。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiswija tal-barmil, il-ħaddiem eżamina d-dugħ biex jara jekk kienx hemm xquq fl-injam.
formal.en: During the repair of the barrel, the worker examined the staves to check for cracks in the wood.
formal.zh: 修理木桶时，工人检查了桶板，查看木材是否有裂缝。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed joħroġ l-ilma mill-barmil? Pawlu: Hemm vojt bejn id-dugħ; irridu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is water leaking out of the barrel? Pawlu: There is a gap between the staves; we need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：水为什么从桶里漏出来？保罗：桶板之间有缝，我们得修一下。

messages.speaker: Marta (学徒)
messages.zh: 水为什么从桶里漏出来？
messages.en: Why is water leaking out of the barrel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm vojt bejn id-dugħ; irridu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm vojt bejn id-dugħ; irridu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 桶板之间有缝，我们得修一下。
messages.en: There is a gap between the staves; we need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dugħ 配上木桶侧壁的画面：一条条窄木板围成桶身，记的是多块桶板。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who holds the noble title of duke.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有公爵这一贵族头衔的男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li għandu t-titlu nobbli ta' duka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公爵；男性贵族的一种头衔，也指拥有该头衔的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-duka jistieden lill-mistednin għal ikla fil-palazz tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the duke invites the guests to a meal at his palace.
formal.zh: 小说中，公爵邀请宾客到他的宫邸用餐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu r-raġel f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Huwa d-duka li jissemma fil-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the man in this picture? Mark: He is the duke mentioned in the book.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这张图片里的男人是谁？马克：他就是书里提到的那位公爵。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图片里的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 他就是书里提到的那位公爵。
messages.en: He is the duke mentioned in the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 duka 写在贵族人物卡片上，与英语 duke、中文公爵并排记忆，建立头衔联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Watermelon considered as a kind of fruit or as an amount of fruit, or several watermelons collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为水果种类或食物总量来谈的西瓜，也可集合地表示多个西瓜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott magħruf bħala dulliegħ, meqjus bħala tip jew kwantità ta' frott, jew diversi frottiet ta' dan it-tip flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: watermelon (as a mass or species); several watermelons
sense_translations.zh_definition: 西瓜，作为食物或种类的统称；也表示若干个西瓜。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tas-sajf, il-kċina ħejjiet biċċiet tad-dulliegħ u poġġiethom fil-friġġ qabel ma serviethom.
formal.en: For the summer meal, the kitchen prepared pieces of watermelon and refrigerated them before serving.
formal.zh: 为准备夏日餐点，厨房切好了西瓜，并在上桌前将西瓜块冷藏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid ftit dulliegħ? Samwel: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like some watermelon? Samwel: Yes, please. Cut it into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你要吃点西瓜吗？萨姆韦尔：好的，谢谢。把它切成小块吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要吃点西瓜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some watermelon?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。把它切成小块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut it into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一盘西瓜块和一堆完整西瓜作两张图：dulliegħ 既能统称西瓜，也能表示多个西瓜。

gloss_zh: 蜜蜂的卵、幼虫和蛹；蜂巢

teaching_sense.en_definition: Developing bees collectively, including eggs, larvae and pupae; also a hive in which bees live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集合地指发育中的蜜蜂，包括卵、幼虫和蛹；也指蜜蜂居住的蜂巢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bajd, il-larva u l-pupi tan-naħal meqjusa flimkien; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll il-post fejn jgħix in-naħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂子；蜜蜂的卵、幼虫和蛹的统称。
蜂巢；蜜蜂群体居住的巢或巢箱。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliem spjega li l-kelma duqqajs tista' tirreferi kemm għall-bajd, il-larva u l-pupi tan-naħal kif ukoll għall-post fejn jgħix in-naħal.
formal.en: In the lesson, the teacher explained that duqqajs can refer both to bee eggs, larvae and pupae and to the place where bees live.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师解释说，duqqajs 既可指蜜蜂的卵、幼虫和蛹，也可指蜜蜂居住的蜂巢。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta tgħid duqqajs hawn, qed tfisser il-post fejn jgħix in-naħal? Ġużeppi: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed nitkellem dwar il-post.
colloquial.en: Marija: When you say duqqajs here, do you mean the place where bees live? Ġużeppi: Yes, in this sentence I am talking about the place.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你这里说 duqqajs，是指蜜蜂住的地方吗？朱塞佩：对，在这个句子里，我说的是那个地方。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid duqqajs hawn, qed tfisser il-post fejn jgħix in-naħal?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid duqqajs hawn, qed tfisser il-post fejn jgħix in-naħal?
messages.zh: 你这里说 duqqajs，是指蜜蜂住的地方吗？
messages.en: When you say duqqajs here, do you mean the place where bees live?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (养蜂人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed nitkellem dwar il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din is-sentenza qed nitkellem dwar il-post.
messages.zh: 对，在这个句子里，我说的是那个地方。
messages.en: Yes, in this sentence I am talking about the place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 duqqajs 画两格图：一格是蜂卵幼虫和蛹，一格是蜂巢；读句子时判断说的是幼体还是住处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the corn bunting, with the scientific name Emberiza calandra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类黍鹀，学名 Emberiza calandra。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Emberiza calandra, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala corn bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黍鹀，学名 Emberiza calandra。

collocations.en: the song of the corn bunting
a photograph of a corn bunting

formal.mt: Fuq il-karta tat-tagħlim, l-istudenti kitbu durrajsa ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Emberiza calandra.
formal.en: On the learning card, the students wrote durrajsa beside the scientific name Emberiza calandra.
formal.zh: 学生们在学习卡上，把 durrajsa 写在学名 Emberiza calandra 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tissejjaħ din l-għasfura fir-ritratt? David: Din durrajsa; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ corn bunting.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this bird in the photograph called? David: It is a durrajsa; in English it is called a corn bunting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？戴维：这是黍鹀，马耳他语叫 durrajsa，英语叫 corn bunting。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: David (自然课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din durrajsa; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ corn bunting.
messages.mt_standard: Din durrajsa; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ corn bunting.
messages.zh: 这是黍鹀，马耳他语叫 durrajsa，英语叫 corn bunting。
messages.en: It is a durrajsa; in English it is called a corn bunting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 durrajsa 制作三语鸟名卡：正面放黍鹀图片，背面并列黍鹀、corn bunting 和学名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the snow bunting, with the scientific name Plectrophenax nivalis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类雪鹀，学名 Plectrophenax nivalis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Plectrophenax nivalis, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala snow bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪鹀，学名 Plectrophenax nivalis。

collocations.en: a photograph of a snow bunting
the identification of the snow bunting

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti qabblu r-ritratt tad-durrajsa bajda mal-isem xjentifiku Plectrophenax nivalis.
formal.en: In the exercise, the students matched the photograph of the snow bunting with the scientific name Plectrophenax nivalis.
formal.zh: 练习中，学生们将雪鹀的照片与学名 Plectrophenax nivalis 配对。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema karta għandha l-isem snow bunting? Luqa: Din, li fuqha hemm miktub durrajsa bajda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which card has the name snow bunting? Luqa: This one, with durrajsa bajda written on it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：哪张卡写着 snow bunting？卢卡：这张，上面写着 durrajsa bajda，也就是雪鹀。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema karta għandha l-isem snow bunting?
messages.mt_standard: Liema karta għandha l-isem snow bunting?
messages.zh: 哪张卡写着 snow bunting？
messages.en: Which card has the name snow bunting?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din, li fuqha hemm miktub durrajsa bajda.
messages.mt_standard: Din, li fuqha hemm miktub durrajsa bajda.
messages.zh: 这张，上面写着 durrajsa bajda，也就是雪鹀。
messages.en: This one, with durrajsa bajda written on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 durrajsa bajda 整体写在雪鹀图片下，再配英语 snow bunting，反复做三语配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the rustic bunting, with the scientific name Emberiza rustica.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类田鹀，学名 Emberiza rustica。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Emberiza rustica, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala rustic bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 田鹀，学名 Emberiza rustica。

collocations.en: a photograph of a rustic bunting
the song of the rustic bunting

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-ismijiet, durrajsa qastnija tidher ħdejn rustic bunting u Emberiza rustica.
formal.en: In the table of names, durrajsa qastnija appears beside rustic bunting and Emberiza rustica.
formal.zh: 名称表中，durrajsa qastnija 与英语名 rustic bunting、学名 Emberiza rustica 并列，指田鹀。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Kif ngħid rustic bunting bil-Malti? Noel: Għid durrajsa qastnija, u ikteb iż-żewġ kelmiet fuq il-karta.
colloquial.en: Emma: How do I say rustic bunting in Maltese? Noel: Say durrajsa qastnija, and write both words on the card.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：田鹀的英语名是 rustic bunting，马耳他语怎么说？诺埃尔：说 durrajsa qastnija，把这两个词都写在卡上。

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.zh: 田鹀的英语名是 rustic bunting，马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say rustic bunting in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Noel (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għid durrajsa qastnija, u ikteb iż-żewġ kelmiet fuq il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Għid durrajsa qastnija, u ikteb iż-żewġ kelmiet fuq il-karta.
messages.zh: 说 durrajsa qastnija，把这两个词都写在卡上。
messages.en: Say durrajsa qastnija, and write both words on the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记田鹀时把 durrajsa qastnija 当作完整鸟名朗读，并与 rustic bunting 成对复习，避免漏记后一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the little bunting, with the scientific name Emberiza pusilla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类小鹀，学名 Emberiza pusilla。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Emberiza pusilla, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala little bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鹀，学名 Emberiza pusilla。

collocations.en: a photograph of a little bunting
the identification of the little bunting

formal.mt: Il-karta tat-tagħlim turi ritratt ta' durrajsa qerqnija flimkien mal-isem Ingliż little bunting u l-isem xjentifiku Emberiza pusilla.
formal.en: The learning card shows a photograph of a little bunting together with the English name little bunting and the scientific name Emberiza pusilla.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Emberiza pusilla, known in English as the little bunting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟，中文名为小鹀，学名为 Emberiza pusilla。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Emberiza pusilla, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala little bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鹀（学名 Emberiza pusilla）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a little bunting
an observation of a little bunting

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' durrajsa żgħira bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza pusilla taħtu.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a little bunting with the scientific name Emberiza pusilla beneath it.
formal.zh: 指南中有一张小鹀的照片，下方标有学名 Emberiza pusilla。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-ritratt ta' durrajsa żgħira? Pawlu: Iva, u taħtu hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Emberiza pusilla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a photograph of a little bunting? Pawlu: Yes, and its scientific name, Emberiza pusilla, is written beneath it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是一张小鹀的照片吗？保罗：是的，下方还写着它的学名 Emberiza pusilla。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是一张小鹀的照片吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of a little bunting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u taħtu hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Emberiza pusilla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u taħtu hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Emberiza pusilla.
messages.zh: 是的，下方还写着它的学名 Emberiza pusilla。
messages.en: Yes, and its scientific name, Emberiza pusilla, is written beneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小鹀图片＋完整马耳他语鸟名＋学名”制作三栏卡片；每次看图说出整个名称，帮助区分相近的鸟名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small light; the diminutive form of the Maltese noun dawl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小小的光或灯光，是马耳他语名词 dawl 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva tan-nom dawl.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small light (the diminutive form of 'dawl')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小灯光；微小的光（dawl 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small light in the window
a small light in the distance

formal.mt: L-osservatur innota dwajjel fit-tieqa tal-bini.
formal.en: The observer noted a small light in the building's window.
formal.zh: 观察者注意到楼房窗里有一点灯光。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dak id-dwajjel fil-bogħod? Mark: Iva, jidher ġej minn tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that small light in the distance? Mark: Yes, it seems to be coming from a window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见远处那一点灯光了吗？马克：看见了，好像是从一扇窗里透出来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见远处那一点灯光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that small light in the distance?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，好像是从一扇窗里透出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it seems to be coming from a window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dawl 想成一片光，再把画面缩成远处窗里的一点光，配上 dwajjel；用已给出的指小关系记住“小”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp, typically one that uses oil to provide light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供照明的灯，通常指使用灯油的油灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa li tagħti d-dawl, tipikament waħda li tuża ż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯，通常指油灯。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja hemm dwala antika li kienet tuża ż-żejt biex tagħti d-dawl.
formal.en: The exhibition contains an old lamp that used oil to provide light.
formal.zh: 展览中有一盏过去用灯油照明的旧灯。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Din id-dwala taħdem biż-żejt? Nannu: Iva, imma llum inżommha biss bħala tifkira.
colloquial.en: Lina: Does this lamp use oil? Grandfather: Yes, but these days I keep it only as a memento.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这盏灯是用油的吗？爷爷：是的，不过现在我只是留着它作纪念。

messages.speaker: Lina (孙女)
messages.zh: 这盏灯是用油的吗？
messages.en: Does this lamp use oil?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum inżommha biss bħala tifkira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum inżommha biss bħala tifkira.
messages.zh: 是的，不过现在我只是留着它作纪念。
messages.en: Yes, but these days I keep it only as a memento.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一盏装着灯油的灯，边做“点亮、熄灭”的动作边读 dwala；把词记成可以拿起的灯具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bright or luminous, describing something that gives off light or appears strongly lit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物明亮、发光或显得光亮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti d-dawl jew jidher imdawwal ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明亮的；光亮的。
发光的；散发光亮的。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-esperiment, l-oġġett ġie deskritt bħala dwali għax kien jagħti d-dawl.
formal.en: In the description of the experiment, the object was described as luminous because it gave off light.
formal.zh: 在实验说明中，该物体因能发出光而被描述为发光的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser dwali hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-oġġett jagħti d-dawl.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does dwali mean here? Pawlu: It means that the object gives off light.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 dwali 是什么意思？保罗：意思是这个物体会发光。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 dwali 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dwali mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是这个物体会发光。
messages.en: It means that the object gives off light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在发光物体旁写 dwali，再补上“它怎么样？很明亮、会发光”；用描述性质的问题提醒自己这里是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small worm; the diminutive form of the Maltese noun duda.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条小蠕虫，是马耳他语名词 duda 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Duda żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva tan-nom duda.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small worm (the diminutive form of 'duda')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蠕虫；小虫（duda 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small worm in the soil
a small worm on a leaf

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenta nnutat dwejda fuq werqa u ħadet ritratt tagħha.
formal.en: During the observation, the student noticed a small worm on a leaf and photographed it.
formal.zh: 观察时，学生注意到叶子上有一条小蠕虫，并给它拍了照。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, hemm dwejda fuq din il-werqa! Omm: Iva, ħalliha hemm u nħarsu lejha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, there is a small worm on this leaf! Mother: Yes, leave it there and let's look at it without touching it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看，这片叶子上有条小蠕虫！妈妈：是呀，让它待在那里，我们看看，别碰它。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, hemm dwejda fuq din il-werqa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, hemm dwejda fuq din il-werqa!
messages.zh: 看，这片叶子上有条小蠕虫！
messages.en: Look, there is a small worm on this leaf!

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalliha hemm u nħarsu lejha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalliha hemm u nħarsu lejha mingħajr ma mmissuha.
messages.zh: 是呀，让它待在那里，我们看看，别碰它。
messages.en: Yes, leave it there and let's look at it without touching it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一条标着 duda 的虫，再画一条更小的并标上 dwejda；利用词条给出的指小关系，把“小虫”直接记成画面。

gloss_zh: 有点窄的；悲伤、抑郁或无聊

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat narrow; the diminutive form of the Maltese adjective dejjaq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有点窄的、窄小的，是马耳他语形容词 dejjaq 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit dejjaq; il-forma diminuttiva tal-aġġettiv dejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窄小的；有点窄的（dejjaq 的指小形式）。
悲伤、抑郁或无聊；具体含义由语境决定。

collocations.en: a feeling of sadness or boredom
collocations.zh: 一种悲伤或无聊的感觉

formal.mt: Fit-test, dwejjaq jiddeskrivi passaġġ bħala xi ftit dejjaq; f'sentenza oħra, in-nom dwejjaq jesprimi s-sentiment ta' niket tal-karattru.
formal.en: In the text, dwejjaq describes a passage as somewhat narrow; in another sentence, the noun dwejjaq expresses the character's feeling of sadness.
formal.zh: 文中 dwejjaq 用来形容一条通道有点窄；在另一句中，名词 dwejjaq 表达人物悲伤的感受。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħoss dwejjaq? Mark: Għax ili d-dar il-ġurnata kollha u m'għandi x'nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you feeling bored? Mark: Because I have been at home all day and have nothing to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么觉得无聊？马克：因为我整天都待在家里，没什么事可做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么觉得无聊？
messages.en: Why are you feeling bored?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ili d-dar il-ġurnata kollha u m'għandi x'nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ili d-dar il-ġurnata kollha u m'għandi x'nagħmel.
messages.zh: 因为我整天都待在家里，没什么事可做。
messages.en: Because I have been at home all day and have nothing to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张同形词卡：一张画窄通道，标“形容词”；另一张画难过或无聊的表情，标“名词”。这是分义记忆法，不表示两个义项的历史来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small weather vane, an instrument that shows the direction of the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型风向标，即用来显示风向的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument żgħir li juri minn liema direzzjoni jkun ġej ir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小风向标；显示风向的小型装置。

collocations.en: a small weather vane on the roof
to install a small weather vane

formal.mt: L-istudenti installaw dwejma fuq il-bejt biex josservaw id-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
formal.en: The students installed a small weather vane on the roof to observe the wind direction.
formal.zh: 学生们在屋顶上安装了一个小风向标，用来观察风向。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhi dik fuq il-bejt? Missier: Dik dwejma; turina minn liema direzzjoni ġej ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is that on the roof? Father: That is a small weather vane; it shows us which direction the wind is coming from.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：屋顶上那个是什么？爸爸：那是小风向标，会告诉我们风是从哪个方向吹来的。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 屋顶上那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that on the roof?

messages.speaker: Missier (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik dwejma; turina minn liema direzzjoni ġej ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik dwejma; turina minn liema direzzjoni ġej ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 那是小风向标，会告诉我们风是从哪个方向吹来的。
messages.en: That is a small weather vane; it shows us which direction the wind is coming from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象屋顶上一个随风转动的小风向标，转动手指时读 dwejma；把“小装置、看风向”的功能画面与词形绑定。

gloss_zh: 烦心事；一点味道，一小口品尝

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that causes worry; in a separate sense, a small taste of food or drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人担忧的一件事；另一个独立词义指对食物或饮料的一点品尝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tqajjem tħassib; f'tifsira oħra, ftit minn ikel jew xorb biex wieħed iduqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人担忧的事；烦心事。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small taste (the diminutive form of 'dewq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一点品尝；一小口尝味，是 dewq 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small taste of the wine

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fil-ħlas sar dwejqa għas-sid tal-ħanut.
formal.en: The delay in payment became a source of worry for the shop owner.
formal.zh: 付款延误成了店主的一件烦心事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kont huwa dwejqa għalija. Mark: Ejja naraw flimkien kif nistgħu nħallsuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: This bill is a worry for me. Mark: Let's work out together how we can pay it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张账单真让我烦心。马克：我们一起想想怎么付吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张账单真让我烦心。
messages.en: This bill is a worry for me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw flimkien kif nistgħu nħallsuh.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw flimkien kif nistgħu nħallsuh.
messages.zh: 我们一起想想怎么付吧。
messages.en: Let's work out together how we can pay it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记忆：账单代表烦心事，茶匙代表一点品尝；遇到这个词先看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small house, including a cottage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积较小的房屋，也可指乡间小屋；是 dar 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar żgħira, li tista' tkun ukoll fil-kampanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小房子；dar 的指小形式。
乡间小屋；小型乡村住宅。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jipproponi r-restawr ta' dwejra tal-ġebel fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The project proposes restoring a small stone house in the countryside.
formal.zh: 该项目提议修复乡间的一座石砌小屋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: F'dwejra ħdejn ir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we staying this weekend? Pawlu: In a cottage near the village.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个周末我们住哪儿？保罗：住在村子附近的一座小屋里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这个周末我们住哪儿？
messages.en: Where are we staying this weekend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 住在村子附近的一座小屋里。
messages.en: In a cottage near the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dar 的房屋画面缩小成一座温馨小屋，再把 dwejra 写在门牌上，记住小房子和乡间小屋两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The inner curved surface of an arch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拱形结构内侧的弯曲表面，即从拱下方看到的拱腹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ mgħawweġ ta' ġewwa ta' arkata, li jidher minn taħtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拱腹；拱的内侧曲面或内弧。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjoni tad-dwella tal-arkata u jirrakkomanda tiswijiet.
formal.en: The report describes the condition of the arch's intrados and recommends repairs.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这座拱的拱腹状况，并建议进行修缮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema parti tal-arkata hi d-dwella? Mark: Il-wiċċ mgħawweġ ta' ġewwa li tara meta tħares 'il fuq minn taħtha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which part of the arch is the intrados? Mark: The inner curved surface you see when you look up from underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：拱的哪一部分叫拱腹？马克：就是站在拱下面抬头看到的内侧曲面。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 拱的哪一部分叫拱腹？
messages.en: Which part of the arch is the intrados?

messages.speaker: Mark (建筑教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wiċċ mgħawweġ ta' ġewwa li tara meta tħares 'il fuq minn taħtha.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wiċċ mgħawweġ ta' ġewwa li tara meta tħares 'il fuq minn taħtha.
messages.zh: 就是站在拱下面抬头看到的内侧曲面。
messages.en: The inner curved surface you see when you look up from underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在拱门下抬头，用手沿着内侧弧面画一道线，把这条内弧与 dwella 对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in a duel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加决斗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'dwell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决斗者；参加决斗的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dwellant jirrifjuta l-isfida u jipprova jsolvi t-tilwima bil-kliem.
formal.en: In the story, the duellist refuses the challenge and tries to settle the dispute through discussion.
formal.zh: 故事中，决斗者拒绝了挑战，并试图通过交谈解决争端。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak il-karattru bix-xabla? Toni: Hu dwellant, imma f'din ix-xena jagħżel li ma jiġġilidx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that character with the sword? Toni: He's a duellist, but in this scene he chooses not to fight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个拿剑的角色是谁？托尼：他是个决斗者，不过在这一幕里他选择不打。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.zh: 那个拿剑的角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character with the sword?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dwellant, imma f'din ix-xena jagħżel li ma jiġġilidx.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dwellant, imma f'din ix-xena jagħżel li ma jiġġilidx.
messages.zh: 他是个决斗者，不过在这一幕里他选择不打。
messages.en: He's a duellist, but in this scene he chooses not to fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在故事人物卡上写 dwellant，旁边画两个相对而立的角色，记住它指参加决斗的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who participates in a duel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与决斗的人，可用于指故事中的决斗角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipparteċipa f'dwell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决斗者；参与决斗的人。

formal.mt: L-attur jinterpreta r-rwol ta' dwellatur li jiddubita jekk għandux jaċċetta l-isfida.
formal.en: The actor plays a duellist who questions whether he should accept the challenge.
formal.zh: 这位演员饰演一名决斗者，他对是否应接受挑战心存疑虑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'parti għandek fid-dramm? Pawlu: Nagħmel il-parti ta' dwellatur li fl-aħħar jitlob il-paċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What part do you have in the play? Pawlu: I play a duellist who asks for peace at the end.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在剧里演什么角色？保罗：我演一个最后请求和解的决斗者。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在剧里演什么角色？
messages.en: What part do you have in the play?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmel il-parti ta' dwellatur li fl-aħħar jitlob il-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmel il-parti ta' dwellatur li fl-aħħar jitlob il-paċi.
messages.zh: 我演一个最后请求和解的决斗者。
messages.en: I play a duellist who asks for peace at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwellatur 放进戏剧角色表，中文旁注决斗者；用整词配人物记忆，不必猜测词尾来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who takes part in a duel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加决斗的人，即决斗者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jieħu sehem f'dwell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决斗者；参加决斗的人。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jippreżenta dwellist b'esperjenza li jagħti aktar valur lir-rikonċiljazzjoni milli lir-rebħa.
formal.en: The chapter presents an experienced duellist who values reconciliation more than victory.
formal.zh: 这一章描写了一位经验丰富的决斗者，他看重和解胜过获胜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex isejħulu dwellist? Mark: Għax jieħu sehem f'dwell fir-rumanz.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do they call him a duellist? Mark: Because he takes part in a duel in the novel.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么大家称他为决斗者？马克：因为他在小说里参加了一场决斗。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 为什么大家称他为决斗者？
messages.en: Why do they call him a duellist?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 因为他在小说里参加了一场决斗。
messages.en: Because he takes part in a duel in the novel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwellist 与英文 duellist 并排做词卡，再画一位小说中的决斗者，借相近拼写连接词义。

gloss_zh: 好诉讼的；动辄打官司的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to bring disputes to court or to engage frequently in lawsuits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于通过诉讼处理争端的，常常提起诉讼的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jressaq tilwim il-qorti jew li jidħol ta' spiss f'kawżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好诉讼的；容易或经常因争端而打官司的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist għandu karattru dwelluż u jressaq anki tilwim żgħir il-qorti.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist has a litigious disposition and takes even minor disputes to court.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公生性好诉讼，连小争端也要诉诸法庭。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li l-karattru hu dwelluż? Toni: Li malajr jiftaħ kawża, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do you mean when you say the character is litigious? Toni: That he's quick to file a lawsuit, even over small things.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你说这个人物好诉讼，是什么意思？托尼：就是他动不动就提起诉讼，连小事也一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li l-karattru hu dwelluż?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li l-karattru hu dwelluż?
messages.zh: 你说这个人物好诉讼，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say the character is litigious?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li malajr jiftaħ kawża, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Li malajr jiftaħ kawża, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 就是他动不动就提起诉讼，连小事也一样。
messages.en: That he's quick to file a lawsuit, even over small things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个遇到小争端就拿出起诉文件的人，把 dwelluż 贴在他的性格卡上，记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A singer or musician who performs as one of the two participants in a duet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加二重唱或二重奏的歌手或乐手，指两位表演者中的一位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kantant jew mużiċist li jkun wieħed miż-żewġ parteċipanti f'dwett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二重唱者或二重奏者；参与二人合唱或合奏的表演者。

collocations.zh: 有才华的二重唱或二重奏表演者
二重唱或二重奏表演者的角色

formal.mt: Bħala dwettista, il-kantant irid jisma' b'attenzjoni lil sieħbu u jżomm il-bilanċ bejn iż-żewġ ilħna.
formal.en: As a duetist, the singer must listen carefully to his partner and maintain a balance between the two voices.
formal.zh: 作为二重唱者，这位歌手必须仔细聆听搭档，并保持两个声部之间的平衡。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum se tkanta waħdek? Pawlu: Le, se nkanta ma' Sara bħala dwettista.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you singing on your own today? Pawlu: No, I'll be singing with Sara as a duetist.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天独唱吗？保罗：不是，我会作为二重唱者和萨拉一起唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天独唱吗？
messages.en: Are you singing on your own today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (歌手)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nkanta ma' Sara bħala dwettista.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nkanta ma' Sara bħala dwettista.
messages.zh: 不是，我会作为二重唱者和萨拉一起唱。
messages.en: No, I'll be singing with Sara as a duetist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两位一起演唱或演奏的人，再圈出其中一位标上 dwettista，记住这个词指参与者个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of a solid becoming liquid through heat, or of a substance dissolving in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 固体受热变成液体，或某种物质溶于液体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih solidu jsir likwidu bis-sħana, jew sustanza tinħall f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熔化；固体受热转变为液体的过程。
溶解；物质在液体中溶解的过程。

collocations.en: the dissolving of sugar in water

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri d-differenza bejn id-dwib tas-silġ bis-sħana u d-dwib taz-zokkor fl-ilma.
formal.en: The experiment shows the difference between ice melting through heat and sugar dissolving in water.
formal.zh: 这个实验展示了冰受热融化与糖在水中溶解的区别。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħawwad l-ilma? Pawlu: Biex inħaffef id-dwib taz-zokkor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you stirring the water? Pawlu: To speed up the dissolving of the sugar.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么搅拌水？保罗：为了让糖溶解得更快。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么搅拌水？
messages.en: Why are you stirring the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了让糖溶解得更快。
messages.en: To speed up the dissolving of the sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把冰块受热融化与糖粒入水溶解并排想象：dwib 指这两类变化的过程，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lasting forever or understood as having no end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 永远持续、被认为没有终点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' għal dejjem u ma jkollux tmiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 永恒的；永久持续、没有终结的。

formal.mt: Il-poeta jesprimi x-xewqa tiegħu għal sliem dwiemi bejn il-popli.
formal.en: The poet expresses his wish for everlasting peace among peoples.
formal.zh: 诗人表达了对各民族之间永久和平的向往。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ferħ dwiemi' f'din il-poeżija? Pawlu: Ferħ li jibqa' għal dejjem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'everlasting joy' mean in this poem? Pawlu: Joy that lasts forever.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这首诗里的“永恒的喜悦”是什么意思？保罗：就是永远持续的喜悦。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这首诗里的“永恒的喜悦”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'everlasting joy' mean in this poem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 就是永远持续的喜悦。
messages.en: Joy that lasts forever.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条没有终点的时间线，把 ferħ dwiemi 放在线上，记住它表示永恒持续的喜悦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of trying a small amount of food or drink to experience its taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝少量食物或饮料，以感受其味道的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu ftit minn ikel jew xorb biex jagħraf it-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品尝；通过尝一点食物或饮料来感受味道的行为。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dwieq tal-inbid, il-parteċipanti qabblu t-togħmiet ta' tliet kampjuni.
formal.en: During the wine tasting, the participants compared the tastes of three samples.
formal.zh: 在葡萄酒品尝过程中，参与者比较了三份样品的味道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta jibda d-dwieq tal-inbid? Pawlu: Fit-tlieta. Ejja nieħdu ftit ilma qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: When does the wine tasting start? Pawlu: At three. Let's have some water first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：葡萄酒品尝什么时候开始？保罗：三点。我们先喝点水吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (参加者)
messages.zh: 葡萄酒品尝什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does the wine tasting start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tlieta. Ejja nieħdu ftit ilma qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tlieta. Ejja nieħdu ftit ilma qabel.
messages.zh: 三点。我们先喝点水吧。
messages.en: At three. Let's have some water first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象只尝一小口、认真辨味的动作：dwieq 指品尝这一行为，不是食物本身的味道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small pieces of a substance or object that remain after it has been pounded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种物质或物体经过捣打后形成的细小碎块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-biċċiet żgħar ta' xi ħaġa li tkun ġiet imfarrka bid-daqq.

sense_translations.en_definition: the pieces of sth. which has been pounded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物经过捣打后形成的碎块；捣碎物。

formal.mt: Wara li farrak il-ġebla bid-daqq, il-ħaddiem ġabar id-dxix f'kontenitur.
formal.en: After pounding the stone into pieces, the worker collected the fragments in a container.
formal.zh: 工人把石头捣碎后，将碎块收集到容器里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dan id-dxix tal-ġebel? Pawlu: Fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok. Uża l-pala ż-żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put these pieces of pounded stone? Pawlu: In the bucket, please. Use the small shovel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些捣碎的石块放在哪里？保罗：请放进桶里，用那把小铲子。

messages.speaker: Maja (工人)
messages.zh: 这些捣碎的石块放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these pieces of pounded stone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok. Uża l-pala ż-żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-barmil, jekk jogħġbok. Uża l-pala ż-żgħira.
messages.zh: 请放进桶里，用那把小铲子。
messages.en: In the bucket, please. Use the small shovel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放石头被反复捣打、变成一堆碎块的画面；把最后留下的碎块整体记作 dxix。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief little laugh; the diminutive form of daħka.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短短的一声笑或轻轻一笑，是 daħka 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħka qasira jew żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' daħka.

sense_translations.en_definition: a short laugh (the diminutive form of 'daħka')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 短促的一笑；daħka 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Meta semgħet il-kumment, l-istudenta tat dħajka ta' mistħija u kompliet bil-preżentazzjoni.
formal.en: When she heard the comment, the student gave a shy little laugh and continued with the presentation.
formal.zh: 听到那句评论后，这名学生羞涩地轻笑了一声，接着继续展示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tajt dħajka? Mark: Ftakarni f'xi ħaġa tad-daħk li ġrat ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you give a little laugh? Mark: It reminded me of something funny that happened yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么轻轻笑了一声？马克：这让我想起了昨天发生的一件趣事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么轻轻笑了一声？
messages.en: Why did you give a little laugh?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftakarni f'xi ħaġa tad-daħk li ġrat ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ftakarni f'xi ħaġa tad-daħk li ġrat ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 这让我想起了昨天发生的一件趣事。
messages.en: It reminded me of something funny that happened yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 daħka 想成“一笑”，再把 dħajka 想成缩小、缩短的一声笑；用“轻轻笑一下”的动作辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Friendly and welcoming towards others, or courteous in the way one treats them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人友善、亲切，或在与人相处时有礼貌的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilqa' lin-nies bi ħbiberija jew jittrattahom bil-kortesija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 友好的；待人亲切的。
有礼貌的；待人彬彬有礼的。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal kien dħuli u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha tal-viżitaturi bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The official was courteous and patiently answered all the visitors' questions.
formal.zh: 这位工作人员态度有礼，耐心回答了访客的所有问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sibt lill-ġar il-ġdid? Lara: Dħuli ħafna! Sellimli u offra li jgħinni bil-basktijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you think of the new neighbour? Lara: Very friendly! He greeted me and offered to help me with the bags.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得新邻居怎么样？拉拉：非常友善！他向我打招呼，还主动提出帮我提袋子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new neighbour?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħuli ħafna! Sellimli u offra li jgħinni bil-basktijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dħuli ħafna! Sellimli u offra li jgħinni bil-basktijiet.
messages.zh: 非常友善！他向我打招呼，还主动提出帮我提袋子。
messages.en: Very friendly! He greeted me and offered to help me with the bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位主动问好、耐心帮忙的人，用 dħuli 描述他；把“友善”和“有礼貌”两种待人表现一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Courtesy or friendliness shown in the way people treat others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人接物时表现出的礼貌、亲切或友善。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kortesija jew ħbiberija fil-mod kif wieħed jittratta lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼貌；待人有礼的态度与举止。
友善；待人亲切友好的态度。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi faħħru d-dħulija tal-persunal u r-ringrazzjament tagħhom deher fir-rapport.
formal.en: The visitors praised the staff's courtesy, and their thanks were recorded in the report.
formal.zh: 访客赞扬了工作人员的礼貌态度，报告中也记录了他们的谢意。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għoġbok is-servizz? Maja: Iva, laqgħuni bi dħulija u spjegawli kollox bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you like the service? Maja: Yes, they welcomed me with friendliness and patiently explained everything to me.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得服务怎么样？玛雅：很好，他们友善地接待了我，还耐心地向我解释了一切。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得服务怎么样？
messages.en: Did you like the service?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, laqgħuni bi dħulija u spjegawli kollox bil-paċenzja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, laqgħuni bi dħulija u spjegawli kollox bil-paċenzja.
messages.zh: 很好，他们友善地接待了我，还耐心地向我解释了一切。
messages.en: Yes, they welcomed me with friendliness and patiently explained everything to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dħulija 当作可以“表现出来”的态度名称：问好、耐心解释、亲切接待，都是礼貌与友善的具体画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人所属家庭的姓氏 Ebejer，可音译为“埃贝耶尔”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Ebejer，可音译为“埃贝耶尔”。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Ebejer bagħtet it-talba tagħha bil-miktub lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Ms Ebejer sent her request to the office in writing.
formal.zh: 埃贝耶尔女士向办公室提交了书面申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi appuntament mas-Sinjura Ebejer. Rita: Iva, qed tistenniek. Idħol, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have an appointment with Ms Ebejer. Rita: Yes, she's expecting you. Please come in.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我和埃贝耶尔女士有预约。丽塔：好的，她正在等您。请进。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我和埃贝耶尔女士有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Ms Ebejer.

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed tistenniek. Idħol, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed tistenniek. Idħol, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好的，她正在等您。请进。
messages.en: Yes, she's expecting you. Please come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌上写着“Ebejer 一家”，再配上先生或女士的称呼，记住这是姓氏，书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Hebrew language, referred to as a subject of study or a means of communication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希伯来语这一语言，可作为学习科目或交流所用的语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Ebrajka, li tista' tiġi studjata jew tintuża għall-komunikazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希伯来语，指语言本身。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-Ebrajk jinkludi eżerċizzji fil-qari, fil-kitba u fit-taħdit.
formal.en: The Hebrew language course includes exercises in reading, writing and speaking.
formal.zh: 希伯来语课程包括阅读、写作和口语练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed titgħallem l-Ebrajk? Pawlu: Iva, bdejt kors din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you learning Hebrew? Pawlu: Yes, I started a course this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学希伯来语吗？保罗：是的，我这周开始上课了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学希伯来语吗？
messages.en: Are you learning Hebrew?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我这周开始上课了。
messages.en: Yes, I started a course this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ebrajk 放进“我正在学习某种语言”的句框中，记住它在本词条中是语言名称这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Hebrew language or the Hebrew people and their culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与希伯来语、希伯来人或其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-lingwa Ebrajka jew mal-poplu Ebrew u l-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希伯来的；与希伯来语、希伯来人或其文化有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw test Ebrew qasir u qabblu żewġ traduzzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The students read a short Hebrew text and compared two translations of it.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了一篇简短的希伯来语文本，并比较了它的两个译本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-test Ebrew diffiċli għalik? Pawlu: Ftit, imma għandi traduzzjoni biex tgħinni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this Hebrew text difficult for you? Pawlu: A little, but I have a translation to help me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇希伯来语文本对你来说难吗？保罗：有一点，不过我有译文可以帮助理解。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇希伯来语文本对你来说难吗？
messages.en: Is this Hebrew text difficult for you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit, imma għandi traduzzjoni biex tgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit, imma għandi traduzzjoni biex tgħinni.
messages.zh: 有一点，不过我有译文可以帮助理解。
messages.en: A little, but I have a translation to help me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 test Ebrew 记成“文本＋希伯来语的”：Ebrew 在这里修饰名词，帮助你与语言名称 Ebrajk 区分。

gloss_zh: 教化；使在道德或精神上受益

teaching_sense.en_definition: To improve someone's moral or spiritual understanding through teaching or example.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过教导或榜样，使人在道德认识或精神修养方面得到提升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin lil xi ħadd jikber moralment jew spiritwalment permezz ta' tagħlim jew eżempju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教化；通过教导或榜样提升他人的道德认识或精神修养

collocations.en: edified the listeners through his example
collocations.zh: 以自身榜样使听众受到教益

formal.mt: L-awtur edifika lill-qarrejja permezz ta' storja dwar l-onestà u r-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The author edified the readers through a story about honesty and responsibility.
formal.zh: 作者通过一个关于诚实与责任的故事，使读者受到教益。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien id-diskors? David: Edifika lil kulħadd; l-eżempju tiegħu ġegħelna naħsbu aktar fl-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was the speech? David: It edified everyone; his example made us think more about others.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：演讲怎么样？戴维：大家都受到教益，他的榜样让我们更为别人着想。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 演讲怎么样？
messages.en: How was the speech?

messages.speaker: David (听众)
messages.mt_spoken: Edifika lil kulħadd; l-eżempju tiegħu ġegħelna naħsbu aktar fl-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Edifika lil kulħadd; l-eżempju tiegħu ġegħelna naħsbu aktar fl-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 大家都受到教益，他的榜样让我们更为别人着想。
messages.en: It edified everyone; his example made us think more about others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听完诚实待人的故事后决定改进行为，用“故事教化了我”记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 有教益的；有助于道德或精神提升的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing moral or spiritual instruction that helps a person improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能给予道德或精神上的启发，帮助人提升修养的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti tagħlim jew eżempju li jgħin lil persuna tikber moralment jew spiritwalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有教益的；能启发人并提升其道德或精神修养的

formal.mt: Il-ġurnal ippubblika rakkont edifikanti dwar persuna li għażlet li tgħid il-verità minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The newspaper published an edifying account of a person who chose to tell the truth despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇有教益的故事，讲述一个人如何克服困难，坚持说出真相。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għoġbok il-ktieb? Samwel: Iva, kien edifikanti ħafna; ġegħelni naħseb dwar kif nittratta lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you like the book? Samwel: Yes, it was very edifying; it made me think about how I treat people.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你喜欢这本书吗？萨姆韦尔：喜欢，很有教益，让我反思自己待人的方式。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这本书吗？
messages.en: Did you like the book?

messages.speaker: Samwel (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien edifikanti ħafna; ġegħelni naħseb dwar kif nittratta lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien edifikanti ħafna; ġegħelni naħseb dwar kif nittratta lin-nies.
messages.zh: 喜欢，很有教益，让我反思自己待人的方式。
messages.en: Yes, it was very edifying; it made me think about how I treat people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一本读后让你更懂得善待他人的书贴上“有教益的”标签，记住它用来描述事物的性质。

gloss_zh: 教化；道德或精神上的提升

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moral or spiritual improvement gained through instruction, reflection, or good example.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过教导、反思或良好榜样而获得的道德或精神上的提升，也指这种教化作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titjib morali jew spiritwali li jiġi minn tagħlim, riflessjoni jew eżempju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教化；受到教益；道德或精神修养的提升

collocations.en: for the edification of the readers

formal.mt: L-għan tal-ġabra ta' stejjer huwa l-edifikazzjoni tal-qarrejja permezz ta' eżempji ta' onestà u ġenerożità.
formal.en: The purpose of the story collection is the edification of readers through examples of honesty and generosity.
formal.zh: 这部故事集旨在通过诚实与慷慨的榜样，使读者受到教益。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex taqra dawn ir-rakkonti? Ġorġ: Għall-edifikazzjoni tiegħi; jgħinuni naħseb kif nista' nkun aktar ġeneruż.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do you read these stories? Ġorġ: For my own edification; they help me think about how I can be more generous.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么读这些故事？乔治：为了提升自己的修养，它们帮助我思考怎样做一个更慷慨的人。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么读这些故事？
messages.en: Why do you read these stories?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-edifikazzjoni tiegħi; jgħinuni naħseb kif nista' nkun aktar ġeneruż.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-edifikazzjoni tiegħi; jgħinuni naħseb kif nista' nkun aktar ġeneruż.
messages.zh: 为了提升自己的修养，它们帮助我思考怎样做一个更慷慨的人。
messages.en: For my own edification; they help me think about how I can be more generous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“听故事、反思、修养提升”画成三个连续画面，最后获得的教益就是这个名词所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female pupil who lives at the school she attends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所就读学校住宿的女学生，即寄宿女生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Studenta li tgħix fl-iskola fejn tkun qed titgħallem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学校的寄宿生；此词指寄宿女生

formal.mt: Kull edukanda għandha ssegwi r-regoli tal-iskola u żżomm il-kamra tagħha nadifa.
formal.en: Every female boarder must follow the school rules and keep her room clean.
formal.zh: 每名寄宿女生都必须遵守校规，并保持自己的房间整洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int edukanda hawn? Nina: Iva, norqod l-iskola matul il-ġimgħa u mmur id-dar fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you a boarder here? Nina: Yes, I sleep at school during the week and go home at the weekend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是这里的寄宿生吗？妮娜：是的，我平日在学校住宿，周末回家。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你是这里的寄宿生吗？
messages.en: Are you a boarder here?

messages.speaker: Nina (寄宿女生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, norqod l-iskola matul il-ġimgħa u mmur id-dar fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, norqod l-iskola matul il-ġimgħa u mmur id-dar fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我平日在学校住宿，周末回家。
messages.en: Yes, I sleep at school during the week and go home at the weekend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名女生带着课本和睡衣进学校：课本表示上学，睡衣表示寄宿，合起来记住寄宿女生。

gloss_zh: 女子寄宿学校，通常由修女管理

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boarding school for girls, typically run by nuns, where pupils both study and live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供女生学习和住宿的寄宿学校，通常由修女管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skola għall-bniet fejn l-istudenti jitgħallmu u jgħixu, ġeneralment immexxija mis-sorijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: boarding school for girls (typically run by nuns)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 女子寄宿学校，通常由修女管理

collocations.en: a girls' boarding school run by nuns
collocations.zh: 由修女管理的女子寄宿学校

collocations.en: she studies at a girls' boarding school
collocations.zh: 她在女子寄宿学校就读

formal.mt: Il-prospett tal-edukandat jispjega r-regoli tal-akkomodazzjoni u l-programm ta' studju għall-bniet.
formal.en: The girls' boarding school's prospectus explains the accommodation rules and the programme of study for the girls.
formal.zh: 这所女子寄宿学校的招生简章介绍了住宿规定和女生的学习课程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Oħtok tmur id-dar wara l-lezzjonijiet? Rita: Le, tistudja f'edukandat immexxi mis-sorijiet u toqgħod hemm matul il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does your sister go home after lessons? Rita: No, she studies at a girls' boarding school run by nuns and stays there during the week.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你妹妹下课后回家吗？丽塔：不，她在一所由修女管理的女子寄宿学校就读，平日住在那里。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你妹妹下课后回家吗？
messages.en: Does your sister go home after lessons?

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tistudja f'edukandat immexxi mis-sorijiet u toqgħod hemm matul il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tistudja f'edukandat immexxi mis-sorijiet u toqgħod hemm matul il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 不，她在一所由修女管理的女子寄宿学校就读，平日住在那里。
messages.en: No, she studies at a girls' boarding school run by nuns and stays there during the week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把教室、女生宿舍和管理学校的修女放进同一幅校园图，记住它指整所女子寄宿学校。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a polite manner, showing respect and consideration for others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以礼貌、尊重他人的方式说话或行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri rispett u manjieri tajbin lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有礼貌地；以尊重他人的方式。

formal.mt: L-impjegati għandhom jitkellmu edukatament mal-klijenti, anki meta jkun hemm nuqqas ta' qbil.
formal.en: Employees should speak politely to customers, even when there is a disagreement.
formal.zh: 员工即使与顾客存在分歧，也应有礼貌地与顾客交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għedtlu li ma stajtx tmur? Lara: Għedtlu edukatament li kelli appuntament ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you tell him you couldn't go? Lara: I politely told him that I had another appointment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么告诉他你去不了的？Lara：我礼貌地告诉他，我还有另一个约会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għedtlu li ma stajtx tmur?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għedtlu li ma stajtx tmur?
messages.zh: 你怎么告诉他你去不了的？
messages.en: How did you tell him you couldn't go?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedtlu edukatament li kelli appuntament ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għedtlu edukatament li kelli appuntament ieħor.
messages.zh: 我礼貌地告诉他，我还有另一个约会。
messages.en: I politely told him that I had another appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象婉拒邀请时先微笑、再解释：edukatament 描写的是说话的礼貌方式，可连着“礼貌地回答”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to education or intended to help people learn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与教育有关的，或旨在帮助人们学习、增长知识的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-edukazzjoni jew maħsub biex jgħin lin-nies jitgħallmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教育的；用于教学的；具有教育意义的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew ħejja programm edukazzjonali biex jgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu l-istorja lokali.
formal.en: The museum prepared an educational programme to help students understand local history.
formal.zh: 博物馆设计了一项教育活动，帮助学生了解当地历史。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-filmat tajjeb għat-tfal? Sara: Iva, huwa edukazzjonali u jispjega kif jikbru l-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this video suitable for children? Sara: Yes, it's educational and explains how plants grow.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个视频适合孩子看吗？Sara：适合，它有教育意义，还会解释植物是怎样生长的。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 这个视频适合孩子看吗？
messages.en: Is this video suitable for children?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa edukazzjonali u jispjega kif jikbru l-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa edukazzjonali u jispjega kif jikbru l-pjanti.
messages.zh: 适合，它有教育意义，还会解释植物是怎样生长的。
messages.en: Yes, it's educational and explains how plants grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 edukazzjonali 贴在“能让人学到知识的视频”上，记住它是在说明内容具有教育用途或教育意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that successfully produces the intended result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以能够取得预期结果、产生实际成效的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jwassal għar-riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有效地；以能取得预期成效的方式。

formal.mt: It-taħriġ jgħin lill-impjegati jikkomunikaw effettivament mal-pubbliku.
formal.en: The training helps employees communicate effectively with the public.
formal.zh: 这项培训帮助员工有效地与公众沟通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nista' nispjega dan effettivament? Maja: Agħti eżempju sempliċi u mbagħad staqsi jekk fehmux.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I explain this effectively? Maja: Give a simple example and then ask whether they understood.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我怎样才能把这个解释清楚、讲出效果？Maja：举个简单的例子，然后问问他们是否听懂了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能把这个解释清楚、讲出效果？
messages.en: How can I explain this effectively?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħti eżempju sempliċi u mbagħad staqsi jekk fehmux.
messages.mt_standard: Agħti eżempju sempliċi u mbagħad staqsi jekk fehmux.
messages.zh: 举个简单的例子，然后问问他们是否听懂了。
messages.en: Give a simple example and then ask whether they understood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讲解后大家都听懂了：effettivament 强调行动取得效果。用“有效地沟通”这个完整搭配来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent to which something produces the intended result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种方法、措施或行动达到预期目标的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad sa fejn xi ħaġa twassal għar-riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有效性；达到预期目标的程度；实际成效。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jevalwa l-effettività tal-programm billi jqabbel ir-riżultati qabel u wara t-taħriġ.
formal.en: The report evaluates the effectiveness of the programme by comparing results before and after the training.
formal.zh: 该报告通过比较培训前后的结果，评估这一项目的成效。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se nkejlu l-effettività tal-lezzjonijiet? Mark: Nistgħu naraw jekk l-istudenti jistgħux jużaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will we measure the effectiveness of the lessons? Mark: We can see whether the students can use the new words.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们怎么衡量这些课的成效？Mark：可以看看学生是否会运用新学的词。

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.zh: 我们怎么衡量这些课的成效？
messages.en: How will we measure the effectiveness of the lessons?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu naraw jekk l-istudenti jistgħux jużaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu naraw jekk l-istudenti jistgħux jużaw il-kliem il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 可以看看学生是否会运用新学的词。
messages.en: We can see whether the students can use the new words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 effettività 配一个“目标是否达到”的检查框：重点是有没有成效；另把 effiċjenza 配给时间和资源的使用效率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring something about or carry out an action so that it takes effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事发生或实现，或把某项行动实际执行出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwettaq azzjoni jew iġib bidla sabiex iseħħ ir-riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使发生；促成或实现；执行某项行动。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat effettwa bidla fil-proċedura sabiex inaqqas iż-żmien ta' stennija.
formal.en: The committee effected a change in the procedure to reduce waiting time.
formal.zh: 委员会对程序作出了实际调整，以缩短等候时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bank effettwa l-ħlas? Mark: Iva, effettwa l-ħlas dalgħodu u bagħat konferma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the bank make the payment? Mark: Yes, it made the payment this morning and sent confirmation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：银行已经付款了吗？Mark：是的，今天早上已经付款，还发来了确认通知。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 银行已经付款了吗？
messages.en: Did the bank make the payment?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, effettwa l-ħlas dalgħodu u bagħat konferma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, effettwa l-ħlas dalgħodu u bagħat konferma.
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上已经付款，还发来了确认通知。
messages.en: Yes, it made the payment this morning and sent confirmation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把“待付款”按钮按成“已付款”：effettwa 表示把事情实际办成。英语提示是 effect，记住这里表示促成或执行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The possibility or practical feasibility of carrying something out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项计划或行动能够实际实施、完成的可能性与可行程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà li pjan jew azzjoni jistgħu jitwettqu fil-prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能性；可行性，尤其指计划或行动能否实际实施。

formal.mt: Qabel l-approvazzjoni, il-kumitat għandu jevalwa l-effettwabilità tal-proġett fid-dawl tal-baġit u taż-żmien disponibbli.
formal.en: Before approval, the committee should assess the feasibility of the project in light of the budget and the time available.
formal.zh: 批准之前，委员会应根据预算和可用时间评估项目的可行性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandna dubji dwar l-effettwabilità tal-pjan. Lara: Ejja naraw jekk għandniex biżżejjed ħin u nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: We still have doubts about the feasibility of the plan. Lara: Let's see whether we have enough time and people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们对这个计划的可行性还有疑问。Lara：我们看看时间和人手够不够吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandna dubji dwar l-effettwabilità tal-pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandna dubji dwar l-effettwabilità tal-pjan.
messages.zh: 我们对这个计划的可行性还有疑问。
messages.en: We still have doubts about the feasibility of the plan.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw jekk għandniex biżżejjed ħin u nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw jekk għandniex biżżejjed ħin u nies.
messages.zh: 我们看看时间和人手够不够吧。
messages.en: Let's see whether we have enough time and people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在计划旁画三个检查框：钱够吗、时间够吗、人手够吗？把这组“能否做成”的问题与 effettwabilità 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of carrying something out or making it a reality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把计划、决定或行动付诸实施，或使其成为现实的行为与过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih pjan, deċiżjoni jew azzjoni jitwettqu fil-prattika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执行；实施；使计划或目标成为现实。

formal.mt: L-effettwazzjoni tal-pjan teħtieġ koordinazzjoni bejn id-dipartimenti kollha.
formal.en: The execution of the plan requires coordination among all departments.
formal.zh: 该计划的实施需要所有部门相互协调。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-effettwazzjoni tal-pjan? Sara: Jien se nqassam ix-xogħol u nsegwi l-progress.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will take care of the execution of the plan? Sara: I'll assign the work and follow the progress.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谁来负责这个计划的执行？Sara：我来分配工作并跟进进度。

messages.speaker: Mark (团队负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-effettwazzjoni tal-pjan?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-effettwazzjoni tal-pjan?
messages.zh: 谁来负责这个计划的执行？
messages.en: Who will take care of the execution of the plan?

messages.speaker: Sara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nqassam ix-xogħol u nsegwi l-progress.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nqassam ix-xogħol u nsegwi l-progress.
messages.zh: 我来分配工作并跟进进度。
messages.en: I'll assign the work and follow the progress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸上的计划变成正在进行的工作：effettwazzjoni 指执行和实现的过程。可按“计划写好，接着实施”这个顺序记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to achieve results while using time, effort, or resources with little waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较少的时间、精力或资源浪费完成工作、取得成果的能力或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li jinkisbu riżultati bi ftit ħela ta' ħin, sforz jew riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效率；在减少时间、精力或资源浪费的情况下完成工作的程度。

formal.mt: Is-sistema l-ġdida tejbet l-effiċjenza billi naqqset il-ħin meħtieġ biex jiġu pproċessati l-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The new system improved efficiency by reducing the time needed to process applications.
formal.zh: 新系统缩短了处理申请所需的时间，从而提高了效率。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nistgħu ntejbu l-effiċjenza fil-kċina? Mark: Inħejju l-ingredjenti kollha qabel nibdew insajru.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can we improve efficiency in the kitchen? Mark: We can prepare all the ingredients before we start cooking.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们怎么提高厨房里的工作效率？Mark：可以在开始做饭之前把所有食材都准备好。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们怎么提高厨房里的工作效率？
messages.en: How can we improve efficiency in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħejju l-ingredjenti kollha qabel nibdew insajru.
messages.mt_standard: Inħejju l-ingredjenti kollha qabel nibdew insajru.
messages.zh: 可以在开始做饭之前把所有食材都准备好。
messages.en: We can prepare all the ingredients before we start cooking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同样做完一顿饭，却少花时间、少浪费食材：这就是 effiċjenza。记忆重点放在“投入省、浪费少、效率高”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called einsteinium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锿，英语名称为 einsteinium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem einsteinju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锿，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-elementi kimiċi tinkludi l-einsteinju.
formal.en: The list of chemical elements includes einsteinium.
formal.zh: 这份化学元素名单包括锿。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ngħidu 'einsteinium' bil-Malti? Mark: Ngħidu 'einsteinju'; huwa element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do we say 'einsteinium' in Maltese? Mark: We say 'einsteinju'; it is a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：einsteinium 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：说 einsteinju，它是一种化学元素。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: einsteinium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say 'einsteinium' in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (化学教师)
messages.zh: 说 einsteinju，它是一种化学元素。
messages.en: We say 'einsteinju'; it is a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作“锿—einsteinium—einsteinju”三语卡片，观察两个外语名称相似的开头，再单独练习马耳他语结尾 ju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adverb used to ask about a place or location: where.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 询问地点或所在位置的副词，相当于“哪里”或“在何处”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li jintuża biex tistaqsi dwar post jew fejn tinsab xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哪里；在何处。

formal.mt: Ejn jinsab id-dokument li semma l-awtur?
formal.en: Where is the document mentioned by the author?
formal.zh: 作者提到的文件在哪里？

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejn qiegħed, Pawlu? Pawlu: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you, Pawlu? Pawlu: I'm next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗，你在哪里？保罗：我在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗，你在哪里？
messages.en: Where are you, Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在门旁边。
messages.en: I'm next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你在地图上画一个问号，每次指着未知地点就问 ejn；再用“你在哪里”和“你去哪里”两句轮换练习。

gloss_zh: 遮蔽；使发生日食或月食

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obscure a celestial body by passing in front of it or blocking the light reaching it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天体通过遮挡另一天体或阻断照向它的光，使其发生食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħatti ġisem ċelesti jew jimblokka d-dawl li jasal fuqu, u b'hekk jikkawża eklissi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮蔽天体；使发生食。

collocations.zh: 遮蔽太阳的一部分，造成日偏食

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-Qamar eklissa parti mix-Xemx.
formal.en: During the observation, the Moon eclipsed part of the Sun.
formal.zh: 观测期间，月球遮蔽了太阳的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-Qamar eklissa x-Xemx kollha? Mark: Le, għatta biss parti minnha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the Moon eclipse the whole Sun? Mark: No, it covered only part of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：月球把整个太阳都遮住了吗？马克：没有，只遮住了一部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 月球把整个太阳都遮住了吗？
messages.en: Did the Moon eclipse the whole Sun?

messages.speaker: Mark (天文教师)
messages.zh: 没有，只遮住了一部分。
messages.en: No, it covered only part of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张小圆纸片遮住画出的太阳，同时读 eklissa，把这个动词和“天体被遮蔽、发生食”的动态画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the ecliptic in astronomy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与天文学中的黄道有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-eklittika fl-astronomija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄道的；与黄道有关的。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-pjan eklittiku b'linja ħamra.
formal.en: The diagram shows the ecliptic plane with a red line.
formal.zh: 图中用一条红线表示黄道平面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi turi l-linja ħamra? Mark: Turi l-pjan eklittiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the red line show? Mark: It shows the ecliptic plane.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：红线表示什么？马克：它表示黄道平面。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 红线表示什么？
messages.en: What does the red line show?

messages.speaker: Mark (天文教师)
messages.zh: 它表示黄道平面。
messages.en: It shows the ecliptic plane.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eklittiku 写在天文图中的黄道平面旁，整组记住 pjan eklittiku；再对照复数搭配 koordinati eklittiċi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of relationships between living organisms and their environment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究生物之间以及生物与环境之间相互关系的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tar-relazzjonijiet bejn il-ħlejjaq ħajjin u l-ambjent tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生态学；研究生物与环境相互关系的学科。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-ekoloġija jispjega kif il-pjanti u l-annimali jiddependu mill-ambjent tagħhom.
formal.en: The ecology course explains how plants and animals depend on their environment.
formal.zh: 这门生态学课程讲解植物和动物如何依赖其生存环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tistudja bħalissa? Pawlu: Qed nistudja l-ekoloġija, speċjalment ir-relazzjoni bejn il-ħut u l-ambjent tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you studying at the moment? Pawlu: I'm studying ecology, especially the relationship between fish and the marine environment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最近在学什么？保罗：我在学生态学，特别是鱼类与海洋环境之间的关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你最近在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at the moment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistudja l-ekoloġija, speċjalment ir-relazzjoni bejn il-ħut u l-ambjent tal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistudja l-ekoloġija, speċjalment ir-relazzjoni bejn il-ħut u l-ambjent tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 我在学生态学，特别是鱼类与海洋环境之间的关系。
messages.en: I'm studying ecology, especially the relationship between fish and the marine environment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把鱼、海水和海草画成关系网，记住这个词研究的是生物与环境的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In terms of money, costs, resources, or economic conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从资金、成本、资源或经济状况的角度而言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-aspett tal-flus, tal-ispejjeż, tar-riżorsi jew tal-qagħda ekonomika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在经济上；从经济或成本的角度而言。

formal.mt: L-istudju juri li l-proġett huwa ekonomikament vijabbli jekk l-ispejjeż jibqgħu taħt kontroll.
formal.en: The study shows that the project is economically viable if costs remain under control.
formal.zh: 研究表明，如果成本得到控制，该项目在经济上是可行的。
