colloquial.mt: Lara: Tajjeb nixtru magna ġdida? Mark: Ekonomikament, aħjar insewwu dik li għandna; it-tiswija tiswa ħafna inqas.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should we buy a new machine? Mark: Economically, we're better off repairing the one we have; the repair costs much less.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们要不要买一台新机器？马克：从经济角度看，修好现有这台更合适；维修便宜得多。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.zh: 我们要不要买一台新机器？
messages.en: Should we buy a new machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ekonomikament, aħjar insewwu dik li għandna; it-tiswija tiswa ħafna inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Ekonomikament, aħjar insewwu dik li għandna; it-tiswija tiswa ħafna inqas.
messages.zh: 从经济角度看，修好现有这台更合适；维修便宜得多。
messages.en: Economically, we're better off repairing the one we have; the repair costs much less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象做决定前先拿出计算器：这个副词提醒你从经济和成本角度判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies or analyzes how economies work, including production, spending, and employment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究或分析经济运行，包括生产、支出和就业等问题的专业人士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja jew tanalizza kif taħdem l-ekonomija, fosthom il-produzzjoni, l-infiq u l-impjiegi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经济学家；研究或分析经济活动的专业人士。

formal.mt: L-ekonomista analizza l-effett taż-żieda fil-prezzijiet fuq l-infiq tal-familji.
formal.en: The economist analyzed the effect of rising prices on household spending.
formal.zh: 这位经济学家分析了物价上涨对家庭支出的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jispjega għaliex għolew il-prezzijiet? David: Se jitkellem ekonomista fuq ir-radju llejla; nistgħu nisimgħuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to explain why prices have gone up? David: An economist will be speaking on the radio tonight; we can listen to him together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来解释一下物价为什么涨了？戴维：今晚有位经济学家会在广播里讲，我们可以一起听。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jispjega għaliex għolew il-prezzijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jispjega għaliex għolew il-prezzijiet?
messages.zh: 谁来解释一下物价为什么涨了？
messages.en: Who is going to explain why prices have gone up?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jitkellem ekonomista fuq ir-radju llejla; nistgħu nisimgħuh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Se jitkellem ekonomista fuq ir-radju llejla; nistgħu nisimgħuh flimkien.
messages.zh: 今晚有位经济学家会在广播里讲，我们可以一起听。
messages.en: An economist will be speaking on the radio tonight; we can listen to him together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着物价和就业图表作分析的人，把整个词记成经济学家。

gloss_zh: 平衡调整；使平衡的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of adjusting something so that its weight or forces are balanced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过调整重量分布或作用力，使某物达到平衡的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' aġġustament ta' xi ħaġa biex il-piż jew il-forzi tagħha jkunu f'bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平衡调整；使重量或作用力达到平衡的过程。

formal.mt: L-ekwilibrazzjoni tar-roti għandha ssir b'tagħmir adattat biex titnaqqas il-vibrazzjoni waqt is-sewqan.
formal.en: Wheel balancing should be carried out with suitable equipment to reduce vibration while driving.
formal.zh: 应使用合适的设备进行车轮平衡调整，以减少行驶时的振动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-karozza għadha tivvibra? Toni: Ir-roti għandhom bżonn l-ekwilibrazzjoni; nista' nagħmilha llum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the car still vibrating? Toni: The wheels need balancing; I can do it today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：汽车为什么还在振动？托尼：车轮需要做平衡调整；我今天可以处理。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.zh: 汽车为什么还在振动？
messages.en: Why is the car still vibrating?

messages.speaker: Toni (修车师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-roti għandhom bżonn l-ekwilibrazzjoni; nista' nagħmilha llum.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-roti għandhom bżonn l-ekwilibrazzjoni; nista' nagħmilha llum.
messages.zh: 车轮需要做平衡调整；我今天可以处理。
messages.en: The wheels need balancing; I can do it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象师傅逐步调整车轮配重，记住这个词强调使其平衡的调整过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state in which opposing forces or influences balance one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相反的作用力或影响彼此抵消、保持平衡的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat li fih forzi jew influwenzi opposti jibbilanċjaw lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平衡；各方作用力或影响相互平衡的状态。

formal.mt: Il-miżien jinsab f'ekwilibriju meta l-piż fuq iż-żewġ naħat ikun indaqs.
formal.en: The balance is in equilibrium when the weight on both sides is equal.
formal.zh: 当天平两侧的重量相等时，天平处于平衡状态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-miżien ma jiċċaqlaqx? Pawlu: Għax jinsab f'ekwilibriju; hemm l-istess piż fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't the balance moving? Pawlu: Because it is in equilibrium; there is the same weight on both sides.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：天平为什么不动？保罗：因为它处于平衡状态；两边的重量相同。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 天平为什么不动？
messages.en: Why isn't the balance moving?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jinsab f'ekwilibriju; hemm l-istess piż fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jinsab f'ekwilibriju; hemm l-istess piż fuq iż-żewġ naħat.
messages.zh: 因为它处于平衡状态；两边的重量相同。
messages.en: Because it is in equilibrium; there is the same weight on both sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平两边一样重、横杆保持水平，记住这个词强调已经达到的平衡状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A performer who walks along a tightly stretched rope while maintaining balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在绷紧的绳索或钢丝上保持平衡并行走的表演者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li jimxi fuq ħabel miġbud u jżomm il-bilanċ waqt il-wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走钢丝演员；在绷紧的绳索上行走的表演者。

collocations.zh: 走钢丝演员的平衡能力

formal.mt: Matul il-wirja, l-ekwilibrist mexa fuq ħabel għoli filwaqt li żamm lasta twila għall-bilanċ.
formal.en: During the performance, the tightrope walker walked along a high rope while holding a long pole for balance.
formal.zh: 表演期间，走钢丝演员手持长杆保持平衡，沿着高处的绳索行走。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min hu dak li qed jimxi fuq il-ħabel? Marija: Dak ekwilibrist; ara kif juża l-lasta biex iżomm il-bilanċ.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who is that walking on the rope? Marija: That's a tightrope walker; look how he uses the pole to keep his balance.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那个在绳子上走的人是谁？玛丽亚：那是走钢丝演员；看他怎样用长杆保持平衡。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jimxi fuq il-ħabel?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jimxi fuq il-ħabel?
messages.zh: 那个在绳子上走的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that walking on the rope?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ekwilibrist; ara kif juża l-lasta biex iżomm il-bilanċ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ekwilibrist; ara kif juża l-lasta biex iżomm il-bilanċ.
messages.zh: 那是走钢丝演员；看他怎样用长杆保持平衡。
messages.en: That's a tightrope walker; look how he uses the pole to keep his balance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一幅马戏画面：一个人拿着长杆走钢丝，把整个词与这位演员联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make two or more things equal in amount, level, or status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使两个或多个事物在数量、水平或地位上相等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel żewġ affarijiet jew aktar indaqs fl-ammont, fil-livell jew fl-istatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使相等；使数量、水平或地位达到同等程度。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim ekwipara s-salarji tal-ħaddiema li jagħmlu l-istess xogħol fiż-żewġ fergħat.
formal.en: The agreement equalized the salaries of employees doing the same work at the two branches.
formal.zh: 该协议使两家分店中从事相同工作的员工薪资一致。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għad hemm differenza bejn is-salarji tagħna? Mark: Le, il-ftehim il-ġdid ekwipara s-salarji tagħna; issa naqilgħu l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is there still a difference between our salaries? Mark: No, the new agreement equalized our salaries; now we earn the same amount.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们的薪资还有差别吗？马克：没有了，新协议把我们的薪资调整到相同水平；现在我们挣得一样多。

messages.speaker: Anna (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm differenza bejn is-salarji tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm differenza bejn is-salarji tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们的薪资还有差别吗？
messages.en: Is there still a difference between our salaries?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ftehim il-ġdid ekwipara s-salarji tagħna; issa naqilgħu l-istess ammont.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ftehim il-ġdid ekwipara s-salarji tagħna; issa naqilgħu l-istess ammont.
messages.zh: 没有了，新协议把我们的薪资调整到相同水平；现在我们挣得一样多。
messages.en: No, the new agreement equalized our salaries; now we earn the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两根高低不同的薪资柱被调整到同一高度，记住这个动词表示使两者相等。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equal in value, level, or status to something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在价值、水平或地位上与另一事物相等或相当的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-istess valur, livell jew status bħal xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 等同的；在价值、水平或地位上相当的。

formal.mt: Biex japplika, il-kandidat irid ikollu diploma jew kwalifika ekwiparabbli fl-istess qasam.
formal.en: To apply, the candidate must hold a diploma or an equivalent qualification in the same field.
formal.zh: 申请者须持有该领域的文凭或同等资格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kwalifika hija ekwiparabbli għal dik li qed jitolbu? David: Iva, għandha l-istess livell u tista' tużaha għall-applikazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this qualification equivalent to the one they are asking for? David: Yes, it is at the same level, and you can use it for the application.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个资格与他们要求的资格等同吗？戴维：是的，它们属于同一水平，你可以用它申请。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kwalifika hija ekwiparabbli għal dik li qed jitolbu?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kwalifika hija ekwiparabbli għal dik li qed jitolbu?
messages.zh: 这个资格与他们要求的资格等同吗？
messages.en: Is this qualification equivalent to the one they are asking for?

messages.speaker: David (招生顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha l-istess livell u tista' tużaha għall-applikazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha l-istess livell u tista' tużaha għall-applikazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，它们属于同一水平，你可以用它申请。
messages.en: Yes, it is at the same level, and you can use it for the application.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张不同的证书被放在同一等级栏里，记住这个形容词表示水平或资格相当。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or explain an idea, plan, or argument in greater detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过补充细节、解释或例子，进一步展开一个想法、计划或论点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżviluppa jew tispjega idea, pjan jew argument b'aktar dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细阐述；补充细节以展开说明。

collocations.en: develop the proposal in greater detail

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur elabora l-argument u żied eżempji biex jiċċara l-konklużjoni.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher elaborated on the argument and added examples to clarify the conclusion.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中进一步阐述了论点，并补充例子以说明结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni ma fhimtx il-proposta tiegħek. Elabora ftit. Mark: Irrid li niftħu l-librerija siegħa qabel, biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jistudjaw qabel il-lezzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: I still haven't understood your proposal. Could you elaborate a little? Mark: I want us to open the library an hour earlier so that students can study before lessons.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我还没明白你的提议，能详细说说吗？Mark：我希望图书馆提前一小时开放，让学生能在上课前学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fhimtx il-proposta tiegħek. Elabora ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fhimtx il-proposta tiegħek. Elabora ftit.
messages.zh: 我还没明白你的提议，能详细说说吗？
messages.en: I still haven't understood your proposal. Could you elaborate a little?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid li niftħu l-librerija siegħa qabel, biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jistudjaw qabel il-lezzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid li niftħu l-librerija siegħa qabel, biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jistudjaw qabel il-lezzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 我希望图书馆提前一小时开放，让学生能在上课前学习。
messages.en: I want us to open the library an hour earlier so that students can study before lessons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成给一句简短观点添上细节和例子：从“说了什么”走向“具体怎么说”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The development or explanation of an idea, plan, or argument through additional detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过增加细节，对想法、计划或论点作出的进一步展开或说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iżvilupp jew l-ispjegazzjoni ta' idea, pjan jew argument permezz ta' aktar dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细阐述；对原有内容的进一步展开或补充说明。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab elaborazzjoni tal-proposta, b'aktar dettalji dwar l-ispejjeż u ż-żmien meħtieġ.
formal.en: The committee requested an elaboration of the proposal, with more details about the costs and the time required.
formal.zh: 委员会要求进一步展开提案，补充有关费用和所需时间的细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għalliema kitbet li hemm bżonn aktar elaborazzjoni f'dan il-paragrafu. Pawlu: Żid eżempju u spjega kif jappoġġa l-idea tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: The teacher wrote that this paragraph needs more elaboration. Pawlu: Add an example and explain how it supports your idea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：老师写道，这一段需要进一步展开。Pawlu：加一个例子，再解释它怎样支持你的观点。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliema kitbet li hemm bżonn aktar elaborazzjoni f'dan il-paragrafu.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliema kitbet li hemm bżonn aktar elaborazzjoni f'dan il-paragrafu.
messages.zh: 老师写道，这一段需要进一步展开。
messages.en: The teacher wrote that this paragraph needs more elaboration.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid eżempju u spjega kif jappoġġa l-idea tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Żid eżempju u spjega kif jappoġġa l-idea tiegħek.
messages.zh: 加一个例子，再解释它怎样支持你的观点。
messages.en: Add an example and explain how it supports your idea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作文旁写着“请展开”：补充解释与例子的这一过程，就是详细阐述。

gloss_zh: 列出；逐项列举；编列清单

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write or state items one by one, or to make an inventory of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物逐项写出或说出，或将其整理成清单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikteb jew issemmi affarijiet waħda waħda, jew tagħmel inventarju tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to list, to enumerate, to inventory
sense_translations.zh_definition: 列出；逐项列举；将物品等编列成清单。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-uffiċjal elenka d-dokumenti kollha li kienu neqsin mill-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: In the report, the officer listed all the documents missing from the application.
formal.zh: 工作人员在报告中列出了申请材料所缺的全部文件。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Elenka l-affarijiet li għandna bżonn għall-piknik. Ben: Ħobż, ġobon, ilma u ftit frott.
colloquial.en: Anna: List the things we need for the picnic. Ben: Bread, cheese, water, and some fruit.
colloquial.zh: Anna：把我们野餐需要的东西列一下。Ben：面包、奶酪、水，还有一些水果。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Elenka l-affarijiet li għandna bżonn għall-piknik.
messages.mt_standard: Elenka l-affarijiet li għandna bżonn għall-piknik.
messages.zh: 把我们野餐需要的东西列一下。
messages.en: List the things we need for the picnic.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħobż, ġobon, ilma u ftit frott.
messages.mt_standard: Ħobż, ġobon, ilma u ftit frott.
messages.zh: 面包、奶酪、水，还有一些水果。
messages.en: Bread, cheese, water, and some fruit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿笔把物品一项一项写下来：记住它强调“列出”这个动作，而不是清单本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A list or catalogue of items, names, or details, including an inventory of things held.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物品、姓名或资料逐项记录的列表或目录，也可指所持物品的清单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista jew katalogu ta' oġġetti, ismijiet jew dettalji, li jista' juri wkoll l-affarijiet miżmuma f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物品清单；列表；目录。

formal.mt: L-elenku tal-oġġetti fil-maħżen ġie aġġornat wara li waslet il-kunsinna l-ġdida.
formal.en: The inventory of items in the storeroom was updated after the new delivery arrived.
formal.zh: 新一批货物送达后，仓库的物品清单进行了更新。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek l-elenku tal-kotba għall-kors? Toni: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tixtrihom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have the list of books for the course? Toni: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can buy them.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你有这门课程的书单吗？Toni：有，我现在发给你，方便你去买。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你有这门课程的书单吗？
messages.en: Do you have the list of books for the course?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tixtrihom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tixtrihom.
messages.zh: 有，我现在发给你，方便你去买。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can buy them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象已经写好的购物清单或课程书单：它指逐项排列的那份清单，是可以查看的名词。

gloss_zh: 选修的；可选择的；由选举产生的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chosen rather than compulsory, as with a course; also, filled or determined by election.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可自行选择而非必修或强制的，如课程；也可指由选举产生或决定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintgħażel u mhux obbligatorju, bħal kors; jew li jimtela jew jiġi deċiż permezz ta' elezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选修的；可选择而非强制的；由选举产生或决定的。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi kors elettiv li l-istudenti jistgħu jagħżlu skont l-interessi tagħhom.
formal.en: The programme includes an elective course that students can choose according to their interests.
formal.zh: 该培养方案包含一门选修课程，学生可以根据自己的兴趣选择。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kors hu obbligatorju? Luke: Le, hu elettiv. Tista' tagħżel kors ieħor minfloku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this course compulsory? Luke: No, it's elective. You can choose another course instead.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这门课程是必修的吗？Luke：不是，是选修的。你可以改选另一门课程。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这门课程是必修的吗？
messages.en: Is this course compulsory?

messages.speaker: Luke (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu elettiv. Tista' tagħżel kors ieħor minfloku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu elettiv. Tista' tagħżel kors ieħor minfloku.
messages.zh: 不是，是选修的。你可以改选另一门课程。
messages.en: No, it's elective. You can choose another course instead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“选择”串起两个场景：课程表上由学生选修，职位则可由选民投票选出；具体意思看搭配。

gloss_zh: 全体选民；有投票权的群体

teaching_sense.en_definition: All the people entitled to vote in a particular election, country, or area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某次选举、某个国家或地区中，所有享有投票权的人组成的群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies kollha li għandhom id-dritt jivvutaw f'elezzjoni partikolari, f'pajjiż jew f'żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全体选民；在特定选举或地区中享有投票权的人群。

collocations.zh: 了解相关情况的选民群体

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li elettorat infurmat jeħtieġ aċċess għal informazzjoni ċara dwar il-proposti tal-kandidati.
formal.en: The report stresses that an informed electorate needs access to clear information about the candidates' proposals.
formal.zh: 报告强调，要让选民充分了解情况，就需要让他们获取有关候选人提案的清晰信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser elettorat f'dan l-artiklu? Ninu: In-nies kollha li għandhom id-dritt jivvutaw, anki dawk li ma jmorrux jivvutaw.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does electorate mean in this article? Ninu: All the people who have the right to vote, including those who don't go and vote.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的 elettorat 是什么意思？Ninu：所有有投票权的人，也包括那些没有去投票的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 elettorat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does electorate mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nies kollha li għandhom id-dritt jivvutaw, anki dawk li ma jmorrux jivvutaw.
messages.mt_standard: In-nies kollha li għandhom id-dritt jivvutaw, anki dawk li ma jmorrux jivvutaw.
messages.zh: 所有有投票权的人，也包括那些没有去投票的人。
messages.en: All the people who have the right to vote, including those who don't go and vote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所有有投票权的人圈在一起：这个大圈就是全体选民，不能只数当天到场投票的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trained worker who installs, maintains, or repairs electrical wiring and equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装、维护或修理电线及电气设备的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem imħarreġ li jinstalla, iżomm fi stat tajjeb jew isewwi wajers u tagħmir tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电工；从事电气安装、维护或修理的人员。

formal.mt: L-installazzjoni tal-wajers għandha ssir minn elettriċista kwalifikat.
formal.en: The wiring installation should be carried out by a qualified electrician.
formal.zh: 电线安装应由合格的电工进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dawl tal-kċina ma jaħdimx. Mark: Inċempel lil elettriċista biex jiġi jiċċekkjah.
colloquial.en: Maja: The kitchen light isn't working. Mark: I'll call an electrician to come and check it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：厨房的灯不亮了。马克：我打电话叫个电工来检查一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房的灯不亮了。
messages.en: The kitchen light isn't working.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inċempel lil elettriċista biex jiġi jiċċekkjah.
messages.mt_standard: Inċempel lil elettriċista biex jiġi jiċċekkjah.
messages.zh: 我打电话叫个电工来检查一下。
messages.en: I'll call an electrician to come and check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 elettriċista 与提着工具箱修灯的人联系起来，记住它指电工这个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The physical phenomenon associated with electric charge, including the electrical energy used to power devices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与电荷有关的物理现象，也指供设备运转使用的电能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu fiżiku marbut maċ-ċarġ elettriku, kif ukoll l-enerġija elettrika li tħaddem l-apparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电；电力；电能。

formal.mt: Il-bini juża pannelli solari biex jipproduċi parti mill-elettriċità li jeħtieġ.
formal.en: The building uses solar panels to produce part of the electricity it needs.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑使用太阳能板生产所需的部分电力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex intefa kollox? Pawlu: Inqatgħet l-elettriċità fit-triq kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has everything switched off? Pawlu: The electricity has gone out along the whole street.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎么所有东西都断电了？保罗：整条街都停电了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 怎么所有东西都断电了？
messages.en: Why has everything switched off?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 整条街都停电了。
messages.en: The electricity has gone out along the whole street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 elettriċità 就想象按下开关灯亮起来，把词与供电和用电的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An accumulation of electric charge on an object, which can cause attraction or a brief discharge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 积聚在物体上的电荷，可产生吸引现象或短暂放电。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkumulazzjoni ta' ċarġ elettriku fuq oġġett li tista' tikkawża attrazzjoni jew skarika qasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 静电；物体上积聚的电荷所产生的现象。

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, l-elettriċità statika fuq il-bużżieqa ġibdet biċċiet żgħar tal-karta.
formal.en: In the experiment, static electricity on the balloon attracted small pieces of paper.
formal.zh: 实验中，气球上的静电吸引了小纸片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex xagħri qed jeħel mal-bużżieqa? Nina: Minħabba l-elettriċità statika li nħolqot meta għoroktha ma' xagħrek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is my hair sticking to the balloon? Nina: Because of the static electricity produced when you rubbed it against your hair.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么我的头发会贴在气球上？妮娜：因为你用气球摩擦头发时产生了静电。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 为什么我的头发会贴在气球上？
messages.en: Why is my hair sticking to the balloon?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-elettriċità statika li nħolqot meta għoroktha ma' xagħrek.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-elettriċità statika li nħolqot meta għoroktha ma' xagħrek.
messages.zh: 因为你用气球摩擦头发时产生了静电。
messages.en: Because of the static electricity produced when you rubbed it against your hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用气球摩擦头发再吸起纸片的画面，记住整个词组 elettriċità statika 表示静电。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give an object an electric charge or equip a system to operate using electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体带上电荷，或使某个系统能够使用电力运行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti ċarġ elettriku lil oġġett jew jgħammar sistema biex taħdem bl-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使带电；使电气化，使能够以电力运行。

formal.mt: It-tim elettriċizza l-linja tal-ferrovija biex il-ferroviji jkunu jistgħu jaħdmu bl-elettriku.
formal.en: The team electrified the railway line so that trains could run on electricity.
formal.zh: 团队完成了这条铁路线的电气化，使列车能够以电力运行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-moxt qed jiġbed dawn il-biċċiet tal-karta? Sara: It-tħakkik elettriċizza l-moxt, u issa għandu ċarġ elettriku.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the comb attracting these pieces of paper? Sara: The rubbing electrified the comb, so it now has an electric charge.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么梳子会吸引这些纸片？萨拉：摩擦使梳子带电了，所以它现在带有电荷。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-moxt qed jiġbed dawn il-biċċiet tal-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-moxt qed jiġbed dawn il-biċċiet tal-karta?
messages.zh: 为什么梳子会吸引这些纸片？
messages.en: Why is the comb attracting these pieces of paper?

messages.speaker: Sara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tħakkik elettriċizza l-moxt, u issa għandu ċarġ elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: It-tħakkik elettriċizza l-moxt, u issa għandu ċarġ elettriku.
messages.zh: 摩擦使梳子带电了，所以它现在带有电荷。
messages.en: The rubbing electrified the comb, so it now has an electric charge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 elettriċizza 记成一个使事物发生变化的动作：梳子变得带电，铁路改用电力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The interaction between electricity and magnetism, and the branch of physics that studies it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电与磁之间的相互作用，也指研究这种相互作用的物理学分支。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-interazzjoni bejn l-elettriku u l-manjetiżmu, u l-fergħa tal-fiżika li tistudjaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电磁学；电磁作用或电磁现象。

formal.mt: L-istudju tal-elettromanjetiżmu jgħinna nifhmu kif jaħdmu l-muturi elettriċi.
formal.en: The study of electromagnetism helps us understand how electric motors work.
formal.zh: 学习电磁学有助于我们理解电动机的工作原理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-labra tal-boxxla tiċċaqlaq ħdejn il-wajer meta jgħaddi l-kurrent? Pawlu: Dan huwa eżempju ta' elettromanjetiżmu: il-kurrent joħloq kamp manjetiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the compass needle move near the wire when current flows? Pawlu: This is an example of electromagnetism: the current creates a magnetic field.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电流通过时，为什么电线旁的指南针指针会移动？保罗：这是电磁现象的一个例子：电流产生了磁场。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-labra tal-boxxla tiċċaqlaq ħdejn il-wajer meta jgħaddi l-kurrent?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-labra tal-boxxla tiċċaqlaq ħdejn il-wajer meta jgħaddi l-kurrent?
messages.zh: 电流通过时，为什么电线旁的指南针指针会移动？
messages.en: Why does the compass needle move near the wire when current flows?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa eżempju ta' elettromanjetiżmu: il-kurrent joħloq kamp manjetiku.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa eżempju ta' elettromanjetiżmu: il-kurrent joħloq kamp manjetiku.
messages.zh: 这是电磁现象的一个例子：电流产生了磁场。
messages.en: This is an example of electromagnetism: the current creates a magnetic field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象通电的线圈吸起铁钉，把电与磁连在同一画面中，帮助记住 elettromanjetiżmu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has the right to vote in an election.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在选举中拥有投票权的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha d-dritt tivvota f'elezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选民；有权在选举中投票的人。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega lil kull elettur kif jimla l-polza tal-vot.
formal.en: The leaflet explains to every elector how to fill in the ballot paper.
formal.zh: 这份说明单向每位选民解释如何填写选票。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din l-ewwel darba li se nivvota. Maja: Mela int elettur ġdid! Taf fejn trid tmur?
colloquial.en: Mark: This is the first time I'm going to vote. Maja: So you're a new elector! Do you know where you need to go?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是我第一次要去投票。玛雅：原来你是新选民呀！你知道要去哪里吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ewwel darba li se nivvota.
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ewwel darba li se nivvota.
messages.zh: 这是我第一次要去投票。
messages.en: This is the first time I'm going to vote.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela int elettur ġdid! Taf fejn trid tmur?
messages.mt_standard: Mela int elettur ġdid! Taf fejn trid tmur?
messages.zh: 原来你是新选民呀！你知道要去哪里吗？
messages.en: So you're a new elector! Do you know where you need to go?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 elettur 放进选民拿着选票排队的画面，重点记住它指拥有投票权的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise something to a higher position or level, or to lift someone's spirits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物升到更高的位置或水平，也可指使人心情振奋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħolli xi ħaġa għal pożizzjoni jew livell ogħla, jew iferraħ lil xi ħadd u jgħollilu l-moral.

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise, to lift, to elevate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举起；抬高；使位置、水平或地位提升。
使高兴起来；使心情振奋；鼓舞。

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu eleva l-pjattaforma sal-għoli meħtieġ għax-xogħol.
formal.en: The mechanism raised the platform to the height required for the work.
formal.zh: 该装置把平台升到了作业所需的高度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif qed tħossok wara t-taħdita? Mark: Aħjar. Il-kliem tal-għalliem eleva l-moral tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are you feeling after the talk? Mark: Better. The teacher's words lifted my spirits.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谈过之后，你感觉怎么样？马克：好多了。老师的话让我振作起来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 谈过之后，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after the talk?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar. Il-kliem tal-għalliem eleva l-moral tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar. Il-kliem tal-għalliem eleva l-moral tiegħi.
messages.zh: 好多了。老师的话让我振作起来了。
messages.en: Better. The teacher's words lifted my spirits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用向上的箭头记 eleva：平台向上是抬高，心情向上是振奋，两种意义一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of raising something to a higher position or level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物升至更高位置或水平的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tittella' għal pożizzjoni jew livell ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 升高；抬升；提升的行为或过程。

collocations.en: the raising of the standard of education

formal.mt: L-elevament tal-pjattaforma sar bil-mod biex it-tagħmir jibqa' stabbli.
formal.en: The raising of the platform was carried out slowly so that the equipment would remain stable.
formal.zh: 平台缓慢升高，以保持设备稳定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jgħid il-programm dwar l-iskola? Pawlu: Isemmi l-elevament tal-livell tal-edukazzjoni, jiġifieri li t-tagħlim isir aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the programme say about the school? Pawlu: It mentions raising the standard of education, meaning making teaching and learning better.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份计划对学校说了些什么？保罗：它提到提升教育水平，也就是改善教学与学习。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 这份计划对学校说了些什么？
messages.en: What does the programme say about the school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Isemmi l-elevament tal-livell tal-edukazzjoni, jiġifieri li t-tagħlim isir aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Isemmi l-elevament tal-livell tal-edukazzjoni, jiġifieri li t-tagħlim isir aħjar.
messages.zh: 它提到提升教育水平，也就是改善教学与学习。
messages.en: It mentions raising the standard of education, meaning making teaching and learning better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 elevament 记作升高这件事：平台高度上升或教育水平提高，都可以用提升的过程来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The raising of the host during Mass; in another sense, sequestration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弥撒中将圣饼举起的礼仪动作；另有扣押、封存之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li s-saċerdot jgħolli l-ostja waqt il-quddiesa; f'sens ieħor, sekwestru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举扬圣体：弥撒中将圣饼举起的礼仪动作。
扣押、封存；将财产等置于受控制的保管之下。

formal.mt: Waqt l-elevazzjoni tal-ostja, il-kongregazzjoni baqgħet fis-skiet.
formal.en: During the elevation of the host, the congregation remained silent.
formal.zh: 举扬圣饼时，全体会众保持肃静。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser l-elevazzjoni fil-quddiesa? Pawlu: Hija meta s-saċerdot jgħolli l-ostja.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does elevation mean in Mass? Pawlu: It is when the priest raises the host.
colloquial.zh: Marija：弥撒中的举扬圣体是什么意思？Pawlu：就是神父将圣饼举起来的时候。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 弥撒中的举扬圣体是什么意思？
messages.en: What does elevation mean in Mass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 就是神父将圣饼举起来的时候。
messages.en: It is when the priest raises the host.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用神父举起圣饼的画面记住礼仪义，再另设“财产扣押”卡片记住第二义，两个语境分开练习。

gloss_zh: 资格；符合申请或参与条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of meeting the conditions required to apply for, receive, or take part in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合申请某事、获得某物或参加某项活动所需条件的资格状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tapplika, tirċievi xi ħaġa jew tieħu sehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 资格；符合规定条件而能够申请、领取或参与的状态。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintbagħat l-applikazzjoni, għandha ssir verifika tal-eleġibbilità skont il-kriterji ppubblikati.
formal.en: Before the application is submitted, an eligibility check should be carried out according to the published criteria.
formal.zh: 提交申请之前，应根据已公布的条件进行资格核查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-eleġibbilità tiegħi għall-borża ta' studju? David: Fuq il-paġna tal-programm; hemm il-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I check my eligibility for the scholarship? David: On the programme's webpage; all the conditions are there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以在哪里确认自己是否符合奖学金申请资格？David：在项目网页上，所有条件都列在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-eleġibbilità tiegħi għall-borża ta' studju?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-eleġibbilità tiegħi għall-borża ta' studju?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里确认自己是否符合奖学金申请资格？
messages.en: Where can I check my eligibility for the scholarship?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-paġna tal-programm; hemm il-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-paġna tal-programm; hemm il-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 在项目网页上，所有条件都列在那里。
messages.en: On the programme's webpage; all the conditions are there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象申请表前的一张条件清单：逐项符合后拥有的“申请资格”，就是这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Meeting the conditions required to apply for, receive, or take part in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合规定条件，因而有资格申请、获得或参与某事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex japplika, jirċievi xi ħaġa jew jieħu sehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合资格的；满足有关申请、领取或参与条件的。

formal.mt: Kull applikant eleġibbli jista' jibgħat l-applikazzjoni tiegħu sad-data indikata fl-avviż.
formal.en: Every eligible applicant may submit their application by the date indicated in the notice.
formal.zh: 每位符合资格的申请人均可在通知所示的截止日期前提交申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien eleġibbli għal dan il-kors? Nina: Iva, għandek il-kwalifiki kollha li jitolbu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Am I eligible for this course? Nina: Yes, you have all the qualifications they require.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我有资格报读这门课程吗？Nina：有，你具备他们要求的全部资历。

messages.speaker: Mark (准学员)
messages.zh: 我有资格报读这门课程吗？
messages.en: Am I eligible for this course?

messages.speaker: Nina (课程顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandek il-kwalifiki kollha li jitolbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandek il-kwalifiki kollha li jitolbu.
messages.zh: 有，你具备他们要求的全部资历。
messages.en: Yes, you have all the qualifications they require.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作贴在申请人名字旁的“符合条件”标签：描述人有资格，用这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one million, equal to one thousand times one thousand, written 1,000,000.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一百万，即一千乘一千，写作1,000,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 1,000,000, jiġifieri elf darba elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百万；此数词短语表示一百万，即1,000,000。

formal.mt: Il-baġit totali tal-proġett huwa ta' elf l-eluf ewro.
formal.en: The total budget for the project is one million euros.
formal.zh: 该项目的总预算为一百万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu elf l-eluf? Mark: Huwa 1,000,000, jiġifieri elf darba elf.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much is elf l-eluf? Mark: It is 1,000,000, meaning one thousand times one thousand.
colloquial.zh: Lara：elf l-eluf是多少？Mark：是1,000,000，也就是一千乘一千。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: elf l-eluf是多少？
messages.en: How much is elf l-eluf?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是1,000,000，也就是一千乘一千。
messages.en: It is 1,000,000, meaning one thousand times one thousand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用算式“一千乘一千等于一百万”配合整条短语记忆，再数出数字1后面的六个零。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one million, equal to one thousand times one thousand, written 1,000,000.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一百万，即一千乘一千，写作1,000,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 1,000,000, jiġifieri elf darba elf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百万；此数词短语表示一百万，即1,000,000。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jistma li l-popolazzjoni se tilħaq elf l-elufijiet ruħ.
formal.en: The report estimates that the population will reach one million people.
formal.zh: 报告估计，人口将达到一百万人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Elf l-elufijiet ifisser 1,000,000? David: Iva, ifisser elf darba elf.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does elf l-elufijiet mean 1,000,000? David: Yes, it means one thousand times one thousand.
colloquial.zh: Nina：elf l-elufijiet的意思是1,000,000吗？David：对，就是一千乘一千。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: elf l-elufijiet的意思是1,000,000吗？
messages.en: Does elf l-elufijiet mean 1,000,000?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 对，就是一千乘一千。
messages.en: Yes, it means one thousand times one thousand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这条较长的表达完整写在“一百万”数字卡背面；短语更长，数值仍是一个1加六个零。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to eliminate participants or options, especially to decide who advances in a competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于淘汰参赛者或排除选项的，尤指决定谁能进入下一轮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jeskludi parteċipanti jew għażliet, speċjalment biex jiddeċiedi min jgħaddi għall-fażi li jmiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘汰性的；具有筛除作用的，常用于比赛或选拔。

formal.mt: Il-kandidati jridu jgħaddu minn test eliminatorju qabel l-intervista finali.
formal.en: Candidates must pass an eliminatory test before the final interview.
formal.zh: 候选人必须通过淘汰性测试，才能参加最终面试。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-rawnd huwa eliminatorju? Toni: Iva, min jitlef ma jgħaddix għar-rawnd li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this an elimination round? Toni: Yes, whoever loses does not advance to the next round.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这一轮是淘汰赛吗？Toni：对，输的人不能进入下一轮。

messages.speaker: Sara (参赛者)
messages.zh: 这一轮是淘汰赛吗？
messages.en: Is this an elimination round?

messages.speaker: Toni (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, min jitlef ma jgħaddix għar-rawnd li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, min jitlef ma jgħaddix għar-rawnd li jmiss.
messages.zh: 对，输的人不能进入下一轮。
messages.en: Yes, whoever loses does not advance to the next round.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赛程表中输者名字被划去；用“这一轮具有淘汰性质”记住它是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of removing something, excluding an option, or knocking a participant out of a competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移除某物、排除某个选项，或使参赛者退出比赛的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li titneħħa xi ħaġa, tiġi eskluża għażla, jew parteċipant jitneħħa minn kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消除、排除或淘汰的行为或过程。

formal.mt: L-eliminazzjoni tal-iżbalji fir-rapport teħtieġ reviżjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Eliminating the errors in the report requires a careful review.
formal.zh: 消除报告中的错误需要仔细审阅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din it-telfa tfisser l-eliminazzjoni tagħna? Lara: Iva, issa ma nistgħux nibqgħu fit-turnew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this defeat mean our elimination? Lara: Yes, we can no longer remain in the tournament.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这次失利意味着我们被淘汰了吗？Lara：对，我们不能继续参加这次锦标赛了。

messages.speaker: Mark (队员)
messages.zh: 这次失利意味着我们被淘汰了吗？
messages.en: Does this defeat mean our elimination?

messages.speaker: Lara (队长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa ma nistgħux nibqgħu fit-turnew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa ma nistgħux nibqgħu fit-turnew.
messages.zh: 对，我们不能继续参加这次锦标赛了。
messages.en: Yes, we can no longer remain in the tournament.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“删掉错误”和“球队出局”并排画出来，二者都体现移除；本词命名的是消除或淘汰这一过程。

gloss_zh: 日心的；以太阳为中心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the Sun as the centre, especially in a model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以太阳为中心的，尤用于描述地球和其他行星绕太阳运行的模型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqiegħed ix-Xemx fiċ-ċentru, speċjalment f'mudell fejn id-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日心的；以太阳为中心的。

formal.mt: Fil-mudell eljoċentriku, id-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwar ix-Xemx.
formal.en: In the heliocentric model, Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
formal.zh: 在日心模型中，地球和其他行星绕太阳运行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-mudell jissejjaħ eljoċentriku? Pawlu: Għax iqiegħed ix-Xemx fiċ-ċentru u juri l-pjaneti jduru madwarha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this model called heliocentric? Pawlu: Because it places the Sun at the centre and shows the planets orbiting it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么这个模型叫日心模型？Pawlu：因为它把太阳放在中心，并展示行星绕太阳运行。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这个模型叫日心模型？
messages.en: Why is this model called heliocentric?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iqiegħed ix-Xemx fiċ-ċentru u juri l-pjaneti jduru madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iqiegħed ix-Xemx fiċ-ċentru u juri l-pjaneti jduru madwarha.
messages.zh: 因为它把太阳放在中心，并展示行星绕太阳运行。
messages.en: Because it places the Sun at the centre and shows the planets orbiting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一颗太阳放在行星轨道中央，再给整幅模型贴上本词；用“日心的模型”记住形容词功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The theory that Earth and the other planets move around the Sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为地球和其他行星绕太阳运行的学说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teorija li d-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwar ix-Xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日心说；认为地球和其他行星绕太阳运行的理论。

formal.mt: L-eljoċentriżmu jqiegħed ix-Xemx fiċ-ċentru tal-mudell u jiddeskrivi d-Dinja bħala pjaneta li ddur madwarha.
formal.en: Heliocentrism places the Sun at the centre of the model and describes Earth as a planet orbiting it.
formal.zh: 日心说将太阳置于模型中心，并将地球描述为绕太阳运行的行星。

colloquial.mt: David: X'inhu l-eljoċentriżmu? Sara: Hija t-teorija li d-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwar ix-Xemx.
colloquial.en: David: What is heliocentrism? Sara: It is the theory that Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
colloquial.zh: David：什么是日心说？Sara：就是认为地球和其他行星绕太阳运行的学说。

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是日心说？
messages.en: What is heliocentrism?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija t-teorija li d-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwar ix-Xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Hija t-teorija li d-Dinja u l-pjaneti l-oħra jduru madwar ix-Xemx.
messages.zh: 就是认为地球和其他行星绕太阳运行的学说。
messages.en: It is the theory that Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把太阳居中的示意图装进一本题为“日心说”的书中；这次记的是整套学说的名称，属于名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In language, the omission of words recoverable from context; in geometry, a closed curve whose points have a constant sum of distances from two fixed points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语言中省去可由上下文补出的词语；几何中指椭圆，即曲线上各点到两个固定点的距离之和为常数的闭合曲线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-lingwa, it-tħollija barra ta' kliem li jinftiehem mill-kuntest; fil-ġeometrija, kurva magħluqa li kull punt fuqha għandu somma kostanti tad-distanzi minn żewġ punti fissi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 省略：省去可由上下文理解或补出的词语；也可指表示省略的省略号。
椭圆：曲线上每一点到两个固定焦点的距离之和为常数的闭合曲线。

formal.mt: Fil-grammatika, l-ellissi tħalli barra kliem li jinftiehem mill-kuntest; fil-ġeometrija, ellissi hija kurva magħluqa b'żewġ foki.
formal.en: In grammar, ellipsis leaves out words understood from context; in geometry, an ellipse is a closed curve with two foci.
formal.zh: 在语法中，省略是省去可由上下文理解的词语；在几何中，椭圆是具有两个焦点的闭合曲线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk ellissi tfisser forma jew kliem imħolli barra? Mark: Qed naqraw dwar il-grammatika, allura tfisser kliem imħolli barra li xorta nifhmuh mill-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does ellissi mean a shape here or words left out? Mark: We are reading about grammar, so it means words left out that we still understand from context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的ellissi是指一种形状，还是省去的词语？Mark：我们读的是语法内容，所以指省去但仍能从上下文理解的词语。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ellissi tfisser forma jew kliem imħolli barra?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ellissi tfisser forma jew kliem imħolli barra?
messages.zh: 这里的ellissi是指一种形状，还是省去的词语？
messages.en: Does ellissi mean a shape here or words left out?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqraw dwar il-grammatika, allura tfisser kliem imħolli barra li xorta nifhmuh mill-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqraw dwar il-grammatika, allura tfisser kliem imħolli barra li xorta nifhmuh mill-kuntest.
messages.zh: 我们读的是语法内容，所以指省去但仍能从上下文理解的词语。
messages.en: We are reading about grammar, so it means words left out that we still understand from context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张双面词卡：一面写省去词语的句子，另一面画有两个焦点的椭圆；遇到本词先看语言还是几何语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak or write with high praise about someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或文字高度赞扬某人或某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifaħħar ħafna lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa bil-kliem jew bil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颂扬；以赞词或赞颂性的言辞称赞。

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, id-direttur eloġja l-ħidma tal-voluntiera.
formal.en: In his speech, the director paid high tribute to the volunteers' work.
formal.zh: 主任在讲话中高度赞扬了志愿者的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal l-għalliem dwar il-proġett? Mark: Eloġja x-xogħol tagħna u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the teacher say about the project? Mark: He praised our work highly and said it was very clear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师怎么评价这个项目？马克：他高度赞扬了我们的成果，说内容非常清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 老师怎么评价这个项目？
messages.en: What did the teacher say about the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Eloġja x-xogħol tagħna u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Eloġja x-xogħol tagħna u qal li kien ċar ħafna.
messages.zh: 他高度赞扬了我们的成果，说内容非常清楚。
messages.en: He praised our work highly and said it was very clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eloġja 联想到站起来致辞赞扬的动作：重点是“开口颂扬”，用动作画面记住动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of high praise, or a speech praising someone, especially someone who has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 高度赞扬的言辞，也指赞颂某人的讲话，尤其是纪念逝者的悼词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifħir kbir jew diskors li jfaħħar lil xi ħadd, speċjalment lil persuna li mietet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞词；颂辞；悼词；赞扬。

formal.mt: L-artiklu kien eloġju lill-għalliema li ddedikaw ħajjithom għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The article was a tribute to the teachers who dedicated their lives to education.
formal.zh: 这篇文章赞颂了那些毕生投身教育的教师。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bagħtitlek dik l-ittra l-klijent? Pawlu: Kienet eloġju għas-servizz tagħna; feraħlitni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the customer send you that letter? Pawlu: It was full of praise for our service; it made me very happy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：顾客为什么给你寄那封信？保罗：那封信是在赞扬我们的服务，让我很开心。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 顾客为什么给你寄那封信？
messages.en: Why did the customer send you that letter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet eloġju għas-servizz tagħna; feraħlitni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet eloġju għas-servizz tagħna; feraħlitni ħafna.
messages.zh: 那封信是在赞扬我们的服务，让我很开心。
messages.en: It was full of praise for our service; it made me very happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eloġju 想成一篇写好的赞词：它是“赞扬的内容”这个名词；遇到葬礼语境时可理解为悼词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To escape or avoid someone or something, often by acting cleverly or indirectly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 常通过巧妙或间接的方式，躲开某人或逃避某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħrab jew jevita lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, spiss b'mod għaqli jew indirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躲开；逃脱；逃避或规避。

formal.mt: Waqt l-intervista, il-kelliem eluda l-mistoqsija dwar l-ispejjeż tal-proġett.
formal.en: During the interview, the spokesperson evaded the question about the project's costs.
formal.zh: 发言人在采访中回避了有关项目费用的问题。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qallek għaliex wasal tard? Ġanni: Le, eluda l-mistoqsija u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did he tell you why he arrived late? Ġanni: No, he evaded the question and started talking about the weather.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他告诉你为什么迟到了吗？詹尼：没有，他回避了问题，开始聊天气。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他告诉你为什么迟到了吗？
messages.en: Did he tell you why he arrived late?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, eluda l-mistoqsija u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp.
messages.mt_standard: Le, eluda l-mistoqsija u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp.
messages.zh: 没有，他回避了问题，开始聊天气。
messages.en: No, he evaded the question and started talking about the weather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 eluda 时想象一个人侧身绕开迎面而来的问题；同一“躲开”画面也能帮助记住躲避追捕的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an idea, statement, or problem clearer by explaining it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过解释，使某个观点、陈述或问题变得清楚易懂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel idea, stqarrija jew problema aktar ċara billi jispjegaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阐明；说明；把意思解释清楚。

collocations.en: elucidated the meaning of the text
collocations.zh: 解释清楚了文本的含义

formal.mt: Il-professur eluċida l-kunċett permezz ta' żewġ eżempji sempliċi.
formal.en: The professor elucidated the concept using two simple examples.
formal.zh: 教授用两个简单的例子阐明了这个概念。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Issa fhimt dak il-paragrafu? David: Iva, l-għalliem eluċida t-tifsira tiegħu b'eżempju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you understand that paragraph now? David: Yes, the teacher clarified its meaning with an example.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：现在你看懂那个段落了吗？戴维：看懂了，老师用一个例子解释清楚了它的意思。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 现在你看懂那个段落了吗？
messages.en: Do you understand that paragraph now?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għalliem eluċida t-tifsira tiegħu b'eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għalliem eluċida t-tifsira tiegħu b'eżempju.
messages.zh: 看懂了，老师用一个例子解释清楚了它的意思。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher clarified its meaning with an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 eluċida 时想象老师把模糊概念逐步讲清楚；抓住“解释后变明白”的动作，不只记成一般的说话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An explanation or act of explanation that makes something clearer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事更加清楚的解释、说明，或进行这种解释的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni jew att ta' spjegazzjoni li jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阐释；阐明；使意思清楚的解释或说明。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi eluċidazzjoni dettaljata tal-metodu użat fl-istudju.
formal.en: The report includes a detailed elucidation of the method used in the study.
formal.zh: 报告详细阐释了研究所采用的方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif sibt in-nota tal-għalliem? Adam: Utli ħafna; fiha eluċidazzjoni tal-punt li ma fhimtx.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you find the teacher's note? Adam: Very useful; it contains an explanation of the point I didn't understand.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得老师的那则说明怎么样？亚当：很有用，里面解释了我没弄懂的那个要点。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得老师的那则说明怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the teacher's note?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Utli ħafna; fiha eluċidazzjoni tal-punt li ma fhimtx.
messages.mt_standard: Utli ħafna; fiha eluċidazzjoni tal-punt li ma fhimtx.
messages.zh: 很有用，里面解释了我没弄懂的那个要点。
messages.en: Very useful; it contains an explanation of the point I didn't understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eluċidazzjoni 记成笔记本里那段“讲清楚的说明”；与 eluċida 对照，一个表示阐释内容或过程，一个表示阐明动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come or spread out from a source, as light, heat, or a smell does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像光、热或气味一样，从某个来源发出或向外散开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ jew jinfirex minn sors, bħad-dawl, is-sħana jew ir-riħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出；散发；从某个来源向外散出。

collocations.en: the light emanated from the lamp

formal.mt: Dawl aħmar emana mill-apparat waqt l-esperiment.
formal.en: Red light emanated from the device during the experiment.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，装置发出了红光。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Minn fejn ġie dak id-dawl blu? Ben: Emana minn dik il-lampa żgħira fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did that blue light come from? Ben: It came from that little lamp on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那道蓝光是从哪里来的？本：是架子上那盏小灯发出来的。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġie dak id-dawl blu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġie dak id-dawl blu?
messages.zh: 那道蓝光是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did that blue light come from?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Emana minn dik il-lampa żgħira fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Emana minn dik il-lampa żgħira fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 是架子上那盏小灯发出来的。
messages.en: It came from that little lamp on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 emana 想成灯光从中心向四周散开的画面；连同 minn“从”一起记住“从某处发出”的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The release or spreading of something from a source, or something that comes from that source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物从源头发出、散开的过程，也指从该源头散发出来的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ jew it-tixrid ta' xi ħaġa minn sors, jew xi ħaġa li toħroġ minn dak is-sors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散发；发散；从某个来源散发出的东西。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-emanazzjoni ta' sħana mill-wiċċ tal-materjal.
formal.en: The study describes the emanation of heat from the material's surface.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了材料表面散发热量的过程。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi tfisser 'emanazzjoni ta' sħana' f'dan il-ktieb? Leo: Tfisser li s-sħana toħroġ minn xi ħaġa, bħal minn radjatur.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'emanation of heat' mean in this book? Leo: It means heat comes out of something, such as a radiator.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这本书里的“热的散发”是什么意思？利奥：就是说热量从某个东西里散出来，比如暖气片。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'emanazzjoni ta' sħana' f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'emanazzjoni ta' sħana' f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里的“热的散发”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'emanation of heat' mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Leo (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li s-sħana toħroġ minn xi ħaġa, bħal minn radjatur.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li s-sħana toħroġ minn xi ħaġa, bħal minn radjatur.
messages.zh: 就是说热量从某个东西里散出来，比如暖气片。
messages.en: It means heat comes out of something, such as a radiator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 emanazzjoni 记成暖气片周围散出的热：既可关注“散发的过程”，也可关注“散出来的东西”，用名词画面固定含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To free someone from control, oppression, or restrictions on their freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人摆脱控制、压迫或对其自由的限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles lil xi ħadd mill-kontroll, mill-oppressjoni jew minn restrizzjonijiet fuq il-libertà tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解放；使摆脱控制、压迫或束缚。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-moviment emanċipa lill-ħaddiema mill-kontroll tas-sidien.
formal.en: In the novel, the movement emancipated the workers from the owners' control.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，这场运动使工人摆脱了雇主的控制。

colloquial.mt: Mila: X'għamel il-moviment fl-istorja li qrajna? Samwel: Emanċipa lill-ħaddiema; fl-aħħar setgħu jagħmlu l-għażliet tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Mila: What did the movement do in the story we read? Samwel: It emancipated the workers; they could finally make their own choices.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：在我们读的故事里，那场运动起了什么作用？萨姆韦尔：它解放了工人，他们终于能自己作选择了。

messages.speaker: Mila (同学)
messages.zh: 在我们读的故事里，那场运动起了什么作用？
messages.en: What did the movement do in the story we read?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Emanċipa lill-ħaddiema; fl-aħħar setgħu jagħmlu l-għażliet tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Emanċipa lill-ħaddiema; fl-aħħar setgħu jagħmlu l-għażliet tagħhom.
messages.zh: 它解放了工人，他们终于能自己作选择了。
messages.en: It emancipated the workers; they could finally make their own choices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 emanċipa 时想象束缚被解开、人能够自主选择；把“使别人获得自由”作为核心动作来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push someone outside a group's social life or activities, leaving them isolated or excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人排斥在群体的交往或活动之外，使其受到孤立或被边缘化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Warrab lil xi ħadd mill-ħajja jew mill-attivitajiet ta' grupp, b'mod li jħossu iżolat jew eskluż.

sense_translations.en_definition: to marginalize, to isolate, to exclude from a community
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使边缘化，使孤立，或将某人排斥在社群之外。

formal.mt: Il-klabb emarġina lill-membri l-ġodda billi ma stedinhomx għal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The club marginalized the new members by not inviting them to meetings.
formal.zh: 俱乐部没有邀请新成员参加会议，使他们受到排斥。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Mark waqaf jiġi? Pawlu: Il-grupp emarġina lil Mark, u issa ma jħossux milqugħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why has Mark stopped coming? Pawlu: The group excluded Mark, and now he doesn't feel welcome.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克为什么不再来了？保罗：这个群体排斥了马克，现在他觉得自己不受欢迎。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不再来了？
messages.en: Why has Mark stopped coming?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp emarġina lil Mark, u issa ma jħossux milqugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp emarġina lil Mark, u issa ma jħossux milqugħ.
messages.zh: 这个群体排斥了马克，现在他觉得自己不受欢迎。
messages.en: The group excluded Mark, and now he doesn't feel welcome.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家围坐交谈，却把一个人留在圈外；用这幅画面记住“使边缘化、排斥”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be changed or corrected, especially when describing a text, proposal, or agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以进行修改或纠正的，尤其用于描述文本、提案或协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinbidel jew jiġi kkoreġut, speċjalment meta jkun test, proposta jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可修订的；可以修改或纠正的。

formal.mt: Dan l-abbozz huwa emendabbli, u l-kumitat jista' jipproponi tibdil qabel il-vot.
formal.en: This draft is amendable, and the committee can propose changes before the vote.
formal.zh: 这份草案可以修订，委员会可以在表决前提出修改建议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-test għadu emendabbli? Luqa: Iva, għadek tista' tbiddel l-aħħar paragrafu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this text still amendable? Luqa: Yes, you can still change the last paragraph.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份文本还可以修改吗？卢卡：可以，你还可以修改最后一段。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这份文本还可以修改吗？
messages.en: Is this text still amendable?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadek tista' tbiddel l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadek tista' tbiddel l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.zh: 可以，你还可以修改最后一段。
messages.en: Yes, you can still change the last paragraph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在一份仍能修改的草稿上，提醒自己这是描述“可修订状态”的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change made or proposed to a law, document, or proposal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对法律、文件或提案已经作出或正式提出的修改，也可指具体的修正案或修订条款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li ssir jew tiġi proposta f'liġi, dokument jew proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修正案；修订条款；对法律、文件或提案所作的修改。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva emendament biex jestendi l-perjodu ta' konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee approved an amendment to extend the consultation period.
formal.zh: 委员会通过了一项修正案，延长意见征询期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jibdel dan l-emendament? David: Jagħtina ġimgħa oħra biex nibagħtu l-kummenti tagħna.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does this amendment change? David: It gives us another week to send in our comments.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这项修正案改了什么？戴维：它让我们多一周时间提交意见。

messages.speaker: Anna (协会成员)
messages.zh: 这项修正案改了什么？
messages.en: What does this amendment change?

messages.speaker: David (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħtina ġimgħa oħra biex nibagħtu l-kummenti tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħtina ġimgħa oħra biex nibagħtu l-kummenti tagħna.
messages.zh: 它让我们多一周时间提交意见。
messages.en: It gives us another week to send in our comments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌上一张等待表决的修改条款，用“提出、通过修正案”的场景记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A correction or revision of a text, especially one made to remove an error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对文本进行的订正或修订，尤其指为消除错误而作出的文字修改。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Korrezzjoni jew reviżjoni ta' test, speċjalment biex jitneħħa żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文本的订正或校订；为纠正错误而作出的修订。

formal.mt: L-editur għamel emendazzjoni fit-test biex jikkoreġi data żbaljata.
formal.en: The editor made an emendation to the text to correct an incorrect date.
formal.zh: 编辑对文本作了一处订正，纠正了一个错误日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm nota ħdejn din il-kelma? Toni: Tispjega emendazzjoni; fil-manuskritt il-kelma kienet miktuba ħażin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a note beside this word? Toni: It explains an emendation; the word was misspelled in the manuscript.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个词旁边为什么有一条注释？托尼：它是在说明一处订正；手稿里这个词拼错了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm nota ħdejn din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm nota ħdejn din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 这个词旁边为什么有一条注释？
messages.en: Why is there a note beside this word?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tispjega emendazzjoni; fil-manuskritt il-kelma kienet miktuba ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Tispjega emendazzjoni; fil-manuskritt il-kelma kienet miktuba ħażin.
messages.zh: 它是在说明一处订正；手稿里这个词拼错了。
messages.en: It explains an emendation; the word was misspelled in the manuscript.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编辑用红笔改正文稿中的错字，把这个词与“文本校订、纠正错误”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off light from a source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某个光源向外发出光线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ dawl minn sors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出光；向外放射光线。

formal.mt: Id-dijodu emetta dawl aħmar meta għadda l-kurrent elettriku.
formal.en: The diode emitted red light when an electric current passed through it.
formal.zh: 电流通过二极管时，它发出了红光。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt dak id-dawl blu? Mark: Iva, l-apparat emetta dawl blu meta xgħeltu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you see that blue light? Mark: Yes, the device emitted blue light when I switched it on.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看到那道蓝光了吗？马克：看到了，我打开设备时，它发出了蓝光。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那道蓝光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that blue light?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-apparat emetta dawl blu meta xgħeltu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-apparat emetta dawl blu meta xgħeltu.
messages.zh: 看到了，我打开设备时，它发出了蓝光。
messages.en: Yes, the device emitted blue light when I switched it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象按下开关后设备向外发出一道光，记住这里的动作是“发光、放射光线”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of leaving one's country to live in another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开自己的国家，到另一个国家居住的行为或过程，着重于从原居国迁出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tluq minn pajjiżek biex tmur tgħix f'pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移居国外；从本国迁往外国居住的行为或过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-raġunijiet għall-emigrazzjoni taż-żgħażagħ lejn pajjiżi oħra.
formal.en: The study examines the reasons for young people's emigration to other countries.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察年轻人移居其他国家的原因。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex qed taħseb fl-emigrazzjoni? Ġanni: Irrid immur ngħix ħdejn oħti, li toqgħod barra minn Malta.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you thinking about emigrating? Ġanni: I want to live near my sister, who lives outside Malta.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么在考虑移居国外？詹尼：我想搬到姐姐附近生活，她住在马耳他以外的地方。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在考虑移居国外？
messages.en: Why are you thinking about emigrating?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid immur ngħix ħdejn oħti, li toqgħod barra minn Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid immur ngħix ħdejn oħti, li toqgħod barra minn Malta.
messages.zh: 我想搬到姐姐附近生活，她住在马耳他以外的地方。
messages.en: I want to live near my sister, who lives outside Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从本国指向外国的箭头，旁边放上搬家行李，记住这个词强调“迁出本国”。

gloss_zh: 使者；特使；受派遣的代表

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person sent to deliver a message or carry out a mission on behalf of someone or a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受某人或某个团体派遣，负责传递信息或执行特定任务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mibgħuta biex twassal messaġġ jew twettaq missjoni f'isem xi ħadd jew xi grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使者；特使；代表他人或团体传递信息、执行任务的受派遣者。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill bagħat emissarju biex iwassal il-proposta tiegħu lill-organizzaturi.
formal.en: The council sent an emissary to convey its proposal to the organizers.
formal.zh: 委员会派出一名使者，向主办方转达其提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem mal-kumitat? Pietru: Dak emissarju tal-klabb; ġie biex iwassal il-proposta tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that person talking to the committee? Pietru: He's an emissary from the club; he came to convey our proposal.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个正在跟委员会交谈的人是谁？彼得：他是俱乐部派来的代表，来转达我们的提议。

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem mal-kumitat?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem mal-kumitat?
messages.zh: 那个正在跟委员会交谈的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person talking to the committee?

messages.speaker: Pietru (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak emissarju tal-klabb; ġie biex iwassal il-proposta tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak emissarju tal-klabb; ġie biex iwassal il-proposta tagħna.
messages.zh: 他是俱乐部派来的代表，来转达我们的提议。
messages.en: He's an emissary from the club; he came to convey our proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人带着团体的提议前去交涉，记住“被派去传话办事的人”就是使者。

gloss_zh: 激起情感的；富有情感感染力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing or arousing strong feelings, especially through language or presentation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达或激起强烈情感的，尤其用于描述语言或表达方式的情感感染力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi jew iqanqal sentimenti qawwija, speċjalment permezz tal-lingwaġġ jew tal-mod kif tiġi ppreżentata xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起情感的；表达强烈情感或具有情感感染力的。

collocations.zh: 富有情感感染力的语言

formal.mt: L-awtur uża lingwaġġ emotiv biex iqanqal il-kompassjoni tal-qarrejja.
formal.en: The author used emotive language to arouse the readers' compassion.
formal.zh: 作者使用富有情感感染力的语言，激起读者的同情心。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dan ir-reklam messni daqshekk? Simon: Juża lingwaġġ emotiv u mużika li tqanqal is-sentimenti.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did this advert move me so much? Simon: It uses emotive language and music that stirs feelings.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个广告为什么这么打动我？西蒙：它用了富有情感感染力的语言和触动情绪的音乐。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个广告为什么这么打动我？
messages.en: Why did this advert move me so much?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Juża lingwaġġ emotiv u mużika li tqanqal is-sentimenti.
messages.mt_standard: Juża lingwaġġ emotiv u mużika li tqanqal is-sentimenti.
messages.zh: 它用了富有情感感染力的语言和触动情绪的音乐。
messages.en: It uses emotive language and music that stirs feelings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段演说让听众感动落泪，把这个形容词与“语言能够激起情感”的效果联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel a strong emotion, especially by touching their feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生强烈情绪，尤其指触动感情、使人感动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem emozzjoni qawwija f'xi ħadd, speċjalment billi jmisslu qalbu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to move, to arouse the feelings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使感动；唤起或激发感情。

formal.mt: Id-diskors tat-tabib emozzjona lill-udjenza meta rrakkonta kif salva lit-tifel.
formal.en: The doctor's speech moved the audience when he described how he had saved the boy.
formal.zh: 医生讲述自己如何救下那个男孩时，他的演讲感动了观众。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-filmat emozzjona lil kulħadd. Mark: Veru, speċjalment meta t-tifla reġgħet rat lil ommha.
colloquial.en: Maja: That video moved everyone. Mark: It really did, especially when the girl saw her mother again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个视频把大家都感动了。马克：确实，尤其是女孩再次见到妈妈的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个视频把大家都感动了。
messages.en: That video moved everyone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, speċjalment meta t-tifla reġgħet rat lil ommha.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, speċjalment meta t-tifla reġgħet rat lil ommha.
messages.zh: 确实，尤其是女孩再次见到妈妈的时候。
messages.en: It really did, especially when the girl saw her mother again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段重逢视频让全场眼眶湿润，把 emozzjona 记成“某件事触动了某人的感情”这一动作。

gloss_zh: 情绪主义；感情用事的倾向

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendency to give emotions excessive importance, especially when forming judgments or expressing opinions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分强调情绪作用的倾向，尤其指判断或表达意见时容易感情用事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza li tingħata importanza żejda lill-emozzjonijiet, speċjalment fil-ġudizzji jew fl-espressjoni tal-opinjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情绪主义；过分强调感情或容易感情用事的倾向。

formal.mt: L-awtur iwissi li l-emozzjonaliżmu jista' jwassal għal ġudizzji li ma jqisux il-fatti kollha.
formal.en: The author warns that emotionalism can lead to judgments that do not consider all the facts.
formal.zh: 作者警告说，感情用事可能使人在判断时未能考虑全部事实。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjaħt dak id-diskors emozzjonaliżmu? Pawlu: Għax kien mimli sentimenti, iżda ftit li xejn ta fatti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you call that speech emotionalism? Pawlu: Because it was full of feeling, but offered hardly any facts.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说那番话是感情用事？保罗：因为里面全是情绪，却几乎没有提供事实。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说那番话是感情用事？
messages.en: Why did you call that speech emotionalism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien mimli sentimenti, iżda ftit li xejn ta fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien mimli sentimenti, iżda ftit li xejn ta fatti.
messages.zh: 因为里面全是情绪，却几乎没有提供事实。
messages.en: Because it was full of feeling, but offered hardly any facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论时有人把情绪音量开得很大，却把事实声音调得很小，用这个画面记住“情绪主义、感情用事的倾向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that concerns a person's emotions or emotional state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从情感或情绪状态方面来说；用来说明某人在情绪上如何受到影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jirrigwarda l-emozzjonijiet jew l-istat emozzjonali ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在情感上；在情绪方面；带着感情地。

formal.mt: Il-bidla fl-iskola kienet emozzjonalment diffiċli għat-tifel, iżda l-appoġġ tal-familja għenu jadatta.
formal.en: Changing schools was emotionally difficult for the boy, but his family's support helped him adapt.
formal.zh: 转学让这个男孩在情绪上很难适应，但家人的支持帮助他逐渐适应了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qed tħossok wara dik il-ġimgħa? Nina: Fiżikament tajba, imma emozzjonalment għajjiena.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you feeling after that week? Nina: Physically fine, but emotionally tired.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：经历了那一周，你现在感觉怎么样？妮娜：身体还好，但情绪上很疲惫。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok wara dik il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok wara dik il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 经历了那一周，你现在感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after that week?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 身体还好，但情绪上很疲惫。
messages.en: Physically fine, but emotionally tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“身体上还好，情绪上很累”分成两栏，emozzjonalment 放在情绪那一栏，提醒自己它说明的是“在哪个方面”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing strong feelings, such as excitement, sympathy, or deep emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够引起激动、共鸣或深切感情的；形容令人动情的事物或经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem sentimenti qawwija, bħal eċċitament, simpatija jew emozzjoni profonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感人的；令人兴奋或激动的；令人动情的。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jirrakkonta storja emozzjonanti dwar żewġ aħwa li jerġgħu jiltaqgħu wara ħafna snin.
formal.en: The novel tells a moving story about two siblings who meet again after many years.
formal.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个感人的故事：一对兄弟姐妹在多年后重逢。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt il-finali lbieraħ? Maja: Iva, kienet emozzjonanti sal-aħħar sekonda!
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you watch the final yesterday? Maja: Yes, it was exciting right up to the last second!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你昨天看决赛了吗？玛雅：看了，直到最后一秒都让人激动！

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天看决赛了吗？
messages.en: Did you watch the final yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 看了，直到最后一秒都让人激动！
messages.en: Yes, it was exciting right up to the last second!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记同一个形容词：重逢故事令人感动，决赛最后一秒令人激动；两者都可以是 emozzjonanti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To follow someone's example or reproduce their achievements, often with the aim of matching or surpassing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以他人为榜样，效仿其做法或成就，常带有努力赶上或超过对方的目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi fuq l-eżempju ta' xi ħadd jew jipprova jikseb suċċess bħalu, spiss biex jilħqu jew jaqbżu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效仿；以某人为榜样，努力达到或超过其水平；仿真其功能或行为。

collocations.zh: 以哥哥或弟弟为榜样取得了类似的成功

formal.mt: Il-pittur żagħżugħ emula l-istil tal-għalliem tiegħu qabel ma żviluppa stil personali.
formal.en: The young painter emulated his teacher's style before developing a personal style.
formal.zh: 这位年轻画家先效仿老师的风格，后来才形成自己的风格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tistudja l-logħob ta' dik iċ-ċampjin? Lara: Irrid nemula l-mod kif taħseb waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you studying that champion's play? Lara: I want to emulate the way she thinks during a game.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么在研究那位冠军的下法？拉拉：我想效仿她在对局中的思考方式。

messages.speaker: Sara (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistudja l-logħob ta' dik iċ-ċampjin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistudja l-logħob ta' dik iċ-ċampjin?
messages.zh: 你为什么在研究那位冠军的下法？
messages.en: Why are you studying that champion's play?

messages.speaker: Lara (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nemula l-mod kif taħseb waqt il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nemula l-mod kif taħseb waqt il-logħba.
messages.zh: 我想效仿她在对局中的思考方式。
messages.en: I want to emulate the way she thinks during a game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学生观察冠军的思考方式，学着做并希望赶上她；用“以榜样为目标去效仿”的动作记住 emula。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seeks to match another by following their example, or a system that reproduces the operation of another system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过效仿他人而力求赶上对方的人；也指再现另一系统运行方式的仿真器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li timxi fuq l-eżempju ta' oħra biex tilħaqha, jew sistema li tirriproduċi l-funzjonament ta' sistema oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效仿者；力求赶上他人的人；仿真器或模拟器。

formal.mt: L-emulatur jippermetti lill-istudenti josservaw kif kien jaħdem kompjuter antik.
formal.en: The emulator allows students to observe how an old computer worked.
formal.zh: 这个仿真器让学生能够观察旧式计算机的运行方式。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif qed tilgħab dik il-logħba antika fuq il-kompjuter? Mark: Qed nuża emulatur ta' konsol.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How are you playing that old game on the computer? Mark: I'm using a console emulator.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你怎么在电脑上玩那个老游戏？马克：我在用游戏主机仿真器。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tilgħab dik il-logħba antika fuq il-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tilgħab dik il-logħba antika fuq il-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 你怎么在电脑上玩那个老游戏？
messages.en: How are you playing that old game on the computer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在用游戏主机仿真器。
messages.en: I'm using a console emulator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电脑里有一台“虚拟老游戏机”，它承担模仿原设备运行的角色；把 emulatur 记成承担效仿或仿真任务的人或工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of following an example to match an achievement, or reproducing the operation of another system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过效仿榜样而争取达到相同成就的过程；也指再现另一系统运行方式的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li wieħed jimxi fuq eżempju biex jikseb riżultat simili, jew li jirriproduċi l-funzjonament ta' sistema oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 效仿；以赶上榜样为目标的模仿；对系统功能或行为的仿真。

formal.mt: L-emulazzjoni ta' sistema antika tippermetti li programmi maħsuba għaliha jitħaddmu fuq kompjuter modern.
formal.en: Emulation of an old system allows programs designed for it to run on a modern computer.
formal.zh: 对旧系统进行仿真，可以让为该系统设计的程序在现代计算机上运行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-emulazzjoni taħdem tajjeb? Pawlu: Iva, il-logħba taħdem kważi bħalma kienet fuq il-konsol l-antik.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this emulation work well? Pawlu: Yes, the game runs almost as it did on the old console.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个仿真效果好吗？保罗：好，游戏运行起来几乎和在旧主机上时一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个仿真效果好吗？
messages.en: Does this emulation work well?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-logħba taħdem kważi bħalma kienet fuq il-konsol l-antik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-logħba taħdem kważi bħalma kienet fuq il-konsol l-antik.
messages.zh: 好，游戏运行起来几乎和在旧主机上时一样。
messages.en: Yes, the game runs almost as it did on the old console.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“工具”和“过程”配对记：emulatur 是执行仿真的工具，emulazzjoni 是仿真这一过程；也可用来理解效仿榜样的过程。

gloss_zh: 力求赶上的；竞相效仿的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eager to equal or surpass another person, especially by following their example.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 渴望通过效仿他人的榜样而赶上或超过对方的；具有竞争进取心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħerqan li jilħaq jew jaqbeż lil ħaddieħor, speċjalment billi jimxi fuq l-eżempju tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渴望与他人比肩或超过他人的；竞相效仿的；有争胜心的。

collocations.zh: 一名力求赶上榜样的学生
争取比肩或超越他人的精神

formal.mt: L-istudent emulu osserva bir-reqqa x-xogħol tal-aqwa sħabu u ħadem biex jilħaq il-livell tagħhom.
formal.en: The emulous student carefully observed the work of his best classmates and worked to reach their level.
formal.zh: 这名力求上进的学生仔细观察最优秀的同学的作品，努力达到他们的水平。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tifhem bi student emulu? Mark: Student li jieħu lil ħaddieħor bħala eżempju u jistinka biex jilħqu jew jaqbżu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you mean by an emulous student? Mark: A student who takes someone else as an example and strives to equal or surpass them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你说学生 emulu 是什么意思？马克：就是以别人为榜样，努力赶上或超过对方的学生。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 你说学生 emulu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by an emulous student?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Student li jieħu lil ħaddieħor bħala eżempju u jistinka biex jilħqu jew jaqbżu.
messages.mt_standard: Student li jieħu lil ħaddieħor bħala eżempju u jistinka biex jilħqu jew jaqbżu.
messages.zh: 就是以别人为榜样，努力赶上或超过对方的学生。
messages.en: A student who takes someone else as an example and strives to equal or surpass them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学生望着优秀同学，心想“我要学他的长处，还要赶上他”；emulu 描写这种竞相效仿、力求比肩的态度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与子宫内膜相似的组织生长在子宫以外部位的一种疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha tessut simili għall-kisja ta' ġewwa tal-utru jikber barra mill-utru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 子宫内膜异位症

collocations.zh: 子宫内膜异位症的诊断
关于子宫内膜异位症的研究

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega x'inhi l-endometrijożi b'lingwa ċara u aċċessibbli.
formal.en: The article explains what endometriosis is in clear, accessible language.
formal.zh: 这篇文章用清楚易懂的语言解释了什么是子宫内膜异位症。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma endometrijożi? Rita: Hija kundizzjoni li fiha tessut simili għall-kisja ta' ġewwa tal-utru jikber barra mill-utru.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word endometriosis mean? Rita: It is a condition in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：子宫内膜异位症这个词是什么意思？丽塔：它是指与子宫内膜相似的组织生长在子宫以外部位的一种疾病。

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.zh: 子宫内膜异位症这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word endometriosis mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kundizzjoni li fiha tessut simili għall-kisja ta' ġewwa tal-utru jikber barra mill-utru.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kundizzjoni li fiha tessut simili għall-kisja ta' ġewwa tal-utru jikber barra mill-utru.
messages.zh: 它是指与子宫内膜相似的组织生长在子宫以外部位的一种疾病。
messages.en: It is a condition in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词配上一幅示意图：与子宫内膜相似的组织出现在子宫外，帮助记住对应的疾病名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express approval of or support for a person, proposal, or idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示认可或支持某个人、提议或观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi approvazzjoni jew appoġġ għal persuna, proposta jew idea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认可；支持；表示赞同

collocations.zh: 表态支持了这位候选人

formal.mt: Il-kumitat endorsja l-proposta wara diskussjoni dwar il-benefiċċji tagħha.
formal.en: The committee endorsed the proposal after a discussion of its benefits.
formal.zh: 委员会在讨论了这项提议的益处后表示支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark endorsja l-proposta tagħna? Toni: Iva, qal li jaqbel magħha u li se jappoġġjaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark endorse our proposal? Toni: Yes, he said he agrees with it and will support it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克表态支持我们的提议了吗？托尼：是的，他说他赞同这个提议，而且会支持它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克表态支持我们的提议了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark endorse our proposal?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li jaqbel magħha u li se jappoġġjaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li jaqbel magħha u li se jappoġġjaha.
messages.zh: 是的，他说他赞同这个提议，而且会支持它。
messages.en: Yes, he said he agrees with it and will support it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会时有人举手说“我支持这项提议”，把 endorsja 与明确表态认可的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of energy, including its transfer and transformation in systems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究能量及其在系统中传递和转化的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-enerġija, inklużi t-trasferiment u t-trasformazzjoni tagħha fis-sistemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能量学；研究能量传递和转化的学科

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu dwar l-enerġetika jispjega kif l-enerġija tiġi trasferita u trasformata f'sistema.
formal.en: The chapter on energetics explains how energy is transferred and transformed in a system.
formal.zh: 关于能量学的这一章解释了能量如何在系统中传递和转化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tistudjaw fil-lezzjoni tal-enerġetika? Pawlu: Kif l-enerġija tgħaddi minn sistema għal oħra u kif tinbidel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you study in the energetics lesson? Pawlu: How energy passes from one system to another and how it changes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们在能量学课上学什么？保罗：学能量怎样从一个系统传到另一个系统，以及它怎样发生转化。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你们在能量学课上学什么？
