messages.en: What do you study in the energetics lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif l-enerġija tgħaddi minn sistema għal oħra u kif tinbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Kif l-enerġija tgħaddi minn sistema għal oħra u kif tinbidel.
messages.zh: 学能量怎样从一个系统传到另一个系统，以及它怎样发生转化。
messages.en: How energy passes from one system to another and how it changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 enerġetika 想成一本讲能量流动和转化的课本；此处记的是学科名词“能量学”。

gloss_zh: 精力充沛地；积极有力地

teaching_sense.en_definition: With energy, enthusiasm, or vigorous effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以充满精力、热情或积极用力的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ħafna enerġija, ħeġġa jew sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精力充沛地；积极有力地；充满干劲地

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera ħadmu enerġikament biex ilestu t-tħejjijiet għall-avveniment.
formal.en: The volunteers worked energetically to complete the preparations for the event.
formal.zh: 志愿者们干劲十足地工作，完成活动的准备工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara lil Toni, qed jiżfen enerġikament! Lara: Iva, għadu ma waqafx minn meta bdiet il-mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at Toni, he's dancing energetically! Lara: Yes, he hasn't stopped since the music started.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看托尼，他跳得真有活力！拉拉：是啊，从音乐开始他就一直没停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara lil Toni, qed jiżfen enerġikament!
messages.mt_standard: Ara lil Toni, qed jiżfen enerġikament!
messages.zh: 看托尼，他跳得真有活力！
messages.en: Look at Toni, he's dancing energetically!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu ma waqafx minn meta bdiet il-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu ma waqafx minn meta bdiet il-mużika.
messages.zh: 是啊，从音乐开始他就一直没停。
messages.en: Yes, he hasn't stopped since the music started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人跳舞时全身充满活力，用 enerġikament 回答“他怎样跳”，记住它修饰动作。

gloss_zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having or showing a lot of energy, activity, or enthusiasm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有或表现出充足精力、活力或热情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jew juri ħafna enerġija, attività jew ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精力充沛的；充满活力的；有干劲的

collocations.zh: 一位充满干劲的领导者

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur enerġiku ħeġġeġ lit-tim biex jipparteċipa b'mod attiv fil-proġett.
formal.en: The energetic coordinator encouraged the team to participate actively in the project.
formal.zh: 这位充满干劲的协调员鼓励团队积极参与项目。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ibnek dejjem daqshekk enerġiku? Mark: Iva, anki wara l-iskola jkun irid jiġri u jilgħab.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is your son always this energetic? Mark: Yes, even after school he wants to run and play.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你儿子总是这么精力充沛吗？马克：是啊，就连放学后他也还想跑跑跳跳地玩。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你儿子总是这么精力充沛吗？
messages.en: Is your son always this energetic?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, anki wara l-iskola jkun irid jiġri u jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, anki wara l-iskola jkun irid jiġri u jilgħab.
messages.zh: 是啊，就连放学后他也还想跑跑跳跳地玩。
messages.en: Yes, even after school he wants to run and play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一个跑完还想继续玩的男孩贴上 enerġiku 标签，记住这是形容人精力充沛的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone or something more energy, enthusiasm, or drive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某事物获得更多活力、热情或动力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti aktar enerġija, ħeġġa jew spinta lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使充满活力；使振奋；激发干劲

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal-kowċ enerġizza lit-tim qabel il-partita finali.
formal.en: The coach's speech energized the team before the final match.
formal.zh: 教练的讲话让团队在决赛前振奋起来。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Dak id-diskors enerġizza lit-tim kollu! Maja: Veru, issa kulħadd ħerqan biex jibda.
colloquial.en: Toni: That speech energized the whole team! Maja: True, now everyone is eager to get started.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：那番讲话让整个团队都振奋起来了！玛雅：确实，现在大家都迫不及待地想开始。

messages.speaker: Toni (队员)
messages.zh: 那番讲话让整个团队都振奋起来了！
messages.en: That speech energized the whole team!

messages.speaker: Maja (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa kulħadd ħerqan biex jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa kulħadd ħerqan biex jibda.
messages.zh: 确实，现在大家都迫不及待地想开始。
messages.en: True, now everyone is eager to get started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练一句鼓励让全队立刻有了干劲，用 enerġizza 记住“使别人充满活力”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a strong, clear way that stresses a point or expresses a firm position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以强烈明确的方式强调某个要点或表达坚定立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod qawwi u ċar li jenfasizza punt jew jesprimi pożizzjoni soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强调地；坚决地；以明确有力的方式

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ċaħad enfatikament l-allegazzjoni waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: The spokesperson emphatically denied the allegation during the conference.
formal.zh: 发言人在会议期间坚决否认了这项指控。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għedt 'le' daqshekk enfatikament? Mark: Għax ridt li jkun ċar li ma naqbilx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you say 'no' so emphatically? Mark: Because I wanted to make it clear that I disagree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把“不”说得那么坚决？马克：因为我想明确表达我不同意。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把“不”说得那么坚决？
messages.en: Why did you say 'no' so emphatically?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ridt li jkun ċar li ma naqbilx.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ridt li jkun ċar li ma naqbilx.
messages.zh: 因为我想明确表达我不同意。
messages.en: Because I wanted to make it clear that I disagree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说话时把“不”字读得特别坚定，用 enfatikament 回答“怎样说”，突出强调的方式。

gloss_zh: 强调的；明确有力的；坚决的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong and clear in expression, showing emphasis or a firm position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达强烈明确、带有强调意味或体现坚定立场的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwi u ċar fl-espressjoni, b'enfasi jew b'pożizzjoni soda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强调的；明确有力的；坚决的

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-awtur juża ton enfatiku biex jenfasizza l-ħtieġa għal azzjoni immedjata.
formal.en: In the report, the author uses an emphatic tone to stress the need for immediate action.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中用明确有力的语气强调立即采取行动的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak kien rifjut enfatiku! Toni: Iva, qalet 'le' b'ton li ma ħalla ebda dubju.
colloquial.en: Maja: That was an emphatic refusal! Toni: Yes, she said 'no' in a tone that left no doubt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那拒绝得可真坚决！托尼：是啊，她说“不”的语气让人毫无疑问。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那拒绝得可真坚决！
messages.en: That was an emphatic refusal!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalet 'le' b'ton li ma ħalla ebda dubju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalet 'le' b'ton li ma ħalla ebda dubju.
messages.zh: 是啊，她说“不”的语气让人毫无疑问。
messages.en: Yes, she said 'no' in a tone that left no doubt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 enfatiku 想成文字旁的粗体感叹号，帮助记住它形容语气或表态明确有力、带有强调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has a strong interest in an activity or subject and takes part with enthusiasm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项活动或某个领域有浓厚兴趣，并热心投入的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha interess qawwi f'attività jew suġġett u tieħu sehem b'ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱好者；对某事十分热心的人

formal.mt: Bħala entużjasta tal-fotografija, Mark jorganizza laqgħat għal dawk li jixtiequ jitgħallmu jużaw il-kamera.
formal.en: As a photography enthusiast, Mark organizes meetings for people who want to learn to use a camera.
formal.zh: 作为摄影爱好者，马克为想学习使用相机的人组织交流活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Paul dejjem imur għall-kunċerti? Lara: Għax hu entużjasta tal-mużika u jħobb jisma' gruppi ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Paul always go to concerts? Lara: Because he's a music enthusiast and likes listening to new bands.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么总去听音乐会？拉拉：因为他是音乐爱好者，喜欢听新乐队演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么总去听音乐会？
messages.en: Why does Paul always go to concerts?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu entużjasta tal-mużika u jħobb jisma' gruppi ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu entużjasta tal-mużika u jħobb jisma' gruppi ġodda.
messages.zh: 因为他是音乐爱好者，喜欢听新乐队演奏。
messages.en: Because he's a music enthusiast and likes listening to new bands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词和一个总带着相机参加活动的人联系起来：他是摄影爱好者，记住它指的是人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that shows strong interest, eagerness, or excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以表现出浓厚兴趣、积极意愿或兴奋心情的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri interess qawwi, ħeġġa jew eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热情地；兴致勃勃地；热烈地

formal.mt: L-istudenti pparteċipaw entużjastikament fid-diskussjoni u pproponew diversi ideat.
formal.en: The students participated enthusiastically in the discussion and proposed several ideas.
formal.zh: 学生们热情地参与讨论，并提出了多个想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif laqgħu l-idea tiegħek? Mark: Entużjastikament! Kulħadd ried jgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did they receive your idea? Mark: Enthusiastically! Everyone wanted to help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家对你的想法反应怎么样？马克：非常热烈！每个人都想帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家对你的想法反应怎么样？
messages.en: How did they receive your idea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 非常热烈！每个人都想帮忙。
messages.en: Enthusiastically! Everyone wanted to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“怎样参与？热情地参与”来记：这个词说明动作进行的方式，可以回答“怎样做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing strong interest, eagerness, or excitement about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表现出浓厚兴趣、积极意愿或兴奋心情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri interess qawwi, ħeġġa jew eċċitament dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热情的；热心的；充满热忱的

formal.mt: Il-proġett irċieva appoġġ entużjastiku mill-għalliema u mill-ġenituri.
formal.en: The project received enthusiastic support from teachers and parents.
formal.zh: 这个项目获得了教师和家长的热烈支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int entużjastiku dwar il-kors il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, qed nistenna bil-ħerqa li jibda!
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you enthusiastic about the new course? Mark: Yes, I can't wait for it to start!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你对新课程很有热情吗？马克：是啊，我盼着它赶快开始！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你对新课程很有热情吗？
messages.en: Are you enthusiastic about the new course?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nistenna bil-ħerqa li jibda!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nistenna bil-ħerqa li jibda!
messages.zh: 是啊，我盼着它赶快开始！
messages.en: Yes, I can't wait for it to start!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位上课总举手的学生，用“热情的学生”整组记忆，提醒自己这个词用来描述特点。

gloss_zh: 使兴奋；激发热情；使激动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel excited, eager, or strongly interested in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到兴奋、产生热情，或对某事形成浓厚兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem ħeġġa, eċċitament jew interess qawwi f'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to excite, to arouse enthusiasm, to thrill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使兴奋；激发热情；使激动不已

formal.mt: L-esperiment entużjażma lill-istudenti u qanqal interess ġdid fix-xjenza.
formal.en: The experiment excited the students and sparked a new interest in science.
formal.zh: 这个实验让学生们兴奋起来，并激发了他们对科学的新兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-kunċert? Mark: Iva! Il-kantant entużjażma lil kulħadd bl-aħħar kanzunetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you enjoy the concert? Mark: Yes! The singer thrilled everyone with the last song.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这场音乐会吗？马克：喜欢！歌手的最后一首歌让所有人都激动不已。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Il-kantant entużjażma lil kulħadd bl-aħħar kanzunetta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Il-kantant entużjażma lil kulħadd bl-aħħar kanzunetta.
messages.zh: 喜欢！歌手的最后一首歌让所有人都激动不已。
messages.en: Yes! The singer thrilled everyone with the last song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“精彩演出使观众兴奋”这个画面，把词义连成“某事激起某人的热情”，突出使人兴奋的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To name or list things one by one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物、理由或项目一项一项地说出或列出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isemmi jew iniżżel affarijiet waħda waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐一列举；逐项列出

collocations.en: listed the reasons one by one

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-awtur enumera r-raġunijiet għad-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In his report, the author enumerated the reasons for the decision.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中逐一列举了作出这一决定的理由。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għalliem spjega kif nagħmlu l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Iva, enumera l-passi wieħed wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the teacher explain how to do the exercise? Mark: Yes, he listed the steps one by one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：老师解释怎么做这道练习了吗？马克：解释了，他把步骤逐一列了出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 老师解释怎么做这道练习了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher explain how to do the exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 解释了，他把步骤逐一列了出来。
messages.en: Yes, he listed the steps one by one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师边伸手指边说“第一、第二、第三”，把这个词记成逐项列出的动作。

gloss_zh: 调查登记员；普查员；逐项计数者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who counts or records people or items, especially when collecting information for a census or survey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责逐项计数或登记的人，尤指为人口普查或调查收集资料的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħodd jew tirreġistra nies jew oġġetti, speċjalment waqt ċensiment jew stħarriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐项计数或登记的人；调查登记员；普查员

formal.mt: L-enumeratur taċ-ċensiment irreġistra l-għadd ta' persuni li jgħixu f'kull dar.
formal.en: The census enumerator recorded the number of people living in each household.
formal.zh: 人口普查员登记了每户居住的人数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġie jħabbat il-bieb? Mark: Enumeratur taċ-ċensiment. Staqsa kemm hawn nies jgħixu fid-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who came to the door? Mark: A census enumerator. He asked how many people live in the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才谁来敲门了？马克：一位人口普查员。他问这所房子里住着多少人。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 刚才谁来敲门了？
messages.en: Who came to the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Enumeratur taċ-ċensiment. Staqsa kemm hawn nies jgħixu fid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Enumeratur taċ-ċensiment. Staqsa kemm hawn nies jgħixu fid-dar.
messages.zh: 一位人口普查员。他问这所房子里住着多少人。
messages.en: A census enumerator. He asked how many people live in the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着登记表逐户询问人数的工作人员，把这个词固定联想到负责计数登记的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of naming, listing, or counting things one by one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物逐一说出、列出或清点的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li fih affarijiet jissemmew, jitniżżlu jew jingħaddu waħda waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 列举；枚举；逐项列出或清点的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi enumerazzjoni dettaljata tal-ispejjeż tal-proġett.
formal.en: The report includes a detailed enumeration of the project's costs.
formal.zh: 报告详细列举了项目的各项费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jonqos fit-tweġiba tiegħi? Maja: Hemm enumerazzjoni tar-raġunijiet, imma trid tispjega kull waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's missing from my answer? Maja: There is an enumeration of the reasons, but you need to explain each one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的答案还缺什么？玛雅：理由已经逐一列出来了，不过你还需要解释每一条。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我的答案还缺什么？
messages.en: What's missing from my answer?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm enumerazzjoni tar-raġunijiet, imma trid tispjega kull waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm enumerazzjoni tar-raġunijiet, imma trid tispjega kull waħda.
messages.zh: 理由已经逐一列出来了，不过你还需要解释每一条。
messages.en: There is an enumeration of the reasons, but you need to explain each one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸上排成一列的理由当作记忆画面：这里说的是“列举”这件事，可搭配“详细的列举”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express or state an idea, principle, or argument clearly and precisely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个观点、原则或论点清楚而准确地表达出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi jew jistqarr idea, prinċipju jew argument b'mod ċar u preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清楚表述；明确陈述观点、原则或论点

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tat-taħdita, il-kelliem enunzja l-prinċipju li kull persuna għandha tiġi ttrattata b'rispett.
formal.en: At the beginning of the talk, the speaker enunciated the principle that every person should be treated with respect.
formal.zh: 演讲开始时，发言者明确阐述了每个人都应受到尊重这一原则。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fhimt x'ried jgħid il-kelliem? Mark: Iva, enunzja l-idea ewlenija b'mod ċar u mbagħad ta eżempju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you understand what the speaker meant? Mark: Yes, he stated the main idea clearly and then gave an example.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听懂发言者想表达什么了吗？马克：听懂了，他清楚地说出了主要观点，然后举了一个例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你听懂发言者想表达什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what the speaker meant?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, enunzja l-idea ewlenija b'mod ċar u mbagħad ta eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, enunzja l-idea ewlenija b'mod ċar u mbagħad ta eżempju.
messages.zh: 听懂了，他清楚地说出了主要观点，然后举了一个例子。
messages.en: Yes, he stated the main idea clearly and then gave an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发言者先清楚说出一句核心原则，再举例解释；把这个词与“明确陈述观点”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who produces an utterance or gives verbal expression to a statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出某一话语或用语言作出陈述的人；在话语分析中指发话者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlissen kliem jew tesprimi stqarrija bil-fomm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发话者；用语言表达或作出陈述的人。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi ta' din il-konversazzjoni, irridu nidentifikaw l-enunzjatur ta' kull stqarrija.
formal.en: In analysing this conversation, we must identify the enunciator of each statement.
formal.zh: 分析这段对话时，我们必须确定每项陈述的发话者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser enunzjatur? Pawlu: Il-persuna li tgħid il-kliem. F'dan l-eżempju, l-enunzjatur huwa Mark.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does enunciator mean? Pawlu: The person who says the words. In this example, the enunciator is Mark.
colloquial.zh: Lara：发话者是什么意思？Pawlu：就是说出这些话的人。在这个例子中，发话者是Mark。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 发话者是什么意思？
messages.en: What does enunciator mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-persuna li tgħid il-kliem. F'dan l-eżempju, l-enunzjatur huwa Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Il-persuna li tgħid il-kliem. F'dan l-eżempju, l-enunzjatur huwa Mark.
messages.zh: 就是说出这些话的人。在这个例子中，发话者是Mark。
messages.en: The person who says the words. In this example, the enunciator is Mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把对话画成两个说话气泡，箭头指向说出这句话的人，并标上 enunzjatur，记住它指发话的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or manner of pronouncing words clearly or expressing a statement in words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚说出词语的行为或方式，也指用语言明确陈述某个意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-mod kif wieħed ilissen il-kliem b'mod ċar jew jesprimi stqarrija bil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清晰发音或吐字；以语言作出的陈述、表述。

collocations.zh: 对一项原则的明确表述

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari quddiem udjenza, enunzjazzjoni ċara tgħin lis-semmiegħa jifhmu kull kelma.
formal.en: When reading before an audience, clear enunciation helps listeners understand every word.
formal.zh: 面对听众朗读时，清晰的吐字有助于听众听懂每一个词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' naqra aħjar quddiem il-klassi? Rita: Aqra ftit aktar bil-mod u oqgħod attenta għall-enunzjazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I read better in front of the class? Rita: Read a little more slowly and pay attention to the enunciation of each word.
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎样才能在全班面前读得更好？Rita：读得稍微慢一点，注意每个词的吐字。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' naqra aħjar quddiem il-klassi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' naqra aħjar quddiem il-klassi?
messages.zh: 怎样才能在全班面前读得更好？
messages.en: How can I read better in front of the class?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra ftit aktar bil-mod u oqgħod attenta għall-enunzjazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra ftit aktar bil-mod u oqgħod attenta għall-enunzjazzjoni ta' kull kelma.
messages.zh: 读得稍微慢一点，注意每个词的吐字。
messages.en: Read a little more slowly and pay attention to the enunciation of each word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朗读时把每个词都清楚送到听众耳边，用 enunzjazzjoni 记住清晰吐字，也可联想到把意思明确表述出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that is a perfect or especially clear example of a quality or type.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最能鲜明体现某种特质或类型的人或事物；典型代表或典范。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tirrappreżenta b'mod perfett jew ċar ħafna kwalità jew tip partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 典范；某种特质的集中体现或典型代表。

formal.mt: Bid-disinn sempliċi u l-proporzjonijiet armonjużi tagħha, din is-sala hija l-epitome tal-eleganza.
formal.en: With its simple design and harmonious proportions, this hall is the epitome of elegance.
formal.zh: 这座大厅设计简洁、比例和谐，堪称优雅的典范。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok kif Anna mexxiet il-laqgħa? Mark: Ħafna! Baqgħet kalma u semgħet lil kulħadd. Hija l-epitome tal-professjonalità.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the way Anna ran the meeting? Mark: Very much! She stayed calm and listened to everyone. She is the epitome of professionalism.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你觉得Anna主持会议的方式好吗？Mark：非常好！她一直很冷静，也听取了每个人的意见。她就是专业精神的典范。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得Anna主持会议的方式好吗？
messages.en: Did you like the way Anna ran the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Baqgħet kalma u semgħet lil kulħadd. Hija l-epitome tal-professjonalità.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Baqgħet kalma u semgħet lil kulħadd. Hija l-epitome tal-professjonalità.
messages.zh: 非常好！她一直很冷静，也听取了每个人的意见。她就是专业精神的典范。
messages.en: Very much! She stayed calm and listened to everyone. She is the epitome of professionalism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给最能代表某种品质的人颁一枚“典范奖章”，把奖章上的词写成 epitome，记住它表示集中体现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To represent a quality or type perfectly or serve as its clearest example.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鲜明而充分地体现某种特质或类型，成为它的典型代表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrappreżenta kwalità jew tip b'mod perfett, jew iservi bħala l-aktar eżempju ċar tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集中体现；成为某种特质或类型的典范。

formal.mt: Dan il-proġett epitomizza l-ispirtu ta' kooperazzjoni bejn l-iskola u l-komunità.
formal.en: This project epitomizes the spirit of cooperation between the school and the community.
formal.zh: 这个项目充分体现了学校与社区之间的合作精神。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt dan ir-ritratt għall-wirja? Ninu: Għax epitomizza l-ferħ tal-festa: kulħadd flimkien u jitbissem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this photo for the exhibition? Ninu: Because it epitomizes the joy of the celebration: everyone together and smiling.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么选这张照片参展？Ninu：因为它充分体现了庆典的欢乐：大家聚在一起，脸上都带着笑容。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这张照片参展？
messages.en: Why did you choose this photo for the exhibition?

messages.speaker: Ninu (摄影师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax epitomizza l-ferħ tal-festa: kulħadd flimkien u jitbissem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax epitomizza l-ferħ tal-festa: kulħadd flimkien u jitbissem.
messages.zh: 因为它充分体现了庆典的欢乐：大家聚在一起，脸上都带着笑容。
messages.en: Because it epitomizes the joy of the celebration: everyone together and smiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张照片把庆典的欢乐全都表现出来，用“这张照片集中体现欢乐”记住 epitomizza 的动词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A polygon with seven sides and seven angles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由七条边围成、具有七个角的多边形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poligonu li għandu seba' naħat u seba' angoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七边形；具有七条边和七个角的多边形。

formal.mt: Eptagonu regolari għandu seba' naħat tal-istess tul u seba' angoli interni ndaqs.
formal.en: A regular heptagon has seven sides of equal length and seven equal interior angles.
formal.zh: 正七边形有七条等长的边和七个相等的内角。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Din il-figura hija eptagonu? Marija: Ejja ngħoddu n-naħat. Għandha seba', allura iva, hija eptagonu.
colloquial.en: Ben: Is this shape a heptagon? Marija: Let's count the sides. It has seven, so yes, it is a heptagon.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这个图形是七边形吗？Marija：我们数数边吧。它有七条边，所以是的，它是七边形。

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.zh: 这个图形是七边形吗？
messages.en: Is this shape a heptagon?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħoddu n-naħat. Għandha seba', allura iva, hija eptagonu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħoddu n-naħat. Għandha seba', allura iva, hija eptagonu.
messages.zh: 我们数数边吧。它有七条边，所以是的，它是七边形。
messages.en: Let's count the sides. It has seven, so yes, it is a heptagon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个封闭图形，沿边依次数到七，再在中央写上 eptagonu；用七条边的画面牢牢记住七边形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The height or most intense stage of something, especially its worst or severest period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事发展到最强烈、最严重或最难熬的阶段，常用于盛夏、风暴等情境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aktar żmien intens ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta tkun fl-agħar jew fl-aktar fażi ħarxa tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: height, the worst or severest period (of something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 最盛期；某事最恶劣、最严酷或最严重的阶段。

collocations.en: at the height of the storm

formal.mt: Fl-eqqel tal-maltemp, il-vapuri baqgħu fil-port sakemm il-kundizzjonijiet tjiebu.
formal.en: At the height of the storm, the ships remained in port until conditions improved.
formal.zh: 风暴最猛烈时，船只留在港内，直到天气状况好转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se mmorru nimxu f'nofsinhar? Toni: Fl-eqqel tas-sajf? Aħjar immorru filgħaxija, meta jkun aktar frisk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go for a walk at noon? Toni: At the height of summer? We'd better go in the evening, when it's cooler.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们中午去散步吗？Toni：现在可是盛夏啊！最好傍晚再去，那时凉快一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们中午去散步吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk at noon?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-eqqel tas-sajf? Aħjar immorru filgħaxija, meta jkun aktar frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-eqqel tas-sajf? Aħjar immorru filgħaxija, meta jkun aktar frisk.
messages.zh: 现在可是盛夏啊！最好傍晚再去，那时凉快一些。
messages.en: At the height of summer? We'd better go in the evening, when it's cooler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把夏季气温画成一座山，最高处标上 eqqel，联想事情最强烈的阶段，再用“盛夏”和“风暴最猛烈时”巩固。

gloss_zh: 四（置于名词前的短形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short form of the numeral four used before a noun to indicate a quantity of four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词“四”放在名词前作数量修饰语时使用的短形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira tan-numru erbgħa li tintuża qabel nom biex tindika kwantità ta' erbgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: erbgħa（四）作定语时的短形式，用于名词前表示四个。

formal.mt: Kull grupp għandu jinkludi erba' studenti, u kull student għandu jġib ktieb wieħed.
formal.en: Each group must include four students, and each student must bring one book.
formal.zh: 每组须有四名学生，每名学生须带一本书。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm kotba għandek fil-basket? Luqa: Għandi erba' kotba: tnejn għalija u tnejn għal oħti.
colloquial.en: Anna: How many books do you have in the basket? Luqa: I have four books: two for me and two for my sister.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你的篮子里有几本书？Luqa：我有四本书，两本给我自己，两本给我姐姐。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的篮子里有几本书？
messages.en: How many books do you have in the basket?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi erba' kotba: tnejn għalija u tnejn għal oħti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi erba' kotba: tnejn għalija u tnejn għal oħti.
messages.zh: 我有四本书，两本给我自己，两本给我姐姐。
messages.en: I have four books: two for me and two for my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四本书并排摆好，在前面贴上 erba' kotba；将 erba' 和后面的名词一起记，书写时保留末尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number four hundred, equal to four groups of one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词四百，即四个一百，写作400。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jikkorrispondi għal erba' gruppi ta' mija u li jinkiteb 400.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四百；数值400。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-organizzaturi, erba' mija persuna attendew il-konferenza.
formal.en: According to the organisers' report, four hundred people attended the conference.
formal.zh: 根据主办方的报告，四百人参加了这次会议。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm jiswa dan il-mejda? Rita: Erba' mija ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi t-trasport.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this table cost? Rita: Four hundred euros, and the price includes delivery.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张桌子多少钱？Rita：四百欧元，价格包括送货。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this table cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (售货员)
messages.mt_spoken: Erba' mija ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi t-trasport.
messages.mt_standard: Erba' mija ewro, u l-prezz jinkludi t-trasport.
messages.zh: 四百欧元，价格包括送货。
messages.en: Four hundred euros, and the price includes delivery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象四捆各有一百张的卡片，把四捆合起来就是四百；用这个画面把 erba' mija 与数字400配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long attributive form of erbgħa, used before a noun to express a quantity of four, as in erbat ijiem, 'four days'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词 erbgħa（四）的长定语形式，用在名词前表示四个，如 erbat ijiem（四天）。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma twila ta' erbgħa meta tintuża quddiem nom biex tindika għadd ta' erbgħa, bħal f'erbat ijiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: erbgħa（四）的长定语形式。

formal.mt: Il-kors idum erbat ijiem u jinkludi taħriġ prattiku.
formal.en: The course lasts four days and includes practical training.
formal.zh: 课程为期四天，包括实践培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se ddum hemm? Lara: Se ndum erbat ijiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will you stay there? Lara: I'll stay for four days.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会在那里待多久？拉拉：我会待四天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在那里待多久？
messages.en: How long will you stay there?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我会待四天。
messages.en: I'll stay for four days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 erbat ijiem（四天）整组记忆，想象日历上圈出的四天，帮助记住 erbat 在名词前的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 4,000, expressing a quantity of four thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为4,000，即四个一千，用于表达人数、金额或其他数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 4,000, jiġifieri erba' gruppi ta' elf.

formal.mt: L-assoċjazzjoni ġabret erbat elef ewro biex tixtri kotba għal-librerija.
formal.en: The association raised four thousand euros to buy books for the library.
formal.zh: 该协会筹集了四千欧元，用于为图书馆购买书籍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm ġbartu għall-librerija? Pawlu: Ġbarna erbat elef ewro.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much did you raise for the library? Pawlu: We raised four thousand euros.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们为图书馆筹到了多少钱？保罗：我们筹到了四千欧元。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为图书馆筹到了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did you raise for the library?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (募款志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们筹到了四千欧元。
messages.en: We raised four thousand euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画四个盒子，每盒标上1,000，合起来就是 erbat elef（四千）；把整个短语作为一个数量单位记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 14,000, expressing a quantity of fourteen thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为14,000，即十四个一千，汉语通常说“一万四千”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 14,000, jiġifieri erbatax-il grupp ta' elf.

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu baġit ta' erbatax-il elf ewro għax-xiri ta' tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The project has a budget of fourteen thousand euros for purchasing new equipment.
formal.zh: 该项目有一万四千欧元的预算，用于购买新设备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-karozza? Rita: Tiswa erbatax-il elf ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this car cost? Rita: It costs fourteen thousand euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车多少钱？丽塔：一万四千欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this car cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (销售员)
messages.zh: 一万四千欧元。
messages.en: It costs fourteen thousand euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十四捆纸币，每捆一千：十四乘一千就是14,000。把 erbatax-il elf 与“一万四千”成对朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 94, equal to ninety plus four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为94，即九十加四；马耳他语表达中先说个位四，再说九十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 94, jiġifieri disgħin u erbgħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十四，即94。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih erbgħa u disgħin paġna u jinkludi tabelli dettaljati.
formal.en: The report contains ninety-four pages and includes detailed tables.
formal.zh: 该报告共九十四页，包含详细表格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jiswa dan il-ġakkett? Mark: Jiswa erbgħa u disgħin ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does this jacket cost? Mark: It costs ninety-four euros.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件夹克多少钱？马克：九十四欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件夹克多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this jacket cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 九十四欧元。
messages.en: It costs ninety-four euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“四＋和＋九十”理解 erbgħa u disgħin，再换成汉语顺序“九十四”；想象九张十元加四枚一元。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 44, equal to forty plus four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为44，即四十加四；马耳他语表达中先说个位四，再说四十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 44, jiġifieri erbgħin u erbgħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四十四，即44。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ bil-ferrovija jdum erbgħa u erbgħin minuta skont l-iskeda.
formal.en: According to the timetable, the train journey takes forty-four minutes.
formal.zh: 根据时刻表，这趟火车的行程需要四十四分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm fadal biex jasal il-ferrovija? Toni: Fadal erbgħa u erbgħin minuta.
colloquial.en: Lara: How long until the train arrives? Toni: There are forty-four minutes left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：火车还有多久到？托尼：还有四十四分钟。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅客)
messages.zh: 火车还有多久到？
messages.en: How long until the train arrives?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 还有四十四分钟。
messages.en: There are forty-four minutes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 erbgħa 记为四、erbgħin 记为四十，中间用 u 连接；脑中排成“四＋四十”，得到四十四。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 24, equal to twenty plus four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为24，即二十加四；马耳他语表达中先说个位四，再说二十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 24, jiġifieri għoxrin u erbgħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二十四，即24。

formal.mt: Is-servizz ta' għajnuna huwa disponibbli erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa kuljum.
formal.en: The support service is available twenty-four hours a day.
formal.zh: 援助服务每天二十四小时开放。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandi nistenna qabel nuża ż-żebgħa mill-ġdid? Rita: Stenna erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long should I wait before using the paint again? Rita: Wait twenty-four hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：再次使用这款油漆前，我应该等多久？丽塔：等二十四小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandi nistenna qabel nuża ż-żebgħa mill-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandi nistenna qabel nuża ż-żebgħa mill-ġdid?
messages.zh: 再次使用这款油漆前，我应该等多久？
messages.en: How long should I wait before using the paint again?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 等二十四小时。
messages.en: Wait twenty-four hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一天二十四小时来记 erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa；短语内部按“四＋和＋二十”排列，理解后读作二十四。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 74, equal to seventy plus four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为74，即七十加四；马耳他语表达中先说个位四，再说七十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 74, jiġifieri sebgħin u erbgħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 七十四，即74。

collocations.zh: 七十四年；用于年龄时表示七十四岁

formal.mt: L-awtur għandu erbgħa u sebgħin sena u għadu jikteb regolarment.
formal.en: The author is seventy-four years old and still writes regularly.
formal.zh: 这位作家七十四岁，仍然定期写作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandu żmien in-nannu tiegħek? Toni: Għandu erbgħa u sebgħin sena.
colloquial.en: Sara: How old is your grandfather? Toni: He's seventy-four years old.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你爷爷多大年纪？托尼：他七十四岁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷多大年纪？
messages.en: How old is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他七十四岁。
messages.en: He's seventy-four years old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象七十四岁生日蛋糕上写着74：erbgħa 是四，sebgħin 是七十，按“四＋和＋七十”记住整个表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 64, used for counting, identifying a number, or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字六十四，用于计数、表示数量或标示编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 64, użat għall-għadd, biex juri kwantità jew biex jidentifika numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十四。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinsab f'paġna erbgħa u sittin tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The exercise is on page sixty-four of the book.
formal.zh: 练习在这本书的第六十四页。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswa dan il-basket? Mark: Erbgħa u sittin ewro. Maja: Tajjeb, neħodha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much is this basket? Mark: Sixty-four euros. Maja: Okay, I'll take it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个篮子多少钱？马克：六十四欧元。玛雅：好，我买了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个篮子多少钱？
messages.en: How much is this basket?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 六十四欧元。
messages.en: Sixty-four euros.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买了。
messages.en: Okay, I'll take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把表达顺序记成“四和六十”：erbgħa 是四，u 是和，sittin 是六十，合起来就是六十四。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 34, used for counting, identifying a number, or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字三十四，用于计数、表示数量或标示编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 34, użat għall-għadd, biex juri kwantità jew biex jidentifika numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三十四。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-vjaġġ dam erbgħa u tletin minuta.
formal.en: According to the report, the journey took thirty-four minutes.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这趟行程用了三十四分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema paġna rridu naqraw? Pawlu: Paġna erbgħa u tletin. Lara: Sibtha, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which page do we need to read? Pawlu: Page thirty-four. Lara: Found it, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们要读哪一页？保罗：第三十四页。拉拉：找到了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们要读哪一页？
messages.en: Which page do we need to read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 第三十四页。
messages.en: Page thirty-four.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢。
messages.en: Found it, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻到第三十四页，口中按“四和三十”来念：erbgħa u tletin，先说个位四，再说三十。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 84, used for counting, identifying a number, or stating an amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字八十四，用于计数、表示数量或标示编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 84, użat għall-għadd, biex juri kwantità jew biex jidentifika numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八十四。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiseb erbgħa u tmenin punt fl-eżami.
formal.en: The student scored eighty-four points in the examination.
formal.zh: 这名学生在考试中得了八十四分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm ġibt fl-eżami? David: Erbgħa u tmenin punt. Nina: Prosit!
colloquial.en: Nina: How much did you score in the exam? David: Eighty-four points. Nina: Well done!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你考试得了多少分？戴维：八十四分。妮娜：考得真好！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你考试得了多少分？
messages.en: How much did you score in the exam?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 八十四分。
messages.en: Eighty-four points.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 考得真好！
messages.en: Well done!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把八十四分拆成“四和八十”来记：erbgħa u tmenin。用同一个 erbgħa，换上 tmenin 就得到八十四。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 54, equal to fifty plus four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数值为54，即五十加四；马耳他语表达中先说个位四，再说五十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 54, jiġifieri ħamsin u erbgħa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十四，即54。

formal.mt: Il-gwida fiha erbgħa u ħamsin paġna ta' struzzjonijiet u eżempji.
formal.en: The guide contains fifty-four pages of instructions and examples.
formal.zh: 这本指南包含五十四页的说明和示例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm qrajt s'issa? Pawlu: Qrajt erbgħa u ħamsin paġna.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much have you read so far? Pawlu: I've read fifty-four pages.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你到现在读了多少？保罗：我读了五十四页。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你到现在读了多少？
messages.en: How much have you read so far?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我读了五十四页。
messages.en: I've read fifty-four pages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象五捆十页纸，再加四页，就是五十四页；朗读 erbgħa u ħamsin 时先说四，再接五十。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element erbium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铒的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ erbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铒，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti jitgħallmu jagħrfu l-isem tal-element erbju.
formal.en: In this lesson, students learn to recognize the name of the element erbium.
formal.zh: 在这节课上，学生学习辨认铒元素的名称。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm miktub fuq din it-tikketta? Mark: Erbju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku. Sara: Issa nifhem, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's written on this label? Mark: Erbium. It's the name of a chemical element. Sara: Now I understand, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张标签上写着什么？马克：铒，是一种化学元素的名称。萨拉：现在我明白了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张标签上写着什么？
messages.en: What's written on this label?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Erbju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Erbju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 铒，是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Erbium. It's the name of a chemical element.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白了，谢谢。
messages.en: Now I understand, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张元素词卡，把 erbju、erbium 和“铒”并排写在同一面；看到 erbju 就回想实验室里的元素标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Upright or held straight up, especially when describing posture or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直立或保持挺直的，常用于描述身体姿势或物体的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieqaf u dritt, speċjalment meta jiddeskrivi l-qagħda tal-ġisem jew il-pożizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直立的；挺直的。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, is-suldat jidher b'ġismu erett u b'ħarstu 'l quddiem.
formal.en: In the picture, the soldier is shown with his body upright and his gaze directed forward.
formal.zh: 图中的士兵身体挺直，目视前方。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Hekk għandi noqgħod għar-ritratt? Lara: Iva, żomm ġismek erett u ħares lejn il-kamera. Pawlu: Tajjeb, lest.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Should I stand like this for the photo? Lara: Yes, keep your body upright and look at the camera. Pawlu: Okay, ready.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：拍照时我该这样站吗？拉拉：对，身体挺直，看镜头。保罗：好，准备好了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (拍照者)
messages.zh: 拍照时我该这样站吗？
messages.en: Should I stand like this for the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (摄影师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żomm ġismek erett u ħares lejn il-kamera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żomm ġismek erett u ħares lejn il-kamera.
messages.zh: 对，身体挺直，看镜头。
messages.en: Yes, keep your body upright and look at the camera.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (拍照者)
messages.zh: 好，准备好了。
messages.en: Okay, ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍照前把背挺直，默念 ġisem erett“挺直的身体”；也可把 erett 与英语 erect 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eritrea, a country in East Africa on the Red Sea, officially called Istat tal-Eritrea in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厄立特里亚，位于东非、濒临红海的国家；马耳他语正式名称为 Istat tal-Eritrea。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant fuq il-Baħar l-Aħmar, bl-isem uffiċjali Istat tal-Eritrea.

sense_translations.en_definition: Eritrea (a country in East Africa, on the Red Sea; official name: Istat tal-Eritrea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 厄立特里亚，位于东非、濒临红海的国家；正式名称为厄立特里亚国，马耳他语为 Istat tal-Eritrea。

formal.mt: L-Eritrea tinsab fl-Afrika tal-Lvant u għandha kosta fuq il-Baħar l-Aħmar.
formal.en: Eritrea is in East Africa and has a coastline on the Red Sea.
formal.zh: 厄立特里亚位于东非，海岸濒临红海。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi l-Eritrea fuq din il-mappa? David: Hawn, fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, ħdejn il-Baħar l-Aħmar. Nina: Issa sibtha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Eritrea on this map? David: Here, in East Africa, beside the Red Sea. Nina: Now I've found it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：厄立特里亚在这张地图上的哪里？戴维：这里，在东非，红海旁边。妮娜：现在我找到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-Eritrea fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-Eritrea fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 厄立特里亚在这张地图上的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Eritrea on this map?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, ħdejn il-Baħar l-Aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, fl-Afrika tal-Lvant, ħdejn il-Baħar l-Aħmar.
messages.zh: 这里，在东非，红海旁边。
messages.en: Here, in East Africa, beside the Red Sea.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 现在我找到了。
messages.en: Now I've found it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Eritrea 与“厄立特里亚”写在东非地图的红海沿岸；用“东非、红海”两个位置提示记住这个国名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Great courage shown in facing danger or difficulty, especially to help others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时表现出的非凡勇气，尤其指为帮助他人而展现的英勇精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kuraġġ kbir muri quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà, speċjalment biex wieħed jgħin lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英勇；英雄气概；面对危险或困难时表现出的非凡勇气。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ifaħħar l-eroiżmu tal-ħaddiema tas-salvataġġ li għenu lin-nies fil-periklu.
formal.en: The report praises the heroism of the rescue workers who helped people in danger.
formal.zh: 报告赞扬了救援人员帮助身处险境者时表现出的英勇精神。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt dwar ir-raġel li salva t-tifel mill-baħar? Pawlu: Iva, dak kien att ta' eroiżmu. Lara: Vera, wera kuraġġ kbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear about the man who saved the boy from the sea? Pawlu: Yes, that was an act of heroism. Lara: Indeed, he showed great courage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听说那个从海里救起男孩的男人了吗？保罗：听说了，那是一个英勇行为。拉拉：确实，他表现出了很大的勇气。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dwar ir-raġel li salva t-tifel mill-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dwar ir-raġel li salva t-tifel mill-baħar?
messages.zh: 你听说那个从海里救起男孩的男人了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear about the man who saved the boy from the sea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak kien att ta' eroiżmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak kien att ta' eroiżmu.
messages.zh: 听说了，那是一个英勇行为。
messages.en: Yes, that was an act of heroism.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，他表现出了很大的勇气。
messages.en: Indeed, he showed great courage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人勇敢救人的画面，并配上 att ta' eroiżmu“一个英勇行为”；把 eroiżmu 记作表现出来的英雄气概。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powerful, highly addictive drug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种作用强烈、极易使人产生依赖的毒品，称为海洛因。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Droga qawwija li toħloq dipendenza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海洛因，一种作用强烈且容易成瘾的毒品。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi servizzi ta' appoġġ għal persuni b'dipendenza fuq l-erojina.
formal.en: The report describes support services for people with heroin dependence.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了为海洛因依赖者提供的支持服务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fuq xiex kien id-dokumentarju? Pawlu: Fuq l-erojina u l-għajnuna għal min għandu dipendenza fuqha.
colloquial.en: Marija: What was the documentary about? Pawlu: Heroin and help for people who are dependent on it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那部纪录片讲什么？Pawlu：讲海洛因，以及为依赖海洛因的人提供的帮助。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部纪录片讲什么？
messages.en: What was the documentary about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-erojina u l-għajnuna għal min għandu dipendenza fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-erojina u l-għajnuna għal min għandu dipendenza fuqha.
messages.zh: 讲海洛因，以及为依赖海洛因的人提供的帮助。
messages.en: Heroin and help for people who are dependent on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 erojina 放进“毒品—依赖—援助”的词汇卡中，借 dipendenza fuq l-erojina 整组记住它表示海洛因。

gloss_zh: 英勇地；以英雄般的方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a very brave way, especially when facing danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以非常勇敢的方式，尤指面对危险或困难时表现得英勇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'kuraġġ kbir, speċjalment quddiem periklu jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英勇地；以英雄般勇敢的方式。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema tas-salvataġġ aġixxew erojkament biex joħorġu lir-residenti mill-bini.
formal.en: The rescue workers acted heroically to get the residents out of the building.
formal.zh: 救援人员英勇行动，将居民救出大楼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif daħal jgħin minkejja l-periklu? Mark: Iva, aġixxa erojkament.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how he went in to help despite the danger? Mark: Yes, he acted heroically.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到他不顾危险进去帮忙了吗？Mark：看到了，他表现得很英勇。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif daħal jgħin minkejja l-periklu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif daħal jgħin minkejja l-periklu?
messages.zh: 你看到他不顾危险进去帮忙了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he went in to help despite the danger?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，他表现得很英勇。
messages.en: Yes, he acted heroically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象救援人员勇敢行动的画面，用 aġixxa erojkament 配上“英勇地行动”，记住它回答的是“怎样行动”。

gloss_zh: 仿英雄体的；以英雄式庄严口吻制造讽刺效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using the grand style of heroic writing to treat a trivial subject humorously or satirically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用英雄文学的宏大、庄严风格描写琐事，以产生幽默或讽刺效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża l-istil grandjuż tal-kitba erojka biex jittratta suġġett trivjali b'umoriżmu jew satira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仿英雄体的；模仿英雄文学的庄严风格来幽默或讽刺地描写琐事的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton erojkosatiriku biex jippreżenta t-tfittxija għal kuċċarina bħala missjoni kbira.
formal.en: The author uses a mock-heroic tone to present the search for a teaspoon as a great mission.
formal.zh: 作者用仿英雄体的口吻，把寻找一把茶匙写成一项伟大的使命。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-poeta jiddeskrivi ġlieda għal siġġu bħal battalja kbira? Toni: Għax qed juża stil erojkosatiriku biex idaħħak.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the poet describe a fight over a chair like a great battle? Toni: Because he is using a mock-heroic style to make people laugh.
colloquial.zh: Nina：诗人为什么把争抢一把椅子写得像一场大战？Toni：因为他在用仿英雄体风格逗人发笑。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poeta jiddeskrivi ġlieda għal siġġu bħal battalja kbira?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poeta jiddeskrivi ġlieda għal siġġu bħal battalja kbira?
messages.zh: 诗人为什么把争抢一把椅子写得像一场大战？
messages.en: Why does the poet describe a fight over a chair like a great battle?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed juża stil erojkosatiriku biex idaħħak.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed juża stil erojkosatiriku biex idaħħak.
messages.zh: 因为他在用仿英雄体风格逗人发笑。
messages.en: Because he is using a mock-heroic style to make people laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“为一把茶匙写英雄史诗”的反差画面：小事配庄严口吻，就是 erojkosatiriku 所描述的仿英雄体效果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delusional belief that another person is in love with oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种坚信另一个人爱上了自己、却缺乏事实依据的妄想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Delużjoni li fiha persuna temmen li xi ħadd ieħor huwa maħbub magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟情妄想，即妄信另一个人爱上了自己。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-erotomanija bħala delużjoni li persuna oħra hija maħbuba mal-individwu.
formal.en: The text describes erotomania as a delusion that another person is in love with the individual.
formal.zh: 该文本将钟情妄想描述为一种妄想，即当事人认为另一个人爱上了自己。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser erotomanija f'dan it-test? David: Hija delużjoni li xi ħadd ieħor huwa maħbub miegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does erotomania mean in this text? David: It is a delusion that someone else is in love with you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这篇文章里的 erotomanija 是什么意思？David：指妄想别人爱上了自己。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 erotomanija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does erotomania mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija delużjoni li xi ħadd ieħor huwa maħbub miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Hija delużjoni li xi ħadd ieħor huwa maħbub miegħek.
messages.zh: 指妄想别人爱上了自己。
messages.en: It is a delusion that someone else is in love with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“妄信别人爱上自己”这句话记住 erotomanija，把“别人爱我”的信念方向记清，避免与普通暗恋混淆。

gloss_zh: 不规律的；反复无常的；难以预测的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Changing or happening without a regular or predictable pattern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变化或发生时没有稳定规律、难以预测的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinbidel jew iseħħ mingħajr regolarità u b'mod li diffiċli tbassru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不规律的；变化不定、难以预测的。

formal.mt: Il-graff juri moviment erratiku fil-prezzijiet, b'żidiet u tnaqqis mingħajr xejra ċara.
formal.en: The graph shows erratic movement in prices, with rises and falls that follow no clear pattern.
formal.zh: 图表显示价格波动不定，涨跌没有明显规律。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tieqaf il-magna? Ġanni: Ma nafx; illum għandha ritmu erratiku, daqqa taħdem malajr u daqqa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does the machine keep stopping? Ġanni: I don't know; its rhythm is erratic today, sometimes fast and sometimes slow.
colloquial.zh: Marta：机器为什么老是停下来？Ġanni：不知道，今天它运行的节奏不规律，一会儿快，一会儿慢。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 机器为什么老是停下来？
messages.en: Why does the machine keep stopping?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; illum għandha ritmu erratiku, daqqa taħdem malajr u daqqa bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; illum għandha ritmu erratiku, daqqa taħdem malajr u daqqa bil-mod.
messages.zh: 不知道，今天它运行的节奏不规律，一会儿快，一会儿慢。
messages.en: I don't know; its rhythm is erratic today, sometimes fast and sometimes slow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条忽上忽下、找不到规律的曲线，旁边写 erratiku；用“不规律、难预测”的画面整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young female cow, also called a heifer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的雌性牛，即小母牛或青年母牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Baqra żgħira ta' età żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小母牛；青年母牛，即年幼的雌性牛。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jżomm l-erħa f'post nadif u jagħtiha ilma frisk kuljum.
formal.en: The farmer keeps the heifer in a clean place and gives her fresh water every day.
formal.zh: 农民把小母牛养在干净的地方，每天给它新鲜的饮用水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik baqra żgħira? Ġużeppi: Iva, dik erħa. Maja: Nista' nagħtiha ftit ħaxix? Ġużeppi: Iva, jien nurik kif.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a young cow? Ġużeppi: Yes, that's a heifer. Maja: Can I give her some grass? Ġużeppi: Yes, I'll show you how.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是一头小牛吗？朱塞佩：是的，那是一头小母牛。玛雅：我可以给它喂点草吗？朱塞佩：可以，我教你怎么喂。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那是一头小牛吗？
messages.en: Is that a young cow?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 是的，那是一头小母牛。
messages.en: Yes, that's a heifer.

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我可以给它喂点草吗？
messages.en: Can I give her some grass?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 可以，我教你怎么喂。
messages.en: Yes, I'll show you how.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 erħa 的词卡旁画一头小母牛，并写上“年幼、雌性”两个提示，帮助自己同时记住年龄和性别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that makes something seem greater, more extreme, or more dramatic than it really is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以使事物显得比实际更大、更极端或更戏剧化的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jagħmel xi ħaġa tidher akbar, aktar estrema jew aktar drammatika milli hi fil-fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸张地；言行或表现超出实际程度地。

formal.mt: L-attur fetaħ għajnejh esaġeratament biex jenfasizza s-sorpriża tal-karattru.
formal.en: The actor opened his eyes exaggeratedly to emphasize the character's surprise.
formal.zh: 演员夸张地睁大眼睛，以突出角色的惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed titkellem esaġeratament, bħal attur fuq palk? Leo: Qed niċċajta biex indaħħak lit-tfal.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you speaking so exaggeratedly, like an actor on a stage? Leo: I'm joking around to make the children laugh.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么说话这么夸张，像舞台上的演员一样？Leo：我在开玩笑，逗孩子们笑。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titkellem esaġeratament, bħal attur fuq palk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titkellem esaġeratament, bħal attur fuq palk?
messages.zh: 你为什么说话这么夸张，像舞台上的演员一样？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so exaggeratedly, like an actor on a stage?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在开玩笑，逗孩子们笑。
messages.en: I'm joking around to make the children laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 esaġeratament 配上演员夸张睁眼的动作，记成“夸张地做”；它说明动作的方式，适合跟说话、反应一起练。

gloss_zh: 夸张；夸大；言过其实的说法

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something seem greater or more extreme than it is, or a statement that does this.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物说得比实际更大或更极端的行为，也指这种言过其实的说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel xi ħaġa tidher akbar jew aktar estrema milli hi, jew stqarrija li tagħmel dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸张；夸大事实的行为或说法。

collocations.zh: 严重的夸大；很夸张的说法

formal.mt: L-istqarrija li kull resident kien kontra l-proġett hija esaġerazzjoni, għax l-istħarriġ juri opinjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: The statement that every resident opposed the project is an exaggeration, because the survey shows differing opinions.
formal.zh: 声称每位居民都反对该项目是夸大其词，因为调查显示大家意见不一。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Domt elf sena nistenniek! Anna: Dik esaġerazzjoni; wasalt ħames minuti tard biss.
colloquial.en: Ben: I've been waiting for you for a thousand years! Anna: That's an exaggeration; I was only five minutes late.
colloquial.zh: Ben：我等了你一千年！Anna：太夸张了，我只迟到了五分钟。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我等了你一千年！
messages.en: I've been waiting for you for a thousand years!

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik esaġerazzjoni; wasalt ħames minuti tard biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dik esaġerazzjoni; wasalt ħames minuti tard biss.
messages.zh: 太夸张了，我只迟到了五分钟。
messages.en: That's an exaggeration; I was only five minutes late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“等五分钟说成等一千年”写在 esaġerazzjoni 的词卡上，记住它指“夸张这种说法或行为”，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that displays products, artwork, or other items at an exhibition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在展览中展示产品、艺术品或其他物品的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li turi prodotti, xogħlijiet tal-arti jew oġġetti oħra f'wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参展者；在展览中展示物品的个人或机构，也可指参展商。

formal.mt: Kull esibitur għandu jipprepara l-istand tiegħu qabel ma tiftaħ il-fiera.
formal.en: Each exhibitor must prepare their stand before the fair opens.
formal.zh: 每位参展者都必须在展会开幕前布置好自己的展位。

colloquial.mt: Klara: Int viżitatur jew esibitur? Mario: Esibitur; qed nuri prodotti ġodda fl-istand ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Klara: Are you a visitor or an exhibitor? Mario: An exhibitor; I'm displaying new products at the stand near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Klara：你是观众还是参展商？Mario：参展商，我在入口旁边的展位展示新产品。

messages.speaker: Klara (展会工作人员)
messages.zh: 你是观众还是参展商？
messages.en: Are you a visitor or an exhibitor?

messages.speaker: Mario (参展商)
messages.mt_spoken: Esibitur; qed nuri prodotti ġodda fl-istand ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Esibitur; qed nuri prodotti ġodda fl-istand ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.zh: 参展商，我在入口旁边的展位展示新产品。
messages.en: An exhibitor; I'm displaying new products at the stand near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展位后介绍产品的人，给他的胸牌写上 esibitur；再把 stand tal-esibitur 与“参展商的展位”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who deliberately draws attention to themselves by showing off, sometimes by exposing their body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意炫耀自己以吸引他人注意的人；在特定语境中也指通过暴露身体获得满足的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex li tiġbed l-attenzjoni billi turi lilha nnifisha, xi drabi billi tesponi ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱炫耀、刻意引人注意的人；也可指暴露癖者。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali huwa esibizzjonista li kontinwament jipprova jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is an exhibitionist who constantly tries to attract other people's attention.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公是个爱表现的人，总想吸引别人的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark dejjem irid ikun fiċ-ċentru ta' kull ritratt? Lara: Għax hu esibizzjonista; iħobb jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark always want to be in the centre of every photo? Lara: Because he's an exhibitionist; he likes attracting attention.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么每次拍照都要站在正中间？拉拉：因为他爱表现，喜欢引人注意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark dejjem irid ikun fiċ-ċentru ta' kull ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark dejjem irid ikun fiċ-ċentru ta' kull ritratt?
messages.zh: 马克为什么每次拍照都要站在正中间？
messages.en: Why does Mark always want to be in the centre of every photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu esibizzjonista; iħobb jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu esibizzjonista; iħobb jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为他爱表现，喜欢引人注意。
messages.en: Because he's an exhibitionist; he likes attracting attention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“镜头一来就抢着站中间的人”联系起来，先记住它指人；遇到身体暴露的语境时，再理解为暴露癖者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaviour that seeks attention through conspicuous self-display, sometimes involving the exposure of private parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刻意展示自己来吸引注意的行为；在特定语境中指暴露私处的行为或倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba li biha persuna tfittex l-attenzjoni billi turi lilha nnifisha b'mod evidenti, xi drabi billi tesponi l-partijiet intimi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻意展示自己以吸引关注的炫耀行为；也指暴露癖。

collocations.zh: 爱炫耀或自我展示的倾向
一次刻意引人注目的展示行为

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddistingwi bejn l-espressjoni personali u l-esibizzjoniżmu li għandu l-għan li jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: The article distinguishes between personal expression and exhibitionism intended to attract attention.
formal.zh: 文章区分了个人表达与旨在吸引注意的炫耀行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed jagħmel dak l-istorbju kollu quddiem il-kamera? Pawlu: Naħseb li dan hu esibizzjoniżmu; irid lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is he making all that noise in front of the camera? Paul: I think it's exhibitionism; he wants everyone to look at him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他为什么在镜头前那么吵闹？保罗：我觉得这是在炫耀自己，他想让所有人都看他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jagħmel dak l-istorbju kollu quddiem il-kamera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jagħmel dak l-istorbju kollu quddiem il-kamera?
messages.zh: 他为什么在镜头前那么吵闹？
messages.en: Why is he making all that noise in front of the camera?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li dan hu esibizzjoniżmu; irid lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li dan hu esibizzjoniżmu; irid lil kulħadd iħares lejh.
messages.zh: 我觉得这是在炫耀自己，他想让所有人都看他。
messages.en: I think it's exhibitionism; he wants everyone to look at him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“为了让大家看自己而不断展示”的行为；与 esibizzjonista 配对记忆：前者记行为或倾向，后者记做出这种行为的人。

gloss_zh: 解除神职人员的教区或修会隶属关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally release a cleric from attachment to a diocese or religious institute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式解除神职人员与其所属教区或修会之间的隶属关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles formalment lil kleriku mir-rabta tiegħu ma' djoċesi jew istitut reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式解除神职人员在某教区或修会的隶属关系。

collocations.zh: 解除一名司铎的隶属关系

collocations.en: to excardinate a cleric from the diocese
collocations.zh: 解除一名神职人员与该教区的隶属关系

formal.mt: L-isqof eskardina lis-saċerdot mid-djoċesi qabel ma dan ġie inkardinat fid-djoċesi l-ġdida.
formal.en: The bishop excardinated the priest from the diocese before he was incardinated into the new diocese.
formal.zh: 在这位司铎加入新教区之前，主教解除了他与原教区的隶属关系。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser li l-isqof eskardina lis-saċerdot? Ġużeppi: Ifisser li ħelsu formalment mir-rabta tiegħu ma' dik id-djoċesi.
colloquial.en: Maria: What does it mean that the bishop excardinated the priest? Joseph: It means he formally released him from his attachment to that diocese.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：说主教解除了那位司铎的隶属关系，是什么意思？约瑟夫：意思是主教正式解除了他与那个教区的隶属关系。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-isqof eskardina lis-saċerdot?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-isqof eskardina lis-saċerdot?
messages.zh: 说主教解除了那位司铎的隶属关系，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the bishop excardinated the priest?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ħelsu formalment mir-rabta tiegħu ma' dik id-djoċesi.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ħelsu formalment mir-rabta tiegħu ma' dik id-djoċesi.
messages.zh: 意思是主教正式解除了他与那个教区的隶属关系。
messages.en: It means he formally released him from his attachment to that diocese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教区名册上的一条隶属连线被正式解除，用这个动作记住动词；重点记“解除所属关系”，不要把它等同于取消神职身份。

gloss_zh: 神职人员隶属关系的正式解除

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal release of a cleric from attachment to a diocese or religious institute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式解除神职人员与其所属教区或修会之间隶属关系的行为或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien formali ta' kleriku mir-rabta tiegħu ma' djoċesi jew istitut reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神职人员与某教区或修会隶属关系的正式解除。

formal.mt: Is-saċerdot ippreżenta talba għall-eskardinazzjoni mid-djoċesi tiegħu.
formal.en: The priest submitted a request for excardination from his diocese.
formal.zh: 这位司铎提交了与其所属教区解除隶属关系的申请。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi din l-ittra ta' eskardinazzjoni? Mark: Hija ittra dwar il-ħelsien formali tas-saċerdot mir-rabta tiegħu mad-djoċesi.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this letter of excardination? Mark: It's a letter about the priest's formal release from his attachment to the diocese.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这封解除隶属关系的信是什么？马克：这封信是关于正式解除那位司铎与教区的隶属关系的。

messages.speaker: Anna (档案助理)
messages.zh: 这封解除隶属关系的信是什么？
messages.en: What is this letter of excardination?

messages.speaker: Mark (档案管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ittra dwar il-ħelsien formali tas-saċerdot mir-rabta tiegħu mad-djoċesi.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ittra dwar il-ħelsien formali tas-saċerdot mir-rabta tiegħu mad-djoċesi.
messages.zh: 这封信是关于正式解除那位司铎与教区的隶属关系的。
messages.en: It's a letter about the priest's formal release from his attachment to the diocese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成文件夹上写着“解除教区隶属关系”的手续名称；与 eskardina 配对，动词记办理动作，名词记这项正式解除程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say something suddenly and with strong feeling, such as surprise, joy or anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因惊讶、喜悦或愤怒等强烈情绪而突然说出某句话，惊呼或感叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid xi ħaġa f'daqqa u b'emozzjoni qawwija, bħal sorpriża, ferħ jew rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因强烈情绪而惊呼、喊出或感叹道。

formal.mt: Meta ra r-riżultat, l-istudent esklama bil-ferħ: "Għaddejt!"
formal.en: When he saw the result, the student exclaimed with joy: "I passed!"
formal.zh: 看到成绩时，那名学生高兴地喊道：“我通过了！”

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal? Maja: Esklama: "Kemm hu sabiħ!" u beda jitbissem.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Paul say when he opened the present? Maja: He exclaimed, "How lovely!" and started smiling.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗打开礼物时说了什么？玛雅：他惊喜地喊道：“真漂亮！”然后笑了起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗打开礼物时说了什么？
messages.en: What did Paul say when he opened the present?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Esklama: "Kemm hu sabiħ!" u beda jitbissem.
messages.mt_standard: Esklama: "Kemm hu sabiħ!" u beda jitbissem.
messages.zh: 他惊喜地喊道：“真漂亮！”然后笑了起来。
messages.en: He exclaimed, "How lovely!" and started smiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想打开礼物时突然喊出“哇，真漂亮！”的瞬间；esklama 记的是带着强烈情绪说出来这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing a strong feeling or having the form of an exclamation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达强烈情绪的，或具有感叹形式的，常用于描述句子、语气或标点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi emozzjoni qawwija jew li għandu l-forma ta' esklamazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感叹的；表达强烈情绪或具有感叹形式的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju "Kemm hu sabiħ dan il-post!", il-punt esklamattiv jenfasizza l-emozzjoni tal-kelliem.
formal.en: In the example "How beautiful this place is!", the exclamation mark emphasizes the speaker's emotion.
formal.zh: 在“这个地方多美啊！”这一例句中，感叹号突出了说话者的情绪。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex poġġejt punt esklamattiv hawn? Mark: Għax il-karattru qed jgħajjat "Oqgħod attent!"
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you put an exclamation mark here? Mark: Because the character is shouting "Watch out!"
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在这里用了感叹号？马克：因为这个角色正在大喊“小心！”

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么在这里用了感叹号？
messages.en: Why did you put an exclamation mark here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为这个角色正在大喊“小心！”
messages.en: Because the character is shouting "Watch out!"

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 punt esklamattiv 整组记成“感叹号”，看到纸上的“！”就联想到 esklamattiv 所表达的“感叹的、带强烈情绪的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word, phrase or cry that expresses a sudden or strong feeling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达突然或强烈情绪的词语、短句或喊声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma, frażi jew għajta li tesprimi emozzjoni f'daqqa jew b'mod qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达惊讶、喜悦等强烈情绪的感叹、惊呼或感叹语。

formal.mt: L-esklamazzjoni "X'sorpriża sabiħa!" tesprimi l-ferħ tal-karattru meta jara lill-ħabib tiegħu.
formal.en: The exclamation "What a lovely surprise!" expresses the character's joy when he sees his friend.
formal.zh: “真是个美好的惊喜！”这句感叹语表达了角色见到朋友时的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Smajt dik l-esklamazzjoni? Anna: Iva, kienet esklamazzjoni ta' ferħ; Lara għadha kif rebħet il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Paul: Did you hear that exclamation? Anna: Yes, it was an exclamation of joy; Lara has just won the game.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你听到那声喊叫了吗？安娜：听到了，那是高兴的欢呼，拉拉刚刚赢了比赛。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观赛朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那声喊叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that exclamation?

messages.speaker: Anna (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet esklamazzjoni ta' ferħ; Lara għadha kif rebħet il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet esklamazzjoni ta' ferħ; Lara għadha kif rebħet il-logħba.
messages.zh: 听到了，那是高兴的欢呼，拉拉刚刚赢了比赛。
messages.en: Yes, it was an exclamation of joy; Lara has just won the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漫画气泡里的一声“哇！”：esklama 是惊呼的动作，esklamazzjoni 是那一声惊呼或那一句感叹语。

gloss_zh: 专属的；独家的；仅限特定对象的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Limited to a particular person or group, or available from only one source.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅供某个人或群体享用的，或仅由一个来源提供的；专属的、独家的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riservat għal persuna jew grupp partikolari, jew disponibbli minn sors wieħed biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专属的、独家的；仅限某些人使用、参与或获得的。

formal.mt: Il-membri għandhom aċċess esklużiv għall-arkivju diġitali tal-għaqda.
formal.en: Members have exclusive access to the association's digital archive.
formal.zh: 该协会的数字档案仅供会员访问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nuża din il-kamra? Mark: Din hi għall-użu esklużiv tal-membri, imma hemm kamra oħra miftuħa għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I use this room? Mark: This one is for members' exclusive use, but there's another room open to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以用这个房间吗？马克：这间是会员专用的，不过还有另一间向所有人开放。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我可以用这个房间吗？
messages.en: Can I use this room?

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi għall-użu esklużiv tal-membri, imma hemm kamra oħra miftuħa għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi għall-użu esklużiv tal-membri, imma hemm kamra oħra miftuħa għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 这间是会员专用的，不过还有另一间向所有人开放。
messages.en: This one is for members' exclusive use, but there's another room open to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门上写着“仅限会员”的牌子，记住 esklużiv 的核心是“限定给特定对象”；用于新闻时，再联想到只有一家拥有的独家报道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that holds a patent for an invention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有某项发明专利权的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha privattiva għal invenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专利权人；持有发明专利的个人或机构。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika lill-esklużivista u jiddeskrivi l-invenzjoni koperta mill-privattiva.
formal.en: The report identifies the patentee and describes the invention covered by the patent.
formal.zh: 报告明确了专利权人，并描述了该专利所涵盖的发明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-esklużivista ta' din l-invenzjoni? Mark: Il-kumpanija li taħdem magħha oħti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the patentee for this invention? Mark: The company my sister works for.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项发明的专利权人是谁？马克：我姐姐工作的那家公司。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-esklużivista ta' din l-invenzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-esklużivista ta' din l-invenzjoni?
messages.zh: 这项发明的专利权人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the patentee for this invention?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我姐姐工作的那家公司。
messages.en: The company my sister works for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 esklużivista 放在专利证书持有人一栏来记：它指拥有专利权的人或机构，不是发明本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or condition of being available only to a particular person, group, or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种事物、机会或权利仅供特定个人、群体或机构享有的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li tkun disponibbli biss għal persuna, grupp jew organizzazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独占性；专属性；仅供特定对象享有的性质或状态。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jagħti lill-ħanut esklużività fuq il-bejgħ ta' dan il-prodott fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The agreement gives the shop exclusivity over sales of this product in the region.
formal.zh: 该协议赋予这家商店在本地区独家销售这一产品的权利。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-prodott jinbiegħ hawn biss? Pawlu: Għax il-ħanut għandu ftehim ta' esklużività.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this product sold only here? Pawlu: Because the shop has an exclusivity agreement.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这个产品只在这里卖？保罗：因为这家店有独家协议。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-prodott jinbiegħ hawn biss?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-prodott jinbiegħ hawn biss?
messages.zh: 为什么这个产品只在这里卖？
messages.en: Why is this product sold only here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħanut għandu ftehim ta' esklużività.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħanut għandu ftehim ta' esklużività.
messages.zh: 因为这家店有独家协议。
messages.en: Because the shop has an exclusivity agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店门口写着“仅此一家”：esklużività 表示这种独家享有的状态，记忆重点是“只给特定对象”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something larger or wider in scope, or to spread over a greater area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物的规模、范围或覆盖面积增大，或向更大的区域延伸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kabbar xi ħaġa fid-daqs jew fil-firxa, jew infirex fuq żona akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩大；扩张；使规模或范围增大。
延伸；扩展；向更广的区域铺开或传播。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru espanda s-servizzi tiegħu biex jilħaq aktar familji fil-komunità.
formal.en: The centre expanded its services to reach more families in the community.
formal.zh: 该中心扩展了服务，以惠及社区内更多家庭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħanut ta' ħuk għadu żgħir? Toni: Le, espanda n-negozju u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your brother's shop still small? Toni: No, he expanded the business and opened another shop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥的店还是很小吗？托尼：不是，他扩大了业务，又开了一家店。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥的店还是很小吗？
messages.en: Is your brother's shop still small?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, espanda n-negozju u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, espanda n-negozju u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
messages.zh: 不是，他扩大了业务，又开了一家店。
messages.en: No, he expanded the business and opened another shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一家店变成两家店”的动作画面记 espanda：规模扩大了；再想象地图上的覆盖范围向外延伸，串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of becoming larger in size, volume, or scope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸、体积或范围增大的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' żieda fid-daqs, fil-volum jew fil-firxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩张；膨胀；尺寸、体积或范围的增大。

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri l-espandiment tal-arja ġewwa bużżieqa meta tissaħħan.
formal.en: The experiment shows the expansion of the air inside a balloon when it is heated.
formal.zh: 该实验展示了气球内的空气受热时发生的膨胀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-bużżieqa kibret fl-ilma sħun? David: Minħabba l-espandiment tal-arja ġewwa fiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the balloon get bigger in the warm water? David: Because of the expansion of the air inside it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么气球在温水里变大了？戴维：因为里面的空气膨胀了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 为什么气球在温水里变大了？
messages.en: Why did the balloon get bigger in the warm water?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 因为里面的空气膨胀了。
messages.en: Because of the expansion of the air inside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espandiment 配上气球慢慢变大的画面：它是名词，给“体积或范围增大”这个过程起名字。

gloss_zh: 开朗健谈的；感情外露的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open, expressive, and willing to talk freely and warmly with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人开朗外向，乐于热情交谈并自然表达感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ruħu bil-miftuħ u jitkellem bil-qalb u b'mod amikevoli mal-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开阔的；广泛的；形容人时可指开朗健谈、感情外露的。

formal.mt: Il-karattru espansiv tal-preżentatur għen biex il-mistednin iħossuhom komdi waqt l-intervista.
formal.en: The presenter's expansive personality helped the guests feel comfortable during the interview.
formal.zh: 主持人开朗健谈的性格使嘉宾在访谈中感到自在。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sibt lill-ġar il-ġdid? Mark: Hu espansiv ħafna; malajr beda jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you think of the new neighbour? Mark: He's very outgoing; he soon started chatting with us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得新邻居怎么样？马克：他很开朗，很快就和我们聊起来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new neighbour?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu espansiv ħafna; malajr beda jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu espansiv ħafna; malajr beda jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 他很开朗，很快就和我们聊起来了。
messages.en: He's very outgoing; he soon started chatting with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在描写人的语境里，把 espansiv 联想成张开双臂、主动聊天的朋友，帮助记住“开朗而善于表达”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in size, extent, activity, or the area that something covers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物在规模、范围、活动量或覆盖区域上的扩大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fid-daqs, fil-firxa, fl-attività jew fiż-żona li tkopri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩张；扩展；膨胀；规模、范围或体积的增大。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' espansjoni tal-kumpanija jinkludi żewġ fergħat ġodda u aktar impjegati.
formal.en: The company's expansion plan includes two new branches and more employees.
formal.zh: 该公司的扩张计划包括新增两家分店和增聘员工。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex qed ifittxu aktar ħaddiema? Sara: Għandhom pjan ta' espansjoni u se jiftħu fergħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why are they looking for more workers? Sara: They have an expansion plan and are going to open another branch.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：他们为什么在招更多员工？萨拉：他们有扩张计划，准备再开一家分店。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么在招更多员工？
messages.en: Why are they looking for more workers?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandhom pjan ta' espansjoni u se jiftħu fergħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandhom pjan ta' espansjoni u se jiftħu fergħa oħra.
messages.zh: 他们有扩张计划，准备再开一家分店。
messages.en: They have an expansion plan and are going to open another branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图上不断增加的分店圆点记 espansjoni：圆点越多，业务范围越大；这个名词概括“扩张”这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument that measures light to help determine suitable exposure settings for a photograph.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测量光线强度、帮助确定合适摄影曝光设置的仪器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jkejjel id-dawl biex jgħin fid-determinazzjoni tal-espożizzjoni xierqa għal ritratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曝光表；测光表；用于测量光线并辅助设定摄影曝光的仪器。

formal.mt: Il-fotografu uża espożimetru biex ikejjel id-dawl qabel ma għażel is-settings tal-kamera.
formal.en: The photographer used an exposure meter to measure the light before choosing the camera settings.
formal.zh: 摄影师先用曝光表测量光线，再选择相机设置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-istrument żgħir? David: Espożimetru; nużah biex inkejjel id-dawl qabel nieħu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that small instrument? David: An exposure meter; I use it to measure the light before taking a photo.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个小仪器是什么？戴维：曝光表；我拍照前用它测量光线。

messages.speaker: Nina (摄影学员)
messages.zh: 那个小仪器是什么？
messages.en: What's that small instrument?

messages.speaker: David (摄影老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Espożimetru; nużah biex inkejjel id-dawl qabel nieħu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Espożimetru; nużah biex inkejjel id-dawl qabel nieħu ritratt.
messages.zh: 曝光表；我拍照前用它测量光线。
messages.en: An exposure meter; I use it to measure the light before taking a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“先测光，再拍照”的顺序，把 espożimetru 想成摄影师手里的小仪表；它提供读数，帮助设置曝光。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to explain a subject or present information clearly and systematically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以清楚、有条理地解释主题或介绍信息为目的的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-għan li jispjega suġġett jew jippreżenta informazzjoni b'mod ċar u ordnat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说明性的；阐释性的；用于清楚解释主题或陈述信息的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu test espożittiv li jispjega kif l-ilma jinbidel fi fwar meta jissaħħan.
formal.en: The students wrote an expository text explaining how water turns into steam when heated.
formal.zh: 学生们写了一篇说明文，解释水受热后如何变成水蒸气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal dan il-kompitu rrid nikteb storja? Pawlu: Le, trid tikteb test espożittiv li jispjega kif taħdem xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I need to write a story for this assignment? Pawlu: No, you need to write an expository text explaining how something works.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次作业要写故事吗？保罗：不是，你要写一篇说明文，解释某种事物如何运作。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal dan il-kompitu rrid nikteb storja?
messages.mt_standard: Għal dan il-kompitu rrid nikteb storja?
messages.zh: 这次作业要写故事吗？
messages.en: Do I need to write a story for this assignment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trid tikteb test espożittiv li jispjega kif taħdem xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trid tikteb test espożittiv li jispjega kif taħdem xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 不是，你要写一篇说明文，解释某种事物如何运作。
messages.en: No, you need to write an expository text explaining how something works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 espożittiv 和课堂上的“原理说明”连起来：文章一步一步解释事物如何运作，就是说明性的文本。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go beyond a stated limit, amount or permitted level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超过规定的界限、数量或允许的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbeż limitu, ammont jew livell permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超过；超出某个界限、数量或程度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-proġett eċċeda l-baġit b'elf ewro.
formal.en: The report shows that the project exceeded the budget by one thousand euros.
