formal.zh: 报告显示，该项目超出预算一千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xahar eċċeda l-baġit tiegħu? Pawlu: Iva, nefaq ħamsin ewro aktar milli ppjana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he exceed his budget this month? Pawlu: Yes, he spent fifty euros more than he planned.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他这个月超出预算了吗？保罗：是的，他比原计划多花了五十欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他这个月超出预算了吗？
messages.en: Did he exceed his budget this month?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nefaq ħamsin ewro aktar milli ppjana.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nefaq ħamsin ewro aktar milli ppjana.
messages.zh: 是的，他比原计划多花了五十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, he spent fifty euros more than he planned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预算表上画着一条上限线，实际支出越过了线；用 eċċeda l-baġit 记住“超出了预算”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform extremely well in an activity or field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某项活动或某个领域中表现非常出色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun tajjeb ħafna u jispikka f'xi attività jew qasam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现优异；在某方面出类拔萃。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena skolastika, Mark eċċella fil-matematika u kiseb riżultati għoljin ħafna.
formal.en: During the school year, Mark excelled in mathematics and achieved very high results.
formal.zh: 本学年，马克在数学方面表现出色，取得了非常优异的成绩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Mark fil-kunċert? Lara: Eċċella! Kulħadd faħħar il-mod kif daqq.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark do at the concert? Lara: He excelled! Everyone praised his playing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在音乐会上表现怎么样？拉拉：出色极了！大家都称赞他的演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在音乐会上表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do at the concert?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Eċċella! Kulħadd faħħar il-mod kif daqq.
messages.mt_standard: Eċċella! Kulħadd faħħar il-mod kif daqq.
messages.zh: 出色极了！大家都称赞他的演奏。
messages.en: He excelled! Everyone praised his playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和成绩单上的亮眼表现联系起来：不是仅仅完成任务，而是在某个领域做得特别出色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving objection or disapproval because it is offensive, inappropriate, or otherwise unacceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因冒犯、不妥或难以接受而值得反对或受到非议的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem oġġezzjoni jew diżapprovazzjoni għax ikun offensiv, mhux xieraq jew inaċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人反感的；不妥而可受到非议的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi dan l-aġir bħala eċċepibbli minħabba n-nuqqas ta' rispett lejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The report describes this conduct as objectionable because of its lack of respect for the participants.
formal.zh: 报告认为，这种行为缺乏对参与者的尊重，因此应受非议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment kien eċċepibbli. Lara: Naqbel. Ma kellux jitkellem hekk magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment was objectionable. Lara: I agree. He should not have spoken to her like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那句话真让人反感。拉拉：我同意。他不该那样对她说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话真让人反感。
messages.en: That comment was objectionable.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel. Ma kellux jitkellem hekk magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel. Ma kellux jitkellem hekk magħha.
messages.zh: 我同意。他不该那样对她说话。
messages.en: I agree. He should not have spoken to her like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到一句失礼的话，心里马上举起反对牌；这个形容词描述的就是那种令人反感、值得非议的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take exception to something by expressing an objection or disagreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表示不赞同或不满，并提出异议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem oġġezzjoni għal xi ħaġa jew jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' qbil magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to except (to take exception, to object to)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出异议；对某事表示反对或不满。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant eċċepixxa kontra l-proposta għax ma kinitx tagħti biżżejjed żmien għall-konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The representative objected to the proposal because it did not allow enough time for consultation.
formal.zh: 代表对该提案提出异议，因为它没有留出足够的咨询时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Paul eċċepixxa kontra l-pjan? Lara: Għax ried aktar ħin biex jipprepara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Paul object to the plan? Lara: Because he wanted more time to prepare.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么反对这个计划？拉拉：因为他想要更多准备时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么反对这个计划？
messages.en: Why did Paul object to the plan?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ried aktar ħin biex jipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ried aktar ħin biex jipprepara.
messages.zh: 因为他想要更多准备时间。
messages.en: Because he wanted more time to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用会议场景记忆：有人举手说“我有异议”，这就是本词的动作；重点记住表达反对这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount or degree that is greater than what is needed, allowed, or reasonable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超过需要、规定限度或合理程度的数量或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont jew grad li jaqbeż dak li jkun meħtieġ, permess jew raġonevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过量；过度；超过所需或限额的部分。

formal.mt: Eċċess ta' ilma fil-ħamrija jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-għeruq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: An excess of water in the soil can damage plant roots.
formal.zh: 土壤中的水分过多可能损害植物根部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tferra' ftit ilma mill-borma? Lara: Hemm eċċess ta' ilma, u ma rridx li r-ross isir artab wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you pouring some water out of the pot? Lara: There is too much water, and I do not want the rice to become too soft.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把锅里的一些水倒出来？拉拉：水太多了，我不想让米饭煮得太软。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tferra' ftit ilma mill-borma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tferra' ftit ilma mill-borma?
messages.zh: 你为什么把锅里的一些水倒出来？
messages.en: Why are you pouring some water out of the pot?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm eċċess ta' ilma, u ma rridx li r-ross isir artab wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm eċċess ta' ilma, u ma rridx li r-ross isir artab wisq.
messages.zh: 水太多了，我不想让米饭煮得太软。
messages.en: There is too much water, and I do not want the rice to become too soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量杯里的水超过刻度线：超过需要或限度的那一部分就是 eċċess，可用来记忆数量或程度上的过量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used after a list to indicate that other similar items could also be included.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在列举之后，表示还有其他同类事物没有逐一说出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża wara lista biex turi li hemm affarijiet oħra simili li ma ssemmewx.

sense_translations.en_definition: et cetera, and so on, and so forth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 等等；以及其他同类事物；诸如此类。

collocations.en: books, notebooks, pencils, and so on

formal.mt: Għall-attività, l-istudenti għandhom iġibu materjal għat-tpinġija: karti, lapsijiet, kuluri, eċċetra.
formal.en: For the activity, students should bring drawing materials: paper, pencils, colours, and so on.
formal.zh: 参加活动时，学生应携带绘画材料，如纸张、铅笔、彩色画笔等等。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandna nixtru għall-piknik? Lara: Ħobż, ġobon, frott, eċċetra. Nagħmlu lista qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should we buy for the picnic? Lara: Bread, cheese, fruit, and so on. Let us make a list before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：野餐要买些什么？拉拉：面包、奶酪、水果等等。出发前我们列张清单吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 野餐要买些什么？
messages.en: What should we buy for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħobż, ġobon, frott, eċċetra. Nagħmlu lista qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħobż, ġobon, frott, eċċetra. Nagħmlu lista qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 面包、奶酪、水果等等。出发前我们列张清单吧。
messages.en: Bread, cheese, fruit, and so on. Let us make a list before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eċċetra 想成清单末尾的省略号：前面已经列出几项，后面还有同类内容，因此译作“等等”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exclude a person or thing from a general statement, rule, or requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某事排除在一般陈述、规则或要求的适用范围之外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa barra mill-applikazzjoni ta' stqarrija, regola jew rekwiżit ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把……除外；将……作为例外排除。

collocations.zh: 将儿童排除在这项规则的适用范围之外

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eċċettwa l-każijiet urġenti mir-rekwiżit li l-applikazzjoni ssir xahar qabel.
formal.en: The committee excepted urgent cases from the requirement to apply one month in advance.
formal.zh: 委员会将紧急情况列为例外，无须遵守提前一个月申请的要求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-regola tapplika wkoll għat-tfal? Lara: Le, il-kumitat eċċettwa t-tfal minn din ir-regola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this rule also apply to children? Lara: No, the committee excepted children from this rule.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项规则也适用于儿童吗？拉拉：不，委员会把儿童列为了例外。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 这项规则也适用于儿童吗？
messages.en: Does this rule also apply to children?

messages.speaker: Lara (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-kumitat eċċettwa t-tfal minn din ir-regola.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-kumitat eċċettwa t-tfal minn din ir-regola.
messages.zh: 不，委员会把儿童列为了例外。
messages.en: No, the committee excepted children from this rule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条规则画成大圆圈，再把例外对象移到圈外；本词记作“将某项除外”，并与表示“提出异议”的词分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unusually good or remarkable, or outside what is ordinary or usual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 好得非同寻常、十分突出，或超出一般情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tajjeb ħafna jew notevoli, jew li joħroġ barra minn dak li hu normali jew tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非凡的；杰出的；不同于通常情况的。

formal.mt: Il-ġurija tat il-premju lil Lara għat-talent eċċezzjonali tagħha fil-mużika.
formal.en: The jury awarded Lara the prize for her exceptional musical talent.
formal.zh: 评审团因拉拉非凡的音乐才华而将奖项授予她。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien is-servizz fir-ristorant? Lara: Kien eċċezzjonali! Il-persunal ħa ħsieb kull dettall.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the service at the restaurant? Lara: It was exceptional! The staff took care of every detail.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那家餐厅的服务怎么样？拉拉：特别出色！工作人员照顾到了每一个细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家餐厅的服务怎么样？
messages.en: How was the service at the restaurant?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien eċċezzjonali! Il-persunal ħa ħsieb kull dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Kien eċċezzjonali! Il-persunal ħa ħsieb kull dettall.
messages.zh: 特别出色！工作人员照顾到了每一个细节。
messages.en: It was exceptional! The staff took care of every detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把普通表现排成一行，其中一个高高突出；用这个画面记住“非同寻常”，夸赞才华或服务时常译为“杰出的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause excitement or to stir strong interest, emotion, or arousal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人兴奋，或激起强烈的兴趣、情感或生理上的兴奋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqanqal eċċitament, interess qawwi, emozzjoni jew tqanqil fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使兴奋；激起兴趣或情感；唤起兴奋反应。

formal.mt: Il-film eċċita l-immaġinazzjoni tal-istudenti u ħeġġiġhom jiktbu stejjer ġodda.
formal.en: The film stimulated the students' imagination and encouraged them to write new stories.
formal.zh: 这部电影激发了学生们的想象力，鼓励他们创作新的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tfal qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa? Lara: Il-filmat dwar il-vjaġġ eċċita lit-tfal. Issa kollha jridu jmorru!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the children all talking at once? Lara: The video about the trip excited them. Now they all want to go!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子们怎么都同时说起话来了？拉拉：介绍这次旅行的视频让他们兴奋起来了。现在他们全都想去！

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tfal qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tfal qed jitkellmu kollha f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 孩子们怎么都同时说起话来了？
messages.en: Why are the children all talking at once?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-filmat dwar il-vjaġġ eċċita lit-tfal. Issa kollha jridu jmorru!
messages.mt_standard: Il-filmat dwar il-vjaġġ eċċita lit-tfal. Issa kollha jridu jmorru!
messages.zh: 介绍这次旅行的视频让他们兴奋起来了。现在他们全都想去！
messages.en: The video about the trip excited them. Now they all want to go!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象平静的人看到精彩视频后眼睛发亮、兴奋说话；本词表示引发这种变化，也可用来记忆激起兴趣或想象力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily becoming excited or emotionally stirred by events or stimuli.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易因事情或刺激而兴奋、激动的，常用于描述人的性情或反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħeġġeġ jew jitqanqal emozzjonalment malajr minħabba xi ġrajja jew stimolu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易兴奋的；易激动的

formal.mt: L-għalliem osserva li t-tifel kien eċċitabbli u kellu bżonn ambjent kalm waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher observed that the boy was excitable and needed a calm environment during the lesson.
formal.zh: 老师观察到，这个男孩容易兴奋，上课时需要安静平和的环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħuk qed jaqbeż hekk? Lara: Hu eċċitabbli ħafna; għadu kemm sema' li se mmorru l-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is your brother jumping around like that? Lara: He's very excitable; he's just heard that we're going to the seaside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟怎么这样蹦来蹦去？拉拉：他特别容易兴奋，刚听说我们要去海边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟怎么这样蹦来蹦去？
messages.en: Why is your brother jumping around like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu eċċitabbli ħafna; għadu kemm sema' li se mmorru l-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Hu eċċitabbli ħafna; għadu kemm sema' li se mmorru l-baħar.
messages.zh: 他特别容易兴奋，刚听说我们要去海边。
messages.en: He's very excitable; he's just heard that we're going to the seaside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子一听到出游就跳起来：用这个画面记住“容易兴奋的”性情，而不是一次兴奋的情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of enthusiasm and emotional energy about something happening or expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因正在发生或即将发生的事情而产生的兴奋、激动或热切期待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ħeġġa u emozzjoni qawwija dwar xi ħaġa li qed tiġri jew li wieħed qed jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴奋；激动；热切期待的心情

formal.mt: It-tħabbira tar-riżultati qajmet eċċitament kbir fost l-istudenti.
formal.en: The announcement of the results caused great excitement among the students.
formal.zh: 成绩公布后，学生们十分激动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest għall-vjaġġ ta' għada? Nina: Iva, ma nistax norqod bl-eċċitament!
colloquial.en: Mark: Ready for tomorrow's trip? Nina: Yes, I can't sleep from all the excitement!
colloquial.zh: 马克：准备好明天的旅行了吗？妮娜：准备好了，我兴奋得睡不着！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 准备好明天的旅行了吗？
messages.en: Ready for tomorrow's trip?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 准备好了，我兴奋得睡不着！
messages.en: Yes, I can't sleep from all the excitement!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与“旅行前夜兴奋得睡不着”联系起来，记住它是兴奋这种心情的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of stimulating a system into an active or higher-energy state, especially in scientific contexts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺激某个系统，使其进入活跃状态或较高能量状态的过程，尤用于科学语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih stimolu jqiegħed sistema fi stat attiv jew fi stat ta' enerġija ogħla, speċjalment f'kuntest xjentifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激发；兴奋作用，指系统受到刺激后进入活跃状态或较高能量状态

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi osservaw l-eċċitazzjoni tan-newroni wara l-istimolu elettriku.
formal.en: The researchers observed the excitation of the neurons after the electrical stimulus.
formal.zh: 研究人员观察了电刺激后神经元的兴奋情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser eċċitazzjoni f'dan l-esperiment? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser li l-istimolu jagħmel lin-newroni attivi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does excitation mean in this experiment? Pawlu: Here it means that the stimulus makes the neurons active.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个实验里的“兴奋作用”是什么意思？保罗：这里是指刺激使神经元活跃起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个实验里的“兴奋作用”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does excitation mean in this experiment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li l-istimolu jagħmel lin-newroni attivi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li l-istimolu jagħmel lin-newroni attivi.
messages.zh: 这里是指刺激使神经元活跃起来。
messages.en: Here it means that the stimulus makes the neurons active.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验图中“刺激进入，系统活跃”的箭头，用来记住科学语境中的激发过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release semen from the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出精液，即射精；用于生理或医学语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ is-semen mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 射精；排出精液。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta li eġakula mingħajr uġigħ.
formal.en: The patient reported that he ejaculated without pain.
formal.zh: 患者报告说，他射精时没有疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kellek uġigħ meta eġakulajt? Mark: Le, ma ħassejt l-ebda uġigħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you have pain when you ejaculated? Mark: No, I did not feel any pain.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你射精时有疼痛吗？马克：没有，我没有感到任何疼痛。

messages.speaker: Lara (医生)
messages.zh: 你射精时有疼痛吗？
messages.en: Did you have pain when you ejaculated?

messages.speaker: Mark (成年患者)
messages.zh: 没有，我没有感到任何疼痛。
messages.en: No, I did not feel any pain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进医生询问生理现象的场景中，整句记住“射精时没有疼痛”，帮助掌握中性医学用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interjection expressing an affirmative answer or agreement, like yes or yeah.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示肯定回答或同意的感叹词，相当于“嗯”“是的”或“对”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex twieġeb fl-affermattiv jew turi qbil, bħal iva.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of iva: yes, yep, yeah
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 iva 同义，表示“是的”“对”“嗯”。

formal.mt: Fit-traskrizzjoni tal-intervista, il-kelma 'eħe' turi li l-parteċipant wieġeb fl-affermattiv.
formal.en: In the interview transcript, the word 'eħe' indicates that the participant answered affirmatively.
formal.zh: 在访谈文字记录中，eħe 一词表明参与者作出了肯定回答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi magħna? Pawlu: Eħe, niġi!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come with us? Pawlu: Yeah, I'll come!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我们一起去吗？保罗：嗯，我去！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come with us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯，我去！
messages.en: Yeah, I'll come!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友发出邀请时，你一边点头一边说 eħe，把它和中文轻松肯定的“嗯，对”一起记。

gloss_zh: 北非吹来的、通常夹沙的南风；干燥空气

teaching_sense.en_definition: A southerly wind from North Africa that generally carries sand; also, dry air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从北非吹来、通常夹带沙尘的南风；也指干燥的空气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ min-nofsinhar li jiġi mill-Afrika ta' Fuq u ġeneralment iġorr ir-ramel; ukoll, arja xotta.

sense_translations.en_definition: southerly wind blowing from North Africa gen. carrying sand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从北非吹来、通常夹带沙尘的南风。
干燥的空气。

collocations.en: a strong southerly wind from North Africa
collocations.zh: 从北非吹来的强劲南风

collocations.en: the southerly wind and the sand
the dry air in the room

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi eħtrieq qawwi mill-Afrika ta' Fuq li ġarr ir-ramel lejn il-gżejjer.
formal.en: The report describes a strong southerly wind from North Africa that carried sand towards the islands.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一股从北非吹来的强劲南风，风将沙尘带向群岛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ramel fuq il-gallarija? Pawlu: Minħabba l-eħtrieq; illum ir-riħ ġej mill-Afrika ta' Fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much sand on the balcony? Pawlu: Because of the southerly wind; today the wind is coming from North Africa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：阳台上怎么有这么多沙子？保罗：是这股南风带来的；今天的风是从北非吹来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ramel fuq il-gallarija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ramel fuq il-gallarija?
messages.zh: 阳台上怎么有这么多沙子？
messages.en: Why is there so much sand on the balcony?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-eħtrieq; illum ir-riħ ġej mill-Afrika ta' Fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-eħtrieq; illum ir-riħ ġej mill-Afrika ta' Fuq.
messages.zh: 是这股南风带来的；今天的风是从北非吹来的。
messages.en: Because of the southerly wind; today the wind is coming from North Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从北非指向马耳他的风向箭头，旁边添上沙点来记南风义；再配一张干燥空气图卡来记第二义。

gloss_zh: 寒冷天气引起的嘴唇干裂

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chapping of the lips in chilly weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天气寒冷时出现的嘴唇干裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qsim fix-xufftejn meta t-temp ikun kiesaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: chapping of the lips in chilly weather
sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷天气造成的嘴唇干裂。

collocations.en: chapping of the lips due to the cold
collocations.zh: 因寒冷而出现的嘴唇干裂

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant irrapporta eħtriq tax-xufftejn wara ġurnata barra fil-kesħa.
formal.en: The participant reported chapping of the lips after a day outside in the cold.
formal.zh: 参与者报告说，在寒冷的户外待了一天后出现了嘴唇干裂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi eħtriq fix-xufftejn wara l-mixja fil-kesħa. Lara: Iva, nara li xufftejk huma maqsumin.
colloquial.en: Maja: My lips are chapped after the walk in the cold. Lara: Yes, I can see that your lips are cracked.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：在冷天走了一趟之后，我的嘴唇干裂了。拉拉：嗯，我看见你的嘴唇裂开了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi eħtriq fix-xufftejn wara l-mixja fil-kesħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi eħtriq fix-xufftejn wara l-mixja fil-kesħa.
messages.zh: 在冷天走了一趟之后，我的嘴唇干裂了。
messages.en: My lips are chapped after the walk in the cold.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nara li xufftejk huma maqsumin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nara li xufftejk huma maqsumin.
messages.zh: 嗯，我看见你的嘴唇裂开了。
messages.en: Yes, I can see that your lips are cracked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eħtriq 写在一张冷天嘴唇干裂的图卡上；和表示南风的 eħtrieq 并排比较，特别留意后者多出的字母 e。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Humorous or fond of making jokes that amuse other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有幽默感的，或喜欢开玩笑逗别人开心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu sens ta' umoriżmu jew iħobb jiċċajta u jdaħħaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幽默的；风趣的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ċajtier juża l-umoriżmu biex jagħmel il-lezzjoni aktar interessanti.
formal.en: The humorous teacher uses humour to make the lesson more interesting.
formal.zh: 这位幽默的老师运用幽默让课堂更加有趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu ċajtier Pawlu! Mark: Veru, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġegħelna nidħku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is so funny! Mark: He really is; he always finds something to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗真幽默！马克：确实，他总能找到点什么逗我们笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗真幽默！
messages.en: Pawlu is so funny!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġegħelna nidħku.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġegħelna nidħku.
messages.zh: 确实，他总能找到点什么逗我们笑。
messages.en: He really is; he always finds something to make us laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċajtier 和课堂上总能逗笑大家的老师联系起来，记住它描述人的幽默特点。

gloss_zh: 粗鲁无礼的；待人粗野的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rude and discourteous in the way one treats other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人粗鲁、缺乏礼貌和体谅的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod goff u bla kortesija ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗鲁无礼的；待人不友善、缺乏礼数的。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ċakkari għajjat mal-impjegat u telaq mingħajr ma rringrazzjah għall-għajnuna.
formal.en: The rude customer shouted at the employee and left without thanking him for his help.
formal.zh: 那位无礼的顾客冲员工大喊，离开时也没有感谢他的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu ċakkari? Luqa: Għax weġibni ħażin meta tlabtu jgħinni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say that man is rude? Luqa: Because he answered me rudely when I asked him to help.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说那个男人很无礼？卢卡：因为我请他帮忙时，他很不客气地回了我。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu ċakkari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dak ir-raġel hu ċakkari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个男人很无礼？
messages.en: Why do you say that man is rude?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax weġibni ħażin meta tlabtu jgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax weġibni ħażin meta tlabtu jgħinni.
messages.zh: 因为我请他帮忙时，他很不客气地回了我。
messages.en: Because he answered me rudely when I asked him to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人面对礼貌求助却粗声回话，用这个场景记住 ċakkari 所表达的粗鲁无礼。

gloss_zh: 挑战；需要努力应对的难题

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficult task or situation that requires effort, skill or determination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要付出努力、运用技能或坚持才能应对的任务或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompitu jew sitwazzjoni diffiċli li titlob sforz, ħila jew determinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑战；需要努力或能力才能克服的困难。

formal.mt: It-tlestija tal-proġett fi żmien ġimgħa kienet ċalinġ kbir għat-tim kollu.
formal.en: Completing the project within a week was a major challenge for the whole team.
formal.zh: 在一周内完成项目，对整个团队都是一项重大挑战。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din it-tellieqa se tkun ċalinġ għalija. Pawlu: Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien biex tkun lesta.
colloquial.en: Maja: This race will be a challenge for me. Pawlu: We can train together so that you are ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这场比赛对我来说会是个挑战。保罗：我们可以一起训练，让你做好准备。

messages.speaker: Maja (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tellieqa se tkun ċalinġ għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tellieqa se tkun ċalinġ għalija.
messages.zh: 这场比赛对我来说会是个挑战。
messages.en: This race will be a challenge for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (跑步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien biex tkun lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitħarrġu flimkien biex tkun lesta.
messages.zh: 我们可以一起训练，让你做好准备。
messages.en: We can train together so that you are ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċalinġ 放进首次参加比赛的画面：有难度，需要准备和努力，因此是一项挑战。

gloss_zh: 行动迟缓的；惯于慢吞吞移动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to move slowly and sluggishly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 往往移动缓慢、行动拖沓的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiċċaqlaq bil-mod u b'toqol.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to move sluggishly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有行动迟缓、慢吞吞移动的倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to move sluggishly
collocations.zh: 一个行动总是慢吞吞的男孩

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ċallami mexa bil-mod lejn il-bieb, u l-oħrajn kellhom jistennewh.
formal.en: The sluggish-moving man walked slowly towards the door, and the others had to wait for him.
formal.zh: 那个行动迟缓的男子慢慢走向门口，其他人只好等他。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li Luqa hu ċallami? Mark: Għax dejjem jimxi bil-mod ħafna, anki meta nkunu mgħaġġlin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say Luqa tends to move sluggishly? Mark: Because he always walks very slowly, even when we are in a hurry.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说卢卡行动慢吞吞的？马克：因为他总是走得特别慢，即使我们赶时间也一样。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li Luqa hu ċallami?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li Luqa hu ċallami?
messages.zh: 你为什么说卢卡行动慢吞吞的？
messages.en: Why do you say Luqa tends to move sluggishly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jimxi bil-mod ħafna, anki meta nkunu mgħaġġlin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jimxi bil-mod ħafna, anki meta nkunu mgħaġġlin.
messages.zh: 因为他总是走得特别慢，即使我们赶时间也一样。
messages.en: Because he always walks very slowly, even when we are in a hurry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家已经走到门口，有个人仍慢吞吞挪步，用这一画面记住 ċallami 描述行动迟缓的倾向。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；涂抹；搞砸；天气转阴；乱涂油漆；笨手笨脚的人；涂抹油漆者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sully or smear a surface, daub paint carelessly, botch a task, or, of the weather, turn cloudy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弄脏或涂抹表面、胡乱涂油漆、把事情做砸；也可指天气转阴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ jew jidlek wiċċ, jidlek iż-żebgħa bla ħila, jagħmel xogħol ħażin, jew, meta jingħad għat-temp, isir imsaħħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使受到污损。
涂抹；把某种物质抹在表面上。
把任务做砸；笨拙或草率地处理工作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn cloudy (used of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气转阴；变得多云。
胡乱或粗笨地涂抹油漆。
笨手笨脚、常把事情做砸的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who smears paint on a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在表面涂抹油漆的人。

collocations.en: he daubed the wall with paint
collocations.zh: 他在墙上胡乱涂了油漆

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċallas il-ħajt biż-żebgħa, u kien meħtieġ li x-xogħol jerġa' jsir.
formal.en: The worker daubed the wall with paint, and the work had to be done again.
formal.zh: 工人在墙上胡乱涂抹油漆，结果这项工作必须重做。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ċallas il-ħajt b'din iż-żebgħa? Mark: Jien; użajt wisq żebgħa u ma ħdimtx b'attenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who smeared this paint all over the wall? Mark: I did; I used too much paint and did not work carefully.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这油漆乱抹在墙上了？马克：是我；我用了太多油漆，干活也不够仔细。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把这油漆乱抹在墙上了？
messages.en: Who smeared this paint all over the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; użajt wisq żebgħa u ma ħdimtx b'attenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; użajt wisq żebgħa u ma ħdimtx b'attenzjoni.
messages.zh: 是我；我用了太多油漆，干活也不够仔细。
messages.en: I did; I used too much paint and did not work carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用乱涂油漆的画面记住弄脏、涂抹和搞砸几个义项；天气转阴另作场景记忆，名词用法则指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wet and muddy, especially when describing ground or a path.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 潮湿且有泥的，尤其用于描述地面或道路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imxarrab u mimli tajn, speċjalment meta jiddeskrivi l-art jew passaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿而泥泞的；又湿又多泥的。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-passaġġ baqa' ċallasi u l-mixja saret aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: After the rain, the path remained wet and muddy, making the walk more difficult.
formal.zh: 雨后，小路仍然湿而泥泞，行走变得更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt l-istvali? Pawlu: Għax il-passaġġ għadu ċallasi wara x-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring boots? Pawlu: Because the path is still wet and muddy after the rain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么带了靴子？保罗：因为下过雨，小路还很泥泞。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么带了靴子？
messages.en: Why did you bring boots?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-passaġġ għadu ċallasi wara x-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-passaġġ għadu ċallasi wara x-xita.
messages.zh: 因为下过雨，小路还很泥泞。
messages.en: Because the path is still wet and muddy after the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后靴底沾满湿泥的小路，把 ċallasi 和又湿又泥泞的触感一起记住。

gloss_zh: 为侮辱而点名；指名辱骂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To refer to someone by name with the intention of insulting them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀着侮辱对方的意图，直接提及其姓名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isemmi lil xi ħadd b'ismu bl-intenzjoni li jinsulentah.

sense_translations.en_definition: to refer to a person by name with a view to insulting them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了侮辱某人而提及其姓名；指名辱骂。

collocations.en: he named someone with insulting intent
collocations.zh: 他带着侮辱意图点了某人的名字

collocations.en: he singled out a colleague by name to insult them in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 他当着所有人的面点名侮辱了一位同事

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ċama lil kollega b'ismu biex jinsulentah quddiem kulħadd.
formal.en: During the meeting, he referred to a colleague by name in order to insult him in front of everyone.
formal.zh: 会议期间，他直接点了一位同事的名字，意在当众侮辱他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ċama lil Mark quddiem kulħadd? Pawlu: Ried jinsulentah, imma ma kellux jagħmel hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he single Mark out by name to insult him in front of everyone? Pawlu: He wanted to insult him, but he should not have done that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么当众点名侮辱马克？保罗：他想羞辱马克，但他不该这么做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ċama lil Mark quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ċama lil Mark quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 他为什么当众点名侮辱马克？
messages.en: Why did he single Mark out by name to insult him in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jinsulentah, imma ma kellux jagħmel hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jinsulentah, imma ma kellux jagħmel hekk.
messages.zh: 他想羞辱马克，但他不该这么做。
messages.en: He wanted to insult him, but he should not have done that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住会议上带着羞辱意图点出别人姓名的场景；ċama 的关键是点名时有侮辱意图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A severe telling-off, warning or admonition intended to correct someone's behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在纠正某人行为的严厉训斥、警告或告诫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċanfira qawwija, twissija jew twiddiba biex xi ħadd ibiddel l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一顿严厉的训斥；狠狠的责骂。
警告；提醒某人注意问题或后果的话。
告诫；针对不当行为作出的劝诫或责备。

collocations.en: he gave him a severe telling-off
collocations.zh: 他狠狠训斥了对方一顿

formal.mt: L-impjegat irċieva ċamata mingħand il-maniġer wara li injora r-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The employee received a severe telling-off from the manager after ignoring the safety rules.
formal.zh: 那名员工无视安全规定，随后受到了经理的严厉训斥。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qlajt ċamata mingħand l-għalliema? Luqa: Għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni wara li wissietni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you get a telling-off from the teacher? Luqa: Because I kept talking during the lesson after she had warned me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么挨老师训了？卢卡：因为她警告过我之后，我上课还是一直讲话。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么挨老师训了？
messages.en: Why did you get a telling-off from the teacher?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni wara li wissietni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni wara li wissietni.
messages.zh: 因为她警告过我之后，我上课还是一直讲话。
messages.en: Because I kept talking during the lesson after she had warned me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċamata 想成老师要求学生改正行为的一番话；按语境分别记作严厉训斥、警告或告诫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to remove substantial amounts of wood during initial rough shaping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木工初步加工时使用的刨子，用于较快地刨去较多木料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tintuża fil-bidu tax-xogħol biex jitneħħa ħafna injam u tingħata forma inizjali lill-biċċa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗刨，用于木料初步加工和较大量去料的木工刨。

collocations.en: remove wood with a scrub plane
adjust the blade of the scrub plane

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-ħidma, il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tal-brix biex ineħħi l-injam żejjed mill-bord.
formal.en: At the beginning of the work, the carpenter used a scrub plane to remove excess wood from the board.
formal.zh: 开始加工时，木匠用粗刨刨去了木板上多余的木料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ċana nuża biex inneħħi dan l-injam żejjed? Pawlu: Uża ċ-ċana tal-brix l-ewwel; wara nkunu nistgħu nillixxaw il-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which plane should I use to remove this excess wood? Pawlu: Use the scrub plane first; afterward we can smooth the surface.
colloquial.zh: Lara：要刨掉这些多余的木料，我该用哪把刨子？Pawlu：先用粗刨，之后我们再把表面刨平。

messages.speaker: Lara (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ċana nuża biex inneħħi dan l-injam żejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ċana nuża biex inneħħi dan l-injam żejjed?
messages.zh: 要刨掉这些多余的木料，我该用哪把刨子？
messages.en: Which plane should I use to remove this excess wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża ċ-ċana tal-brix l-ewwel; wara nkunu nistgħu nillixxaw il-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Uża ċ-ċana tal-brix l-ewwel; wara nkunu nistgħu nillixxaw il-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 先用粗刨，之后我们再把表面刨平。
messages.en: Use the scrub plane first; afterward we can smooth the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在木工流程的第一步记忆：先用粗刨去掉多余木料，再做精细加工。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to take fine shavings and leave a smooth surface on wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于刨下薄木屑、使木料表面平滑细致的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tneħħi saffi rqaq tal-injam biex tħalli l-wiċċ lixx u fin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精刨，通过细薄刨削使木料表面平滑的木工刨。

collocations.en: smooth a board with a smoothing plane

collocations.mt: taġġusta ċ-ċana tal-ippulir għal qatgħa rqiqa
collocations.en: adjust the smoothing plane for a fine cut
collocations.zh: 将精刨调到薄刨削状态

formal.mt: Wara l-iffurmar inizjali, il-mastrudaxxa għadda ċ-ċana tal-ippulir fuq il-bord biex jikseb wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: After the initial shaping, the carpenter passed the smoothing plane over the board to obtain a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 初步成形后，木匠用精刨刨过木板，使表面变得平滑。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-bord għadu mhux lixx biżżejjed. Ġużeppi: Ipprova ċ-ċana tal-ippulir u neħħi biss saff irqiq.
colloquial.en: Marta: The board still isn't smooth enough. Ġużeppi: Try the smoothing plane and remove only a thin layer.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这块木板还不够光滑。Ġużeppi：试试精刨，只刨掉薄薄一层。

messages.speaker: Marta (木工学徒)
messages.zh: 这块木板还不够光滑。
messages.en: The board still isn't smooth enough.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova ċ-ċana tal-ippulir u neħħi biss saff irqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova ċ-ċana tal-ippulir u neħħi biss saff irqiq.
messages.zh: 试试精刨，只刨掉薄薄一层。
messages.en: Try the smoothing plane and remove only a thin layer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌摸过细滑木板的画面，把这个词与最后几下轻薄精刨联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to prepare grooves for decorative banding in wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在木料上加工装饰镶条所需沟槽的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tintuża biex isiru kanali fl-injam għal strixxi dekorattivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镶条槽刨，用于加工装饰镶条所需沟槽的木工刨。

collocations.en: prepare a groove with a banding plane

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tal-kanali biex iħejji kanal għall-istrixxa dekorattiva fil-pannell.
formal.en: The carpenter used a banding plane to prepare a groove for the decorative strip in the panel.
formal.zh: 木匠用镶条槽刨在面板上加工了一道沟槽，以便嵌入装饰条。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se nħejju l-kanal għal din l-istrixxa? Mark: Biċ-ċana tal-kanali; l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to prepare the groove for this strip? Mark: With the banding plane; first we need to mark where it will run.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这根镶条要用的槽怎么加工？Mark：用镶条槽刨；我们得先标出槽的位置。

messages.speaker: Nina (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nħejju l-kanal għal din l-istrixxa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nħejju l-kanal għal din l-istrixxa?
messages.zh: 这根镶条要用的槽怎么加工？
messages.en: How are we going to prepare the groove for this strip?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Biċ-ċana tal-kanali; l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Biċ-ċana tal-kanali; l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 用镶条槽刨；我们得先标出槽的位置。
messages.en: With the banding plane; first we need to mark where it will run.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条装饰镶条嵌进木板沟槽，把工具、沟槽和镶条三个画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane with a rounded cutting profile, used to form concave curves in wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刨削轮廓呈凸圆形、用于在木料上加工凹曲面的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana b'xafra bi profil tond 'il barra, li tintuża biex tifforma wiċċ mgħawweġ 'il ġewwa fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凸底刨，以凸圆形刨削轮廓加工木料凹曲面的木工刨。

collocations.en: form a concave surface with a round plane

formal.mt: Biex jifforma l-parti konkava tal-profil, il-mastrudaxxa għażel ċana tal-kavar adattata għall-kurva mixtieqa.
formal.en: To form the concave part of the profile, the carpenter selected a round plane suited to the desired curve.
formal.zh: 为了加工截面中的凹曲面部分，木匠选择了一把适合目标曲线的凸底刨。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-parti trid tkun mgħawġa 'il ġewwa, hux? Toni: Iva, għalhekk se nużaw iċ-ċana tal-kavar.
colloquial.en: Sara: This part needs to curve inward, right? Toni: Yes, that's why we're going to use the round plane.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这一部分要向内凹，对吧？Toni：对，所以我们要用凸底刨。

messages.speaker: Sara (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-parti trid tkun mgħawġa 'il ġewwa, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-parti trid tkun mgħawġa 'il ġewwa, hux?
messages.zh: 这一部分要向内凹，对吧？
messages.en: This part needs to curve inward, right?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk se nużaw iċ-ċana tal-kavar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk se nużaw iċ-ċana tal-kavar.
messages.zh: 对，所以我们要用凸底刨。
messages.en: Yes, that's why we're going to use the round plane.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住形状互补的画面：凸圆的刨削轮廓伸入木料，留下向内凹的曲面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to make matching tongues and grooves along board edges so the boards fit together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在木板边缘加工相互配合的榫舌和凹槽，使木板能够拼接的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tintuża biex tifforma ilsien u kanal korrispondenti fit-truf tal-bordijiet ħalli dawn jidħlu f'xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 榫槽刨，用于加工木板边缘相配榫舌和凹槽的木工刨，也称企口刨。

collocations.mt: tagħmel ilsien u kanal b'ċana tal-mudullun
collocations.en: make a tongue and groove with a tongue and groove plane
collocations.zh: 用榫槽刨加工榫舌和凹槽

collocations.en: prepare board edges with the tongue and groove plane
collocations.zh: 用榫槽刨加工木板边缘

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ħejja t-truf tal-bordijiet b'ċana tal-mudullun sabiex l-ilsien ta' bord jidħol fil-kanal tal-ieħor.
formal.en: The carpenter prepared the board edges with a tongue and groove plane so that the tongue of one board would fit into the groove of the other.
formal.zh: 木匠用榫槽刨加工木板边缘，使一块板的榫舌能够嵌入另一块板的凹槽。

colloquial.mt: David: Kif se nagħmlu dawn iż-żewġ bordijiet jidħlu f'xulxin? Rita: Nużaw iċ-ċana tal-mudullun biex nagħmlu ilsien fuq wieħed u kanal fuq l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: David: How are we going to make these two boards fit together? Rita: We'll use the tongue and groove plane to make a tongue on one and a groove on the other.
colloquial.zh: David：怎样才能让这两块木板拼合起来？Rita：用榫槽刨，在一块板上加工榫舌，在另一块板上加工凹槽。

messages.speaker: David (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħmlu dawn iż-żewġ bordijiet jidħlu f'xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħmlu dawn iż-żewġ bordijiet jidħlu f'xulxin?
messages.zh: 怎样才能让这两块木板拼合起来？
messages.en: How are we going to make these two boards fit together?

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Nużaw iċ-ċana tal-mudullun biex nagħmlu ilsien fuq wieħed u kanal fuq l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Nużaw iċ-ċana tal-mudullun biex nagħmlu ilsien fuq wieħed u kanal fuq l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 用榫槽刨，在一块板上加工榫舌，在另一块板上加工凹槽。
messages.en: We'll use the tongue and groove plane to make a tongue on one and a groove on the other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两块木板想成拼图：一边伸出榫舌，一边留出凹槽，这把刨帮助它们咬合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to cut a shaped decorative profile along a wooden edge or strip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于沿木料边缘或木条刨出特定装饰轮廓的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tintuża biex tagħti profil dekorattiv lil tarf jew strixxa tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线脚刨，用于在木料上刨出装饰性线脚轮廓的成形刨。

collocations.en: make a decorative profile with a moulding plane
collocations.zh: 用线脚刨加工装饰轮廓

collocations.en: choose a moulding plane for the frame

formal.mt: Biex iżejjen il-qafas, il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tal-orlu biex joħloq profil dekorattiv tul it-tarf tal-injam.
formal.en: To decorate the frame, the carpenter used a moulding plane to create a decorative profile along the wooden edge.
formal.zh: 为了装饰框架，木匠用线脚刨沿木料边缘刨出了装饰轮廓。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Nistgħu nagħmlu dan it-tarf aktar dekorattiv? Simon: Iva, biċ-ċana tal-orlu nistgħu nagħtuh dan il-profil.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can we make this edge more decorative? Simon: Yes, with the moulding plane we can give it this profile.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这条边能做得更有装饰感吗？Simon：可以，用线脚刨就能把它加工成这个轮廓。

messages.speaker: Elena (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nagħmlu dan it-tarf aktar dekorattiv?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nagħmlu dan it-tarf aktar dekorattiv?
messages.zh: 这条边能做得更有装饰感吗？
messages.en: Can we make this edge more decorative?

messages.speaker: Simon (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biċ-ċana tal-orlu nistgħu nagħtuh dan il-profil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biċ-ċana tal-orlu nistgħu nagħtuh dan il-profil.
messages.zh: 可以，用线脚刨就能把它加工成这个轮廓。
messages.en: Yes, with the moulding plane we can give it this profile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象普通木框的直边变成有起伏的装饰线条，把这把刨与线脚轮廓相联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to shape wooden members of a glazed window sash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于加工镶玻璃窗扇木构件形状的专用木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li tintuża biex tifforma l-partijiet tal-injam ta' qafas ta' tieqa li jżomm il-ħġieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗扇刨，用于加工镶玻璃窗扇木构件的专用刨子。

collocations.en: shape the window woodwork with a sash plane
collocations.zh: 用窗扇刨加工窗户木构件

collocations.en: adjust the blade of the sash plane

formal.mt: Waqt il-manifattura tat-tieqa, il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tal-vitrati biex jifforma l-partijiet tal-injam qabel it-twaħħil tal-ħġieġ.
formal.en: During the making of the window, the carpenter used a sash plane to shape the wooden members before fitting the glass.
formal.zh: 制作窗户时，木匠在安装玻璃之前，用窗扇刨加工了窗扇的木构件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema ċana se nużaw għal dawn il-partijiet tat-tieqa? Anton: Iċ-ċana tal-vitrati; l-ewwel irridu nagħtuhom il-forma t-tajba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which plane are we going to use for these window parts? Anton: The sash plane; first we need to give them the right shape.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这些窗户构件要用哪把刨子加工？Anton：用窗扇刨；我们得先把它们加工成合适的形状。

messages.speaker: Marija (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ċana se nużaw għal dawn il-partijiet tat-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ċana se nużaw għal dawn il-partijiet tat-tieqa?
messages.zh: 这些窗户构件要用哪把刨子加工？
messages.en: Which plane are we going to use for these window parts?

messages.speaker: Anton (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċana tal-vitrati; l-ewwel irridu nagħtuhom il-forma t-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċana tal-vitrati; l-ewwel irridu nagħtuhom il-forma t-tajba.
messages.zh: 用窗扇刨；我们得先把它们加工成合适的形状。
messages.en: The sash plane; first we need to give them the right shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尚未装玻璃的木窗扇：先用这把刨加工木构件，再让玻璃进入窗扇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane with a hollow cutting profile, used to form convex curves on wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刨削轮廓呈内凹形、用于在木料上加工外凸曲面的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana b'xafra bi profil mgħawweġ 'il ġewwa, li tintuża biex tifforma wiċċ tond 'il barra fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凹底刨，以内凹的刨削轮廓加工木料外凸曲面的木工刨。

collocations.en: form a convex surface with a hollow plane
collocations.zh: 用凹底刨加工外凸曲面

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tat-tond biex jifforma l-parti konvessa tal-profil tul l-istrixxa tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter used a hollow plane to form the convex part of the profile along the wooden strip.
formal.zh: 木匠用凹底刨沿木条加工了轮廓中向外凸起的部分。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Din il-parti trid tkun tonda 'il barra? Karl: Iva, u ċ-ċana tat-tond tgħinna nagħmlu dik il-kurva.
colloquial.en: Julia: Does this part need to curve outward? Karl: Yes, and the hollow plane will help us make that curve.
colloquial.zh: Julia：这一部分要做成向外凸的圆弧吗？Karl：对，用凹底刨可以帮我们加工出那道弧面。

messages.speaker: Julia (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-parti trid tkun tonda 'il barra?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-parti trid tkun tonda 'il barra?
messages.zh: 这一部分要做成向外凸的圆弧吗？
messages.en: Does this part need to curve outward?

messages.speaker: Karl (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ċ-ċana tat-tond tgħinna nagħmlu dik il-kurva.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ċ-ċana tat-tond tgħinna nagħmlu dik il-kurva.
messages.zh: 对，用凹底刨可以帮我们加工出那道弧面。
messages.en: Yes, and the hollow plane will help us make that curve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住凹凸互补：刨子的轮廓向内凹，包住木料向外凸的弧面，帮助修出圆弧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to shape or smooth curved wooden surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木工用来修整或刨平弯曲木面的刨子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-injam li tintuża biex issawwar jew twitti uċuħ mgħawġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曲面刨；用于加工弯曲木面的刨子。

collocations.en: to work a curved surface with a compass plane
collocations.zh: 用曲面刨加工弯曲表面

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana tonda biex iwitti l-wiċċ mgħawweġ tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter used a compass plane to smooth the curved surface of the wood.
formal.zh: 木匠用曲面刨修平了木料的弯曲表面。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema ċana għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa mgħawġa? Pawlu: Uża ċana tonda; tkun tista' taħdem il-kurva aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which plane should I use for this curved piece? Pawlu: Use a compass plane; you'll be able to work the curve better.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这块弯曲的木料该用哪种刨子？保罗：用曲面刨，这样更容易加工弯曲部分。

messages.speaker: Marta (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ċana għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa mgħawġa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ċana għandi nuża għal din il-biċċa mgħawġa?
messages.zh: 这块弯曲的木料该用哪种刨子？
messages.en: Which plane should I use for this curved piece?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża ċana tonda; tkun tista' taħdem il-kurva aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Uża ċana tonda; tkun tista' taħdem il-kurva aħjar.
messages.zh: 用曲面刨，这样更容易加工弯曲部分。
messages.en: Use a compass plane; you'll be able to work the curve better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组和弯曲木面的画面一起记：木面有弧度，便想到曲面刨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cooper's plane used to shape or smooth the inside surface of a wooden cask.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制桶工匠用来修整或刨平木桶内侧表面的专用刨子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana li juża l-buttar biex isawwar jew iwitti l-wiċċ ta' ġewwa ta' bettija tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桶匠内壁刨；用于修整木桶内侧表面的专用刨具。

collocations.mt: twitti ġewwa l-bettija b'ċana tonda tal-buttara
collocations.en: to smooth the inside of a cask with a howel
collocations.zh: 用桶匠内壁刨修平木桶内部

formal.mt: Il-buttar uża ċana tonda tal-buttara biex iwitti l-wiċċ ta' ġewwa tal-bettija.
formal.en: The cooper used a howel to smooth the inside surface of the cask.
formal.zh: 制桶匠用桶匠内壁刨修平了木桶的内侧表面。

colloquial.en: Lina: How are you going to smooth the inside of this cask? Ġużeppi: I'll use a howel for this job.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你打算怎么修平这个木桶的内部？朱塞佩：这活儿我要用桶匠内壁刨。

messages.speaker: Lina (制桶学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se twitti ġewwa din il-bettija?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se twitti ġewwa din il-bettija?
messages.zh: 你打算怎么修平这个木桶的内部？
messages.en: How are you going to smooth the inside of this cask?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (制桶师傅)

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景区分相近刨具：看到这个完整长词组，就想象制桶师傅正在修平木桶内壁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A general-purpose woodworking plane used for initial shaping and leveling before finer finishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于木料初步修形和刨平、为后续精细加工做准备的通用木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana għal xogħol ġenerali tal-injam, użata għall-ewwel tiswir u twittija qabel l-irfinar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木工粗刨；用于初步修整和刨平木料的通用刨子。

collocations.en: to level a board with a jack plane
to sharpen the blade of the jack plane

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel twittija tat-tavla, il-mastrudaxxa għażel ċana varloppa.
formal.en: For the initial leveling of the board, the carpenter selected a jack plane.
formal.zh: 为了先把木板初步刨平，木匠选用了一把木工粗刨。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din it-tavla għadha ħarxa. Rita: Ibda b'ċana varloppa, imbagħad agħmel l-irfinar.
colloquial.en: Mark: This board is still rough. Rita: Start with a jack plane, then do the fine finishing.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块木板还很粗糙。丽塔：先用木工粗刨，再做精细修整。

messages.speaker: Mark (木工学徒)
messages.zh: 这块木板还很粗糙。
messages.en: This board is still rough.

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda b'ċana varloppa, imbagħad agħmel l-irfinar.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda b'ċana varloppa, imbagħad agħmel l-irfinar.
messages.zh: 先用木工粗刨，再做精细修整。
messages.en: Start with a jack plane, then do the fine finishing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按加工顺序记忆：粗木板先用这把刨子初步修平，然后才进入精细修整。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak angrily or severely to someone because they have done something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人做错了事而生气或严厉地责备、训斥对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem ma' xi ħadd b'rabja jew b'mod aħrax minħabba xi ħaġa ħażina li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责骂；因对方做错事而严厉责备。
训斥；明确而严厉地批评某人的不当行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sb. a dressing down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人狠狠训一顿；严厉斥责某人。

collocations.en: he told the employee off for arriving late
collocations.zh: 他因员工迟到而训斥了对方

formal.mt: Id-direttur ċanfar lill-impjegat talli injora l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The director reprimanded the employee for ignoring the safety instructions.
formal.zh: 主管因那名员工无视安全指示而严厉训斥了他。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int imdejjaq? Ninu: L-għalliem ċanfarni għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you upset? Ninu: The teacher told me off because I kept talking during the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不开心？尼努：老师训了我一顿，因为我上课一直讲话。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么不开心？
messages.en: Why are you upset?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem ċanfarni għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem ċanfarni għax bqajt nitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 老师训了我一顿，因为我上课一直讲话。
messages.en: The teacher told me off because I kept talking during the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词记成一个动作画面：有人做错事，另一人正在严厉训斥他。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Angry or severe criticism directed at someone for something they have done wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某人过错所作的生气或严厉的责备，也指一次训斥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem ta' rabja jew kritika ħarxa lil xi ħadd minħabba xi ħaġa ħażina li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责骂；因某人的过错而作出的严厉责备。
训斥；针对不当行为的一顿批评。

formal.mt: L-impjegat qala' ċanfir mingħand il-maniġer wara li reġa' injora l-proċedura.
formal.en: The employee received a scolding from the manager after ignoring the procedure again.
formal.zh: 那名员工再次无视操作程序后，挨了经理一顿训斥。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif marret mal-għalliem? Toni: Qlajt ċanfir għax ma għamiltx ix-xogħol tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did it go with the teacher? Toni: I got a telling-off because I didn't do my homework.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：老师那边怎么样？托尼：我没做家庭作业，挨了一顿训。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 老师那边怎么样？
messages.en: How did it go with the teacher?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qlajt ċanfir għax ma għamiltx ix-xogħol tad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Qlajt ċanfir għax ma għamiltx ix-xogħol tad-dar.
messages.zh: 我没做家庭作业，挨了一顿训。
messages.en: I got a telling-off because I didn't do my homework.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与动词 ċanfar 对照记：动词表示训斥别人，名词 ċanfir 表示那一顿训斥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow sloping surface made by cutting away the sharp edge where two surfaces meet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 削去两个表面交接处的锐边后形成的狭窄斜面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ dejjaq u mmejjel magħmul billi titneħħa x-xifer jaqta' fejn jiltaqgħu żewġ uċuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒角；在棱边处削切形成的斜面。

formal.mt: It-tpinġija teknika tispeċifika ċanfrin ta' 45 grad tul ix-xifer tal-biċċa.
formal.en: The technical drawing specifies a 45-degree chamfer along the edge of the part.
formal.zh: 技术图纸规定在零件的棱边处加工四十五度倒角。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan ix-xifer jaqta' wisq. David: Nista' nagħmel ċanfrin żgħir biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
colloquial.en: Anna: This edge is too sharp. David: I can make a small chamfer so it won't be sharp anymore.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个边太锋利了。戴维：我可以加工一个小倒角，让它不再锋利。

messages.speaker: Anna (工作坊学员)
messages.zh: 这个边太锋利了。
messages.en: This edge is too sharp.

messages.speaker: David (工作坊导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħmel ċanfrin żgħir biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħmel ċanfrin żgħir biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
messages.zh: 我可以加工一个小倒角，让它不再锋利。
messages.en: I can make a small chamfer so it won't be sharp anymore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把方块的锋利棱边斜削一刀，留下的小斜面就是这个词所指的倒角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of cutting a sloping surface along an edge to create a chamfer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿棱边削切出斜面、形成倒角的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jinqata' wiċċ immejjel tul xifer biex jinħoloq ċanfrin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒角加工；将棱边切削成斜面的作业过程。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċanfrinatura tax-xfar għandha titlesta qabel l-ispezzjoni finali tal-biċċa.
formal.en: Chamfering of the edges must be completed before the final inspection of the part.
formal.zh: 零件进行最终检验之前，必须完成棱边的倒角加工。

colloquial.mt: Pietru: Nista' nibda niżbogħ din il-biċċa? Elena: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nlestu ċ-ċanfrinatura.
colloquial.en: Pietru: Can I start painting this piece? Elena: Wait a moment; first we need to finish the chamfering.
colloquial.zh: 彼得：我可以开始给这件东西上漆了吗？埃莱娜：等一下，我们得先完成倒角加工。

messages.speaker: Pietru (工作坊学员)
messages.zh: 我可以开始给这件东西上漆了吗？
messages.en: Can I start painting this piece?

messages.speaker: Elena (工作坊导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nlestu ċ-ċanfrinatura.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; l-ewwel irridu nlestu ċ-ċanfrinatura.
messages.zh: 等一下，我们得先完成倒角加工。
messages.en: Wait a moment; first we need to finish the chamfering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个词配成结果与过程来记：ċanfrin 是留下的倒角，ċanfrinatura 是加工倒角的过程。

gloss_zh: 把事情撂下不做完；丢下某人不管

teaching_sense.en_definition: To abandon a task before finishing it, or to leave someone without the help they need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把尚未完成的工作撂下，或在某人需要帮助时丢下对方不管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla xogħol mhux lest, jew ħalla lil xi ħadd mingħajr l-għajnuna li kellu bżonn.

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave sth. unfinished (e.g. a piece of work)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事留着不完成；例如把做了一部分的工作撂下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave sb. in the lurch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人需要帮助或支持时丢下对方不管，使其陷入困境。

collocations.en: he left his companion in the lurch

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċanta x-xogħol qabel ma lestieh, u t-tim kellu jsib lil xi ħadd ieħor biex ikomplih.
formal.en: The worker left the work unfinished, and the team had to find someone else to complete it.
formal.zh: 那名工人把尚未完成的工作撂下了，团队只好另找人接着完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kellek iġġorr il-kaxxi kollha waħdek? Mark: Toni ċanta lili u telaq meta kien għad baqa' nofshom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you have to carry all the boxes on your own? Mark: Toni left me in the lurch and walked off when half of them were still left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么得一个人搬所有箱子？马克：还有一半没搬的时候，托尼就丢下我走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kellek iġġorr il-kaxxi kollha waħdek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kellek iġġorr il-kaxxi kollha waħdek?
messages.zh: 你怎么得一个人搬所有箱子？
messages.en: Why did you have to carry all the boxes on your own?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni ċanta lili u telaq meta kien għad baqa' nofshom.
messages.mt_standard: Toni ċanta lili u telaq meta kien għad baqa' nofshom.
messages.zh: 还有一半没搬的时候，托尼就丢下我走了。
messages.en: Toni left me in the lurch and walked off when half of them were still left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个撂下的画面记两义：桌上工作只做一半，搬箱子的同伴也被丢下不管。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wish that something bad will happen to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希望别人遭遇坏事或厄运。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tawgura d-deni jew ix-xorti ħażina lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望某人倒霉；诅咒某人遭遇厄运。

formal.mt: Wara t-tilwima, ir-raġel ċantar lill-ġar tiegħu u awguralu xorti ħażina.
formal.en: After the argument, the man wished his neighbour bad fortune.
formal.zh: 争吵之后，那名男子诅咒邻居倒霉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ċantar lil Pawlu? Mark: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu, iżda ma kellux jawguralu d-deni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he wish Pawlu bad fortune? Mark: Because he was angry with him, but he shouldn't have wished him harm.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么诅咒保罗倒霉？马克：因为他生保罗的气，但他不该盼着保罗遭殃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么诅咒保罗倒霉？
messages.en: Why did he wish Pawlu bad fortune?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu, iżda ma kellux jawguralu d-deni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien irrabjat miegħu, iżda ma kellux jawguralu d-deni.
messages.zh: 因为他生保罗的气，但他不该盼着保罗遭殃。
messages.en: Because he was angry with him, but he shouldn't have wished him harm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住争吵后盼对方倒霉的情景，把 ċantar 与“诅咒别人遭厄运”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 把事情留着不完成；半途搁置

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of leaving something unfinished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有把事情做完便将其搁下的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħalli xi ħaġa mhux lesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事留着不完成；未完成便搁置。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ilmenta dwar iċ-ċantir tax-xogħol, għax il-ħajt kien għadu nofsu miżbugħ.
formal.en: The client complained about the work being left unfinished, because the wall was still only half painted.
formal.zh: 客户投诉工作没有做完就被搁置，因为墙壁仍然只刷了一半。

colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you complaining? Toni: Because the work was left unfinished: the wall is still only half painted.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在抱怨？托尼：因为活儿没干完就被搁下了，墙还只刷了一半。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么在抱怨？

messages.speaker: Toni (住户)

messages.mt_standard: Minħabba ċ-ċantir tax-xogħol: il-ħajt għadu nofsu miżbugħ.
messages.zh: 因为活儿没干完就被搁下了，墙还只刷了一半。

gloss_zh: 一团；一块；劈石用的铁杆

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clump or lump of material; also an iron bar used to split rock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚成一团或一块的物质；也指用来劈开岩石的铁杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Massa ta' materjal miġbur flimkien; ukoll virga tal-ħadid li tintuża biex jinqasam il-blat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一团或一簇。
一块；一团块状物。

sense_translations.en_definition: an iron bar used to split rock
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于劈开岩石的铁杆。

collocations.en: split rock with an iron bar

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa ċappa tafal fuq il-mejda u beda jifforma skutella.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċappa ħamrija. Se nneħħiha qabel nidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ċappa ħamrija. Se nneħħiha qabel nidħol.
messages.zh: 一团土。我进去之前先把它弄掉。
messages.en: A clump of soil. I'll remove it before going inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一团黏土”记住 ċappa 的团块义，再另画一根劈石铁杆，分别记牢两个不同用法。

gloss_zh: 凝结成块；使凝结或凝乳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clot, or to allow a substance to clot or curdle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凝结成块，或让某种物质凝结、让乳液凝成块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħqad f'ċapep, jew tħalli sustanza tagħqad jew il-ħalib jaqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝结；凝成团块。

sense_translations.en_definition: to allow sth. to clot or curdle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让某物凝结成块，或让乳液凝结成凝乳。

formal.mt: Il-produttur ċappap il-ħalib bħala parti mill-proċess biex jagħmel il-ġobon.

colloquial.en: Lara: What did the producer do with the milk? Toni: He let the milk curdle to make cheese.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：生产者对牛奶做了什么处理？托尼：他让牛奶凝结成凝乳，用来制作奶酪。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
