messages.en: What did the producer do with the milk?

messages.speaker: Toni (导览员)
messages.zh: 他让牛奶凝结成凝乳，用来制作奶酪。
messages.en: He let the milk curdle to make cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本流动的液体变成小团块，用“液体凝成块”的变化记住 ċappap，也记住它可表示让这种变化发生。

gloss_zh: 弄污；弄脏；玷污名誉；给人带来负面影响；涂抹者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stain or dirty something, or figuratively to damage someone's reputation or affect them negatively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西弄出污渍或弄脏；比喻玷污某人的名誉，或对某人造成负面影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħammeġ jew tħalli tbajja' fuq xi ħaġa; b'mod figurattiv, tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd jew taffettwah ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使留下污渍；把某物弄污。
把某物弄脏。
玷污某人的名誉；损害某人的声誉。
对某人产生负面影响；使某人受到不利影响。
涂抹或乱涂乱抹的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport falz ċappas ir-reputazzjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The false report tarnished the teacher's reputation.
formal.zh: 那份虚假报告损害了教师的声誉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċappas il-mejda biż-żebgħa? Mark: Jien, bi żball. Se nnaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who got paint on the table? Mark: I did, by mistake. I'll clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把油漆弄到桌上了？马克：是我，不小心弄的。我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把油漆弄到桌上了？
messages.en: Who got paint on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, bi żball. Se nnaddafha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, bi żball. Se nnaddafha issa.
messages.zh: 是我，不小心弄的。我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: I did, by mistake. I'll clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 从“衣服沾上污渍”联想到“名誉蒙上污点”，串起 ċappas 的实义和比喻义；名词义另记为“涂抹的人”。

gloss_zh: 容易造成涂污或污渍的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of smearing or leaving stains on a surface or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可能涂污物体表面或在材料上留下污渍的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jċappas jew iħalli tbajja' fuq wiċċ jew materjal.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the potential to smear or stain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有涂污或留下污渍的可能性的；容易造成污渍的。

collocations.en: a colour that can smear or stain
collocations.zh: 容易涂污或留下污渍的颜料

collocations.en: a material that can smear or stain
collocations.zh: 容易造成涂污或污渍的材料

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal huwa ċappasi u jista' jħalli tbajja' fuq id-drapp.
formal.en: This material can smear or stain and may leave marks on fabric.
formal.zh: 这种材料容易造成涂污，可能在布料上留下污渍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nuża dan il-kulur fuq il-mejda? Toni: Oqgħod attenta, huwa ċappasi. Għatti l-mejda l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I use this colour on the table? Toni: Be careful, it can stain. Cover the table first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以在桌上用这种颜料吗？托尼：小心，它容易留下污渍。先把桌子盖好。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża dan il-kulur fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża dan il-kulur fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 我可以在桌上用这种颜料吗？
messages.en: Can I use this colour on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (美术教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attenta, huwa ċappasi. Għatti l-mejda l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attenta, huwa ċappasi. Għatti l-mejda l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 小心，它容易留下污渍。先把桌子盖好。
messages.en: Be careful, it can stain. Cover the table first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象使用颜料前先铺桌布，把 ċappasi 记成“有弄脏潜力的”这一性质，强调尚未弄脏也可以这样描述。

gloss_zh: 懒洋洋的人；无精打采的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lacks energy and is slow or reluctant to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精神不振、行动迟缓或提不起劲做事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna bla enerġija li ddum biex taġixxi jew ma jkollhiex ħeġġa tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无精打采、懒洋洋而不愿活动的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru joqgħod bħal ċapsa waqt li sħabu jħejju għall-vjaġġ.
formal.en: In the story, the character sits around listlessly while his friends prepare for the journey.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物懒洋洋地坐着，同伴们则在为旅程做准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum qiegħed qisek ċapsa. Ma rqadtx sew? Mark: Le, ftit li xejn irqadt. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: You're so listless today. Didn't you sleep well? Mark: No, I barely slept. I need to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天懒洋洋的，没睡好吗？马克：是啊，几乎没睡。我需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qiegħed qisek ċapsa. Ma rqadtx sew?
messages.mt_standard: Illum qiegħed qisek ċapsa. Ma rqadtx sew?
messages.zh: 你今天懒洋洋的，没睡好吗？
messages.en: You're so listless today. Didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ftit li xejn irqadt. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ftit li xejn irqadt. Għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，几乎没睡。我需要休息一下。
messages.en: No, I barely slept. I need to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċapsa 和一个瘫坐在椅子上、提不起精神的人联系起来；记住它指人，而不是疲倦这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike one's hands together, especially to show approval or appreciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将双手相互拍击，尤其用来表示赞许或欣赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħabbat idejk ma' xulxin, speċjalment biex turi approvazzjoni jew apprezzament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍手；使两手掌相互拍击。
鼓掌，以表示赞许、欣赏或支持。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, il-pubbliku ċapċap lill-kantanta biex juri l-apprezzament tiegħu.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the audience applauded the singer to show its appreciation.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众为女歌手鼓掌，表达欣赏之情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbitek il-kanzunetta? Mark: Iva! Kulħadd ċapċap meta spiċċat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the song? Mark: Yes! Everyone clapped when it ended.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢那首歌吗？马克：喜欢！唱完时大家都鼓掌了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那首歌吗？
messages.en: Did you like the song?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢！唱完时大家都鼓掌了。
messages.en: Yes! Everyone clapped when it ended.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边读 ċapċap 边拍两下手，用动作记住动词“拍手”，再联想到表示赞赏的“鼓掌”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or sound of clapping hands, often to express approval.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拍手的动作或发出的声音，常用于表达赞许。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss tat-taħbit tal-idejn ma' xulxin, spiss biex tintwera approvazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍手这一动作，或拍手发出的声音。
表示赞许或欣赏的掌声。

formal.mt: Il-preżentazzjoni ntemmet b'ċapċip qawwi mill-udjenza.
formal.en: The presentation ended with loud applause from the audience.
formal.zh: 演示结束时，观众报以响亮的掌声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt dak iċ-ċapċip? Toni: Iva, il-pubbliku veru ħa gost!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that applause? Toni: Yes, the audience really enjoyed it!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到那阵掌声了吗？托尼：听到了，观众真的很喜欢！

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵掌声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that applause?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，观众真的很喜欢！
messages.en: Yes, the audience really enjoyed it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċapċap 记作“做出拍手动作”，把 ċapċip 记作“听见一阵掌声”，用动词与名词对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement that happens slowly or progresses only a little at a time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 速度缓慢、每次只挪动一点的移动或动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment bil-mod, li fih persuna jew ħaġa tavvanza ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢的移动；慢慢挪动的动作。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw iċ-ċaqlim tal-fekruna waqt li kienet taqsam il-ġnien.
formal.en: The students observed the tortoise's slow movement as it crossed the garden.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了乌龟穿过花园时缓慢移动的样子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: B'dan iċ-ċaqlim tal-kju, se ndumu hawn! Pawlu: Iva, għadna mxejna biss żewġ passi.
colloquial.en: Nina: With the queue moving this slowly, we'll be here a while! Pawlu: Yes, we've only moved two steps so far.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：队伍挪得这么慢，我们得等好一阵了！保罗：是啊，到现在才前进了两步。

messages.speaker: Nina (排队的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: B'dan iċ-ċaqlim tal-kju, se ndumu hawn!
messages.mt_standard: B'dan iċ-ċaqlim tal-kju, se ndumu hawn!
messages.zh: 队伍挪得这么慢，我们得等好一阵了！
messages.en: With the queue moving this slowly, we'll be here a while!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (排队的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadna mxejna biss żewġ passi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadna mxejna biss żewġ passi.
messages.zh: 是啊，到现在才前进了两步。
messages.en: Yes, we've only moved two steps so far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象乌龟一步一步慢慢挪：ċaqlim 的重点是“慢”。与泛指移动的 ċaqliq 对照着记，更容易区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in position or the activity of moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置发生变化，或身体、物体移动的过程与动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fil-pożizzjoni jew l-attività ta' persuna jew ħaġa li tkun qed tiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动；运动；位置变化或身体动作。

formal.mt: Il-kamera rreġistrat kull ċaqliq tal-annimal waqt l-osservazzjoni.
formal.en: The camera recorded every movement of the animal during the observation.
formal.zh: 观察期间，摄像机记录了那只动物的每一个动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt xi ċaqliq wara l-purtiera? Mark: Iva, il-qattus qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see any movement behind the curtain? Mark: Yes, the cat is there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见窗帘后面有什么在动吗？马克：看见了，猫在那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见窗帘后面有什么在动吗？
messages.en: Did you see any movement behind the curtain?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 看见了，猫在那里。
messages.en: Yes, the cat is there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看一张静止照片，再看物体换了位置的画面：这份“动起来的变化”就是 ċaqliq；词义本身不限定速度快慢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a great deal, often with little pause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话很多、常常一开口就停不下来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna u ta' spiss bilkemm tieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话匣子；总爱说个不停的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Sara hija ċaqċieqa kbira li dejjem issib xi ħaġa fuq xiex titkellem.
formal.en: In the story, Sara is a real chatterbox who always finds something to talk about.
formal.zh: 在故事中，萨拉是个十足的话匣子，总能找到话题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Oħti ċaqċieqa kbira; matul il-vjaġġ kollu ma waqfitx titkellem! Nina: Tassew? U jien bilkemm għedt kelma!
colloquial.en: Lara: My sister is a real chatterbox; she talked throughout the whole journey! Nina: Really? And I barely said a word!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我姐姐真是个话匣子，一路上说个不停！妮娜：真的吗？我倒是几乎一句话也没说！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oħti ċaqċieqa kbira; matul il-vjaġġ kollu ma waqfitx titkellem!
messages.mt_standard: Oħti ċaqċieqa kbira; matul il-vjaġġ kollu ma waqfitx titkellem!
messages.zh: 我姐姐真是个话匣子，一路上说个不停！
messages.en: My sister is a real chatterbox; she talked throughout the whole journey!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tassew? U jien bilkemm għedt kelma!
messages.mt_standard: Tassew? U jien bilkemm għedt kelma!
messages.zh: 真的吗？我倒是几乎一句话也没说！
messages.en: Really? And I barely said a word!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友打开一个装满话语的盒子，话不停往外冒；用“话匣子”这个画面记住 ċaqċieqa 指爱说话的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cracking sound or a series of short, sharp cracking sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体发出的短促清脆的咔嚓声，或连续的噼啪声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss qasir u qawwi, jew sensiela ta' ħsejjes bħal dawk ta' friegħi niexfa meta jinkisru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连续或反复发出的噼啪声、咔嚓声。
一声短促清脆的咔嚓声或噼啪声。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, iċ-ċaqċiq tal-injam fin-nar kien jinstema' fil-kamra kollha.
formal.en: During the night, the crackling of the wood in the fire could be heard throughout the room.
formal.zh: 夜里，炉火中木头的噼啪声传遍了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt dak iċ-ċaqċiq? Maja: Iva, kienet fergħa niexfa li ksirt taħt saqajja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you hear that cracking sound? Maja: Yes, it was a dry branch I broke underfoot.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你听见那声咔嚓了吗？玛雅：听见了，是我踩断了一根干树枝。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那声咔嚓了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that cracking sound?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet fergħa niexfa li ksirt taħt saqajja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet fergħa niexfa li ksirt taħt saqajja.
messages.zh: 听见了，是我踩断了一根干树枝。
messages.en: Yes, it was a dry branch I broke underfoot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċaqċiq 配上脚踩干树枝的“咔嚓”声，再想象柴火连续“噼啪”；用一个声音和一串声音分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something clearer or help someone understand it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事情解释清楚，或帮助别人理解原先不明白的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ċara jew tgħin lil xi ħadd jifhimha aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 澄清；阐明；把含糊或容易误解的内容解释清楚。
使明白；启发；通过说明帮助别人获得理解。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ċara t-tifsira tas-sentenza permezz ta' żewġ eżempji.
formal.en: The teacher clarified the meaning of the sentence through two examples.
formal.zh: 老师通过两个例子阐明了这个句子的意思。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Issa fhimt dan il-punt? Mark: Iva, l-għalliem ċara l-punt b'eżempju sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you understand this point now? Mark: Yes, the teacher clarified it with a simple example.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在明白这一点了吗？马克：明白了，老师用一个简单的例子解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你现在明白这一点了吗？
messages.en: Do you understand this point now?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għalliem ċara l-punt b'eżempju sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għalliem ċara l-punt b'eżempju sempliċi.
messages.zh: 明白了，老师用一个简单的例子解释清楚了。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher clarified it with a simple example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把难懂的句子想成蒙雾的玻璃，解释之后看清了意思：对事情是“澄清”，对听者是“使明白”。这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being clear and easy to understand or perceive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容容易理解，或声音、形象等容易辨认的清晰程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun ċara u faċli biex tinftiehem jew tingħaraf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清晰；明确；容易理解或辨认的性质。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċarezza tal-ispjegazzjoni għenet lill-istudenti jifhmu l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The clarity of the explanation helped the students understand the instructions.
formal.zh: 解释清楚明白，帮助学生们理解了操作说明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-ispjegazzjoni għandha ħafna ċarezza. Fhimtha mill-ewwel. Mark: Iva, l-eżempju għen lili wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: This explanation is very clear. I understood it straight away. Mark: Yes, the example helped me too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个解释很清楚，我一下就懂了。马克：是啊，那个例子也帮我理解了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ispjegazzjoni għandha ħafna ċarezza. Fhimtha mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ispjegazzjoni għandha ħafna ċarezza. Fhimtha mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 这个解释很清楚，我一下就懂了。
messages.en: This explanation is very clear. I understood it straight away.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，那个例子也帮我理解了。
messages.en: Yes, the example helped me too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċarezza 记成一份条理清楚、读一遍就懂的说明所具有的“清晰度”；它是名词，表示清楚明白这种性质。

gloss_zh: 非常清楚的；解释得很明白的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very clear or explained so well that it is easy to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常清楚的，或解释得十分明白、容易理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċar ħafna jew spjegat tajjeb ħafna, b'mod li jinftiehem faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常清楚的；十分明晰的
解释得很明白的；阐述清楚的

collocations.zh: 解释得非常明白的概念

formal.mt: Il-kunċett huwa spjegat b'mod ċarissimu fir-rapport, b'eżempju għal kull pass.
formal.en: The concept is explained very clearly in the report, with an example for each step.
formal.zh: 报告把这个概念解释得非常明白，每一步都附有例子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fhimt kif taħdem il-magna? Pawlu: Iva, issa kollox ċarissimu. L-eżempju għenni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you understand how the machine works? Pawlu: Yes, everything is very clear now. The example helped me a lot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明白这台机器怎么运作了吗？保罗：明白了，现在一切都非常清楚。那个例子帮了我很大的忙。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你明白这台机器怎么运作了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand how the machine works?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa kollox ċarissimu. L-eżempju għenni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa kollox ċarissimu. L-eżempju għenni ħafna.
messages.zh: 明白了，现在一切都非常清楚。那个例子帮了我很大的忙。
messages.en: Yes, everything is very clear now. The example helped me a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把每一步都解释到你完全明白，用“清楚得不能再清楚”记住这个形容词的强烈程度。

gloss_zh: 具有撕裂能力或可能性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability or potential to tear or rend something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有撕开、扯裂某物的能力，或可能造成这种结果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom il-ħila jew il-potenzjal li jqattgħu jew iċarrtu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability or potential to tear or rend sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有撕开或扯裂某物的能力或可能性的

formal.mt: It-truf ċarrati tal-biċċa tal-metall jistgħu jqattgħu d-drapp waqt il-kuntatt.
formal.en: The metal piece's edges, which can tear material, may tear the fabric on contact.
formal.zh: 这块金属具有撕裂能力的边缘，在接触时可能把布料划裂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' npoġġi din il-biċċa fil-borża tad-drapp? Mark: Aħjar le. Għandha truf ċarrati u tista' tqatta' l-borża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I put this piece in the cloth bag? Mark: Better not. It has edges that can tear things and could tear the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能把这块东西放进布袋吗？马克：最好别放。它的边缘可能撕裂东西，会把袋子弄破。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' npoġġi din il-biċċa fil-borża tad-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' npoġġi din il-biċċa fil-borża tad-drapp?
messages.zh: 我能把这块东西放进布袋吗？
messages.en: Can I put this piece in the cloth bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. Għandha truf ċarrati u tista' tqatta' l-borża.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. Għandha truf ċarrati u tista' tqatta' l-borża.
messages.zh: 最好别放。它的边缘可能撕裂东西，会把袋子弄破。
messages.en: Better not. It has edges that can tear things and could tear the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个边缘会把布袋划裂的物体，把注意力放在“有能力造成撕裂”这一性质上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rag or piece of cloth, especially one used for cleaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块布或破布，尤其指用于擦拭、清洁的抹布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp, li tista' tkun qadima jew tintuża biex tnaddaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块破布；旧布
一块布
清洁用布；抹布

formal.mt: Naddaf il-wiċċ tal-mejda b'ċarruta niedja, imbagħad nixxfu b'ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: Clean the tabletop with a damp cloth, then dry it with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 用湿抹布清洁桌面，然后用干净的布擦干。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek ċarruta? Xerridt ftit ilma. Toni: Iva, ħu din u imsaħ il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a cloth? I spilled some water. Toni: Yes, take this one and wipe the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有抹布吗？我洒了点水。托尼：有，拿这块擦一下桌子吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你有抹布吗？我洒了点水。
messages.en: Do you have a cloth? I spilled some water.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din u imsaħ il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din u imsaħ il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有，拿这块擦一下桌子吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and wipe the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把单词贴在一块日常抹布的画面上：它是一块布，用旧了可以叫破布，拿来擦桌子就是清洁布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tear or ripped opening in a material such as cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料等材料被撕开后形成的裂口或破口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasma jew fetħa f'materjal, bħal drapp, li tkun saret meta ċċarrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕裂形成的裂口；破口

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet ċarta żgħira fid-drapp, ħdejn il-ħjata.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small tear was found in the fabric near the seam.
formal.zh: 检查时，在布料靠近接缝的位置发现了一处小裂口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara, hemm ċarta fil-kmiem tal-ġakketta. Rita: Iva, rajtha. Se nsewwiha llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look, there is a tear in the jacket sleeve. Rita: Yes, I saw it. I'll repair it today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看，夹克袖子上有个裂口。丽塔：嗯，我看到了。我今天会把它补好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，夹克袖子上有个裂口。
messages.en: Look, there is a tear in the jacket sleeve.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯，我看到了。我今天会把它补好。
messages.en: Yes, I saw it. I'll repair it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袖子被钩住后留下的一道破口，用“需要缝补的裂口”记住这里的 tear 所表示的词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gentle flow of liquid in a small, thin stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体以细小水流缓缓流动的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fluss ħafif ta' likwidu li jinżel jew jgħaddi fi fluss żgħir u rqiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涓涓流淌；液体成细流缓缓流动。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, kien jidher ċarċir tal-ilma mal-ġenb tal-blata.
formal.en: After the rain, water could be seen trickling down the side of the rock.
formal.zh: 雨后，可以看见水沿着岩石侧面涓涓流下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' ċ-ċarċir tal-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mill-funtana ż-żgħira ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear the water trickling? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from the small fountain beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见水涓涓流淌的声音了吗？保罗：听见了，是树旁边的小喷泉传来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见水涓涓流淌的声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the water trickling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-funtana ż-żgħira ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-funtana ż-żgħira ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 听见了，是树旁边的小喷泉传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the small fountain beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后岩壁上有一条细细的水线不断流下，用“涓涓细流”的画面记住 ċarċir，重点是少量液体持续流动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electric charge; in other contexts, a push with the shoulder or an accusation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指电荷；在其他语境中也可表示用肩部进行的冲撞，或对某人的指控。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċarġ elettriku; f'kuntesti oħra, daqqa bl-ispalla jew akkuża kontra xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电荷
用肩部进行的推撞；肩部冲撞
指控；控告

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-esperiment, l-istudenti rreġistraw iċ-ċarġ elettriku ta' kull oġġett.
formal.en: In the experiment report, the students recorded the electric charge of each object.
formal.zh: 学生们在实验报告中记录了每个物体的电荷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqa' l-plejer? Mark: Plejer ieħor tah ċarġ bl-ispalla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the player fall? Mark: Another player gave him a push with the shoulder.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个球员为什么摔倒了？马克：另一个球员用肩膀撞了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个球员为什么摔倒了？
messages.en: Why did the player fall?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 另一个球员用肩膀撞了他。
messages.en: Another player gave him a push with the shoulder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分开记忆：实验中的电荷、球场上的肩撞、针对某人的指控；依靠搭配判断具体词义。

gloss_zh: 凝视的；缺乏个性的；平淡乏味的；直勾勾地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gazing with a fixed look; also describing someone lacking personality or something unappealing and neutral.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目光固定、凝视着的；也可形容人卑弱而缺乏个性，或事物平淡、缺乏吸引力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ħarsa fissa; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi persuna bla personalità jew xi ħaġa newtrali u bla ġibda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝视的；目不转睛地看着的
卑弱的；缺乏个性或主见的
缺乏吸引力的；平淡而无鲜明特色的
目不转睛地；直勾勾地盯着

collocations.zh: 一种平淡而缺乏吸引力的颜色

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, it-tifel baqa' ċass quddiem l-istampa għal diversi sekondi.
formal.en: During the observation, the boy remained gazing at the picture for several seconds.
formal.zh: 观察过程中，男孩在图片前凝视了好几秒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħares ċass lejn il-bieb? Mark: Qed nistenna lil ħija. Għandu jasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you staring fixedly at the door? Mark: I'm waiting for my brother. He should arrive soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么一直盯着门看？马克：我在等我兄弟。他应该快到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares ċass lejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares ċass lejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 你为什么一直盯着门看？
messages.en: Why are you staring fixedly at the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna lil ħija. Għandu jasal dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna lil ħija. Għandu jasal dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 我在等我兄弟。他应该快到了。
messages.en: I'm waiting for my brother. He should arrive soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成三张记忆卡：固定的目光、缺乏个性的人、平淡的颜色；跟在“看”后面时，记作“直勾勾地”。

gloss_zh: 动词，所给材料未提供词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose meaning is not specified in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将此词标为动词，但未提供可用于教学的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata fil-pakkett mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给材料未提供此动词的具体义项。

formal.mt: Fil-materjal mogħti, 'ċattar' huwa mmarkat bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhix speċifikata.
formal.en: In the supplied material, 'ċattar' is marked as a verb, but its meaning is not specified.
formal.zh: 在所给材料中，“ċattar”被标为动词，但没有注明具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser il-verb 'ċattar'? Toni: It-tifsira mhix mogħtija hawn. Ejjew inħalluha miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the verb 'ċattar' mean? Toni: Its meaning isn't given here. Let's leave it open until we have more information.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：动词“ċattar”是什么意思？托尼：这里没有给出词义。等有更多资料后再确定吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 动词“ċattar”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'ċattar' mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira mhix mogħtija hawn. Ejjew inħalluha miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira mhix mogħtija hawn. Ejjew inħalluha miftuħa sakemm ikollna aktar tagħrif.
messages.zh: 这里没有给出词义。等有更多资料后再确定吧。
messages.en: Its meaning isn't given here. Let's leave it open until we have more information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把它记成一张“动词，词义待补”的卡片，练习辨认拼写，不根据相似词形自行猜测含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or action of making something flat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变平的过程或动作，例如把材料压平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa ssir ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压平；弄平；使之变平的过程

formal.mt: Iċ-ċattjatura tal-metall issir qabel il-qtugħ, sabiex il-biċċa tkun ċatta.
formal.en: The metal is flattened before cutting so that the piece is flat.
formal.zh: 金属的压平工序在切割之前进行，以使工件平整。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nagħmel wara li nħallat l-għaġina? Pawlu: Issa jmiss iċ-ċattjatura. Uża l-lembuba biex tagħmilha ċatta.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do I do after mixing the dough? Pawlu: Flattening comes next. Use the rolling pin to make it flat.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：把面团混合好之后做什么？保罗：接下来要把它压平。用擀面杖把它擀平吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 把面团混合好之后做什么？
messages.en: What do I do after mixing the dough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa jmiss iċ-ċattjatura. Uża l-lembuba biex tagħmilha ċatta.
messages.mt_standard: Issa jmiss iċ-ċattjatura. Uża l-lembuba biex tagħmilha ċatta.
messages.zh: 接下来要把它压平。用擀面杖把它擀平吧。
messages.en: Flattening comes next. Use the rolling pin to make it flat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团鼓起的面团经过擀压逐渐变平，把整个“使东西变平的过程”与这个名词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stone at the very top of an arch, called the keystone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于拱形结构最顶端的石块，即拱顶石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġebla fil-quċċata ta' arkata.

sense_translations.en_definition: keystone (the top stone of an arch)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拱顶石，即拱形结构最顶端的石块。
紧紧地；牢牢地。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, iċ-ċavi tidher fil-quċċata tal-arkata.
formal.en: In the photograph, the keystone is visible at the top of the arch.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到位于拱顶的拱顶石。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi ċ-ċavi? Pawlu: Hemm fuq, fin-nofs tal-arkata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the keystone? Pawlu: Up there, in the middle of the arch.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：拱顶石在哪里？保罗：在上面，拱的正中间。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 拱顶石在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the keystone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 在上面，拱的正中间。
messages.en: Up there, in the middle of the arch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一道石拱，把最高处的石块标成 ċavi；另做一张副词卡记“紧紧地”，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mast described as a locking mast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为“锁固桅杆”的桅杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arblu msejjaħ arblu tal-illokkjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锁固桅杆。

collocations.en: the condition of the locking mast

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi deskrizzjoni taċ-ċavu u tal-qagħda tiegħu.
formal.en: The report includes a description of the locking mast and its condition.
formal.zh: 报告包含对锁固桅杆及其状况的描述。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Iċċekkjajt iċ-ċavu? Rita: Iva, u ktibt nota dwar il-qagħda tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you check the locking mast? Rita: Yes, and I wrote a note about its condition.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你检查锁固桅杆了吗？丽塔：检查了，还记录了它的状况。

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.zh: 你检查锁固桅杆了吗？
messages.en: Did you check the locking mast?

messages.speaker: Rita (检查员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ktibt nota dwar il-qagħda tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ktibt nota dwar il-qagħda tiegħu.
messages.zh: 检查了，还记录了它的状况。
messages.en: Yes, and I wrote a note about its condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċavu 写在“锁固桅杆”的图卡上，用“检查桅杆、记录状况”的场景记忆；注意词尾是 u。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal expression used to say goodbye when parting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分别时使用的非正式告别语，相当于“再见”或“拜拜”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali li tintuża biex issellem lil xi ħadd meta titlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 再见；拜拜，用于告别。

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu miktub, il-kelma 'ċaw' tintuża biex tintemm konversazzjoni bejn ħbieb.
formal.en: In this written dialogue, the word 'ċaw' is used to end a conversation between friends.
formal.zh: 在这段书面对话中，ċaw 用于结束朋友之间的交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Issa rrid nitlaq. Ċaw! Lara: Ċaw, narak għada!
colloquial.en: Maja: I have to go now. Bye! Lara: Bye, see you tomorrow!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我现在得走了。拜拜！拉拉：拜拜，明天见！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我现在得走了。拜拜！
messages.en: I have to go now. Bye!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 拜拜，明天见！
messages.en: Bye, see you tomorrow!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友转身离开时挥一下手，说一声 ċaw，把这个短词与轻松告别的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal goodbye expressed by repeating 'ċaw'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重复 ċaw 构成的非正式告别语，相当于“拜拜”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima informali ta' firda li fiha l-kelma 'ċaw' tingħad darbtejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拜拜；再见，用于告别。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jużaw 'ċaw ċaw' fl-aħħar ta' djalogu informali.
formal.en: In the exercise, the students use 'ċaw ċaw' at the end of an informal dialogue.
formal.zh: 练习中，学生在非正式对话的结尾使用 ċaw ċaw。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-karozza tal-linja waslet. Ċaw ċaw! Mark: Ċaw ċaw, sa għada!
colloquial.en: Nina: The bus is here. Bye-bye! Mark: Bye-bye, see you tomorrow!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：公交车来了。拜拜！马克：拜拜，明天见！

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 公交车来了。拜拜！
messages.en: The bus is here. Bye-bye!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 拜拜，明天见！
messages.en: Bye-bye, see you tomorrow!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“拜拜”的重复节奏记 ċaw ċaw：挥两下手，说两次 ċaw，整组作为告别语记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jackdaw, the bird identified scientifically as Coloeus monedula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒鸦，学名为 Coloeus monedula 的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Coloeus monedula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒鸦（Coloeus monedula）。
雀鲷（Chromis chromis）。
话痨；说话很多的人。
碎云；散碎的云块。

collocations.en: ragged cloud fragments in the sky

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika ċ-ċawl f'dan ir-ritratt bħala Coloeus monedula.
formal.en: The guide identifies the jackdaws in this photograph as Coloeus monedula.
formal.zh: 指南将这张照片中的寒鸦鉴定为 Coloeus monedula。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma dawk l-għasafar fuq il-bejt? Pawlu: Dawk ċawl. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are those birds on the roof? Pawlu: Those are jackdaws. Let's watch them from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：屋顶上那些是什么鸟？保罗：那些是寒鸦。我们在这里看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 屋顶上那些是什么鸟？
messages.en: What are those birds on the roof?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk ċawl. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk ċawl. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那些是寒鸦。我们在这里看看吧。
messages.en: Those are jackdaws. Let's watch them from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċawl 画四格记忆卡：屋顶寒鸦、海中雀鲷、说个不停的人、天空碎云；根据句子场景选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A magpie, the bird identified scientifically as Pica pica.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜鹊，学名为 Pica pica 的鸟；整个短语作为鸟名学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Pica pica.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜鹊（Pica pica）。

formal.mt: Il-paġna tal-gwida turi ċ-ċawl abjad u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku Pica pica.
formal.en: The guidebook page shows the magpie and gives the scientific name Pica pica.
formal.zh: 指南的这一页展示了喜鹊，并列出其学名 Pica pica。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan ċawl abjad fir-ritratt? Rita: Iva, u fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Pica pica.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this a magpie in the photograph? Rita: Yes, and the book also gives the name Pica pica.
colloquial.zh: 马克：照片里这只是喜鹊吗？丽塔：是的，书里还列出了 Pica pica 这个名字。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里这只是喜鹊吗？
messages.en: Is this a magpie in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Pica pica.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Pica pica.
messages.zh: 是的，书里还列出了 Pica pica 这个名字。
messages.en: Yes, and the book also gives the name Pica pica.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在喜鹊图片下并排写 ċawl abjad、magpie、Pica pica，把整个马耳他语短语与同一只鸟绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cardinalfish, a fish belonging to the family Apogonidae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天竺鲷科（Apogonidae）的鱼类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-familja Apogonidae.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天竺鲷科鱼类（Apogonidae）。

formal.mt: Il-gwida telenka ċ-ċawl aħmar bħala ħuta tal-familja Apogonidae.
formal.en: The guide lists cardinalfish as fish belonging to the family Apogonidae.
formal.zh: 指南将天竺鲷列为属于天竺鲷科（Apogonidae）的鱼类。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-ħuta fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Ċawl aħmar. Ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this fish in the photograph called? Pawlu: A cardinalfish. Let's look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种鱼叫什么？保罗：天竺鲷。我们在指南里查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fish in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 天竺鲷。我们在指南里查一下吧。
messages.en: A cardinalfish. Let's look it up in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċawl aħmar 整组写在天竺鲷图卡上，并配上 cardinalfish 与 Apogonidae；用鱼类场景帮助区别其他 ċawl 词条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hooded crow (Corvus cornix), a crow with a grey body and black head, wings and tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰鸦（Corvus cornix），一种身体主要呈灰色、头部、翅膀和尾部呈黑色的鸦科鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Corvus cornix, b'ġisem griż u ras, ġwienaħ u denb suwed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰鸦（Corvus cornix）。

collocations.en: a hooded crow on a tree

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra ċawl griż fuq siġra ħdejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw a hooded crow on a tree beside the field.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，小组在田边的一棵树上看到了一只灰鸦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq is-siġra. Huwa ċawl griż? Pawlu: Iva, ħares lejn il-ġisem griż u r-ras sewda tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird on the tree. Is it a hooded crow? Pawlu: Yes, look at its grey body and black head.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看树上的那只鸟，是灰鸦吗？Pawlu：是的，看看它灰色的身体和黑色的头。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq is-siġra. Huwa ċawl griż?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq is-siġra. Huwa ċawl griż?
messages.zh: 看树上的那只鸟，是灰鸦吗？
messages.en: Look at that bird on the tree. Is it a hooded crow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn il-ġisem griż u r-ras sewda tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn il-ġisem griż u r-ras sewda tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，看看它灰色的身体和黑色的头。
messages.en: Yes, look at its grey body and black head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 griż 与“灰色”一起记，脑中画一只灰身黑头的乌鸦，帮助记住“灰鸦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raven (Corvus corax), a large black bird belonging to the crow family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 渡鸦（Corvus corax），一种体型较大的黑色鸦科鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir u iswed tal-familja taċ-ċawl, tal-ispeċi Corvus corax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渡鸦（Corvus corax）。

formal.mt: Il-paġna tal-ktieb turi ċawl imperjali u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Corvus corax.
formal.en: The book page shows a raven and gives its scientific name, Corvus corax.
formal.zh: 书页展示了一只渡鸦，并列出了它的学名 Corvus corax。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur iswed fir-ritratt? Mark: Ċawl imperjali. Ara, l-isem qiegħed taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this black bird in the photograph called? Mark: A raven. Look, the name is below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: Lara：照片里的这只黑鸟叫什么？Mark：渡鸦。看，名字就在照片下面。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只黑鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this black bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċawl imperjali. Ara, l-isem qiegħed taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Ċawl imperjali. Ara, l-isem qiegħed taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 渡鸦。看，名字就在照片下面。
messages.en: A raven. Look, the name is below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大黑鸟披着帝王斗篷”的画面记住 ċawl imperjali 对应渡鸦；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A magpie (Pica pica); another name for ċawl abjad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜鹊（Pica pica）；与 ċawl abjad 指同一种鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Pica pica; isem ieħor għaċ-ċawl abjad.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of ċawl abjad: magpie (Pica pica)
sense_translations.zh_definition: ċawl abjad 的同义名称：喜鹊（Pica pica）。

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-isem ċawl ta' Sqallija jirreferi għall-istess speċi bħall-isem ċawl abjad: Pica pica.
formal.en: In this list, the name ċawl ta' Sqallija refers to the same species as the name ċawl abjad: Pica pica.
formal.zh: 在这份清单中，ċawl ta' Sqallija 与 ċawl abjad 指同一种鸟，即喜鹊，学名 Pica pica。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ċawl ta' Sqallija? Il-ktieb tiegħi jgħid ċawl abjad. Toni: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għall-istess għasfur.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a magpie called ċawl ta' Sqallija? My book says ċawl abjad. Toni: Yes, both names refer to the same bird.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是叫作 ċawl ta' Sqallija 的喜鹊吗？我的书上写的是 ċawl abjad。Toni：是的，这两个名称指的是同一种鸟。

messages.speaker: Nina (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ċawl ta' Sqallija? Il-ktieb tiegħi jgħid ċawl abjad.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ċawl ta' Sqallija? Il-ktieb tiegħi jgħid ċawl abjad.
messages.zh: 这是叫作 ċawl ta' Sqallija 的喜鹊吗？我的书上写的是 ċawl abjad。
messages.en: Is this a magpie called ċawl ta' Sqallija? My book says ċawl abjad.

messages.speaker: Toni (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għall-istess għasfur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għall-istess għasfur.
messages.zh: 是的，这两个名称指的是同一种鸟。
messages.en: Yes, both names refer to the same bird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċawl ta' Sqallija 和 ċawl abjad 写在同一张“喜鹊”卡片上，用双名称配同一图片来记。

gloss_zh: 乌鸦；寒鸦；小型黑色雀鲷；话痨；守不住秘密的人；低垂云

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crow, a bird referred to by this name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只乌鸦；该词也可用于其他鸟、鱼、人或云的指定义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala ċawla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只乌鸦。
一只寒鸦。

sense_translations.en_definition: a damsel fish (small, black species of fish)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种雀鲷，即小型、黑色的鱼。
一个健谈或说话很多的人；话痨。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who cannot be trusted with secrets
sense_translations.zh_definition: 守不住秘密、不能托付秘密的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a type of low-hanging cloud, usually when the wind blows from the north-west
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种低垂的云，通常在刮西北风时出现。

collocations.en: she cannot keep a secret; she tells everything
collocations.zh: 她守不住秘密，什么都说出去

formal.mt: L-istampa turi ċawla fuq fergħa ta' siġra.
formal.en: The picture shows a crow on a tree branch.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只乌鸦停在树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik iċ-ċawla fuq is-siġra! Maja: Qed naraha. Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that crow in the tree! Maja: I can see it. Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看树上那只乌鸦！玛雅：我看到了。我们拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树上那只乌鸦！
messages.en: Look at that crow in the tree!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们拍张照吧。
messages.en: I can see it. Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用六张小图记 ċawla：乌鸦、寒鸦、黑色小鱼、健谈者、泄密者、低云；特别分清“话多”和“守不住秘密”。

gloss_zh: 灰鸦；ċawl griż 的同义名称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hooded crow (Corvus cornix); another name for ċawl griż.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰鸦（Corvus cornix）；与 ċawl griż 指同一种鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Corvus cornix; isem ieħor għaċ-ċawl griż.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of ċawl griż: hooded crow (Corvus cornix)
sense_translations.zh_definition: ċawl griż 的同义名称：灰鸦（Corvus cornix）。

collocations.en: a hooded crow in the field
a picture of the hooded crow

formal.mt: Il-materjal tat-tagħlim jagħti ċawlun griż bħala isem ieħor għaċ-ċawl griż, Corvus cornix.
formal.en: The teaching material gives ċawlun griż as another name for the hooded crow, ċawl griż, Corvus cornix.
formal.zh: 教材将 ċawlun griż 列为 ċawl griż 的另一名称，两者都指灰鸦，学名 Corvus cornix。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub ċawlun griż. Huwa l-istess bħaċ-ċawl griż? David: Iva, tista' tpoġġi ż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn l-istess stampa.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says ċawlun griż here. Is that the same as ċawl griż? David: Yes, you can put both names beside the same picture.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里写着 ċawlun griż，和 ċawl griż 一样吗？David：是的，你可以把这两个名称写在同一张图片旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub ċawlun griż. Huwa l-istess bħaċ-ċawl griż?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub ċawlun griż. Huwa l-istess bħaċ-ċawl griż?
messages.zh: 这里写着 ċawlun griż，和 ċawl griż 一样吗？
messages.en: It says ċawlun griż here. Is that the same as ċawl griż?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tpoġġi ż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn l-istess stampa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tpoġġi ż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn l-istess stampa.
messages.zh: 是的，你可以把这两个名称写在同一张图片旁边。
messages.en: Yes, you can put both names beside the same picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到共同的 griż 就想起灰色，把 ċawlun griż 与 ċawl griż 连线，共用一张灰鸦图片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the Latin letter Ċ or ċ, distinguished by the dot above it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拉丁字母Ċ或ċ的名称，字形特点是上方带有一个点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-ittra Latina Ċ jew ċ, li għandha tikka fuqha.

sense_translations.en_definition: The name of the Latin script letter Ċ/ċ.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉丁字母Ċ/ċ的名称，即上方带点的字母C/c。
笨蛋；蠢人，用于贬称或辱骂他人。

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'ċavetta' tibda bl-ittra ċe bit-tikka.
formal.en: The word 'ċavetta' begins with the letter ċ.
formal.zh: 单词ċavetta以字母ċ开头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Ċavetta' tinkiteb b'ċe bit-tikka? Sara: Iva, tinsiex it-tikka fuq l-ewwel ittra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is 'ċavetta' written with a dotted c? Sara: Yes, don't forget the dot above the first letter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：ċavetta是用上面带点的c写的吗？Sara：对，别忘了第一个字母上面的点。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ċavetta是用上面带点的c写的吗？
messages.en: Is 'ċavetta' written with a dotted c?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tinsiex it-tikka fuq l-ewwel ittra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tinsiex it-tikka fuq l-ewwel ittra.
messages.zh: 对，别忘了第一个字母上面的点。
messages.en: Yes, don't forget the dot above the first letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先盯住ċ上方的小点，把整个名称和这个字形绑定；另把“笨蛋”义单独标为贬称，避免误用于称呼别人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or party who cedes or transfers a right, claim, or property to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把权利、请求权或财产让与、转移给另一方的人或当事方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew parti li ċċedi jew tittrasferixxi dritt, pretensjoni jew proprjetà lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 让出或让与某物的人。
让与人；把权利或请求权让与另一方的人或当事方。
转让人；把财产或权利转移给另一方的人或当事方。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju ta' ftehim, iċ-ċedent jittrasferixxi d-dritt deskritt fid-dokument lil parti oħra.
formal.en: In this example agreement, the assignor transfers the right described in the document to another party.
formal.zh: 在这份协议示例中，让与人把文件所述的权利转让给另一方。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu ċ-ċedent f'dan l-eżempju? David: Hu dak li jittrasferixxi d-dritt, mhux dak li jirċevih.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the assignor in this example? David: It is the person transferring the right, not the person receiving it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个例子里的让与人是谁？David：是转出权利的人，不是接收权利的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子里的让与人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the assignor in this example?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dak li jittrasferixxi d-dritt, mhux dak li jirċevih.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dak li jittrasferixxi d-dritt, mhux dak li jirċevih.
messages.zh: 是转出权利的人，不是接收权利的人。
messages.en: It is the person transferring the right, not the person receiving it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支从甲指向乙的权利转让箭头，把ċedent写在甲旁边：记住它指转出的一方，而非接收的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cedar tree, an evergreen tree with needle-like leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雪松，一种具有针状叶的常绿树木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra dejjem ħadra bil-weraq qishom labar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪松；雪松树。

formal.mt: Fiċ-ċentru tal-ġnien hemm ċedru kbir, u ħdejh hemm bank għall-viżitaturi.
formal.en: In the centre of the garden there is a large cedar tree, with a bench beside it for visitors.
formal.zh: 花园中央有一棵大雪松，旁边设有供游客休息的长椅。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn se niltaqgħu fil-ġnien? Samwel: Ħdejn iċ-ċedru l-kbir, fejn hemm il-bank.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where shall we meet in the garden? Samwel: By the big cedar tree, where the bench is.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们在花园哪里碰面？Samwel：在大雪松旁边，就是有长椅的地方。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在花园哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet in the garden?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn iċ-ċedru l-kbir, fejn hemm il-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn iċ-ċedru l-kbir, fejn hemm il-bank.
messages.zh: 在大雪松旁边，就是有长椅的地方。
messages.en: By the big cedar tree, where the bench is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园里一棵针叶常绿的雪松，树下放着长椅；把ċedru贴在树干上，记住它是树木名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Headache, expressed using a medical term for pain in the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头部疼痛，即医学用语中的“头痛”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uġigħ fir-ras, imfisser b'terminu mediku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头痛；表示头部疼痛的医学术语。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku ġie rreġistrat episodju ta' ċefalalġija li dam sagħtejn.
formal.en: An episode of cephalalgia lasting two hours was recorded in the medical report.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪去植被的簇状部分以作修整，例如修剪三叶草

collocations.en: he trimmed the clover by cutting its tufts
collocations.zh: 他剪去三叶草的簇状部分进行修整

collocations.en: he trimmed the grass tufts with shears
collocations.zh: 他用剪刀修剪草丛的簇状部分

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ċejjem is-silla billi qata' l-partijiet li kienu kibru fi gzuz.
formal.en: The gardener trimmed the clover by cutting the parts that had grown in tufts.
formal.zh: 园丁剪去了三叶草长成簇状的部分，完成了修整。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għamel Ġużeppi bis-silla? Pietru: Ċejjem is-silla; qata' biss il-partijiet li kienu ħerġin 'il fuq.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did Ġużeppi do to the clover? Pietru: He trimmed its tufts; he cut only the parts sticking up.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：朱塞佩对那片三叶草做了什么？彼得：他修剪了簇状部分，只剪掉了向上突出的那些。

messages.speaker: Marija (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 朱塞佩对那片三叶草做了什么？
messages.en: What did Ġużeppi do to the clover?

messages.speaker: Pietru (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċejjem is-silla; qata' biss il-partijiet li kienu ħerġin 'il fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Ċejjem is-silla; qata' biss il-partijiet li kienu ħerġin 'il fuq.
messages.zh: 他修剪了簇状部分，只剪掉了向上突出的那些。
messages.en: He trimmed its tufts; he cut only the parts sticking up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剪刀逐簇剪去三叶草冒出的部分，把动作记为修整草簇，突出剪簇这一特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A baby bird that has just begun to make chirping sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刚刚开始发出啾啾叫声的雏鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fellus ta' għasfur li għadu kemm beda jagħmel l-ewwel ħsejjes tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a baby bird that is just starting to chirp
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刚开始学着啾啾叫的雏鸟

collocations.en: a newly chirping baby bird in the nest
collocations.zh: 巢里刚开始啾啾叫的雏鸟

collocations.en: a newly chirping baby bird asking for food

formal.mt: L-osservatur ra ċejjieq fil-bejta u sema' l-ewwel ħsejjes dgħajfa tiegħu.
formal.en: The observer saw a newly chirping baby bird in the nest and heard its first faint calls.
formal.zh: 观察者看见巢里有一只初鸣雏鸟，并听见了它最初微弱的叫声。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhu dak il-fellus li għadu kemm beda jċajċar? David: Dak ċejjieq; ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Elena: What do you call that baby bird that has just started chirping? David: That's a ċejjieq; let's watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：那只刚开始啾啾叫的雏鸟叫什么？戴维：那叫 ċejjieq；我们远远地看着它吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-fellus li għadu kemm beda jċajċar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-fellus li għadu kemm beda jċajċar?
messages.zh: 那只刚开始啾啾叫的雏鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What do you call that baby bird that has just started chirping?

messages.speaker: David (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 那叫 ċejjieq；我们远远地看着它吧。
messages.en: That's a ċejjieq; let's watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一只张嘴初鸣的雏鸟图片，记住它指小鸟本身，并含刚开始叫的意思。

gloss_zh: 啾啾声；鸟儿细小的鸣叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chirping or cheeping sound made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟儿发出的啾啾鸣叫声，尤其是细小短促的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss qasir u rqiq li jagħmlu l-għasafar meta jċajċru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啾啾鸣叫声
鸟儿细小、短促的啾啾声

formal.mt: Ir-reġistrazzjoni tinkludi ċ-ċejq tal-għasafar li nstema' fil-ġnien kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The recording includes the birds' chirping heard in the garden early in the morning.
formal.zh: 这段录音收录了清晨花园里听到的鸟儿啾啾声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed tisma' ċ-ċejq? Luqa: Iva, ġej mill-bejta ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you hear the cheeping? Luqa: Yes, it's coming from the nest near the window.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听见啾啾声了吗？卢卡：听见了，是从窗边的鸟巢里传来的。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见啾啾声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the cheeping?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是从窗边的鸟巢里传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the nest near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象鸟巢里传出啾啾声，把这个短词记成声音名词；再与表示雏鸟的词对照。

gloss_zh: 糖果；适合儿童吃的小甜食

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet or a small sweet food suitable for a child to eat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 糖果，或适合儿童食用的小份甜食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelwa jew xi ħaġa żgħira u ħelwa li tkun tajba biex jikolha tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.en_definition: candy; sweets; anything small and sweet suitable for children to eat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖果；甜食；任何适合儿童食用的小巧甜食

collocations.zh: 一小颗糖果；一小份甜食

collocations.en: to give a sweet to a boy

formal.mt: Fl-istorja għat-tfal, in-nanna tagħti ċejċa żgħira lin-neputija tagħha wara l-ikla.
formal.en: In the children's story, the grandmother gives her granddaughter a small sweet after the meal.
formal.zh: 在这则儿童故事中，奶奶在饭后给孙女一小颗糖果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nieħu ċejċa wara l-ikla? Rita: Iva, agħżel waħda żgħira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I have a sweet after the meal? Rita: Yes, choose a small one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：吃完饭我可以吃一颗糖吗？丽塔：可以，挑一颗小的吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 吃完饭我可以吃一颗糖吗？
messages.en: Can I have a sweet after the meal?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 可以，挑一颗小的吧。
messages.en: Yes, choose a small one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和孩子手心里的一小颗糖联系起来，抓住小巧、甜味、儿童这三个提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Czechia, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与捷克、捷克人或捷克语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-Ċekja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捷克的；捷克人的；捷克语的
捷克人
捷克语

collocations.zh: 一位来自布拉格的捷克人

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Ċek ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu biċ-Ċek, u l-udjenza segwiet traduzzjoni bil-Malti.
formal.en: The Czech writer presented his work in Czech, and the audience followed a Maltese translation.
formal.zh: 这位捷克作家用捷克语介绍了自己的作品，观众借助马耳他语译文理解内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel Ċek? Mark: Iva, hu Ċek minn Praga u jitkellem biċ-Ċek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that man Czech? Mark: Yes, he's a Czech from Prague and speaks Czech.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人是捷克人吗？马克：是的，他是来自布拉格的捷克人，会说捷克语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是捷克人吗？
messages.en: Is that man Czech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu Ċek minn Praga u jitkellem biċ-Ċek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu Ċek minn Praga u jitkellem biċ-Ċek.
messages.zh: 是的，他是来自布拉格的捷克人，会说捷克语。
messages.en: Yes, he's a Czech from Prague and speaks Czech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三格卡片分别写捷克的、捷克人、捷克语，用作家、人物和说话气泡提示三种用法。

gloss_zh: 使物体变小的人；贬低或羞辱他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something smaller; also a person who humiliates another person or makes them feel less important.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物尺寸缩小的人；也指羞辱、贬低他人，使对方觉得自己低人一等的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnaqqas id-daqs ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll persuna li tumilja lil ħaddieħor jew iġġiegħlu jħossu inqas importanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who reduces the size of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物的尺寸缩小的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who humiliates or humbles sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞辱他人或使他人不再自高自大的人。

collocations.en: someone who reduces the size of objects

formal.mt: Mexxej għandu jgħin lill-membri tat-tim jiżviluppaw il-ħiliet tagħhom, mingħajr ma jsir ċekkien tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: A leader should help team members develop their skills without becoming someone who belittles others.
formal.zh: 领导者应帮助团队成员发展技能，避免成为贬低别人的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex sejjaħtlu ċekkien tal-oħrajn? | Mark: Għax kull darba li xi ħadd jitkellem, hu jidħak bih u jġiegħlu jistħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you call him someone who belittles others? | Mark: Because whenever someone speaks, he laughs at them and makes them feel ashamed.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么说他是个贬低别人的人？ | Mark：因为每次有人开口，他都嘲笑对方，让人难堪。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个贬低别人的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him someone who belittles others?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li xi ħadd jitkellem, hu jidħak bih u jġiegħlu jistħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li xi ħadd jitkellem, hu jidħak bih u jġiegħlu jistħi.
messages.zh: 因为每次有人开口，他都嘲笑对方，让人难堪。
messages.en: Because whenever someone speaks, he laughs at them and makes them feel ashamed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让东西变小的人”和“让别人觉得自己渺小的人”两个画面记住两义；本词是名词，重点在做出行为的人。

gloss_zh: 爱贬低人的；具有缩小作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to belittle people, or having an effect that makes something smaller.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有贬低他人倾向的言行或态度，也可形容具有缩小尺寸作用的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jbaxxi l-valur ta' ħaddieħor, jew li għandu l-effett li jnaqqas id-daqs ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有贬低、轻视他人倾向的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the effect of reducing size
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有缩小尺寸效果的；起缩小作用的。

formal.mt: Fir-rispons lill-istudenti, l-għalliema għandhom jevitaw kliem ċekkieni li jista' jdgħajjef il-fiduċja tagħhom fihom infushom.
formal.en: When giving students feedback, teachers should avoid belittling words that could weaken their self-confidence.
formal.zh: 向学生提供反馈时，教师应避免使用可能削弱学生自信心的贬低性言语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kumment kien ċekkieni. | David: Għandek raġun. Stajt ngħid x'kien ħażin mingħajr ma nwaqqa' lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: That comment was belittling. | David: You're right. I could have said what was wrong without putting someone down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那句话有点贬低人。 | David：你说得对。我本可以指出问题，而不用贬低别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话有点贬低人。
messages.en: That comment was belittling.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Stajt ngħid x'kien ħażin mingħajr ma nwaqqa' lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Stajt ngħid x'kien ħażin mingħajr ma nwaqqa' lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我本可以指出问题，而不用贬低别人。
messages.en: You're right. I could have said what was wrong without putting someone down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċekkieni 放在“话语”和“效果”后面练习：话语使人受贬低，效果使尺寸缩小；它描述性质，区别于指人的名词 ċekkien。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shooter who fires accurately at selected targets from a concealed position, often at a distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常从隐蔽位置对选定的远处目标进行精确射击的射手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiratur li jispara bi preċiżjoni lejn miri magħżula minn post moħbi, spiss minn distanza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狙击手；通常隐蔽行动、对目标进行精确射击的射手。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ċekkin moħbi fuq il-bejt iżomm it-triq taħt osservazzjoni.
formal.en: In the novel, a sniper concealed on the roof keeps the street under observation.
formal.zh: 小说中，一名隐蔽在屋顶上的狙击手持续监视着街道。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Min hu dak fuq il-bejt fil-film? | Emma: Dak ċekkin. Qed josserva t-triq minn hemm fuq.
colloquial.en: Luca: Who is that on the roof in the film? | Emma: That's a sniper. He's watching the street from up there.
colloquial.zh: Luca：电影里屋顶上的那个人是谁？ | Emma：那是个狙击手。他正从上面监视街道。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak fuq il-bejt fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak fuq il-bejt fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里屋顶上的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the roof in the film?

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ċekkin. Qed josserva t-triq minn hemm fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ċekkin. Qed josserva t-triq minn hemm fuq.
messages.zh: 那是个狙击手。他正从上面监视街道。
messages.en: That's a sniper. He's watching the street from up there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影里隐蔽观察远处目标的狙击手，把画面与 ċekkin 配对；特别看清结尾是 in，避免和 ċekkien 混读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of examining or verifying something to see whether it is correct, complete, or in order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 查看或核实某事物，以确认其是否正确、齐全或符合要求的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li teżamina jew tivverifika xi ħaġa biex tara jekk hijiex korretta, kompluta jew kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查；核查；对内容、状态或资料进行核实的过程。

formal.mt: Qabel l-approvazzjoni tal-applikazzjoni, issir ċekkjatura tad-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa.
formal.en: Before the application is approved, all required documents are checked.
formal.zh: 申请获批之前，会对所有必需文件进行核查。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nistgħu nidħlu issa? | Ġużeppi: Għad trid issir ċekkjatura tal-biljetti. Żomm il-biljett lest.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can we go in now? | Ġużeppi: The tickets still need to be checked. Have your ticket ready.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们现在可以进去了吗？ | Ġużeppi：还得先验票。把你的票准备好。

messages.speaker: Marta (观众)
messages.zh: 我们现在可以进去了吗？
messages.en: Can we go in now?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (检票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad trid issir ċekkjatura tal-biljetti. Żomm il-biljett lest.
messages.mt_standard: Għad trid issir ċekkjatura tal-biljetti. Żomm il-biljett lest.
messages.zh: 还得先验票。把你的票准备好。
messages.en: The tickets still need to be checked. Have your ticket ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċekkjatura 与工作人员逐项核对文件、逐张检查门票的动作连起来记，重点是“检查这一过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Checkmate in chess: the decisive situation in which the king is under attack and no legal move can save it, also announced when the winning move is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际象棋中，王受到攻击且无法通过任何合法走法解除威胁的将死局面；也用于走出决定胜负的一步时宣告将死。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qagħda fiċ-ċess fejn ir-re jkun taħt attakk u ma jkun hemm ebda mossa legali li ssalvah; il-kelma tingħad ukoll meta ssir il-mossa rebbieħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: checkmate (said when making the conclusive move in chess)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将死；在国际象棋中走出决定胜负、使对方被将死的一步时所说的宣告。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju taċ-ċess, l-istudent għandu jsib il-mossa li tagħti ċekkmejt.
formal.en: In the chess exercise, the student must find the move that delivers checkmate.
formal.zh: 在这道国际象棋练习中，学生需要找出能够将死对方的一步。

colloquial.mt: Pietru: Ċekkmejt! Ir-re tiegħek ma jistax jaħrab. | Marija: Veru, ma nista' nsalvah b'ebda mossa. Erġajna nilagħbu?
colloquial.en: Pietru: Checkmate! Your king can't escape. | Marija: True, I can't save it with any move. Shall we play again?
colloquial.zh: Pietru：将死！你的王逃不掉了。 | Marija：确实，我怎么走都救不了它。再下一局吗？

messages.speaker: Pietru (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċekkmejt! Ir-re tiegħek ma jistax jaħrab.
messages.mt_standard: Ċekkmejt! Ir-re tiegħek ma jistax jaħrab.
messages.zh: 将死！你的王逃不掉了。
messages.en: Checkmate! Your king can't escape.

messages.speaker: Marija (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ma nista' nsalvah b'ebda mossa. Erġajna nilagħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ma nista' nsalvah b'ebda mossa. Erġajna nilagħbu?
messages.zh: 确实，我怎么走都救不了它。再下一局吗？
messages.en: True, I can't save it with any move. Shall we play again?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċekkmejt 与棋盘上“王受攻击、合法走法都无法解围”的终局画面绑定，再练习落子后喊出这个词。

gloss_zh: 小婴儿，通常指处于咿呀学语阶段的婴儿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young infant, especially one at the stage of making babbling sounds before speaking words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的婴儿，尤其指尚未正式说话、正在咿呀发声的婴儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarbija żgħira, speċjalment waħda fl-istadju li tagħmel ħsejjes ripetuti qabel tibda tgħid il-kliem.

sense_translations.en_definition: an infant, usually at the babbling stage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小婴儿，通常指正在咿呀学语的婴儿。

collocations.en: an infant in his mother's lap
collocations.zh: 坐在母亲膝上的小婴儿

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, iċ-ċekkun beda jagħmel ħsejjes ripetuti waqt li ommu kienet tkellmu.
formal.en: During the observation, the infant began making repeated sounds while his mother was talking to him.
formal.zh: 观察期间，母亲对小婴儿说话时，他开始反复发出咿呀声。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Isma' liċ-ċekkun! Qisu qed ikellimna. | Marija: Iva, għadu ma jgħidx kliem, imma jħobb jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes.
colloquial.en: Rita: Listen to the little baby! It's as if he's talking to us. | Marija: Yes, he doesn't say words yet, but he loves making those sounds.
colloquial.zh: Rita：听听这个小宝宝！好像在跟我们说话呢。 | Marija：是啊，他还不会说词语，不过很喜欢咿咿呀呀地发声。

messages.speaker: Rita (姨妈)
messages.zh: 听听这个小宝宝！好像在跟我们说话呢。
messages.en: Listen to the little baby! It's as if he's talking to us.

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu ma jgħidx kliem, imma jħobb jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu ma jgħidx kliem, imma jħobb jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes.
messages.zh: 是啊，他还不会说词语，不过很喜欢咿咿呀呀地发声。
messages.en: Yes, he doesn't say words yet, but he loves making those sounds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母亲膝上咿咿呀呀的小宝宝，把 ċekkun 与这个阶段的婴儿相连；用完整画面区分它和其他拼写相近的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do household chores, such as cleaning and putting things in order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做清洁、整理等日常家务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xogħol tad-dar, bħat-tindif u t-tqegħid tal-affarijiet f'posthom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做家务；处理家中的日常杂务。

collocations.en: did household chores in the morning

formal.mt: Qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin, Pawlu ċekner għal sagħtejn biex id-dar tkun nadifa u kollox ikun f'postu.
formal.en: Before the guests arrived, Pawlu did household chores for two hours so that the house would be clean and everything would be in its place.
formal.zh: 客人到来之前，保罗做了两个小时的家务，让屋子保持整洁，所有东西都各归其位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu dalgħodu? Rita: Ċekner ftit, imbagħad ħareġ jixtri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do this morning? Rita: He did a few household chores, then went out shopping.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天早上做了什么？丽塔：他做了点家务，然后出门买东西了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do this morning?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他做了点家务，然后出门买东西了。
messages.en: He did a few household chores, then went out shopping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċekner放进“扫地、擦桌、收拾房间”的连续画面中，整组记成“做家务”。

gloss_zh: 摇铃；拨浪鼓一类的响声玩具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toy or small object that makes a rattling sound when shaken, especially one used by a baby or child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动时会发出咔嗒声或沙沙声的小物件，尤指婴幼儿玩的摇铃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġugarell jew oġġett żgħir li jagħmel ħoss meta tħarrku jew tħawwdu, speċjalment wieħed għat-trabi jew għat-tfal.

sense_translations.en_definition: a rattle (e.g. of the sort used by children as a plaything)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇铃；摇动时会发出响声的物件，例如儿童玩的响声玩具。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, l-edukatriċi ħawdet iċ-ċekċieka bil-mod biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni tat-tarbija.
formal.en: During the activity, the educator gently shook the rattle to attract the baby's attention.
formal.zh: 活动期间，幼教老师轻轻摇动摇铃，吸引婴儿的注意。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi ċ-ċekċieka tat-tarbija? | Pawlu: Hawn, ħdejn il-kutra. Agħtihielha biex tilgħab biha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the baby's rattle? | Pawlu: Here, beside the blanket. Give it to her to play with.
colloquial.zh: Marija：宝宝的摇铃在哪里？ | Pawlu：在这里，毯子旁边。拿给她玩吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的摇铃在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the baby's rattle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħdejn il-kutra. Agħtihielha biex tilgħab biha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħdejn il-kutra. Agħtihielha biex tilgħab biha.
messages.zh: 在这里，毯子旁边。拿给她玩吧。
messages.en: Here, beside the blanket. Give it to her to play with.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċekċieka 和宝宝手中摇动的摇铃连在一起记：看到这个词，就想象小手一摇、玩具一响。

gloss_zh: 咔嗒作响；微不足道的小事或小东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rattling sound or the making of that sound; also a small or insignificant thing or matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物件摇动或碰撞时发出的连续咔嗒声，也可指很小或无关紧要的东西、事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ripetut ta' oġġetti li jitħarrku jew jaħbtu ma' xulxin; ukoll ħaġa żgħira jew bla wisq importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连续的咔嗒声或碰撞声；发出这种响声的过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: a trifle, sth. small or insignificant
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小事；小东西；微不足道或无关紧要的事物。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċekċik tal-fliexken fil-kaxxa waqaf meta l-ħaddiem poġġa biċċiet tad-drapp bejniethom.
formal.en: The rattling of the bottles in the box stopped when the worker placed pieces of cloth between them.
formal.zh: 工人在瓶子之间塞入布片后，箱内瓶子的碰撞声便停止了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Inkwetata għax hemm tebgħa żgħira fuq il-karta. | Nina: Tinkwetax għal ċekċik! Għandna kopja oħra nadifa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm worried because there's a small stain on the paper. | Nina: Don't worry over a trifle! We have another clean copy.
colloquial.zh: Lara：纸上有个小污点，我有点担心。 | Nina：别为一点小事担心啦！我们还有一份干净的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Inkwetata għax hemm tebgħa żgħira fuq il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Inkwetata għax hemm tebgħa żgħira fuq il-karta.
messages.zh: 纸上有个小污点，我有点担心。
messages.en: I'm worried because there's a small stain on the paper.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkwetax għal ċekċik! Għandna kopja oħra nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax għal ċekċik! Għandna kopja oħra nadifa.
messages.zh: 别为一点小事担心啦！我们还有一份干净的。
messages.en: Don't worry over a trifle! We have another clean copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：瓶子相碰是咔嗒声，纸上一点污渍是小事；不要把它和表示摇铃实物的 ċekċieka 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who officiates at a religious ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主持宗教仪式的人；主礼人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi ċerimonja reliġjuża.

sense_translations.en_definition: celebrant (person who officiates at a religious ceremony)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教仪式的主礼人；主持宗教仪式者。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċelebrant fetaħ iċ-ċerimonja b'talba u stieden lill-kongregazzjoni biex tipparteċipa.
formal.en: The celebrant opened the ceremony with a prayer and invited the congregation to participate.
formal.zh: 主礼人以祈祷开始仪式，并邀请会众参与。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jkun iċ-ċelebrant tal-quddiesa llum? Anna: Dun Ġorġ; diġà wasal il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will be the celebrant of Mass today? Anna: Father George; he has already arrived at the church.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天的弥撒由谁主礼？安娜：乔治神父；他已经到教堂了。

messages.speaker: Mark (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun iċ-ċelebrant tal-quddiesa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun iċ-ċelebrant tal-quddiesa llum?
messages.zh: 今天的弥撒由谁主礼？
messages.en: Who will be the celebrant of Mass today?

messages.speaker: Anna (教友)
messages.zh: 乔治神父；他已经到教堂了。
messages.en: Father George; he has already arrived at the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式前方带领祈祷的人，把ċelebrant牢牢记作“宗教仪式主礼人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Widely known and recognized, often for achievements or distinctive qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 广为人知的，常因成就或特色而享有声誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħruf ħafna, spiss minħabba kisbiet jew kwalitajiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著名的；知名的；享有盛名的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza wirja ddedikata lil pittur ċelebri li x-xogħlijiet tiegħu huma magħrufa madwar id-dinja.
formal.en: The museum organized an exhibition devoted to a renowned painter whose works are known around the world.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场专题展览，介绍一位作品闻名世界的著名画家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak ħdejn il-bieb? Luqa: Hu attur ċelebri; rajtu f'ħafna films.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that by the door? Luqa: He is a famous actor; I have seen him in many films.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：门边那个人是谁？卢卡：他是个著名演员；我在很多电影里见过他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 门边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that by the door?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu attur ċelebri; rajtu f'ħafna films.
messages.mt_standard: Hu attur ċelebri; rajtu f'ħafna films.
messages.zh: 他是个著名演员；我在很多电影里见过他。
messages.en: He is a famous actor; I have seen him in many films.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċelebri贴在作家、演员、画作旁边，想成一张写着“大家都知道”的形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being famous, or a person who is widely known to the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出名的状态、名气；也指广为公众熟知的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna tkun magħrufa ħafna, jew persuna magħrufa ħafna mill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名气；声名；知名度。
名人；广为公众熟知的人物。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti l-prezz taċ-ċelebrità u d-diffikultajiet li persuna famuża tista' tiltaqa' magħhom fil-ħajja privata.
formal.en: The article discusses the price of fame and the difficulties a famous person may encounter in private life.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论了成名的代价，以及名人在私人生活中可能遇到的困难。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik ċelebrità, hux? Mark: Iva, hi kantanta magħrufa ħafna, imma llum ġiet biss tieħu kafè.
colloquial.en: Nina: She is a celebrity, isn't she? Mark: Yes, she is a very well-known singer, but today she has just come for a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那是位名人，对吧？马克：对，她是位很有名的歌手，不过今天只是来喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Nina (咖啡馆顾客)
messages.zh: 那是位名人，对吧？
messages.en: She is a celebrity, isn't she?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi kantanta magħrufa ħafna, imma llum ġiet biss tieħu kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi kantanta magħrufa ħafna, imma llum ġiet biss tieħu kafè.
messages.zh: 对，她是位很有名的歌手，不过今天只是来喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, she is a very well-known singer, but today she has just come for a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分ċelebrità：聚光灯象征抽象的“名气”，灯下的人就是具体的“名人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the sky, outer space, or heaven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与天空、宇宙天体或天国有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sema, mal-ispazju jew mal-ġenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天空的；天体的；天国的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw teleskopju biex josservaw korpi ċelestjali u jiddeskrivu dak li raw fis-sema.
formal.en: The students used a telescope to observe celestial bodies and describe what they saw in the sky.
formal.zh: 学生们用望远镜观察天体，并描述他们在天空中看到的景象。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'inhuma korpi ċelestjali? Ben: Bħax-xemx, il-qamar u l-istilel; ejja nħarsu bit-teleskopju.
colloquial.en: Ella: What are celestial bodies? Ben: Things like the sun, the moon and the stars; let's look through the telescope.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：什么是天体？本：比如太阳、月亮和星星；我们用望远镜看看吧。

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是天体？
messages.en: What are celestial bodies?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħax-xemx, il-qamar u l-istilel; ejja nħarsu bit-teleskopju.
messages.mt_standard: Bħax-xemx, il-qamar u l-istilel; ejja nħarsu bit-teleskopju.
messages.zh: 比如太阳、月亮和星星；我们用望远镜看看吧。
messages.en: Things like the sun, the moon and the stars; let's look through the telescope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到ċelestjali就把视线移向天空：日月星辰提示“天体的”，天国画面提示宗教语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smear a substance over a surface, or figuratively to damage someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某种物质涂抹在表面上；也可比喻玷污他人的名誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidlek wiċċ b'xi sustanza, jew, f'sens figurattiv, iħammeġ ir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；抹污；把某种物质抹在表面上。
玷污；诋毁；损害他人的名誉。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif l-awtur ċellaq ir-reputazzjoni tal-għalliem b'akkużi foloz.
formal.en: The report explains how the author besmirched the teacher's reputation with false accusations.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该作者如何通过虚假指控玷污这位教师的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċellaq il-mejda biż-żebgħa? Tom: Jien, bi żball; se nnaddafha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who smeared paint on the table? Tom: I did, by accident; I will clean it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把油漆抹到桌上了？汤姆：是我，不小心弄的；我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把油漆抹到桌上了？
messages.en: Who smeared paint on the table?

messages.speaker: Tom (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, bi żball; se nnaddafha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, bi żball; se nnaddafha issa.
messages.zh: 是我，不小心弄的；我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: I did, by accident; I will clean it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“抹上一道污痕”记ċellaq：桌面上的污痕是实义，名誉上的污痕是比喻义。

gloss_zh: 穿着邋遢的；衣着不整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dressed poorly or untidily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着邋遢、衣着不整的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liebes ħażin jew b'mod traskurat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着邋遢的；衣着不整的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jidher ċellaqbiebu fl-ewwel laqgħa, bi qmis imtebbgħa u ġakketta mqattgħa.
formal.en: In the novel, the character appears poorly dressed at the first meeting, wearing a stained shirt and a torn jacket.
formal.zh: 小说中，这个人物初次见面时衣着邋遢，穿着一件有污渍的衬衫和一件破夹克。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħriġt ċellaqbiebu llum? Pawlu: Kont qed inżebgħa; se mmur nibdel qabel niltaqgħu mal-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you come out looking so untidily dressed today? Pawlu: I was painting; I will go and change before we meet the others.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你今天怎么穿得这么邋遢就出来了？保罗：我刚才在刷漆；见其他人之前我会去换衣服。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么穿得这么邋遢就出来了？
messages.en: Why did you come out looking so untidily dressed today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed inżebgħa; se mmur nibdel qabel niltaqgħu mal-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed inżebgħa; se mmur nibdel qabel niltaqgħu mal-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 我刚才在刷漆；见其他人之前我会去换衣服。
messages.en: I was painting; I will go and change before we meet the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċellaqbiebu记成描述穿着的标签：衬衫有污渍、衣服没整理，回答的是“穿得怎么样”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually looks shabby, for example by wearing stained or untidy clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常显得邋遢的人，例如常穿有污渍或不整洁的衣服的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li s-soltu tidher traskurata, pereżempju bi ħwejjeġ imtebbgħin jew mhux puliti.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to be shabby, wearing stained clothes etc
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常衣着邋遢的人，例如经常穿着有污渍衣服的人。

collocations.zh: 像个惯常衣着邋遢的人

collocations.en: the role of a habitually shabby person
collocations.zh: 一个常穿得邋遢的人的角色

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, iċ-ċellieq jintgħaraf mill-qmis imtebbgħa li jilbes kuljum u mill-ġakketta li qatt ma jnaddaf.
formal.en: In the story, the habitually shabby man is recognizable by the stained shirt he wears every day and the jacket he never cleans.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个常穿得邋遢的人很好辨认：他每天都穿着那件有污渍的衬衫，夹克也从不清洗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru tiegħek jidher qisu ċellieq? Ben: Għax qatt ma jieħu ħsieb ħwejġu; għalhekk il-kostum għandu ħafna tbajja'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does your character look like someone who is always shabbily dressed? Ben: Because he never takes care of his clothes; that is why the costume has so many stains.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的角色为什么看起来像个总是穿得邋遢的人？本：因为他从来不打理自己的衣服，所以戏服上有很多污渍。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru tiegħek jidher qisu ċellieq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru tiegħek jidher qisu ċellieq?
messages.zh: 你的角色为什么看起来像个总是穿得邋遢的人？
messages.en: Why does your character look like someone who is always shabbily dressed?

messages.speaker: Ben (同剧演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qatt ma jieħu ħsieb ħwejġu; għalhekk il-kostum għandu ħafna tbajja'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qatt ma jieħu ħsieb ħwejġu; għalhekk il-kostum għandu ħafna tbajja'.
messages.zh: 因为他从来不打理自己的衣服，所以戏服上有很多污渍。
messages.en: Because he never takes care of his clothes; that is why the costume has so many stains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“常穿脏衣服的那个人”记ċellieq，抓住它是指人的名词，并带有惯常邋遢的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to dirty or soil things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人经常或容易把东西弄脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jħammeġ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. with a tendency to dirty or soil things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容容易把东西弄脏的人。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to make things dirty
collocations.zh: 容易把东西弄脏的男孩

collocations.en: a worker who tends to soil things
collocations.zh: 干活时容易弄脏东西的工人

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, tifel ċellieqi ħammeġ il-mejda biż-żebgħa.
formal.en: During the activity, a boy who tends to make things dirty soiled the table with paint.
formal.zh: 活动期间，一个容易弄脏东西的男孩用颜料弄脏了桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħija ċellieqi; dejjem iħalli tbajja' fuq il-mejda. Mark: Agħtih drapp biex inaddaf warajh.
colloquial.en: Maja: My brother tends to make things dirty; he always leaves stains on the table. Mark: Give him a cloth so he can clean up after himself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我弟弟很容易弄脏东西，总在桌上留下污渍。Mark：给他一块抹布，让他自己收拾干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ċellieqi; dejjem iħalli tbajja' fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ċellieqi; dejjem iħalli tbajja' fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 我弟弟很容易弄脏东西，总在桌上留下污渍。
messages.en: My brother tends to make things dirty; he always leaves stains on the table.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给他一块抹布，让他自己收拾干净。
messages.en: Give him a cloth so he can clean up after himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人走到哪里就把哪里弄脏：这个形容词描述人的弄脏倾向，记成“容易制造污渍的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of smearing something or making it dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物涂抹得污脏，或将其弄脏的一次动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidlek jew iħammeġ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of smearing or soiling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹或弄脏某物的动作。

collocations.en: an act of smearing with mud
an act of smearing with paint
collocations.zh: 用颜料涂抹弄脏的动作

formal.mt: B'ċelqa waħda ta' żebgħa, it-tifel ħammeġ il-mejda.
formal.en: With a single smear of paint, the boy made the table dirty.
formal.zh: 男孩用颜料一抹，就把桌子弄脏了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: B'ċelqa waħda ħammeġ il-mejda kollha! Mark: Ġib drapp imxarrab u nnaddfuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: With one smear, he made the whole table dirty! Mark: Bring a damp cloth and we'll clean it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他这么一抹，就把整张桌子弄脏了！Mark：拿块湿抹布来，我们把它擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他这么一抹，就把整张桌子弄脏了！
messages.en: With one smear, he made the whole table dirty!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 拿块湿抹布来，我们把它擦干净。
messages.en: Bring a damp cloth and we'll clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一抹就弄脏”的动作画面记忆：重点放在手抹过去的那一下，而不是已经留下的污点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ringing of bells or a telephone, or the act of calling someone by telephone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟或电话发出的铃声，也指给某人打电话这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq tal-qniepen jew tat-telefon, jew l-att li wieħed iċempel lil xi ħadd bit-telefon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟的鸣响；钟声。
电话的铃响；电话铃声。
给某人打电话这一行为。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċempil lill-klijenti għandu jsir matul il-ħinijiet tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Telephone calls to customers should be made during office hours.
formal.zh: 给客户打电话应安排在办公时间内。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' ċ-ċempil tat-telefon? Mark: Iva, se nwieġeb jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the telephone ringing? Mark: Yes, I'll answer it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见电话铃响了吗？Mark：听见了，我来接。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见电话铃响了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the telephone ringing?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，我来接。
messages.en: Yes, I'll answer it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 串起三个画面：教堂钟响、桌上电话响、拿起电话拨给别人；前两个记声音，第三个记打电话的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room used for eating meals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人用餐的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra fejn jittieklu l-ikliet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐室；供人用餐的房间。

formal.mt: Il-mistednin daħlu fiċ-ċenakolu u qagħdu madwar il-mejda għall-ikla.
formal.en: The guests entered the dining room and sat around the table for the meal.
formal.zh: 客人们走进餐室，围坐在桌旁用餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nieklu? Mark: Fiċ-ċenakolu; il-mejda diġà lesta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going to eat? Mark: In the dining room; the table is already set.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪儿吃饭？Mark：在餐室里，餐桌已经摆好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (客人)
messages.zh: 我们在哪儿吃饭？
messages.en: Where are we going to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 在餐室里，餐桌已经摆好了。
messages.en: In the dining room; the table is already set.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象推开一扇门，里面只有摆好餐具的大餐桌；把整个用餐房间作为这个名词的记忆画面。
