teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread incense smoke; also, to be unwilling to spend or give money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使焚香的烟气散开；也指舍不得花钱或给钱，表现得吝啬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred id-duħħan tal-inċens; ukoll, ma jkunx lest li jonfoq jew jagħti flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使焚香的烟气散开；散布香烟。
吝啬；舍不得花钱或给钱。

collocations.en: was tight-fisted when it came to paying
collocations.zh: 到了付款时就表现得很吝啬

formal.mt: Il-qassis ċenser waqt iċ-ċerimonja, u d-duħħan tal-inċens infirex fil-knisja.
formal.en: The priest spread incense during the ceremony, and the incense smoke spread through the church.
formal.zh: 神父在仪式期间散布香烟，焚香的烟气在教堂内弥漫开来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ċenser meta ġie biex iħallas is-sehem tiegħu. Mark: Iva, ma ried joħroġ xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Paul was tight-fisted when it came to paying his share. Mark: Yes, he didn't want to contribute anything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：到了该付自己那份钱的时候，保罗就很吝啬。Mark：是啊，他一点钱都不想出。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ċenser meta ġie biex iħallas is-sehem tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ċenser meta ġie biex iħallas is-sehem tiegħu.
messages.zh: 到了该付自己那份钱的时候，保罗就很吝啬。
messages.en: Paul was tight-fisted when it came to paying his share.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他一点钱都不想出。
messages.en: Yes, he didn't want to contribute anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两张情景卡：一张是香烟向四周散开，一张是付钱时紧捂钱包；用上下文选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official count of a population, usually collecting information about the people counted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某一地区人口进行的正式统计，通常同时收集居民的相关资料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd uffiċjali tal-popolazzjoni li normalment jiġbor ukoll informazzjoni dwar in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人口普查；对人口进行的正式统计。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati taċ-ċensiment jintużaw biex jiġu ppjanati s-servizzi għall-popolazzjoni.
formal.en: Census results are used to plan services for the population.
formal.zh: 人口普查结果用于规划面向居民的服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Imlejt il-kwestjonarju taċ-ċensiment? Mark: Għadni le; se nimlieh illejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you filled in the census questionnaire? Mark: Not yet; I'll fill it in tonight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你填好人口普查问卷了吗？Mark：还没有，我今晚填。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你填好人口普查问卷了吗？
messages.en: Have you filled in the census questionnaire?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 还没有，我今晚填。
messages.en: Not yet; I'll fill it in tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每户填写一张人口问卷，最后汇成全地区人数统计；把“逐户登记、汇总人口”连成一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who examines material and decides whether any part must be removed or restricted before publication or public presentation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在材料出版或公开展示前检查其内容，并决定是否删改或限制传播的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li teżamina materjal qabel il-pubblikazzjoni jew il-wiri tiegħu u tiddeċiedi jekk xi parti għandhiex titneħħa jew tiġi ristretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审查出版物、电影等内容并有权要求删改或限制传播的人；审查员。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċensur talab li titneħħa xena mill-film qabel il-wiri pubbliku.
formal.en: The censor requested that a scene be removed from the film before its public screening.
formal.zh: 审查员要求在电影公开放映前删去一个场景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex neħħew dik ix-xena? Mark: Iċ-ċensur talab li titneħħa qabel jintwera l-film.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they remove that scene? Mark: The censor asked for it to be removed before the film was shown.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们为什么删掉那个场景？Mark：审查员要求在电影放映前把它删掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么删掉那个场景？
messages.en: Why did they remove that scene?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċensur talab li titneħħa qabel jintwera l-film.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċensur talab li titneħħa qabel jintwera l-film.
messages.zh: 审查员要求在电影放映前把它删掉。
messages.en: The censor asked for it to be removed before the film was shown.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着红笔决定电影删哪一幕的人，把 ċensur 牢牢记成审查员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice or system of examining material and suppressing or restricting content before or during its public circulation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检查传播内容，并在公开传播前或传播过程中删禁、限制有关内容的做法或制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika jew is-sistema li teżamina materjal u tneħħi jew tillimita kontenut qabel jew waqt it-tixrid tiegħu lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对出版、影视、言论等内容进行检查并加以删禁或限制的做法或制度。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-effetti taċ-ċensura fuq il-libertà tal-espressjoni.
formal.en: The study analyses the effects of censorship on freedom of expression.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了审查制度对表达自由的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tant paġni neqsin minn dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Minħabba ċ-ċensura; xi partijiet ma tħallewx jiġu ppubblikati.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are so many pages missing from this book? Pawlu: Because of censorship; some parts were not allowed to be published.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书为什么缺了这么多页？Pawlu：因为内容审查，有些部分不获准出版。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant paġni neqsin minn dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant paġni neqsin minn dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书为什么缺了这么多页？
messages.en: Why are so many pages missing from this book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba ċ-ċensura; xi partijiet ma tħallewx jiġu ppubblikati.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba ċ-ċensura; xi partijiet ma tħallewx jiġu ppubblikati.
messages.zh: 因为内容审查，有些部分不获准出版。
messages.en: Because of censorship; some parts were not allowed to be published.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把书页被遮住的画面与 ċensura 联系起来，记住它表示审查行为或制度。

gloss_zh: 应受谴责的；值得责备的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving blame or strong disapproval because of wrongdoing or unacceptable behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因做错事或行为不可接受而应受到责备或强烈批评的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħoqqlu tmaqdir jew kundanna minħabba għemil ħażin jew imġiba mhux aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应受责备或谴责的；行为、决定等有过错而值得批评的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeskriva l-użu ta' informazzjoni falza bħala att ċensurabbli.
formal.en: The committee described the use of false information as a censurable act.
formal.zh: 委员会将使用虚假信息描述为应受谴责的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Huwa żvela s-sigriet tagħha biex idaħħaq lill-oħrajn. Toni: Dik hi mġiba ċensurabbli. Għandu jitlobha skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: He revealed her secret to make the others laugh. Toni: That is censurable behaviour. He should apologise to her.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他为了逗其他人笑，泄露了她的秘密。Toni：这种行为应受谴责。他应该向她道歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa żvela s-sigriet tagħha biex idaħħaq lill-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa żvela s-sigriet tagħha biex idaħħaq lill-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 他为了逗其他人笑，泄露了她的秘密。
messages.en: He revealed her secret to make the others laugh.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi mġiba ċensurabbli. Għandu jitlobha skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi mġiba ċensurabbli. Għandu jitlobha skuża.
messages.zh: 这种行为应受谴责。他应该向她道歉。
messages.en: That is censurable behaviour. He should apologise to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“泄露秘密，应受责备”的小场景记住 ċensurabbli，重点是值得谴责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hundredth anniversary of an event, or a celebration marking that anniversary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一事件发生一百周年的纪念日，或为此举行的庆祝活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-anniversarju li jimmarka mitt sena minn ġrajja, jew iċ-ċelebrazzjoni ta' dan l-anniversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百周年；百年纪念日或百年纪念活动。
百周年的；与百年纪念有关的。

collocations.en: the centenary of the school's founding

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat wirja ta' ritratti biex tfakkar iċ-ċentinarju tat-twaqqif tagħha.
formal.en: The school organised a photographic exhibition to mark the centenary of its founding.
formal.zh: 学校举办了摄影展，以纪念建校一百周年。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm festa fl-iskola llum? Ben: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentinarju tagħha; twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a celebration at school today? Ben: We are celebrating its centenary; it was founded a hundred years ago.
colloquial.zh: Nina：学校今天为什么举办庆祝活动？Ben：我们在庆祝建校一百周年，学校是一百年前创立的。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 学校今天为什么举办庆祝活动？
messages.en: Why is there a celebration at school today?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentinarju tagħha; twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niċċelebraw iċ-ċentinarju tagħha; twaqqfet mitt sena ilu.
messages.zh: 我们在庆祝建校一百周年，学校是一百年前创立的。
messages.en: We are celebrating its centenary; it was founded a hundred years ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象校庆蛋糕上写着一百周年：ċentinarju 作名词指百年纪念，作形容词表示百周年的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being centrally located or of having a main and important role within something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于中心位置的性质，或在某个整体中具有核心作用和重要地位的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li xi ħaġa tkun fiċ-ċentru jew ikollha rwol ewlieni u importanti fi ħdan xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中心性；居于中心的位置，或所具有的核心地位与重要作用。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza ċ-ċentralità tal-edukazzjoni fl-iżvilupp tas-soċjetà.
formal.en: The report emphasises the centrality of education in the development of society.
formal.zh: 报告强调了教育在社会发展中的核心地位。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għażiltu din is-sala għal-laqgħa? David: Minħabba ċ-ċentralità tal-post; kulħadd jista' jasal faċilment.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you choose this hall for the meeting? David: Because of its central location; everyone can get here easily.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你们为什么选这个大厅开会？David：因为它的位置居中，大家都容易到达。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你们为什么选这个大厅开会？
messages.en: Why did you choose this hall for the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba ċ-ċentralità tal-post; kulħadd jista' jasal faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba ċ-ċentralità tal-post; kulħadd jista' jasal faċilment.
messages.zh: 因为它的位置居中，大家都容易到达。
messages.en: Because of its central location; everyone can get here easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图或概念图中央画一个圆，用 ċentralità 同时记住位置居中和作用核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing control, decisions, services, or resources together under one centre or authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将控制权、决策、服务或资源集中到一个中心或统一机构的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jiġbor il-kontroll, id-deċiżjonijiet, is-servizzi jew ir-riżorsi f'ċentru wieħed jew taħt awtorità waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集中化；把权力、决策、资源或服务集中到单一中心或机构。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi ċentralizzazzjoni tas-servizzi amministrattivi f'uffiċċju wieħed.
formal.en: The plan proposes centralizing administrative services in a single office.
formal.zh: 该计划建议将行政服务集中到一个办公室。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji differenti? Karl: Le, wara ċ-ċentralizzazzjoni tas-servizzi tista' tagħmel kollox hawn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do I still have to go to three different offices? Karl: No, following the centralization of services, you can do everything here.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我还得跑三个不同的办公室吗？Karl：不用，服务集中以后，你可以在这里办完所有事情。

messages.speaker: Rita (办事居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji differenti?
messages.zh: 我还得跑三个不同的办公室吗？
messages.en: Do I still have to go to three different offices?

messages.speaker: Karl (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara ċ-ċentralizzazzjoni tas-servizzi tista' tagħmel kollox hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara ċ-ċentralizzazzjoni tas-servizzi tista' tagħmel kollox hawn.
messages.zh: 不用，服务集中以后，你可以在这里办完所有事情。
messages.en: No, following the centralization of services, you can do everything here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多个办事窗口的箭头汇入同一个中心，把 ċentralizzazzjoni 记成集中化的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Located at a centre or arranged in relation to a centre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于中心位置的，或围绕某个中心安排的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fiċ-ċentru jew huwa mqassam madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中心的；处于中心位置或以中心为依据安排的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan ipoġġi l-funtana f'punt ċentriku tal-ġnien, bil-mogħdijiet madwarha.
formal.en: The plan places the fountain at a central point in the garden, with paths around it.
formal.zh: 该规划将喷泉设在花园的中心位置，并在周围布置小径。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn inpoġġu l-mejda? Mario: F'punt ċentriku tal-kamra, biex inkunu nistgħu noqogħdu madwarha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where shall we put the table? Mario: At a central point in the room, so we can sit around it.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们把桌子放在哪里？Mario：放在房间中央，这样我们就能围着它坐。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把桌子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the table?

messages.speaker: Mario (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'punt ċentriku tal-kamra, biex inkunu nistgħu noqogħdu madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: F'punt ċentriku tal-kamra, biex inkunu nistgħu noqogħdu madwarha.
messages.zh: 放在房间中央，这样我们就能围着它坐。
messages.en: At a central point in the room, so we can sit around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌子放在房间正中间，用 punt ċentriku 记住中心位置；搭配阴性名词时可见 ċentrika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with a long, segmented body and one pair of legs on each leg-bearing body segment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体细长、分节，具有足的各躯干节上各有一对足的小动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem twil maqsum f'segmenti, b'par saqajn fuq kull segment li jġorr is-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜈蚣；身体细长而分节、各有足躯干节各具一对足的多足动物。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, l-istudenti raw ċentupied jiċċaqlaq taħt ġebla niedja.
formal.en: While observing the garden, the students saw a centipede moving beneath a damp stone.
formal.zh: 学生们观察花园时，看见一条蜈蚣在一块潮湿的石头下面爬动。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara kemm għandu saqajn dak l-annimal! Nannu: Dak ċentupied. Ejja nħalluh jimxi fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look how many legs that animal has! Grandpa: That is a centipede. Let's leave it to move around the garden.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你看，那只动物有好多条腿！爷爷：那是蜈蚣。让它在花园里爬吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm għandu saqajn dak l-annimal!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm għandu saqajn dak l-annimal!
messages.zh: 你看，那只动物有好多条腿！
messages.en: Look how many legs that animal has!

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ċentupied. Ejja nħalluh jimxi fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ċentupied. Ejja nħalluh jimxi fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 那是蜈蚣。让它在花园里爬吧。
messages.en: That is a centipede. Let's leave it to move around the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石头下面一条身体分节、许多小脚依次迈动的蜈蚣，把画面与 ċentupied 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of multiplying a quantity by one hundred, making it one hundred times its original value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个数量乘以一百，使其达到原来一百倍的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih kwantità tiġi mmultiplikata b'mija u ssir mitt darba l-valur oriġinali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百倍化；使数量增至原来一百倍的过程。

collocations.en: the multiplication of the amount by one hundred
the multiplication of the value by one hundred

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentuplikazzjoni ta' żewġ unitajiet tagħti mitejn unità.
formal.en: Multiplying two units by one hundred gives two hundred units.
formal.zh: 将两个单位百倍化，得到两百个单位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser ċentuplikazzjoni? Mark: Timmaġina li għandek tliet ewro u timmultiplikahom b'mija: ikollok tliet mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does centuplication mean? Mark: Imagine you have three euros and multiply that by one hundred: you get three hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: Maja：百倍化是什么意思？Mark：想象你有三欧元，把它乘以一百，就得到三百欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 百倍化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does centuplication mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Timmaġina li għandek tliet ewro u timmultiplikahom b'mija: ikollok tliet mitt ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Timmaġina li għandek tliet ewro u timmultiplikahom b'mija: ikollok tliet mitt ewro.
messages.zh: 想象你有三欧元，把它乘以一百，就得到三百欧元。
messages.en: Imagine you have three euros and multiply that by one hundred: you get three hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上一张算式卡：2 × 100 = 200，记住它表示百倍化的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equal to one hundred times a reference quantity or value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个数量或数值是参照量的一百倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mitt darba daqs kwantità jew valur ta' referenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一百倍的；相当于参照数量一百倍的。

collocations.en: an amount one hundred times as large
a value one hundred times as large

formal.mt: Meta mqabbel ma' żewġ ewro, ammont ta' mitejn ewro huwa ċentuplu.
formal.en: Compared with two euros, an amount of two hundred euros is a hundredfold amount.
formal.zh: 与两欧元相比，两百欧元是其一百倍的数额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jekk nibdew b'ħames ewro, kemm ikun ammont ċentuplu? Toni: Ħames mitt ewro, għax timmultiplika b'mija.
colloquial.en: Lara: If we start with five euros, how much would a hundredfold amount be? Toni: Five hundred euros, because you multiply by one hundred.
colloquial.zh: Lara：如果从五欧元开始，一百倍的数额是多少？Toni：五百欧元，因为要乘以一百。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nibdew b'ħames ewro, kemm ikun ammont ċentuplu?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nibdew b'ħames ewro, kemm ikun ammont ċentuplu?
messages.zh: 如果从五欧元开始，一百倍的数额是多少？
messages.en: If we start with five euros, how much would a hundredfold amount be?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħames mitt ewro, għax timmultiplika b'mija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħames mitt ewro, għax timmultiplika b'mija.
messages.zh: 五百欧元，因为要乘以一百。
messages.en: Five hundred euros, because you multiply by one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一枚硬币旁放着一百枚同值硬币：这个形容词描述一百倍的数量关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a light, clear ringing sound, or to sound like a bell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出轻而清脆的叮当声，或像钟铃一样鸣响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ħafif u ċar bħal ta' qanpiena, jew idoqq bħal qanpiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出轻微而清脆的叮当声。
像钟铃一样鸣响。

formal.mt: Il-qanpien ċenċel qabel il-bidu taċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The bells chimed before the ceremony began.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，钟鸣响了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt? Il-qanpiena ċenċlet. Mark: Iva, hemm xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that? The bell tinkled. Mark: Yes, there's someone by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：听见了吗？铃叮当响了一下。Mark：听见了，门边有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了吗？铃叮当响了一下。
messages.en: Did you hear that? The bell tinkled.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm xi ħadd ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 听见了，门边有人。
messages.en: Yes, there's someone by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放小铃“叮当响起来”的过程；这是表示发声动作的动词，可以用“铃响了”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light, clear ringing sound, such as the tinkling, jingling, or chiming of small metal objects or bells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金属小物件或钟铃发出的清脆叮当声、铃声或钟鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ħafif u ċar bħal dak li jagħmlu ċ-ċwievet jew il-qniepen meta jdoqqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻而清脆的叮当作响声。
小金属物件碰撞时连续发出的叮当声。
钟铃的鸣响声。
一声轻而清脆的叮当声。

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-kamra, iċ-ċenċil taċ-ċwievet instema' ċar.
formal.en: In the quiet room, the jingling of the keys could be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 房间里很安静，钥匙的叮当声听得格外清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak iċ-ċenċil? Mark: Iċ-ċwievet fil-but tiegħi; qed jolqtu ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that jingling? Mark: The keys in my pocket; they're knocking against each other.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是什么叮当声？Mark：是我口袋里的钥匙，它们碰在一起了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么叮当声？
messages.en: What's that jingling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċwievet fil-but tiegħi; qed jolqtu ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċwievet fil-but tiegħi; qed jolqtu ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 是我口袋里的钥匙，它们碰在一起了。
messages.en: The keys in my pocket; they're knocking against each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把钥匙串的叮当声想成可以录下来的一段声音：ċenċil是声音名词，可用“听见叮当声”来记。

gloss_zh: 动词，所给材料未提供词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose meaning is not supplied in the packet; its specific meaning cannot be determined from the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将本词标为动词，但未提供释义，因此无法根据现有材料确定其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex mogħtija fil-pakkett; it-tifsira speċifika ma tistax tiġi ddeterminata mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给材料未提供释义；具体动词义无法确定。

formal.mt: Il-verb 'ċeppen' jidher fil-lista, iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex mogħtija.
formal.en: The verb 'ċeppen' appears in the list, but its meaning is not supplied.
formal.zh: 动词“ċeppen”出现在词表中，但材料未提供其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ċeppen'? Mark: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira, għalhekk ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ċeppen' mean? Mark: The packet gives no meaning, so we cannot determine it from this information.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“ċeppen”是什么意思？Mark：材料没有给出释义，所以我们无法根据这些信息确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “ċeppen”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċeppen' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira, għalhekk ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix tifsira, għalhekk ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 材料没有给出释义，所以我们无法根据这些信息确定它的含义。
messages.en: The packet gives no meaning, so we cannot determine it from this information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它写在标有“动词，释义待补”的学习卡上，先记拼写，不凭近形词猜测意思。

gloss_zh: 女式短外套；波列罗短上衣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short jacket for women, such as a bolero, worn over other clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在其他衣服外面的女式短外套，例如波列罗短上衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġakketta qasira għan-nisa, bħal bolero, li tintlibes fuq ħwejjeġ oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波列罗短上衣；女式短外套。

collocations.en: a bolero jacket over a dress
collocations.zh: 罩在连衣裙外的女式短外套

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, għażlet ċeppun tal-ħarir biex tilbsu fuq il-libsa.
formal.en: For the ceremony, she chose a silk bolero jacket to wear over her dress.
formal.zh: 为了参加仪式，她选了一件丝质女式短外套，穿在连衣裙外面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn xi ħaġa biex nilbes fuq din il-libsa. Nina: Ipprova dan iċ-ċeppun; il-kulur jaqbel mal-libsa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need something to wear over this dress. Nina: Try this bolero jacket; its colour matches the dress.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我需要一件能穿在这条连衣裙外面的衣服。Nina：试试这件短外套，它的颜色和裙子很搭。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn xi ħaġa biex nilbes fuq din il-libsa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn xi ħaġa biex nilbes fuq din il-libsa.
messages.zh: 我需要一件能穿在这条连衣裙外面的衣服。
messages.en: I need something to wear over this dress.

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova dan iċ-ċeppun; il-kulur jaqbel mal-libsa.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova dan iċ-ċeppun; il-kulur jaqbel mal-libsa.
messages.zh: 试试这件短外套，它的颜色和裙子很搭。
messages.en: Try this bolero jacket; its colour matches the dress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象连衣裙外罩着一件短到腰际的小外套，用这幅穿搭画面记住女式短外套义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosure for keeping animals; also a jail where people are confined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圈养动物的围栏或畜栏；也指关押人的监牢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post magħluq fejn jinżammu l-annimali; ukoll ħabs fejn jinżammu l-priġunieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畜栏；羊圈；用于圈养动物的围栏或围地。
监牢；关押人的地方。

formal.mt: In-nagħaġ inżammu fiċ-ċeppuna matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The sheep were kept in the pen during the night.
formal.zh: 夜间，羊被关在畜栏里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'din l-istorja, il-priġunier qiegħed fiċ-ċeppuna. Dan ifisser ħabs? Mark: Iva, hawnhekk ċeppuna tfisser ħabs.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this story, the prisoner is in a ċeppuna. Does that mean jail? Mark: Yes, here ċeppuna means jail.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事说囚犯在ċeppuna里。这里是指监牢吗？Mark：对，这里的ċeppuna指监牢。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din l-istorja, il-priġunier qiegħed fiċ-ċeppuna. Dan ifisser ħabs?
messages.mt_standard: F'din l-istorja, il-priġunier qiegħed fiċ-ċeppuna. Dan ifisser ħabs?
messages.zh: 这个故事说囚犯在ċeppuna里。这里是指监牢吗？
messages.en: In this story, the prisoner is in a ċeppuna. Does that mean jail?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 对，这里的ċeppuna指监牢。
messages.en: Yes, here ċeppuna means jail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立的词义卡：一张是羊圈，一张是监牢；根据句中的动物或囚犯选择含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element cerium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铈的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala ċerju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铈，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kampjun taċ-ċerju u l-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the cerium sample and its properties.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这份铈样品及其性质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu ċ-ċerju? | Mark: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is cerium? | Mark: It is a chemical element; we read about it in class today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：铈是什么？ | 马克：它是一种化学元素；我们今天上课读到了它。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 铈是什么？
messages.en: What is cerium?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素；我们今天上课读到了它。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; we read about it in class today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċerju 做一张“铈样品”标签卡，再配记 kampjun taċ-ċerju，把元素名称放进实验报告场景中记忆。

gloss_zh: 缓慢跟随；慢慢跟在后面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To follow someone slowly, for example an animal following its leader.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 慢慢跟随某人，例如动物缓慢跟在领头者后面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi bil-mod wara xi ħadd, bħal annimal li jsegwi lill-mexxej tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to follow sb. slowly (used, e.g., of animals following their leader)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢跟随某人，例如用于描述动物慢慢跟随领头者。

formal.mt: Il-kelb ċerkek wara sidu tul it-triq.
formal.en: The dog followed its owner slowly along the road.
formal.zh: 那只狗沿着路慢慢跟在主人后面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb ġera warajk? | Pawlu: Le, ċerkek warajja sat-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the dog run after you? | Pawlu: No, it followed me slowly as far as the road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只狗跑着追你了吗？ | 保罗：没有，它慢慢跟着我，一直跟到了路边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只狗跑着追你了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog run after you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，它慢慢跟着我，一直跟到了路边。
messages.en: No, it followed me slowly as far as the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只狗慢悠悠地跟着主人走，用 ċerkek 配上 wara sidu；重点同时记住“跟随”和“速度慢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To waste time or carry out duties without real commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 浪费时间，或做事缺乏认真投入、敷衍地履行职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħli l-ħin jew iwettaq dmirijietu mingħajr impenn serju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浪费时间，虚耗光阴。

sense_translations.en_definition: to carry out duties in a non-commital fashion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏认真投入地履行职责；敷衍了事。

formal.mt: L-impjegat ċerkes għal siegħa qabel beda jħejji r-rapport.
formal.en: The employee wasted an hour before starting to prepare the report.
formal.zh: 那名员工虚耗了一个小时，才开始准备报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark lesta x-xogħol? | Toni: Le, ċerkes ilgħodu kollu u għadu ma spiċċax.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark finished the work? | Toni: No, he wasted the whole morning and still has not finished.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克把工作做完了吗？ | 托尼：没有，他浪费了整个上午，到现在还没做完。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finished the work?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ċerkes ilgħodu kollu u għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ċerkes ilgħodu kollu u għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.zh: 没有，他浪费了整个上午，到现在还没做完。
messages.en: No, he wasted the whole morning and still has not finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“坐在桌前磨时间，做起工作也敷衍”的画面记 ċerkes；分别对应浪费时间与不认真履职两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or habit of spending time without doing useful work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 闲着不做有用事情的状态或习惯；懒散、游手好闲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew id-drawwa li wieħed jgħaddi l-ħin mingħajr ma jagħmel xogħol utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒散、无所事事或游手好闲的状态。

collocations.zh: 在无所事事中消磨时间

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerkis fuq ix-xogħol wassal għal dewmien fit-tlestija tal-proġett.
formal.en: Idleness at work led to a delay in completing the project.
formal.zh: 工作中的懒散导致项目延期完成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Pawlu wara nofsinhar? | Maja: Xejn; għadda l-ħin kollu fiċ-ċerkis.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Pawlu do in the afternoon? | Maja: Nothing; he spent the whole time in idleness.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗下午做了什么？ | 玛雅：什么也没做；他一直无所事事。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗下午做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in the afternoon?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 什么也没做；他一直无所事事。
messages.en: Nothing; he spent the whole time in idleness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċerkis 记成可以命名的“无所事事状态”：动词 ċerkes 表示磨时间，名词 ċerkis 表示懒散；这里只作词性对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for the wreckfish, Polyprion americanus, also called ċerna.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鱼类多锯鲈（Polyprion americanus）的名称，与 ċerna 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għaċ-ċerna, il-ħuta tal-ispeċi Polyprion americanus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 ċerna 同义：多锯鲈（Polyprion americanus）。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka ċ-ċerna tal-fond bl-isem xjentifiku Polyprion americanus.
formal.en: The catalogue lists the wreckfish under the scientific name Polyprion americanus.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Polyprion americanus 列出了多锯鲈。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ċerna tal-fond friska llum? | Rita: Iva, kemm trid minnha?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh wreckfish today? | Rita: Yes, how much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天有新鲜的多锯鲈吗？ | 丽塔：有，你想要多少？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你今天有新鲜的多锯鲈吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh wreckfish today?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你想要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċerna tal-fond 整体写在鱼摊标签上，旁边配“多锯鲈”和学名；整组记忆，避免把鱼名拆散后误认成别的鱼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a particular person or thing that has not previously been mentioned, as in 'a certain Pawlu'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引入此前未提及的某个人或事物，例如“一位叫保罗的人”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jintroduċi persuna jew ħaġa partikolari li ma tkunx issemmiet qabel, bħal fil-frażi 'ċertu Pawlu'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a certain (named but not previously mentioned)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个；用于引入已给出名称、但此前尚未提及的人或事物。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport jissemma ċertu Pawlu Borg bħala xhud tal-inċident.
formal.en: The report mentions a certain Pawlu Borg as a witness to the incident.
formal.zh: 报告提到一位叫保罗·博尔格的人，称他是该事件的目击者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ċertu Mark ċempel għalik. | Sara: Ħalla numru biex inċempillu lura?
colloquial.en: Maja: A certain Mark called for you. | Sara: Did he leave a number so I can call him back?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一位叫马克的人打电话找你。 | 萨拉：他留下号码让我回电话了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 一位叫马克的人打电话找你。
messages.en: A certain Mark called for you.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 他留下号码让我回电话了吗？
messages.en: Did he leave a number so I can call him back?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人递来留言：“有位叫 Mark 的人找你。”把 ċertu Mark 连起来记，此处表达“某位”，不是判断事情是否确定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow slowly in a small, thin stream.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体以少量、细流的方式缓缓流动或流出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċirkola jew joħroġ bil-mod fi fluss żgħir u rqiq, bħall-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涓涓流动；以细小的水流缓缓流出。

formal.mt: L-ilma ċerċaq mill-vit u nġabar f'reċipjent taħtu.
formal.en: The water trickled from the tap and collected in a container underneath.
formal.zh: 水从水龙头涓涓流出，积在下方的容器里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art? Toni: L-ilma ċerċaq mill-pajp waqt il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there water on the floor? Toni: Water trickled from the pipe during the night.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地上怎么有水？Toni：夜里水从管子里缓缓流出来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 夜里水从管子里缓缓流出来了。
messages.en: Water trickled from the pipe during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水龙头只开了一点点，水形成细细的一线；用这幅画面记住涓涓流动。

gloss_zh: 闲混；四处闲逛；举止失当

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time idly, to gad about, or to engage in unseemly behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无所事事地消磨时间、四处闲逛，或做出不得体的行为；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi l-ħin bla ma jagħmel xejn, idur minn post għal ieħor bla skop, jew iġib ruħu b'mod mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass the time in idleness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间；闲混度日。
四处闲逛；到处游荡。
放纵自己做出不得体的行为；举止失当。

collocations.zh: 放纵自己做出不得体的行为

formal.mt: Matul il-ġurnata ċerċer u ma għamel ebda xogħol.
formal.en: He spent the day idly and did no work.
formal.zh: 他整天无所事事，没有做任何工作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Pawlu wara nofsinhar? Mark: Ċerċer fit-toroq mal-ħbieb u wasal id-dar tard.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Pawlu do in the afternoon? Mark: He gadded about in the streets with his friends and got home late.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Pawlu下午干什么了？Mark：他和朋友们在街上闲逛，很晚才到家。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu下午干什么了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in the afternoon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċerċer fit-toroq mal-ħbieb u wasal id-dar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ċerċer fit-toroq mal-ħbieb u wasal id-dar tard.
messages.zh: 他和朋友们在街上闲逛，很晚才到家。
messages.en: He gadded about in the streets with his friends and got home late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面分别记义：坐着闲混、街头闲逛、举止失当；这是表示行为的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of spending time idly or gadding about without a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间，或没有明确目的地四处闲逛这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed jgħaddi l-ħin bla ma jagħmel xejn jew idur minn post għal ieħor bla skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间；闲混。
四处闲逛；到处游荡。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerċir matul il-ħin tax-xogħol inaqqas il-produttività.
formal.en: Spending working hours idly reduces productivity.
formal.zh: 在工作时间闲混会降低工作效率。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qattajt il-Ħadd? Toni: Għaddejt il-ħin fiċ-ċerċir mal-ħbieb, minn pjazza għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you spend Sunday? Toni: I spent the time gadding about with friends, going from one square to another.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你星期天怎么过的？Toni：我和朋友们四处闲逛，从一个广场逛到另一个广场。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期天怎么过的？
messages.en: How did you spend Sunday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt il-ħin fiċ-ċerċir mal-ħbieb, minn pjazza għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt il-ħin fiċ-ċerċir mal-ħbieb, minn pjazza għal oħra.
messages.zh: 我和朋友们四处闲逛，从一个广场逛到另一个广场。
messages.en: I spent the time gadding about with friends, going from one square to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“闲混、闲逛这件事”贴上名词标签，用来区别描述行为的动词ċerċer；本词只记材料提供的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 举止粗俗的人；游手好闲的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disparaging term for a person with vulgar habits or someone who spends their time doing nothing useful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贬义名词，指行为习惯粗俗的人，也可指整天游手好闲、不做正事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna bi drawwiet vulgari jew għal xi ħadd li jgħaddi ħinu mingħajr ma jagħmel xejn utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为习惯粗俗的人。
游手好闲、不肯做正事的人。

collocations.en: to behave like a vulgar person

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala ċerċur minħabba d-drawwiet vulgari tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the character is described as a vulgar person because of his coarse habits.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物因习惯粗俗而被描写成一个粗鄙的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħlu ċerċur? | Toni: Għax jgħaddi l-ġurnata ma jagħmel xejn, imma dik kelma ta' disprezz.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call him a layabout? | Toni: Because he spends the day doing nothing, but that is a disparaging word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么叫那个人“游手好闲的家伙”？ | 托尼：因为那个人整天什么也不干，不过这个词带有贬义。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么叫那个人“游手好闲的家伙”？
messages.en: Why did he call him a layabout?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħaddi l-ġurnata ma jagħmel xejn, imma dik kelma ta' disprezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħaddi l-ġurnata ma jagħmel xejn, imma dik kelma ta' disprezz.
messages.zh: 因为那个人整天什么也不干，不过这个词带有贬义。
messages.en: Because he spends the day doing nothing, but that is a disparaging word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċerċur 联系到故事里“举止粗俗、整日闲逛”的人物；分开记住粗俗和懒散两个义项，并记得它带贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element caesium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铯的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala ċesju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铯，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jintroduċi ċ-ċesju bħala element kimiku u jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The chapter introduces caesium as a chemical element and describes its properties.
formal.zh: 本章介绍了化学元素铯，并描述了它的性质。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-paġna titkellem dwar iċ-ċesju? | Adam: Iva, u l-paġna ta' wara titkellem dwar element ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this page about caesium? | Adam: Yes, and the next page is about another element.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这一页讲的是铯吗？ | 亚当：是的，下一页讲另一种元素。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这一页讲的是铯吗？
messages.en: Is this page about caesium?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-paġna ta' wara titkellem dwar element ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-paġna ta' wara titkellem dwar element ieħor.
messages.zh: 是的，下一页讲另一种元素。
messages.en: Yes, and the next page is about another element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċesju 与“铯”写成一张元素卡，再和 ċerju“铈”并排对照；留意词中的 s 与 r，帮助区分两个相近的名称。

gloss_zh: 无礼地对待；外观变得破旧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone discourteously, or to become shabby in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无礼地对待某人，也可指外表变得破旧、不整洁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd bla korteżija, jew isir mitluq fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无礼地对待某人。
外观变得破旧或邋遢。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-impjegat ċewlaħ lill-klijent meta dan talab l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The report states that the employee treated the customer discourteously when the customer asked for help.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该员工在顾客寻求帮助时对其态度无礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq il-mistieden? Mark: Għax Pawlu ċewlaħ lilu quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the guest leave? Mark: Because Pawlu treated him discourteously in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那位客人为什么走了？马克：因为保罗当着大家的面对他很无礼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位客人为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did the guest leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu ċewlaħ lilu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu ċewlaħ lilu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为保罗当着大家的面对他很无礼。
messages.en: Because Pawlu treated him discourteously in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面并排记：待人失礼，外观失整；分别对应态度无礼和样子破旧。

gloss_zh: 动词，所给材料未提供词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose lexical meaning is not supplied in the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将此词标为动词，但未提供具体词义，暂以词形识别为学习重点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhix mogħtija fil-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给材料未提供此动词的具体词义。

formal.mt: Il-materjal jelenka 'ċewwer' bħala verb, iżda ma jagħtix it-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The material lists 'ċewwer' as a verb but does not give its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“ċewwer”列为动词，但未给出其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ċewwer'? Mark: Hawn miktub li hu verb, imma t-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ċewwer' mean? Mark: It says here that it is a verb, but the meaning is not provided.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“ċewwer”是什么意思？马克：这里写着它是动词，但没有提供词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习伙伴)
messages.zh: “ċewwer”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċewwer' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub li hu verb, imma t-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub li hu verb, imma t-tifsira mhix mogħtija.
messages.zh: 这里写着它是动词，但没有提供词义。
messages.en: It says here that it is a verb, but the meaning is not provided.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记词形和动词标签，词义栏保留空位；不要借相似拼写猜出未经提供的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone look foolish or make a fool of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚弄某人，或使某人显得愚蠢、当众出丑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jidher iblah jew iwaqqgħu għaċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a fool of sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚弄某人；使某人出丑。

collocations.en: made a fool of his friend

collocations.mt: ċewweċ lil xi ħadd quddiem kulħadd
collocations.en: made a fool of someone in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 使某人在大家面前出丑

formal.mt: Il-kelliem ċewweċ lill-kollega tiegħu quddiem l-udjenza, u wara talab skuża.
formal.en: The speaker made a fool of his colleague in front of the audience and later apologized.
formal.zh: 发言者使同事在听众面前出丑，随后作了道歉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark irrabja ma' Pawlu? Nina: Għax Pawlu ċewweċ lilu quddiem sħabu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark get angry with Pawlu? Nina: Because Pawlu made a fool of him in front of his friends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么生保罗的气？妮娜：因为保罗让他在朋友面前出了丑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生保罗的气？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu ċewweċ lilu quddiem sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu ċewweċ lilu quddiem sħabu.
messages.zh: 因为保罗让他在朋友面前出了丑。
messages.en: Because Pawlu made a fool of him in front of his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友被恶作剧弄得当众出丑，把这个场景与“愚弄某人”一起记。

gloss_zh: 铺卵石；铺路；使坚硬如卵石

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with cobbles, to pave it, or to make something hard like a pebble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给表面铺上卵石或进行铺砌，也可指使某物变得像卵石一样坚硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi wiċċ biċ-ċagħaq, iwitti triq b'materjal tal-pavimentar, jew jagħmel xi ħaġa iebsa bħal ċagħqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用卵石铺砌某个表面。
铺路；铺砌地面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. hard like a pebble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得像卵石一样坚硬。

formal.mt: Il-bennej ċiegħek il-mogħdija li twassal mid-daħla sal-ġnien.
formal.en: The builder paved the path leading from the entrance to the garden.
formal.zh: 建筑工人铺砌了从入口通往花园的小路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ċiegħek il-bitħa? Pawlu: Il-bennej; issa nistgħu nimxu fuqha aktar komdi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who paved the courtyard? Pawlu: The builder; now we can walk across it more comfortably.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁铺砌了庭院？保罗：建筑工人铺的，现在走起来舒服多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 谁铺砌了庭院？
messages.en: Who paved the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bennej; issa nistgħu nimxu fuqha aktar komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bennej; issa nistgħu nimxu fuqha aktar komdi.
messages.zh: 建筑工人铺的，现在走起来舒服多了。
messages.en: The builder; now we can walk across it more comfortably.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用卵石作学习画面：把卵石铺在地上是铺砌，让东西像卵石一样硬是另一义。

gloss_zh: 弹棉、拍打棉花（动词）；弹棉器（名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To beat cotton as part of preparing or processing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在整理或加工棉花时对其进行拍打，即弹棉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isawwat il-qoton waqt it-tħejjija jew l-ipproċessar tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹棉；拍打棉花。
弹棉器；用于拍打棉花的用具。

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, il-ħaddiem ċiek il-qoton biex juri dan l-istadju tal-ipproċessar.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the worker beat the cotton to show this stage of processing.
formal.zh: 演示过程中，工人拍打棉花，展示这一加工步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-ħaddiem bil-qoton? Mark: Ċiek il-qoton waqt id-dimostrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the worker do with the cotton? Mark: He beat the cotton during the demonstration.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工人对棉花做了什么？马克：他在演示时拍打了棉花。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 工人对棉花做了什么？
messages.en: What did the worker do with the cotton?

messages.speaker: Mark (讲解员)
messages.zh: 他在演示时拍打了棉花。
messages.en: He beat the cotton during the demonstration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 同一词形分两张卡记：动词卡画拍打棉花的动作，名词卡画弹棉用具，注意词性边界。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of carding and cleaning wool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对羊毛进行梳理和清理的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tqardix u t-tindif tas-suf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羊毛的梳理与清理；梳理和清理羊毛的过程。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tispjega ċ-ċifi tas-suf u turi kif is-suf jiġi mqardax u mnaddaf.
formal.en: The lesson explains the carding and cleaning of wool and shows how the wool is carded and cleaned.
formal.zh: 本课讲解羊毛的梳理与清理，并展示羊毛如何经过这两道处理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'ċifi'? Nina: It-tqardix u t-tindif tas-suf; illum se naraw kif isir.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'ċifi' mean? Nina: Carding and cleaning wool; today we'll see how it is done.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：“ċifi”是什么意思？妮娜：就是梳理和清理羊毛；今天我们会看看具体怎么做。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: “ċifi”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċifi' mean?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tqardix u t-tindif tas-suf; illum se naraw kif isir.
messages.mt_standard: It-tqardix u t-tindif tas-suf; illum se naraw kif isir.
messages.zh: 就是梳理和清理羊毛；今天我们会看看具体怎么做。
messages.en: Carding and cleaning wool; today we'll see how it is done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团羊毛同时需要梳顺和清理，把两个动作合成一个工序名词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A remark or action intended to mock or provoke someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为嘲笑、刺激或挑衅某人而说的话或做出的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew azzjoni maħsuba biex twaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt jew tipprovokah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄或挑衅他人的话语或举动。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li ċika tista' tweġġa' lil min jirċeviha.
formal.en: The teacher explained that a taunt can hurt the person it targets.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，嘲弄可能伤害被针对的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik kienet ċika? Pawlu: Iva, imma ma tajtux kas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that a taunt? Pawlu: Yes, but I ignored him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是在嘲弄你吗？保罗：是啊，不过我没理他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是在嘲弄你吗？
messages.en: Was that a taunt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我没理他。
messages.en: Yes, but I ignored him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċika 记成一句带刺的嘲弄话，并与双写 k、表示好运的 ċikka 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Good fortune that helps someone in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人在某种情境下碰巧得到好结果的运气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xorti tajba li tgħin lil xi ħadd f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好运；带来有利结果的幸运。

formal.mt: Kienet ċikka li l-grupp sab kamra ħielsa fl-aħħar minuta.
formal.en: It was good luck that the group found an available room at the last minute.
formal.zh: 这个小组在最后一刻找到空房间，实属幸运。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt post fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Mark: Kelli ċikka: xi ħadd niżel eżatt qabel tlajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you get a seat on the bus? Mark: I was lucky: someone got off just before I got on.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么在公交车上找到座位的？马克：我运气好，刚好有人在我上车前下了车。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt post fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt post fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你怎么在公交车上找到座位的？
messages.en: How did you get a seat on the bus?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ċikka: xi ħadd niżel eżatt qabel tlajt.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ċikka: xi ħadd niżel eżatt qabel tlajt.
messages.zh: 我运气好，刚好有人在我上车前下了车。
messages.en: I was lucky: someone got off just before I got on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用双写的 kk 想象两份好运，帮助记住 ċikka 表示幸运；这只是拼写联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pot used to prepare or serve hot chocolate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作或盛倒热巧克力饮品的壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex titħejja jew tiġi servuta ċ-ċikkulata sħuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧克力壶；用于制作或盛倒巧克力饮品的壶。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċikkulatiera tqiegħdet ħdejn it-tazzi biex tiġi servuta ċ-ċikkulata sħuna.
formal.en: The chocolate pot was placed beside the cups so that the hot chocolate could be served.
formal.zh: 巧克力壶被放在杯子旁边，以便倒出热巧克力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi ċ-ċikkulatiera? Omm: Fuq il-mejda; iċ-ċikkulata għadha sħuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the chocolate pot? Mum: On the table; the chocolate is still hot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：巧克力壶在哪儿？妈妈：在桌上，里面的巧克力还热着呢。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 巧克力壶在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the chocolate pot?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在桌上，里面的巧克力还热着呢。
messages.en: On the table; the chocolate is still hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċikkulatiera 配上一幅从壶嘴倒出热巧克力的画面，用器物形象记住它是壶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plate used to present or serve chocolate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于摆放、展示或端上巧克力的盘子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt li jintuża biex titqiegħed jew tiġi servuta ċ-ċikkulata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧克力盘；用于摆放或供应巧克力的盘子。

collocations.en: a chocolate plate filled with chocolates
collocations.zh: 摆满巧克力糖的巧克力盘

formal.mt: Il-wejter poġġa ċ-ċikkulatiniera fin-nofs tal-mejda biex il-mistednin jieħdu ċ-ċikkulatini.
formal.en: The waiter placed the chocolate plate in the middle of the table so that the guests could help themselves to chocolates.
formal.zh: 服务员把巧克力盘放在桌子中央，方便客人取用巧克力糖。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tgħaddili ċ-ċikkulatiniera? Rita: Żgur, ħu ċikkulatina.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you pass me the chocolate plate? Rita: Of course, have a chocolate.
colloquial.zh: 马克：能把巧克力盘递给我吗？丽塔：当然，拿一颗巧克力糖吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.zh: 能把巧克力盘递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the chocolate plate?

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.zh: 当然，拿一颗巧克力糖吧。
messages.en: Of course, have a chocolate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċikkulatiniera 画一个摆满巧克力糖的浅盘，与 ċikkulatiera 的倒饮品壶成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring or proceeding in a repeating series of stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一系列阶段反复发生或进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew jimxi f'sensiela ta' stadji li jerġgħu jirrepetu ruħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环的；按一定阶段或周期反复出现的。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi proċess ċikliku li fih l-aħħar stadju jwassal lura għall-ewwel wieħed.
formal.en: The diagram shows a cyclic process in which the final stage leads back to the first.
formal.zh: 图示展示了一个循环过程，其中最后一个阶段又回到第一个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed insejħu dan proċess ċikliku? Għalliem: Għax l-istess stadji jerġgħu jirrepetu ruħhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we calling this a cyclic process? Teacher: Because the same stages repeat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我们把这叫作循环过程？老师：因为相同的阶段会反复出现。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed insejħu dan proċess ċikliku?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed insejħu dan proċess ċikliku?
messages.zh: 为什么我们把这叫作循环过程？
messages.en: Why are we calling this a cyclic process?

messages.speaker: Għalliem (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-istess stadji jerġgħu jirrepetu ruħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-istess stadji jerġgħu jirrepetu ruħhom.
messages.zh: 因为相同的阶段会反复出现。
messages.en: Because the same stages repeat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċikliku 写在首尾相接的圆形箭头旁，记住它用来形容过程具有循环性。

gloss_zh: 骑自行车的人；自行车骑手

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rides a bicycle, for travel, recreation, or sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑自行车出行、休闲或参加运动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirkeb rota għall-ivvjaġġar, għad-divertiment jew għall-isport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑自行车的人；自行车骑手或运动员。

collocations.zh: 经验丰富的自行车骑手

formal.mt: Iċ-ċiklist professjonali temm it-tellieqa fl-ewwel post.
formal.en: The professional cyclist finished the race in first place.
formal.zh: 这位职业自行车运动员以第一名的成绩完成了比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak iċ-ċiklist ħdejn il-ħanut? Pawlu: Ħija; kuljum imur ix-xogħol bir-rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that cyclist beside the shop? Pawlu: My brother; he cycles to work every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店旁边那个骑自行车的人是谁？保罗：我哥哥，他每天骑自行车上班。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak iċ-ċiklist ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak iċ-ċiklist ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 商店旁边那个骑自行车的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that cyclist beside the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他每天骑自行车上班。
messages.en: My brother; he cycles to work every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċiklist 和英语 cyclist 并排写在骑车人的图旁，借助拼写相似性记住它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a cyclone or its effects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与气旋或气旋造成的影响有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' ċiklun jew mal-effetti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气旋的；与气旋有关或具有气旋特征的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effetti tat-temp ċikloniku fuq il-gżira.
formal.en: The report describes the effects of the cyclonic weather on the island.
formal.zh: 报告描述了气旋天气对该岛的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser temp ċikloniku? Mark: Ifisser temp marbut ma' ċiklun.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does cyclonic weather mean? Mark: It means weather associated with a cyclone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：气旋天气是什么意思？马克：就是与气旋有关的天气。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 气旋天气是什么意思？
messages.en: What does cyclonic weather mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 就是与气旋有关的天气。
messages.en: It means weather associated with a cyclone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċikloniku 与英语 cyclonic 并排放在气旋云图下，记住它是描述气旋相关事物的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of stages or events that returns to its starting point and can repeat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一系列阶段或事件构成的完整过程，结束后可回到起点并再次发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' stadji jew ġrajjiet li terġa' lura għall-bidu u tista' tirrepeti ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环；由一系列阶段构成、可以重复的完整周期。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ddeskrivew l-istadji kollha taċ-ċiklu tal-ħajja tal-farfett.
formal.en: The students described all the stages of the butterfly's life cycle.
formal.zh: 学生们描述了蝴蝶生命周期的所有阶段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' noħroġ il-ħwejjeġ mill-magna? Omm: Stenna ftit; iċ-ċiklu tal-ħasil għadu ma spiċċax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I take the clothes out of the machine? Mum: Wait a little; the wash cycle has not finished yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？妈妈：再等一会儿，洗涤周期还没结束。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？
messages.en: Can I take the clothes out of the machine?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; iċ-ċiklu tal-ħasil għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; iċ-ċiklu tal-ħasil għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.zh: 再等一会儿，洗涤周期还没结束。
messages.en: Wait a little; the wash cycle has not finished yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用洗衣程序转完一整圈来记 ċiklu：它指一个循环，而 ċikliku 用来形容循环的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large rotating storm system with strong winds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大范围旋转、伴有强风的风暴系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema kbira ta' maltemp b'irjieħ qawwija li jduru madwar ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气旋；旋转并伴有强风的风暴系统。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħsara li kkawża ċiklun qawwi.
formal.en: The report describes the damage caused by a powerful cyclone.
formal.zh: 报告描述了强烈气旋造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt bit-twissija dwar iċ-ċiklun? Mark: Iva, illum se nibqgħu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the warning about the cyclone? Mark: Yes, we're staying home today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到气旋预警了吗？马克：听到了，我们今天会待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到气旋预警了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the warning about the cyclone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，我们今天会待在家里。
messages.en: Yes, we're staying home today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċiklun 配上一幅云团旋转的图，再用 ċiklun qawwi「强烈气旋」整组复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The white stork, a bird of the species Ciconia ciconia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白鹳，学名为 Ciconia ciconia 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Ciconia ciconia, magħruf bħala ċ-ċikonja bajda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白鹳（学名：Ciconia ciconia）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a white stork

formal.mt: Il-gwida turi ritratt ta' ċikonja bajda u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Ciconia ciconia.
formal.en: The guide shows a photograph of a white stork and gives its scientific name, Ciconia ciconia.
formal.zh: 指南展示了一张白鹳的照片，并列出其学名 Ciconia ciconia。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għasfur hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dik ċikonja bajda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What bird is in this photograph? Pawlu: That's a white stork.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这张照片里是什么鸟？保罗：那是一只白鹳。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 那是一只白鹳。
messages.en: That's a white stork.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajda 记作「白色的」，将 ċikonja bajda 与白鹳图片配对，再和 ċikonja sewda 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The black stork, a bird of the species Ciconia nigra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑鹳，学名为 Ciconia nigra 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Ciconia nigra, magħruf bħala ċ-ċikonja sewda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑鹳（学名：Ciconia nigra）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a black stork

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar iċ-ċikonja sewda tinkludi l-isem xjentifiku Ciconia nigra.
formal.en: The page about the black stork includes the scientific name Ciconia nigra.
formal.zh: 介绍黑鹳的页面列出了学名 Ciconia nigra。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din ċikonja bajda? Toni: Le, din ċikonja sewda. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是一只白鹳吗？托尼：不是，这是一只黑鹳。看看照片下面的名称。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这是一只白鹳吗？
messages.en: Is this a white stork?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din ċikonja sewda. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din ċikonja sewda. Ara l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 不是，这是一只黑鹳。看看照片下面的名称。
messages.en: No, this is a black stork. Look at the name below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sewda 记作「黑色的」，用「bajda 白、sewda 黑」成对复习两个鹳类名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dandelion of the species Taraxacum megalorrhizon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 学名为 Taraxacum megalorrhizon 的一种蒲公英。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ispeċi Taraxacum megalorrhizon, magħrufa bħala ċ-ċikwejra salvaġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒲公英，特指学名为 Taraxacum megalorrhizon 的植物。

formal.mt: Il-gwida botanika tinkludi ritratt taċ-ċikwejra salvaġġa, Taraxacum megalorrhizon.
formal.en: The botanical guide includes a photograph of the dandelion Taraxacum megalorrhizon.
formal.zh: 植物指南收录了蒲公英 Taraxacum megalorrhizon 的照片。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta fil-ktieb? Lara: Ċikwejra salvaġġa. Ejja nħarsu lejn ir-ritratt tal-weraq tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this plant in the book called? Lara: A dandelion. Let's look at the photograph of its leaves.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里的这种植物叫什么？劳拉：蒲公英。我们看看它叶子的照片吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the book called?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċikwejra salvaġġa. Ejja nħarsu lejn ir-ritratt tal-weraq tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ċikwejra salvaġġa. Ejja nħarsu lejn ir-ritratt tal-weraq tagħha.
messages.zh: 蒲公英。我们看看它叶子的照片吧。
messages.en: A dandelion. Let's look at the photograph of its leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整名称 ċikwejra salvaġġa 写在蒲公英图片旁，分成两个词朗读，再合起来记住这个植物名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small clump of clover growing together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起生长的一小簇三叶草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra żgħira ta' silla li tikber flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一簇三叶草；聚生的一小丛三叶草。

collocations.en: a tuft of clover beside the path

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher ċim tas-silla ħdejn il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The photograph shows a tuft of clover beside the path.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到小路旁的一簇三叶草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak iċ-ċim ħdejn il-ġebla. Mark: Iva, se nieħu ritratt tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that tuft of clover beside the stone. Mark: Yes, I'll take a photograph of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看石头旁边的那簇三叶草。马克：看到了，我来给它拍张照。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看石头旁边的那簇三叶草。
messages.en: Look at that tuft of clover beside the stone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，我来给它拍张照。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take a photograph of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ċim 就想象地面上聚在一起的一小簇三叶草，重点记住「一簇」这个整体画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wild pig; the word can also refer to pigskin as a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 野生的猪，即野猪；该词也可指作为材料的猪皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanżir selvaġġ; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-ġilda tal-ħanżir bħala materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野猪；野生的猪。
猪皮；用作皮革材料的猪皮。

collocations.en: a wild boar in the forest

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi din il-kartiera bħala magħmula miċ-ċingjal.
formal.en: The catalogue describes this wallet as being made of pigskin.
formal.zh: 商品目录说明这个钱包由猪皮制成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'annimal rajt fil-foresta? Toni: Rajt ċingjal ħdejn siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What animal did you see in the forest? Toni: I saw a wild boar beside a tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在森林里看到了什么动物？托尼：我看到一头野猪在树旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么动物？
messages.en: What animal did you see in the forest?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到一头野猪在树旁。
messages.en: I saw a wild boar beside a tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċingjal 配两张记忆卡：森林里的野猪、钱包使用的猪皮；根据动物或材料语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Costing little money; not expensive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所需花费较少的；价格不贵的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiswa ftit flus; li mhuwiex għali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便宜的；价格不贵的。

formal.mt: Il-klabb għażel ktieb ċip biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jixtruh.
formal.en: The club chose an inexpensive book so that the students could buy it.
formal.zh: 俱乐部选了一本价格不贵的书，方便学生购买。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb ċip? Maja: Iva, jiswa biss żewġ ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book cheap? Maja: Yes, it costs only two euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书便宜吗？玛雅：便宜，只要两欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这本书便宜吗？
messages.en: Is this book cheap?

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 便宜，只要两欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it costs only two euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċip 与英文 cheap 对照朗读，再想象书上的低价标签，记住这里表达「价格便宜」。

gloss_zh: 指捻陀螺；走路摇摆或动个不停的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spinning top called a teetotum; also a person who waddles or moves about a lot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种用手指捻转的小陀螺；也指走路摇摇摆摆或总是动来动去的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġugarell żgħir li ddawwar b'subgħajk u jdur fuq ponta; ukoll persuna li titbandal waqt li timxi jew li tiċċaqlaq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指捻陀螺；用手指捻转的小陀螺。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who waddles/moves a lot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路摇摇摆摆的人；总是动来动去的人。

collocations.en: like someone who is always moving about
collocations.zh: 像个总是动来动去的人

formal.mt: L-istudent idawwar iċ-ċippitatu b'subgħajh u josserva kemm idum idur.
formal.en: The student spins the teetotum with his fingers and observes how long it keeps spinning.
formal.zh: 学生用手指捻转小陀螺，观察它能持续旋转多久。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu qisu ċippitatu llum! Lara: Veru, ma joqgħodx bilqiegħda għal minuta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu is like someone who can't stop moving today! Lara: True, he won't sit down for a minute.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗今天真是动个不停！劳拉：是啊，他连一分钟都坐不住。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天真是动个不停！
messages.en: Pawlu is like someone who can't stop moving today!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ma joqgħodx bilqiegħda għal minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ma joqgħodx bilqiegħda għal minuta.
messages.zh: 是啊，他连一分钟都坐不住。
messages.en: True, he won't sit down for a minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动态画面记 ċippitatu：手指捻转的小陀螺、总在动来动去的人；这只是帮助区分词义的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 街区；附近一带；周围环境

teaching_sense.en_definition: The neighborhood or surrounding area of a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地点附近的街区或周围一带，也可指该地点的周边环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inħawi ta' madwar post partikolari, inklużi t-toroq u l-bini fil-qrib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街区；某处附近的社区或一带地方
周围环境；某地点四周的地方

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ċ-ċirkondarju tal-iskola u l-aċċess għat-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The report describes the area surrounding the school and access to public transport.
formal.zh: 报告描述了学校周边环境及公共交通的便利程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu ċ-ċirkondarju tad-dar il-ġdida tiegħek? Sara: Huwa kwiet, u hemm ħanut żgħir fil-qrib.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the neighborhood around your new home like? Sara: It is quiet, and there is a small shop nearby.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你新家附近的街区怎么样？萨拉：很安静，附近还有一家小商店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu ċ-ċirkondarju tad-dar il-ġdida tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu ċ-ċirkondarju tad-dar il-ġdida tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你新家附近的街区怎么样？
messages.en: What is the neighborhood around your new home like?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa kwiet, u hemm ħanut żgħir fil-qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa kwiet, u hemm ħanut żgħir fil-qrib.
messages.zh: 很安静，附近还有一家小商店。
messages.en: It is quiet, and there is a small shop nearby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在家门口环顾四周，把附近的街道、商店和住宅一起装进 ċirkondarju 的画面，记住它指周围这一带。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having undergone circumcision, the removal of the foreskin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容已接受包皮环切、包皮已被切除的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun saritlu ċirkonċiżjoni, jiġifieri tneħħietlu l-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已接受包皮环切的；已割除包皮的

collocations.zh: 接受过包皮环切的男子
接受过包皮环切的患者

formal.mt: Fir-rekord mediku hemm miktub li l-pazjent huwa ċirkonċiż.
formal.en: The medical record states that the patient is circumcised.
formal.zh: 病历记载该患者接受过包皮环切。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'ċirkonċiż' f'din il-formola? Rita: Tfisser li l-persuna tkun għamlet ċirkonċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'circumcised' mean on this form? Rita: It means that the person has undergone circumcision.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张表上的“已接受包皮环切的”是什么意思？丽塔：意思是这个人做过包皮环切。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 这张表上的“已接受包皮环切的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'circumcised' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-persuna tkun għamlet ċirkonċiżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-persuna tkun għamlet ċirkonċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人做过包皮环切。
messages.en: It means that the person has undergone circumcision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċirkonċiż 放在“患者”的人物卡片旁，记住它描述接受过手术的状态；再与表示手术本身的 ċirkonċiżjoni 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The surgical removal of the foreskin, performed for medical, religious, or cultural reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切除包皮的手术或行为，可出于医疗、宗教或文化原因；在宗教文化语境中也称割礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Operazzjoni li fiha titneħħa l-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene, għal raġunijiet mediċi, reliġjużi jew kulturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包皮环切；割礼，即切除包皮的手术或行为

collocations.zh: 出于医疗原因进行的包皮环切
作为宗教或文化仪式的割礼

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega x'inhi ċ-ċirkonċiżjoni u għaliex tista' ssir.
formal.en: The leaflet explains what circumcision is and why it may be performed.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册解释了什么是包皮环切，以及可能进行这项手术的原因。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-fuljett jitkellem dwar iċ-ċirkonċiżjoni? Pawlu: Iva, jispjega l-proċedura b'lingwa sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this leaflet about circumcision? Pawlu: Yes, it explains the procedure in simple language.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份宣传册讲的是包皮环切吗？保罗：是的，它用简单的语言解释这项手术。

messages.speaker: Lara (患者)
messages.zh: 这份宣传册讲的是包皮环切吗？
messages.en: Is this leaflet about circumcision?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护士)
messages.zh: 是的，它用简单的语言解释这项手术。
messages.en: Yes, it explains the procedure in simple language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċirkonċiżjoni 写在“手术名称”栏，把 ċirkonċiż 写在“术后状态”栏；用名称与状态的对照记住两个词的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The delimitation of an area, or a territorial district defined by such boundaries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对区域界限的划定，也指由这些界限确定的地域辖区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tfassil tal-konfini ta' żona, jew id-distrett territorjali definit minn dawk il-konfini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 界限的划定；由划定界限形成的地域辖区

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-konfini taċ-ċirkoskrizzjoni amministrattiva u l-irħula li jinsabu fiha.
formal.en: The map shows the boundaries of the administrative circumscription and the villages within it.
formal.zh: 地图标出了该行政辖区的界限及其范围内的村庄。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ir-raħal tagħna jinsab f'din iċ-ċirkoskrizzjoni? Rita: Iva, ara l-konfini fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is our village within this district? Rita: Yes, look at the boundaries on the map.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们的村庄在这个辖区内吗？丽塔：是的，你看地图上的界线。

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.zh: 我们的村庄在这个辖区内吗？
messages.en: Is our village within this district?

messages.speaker: Rita (行政人员)
messages.zh: 是的，你看地图上的界线。
messages.en: Yes, look at the boundaries on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习地图上给几个村庄画一道边界，再给圈定区域贴上 ċirkoskrizzjoni，联想“划定界限后形成的辖区”。

gloss_zh: 流通中的；循环流动的；流传中的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moving through a system or passing from one person or place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容在某个系统内循环流动，或在人与人、地点与地点之间流通或流传的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċirkola f'sistema jew jgħaddi minn persuna jew minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环流动的；正在流通或流传的

formal.mt: Id-demm ċirkulanti jwassal l-ossiġnu lit-tessuti tal-ġisem.
formal.en: Circulating blood delivers oxygen to the body's tissues.
formal.zh: 循环流动的血液把氧气输送到身体组织。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'flus ċirkulanti' f'dan l-artiklu? Pawlu: Huma l-flus li jgħaddu minn id għal oħra meta n-nies jixtru u jħallsu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'money in circulation' mean in this article? Pawlu: It is the money that passes from hand to hand when people buy things and make payments.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的“流通中的货币”是什么意思？保罗：就是人们购物和付款时，在不同人手中流转的钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“流通中的货币”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'money in circulation' mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma l-flus li jgħaddu minn id għal oħra meta n-nies jixtru u jħallsu.
messages.mt_standard: Huma l-flus li jgħaddu minn id għal oħra meta n-nies jixtru u jħallsu.
messages.zh: 就是人们购物和付款时，在不同人手中流转的钱。
messages.en: It is the money that passes from hand to hand when people buy things and make payments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一枚硬币不断从一只手传到另一只手，用 ċirkulanti 给“正在流通”的状态贴标签，再联想到循环流动的血液。

gloss_zh: 循环的；血液循环系统的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to circulation, especially the movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与循环有关的，尤其指与血液经由心脏和血管运行有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-ċirkulazzjoni, speċjalment mal-moviment tad-demm mill-qalb u mill-vini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环的；血液循环的；循环系统的

formal.mt: Is-sistema ċirkulatorja tinkludi l-qalb u l-vini li minnhom jgħaddi d-demm.
formal.en: The circulatory system includes the heart and the blood vessels through which blood flows.
formal.zh: 循环系统包括心脏以及血液流经的血管。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm qalb f'din l-istampa? Sara: Għax l-istampa turi s-sistema ċirkulatorja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a heart in this picture? Sara: Because the picture shows the circulatory system.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这幅图里有一颗心脏？萨拉：因为这幅图展示的是循环系统。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这幅图里有一颗心脏？
messages.en: Why is there a heart in this picture?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.zh: 因为这幅图展示的是循环系统。
messages.en: Because the picture shows the circulatory system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċirkulatorju 记作人体循环图的说明标签；搭配 sistema 时用 ċirkulatorja，整组记忆 sistema ċirkulatorja“循环系统”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement through a system, or the passing of money, information, or other things among people and places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在系统中的循环运行，或货币、信息等在人群和地点之间的流通、传播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment f'sistema, jew il-mogħdija ta' flus, informazzjoni u affarijiet oħra bejn persuni u postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环；流通；传播或流传

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bini jippermetti ċirkulazzjoni tajba tal-arja fil-kmamar kollha.
formal.en: The building's design allows good air circulation in all rooms.
formal.zh: 这座建筑的设计使所有房间都能保持良好的空气流通。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Niftħu t-tieqa l-oħra wkoll? Rita: Iva, hekk ikun hemm ċirkulazzjoni aħjar tal-arja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we open the other window too? Rita: Yes, that will improve the air circulation.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们也把另一扇窗打开好吗？丽塔：好，这样空气会更流通。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我们也把另一扇窗打开好吗？
messages.en: Shall we open the other window too?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk ikun hemm ċirkulazzjoni aħjar tal-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk ikun hemm ċirkulazzjoni aħjar tal-arja.
messages.zh: 好，这样空气会更流通。
messages.en: Yes, that will improve the air circulation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画几支连续移动的箭头，把空气、血液和货币分别放进去；ċirkulazzjoni 指这些事物循环或流通的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The boundary of a circle, or the distance all the way around it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圆的边界，也指沿这条边界完整绕行一周的长度，即圆周长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja li tagħlaq ċirku, jew it-tul sħiħ ta' dik il-linja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆周；圆周长，即沿圆的边界绕一周的长度

formal.mt: Biex tkejjel iċ-ċirkumferenza ta' ċirku, poġġi ħajta tul il-linja kollha tiegħu u mbagħad kejjel it-tul tal-ħajta.
formal.en: To measure a circle's circumference, place a piece of string along its entire boundary and then measure the length of the string.
formal.zh: 要测量一个圆的圆周长，可沿圆的整条边界放置一根细绳，再测量细绳的长度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nista' nkejjel iċ-ċirkumferenza ta' dan l-għatu? Pawlu: Dawwar ħajta mat-tarf tiegħu, imbagħad kejjel il-ħajta b'riga.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I measure the circumference of this lid? Pawlu: Wrap a piece of string around its edge, then measure the string with a ruler.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我怎么测量这个盖子的圆周长？保罗：用细绳沿它的边缘绕一圈，再用直尺量细绳。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nkejjel iċ-ċirkumferenza ta' dan l-għatu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nkejjel iċ-ċirkumferenza ta' dan l-għatu?
messages.zh: 我怎么测量这个盖子的圆周长？
messages.en: How can I measure the circumference of this lid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawwar ħajta mat-tarf tiegħu, imbagħad kejjel il-ħajta b'riga.
messages.mt_standard: Dawwar ħajta mat-tarf tiegħu, imbagħad kejjel il-ħajta b'riga.
messages.zh: 用细绳沿它的边缘绕一圈，再用直尺量细绳。
messages.en: Wrap a piece of string around its edge, then measure the string with a ruler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用一根细绳沿圆形盖子的边缘绕满一圈，再把绳子拉直；这整圈边界及其长度就是 ċirkumferenza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who belongs legally to a country and has rights and duties as a member of that country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在法律上属于某个国家，并享有相应权利、承担相应义务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li legalment tagħmel parti minn pajjiż u għandha drittijiet u dmirijiet bħala membru tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公民；具有某国公民身份的人。

formal.mt: Kull ċittadin għandu jirrispetta d-drittijiet tal-oħrajn u jieħu ħsieb l-ambjent.
formal.en: Every citizen should respect the rights of others and care for the environment.
formal.zh: 每位公民都应尊重他人的权利，并爱护环境。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dejjem tiġbor iż-żibel li ssib fil-park? Pawlu: Għax irrid inkun ċittadin responsabbli u nżomm il-post nadif.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do you always pick up the litter you find in the park? Pawlu: Because I want to be a responsible citizen and keep the place clean.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么总是捡起在公园里看到的垃圾？Pawlu：因为我想做个负责任的公民，让这里保持干净。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem tiġbor iż-żibel li ssib fil-park?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem tiġbor iż-żibel li ssib fil-park?
messages.zh: 你为什么总是捡起在公园里看到的垃圾？
messages.en: Why do you always pick up the litter you find in the park?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid inkun ċittadin responsabbli u nżomm il-post nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid inkun ċittadin responsabbli u nżomm il-post nadif.
messages.zh: 因为我想做个负责任的公民，让这里保持干净。
messages.en: Because I want to be a responsible citizen and keep the place clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċittadin和“公民的权利与义务”一起记，再用“负责任的公民”这个短语巩固含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lawyer who specializes in civil law, including disputes about contracts, property, and other private matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门处理民法事务的律师，例如合同、财产及其他私人权益纠纷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avukat li jispeċjalizza fid-dritt ċivili, bħal tilwim dwar kuntratti, proprjetà u kwistjonijiet privati oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民事律师；专门处理民法事务的律师。

collocations.en: the advice of a civil lawyer

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kkonsultat ċivilista biex teżamina l-kuntratt qabel ma tiffirmah.
formal.en: The company consulted a civil lawyer to examine the contract before signing it.
formal.zh: 公司在签署合同之前，咨询了一位民事律师，请其审查合同。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi problema bil-kuntratt tal-kera. Lil min nista' nistaqsi? Lara: Tista' tkellem ċivilista; jgħinek tifhem il-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have a problem with the rental contract. Who can I ask? Lara: You can speak to a civil lawyer; they can help you understand the contract.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的租赁合同有个问题，可以问谁？Lara：你可以找民事律师谈谈，他可以帮你理解合同。

messages.speaker: Mark (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi problema bil-kuntratt tal-kera. Lil min nista' nistaqsi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi problema bil-kuntratt tal-kera. Lil min nista' nistaqsi?
messages.zh: 我的租赁合同有个问题，可以问谁？
messages.en: I have a problem with the rental contract. Who can I ask?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tkellem ċivilista; jgħinek tifhem il-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tkellem ċivilista; jgħinek tifhem il-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 你可以找民事律师谈谈，他可以帮你理解合同。
messages.en: You can speak to a civil lawyer; they can help you understand the contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着租赁合同走进律师事务所，把ċivilista记成“帮人处理民事合同纠纷的律师”。

gloss_zh: 有礼貌地；以公民身份或从公民责任角度

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a polite and respectful manner; also, in a way relating to citizenship or civic responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以礼貌、尊重他人的方式；也可表示以公民身份或从公民责任的角度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod edukat u rispettuż; ukoll, b'mod li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-ċittadinanza jew mar-responsabbiltà taċ-ċittadin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有礼貌地；客气而尊重他人地。
以公民身份；从公民责任或公共生活参与的角度。

collocations.zh: 以承担公民责任的方式行事

formal.mt: Il-proġett iħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jaġixxu ċivilment billi jieħdu sehem f'attivitajiet li jtejbu l-komunità.
formal.en: The project encourages students to act with civic responsibility by taking part in activities that improve the community.
formal.zh: 该项目鼓励学生参与改善社区的活动，以实际行动承担公民责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma qbilniex, imma tkellimna ċivilment. David: Sew għamiltu. Tistgħu ma taqblux u xorta tirrispettaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: We disagreed, but we spoke civilly. David: You did the right thing. You can disagree and still respect each other.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们意见不合，但说话都很客气。David：你们做得对。即使意见不同，也可以互相尊重。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们意见不合，但说话都很客气。
messages.en: We disagreed, but we spoke civilly.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sew għamiltu. Tistgħu ma taqblux u xorta tirrispettaw lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Sew għamiltu. Tistgħu ma taqblux u xorta tirrispettaw lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 你们做得对。即使意见不同，也可以互相尊重。
messages.en: You did the right thing. You can disagree and still respect each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分ċivilment：讨论时客气回应是“有礼貌地”，参与社区事务是“尽公民责任地”。

gloss_zh: 坐下吧；悠闲地坐着放松

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression telling someone to sit down, or describing sitting comfortably and without worries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用来叫人坐下，也可描述无忧无虑、悠闲放松地坐着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni biex tgħid lil xi ħadd joqgħod bilqiegħda, jew biex tiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd bilqiegħda rilassat u bla ħsibijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐下！坐下吧！
无忧无虑地坐着；坐着悠闲放松。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-qari, il-karattru jgħid 'ċiċċi beqqi' biex jistieden lit-tifel joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: In the reading exercise, the character says 'ċiċċi beqqi' to invite the boy to sit down.
formal.zh: 在阅读练习中，人物说“ċiċċi beqqi”，招呼男孩坐下。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Ejja, ċiċċi beqqi hawn ħdejja. Ben: Tajjeb, noqgħod hawn u nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Mother: Come on, sit down here beside me. Ben: All right, I'll sit here and rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：来，坐到我旁边吧。本：好，我坐在这里休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 来，坐到我旁边吧。
messages.en: Come on, sit down here beside me.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, noqgħod hawn u nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, noqgħod hawn u nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 好，我坐在这里休息一会儿。
messages.en: All right, I'll sit here and rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句当作一个坐下休息的画面：招呼别人时是“坐下吧”，描述状态时是“悠闲坐着”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a sharp cutting edge used to cut or carve wood, stone, or other hard material, often by striking it with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有锋利刃口的工具，用来切削或雕刻木材、石头等硬质材料，常配合锤击使用。
