teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'tarf jaqta' li tintuża biex tqatta' jew tnaqqax l-injam, il-ġebel jew materjal iebes ieħor, spiss bid-daqqiet ta' martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿子；用于切削或雕刻木材、石材等材料的刃具。

formal.mt: L-iskultur uża ċiżell biex inaqqax disinn sempliċi fil-ġebla.
formal.en: The sculptor used a chisel to carve a simple design into the stone.
formal.zh: 雕刻师用凿子在石头上刻出了一个简单的图案。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċiżell għall-injam? Rita: Fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where did you put the wood chisel? Rita: In the toolbox, next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: Toni：你把木工凿放在哪里了？Rita：在工具箱里，锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Toni (木工)
messages.zh: 你把木工凿放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the wood chisel?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 在工具箱里，锤子旁边。
messages.en: In the toolbox, next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一手拿锤子、一手拿ċiżell，在石头上慢慢凿出图案，把工具和动作画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blue-green colour between blue and green, also used as one of the basic ink colours in colour printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介于蓝色与绿色之间的蓝绿色，也是彩色印刷使用的基本油墨颜色之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kulur bejn il-blu u l-aħdar, li jintuża wkoll bħala wieħed mill-kuluri bażiċi tal-linka fl-istampar bil-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青色；介于蓝与绿之间的蓝绿色。

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel il-kulur ċjan għall-isfond tal-poster biex it-test skur jidher ċar.
formal.en: The designer chose cyan for the poster background so that the dark text would stand out clearly.
formal.zh: 设计师选择青色作为海报背景，使深色文字清晰醒目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kulur trid għall-isfond, blu jew ċjan? Adam: Ċjan, jekk jogħġbok. Irrid kulur bejn il-blu u l-aħdar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which colour do you want for the background, blue or cyan? Adam: Cyan, please. I want a colour between blue and green.
colloquial.zh: Nina：背景你想用哪种颜色，蓝色还是青色？Adam：请用青色。我想要介于蓝色和绿色之间的颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kulur trid għall-isfond, blu jew ċjan?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kulur trid għall-isfond, blu jew ċjan?
messages.zh: 背景你想用哪种颜色，蓝色还是青色？
messages.en: Which colour do you want for the background, blue or cyan?

messages.speaker: Adam (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċjan, jekk jogħġbok. Irrid kulur bejn il-blu u l-aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Ċjan, jekk jogħġbok. Irrid kulur bejn il-blu u l-aħdar.
messages.zh: 请用青色。我想要介于蓝色和绿色之间的颜色。
messages.en: Cyan, please. I want a colour between blue and green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċjan写在一块蓝绿色色卡旁，记住它对应英语cyan，画面是蓝与绿之间的青色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very small in size, often used when speaking affectionately about something little.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积或大小非常小的；形容小东西时，也常带有亲昵、怜爱的语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żgħir ħafna fid-daqs, spiss b'ton ta' ħlewwa jew għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常小的；极小的；小小的。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola, l-istudenti osservaw għasfur ċkejkun fuq fergħa baxxa.
formal.en: In the school garden, the students observed a tiny bird on a low branch.
formal.zh: 学生们在学校花园里观察到一只停在低矮树枝上的小鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara dan il-ġugarell ċkejkun! Joqgħod fil-but tiegħi. Ben: Veru żgħir! Minn fejn xtrajtu?
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at this tiny toy! It fits in my pocket. Ben: It really is small! Where did you buy it?
colloquial.zh: Lina：看这个小小的玩具！它能装进我的口袋。Ben：真小呀！你在哪里买的？

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan il-ġugarell ċkejkun! Joqgħod fil-but tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan il-ġugarell ċkejkun! Joqgħod fil-but tiegħi.
messages.zh: 看这个小小的玩具！它能装进我的口袋。
messages.en: Look at this tiny toy! It fits in my pocket.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 真小呀！你在哪里买的？
messages.en: It really is small! Where did you buy it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个能放进口袋的小小玩具，用ġugarell ċkejkun整组记住“非常小、带点可爱”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is very fat; a label that can sound insulting when used about someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型非常肥胖的人；用来称呼他人时可能带有侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ħoxna ħafna; kelma li tista' tinstema' offensiva meta tintuża dwar xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥胖的人；用作对人的称呼时可能含有贬损意味。

collocations.en: to call someone an obese person in a potentially insulting way
collocations.zh: 用可能带侮辱意味的称呼说某人是个胖子

collocations.en: the word for an obese person, ċombos

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat li l-kelma ċombos tirreferi għal persuna ħoxna ħafna u tista' tweġġa' lil min tiġi indirizzata lejh.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher explained that the word ċombos refers to a very fat person and can hurt the person it is directed at.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师解释说，ċombos指非常肥胖的人，用它称呼他人可能会伤害对方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma ċombos? Karl: Tfisser persuna ħoxna ħafna, imma tista' tweġġa'. Aħjar ma tużahiex biex issejjaħ lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word ċombos mean? Karl: It means a very fat person, but it can be hurtful. It is better not to use it to address someone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：ċombos这个词是什么意思？Karl：意思是非常肥胖的人，但这个词可能伤人。最好别用它来称呼别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ċombos这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word ċombos mean?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser persuna ħoxna ħafna, imma tista' tweġġa'. Aħjar ma tużahiex biex issejjaħ lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser persuna ħoxna ħafna, imma tista' tweġġa'. Aħjar ma tużahiex biex issejjaħ lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 意思是非常肥胖的人，但这个词可能伤人。最好别用它来称呼别人。
messages.en: It means a very fat person, but it can be hurtful. It is better not to use it to address someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċombos记在“描述人的名词”卡片上，同时标注“肥胖者，称呼他人可能伤人”，兼记词义与语气。

gloss_zh: 瘫痪的；麻痹而不能活动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to move because of paralysis, used of a person or a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因瘫痪或麻痹而不能活动的，可形容人或身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiċċaqlaq minħabba paraliżi; jista' jingħad dwar persuna jew parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘫痪的；因麻痹而不能活动的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali għandu driegħ ċong u jitgħallem jikteb bl-id l-oħra.
formal.en: In the story, the main character has a paralyzed arm and learns to write with the other hand.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公的一只手臂瘫痪了，于是学习用另一只手写字。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-karattru jikteb biss b'idu x-xellugija? Mark: Għax id-driegħ tal-lemin tiegħu huwa ċong; ma jistax iċaqalqu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does the character write only with his left hand? Mark: Because his right arm is paralyzed; he cannot move it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这个人物为什么只用左手写字？Mark：因为他的右臂瘫痪了，不能活动。

messages.speaker: Anna (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru jikteb biss b'idu x-xellugija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru jikteb biss b'idu x-xellugija?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么只用左手写字？
messages.en: Why does the character write only with his left hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax id-driegħ tal-lemin tiegħu huwa ċong; ma jistax iċaqalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax id-driegħ tal-lemin tiegħu huwa ċong; ma jistax iċaqalqu.
messages.zh: 因为他的右臂瘫痪了，不能活动。
messages.en: Because his right arm is paralyzed; he cannot move it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用driegħ ċong“瘫痪的手臂”作为记忆短语，把ċong和“因瘫痪而不能活动”的状态联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loss of the ability to move a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体某一部分失去活动能力的状态，即瘫痪或麻痹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telf tal-ħila li wieħed iċaqlaq parti minn ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘫痪；身体某部分失去活动能力。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi ċongatura parzjali fid-driegħ tax-xellug.
formal.en: The medical report describes partial paralysis in the left arm.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了左臂局部瘫痪的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser ċongatura? Pawlu: Tfisser li parti mill-ġisem ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does ċongatura mean? Pawlu: It means that a part of the body cannot move.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ċongatura 是什么意思？保罗：意思是身体的某一部分不能活动。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ċongatura 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ċongatura mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li parti mill-ġisem ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li parti mill-ġisem ma tkunx tista' tiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 意思是身体的某一部分不能活动。
messages.en: It means that a part of the body cannot move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċongatura 和“肢体无法活动”的画面绑定，再用“双腿瘫痪”这个搭配帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of cloth, especially one used as a cleaning rag.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小片布，尤其指用来擦拭清洁的小抹布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' drapp, speċjalment waħda li tintuża għat-tindif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小片布；小布片。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cleaning rag (the diminutive form of 'ċarruta')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块清洁用的抹布；ċarruta 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to wipe with a small rag

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tal-wiċċ tal-mejda, uża ċrajrta nadifa u ratba.
formal.en: To clean the tabletop, use a clean, soft little cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁桌面时，请使用一小块干净柔软的布。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tini ċrajrta biex nimsaħ il-mejda? Ġużeppi: Iva, hemm waħda nadifa ħdejn is-sink.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you give me a small rag to wipe the table? Ġużeppi: Yes, there is a clean one next to the sink.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：能给我一块小抹布擦桌子吗？朱塞佩：可以，水槽旁边有一块干净的。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 能给我一块小抹布擦桌子吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a small rag to wipe the table?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda nadifa ħdejn is-sink.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda nadifa ħdejn is-sink.
messages.zh: 可以，水槽旁边有一块干净的。
messages.en: Yes, there is a clean one next to the sink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里捏着一小块布擦桌子：ċrajrta 既可以是小布片，也可以是清洁用的小抹布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rip or split in a material such as cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料等材料上的一处小裂口或小破口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiċrita żgħira f'materjal bħad-drapp.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small tear (the diminutive form of 'ċarta')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一处小裂口或小破口；ċarta 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small tear in the cloth

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet ċrajta fid-drapp tal-purtiera.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small tear was found in the curtain fabric.
formal.zh: 检查时发现窗帘布上有一处小裂口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm ċrajta fil-qmis tiegħi. Rita: Ġibha hawn, nista' nsewwiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: There is a small tear in my shirt. Rita: Bring it here; I can mend it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的衬衫上有个小破口。丽塔：拿过来，我可以补好。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有个小破口。
messages.en: There is a small tear in my shirt.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 拿过来，我可以补好。
messages.en: Bring it here; I can mend it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衬衫上只需几针就能补好的小破口，用这个画面记住 ċrajta 的“小裂口”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small circle, such as one drawn around an item on a page.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小的圆形或圆圈，例如在纸上圈住某个项目的小圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku żgħir, bħal wieħed li jitpinġa madwar xi ħaġa fuq paġna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小圆圈；ċirku 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small circle around a number

formal.mt: Pinġi ċrejjek madwar in-numru li jikkorrispondi għat-tweġiba t-tajba.
formal.en: Draw a small circle around the number that corresponds to the correct answer.
formal.zh: 请在正确答案所对应的数字周围画一个小圆圈。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Kif nimmarka t-tweġiba? Sara: Pinġi ċrejjek madwar in-numru.
colloquial.en: Luca: How do I mark the answer? Sara: Draw a small circle around the number.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：答案要怎么标记？萨拉：在数字周围画一个小圆圈。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 答案要怎么标记？
messages.en: How do I mark the answer?

messages.speaker: Sara (老师)
messages.zh: 在数字周围画一个小圆圈。
messages.en: Draw a small circle around the number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在笔记里的 ċrejjek 旁画一个小圆圈，把词形、手势和“小圆圈”的意思一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suddenly and with little or no warning, especially when an action starts or ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动作或变化来得突然、几乎没有预兆，尤其用于突然开始或结束的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'daqqa u bi ftit jew xejn twissija, speċjalment meta azzjoni tibda jew tieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然地；猝然地；毫无预兆地。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur waqaf ċumm-bumm meta ra s-siġra mwaqqgħa fit-triq.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller stopped abruptly when he saw the fallen tree in the road.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人看到路上倒下的树时，突然停住了脚步。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għaliex telaq ċumm-bumm? Karl: Ċemplulu mix-xogħol u kellu jitlaq minnufih.
colloquial.en: Julia: Why did he leave so abruptly? Karl: He got a call from work and had to leave immediately.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：他怎么突然就走了？卡尔：单位打电话给他，他必须马上离开。

messages.speaker: Julia (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么突然就走了？
messages.en: Why did he leave so abruptly?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċemplulu mix-xogħol u kellu jitlaq minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Ċemplulu mix-xogħol u kellu jitlaq minnufih.
messages.zh: 单位打电话给他，他必须马上离开。
messages.en: He got a call from work and had to leave immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 ċumm-bumm 时配合“走着走着突然停住”的动作，用两个短节拍提醒自己它表示动作猝然发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suddenly and abruptly, with little or no warning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动作突然发生，几乎没有预告或过渡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod f'daqqa, mingħajr twissija jew bidla gradwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然地；猛然地；没有过渡地。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti qam ċumm-paqq u ħareġ mill-kamra.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the participants got up abruptly and left the room.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者猛地站起来，走出了房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt ċumm-paqq? Mark: Skużani, ftakart li kelli appuntament.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave so abruptly? Mark: Sorry, I remembered I had an appointment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么突然就走了？Mark：抱歉，我想起自己还有个预约。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么突然就走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave so abruptly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，我想起自己还有个预约。
messages.en: Sorry, I remembered I had an appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个带连字符的词配上“猛地起身”的动作来记：动作突然一跳，就是 ċumm-paqq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long pillow used to support the head or another part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于承托头部或身体其他部位的长形枕头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħadda twila li tintuża biex issostni r-ras jew parti oħra tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长枕；用于支撑头部或身体的长靠枕。

formal.mt: Il-kamra għandha sodda doppja b'ċuviera twila u żewġ imħaded żgħar.
formal.en: The room has a double bed with a long bolster and two small pillows.
formal.zh: 房间里有一张双人床，床上放着一个长枕和两个小枕头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tgħaddili ċ-ċuviera, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Żgur. Tridha wara dahrek?
colloquial.en: Lara: Could you pass me the bolster, please? Pawlu: Sure. Do you want it behind your back?
colloquial.zh: Lara：请把那个长靠枕递给我，好吗？Pawlu：当然。你要把它垫在背后吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 请把那个长靠枕递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the bolster, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 当然。你要把它垫在背后吗？
messages.en: Sure. Do you want it behind your back?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象床上横放着一个长长的靠枕，把 ċuviera 与“长枕支撑身体”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft substance that people chew for its taste without swallowing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人咀嚼以享受味道、通常不吞咽的软性糖胶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza ratba li tomgħodha għat-togħma tagħha mingħajr ma tiblagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口香糖；供咀嚼而不吞咽的糖胶。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jarmu ċ-ċuwing-gamm fil-landa taż-żibel qabel jidħlu fil-klassi.
formal.en: Students should put their chewing gum in the bin before entering the classroom.
formal.zh: 学生进入教室前应将口香糖扔进垃圾桶。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid biċċa ċuwing-gamm? Maja: Iva, grazzi. Għandek wieħed bla zokkor?
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like a piece of chewing gum? Maja: Yes, thanks. Have you got a sugar-free one?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你要来一块口香糖吗？Maja：好，谢谢。你有无糖的吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要来一块口香糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of chewing gum?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għandek wieħed bla zokkor?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għandek wieħed bla zokkor?
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。你有无糖的吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Have you got a sugar-free one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċuwing-gamm 的读音与英语 chewing gum 对照，再配上“嚼口香糖”的动作记忆。

gloss_zh: 傻气的；荒唐可笑的；愚蠢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Silly, ridiculous, or showing a lack of good judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语、想法或行为傻气、荒唐可笑，或缺乏合理判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun iblah, redikolu jew juri nuqqas ta' ġudizzju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻气的；不够认真或显得幼稚可笑的。
荒唐可笑的；不合理得令人发笑的。
愚蠢的；缺乏明智判断的。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku ddeskriva l-argument bħala ċuċesk għax kien ibbażat fuq suppożizzjoni bla bażi.
formal.en: The critic described the argument as ridiculous because it was based on an unfounded assumption.
formal.zh: 评论者认为这一论点荒唐可笑，因为它建立在毫无根据的假设之上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naħseb li nista' nitgħallem il-ktieb kollu f'ħames minuti. Anna: Dak pjan ċuċesk! Aħjar tibda kapitlu kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I think I can learn the whole book in five minutes. Anna: That is a foolish plan! You would do better to start chapter by chapter.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我觉得五分钟就能学完整本书。安娜：这计划也太傻了！你还是一章一章开始学比较好。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li nista' nitgħallem il-ktieb kollu f'ħames minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li nista' nitgħallem il-ktieb kollu f'ħames minuti.
messages.zh: 我觉得五分钟就能学完整本书。
messages.en: I think I can learn the whole book in five minutes.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pjan ċuċesk! Aħjar tibda kapitlu kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pjan ċuċesk! Aħjar tibda kapitlu kapitlu.
messages.zh: 这计划也太傻了！你还是一章一章开始学比较好。
messages.en: That is a foolish plan! You would do better to start chapter by chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“五分钟学完整本书”的荒唐计划，用 ċuċesk 同时联系“傻气、可笑、欠考虑”三层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stupid thing someone says or does, or a serious mistake caused by poor judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人说出或做出的蠢事，也可指判断不当造成的大错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa stupida li wieħed jgħid jew jagħmel, jew żball kbir minħabba ġudizzju ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件蠢事；愚蠢的言语或行为。
一个大错；严重的失误。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, ammetta li kienet ċuċija li bagħat id-dokument mingħajr ma ċċekkja ċ-ċifri.
formal.en: In his letter, he admitted that sending the document without checking the figures had been a big mistake.
formal.zh: 他在信中承认，未核对数字就发出文件是一个大错。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għamilt ċuċija: ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa. David: Għandi kopja jien. Niftaħlek.
colloquial.en: Elena: I did something stupid: I left the keys inside. David: I have a spare set. I will open the door for you.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我干了件蠢事，把钥匙落在屋里了。戴维：我有一套备用钥匙，我帮你开门。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 我干了件蠢事，把钥匙落在屋里了。
messages.en: I did something stupid: I left the keys inside.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 我有一套备用钥匙，我帮你开门。
messages.en: I have a spare set. I will open the door for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċuċija 放进“我做了件蠢事”的自述里记忆；后果严重时，再联想到“犯了一个大错”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person as very foolish or severely lacking good judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人非常愚蠢、极其缺乏判断力，带有“大傻瓜”的贬斥意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna bħala belha ħafna jew nieqsa ħafna mill-ġudizzju.

sense_translations.en_definition: a very foolish person (the augmentative form of 'ċuċ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容非常愚蠢的人，即“大傻瓜”；ċuċ 的指大形式。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel ċuċun jitlef flusu għax jemmen kull wegħda li jisma'.
formal.en: In the story, the very foolish man loses his money because he believes every promise he hears.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个十分愚蠢的男人听到什么承诺都相信，结果损失了钱财。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Kont ċuċun meta emmint dik il-wegħda. Marisa: Issa taf x'ġara. Id-darba li jmiss iċċekkja l-fatti.
colloquial.en: Toni: I was very foolish to believe that promise. Marisa: Now you know what happened. Next time, check the facts.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我当时相信那个承诺，真是太傻了。玛丽莎：现在你知道是怎么回事了，下次先核实事实。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ċuċun meta emmint dik il-wegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Kont ċuċun meta emmint dik il-wegħda.
messages.zh: 我当时相信那个承诺，真是太傻了。
messages.en: I was very foolish to believe that promise.

messages.speaker: Marisa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa taf x'ġara. Id-darba li jmiss iċċekkja l-fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Issa taf x'ġara. Id-darba li jmiss iċċekkja l-fatti.
messages.zh: 现在你知道是怎么回事了，下次先核实事实。
messages.en: Now you know what happened. Next time, check the facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċuċun 记成对人说的“太傻了”，想象轻信所有承诺的人，突出“非常愚蠢”的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small crow; the diminutive form of ċawla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小乌鸦，是 ċawla 的指小形式，突出体形小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċawla żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' ċawla.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small crow (the diminutive form of 'ċawla')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小乌鸦；ċawla 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small crow on a branch

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw ċwajla fuq fergħa qrib il-mogħdija.
formal.en: During the bird observation activity, the students saw a small crow on a branch near the path.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看到小路附近的树枝上有一只小乌鸦。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik iċ-ċwajla fuq il-ħajt! Toni: Rajtha. Issa qed ittir lejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that small crow on the wall! Toni: I see it. Now it is flying towards the tree.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看墙上那只小乌鸦！Toni：看到了。它现在正朝那棵树飞去。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看墙上那只小乌鸦！
messages.en: Look at that small crow on the wall!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha. Issa qed ittir lejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha. Issa qed ittir lejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 看到了。它现在正朝那棵树飞去。
messages.en: I see it. Now it is flying towards the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċawla 和 ċwajla 并排记成“大乌鸦图、小乌鸦图”；后者表示小，不必理解为幼鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who has a dark complexion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述一个人的肤色较深或黝黑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna b'karnaġġjon skur.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is dark or dark-skinned
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人肤色较深的、黝黑的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru prinċipali bħala raġel ċwajlu b'għajnejn kannella.
formal.en: In the story, the author describes the main character as a dark-complexioned man with brown eyes.
formal.zh: 在故事中，作者将主人公描写成一名肤色较深、长着棕色眼睛的男子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema wieħed hu ħuk fir-ritratt? Luqa: Dak it-tifel ċwajlu bil-flokk aħdar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which one is your brother in the photo? Luqa: That dark-complexioned boy in the green shirt.
colloquial.zh: Sara：照片里哪一个是你兄弟？Luqa：那个穿绿色上衣、肤色较深的男孩。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里哪一个是你兄弟？
messages.en: Which one is your brother in the photo?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个穿绿色上衣、肤色较深的男孩。
messages.en: That dark-complexioned boy in the green shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物照片旁的“肤色较深”标签记住 ċwajlu；注意它是描述人的形容词，与 ċwajla 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smooth or level a surface, especially wood, using a plane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用刨子将表面，尤其是木材表面，刨平或刨光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Illixxa jew ġab wiċċ, speċjalment tal-injam, indaqs permezz ta' ċana.

sense_translations.en_definition: to plane (to smooth with a plane)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刨子刨平或刨光。

collocations.en: planed the surface of the board

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ċċaffronta wiċċ il-bord biex ikun lixx u indaqs qabel ma waħħlu mal-qafas.
formal.en: The carpenter planed the surface of the board to make it smooth and level before attaching it to the frame.
formal.zh: 木匠先将木板表面刨得平整光滑，再把它固定到框架上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-bord issa lixx ħafna. X'għamel il-mastrudaxxa? Pawlu: Ċċaffronta l-wiċċ biċ-ċana.
colloquial.en: Sara: This board is very smooth now. What did the carpenter do? Pawlu: He smoothed the surface with a plane.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这块木板现在很光滑。木匠做了什么？Pawlu：他用刨子把表面刨平了。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-bord issa lixx ħafna. X'għamel il-mastrudaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-bord issa lixx ħafna. X'għamel il-mastrudaxxa?
messages.zh: 这块木板现在很光滑。木匠做了什么？
messages.en: This board is very smooth now. What did the carpenter do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工作坊助手)
messages.zh: 他用刨子把表面刨平了。
messages.en: He smoothed the surface with a plane.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċċaffronta 配成动作卡：刨子沿木板推出，卷起薄木屑，留下平整表面，记住“刨平”。

gloss_zh: 油漆流淌；被水或泥等溅到

teaching_sense.en_definition: For paint to run, or for someone or something to be splashed with water, mud or a similar substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指油漆流淌；也指人或物被水、泥等溅到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta ż-żebgħa tinżel u tħalli marki, jew meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jintlaqat minn titjir ta' ilma, tajn jew sustanza simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流淌、流挂；用于油漆。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be splashed (with water, mud etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被水、泥等溅到。

formal.mt: Il-kulur ċċaflas qabel ma nixef u ħalla marki twal fuq il-bieb.
formal.en: The paint ran before it dried and left long streaks on the door.
formal.zh: 油漆在干燥前发生流淌，在门上留下了长长的流痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għandu t-tajn fuq il-qalziet? Lara: Ċċaflas bit-tajn meta għaddiet karozza minn ġo għadira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Mark have mud on his trousers? Lara: He got splashed with mud when a car drove through a puddle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 的裤子上为什么有泥？Lara：一辆车驶过水坑时，他被泥溅到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark għandu t-tajn fuq il-qalziet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark għandu t-tajn fuq il-qalziet?
messages.zh: Mark 的裤子上为什么有泥？
messages.en: Why does Mark have mud on his trousers?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċċaflas bit-tajn meta għaddiet karozza minn ġo għadira.
messages.mt_standard: Ċċaflas bit-tajn meta għaddiet karozza minn ġo għadira.
messages.zh: 一辆车驶过水坑时，他被泥溅到了。
messages.en: He got splashed with mud when a car drove through a puddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格画面记 ċċaflas：第一格油漆向下流，第二格泥水溅到裤子；分别对应“流淌”和“被溅到”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become flat or lose thickness because pressure is applied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体受到压力后变平、变薄或被压扁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir ċatta jew titlef il-ħxuna tagħha minħabba pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压扁；受压而变平。

formal.mt: Il-kartun iċċaftar taħt il-kaxxi tqal waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The cardboard was flattened under the heavy boxes during transport.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，纸板被沉重的箱子压扁了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-pakkett sar daqshekk ċatt? Toni: Iċċaftar taħt il-bagalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the package become so flat? Toni: It got flattened under the suitcase.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹怎么变得这么扁？托尼：它被行李箱压扁了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么变得这么扁？
messages.en: Why has the package become so flat?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 它被行李箱压扁了。
messages.en: It got flattened under the suitcase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“纸板被重箱压成薄片”的画面一起记，重点记住物体承受压力后变扁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For the sea to become choppy, with short, irregular waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指海面变得波浪翻涌，出现短而不规则的波浪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-baħar meta jibda jkollu mewġ qasir u irregolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn choppy (used of the sea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得波浪翻涌、海面起浪；用于海。

collocations.en: the sea turned choppy in the wind
collocations.zh: 海面在风中变得波浪翻涌

formal.mt: Wara nofsinhar, ir-riħ żdied u l-baħar ċċafċaf, għalhekk il-grupp ippospona l-ħarġa bid-dgħajsa.
formal.en: In the afternoon, the wind strengthened and the sea turned choppy, so the group postponed the boat trip.
formal.zh: 下午风力增强，海面变得波浪翻涌，因此小组推迟了乘船出游。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex ma ħriġtux bid-dgħajsa? Mark: Il-baħar ċċafċaf, u ddeċidejna li nibqgħu fuq l-art.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why didn't you go out in the boat? Mark: The sea turned choppy, and we decided to stay on land.
colloquial.zh: Toni：你们为什么没乘船出去？Mark：海面起浪了，我们决定留在岸上。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么没乘船出去？
messages.en: Why didn't you go out in the boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (出游者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-baħar ċċafċaf, u ddeċidejna li nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Il-baħar ċċafċaf, u ddeċidejna li nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.zh: 海面起浪了，我们决定留在岸上。
messages.en: The sea turned choppy, and we decided to stay on land.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċċafċaf 的重复字形想成一排排小浪峰，并连着 il-baħar“海”一起记，表示海面起浪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something for amusement rather than as a serious statement or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了逗乐而说话或做事，所表达的内容并非严肃认真。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħid jew jagħmel xi ħaġa biex idaħħak, mingħajr ma jkun qed jitkellem jew jaġixxi bis-serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开玩笑；说笑；用言语或行动逗乐。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem iċċajta dwar it-temp fil-bidu tad-diskors, u l-udjenza daħket.
formal.en: The speaker joked about the weather at the beginning of the speech, and the audience laughed.
formal.zh: 演讲者在讲话开头拿天气开了个玩笑，听众都笑了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu qal li se jixtri kastell! Maja: Iċċajta biss; ma kienx qed jitkellem bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu said he's going to buy a castle! Maja: He was only joking; he wasn't being serious.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗说他要买一座城堡！玛雅：他只是开玩笑，没当真。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qal li se jixtri kastell!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qal li se jixtri kastell!
messages.zh: 保罗说他要买一座城堡！
messages.en: Pawlu said he's going to buy a castle!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċajta biss; ma kienx qed jitkellem bis-serjetà.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċajta biss; ma kienx qed jitkellem bis-serjetà.
messages.zh: 他只是开玩笑，没当真。
messages.en: He was only joking; he wasn't being serious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“说要买城堡，朋友笑着说别当真”的场景，把这个动词与轻松说笑的语气联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To invite someone to compete or prove their ability, or to question whether an idea or decision is valid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提出比赛或能力上的挑战，也可指质疑某个观点或决定是否成立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jistieden lil xi ħadd jikkompeti jew juri l-ħila tiegħu, jew iqiegħed fid-dubju idea jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑战；要求对方应战或证明能力；对观点、决定等提出质疑。

collocations.en: challenge his friend to a race

formal.mt: L-istudent iċċalinġja l-argument billi ppreżenta evidenza li ma kinitx taqbel mal-konklużjoni.
formal.en: The student challenged the argument by presenting evidence that did not agree with the conclusion.
formal.zh: 这名学生提出了与结论不符的证据，对该论点发起质疑。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex qed titħarreġ daqshekk? Mark: Pawlu ċċalinġjani għal tellieqa nhar is-Sibt!
colloquial.en: Toni: Why are you training so much? Mark: Pawlu challenged me to a race on Saturday!
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你怎么练得这么起劲？马克：保罗向我挑战，约好星期六赛跑！

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么练得这么起劲？
messages.en: Why are you training so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ċċalinġjani għal tellieqa nhar is-Sibt!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ċċalinġjani għal tellieqa nhar is-Sibt!
messages.zh: 保罗向我挑战，约好星期六赛跑！
messages.en: Pawlu challenged me to a race on Saturday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并排记忆：向朋友约赛跑是挑战能力，向论点提出证据是挑战其成立性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become blurred and difficult to distinguish, or to become dirty or stained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得模糊不清、难以辨认，或受到污物沾染而变脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir imċajpra u diffiċli biex tingħaraf, jew titħammeġ u jkollha tbajja'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得模糊不清；轮廓或字迹难以辨认。
被弄脏；被污物沾染。

collocations.en: the text became blurred by water
the shirt became soiled with mud

formal.mt: It-test fuq it-tikketta iċċallas meta xxarrab, u n-numru ma baqax jinqara.
formal.en: The text on the label became blurred when it got wet, and the number could no longer be read.
formal.zh: 标签上的文字受潮后变得模糊，号码已经无法辨认。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara mill-flokk tiegħek? Toni: Iċċallas bit-tajn meta waqajt fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to your shirt? Toni: It got muddy when I fell in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的上衣怎么了？托尼：我在花园里摔了一跤，衣服沾上了泥。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的上衣怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your shirt?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在花园里摔了一跤，衣服沾上了泥。
messages.en: It got muddy when I fell in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把水洇开的字和沾泥的衣服并排想象：前者记“模糊”，后者记“弄脏”，分别掌握两个义项。

gloss_zh: 体重大幅增加；胖了很多

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain a large amount of weight, making the change in body size noticeable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体重增加很多，身体大小出现明显变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiżdied ħafna fil-piż, b'bidla fid-daqs tal-ġisem li tidher sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重大幅增加；明显发胖。

collocations.en: gain a great deal of weight over the year
gain a great deal of weight in a short time
collocations.zh: 短时间内体重大幅增加

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni ċċambas matul is-sena, u l-ħwejjeġ tiegħu ma baqgħux jiġuh.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character gained a great deal of weight over the year, and his clothes no longer fitted him.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公在一年间体重大幅增加，原来的衣服已经穿不下了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-karattru fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Lara: Iċċambas tant li kellu jixtri ħwejjeġ akbar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the character at the end of the story? Lara: He gained so much weight that he had to buy bigger clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事结尾那个角色怎么样了？劳拉：他胖了很多，得买更大码的衣服了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事结尾那个角色怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the character at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċambas tant li kellu jixtri ħwejjeġ akbar.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċambas tant li kellu jixtri ħwejjeġ akbar.
messages.zh: 他胖了很多，得买更大码的衣服了。
messages.en: He gained so much weight that he had to buy bigger clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原来的衣服穿不下，需要换大码”的故事记忆，突出体重增加幅度很大这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be scolded for something one has done, or to reproach oneself for a mistake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己的行为受到训斥，或因犯错而责备自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi mwiddeb għal dak li jkun għamel, jew iċanfar lilu nnifsu għal żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被训斥；因行为不当而受到责备。
责备自己；因自己的错误或疏忽而自责。

collocations.en: be told off by the teacher

formal.mt: Wara li ntebaħ bl-iżball tiegħu, Mark iċċanfar bejnu u bejn ruħu talli ma ċċekkjax iċ-ċifri.
formal.en: After noticing his mistake, Mark reproached himself inwardly for not checking the figures.
formal.zh: 发现自己的错误后，马克在心里责备自己没有核对数字。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Toni jidher imdejjaq? Nina: Iċċanfar mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does Toni look upset? Nina: He got told off by the teacher because he kept talking during the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：托尼怎么看起来不高兴？妮娜：他上课一直讲话，被老师训了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 托尼怎么看起来不高兴？
messages.en: Why does Toni look upset?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċanfar mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċanfar mill-għalliem għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 他上课一直讲话，被老师训了。
messages.en: He got told off by the teacher because he kept talking during the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象责备的话有两个来源：老师说出口就是“被训斥”，自己在心里说就是“责备自己”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut away a sharp edge at an angle so that a narrow sloping surface is formed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿材料的尖锐边缘斜切，形成一条狭窄的斜面，即进行倒角加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jaqta' tarf jaqta' b'mod inklinat biex joħloq wiċċ dejjaq u mmejjel tul it-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给材料边缘倒角；将尖锐棱边削成斜面。

collocations.en: chamfer the edge of the wood
chamfer the edges of the metal

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ċċanfrina t-tarf tal-bord biex ineħħi l-kantuniera li taqta' u joħloq wiċċ immejjel.
formal.en: The carpenter chamfered the edge of the board to remove the sharp corner and create a sloping surface.
formal.zh: 木工给木板边缘倒了角，去除尖锐棱角并形成斜面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tarf għandu wiċċ immejjel? Pawlu: Il-mastrudaxxa ċċanfrinah biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this edge have a sloping surface? Pawlu: The carpenter chamfered it so it would no longer be sharp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条边怎么有个斜面？保罗：木工给它倒了角，这样就不会那么锋利了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tarf għandu wiċċ immejjel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tarf għandu wiċċ immejjel?
messages.zh: 这条边怎么有个斜面？
messages.en: Why does this edge have a sloping surface?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mastrudaxxa ċċanfrinah biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mastrudaxxa ċċanfrinah biex ma jibqax jaqta'.
messages.zh: 木工给它倒了角，这样就不会那么锋利了。
messages.en: The carpenter chamfered it so it would no longer be sharp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把木板直角边削去一小条，留下平直的斜面；用这个加工画面记住“倒角”的具体动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface, such as a path or courtyard, with stone slabs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石板铺设道路、庭院等地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi wiċċ, bħal mogħdija jew bitħa, b'ċangaturi tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用石板铺砌地面。

collocations.en: paved the courtyard with stone slabs
paved the path with stone slabs

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċċanga l-mogħdija b'ċangaturi tal-ġebel biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jimxu fuq wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: The worker paved the path with stone slabs so that visitors could walk on a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 工人用石板铺好了小径，让访客能够走在平整的路面上。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ċċanga l-bitħa? Pawlu: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Ara kemm tidher sabiħa issa!
colloquial.en: Marija: Who paved the courtyard with stone slabs? Pawlu: The worker who came yesterday. Look how lovely it looks now!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁用石板铺了庭院？保罗：昨天来的那位工人。你看，现在多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.zh: 谁用石板铺了庭院？
messages.en: Who paved the courtyard with stone slabs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Ara kemm tidher sabiħa issa!
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Ara kemm tidher sabiħa issa!
messages.zh: 昨天来的那位工人。你看，现在多漂亮！
messages.en: The worker who came yesterday. Look how lovely it looks now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人把一块块石板铺满庭院，把ċċanga和“石板铺地”的完整画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try something despite uncertainty about whether it will succeed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在结果不确定的情况下尝试一下，碰碰运气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jagħmel xi ħaġa minkejja li ma jkunx jaf jekk hux se jirnexxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碰碰运气；在没有成功把握时冒险一试。

collocations.zh: 抱着试一试的心态提交了申请

collocations.en: took a chance despite the risk
collocations.zh: 尽管有风险，还是冒险试了试

formal.mt: Minkejja li kellu ftit esperjenza, Mark ċċansja u applika għall-impjieg.
formal.en: Although he had little experience, Mark took a chance and applied for the job.
formal.zh: 尽管经验不多，马克还是抱着试一试的心态申请了这份工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mark ċċansja u daħal fil-kompetizzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, u rebaħ it-tieni premju!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Mark take a chance and enter the competition? Pawlu: Yes, and he won second prize!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克是不是抱着试一试的心态参加了比赛？保罗：是啊，他还拿了二等奖！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是不是抱着试一试的心态参加了比赛？
messages.en: Did Mark take a chance and enter the competition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他还拿了二等奖！
messages.en: Yes, and he won second prize!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċċansja放进“没把握也报名试试”的小故事里，记住重点是愿意尝试，并不保证成功。

gloss_zh: 沾污；弄脏；名誉受损；受拖累；久困某处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become stained or dirty; also to suffer damage to one's reputation, be adversely affected, or remain delayed in one place for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沾上污渍或变脏；也可指名誉受损、受到人或事的不良影响，或长时间滞留在某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittebba' jew jitħammeġ; jista' wkoll ifisser li ssir ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu, li jintlaqat ħażin minn xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd, jew li jdum imwaħħal f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾上污渍；被染污。
被弄脏；变得不干净。
名誉受到玷污；声誉受损。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be negatively affected by sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到某事或某人的不良影响；受牵连或拖累。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be delayed in a specific place for a long time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长时间耽搁或滞留在某个地方。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, il-kmiem tal-ħaddiem ċċappas biż-żebgħa.
formal.en: During the maintenance work, the worker's sleeve became stained with paint.
formal.zh: 进行维护工作时，工人的袖子沾上了油漆。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ċċappas il-qmis tiegħek? Pawlu: Waqagħli ftit zalza waqt l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did your shirt get stained? Pawlu: I spilled a little sauce while eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你的衬衫怎么沾上污渍了？保罗：吃饭时我不小心洒了点酱汁。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的衬衫怎么沾上污渍了？
messages.en: How did your shirt get stained?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时我不小心洒了点酱汁。
messages.en: I spilled a little sauce while eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“衬衫沾酱汁”记住具体的沾污义，再分别联想名誉蒙污、受到拖累和久困某处；这是串联义项的学习图像。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change position or to be moved or shifted from one position to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变位置，或受到外力而被移动、挪到另一个位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibdel il-pożizzjoni tiegħu jew jitmexxa minn pożizzjoni għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动；改变位置。
被移动；受到作用而改变位置。
被挪动；被移到另一位置。

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-kontenitur ċċaqlaq minn postu minħabba li ma kienx marbut sew.
formal.en: During transport, the container shifted from its position because it had not been secured properly.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，集装箱因未妥善固定而偏离了原来的位置。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-mejda ċċaqlaq minn postha? Pawlu: Iva, imbuttajtha ftit biex nagħmel spazju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the table moved from its place? Pawlu: Yes, I pushed it a little to make room.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：桌子是不是挪位置了？保罗：是的，我把它推开了一点，腾些空间。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子是不是挪位置了？
messages.en: Has the table moved from its place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imbuttajtha ftit biex nagħmel spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imbuttajtha ftit biex nagħmel spazju.
messages.zh: 是的，我把它推开了一点，腾些空间。
messages.en: Yes, I pushed it a little to make room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给桌子画出移动前后两个位置，用连接两点的箭头记住ċċaqlaq，重点是位置发生变化。

gloss_zh: 被缓慢移动；被慢慢挪动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moved or shifted gradually and slowly from one position to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被缓慢地移动，或一点一点地挪到另一位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitmexxa jew jinbidel minn postu bil-mod, ftit ftit.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be moved or shifted slowly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被慢慢移动；被缓缓挪动。

collocations.en: was slowly moved towards the wall

formal.mt: Il-kabinett tqil ċċaqlem ftit ftit lejn il-ħajt bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
formal.en: The heavy cabinet was shifted little by little towards the wall with the help of two workers.
formal.zh: 在两名工人的帮助下，沉重的柜子被一点一点地挪向墙边。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kabinett ċċaqlem ftit? Pawlu: Iva, imma għad irridu nressquh aktar lejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the cabinet been shifted a little? Pawlu: Yes, but we still need to move it closer to the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：柜子是不是已经慢慢挪动了一点？保罗：是的，不过还得把它再往墙边挪。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.zh: 柜子是不是已经慢慢挪动了一点？
messages.en: Has the cabinet been shifted a little?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (搬运工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għad irridu nressquh aktar lejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għad irridu nressquh aktar lejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 是的，不过还得把它再往墙边挪。
messages.en: Yes, but we still need to move it closer to the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人合力把沉重柜子一寸一寸挪向墙边，用这个慢动作画面记住ċċaqlem的缓慢移动义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become chipped, with a small piece broken off an object such as glass or china.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玻璃、瓷器等物品被磕掉一小块，出现缺口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef biċċa żgħira minħabba ksur, bħal meta jiġri dan fit-tarf ta' oġġett tal-ħġieġ jew tal-porċellana.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be chipped (e.g. used of glass or china)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磕掉小块；出现崩口，如玻璃或瓷器边缘受损。

collocations.en: the rim of the cup became chipped

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie nnutat li t-tarf tal-platt tal-porċellana ċċaqqam waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was noted that the edge of the porcelain plate had become chipped during transport.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，瓷盘边缘在运输过程中被磕掉了一小块。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex warrabt dak il-platt? Pawlu: Ċċaqqam meta ħbat mal-mejda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you set that plate aside? Pawlu: It became chipped when it hit the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么把那个盘子放到一边了？保罗：它碰到桌子时磕出了一个缺口。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那个盘子放到一边了？
messages.en: Why did you set that plate aside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 它碰到桌子时磕出了一个缺口。
messages.en: It became chipped when it hit the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完整的瓷盘边缘少了一小块，用“小缺口”的视觉特征记住ċċaqqam，抓住局部崩损这一重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caused to crack by pressure, force, or another external influence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压力、外力等作用而开裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa xaqq minħabba pressjoni, forza jew xi influwenza esterna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被外力等作用弄得开裂。

collocations.en: was made to crack under pressure
was made to crack by a blow

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-ħġieġ ċċaqċaq taħt il-pressjoni.
formal.en: During the test, the glass was made to crack under pressure.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，玻璃在压力作用下开裂了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex hemm xaqq fil-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Ċċaqċaq minħabba daqqa waqt li konna nġorruh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is there a crack in the glass? Pawlu: It was made to crack by a knock while we were carrying it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：玻璃上为什么有条裂缝？保罗：我们搬它时碰了一下，把它弄裂了。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.zh: 玻璃上为什么有条裂缝？
messages.en: Why is there a crack in the glass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (搬运工)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċċaqċaq minħabba daqqa waqt li konna nġorruh.
messages.mt_standard: Ċċaqċaq minħabba daqqa waqt li konna nġorruh.
messages.zh: 我们搬它时碰了一下，把它弄裂了。
messages.en: It was made to crack by a knock while we were carrying it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象玻璃受压后出现一道裂缝，用“外力造成开裂”的画面记住ċċaqċaq，并留意它描述承受作用的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a meaning, fact, or situation clear and easier to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把意思、事实或情况说明白，使人更容易理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tifsira, fatt jew sitwazzjoni ċara u aktar faċli biex tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使清楚；澄清或解释明白。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur ċċara li l-laqgħa kienet ġiet posposta sal-ġimgħa ta' wara.
formal.en: In his report, the director made it clear that the meeting had been postponed until the following week.
formal.zh: 主任在报告中明确说明，会议已推迟到下一周。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-għalliem ċċara x'irridu nagħmlu? Pawlu: Iva, irridu naqraw it-test u nwieġbu t-tliet mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the teacher make it clear what we need to do? Pawlu: Yes, we need to read the text and answer the three questions.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：老师把我们要做什么讲清楚了吗？保罗：讲清楚了，我们要读课文，再回答那三个问题。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 老师把我们要做什么讲清楚了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher make it clear what we need to do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu naqraw it-test u nwieġbu t-tliet mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu naqraw it-test u nwieġbu t-tliet mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 讲清楚了，我们要读课文，再回答那三个问题。
messages.en: Yes, we need to read the text and answer the three questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把模糊的任务要求逐条写清楚，用“听完就明白该做什么”的课堂情景记住ċċara。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tear or split, as paper, fabric, or another material does when it breaks apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指纸张、布料等材料撕裂或裂开，原本连在一起的部分分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor jinqasam jew jitqatta' u ma jibqax sħiħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕裂、裂开，常用于纸张、布料等材料。

collocations.en: the fabric tore at the edge

formal.mt: Il-kartun iċċarrat waqt it-trasport, u għalhekk il-pakkett kellu jitqiegħed f'kaxxa ġdida.
formal.en: The cardboard tore during transport, so the package had to be placed in a new box.
formal.zh: 纸板在运输途中撕裂了，因此包裹必须换装到一个新箱子里。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-borża għadha tajba? Nina: Le, il-qiegħ iċċarrat u waqgħu t-tuffieħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the bag still all right? Nina: No, the bottom tore and the apples fell out.
colloquial.zh: Mark：袋子还好用吗？Nina：不行了，底部裂开了，苹果都掉出来了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 袋子还好用吗？
messages.en: Is the bag still all right?

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-qiegħ iċċarrat u waqgħu t-tuffieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-qiegħ iċċarrat u waqgħu t-tuffieħ.
messages.zh: 不行了，底部裂开了，苹果都掉出来了。
messages.en: No, the bottom tore and the apples fell out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装苹果的纸袋底部突然裂开，苹果滚落一地；用“完整材料出现裂口”的画面记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 被弄得滴流；（颜色、颜料）洇开、流散

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to trickle, or, of colours and paints, to run and spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体被弄得缓缓滴流，也指颜色或颜料受影响而流散、洇开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li likwidu jitħalla jinżel fi qtar jew ftit ftit; jew li kulur jew żebgħa jinfirxu u joħorġu minn fejn kienu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得一点点滴下或缓缓流下。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to run (used of colours and paints)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （颜色或颜料）被弄得流散、洇开。

collocations.en: the liquid was made to trickle down the wall
collocations.zh: 液体被弄得沿墙缓缓流下

collocations.en: the colour ran through the fabric

formal.mt: Meta d-drapp ixxarrab, il-kulur iċċarċar u ħalla tbajja' fuq il-parti l-bajda.
formal.en: When the fabric got wet, the colour ran and left stains on the white section.
formal.zh: 布料湿了以后，颜色洇开，在白色部分留下了色斑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, il-kulur iċċarċar fuq il-qmis! Lara: Iva, il-parti l-bajda issa għandha tbajja' blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, the colour has run on the shirt! Lara: Yes, the white part now has blue stains.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看，衬衫上的颜色洇开了！Lara：是啊，白色部分现在有蓝色的色斑了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看，衬衫上的颜色洇开了！
messages.en: Look, the colour has run on the shirt!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-parti l-bajda issa għandha tbajja' blu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-parti l-bajda issa għandha tbajja' blu.
messages.zh: 是啊，白色部分现在有蓝色的色斑了。
messages.en: Yes, the white part now has blue stains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项连成一幅画：水沿墙一点点流下，衣服上的颜色也跟着流散洇开；共同记住“液体或颜色流动”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something flat, or to become flat through pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体弄平或压平，也可指物体在压力作用下变平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel xi ħaġa ċatta, jew li xi ħaġa ssir ċatta minħabba pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弄平、压平。
被弄平、被压平。

collocations.en: the cardboard flattened under the weight
collocations.zh: 纸板在重物下面被压平了

formal.mt: Il-furnar iċċattja l-għaġina b'lembuba qabel qiegħed il-mili fin-nofs.
formal.en: The baker flattened the dough with a rolling pin before placing the filling in the middle.
formal.zh: 面包师先用擀面杖把面团压平，然后把馅料放在中间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kartun sar ċatt? Pawlu: Iċċattja taħt il-kotba; kienu tqal wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the cardboard gone flat? Pawlu: It flattened under the books; they were too heavy.
colloquial.zh: Lara：纸板怎么变平了？Pawlu：被书压平了，那些书太重了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 纸板怎么变平了？
messages.en: Why has the cardboard gone flat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċattja taħt il-kotba; kienu tqal wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċattja taħt il-kotba; kienu tqal wisq.
messages.zh: 被书压平了，那些书太重了。
messages.en: It flattened under the books; they were too heavy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“圆面团变成薄面饼”的过程：有人动手就是压平，物体承受压力就是被压平；两义都围绕形状变平。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk informally, often at length, or to gossip about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意地闲聊，常指聊个不停；也可指谈论别人的私事、说闲话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod informali, spiss fit-tul, jew jitkellem fuq il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲聊；叽叽喳喳地说个不停。
说闲话；谈论别人的私事。

formal.mt: Waqt il-pawża, Mark ċċaċċar mal-kollegi dwar il-pjanijiet tagħhom għal tmiem il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: During the break, Mark chatted with his colleagues about their plans for the weekend.
formal.zh: 休息时，Mark 和同事们闲聊了各自的周末计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed tistenna? Lara: Ċċaċċar miegħi fuq il-ġirien, imma ma ridtx nitkellem fuq il-ħajja privata tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do while you were waiting? Lara: He gossiped with me about the neighbours, but I didn't want to talk about their private lives.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你等着的时候，Pawlu 做了什么？Lara：他跟我说邻居们的闲话，但我不想谈他们的私生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed tistenna?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li kont qed tistenna?
messages.zh: 你等着的时候，Pawlu 做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do while you were waiting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċċaċċar miegħi fuq il-ġirien, imma ma ridtx nitkellem fuq il-ħajja privata tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ċċaċċar miegħi fuq il-ġirien, imma ma ridtx nitkellem fuq il-ħajja privata tagħhom.
messages.zh: 他跟我说邻居们的闲话，但我不想谈他们的私生活。
messages.en: He gossiped with me about the neighbours, but I didn't want to talk about their private lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词中反复出现的 ċ 当作聊天声的视觉提示：聊日常是“闲聊”，聊别人私事就是“说闲话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To willingly go without something one values or needs, often as a sacrifice for another purpose or person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动放弃自己珍视或需要的东西，常指为了某个目的或他人而作出牺牲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħżel li jgħaddi mingħajr xi ħaġa li jgħożż jew jeħtieġ, spiss għal skop jew għal persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己失去某种享受或需要的东西；主动舍弃。
作出牺牲；为了其他目的或他人而放弃自身利益。

formal.mt: Il-missier iċċaħħad minn ħafna kumditajiet biex seta' jħallas għall-istudji ta' bintu.
formal.en: The father gave up many comforts so that he could pay for his daughter's studies.
formal.zh: 这位父亲舍弃了许多舒适的享受，以便支付女儿的学费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma marx għall-kunċert? Nina: Iċċaħħad minn dik il-ħarġa biex jiffranka għall-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark go to the concert? Nina: He gave up that outing to save for the trip.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：马克为什么没去听音乐会？妮娜：他为了攒旅行的钱，放弃了那次外出活动。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没去听音乐会？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark go to the concert?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċaħħad minn dik il-ħarġa biex jiffranka għall-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċaħħad minn dik il-ħarġa biex jiffranka għall-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 他为了攒旅行的钱，放弃了那次外出活动。
messages.en: He gave up that outing to save for the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己把喜欢的东西暂时放下，为更重要的目标让路；由“主动舍弃”联想到“作出牺牲”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shifted from an existing position to another position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被挪动，离开原来所在的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titmexxa minn fejn kienet u tinbidel il-pożizzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挪动、被移位，位置发生变化。

collocations.en: the cupboard was shifted out of position
the bench was shifted towards the wall

formal.mt: L-armarju iċċeflaq minn postu waqt ix-xogħol fil-kamra, u wara tqiegħed lura fil-post oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: The cupboard was shifted out of position during work in the room and was later returned to its original place.
formal.zh: 在房间里施工时，柜子被挪离了原位，之后又被放回原来的位置。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bank iċċeflaq minn postu? Nina: Iva, issa qiegħed eqreb lejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the bench been shifted from its place? Nina: Yes, it's closer to the wall now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：长凳被挪过位置了吗？Nina：是啊，现在更靠近墙了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 长凳被挪过位置了吗？
messages.en: Has the bench been shifted from its place?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qiegħed eqreb lejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qiegħed eqreb lejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在更靠近墙了。
messages.en: Yes, it's closer to the wall now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给柜子原来的位置画一个框，再想象柜子被挪到框外；重点记住“位置改变、被挪动”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of someone's eyes, to grow dim or lose clarity so that things appear blurry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于人的眼睛，指视觉变得昏暗或不清楚，看东西模糊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għajnejn xi ħadd jibdew jaraw inqas ċar, u l-affarijiet jidhru mudlama jew imċajpra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go dim (used of sb.'s eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （人的眼睛）视线变暗、视觉变得昏暗。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go blurry (used of sb.'s eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （人的眼睛）看东西变得模糊，视物不清。

collocations.en: his eyes grew dim or blurry
collocations.zh: 他的视线变暗或模糊了

collocations.en: her vision became blurry while reading
collocations.zh: 她阅读时看东西变得模糊了

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari, għajnejn il-qarrej iċċefċqu u l-ittri fuq il-paġna dehru mċajpra.
formal.en: While reading, the reader's vision became blurry and the letters on the page looked indistinct.
formal.zh: 阅读时，读者的视线变得模糊，书页上的字母看起来不清楚了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għajnejja iċċefċqu u ma nistax naqra l-kliem sew. Lara: Ħalli l-ktieb għal ftit u strieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: My vision has gone blurry and I can't read the words properly. Lara: Put the book aside for a bit and rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我看东西模糊了，字也读不清楚。Lara：先把书放一放，休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajnejja iċċefċqu u ma nistax naqra l-kliem sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għajnejja iċċefċqu u ma nistax naqra l-kliem sew.
messages.zh: 我看东西模糊了，字也读不清楚。
messages.en: My vision has gone blurry and I can't read the words properly.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalli l-ktieb għal ftit u strieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalli l-ktieb għal ftit u strieħ.
messages.zh: 先把书放一放，休息一下。
messages.en: Put the book aside for a bit and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读书时字母逐渐失去清晰轮廓，眼前像蒙了一层暗纱；把这个词与“眼睛看不清”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 变小、缩小；羞辱；使谦卑、挫其傲气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller in size, or to lower someone's dignity or pride by humiliating or humbling them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指尺寸缩小，也可指使人受辱、降低其尊严，或使人收敛骄傲、变得谦卑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir iżgħar fid-daqs, jew li jbaxxi d-dinjità jew il-kburija ta' xi ħadd billi jumiljah jew jagħmlu aktar umli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸被缩小，变得比原来小。
羞辱、贬低某人，使其感到丢脸或尊严受损。
使人谦卑、挫其傲气，使其不再自高自大。

collocations.en: the photograph was reduced in size
the size was reduced by half

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt iċċekken biex jidħol fil-paġna, iżda d-dettalji baqgħu jidhru ċari.
formal.en: The photograph was reduced in size to fit on the page, but the details remained clear.
formal.zh: 照片被缩小以适应页面大小，但细节仍然清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-ritratt iċċekken wisq! Mark: Iva, issa bilkemm nistgħu naraw l-uċuħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: The photograph has been made too small! Mark: Yes, now we can barely see the faces.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片缩得太小了！Mark：是啊，现在连人脸都快看不清了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 照片缩得太小了！
messages.en: The photograph has been made too small!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa bilkemm nistgħu naraw l-uċuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa bilkemm nistgħu naraw l-uċuħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在连人脸都快看不清了。
messages.en: Yes, now we can barely see the faces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小”串联记忆：照片尺寸变小是缩小；让人觉得自己低人一等是羞辱；让人的骄傲变小则是使其谦卑。这只是学习联想。

gloss_zh: （国际象棋）将军，使对方的王受将

teaching_sense.en_definition: In chess, to make a move that directly threatens the opposing king and puts it in check.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在国际象棋中走出一步棋，直接威胁对方的王，使其处于被将军的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fiċ-ċess, li jagħmel mossa li thedded direttament lir-re tal-avversarju u tqiegħdu fix-xakk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to check (chess: to make a move which puts an adversary's king in check)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （国际象棋）将军：走出一步使对方的王受到直接攻击的棋。

collocations.en: put the opponent's king in check
check the king with the rook

formal.mt: Il-plejer iċċekkja lir-re tal-avversarju bit-torri; l-avversarju kellu jagħmel mossa li tneħħi x-xakk.
formal.en: The player checked the opponent's king with the rook; the opponent had to make a move that removed the check.
formal.zh: 棋手用车向对方的王将军；对方必须走出一步解除将军的棋。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Iċċekkjajt lir-re tiegħek b'din il-mossa. Maja: Rajt! Se nċaqlaq ir-re f'każella sigura.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I've checked your king with this move. Maja: I see! I'll move the king to a safe square.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我这一步将你的王了。Maja：看到了！我把王移到一个安全的格子。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (棋友)
messages.zh: 我这一步将你的王了。
messages.en: I've checked your king with this move.

messages.speaker: Maja (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt! Se nċaqlaq ir-re f'każella sigura.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt! Se nċaqlaq ir-re f'każella sigura.
messages.zh: 看到了！我把王移到一个安全的格子。
messages.en: I see! I'll move the king to a safe square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助英语棋语 check 记忆：想象车沿直线瞄准对方的王，棋手喊出“将军”；本词条要牢牢记住这个棋盘场景。

gloss_zh: 被摇得咔嗒作响；被震得碰响

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shaken or jolted with a rattling sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被摇动或颠动，发出连续的碰撞声、咔嗒声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titħarrek jew titħawwad u tagħmel ħoss ta' daqqiet żgħar ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摇动或震动得发出咔嗒碰撞声。

collocations.en: the bottle was rattled in the bag
collocations.zh: 瓶子在袋子里被晃得碰响

collocations.en: the door was rattled by the wind

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-bieb iċċekċek bir-riħ u l-ħoss instema' fil-kuritur.
formal.en: During the night, the door was rattled by the wind, and the sound could be heard in the corridor.
formal.zh: 夜里，门被风吹得咔嗒作响，走廊里也能听见声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss fil-borża? Pawlu: Il-flixkun iċċekċek meta ħriġt niġri.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise in the bag? Pawlu: The bottle rattled when I ran out.
colloquial.zh: Lara：袋子里刚才是什么声音？Pawlu：我跑出去的时候，瓶子被晃得碰响了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 袋子里刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise in the bag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我跑出去的时候，瓶子被晃得碰响了。
messages.en: The bottle rattled when I ran out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用声音辅助记忆：想象风把门吹得连续“咔嗒咔嗒”，同时配上物体来回震动的画面，记住被摇得碰响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark a special occasion or achievement with expressions of happiness or a festive activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用表达喜悦或举行庆祝活动的方式，纪念特别的日子或取得的成就。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfakkar okkażjoni speċjali jew kisba b'espressjonijiet ta' ferħ jew b'attività ta' festa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 庆祝；庆贺。

formal.mt: Il-klabb iċċelebra l-ħamsin anniversarju tiegħu b'kunċert għall-komunità.
formal.en: The club celebrated its fiftieth anniversary with a concert for the community.
formal.zh: 俱乐部举办了一场面向社区的音乐会，庆祝成立五十周年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif iċċelebrajt għeluq sninek? Mark: Iċċelebrajt mal-familja, b'ikla d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you celebrate your birthday? Mark: I celebrated with my family over a meal at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么庆祝生日的？马克：我和家人在家吃了顿饭庆祝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么庆祝生日的？
messages.en: How did you celebrate your birthday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我和家人在家吃了顿饭庆祝。
messages.en: I celebrated with my family over a meal at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把生日蛋糕、胜利欢呼和周年聚会放在同一幅画面里，记住这个动词表示“庆祝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smeared with a substance such as paint, grease, or sauce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因沾上颜料、油脂或酱汁等物质而出现涂抹状的污迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titħammeġ b'sustanza, bħal żebgħa, xaħam jew zalza, li tinfirex fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抹上污物；沾上涂抹状的污迹。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol taż-żebgħa, il-fardal tal-ħaddiem iċċellaq biż-żebgħa ħamra.
formal.en: During the painting work, the worker's apron got smeared with red paint.
formal.zh: 在刷漆过程中，工人的围裙沾上了红色油漆污迹。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara, il-kmiem tiegħek iċċellaq biz-zalza! Pawlu: Veru! Se naħslu qabel tinxef.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look, your sleeve got smeared with sauce! Pawlu: It did! I'll wash it before it dries.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看，你的袖子沾上酱汁了！保罗：还真是！我趁它没干赶紧洗掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，你的袖子沾上酱汁了！
messages.en: Look, your sleeve got smeared with sauce!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 还真是！我趁它没干赶紧洗掉。
messages.en: It did! I'll wash it before it dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象袖子擦过一摊酱汁，留下拖开的污痕；重点记“东西被抹脏了”这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat dinner, either at home or somewhere else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃晚饭；可以指在家用餐，也可以指在外面吃晚餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiekol l-ikla ta' filgħaxija, id-dar jew f'post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用晚餐；吃晚饭。

formal.mt: Wara l-konferenza, il-mistieden iċċena mar-rappreżentanti tal-università.
formal.en: After the conference, the guest had dinner with the university representatives.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，来宾与大学代表共进了晚餐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà ċċenajt? Daniel: Iva, iċċenajt għand ommi. Inti għadek?
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you had dinner already? Daniel: Yes, I had dinner at my mother's. Have you not eaten yet?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你已经吃过晚饭了吗？丹尼尔：吃过了，我在妈妈家吃的。你还没吃吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经吃过晚饭了吗？
messages.en: Have you had dinner already?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iċċenajt għand ommi. Inti għadek?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iċċenajt għand ommi. Inti għadek?
messages.zh: 吃过了，我在妈妈家吃的。你还没吃吗？
messages.en: Yes, I had dinner at my mother's. Have you not eaten yet?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与夜晚的餐桌联系起来：太阳落下，一家人坐好，接着就是“吃晚饭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove, conceal, or prohibit material judged unsuitable for publication or public viewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对文字、影像等内容进行审查，删去、遮蔽或禁止被认为不宜公开的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi, taħbi jew tipprojbixxi materjal meqjus mhux xieraq għall-pubblikazzjoni jew għall-wiri lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审查并删改、遮蔽或禁止公开某些内容。

collocations.zh: 审查并删改了一篇文章

collocations.en: censored a scene from a film
collocations.zh: 删禁了一部电影中的一个场景

formal.mt: Il-bord iċċensura diversi siltiet mill-film qabel ma awtorizza l-wiri tiegħu.
formal.en: The board censored several passages from the film before authorizing its screening.
formal.zh: 审查委员会删去了影片中的若干片段，然后才批准放映。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din ix-xena hija iqsar fil-verżjoni tat-televiżjoni? Mark: L-istazzjon iċċensura parti minnha minħabba l-vjolenza.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this scene shorter in the television version? Mark: The station censored part of it because of the violence.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么电视版的这个场景更短？马克：电视台因为其中的暴力内容删掉了一部分。

messages.speaker: Nina (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din ix-xena hija iqsar fil-verżjoni tat-televiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din ix-xena hija iqsar fil-verżjoni tat-televiżjoni?
messages.zh: 为什么电视版的这个场景更短？
messages.en: Why is this scene shorter in the television version?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istazzjon iċċensura parti minnha minħabba l-vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: L-istazzjon iċċensura parti minnha minħabba l-vjolenza.
messages.zh: 电视台因为其中的暴力内容删掉了一部分。
messages.en: The station censored part of it because of the violence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文章上盖着审查章，几行文字被遮住；用“审查后删禁内容”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To place something in the middle, or to bring attention or activity together around a central point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放在中间，或把注意力、活动等集中到一个中心点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed xi ħaġa fin-nofs, jew tiġbor l-attenzjoni jew l-attività madwar punt ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使居中；使集中于一个中心。

collocations.zh: 将注意力集中在问题上

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur iċċentra t-titlu fil-parti ta' fuq tal-paġna biex jagħmel it-tqassim aktar ċar.
formal.en: The designer centered the title at the top of the page to make the layout clearer.
formal.zh: 设计师将标题放在页面顶部并居中排列，使版面更加清晰。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-titlu għadu fuq ix-xellug? Ben: Le, iċċentrajtu. Issa qiegħed fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the title still on the left? Ben: No, I centered it. It's in the middle now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：标题还在左边吗？本：没有，我把它居中了。现在它在中间。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 标题还在左边吗？
messages.en: Is the title still on the left?

messages.speaker: Ben (设计师)
messages.zh: 没有，我把它居中了。现在它在中间。
messages.en: No, I centered it. It's in the middle now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拖动标题，让它正好落在页面中线；再把这个“移到中心”的画面用于注意力集中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring services, resources, or decision-making into one central place or authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把服务、资源或决策权集中到一个中心地点或统一管理机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbor servizzi, riżorsi jew it-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet f'post wieħed jew taħt awtorità waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使集中于中心；集中设置或统一管理。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill iċċentralizza s-servizzi amministrattivi f'bini wieħed biex jiffaċilita l-aċċess għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The council centralized its administrative services in one building to make public access easier.
formal.zh: 地方议会将行政服务集中到一栋楼内，以方便公众办理事务。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji biex inlesti l-applikazzjoni? Toni: Le, il-kunsill iċċentralizza s-servizzi. Issa kollox fl-istess bini.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do I still have to go to three offices to complete the application? Toni: No, the council centralized the services. Everything is in the same building now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：办完申请还得跑三个办公室吗？托尼：不用，地方议会把服务集中起来了。现在都在同一栋楼里。

messages.speaker: Marta (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji biex inlesti l-applikazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għad irrid immur fi tliet uffiċċji biex inlesti l-applikazzjoni?
messages.zh: 办完申请还得跑三个办公室吗？
messages.en: Do I still have to go to three offices to complete the application?

messages.speaker: Toni (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-kunsill iċċentralizza s-servizzi. Issa kollox fl-istess bini.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-kunsill iċċentralizza s-servizzi. Issa kollox fl-istess bini.
messages.zh: 不用，地方议会把服务集中起来了。现在都在同一栋楼里。
messages.en: No, the council centralized the services. Everything is in the same building now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出三个分散的服务窗口，再用箭头把它们汇入同一栋楼，记住“集中设置、统一管理”。

gloss_zh: 乘以一百；使变为一百倍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To multiply a number or quantity by one hundred, making it one hundred times its original value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个数或数量乘以一百，使结果成为原值的一百倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timmultiplika numru jew kwantità b'mija, biex ir-riżultat ikun mitt darba l-valur oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘以一百；使成为原来的百倍。

collocations.en: multiplied the number by one hundred
increased the amount to one hundred times its original value
collocations.zh: 使数量变为了原来的一百倍

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-għalliem iċċentuplika l-valur inizjali minn tlieta għal tliet mija.
formal.en: In this example, the teacher multiplied the initial value by one hundred, from three to three hundred.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，教师把初始值乘以一百，从三变为三百。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif minn tnejn wasalt għal mitejn? David: Iċċentuplikajt in-numru: immultiplikajt tnejn b'mija.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did you get from two to two hundred? David: I multiplied the number by a hundred: two times one hundred.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你怎么从二算到二百的？戴维：我把这个数变成了一百倍，也就是二乘以一百。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif minn tnejn wasalt għal mitejn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif minn tnejn wasalt għal mitejn?
messages.zh: 你怎么从二算到二百的？
messages.en: How did you get from two to two hundred?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 我把这个数变成了一百倍，也就是二乘以一百。
messages.en: I multiplied the number by a hundred: two times one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用算式“3 × 100 = 300”作记忆卡：结果是原数的一百倍，明确记成乘法操作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fit a hoop around something or surround it in a circle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某物外面套上箍圈，或用一圈东西将其围住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed ċirku madwar xi ħaġa jew idawwarha b'xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物加箍；环绕或围住某物。

collocations.en: encircle a well with a ring of stones

formal.mt: Il-buttar iċċerkja l-bettija b'żewġ ċrieki tal-ħadid biex iżomm it-twavel f'posthom.
formal.en: The cooper fitted two iron hoops around the barrel to hold its wooden staves in place.
formal.zh: 制桶匠给木桶套上了两个铁箍，将桶板固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dawk iċ-ċrieki madwar il-bettija? Pawlu: In-nannu ċċerkja l-bettija biex it-twavel jibqgħu f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are those hoops around the barrel? Pawlu: Grandpa put hoops around the barrel to keep the staves in place.
colloquial.zh: Maja：木桶外面为什么套着那些圈？Pawlu：爷爷给木桶加了箍，让桶板保持固定。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawk iċ-ċrieki madwar il-bettija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawk iċ-ċrieki madwar il-bettija?
messages.zh: 木桶外面为什么套着那些圈？
messages.en: Why are those hoops around the barrel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu ċċerkja l-bettija biex it-twavel jibqgħu f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu ċċerkja l-bettija biex it-twavel jibqgħu f'posthom.
messages.zh: 爷爷给木桶加了箍，让桶板保持固定。
messages.en: Grandpa put hoops around the barrel to keep the staves in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木桶外面套上一圈铁箍：从“加箍”这个动作，联想到“围成一圈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally confirm that a fact is true or that something meets stated requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式证明某项事实属实，或确认某物符合规定的要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkonferma b'mod uffiċjali li fatt huwa minnu jew li xi ħaġa tissodisfa rekwiżiti stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式证明；出具证明；认证符合要求。

collocations.en: certify a copy of a document
certify that the work has been completed

formal.mt: L-inġinier iċċertifika li x-xogħol tlesta skont il-pjan approvat.
formal.en: The engineer certified that the work had been completed according to the approved plan.
formal.zh: 工程师正式证明，该项工程已按照获批方案完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kopja hija ċċertifikata? Mark: Iva, in-nutar iċċertifika li taqbel mal-oriġinal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this copy certified? Mark: Yes, the notary certified that it matches the original.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份副本经过认证了吗？Mark：是的，公证人证明它与原件一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.zh: 这份副本经过认证了吗？
messages.en: Is this copy certified?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nutar iċċertifika li taqbel mal-oriġinal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nutar iċċertifika li taqbel mal-oriġinal.
messages.zh: 是的，公证人证明它与原件一致。
messages.en: Yes, the notary certified that it matches the original.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与文件上的认证印章配对记忆：有人正式确认事实，才是“证明、认证”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To read a notarial act aloud to the person or people concerned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向相关当事人朗读公证文书的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqra att notarili b'leħen għoli lill-persuna jew lill-persuni kkonċernati.

sense_translations.en_definition: to read a notarial act to (someone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人宣读公证文书。

collocations.en: read a notarial act to the parties
collocations.zh: 向各方当事人宣读公证文书

collocations.en: read a notarial act to the buyer

formal.mt: In-nutar iċċerzjora lill-partijiet billi qara l-att kollu b'leħen għoli qabel l-iffirmar.
formal.en: The notary read the notarial act to the parties, reading the entire document aloud before signing.
formal.zh: 公证人在签署前，向各方当事人完整宣读了公证文书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nutar qralek l-att qabel iffirmajt? Pawlu: Iva, in-nutar iċċerzjora lili u lix-xerrej l-ieħor qabel iffirmajna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the notary read the act to you before you signed? Pawlu: Yes, the notary read it to me and the other buyer before we signed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你签字之前，公证人向你宣读文书了吗？Pawlu：是的，公证人在我们签字前，向我和另一位买方宣读了文书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你签字之前，公证人向你宣读文书了吗？
messages.en: Did the notary read the act to you before you signed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nutar iċċerzjora lili u lix-xerrej l-ieħor qabel iffirmajna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nutar iċċerzjora lili u lix-xerrej l-ieħor qabel iffirmajna.
messages.zh: 是的，公证人在我们签字前，向我和另一位买方宣读了文书。
messages.en: Yes, the notary read it to me and the other buyer before we signed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“公证人开口、当事人听文书”的场景，把这个专门动词与宣读公证文书绑定。

gloss_zh: 闲混度日；四处闲逛；举止失当

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time idly, wander about without a useful purpose, or engage in improper behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间、漫无目的地四处闲逛，或做出不得体的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi l-ħin bla ma tagħmel xejn utli, iddur minn post għal ieħor bla skop, jew iġġib ruħek b'mod mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass the time in idleness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间；闲混度日。
四处闲逛；漫无目的地到处游荡。
做出不得体的举动；放任自己举止失当。

collocations.en: gadded about from place to place
collocations.zh: 从一个地方闲逛到另一个地方

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ qatta' l-għodwa jiċċerċer fil-pjazza minflok iwettaq ix-xogħol li kien ingħata.
formal.en: In the story, the young man spent the morning idling in the square instead of doing the work he had been assigned.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个年轻人整个上午都在广场上闲混，没有完成分配给他的工作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu Pawlu? Għadna qed nistennewh biex nibdew. Karl: Qiegħed jiċċerċer barra mal-ħbieb. Se ngħidlu jidħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is Pawlu? We're still waiting for him so we can start. Karl: He's hanging around outside with his friends. I'll tell him to come in.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗在哪里？我们还等着他开始呢。卡尔：他在外面和朋友闲混。我去叫他进来。

messages.speaker: Rita (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu? Għadna qed nistennewh biex nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu? Għadna qed nistennewh biex nibdew.
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？我们还等着他开始呢。
messages.en: Where is Pawlu? We're still waiting for him so we can start.

messages.speaker: Karl (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed jiċċerċer barra mal-ħbieb. Se ngħidlu jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed jiċċerċer barra mal-ħbieb. Se ngħidlu jidħol.
messages.zh: 他在外面和朋友闲混。我去叫他进来。
messages.en: He's hanging around outside with his friends. I'll tell him to come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面分开记：坐着闲混、到处闲逛、举止不得体；结合上下文选择对应意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an anchored vessel to drift because its anchor drags along the bottom instead of holding firmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指停泊的船因锚未能牢牢抓住水底、被拖着移动而发生漂移。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal bastiment li jiċċaqlaq għax l-ankra titkaxkar mal-qiegħ minflok iżżommu f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走锚；船锚沿水底拖动，导致船只漂移。

collocations.en: dragged anchor because of strong winds

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-bastiment iċċessa minħabba r-riħ qawwi u tbiegħed mill-post fejn kien ankrat.
formal.en: During the night, the vessel dragged anchor because of strong winds and moved away from its anchorage.
formal.zh: 夜间，船只因强风走锚，偏离了原来的锚泊位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-bastiment qiegħed aktar 'il barra? Mark: Il-bastiment iċċessa matul il-lejl; l-ankra ma żammitux f'postu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the vessel farther out? Mark: It dragged anchor during the night; the anchor did not hold it in place.
colloquial.zh: Sara：船怎么移到更外面去了？Mark：船夜里走锚了，锚没能把它固定在原位。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 船怎么移到更外面去了？
messages.en: Why is the vessel farther out?

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bastiment iċċessa matul il-lejl; l-ankra ma żammitux f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bastiment iċċessa matul il-lejl; l-ankra ma żammitux f'postu.
messages.zh: 船夜里走锚了，锚没能把它固定在原位。
messages.en: It dragged anchor during the night; the anchor did not hold it in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锚还在水底，却被船拖着滑动：锚抓不牢，船就漂移，这就是“走锚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk informally with someone, either in person or through written messages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别人轻松、非正式地交谈，可以当面聊天，也可以通过文字消息交流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod informali ma' xi ħadd, wiċċ imb wiċċ jew permezz ta' messaġġi miktuba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聊天；闲聊；通过消息轻松交谈。

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, Pawlu ċċettja mal-parteċipanti dwar l-esperjenzi tagħhom fil-kors.
formal.en: After the meeting, Pawlu chatted with the participants about their experiences on the course.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，Pawlu与参与者聊了聊他们的课程经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu waqt il-brejk? Sara: Pawlu ċċettja magħna dwar il-vaganzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do during the break? Sara: Pawlu chatted with us about the holidays.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu休息时做了什么？Sara：Pawlu和我们聊了聊假期。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu休息时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do during the break?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu和我们聊了聊假期。
