messages.en: Pawlu chatted with us about the holidays.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进课间聊假期、网上发消息的画面里，记住轻松随意的“聊天”感。

gloss_zh: 变得邋遢；陷入困境；犯错

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become shabby or unkempt in appearance; in other uses, to fall on hard times or make an error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外表变得破旧或不整洁；在其他用法中，也可指生活陷入困境或犯下错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir traskurat fid-dehra; f'użi oħra, jaqa' f'qagħda diffiċli jew jagħmel żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外表变得邋遢、不整洁或显得破旧。
时运不济；生活或经济状况陷入困境。
犯错；出现失误。

collocations.en: make an error in the calculation

formal.mt: Pawlu ċċewlaħ fil-kalkolu tal-ispejjeż, iżda kkoreġa l-iżball qabel ippreżenta r-rapport.
formal.en: Pawlu made an error in calculating the costs, but corrected it before presenting the report.
formal.zh: Pawlu在计算费用时出了错，但在提交报告前纠正了错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu jidher traskurat dan l-aħħar. Sara: Iva, ċċewlaħ fid-dehra; se nistaqsih jekk għandux bżonn xi għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has been looking unkempt lately. Sara: Yes, his appearance has become shabby; I'll ask him whether he needs any help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu最近看起来不太整洁。Sara：是啊，他的外表变得邋遢了；我会问问他是否需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu最近看起来不太整洁。
messages.en: Pawlu has been looking unkempt lately.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ċċewlaħ fid-dehra; se nistaqsih jekk għandux bżonn xi għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ċċewlaħ fid-dehra; se nistaqsih jekk għandux bżonn xi għajnuna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他的外表变得邋遢了；我会问问他是否需要帮助。
messages.en: Yes, his appearance has become shabby; I'll ask him whether he needs any help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立画面记义项：衣着邋遢、生活困顿、算错数字；根据上下文判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave foolishly or make a decision that is wrong or unwise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为愚蠢、做出傻事，或作出错误、不明智的决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod iblah jew jieħu deċiżjoni ħażina jew mhux għaqlija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做傻事；行事愚蠢。
作出错误的决定；选择失当。

collocations.en: act foolishly in front of everyone

formal.mt: Id-direttur iċċewweċ meta għażel l-orħos offerta mingħajr ma eżamina l-kwalità tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The director made an unwise decision when he chose the cheapest bid without examining the quality of the work.
formal.zh: 主管没有考察工程质量就选择了最低报价，作出了不明智的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark xtara biljett għad-data ħażina? Pawlu: Mark iċċewweċ meta għaġġel; messu ċċekkja d-data.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark buy a ticket for the wrong date? Pawlu: Mark acted foolishly by rushing; he should have checked the date.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么买了日期不对的票？Pawlu：Mark太着急，做了傻事；他本该核对日期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark xtara biljett għad-data ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark xtara biljett għad-data ħażina?
messages.zh: Mark为什么买了日期不对的票？
messages.en: Why did Mark buy a ticket for the wrong date?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark iċċewweċ meta għaġġel; messu ċċekkja d-data.
messages.mt_standard: Mark iċċewweċ meta għaġġel; messu ċċekkja d-data.
messages.zh: Mark太着急，做了傻事；他本该核对日期。
messages.en: Mark acted foolishly by rushing; he should have checked the date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象没看日期就急着买票：行为上是“做傻事”，选择上是“作出错误决定”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a surface to be paved or cobbled, or for a material to become hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指路面等被铺上石块或卵石；也指材料变硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal wiċċ li jinkesa bil-ġebel jew biċ-ċagħaq, jew għal materjal li jsir iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被铺上石块或卵石；成为石铺路面。
变硬；硬化。

collocations.en: the path was paved with stones

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħlijiet, il-passaġġ iċċiegħek biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jimxu fuqu mingħajr ma jgħaddu mit-tajn.
formal.en: During the works, the path was paved with stones so that visitors could walk along it without going through mud.
formal.zh: 施工期间，小路被铺上了石块，让访客能够沿路行走而不必踩过泥地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tajn għadu artab? Pawlu: Le, it-tajn iċċiegħek wara li nixef fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the mud still soft? Pawlu: No, the mud hardened after drying in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Maja：泥土还是软的吗？Pawlu：不是，泥土在太阳下晒干后变硬了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 泥土还是软的吗？
messages.en: Is the mud still soft?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-tajn iċċiegħek wara li nixef fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-tajn iċċiegħek wara li nixef fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 不是，泥土在太阳下晒干后变硬了。
messages.en: No, the mud hardened after drying in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅画面：小路铺上坚硬石块，软泥晒干后变硬；分别对应铺石与硬化两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lucky, especially when something turns out well by chance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因运气好而遇到好事，尤其指事情碰巧有了有利的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollok ix-xorti u xi ħaġa tiġik tajba b'kumbinazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to luck out, to be lucky
sense_translations.zh_definition: 走运；交好运；碰巧获得有利的结果。

collocations.en: got lucky and found a place

formal.mt: Il-grupp ċċikkja bit-temp: ix-xita bdiet biss wara li ntemmet iż-żjara.
formal.en: The group got lucky with the weather: the rain began only after the visit had ended.
formal.zh: 这个团队碰上了好天气：参观结束后才开始下雨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sab post daqshekk qrib id-daħla? Luka: Ċċikkja! Xi ħadd telaq eżatt qabel wasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he find a space so close to the entrance? Luka: He got lucky! Someone left just before he arrived.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么找到离入口这么近的位置的？卢卡：他走运了！刚好有人在他到之前离开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sab post daqshekk qrib id-daħla?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sab post daqshekk qrib id-daħla?
messages.zh: 他怎么找到离入口这么近的位置的？
messages.en: How did he find a space so close to the entrance?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċċikkja! Xi ħadd telaq eżatt qabel wasal.
messages.mt_standard: Ċċikkja! Xi ħadd telaq eżatt qabel wasal.
messages.zh: 他走运了！刚好有人在他到之前离开。
messages.en: He got lucky! Someone left just before he arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚到门口就空出一个停车位，把这个词与“碰巧走运”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a belt or strap around something to hold it securely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用腰带或绑带围住某物，使它固定牢靠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ddawwar ċinturin jew ċinga ma' xi ħaġa biex iżżommha soda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to girdle, to secure with a strap
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用带子环绕；用绑带固定或绑牢。

collocations.en: secured the suitcase with a strap

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċċingja t-tagħbija biex ma tiċċaqlaqx waqt il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The worker secured the load with straps so that it would not move during the journey.
formal.zh: 工人用绑带固定了货物，防止它在运输途中移动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ċċingja l-bagalja tiegħi? Mark: Jien. Iċ-ċinga żżommha magħluqa waqt il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who put a strap around my suitcase? Mark: I did. The strap keeps it closed during the journey.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁给我的行李箱绑了带子？马克：我绑的。带子能让它在旅途中保持合拢。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 谁给我的行李箱绑了带子？
messages.en: Who put a strap around my suitcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Iċ-ċinga żżommha magħluqa waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Iċ-ċinga żżommha magħluqa waqt il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 我绑的。带子能让它在旅途中保持合拢。
messages.en: I did. The strap keeps it closed during the journey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绑带绕行李箱一圈后扣紧，把“环绕”和“固定”两个动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 涉及；参与其中；与某事有关

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be involved in something or have a connection with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与某件事情，或与该事情存在关联。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollok x'taqsam ma' xi ħaġa jew tkun involut fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与某事；牵涉其中；与某事有关。

formal.mt: Pawlu ċċintra fil-kwistjoni minħabba r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu fuq ix-xogħol.
formal.en: Pawlu was involved in the matter because of his responsibilities at work.
formal.zh: 由于工作职责，保罗参与了这件事。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ċċintra Pawlu f'din il-kwistjoni? Adam: Hu responsabbli għall-iskeda, għalhekk kellmu lilu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Pawlu become involved in this matter? Adam: He is responsible for the schedule, so they spoke to him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗怎么会参与这件事？亚当：他负责时间安排，所以他们找他谈了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么会参与这件事？
messages.en: How did Pawlu become involved in this matter?

messages.speaker: Adam (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu responsabbli għall-iskeda, għalhekk kellmu lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu responsabbli għall-iskeda, għalhekk kellmu lilu.
messages.zh: 他负责时间安排，所以他们找他谈了。
messages.en: He is responsible for the schedule, so they spoke to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张人物与事件的连线图：某人与事情连上线，就表示他参与其中或与它有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone in prison; in a separate sense, to chip or break something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人关进监狱；另一个义项是使某物出现缺口或破损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ddaħħal lil xi ħadd il-ħabs; f'tifsira oħra, li taqla' biċċa minn xi ħaġa jew tkisserha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监禁；把某人关进监狱。
磕掉一小块；使出现缺口；弄破或打碎。

collocations.en: chipped the edge of the plate
collocations.zh: 把盘子边缘磕出了缺口

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-re ċċippja lill-avversarju tiegħu wara l-ġlieda għall-poter.
formal.en: In the novel, the king imprisoned his rival after the struggle for power.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，国王在权力斗争后把对手关进了监狱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċċippja dan il-platt? Ben: Jien. Waqa' minni waqt li kont qed naħslu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who chipped this plate? Ben: I did. I dropped it while I was washing it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这个盘子磕破了？本：是我。我洗盘子时没拿稳，让它掉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把这个盘子磕破了？
messages.en: Who chipped this plate?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Waqa' minni waqt li kont qed naħslu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Waqa' minni waqt li kont qed naħslu.
messages.zh: 是我。我洗盘子时没拿稳，让它掉了。
messages.en: I did. I dropped it while I was washing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张记忆卡：一张画监狱铁门，一张画缺口盘子，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or move around someone or something on all sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从四周围住某人或某物，或位于其周围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun jew tmur madwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa min-naħat kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包围；围住；环绕在周围。

formal.mt: It-tim tas-salvataġġ ċċirkonda l-bini biex ifittex daħla sigura.
formal.en: The rescue team surrounded the building to look for a safe entrance.
formal.zh: 救援队在建筑物四周展开，寻找安全的入口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-grupp ċċirkonda l-mejda? Toni: Biex kulħadd seta' jara l-mappa fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the group gather around the table? Toni: So that everyone could see the map in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：大家为什么围住了桌子？托尼：这样每个人都能看到放在中间的地图。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 大家为什么围住了桌子？
messages.en: Why did the group gather around the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex kulħadd seta' jara l-mappa fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Biex kulħadd seta' jara l-mappa fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 这样每个人都能看到放在中间的地图。
messages.en: So that everyone could see the map in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸中央画一栋房子，再在四周画人，利用“从各方向围住”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set clear limits around an area, subject, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为区域、主题或活动划定明确界限，使其限于一定范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tistabbilixxi limiti ċari għal żona, suġġett jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划定界限；限定范围；使局限于一定界限内。

collocations.en: defined the limits of the study

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ċċirkoskriva l-ambitu tal-istudju għal tliet lokalitajiet.
formal.en: The committee circumscribed the scope of the study to three localities.
formal.zh: 委员会把研究范围限定在三个地区。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-għalliem ċċirkoskriva s-suġġett daqshekk? Mark: Biex niffukaw fuq mistoqsija waħda u nispiċċaw fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the teacher limit the topic so much? Mark: So that we focus on one question and finish on time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：老师为什么把题目范围限定得这么窄？马克：为了让我们集中回答一个问题，并按时完成。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 老师为什么把题目范围限定得这么窄？
messages.en: Why did the teacher limit the topic so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niffukaw fuq mistoqsija waħda u nispiċċaw fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niffukaw fuq mistoqsija waħda u nispiċċaw fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 为了让我们集中回答一个问题，并按时完成。
messages.en: So that we focus on one question and finish on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师给大题目画一个边框，只讨论框内内容，以此记住“划界、限定范围”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move around or pass from one place or person to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不同地点之间流动，或在人与人之间传递、流通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor jew tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 循环；流通；流传；在人群中传递或传阅。

collocations.en: the report circulated among the members

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ċċirkula fost il-membri tal-kumitat qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The report circulated among the committee members before the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，报告已在委员会成员之间传阅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-messaġġ ċċirkula fil-grupp? Ben: Iva, kulħadd diġà rah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this message circulated in the group? Ben: Yes, everyone has already seen it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条消息已经在群里传开了吗？本：是的，大家都已经看过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (群组成员)
messages.zh: 这条消息已经在群里传开了吗？
messages.en: Has this message circulated in the group?

messages.speaker: Ben (群组成员)
messages.zh: 是的，大家都已经看过了。
messages.en: Yes, everyone has already seen it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份报告从一个人传到下一个人，再传遍全组，把连续传递的路线记在脑中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repeat someone's words or refer to a source as support for a statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引述他人的话语，或援引资料来源来支持自己的陈述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tirrepeti kliem ħaddieħor jew tirreferi għal sors biex issostni dak li tgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引用或引述他人的话；援引文献、资料或其他来源。

collocations.en: quoted a passage from the book
collocations.zh: 引用了书中的一段文字

formal.mt: L-istudent ċċita żewġ studji xjentifiċi biex isostni l-argument tiegħu.
formal.en: The student cited two scientific studies to support his argument.
formal.zh: 这名学生援引了两项科学研究来支持自己的论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kittieb ċċita l-għalliem illum? Luka: Ċċita lill-awtur tal-ktieb li qed naqraw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which writer did the teacher quote today? Luka: He quoted the author of the book we are reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师今天引用了哪位作家的话？卢卡：他引用了我们正在读的那本书的作者的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 老师今天引用了哪位作家的话？
messages.en: Which writer did the teacher quote today?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċċita lill-awtur tal-ktieb li qed naqraw.
messages.mt_standard: Ċċita lill-awtur tal-ktieb li qed naqraw.
messages.zh: 他引用了我们正在读的那本书的作者的话。
messages.en: He quoted the author of the book we are reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象写文章时给一句话加上引号，再标明出处，用“引号加来源”的画面记住引用。

gloss_zh: 使文明化；使行为文明有礼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring people or their behaviour towards standards considered civilized, orderly, or courteous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或其行为符合被视为文明、有秩序或有礼貌的标准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwassal lin-nies jew lill-imġiba tagħhom lejn dak li jitqies ċivili, ordnat jew edukat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使文明化；使行为变得文明有礼。

collocations.zh: 使自己的行为更加文明
使辩论变得更加文明有礼

formal.mt: Il-moderatur ċċivilizza d-dibattitu billi insista fuq ir-rispett bejn il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The moderator made the debate more civil by insisting on respect among the participants.
formal.zh: 主持人坚持要求参与者相互尊重，使辩论变得更加文明有礼。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar id-dibattitu lbieraħ? Pawlu: Aħjar mis-soltu; il-moderatur ċċivilizza d-diskussjoni u kulħadd seta' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the debate go yesterday? Pawlu: Better than usual; the moderator made the discussion more civil, and everyone had a chance to speak.
colloquial.zh: Marija：昨天的辩论怎么样？Pawlu：比平时好；主持人让讨论变得更有礼貌，每个人都有机会发言。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的辩论怎么样？
messages.en: How did the debate go yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar mis-soltu; il-moderatur ċċivilizza d-diskussjoni u kulħadd seta' jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar mis-soltu; il-moderatur ċċivilizza d-diskussjoni u kulħadd seta' jitkellem.
messages.zh: 比平时好；主持人让讨论变得更有礼貌，每个人都有机会发言。
messages.en: Better than usual; the moderator made the discussion more civil, and everyone had a chance to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象吵闹的讨论经过主持人协调，变成轮流发言；用这个画面记住“使行为文明有礼”的动作义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut, shape, or carve a material using a chisel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用凿子切削、修整或雕刻材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqta', jagħti forma jew inaqqax materjal b'skarpell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用凿子凿削、修整或雕刻。

collocations.en: chiseled the letters into the marble

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ċċiżella l-ittri fl-irħam b'attenzjoni kbira.
formal.en: The craftsman chiseled the letters into the marble with great care.
formal.zh: 工匠十分仔细地在大理石上凿刻字母。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel dawn l-ittri fuq il-ġebla? Toni: Missieri ċċiżella kull ittra bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made these letters on the stone? Toni: My father chiseled every letter by hand.
colloquial.zh: Lara：石头上的这些字母是谁刻的？Toni：我父亲用凿子逐个手工刻出来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dawn l-ittri fuq il-ġebla?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dawn l-ittri fuq il-ġebla?
messages.zh: 石头上的这些字母是谁刻的？
messages.en: Who made these letters on the stone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我父亲用凿子逐个手工刻出来的。
messages.en: My father chiseled every letter by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“凿子轻敲石面、逐笔刻出字母”的画面绑定，重点记住工具是凿子、动作是雕凿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To splice lengths of rope or similar material; in other senses, to catch someone red-handed or to hit a target.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把绳索等材料绞接起来；另可表示当场抓住正在做坏事的人，或击中目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħaqqad biċċiet ta' ħabel jew materjal simili; f'tifsiriet oħra, li jaqbad lil xi ħadd fil-fatt jew jolqot mira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绞接；把绳索等材料的端部接合起来。
当场抓获；在某人正在做坏事时将其抓住。
击中它；打中所指的目标。

formal.mt: Il-baħri ċċomba żewġ biċċiet tal-ħabel biex jagħmel ħabel wieħed itwal.
formal.en: The sailor spliced two pieces of rope to make one longer rope.
formal.zh: 水手把两段绳索绞接起来，接成一根更长的绳子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħalliel ħarab? Mark: Le, il-gwardjan ċċomba lill-ħalliel waqt li kien qed jisraq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the thief get away? Mark: No, the guard caught the thief red-handed while he was stealing.
colloquial.zh: Rita：小偷逃走了吗？Mark：没有，保安在他行窃时当场抓住了他。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 小偷逃走了吗？
messages.en: Did the thief get away?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-gwardjan ċċomba lill-ħalliel waqt li kien qed jisraq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-gwardjan ċċomba lill-ħalliel waqt li kien qed jisraq.
messages.zh: 没有，保安在他行窃时当场抓住了他。
messages.en: No, the guard caught the thief red-handed while he was stealing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记三个义项：绳头接合、小偷当场被抓、球击中目标；看上下文选择，不把三义混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause paralysis, or to become paralyzed and unable to move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或身体部位瘫痪，也可表示自身陷入无法活动的瘫痪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża paraliżi, jew li jispiċċa paralizzat u ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使瘫痪；使人或身体部位失去活动能力。
瘫痪；处于无法活动的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-inċident ċċonga lir-raġel u biddel il-ħajja tiegħu ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The report describes how the accident paralyzed the man and changed his daily life.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这起事故如何使该男子瘫痪，并改变了他的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Pietru juża siġġu tar-roti? Luqa: Hu ċċonga wara l-inċident, u s-siġġu jgħinu jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does Pietru use a wheelchair? Luqa: He became paralyzed after the accident, and the chair helps him get around.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pietru为什么使用轮椅？Luqa：他在事故后瘫痪了，轮椅帮助他出行。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Pietru为什么使用轮椅？
messages.en: Why does Pietru use a wheelchair?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ċċonga wara l-inċident, u s-siġġu jgħinu jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ċċonga wara l-inċident, u s-siġġu jgħinu jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 他在事故后瘫痪了，轮椅帮助他出行。
messages.en: He became paralyzed after the accident, and the chair helps him get around.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“事故使他瘫痪”和“他瘫痪了”两句对照记忆：同一词既能表达造成瘫痪，也能表达自身瘫痪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement or act of saying that something is not true or did not happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事不属实或未发生的声明或行为，即否认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew att li bih wieħed jgħid li xi ħaġa mhix vera jew ma seħħitx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否认；表示某事不属实的声明或行为。

formal.mt: L-istqarrija tinkludi ċħid ċar tal-allegazzjonijiet magħmula kontra l-kumpanija.
formal.en: The statement includes a clear denial of the allegations made against the company.
formal.zh: 该声明明确否认了针对公司的指称。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt it-tweġiba tagħhom? Mark: Iva, fiha ċħid tal-allegazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you read their response? Mark: Yes, it contains a denial of the allegations.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你读了他们的回应吗？马克：读了，里面否认了那些指称。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你读了他们的回应吗？
messages.en: Did you read their response?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 读了，里面否认了那些指称。
messages.en: Yes, it contains a denial of the allegations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“对某事的否认”这个名词框架，联想一份写着“并非如此”的声明。
